passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Bandit Leader (Pup)
passages.content:
Bandit Leader: So the runt made it here.
Pup: Ready to talk now? I'd even be up for trying that 
"blade to your throat" idea of yours, too. Dealer's 
choice.
passages.content_zh:
強盜首領：所以這個矮子就到了這裡。
小狗：現在準備好說話了嗎？我甚至願意嘗試一下
「把刀抵著你的喉嚨」也是你的想法。經銷商的
選擇。

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Bandit Leader (Satia)
passages.content:
Bandit Leader: Heh, no biting comment this time? I wonder if your 
bite is as a bad as your bark.
Satia: There is no need. Your value is as dead as you 
yourself will soon be.
passages.content_zh:
盜匪首領： 哼，這次沒什麼尖酸刻薄的評論了嗎？我倒想知道你的咬勁是不是跟你叫聲一樣遜。
莎提亞： 沒那個必要。你的價值就跟你即將死去的自己一樣。

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Bandit Leader (Rowan)
passages.content:
Bandit Leader: You fucking brat... I'll pry it off your cold dead 
body.
Rowan: That does remind me. You wouldn't happen to 
have gold on you? You still owe me for that craps 
game I won.
Bandit Leader: You fucking- ...hehehe... I'm gonna enjoy this.
passages.content_zh:
強盜頭子：你這他媽的小鬼...我會從你冰冷的屍體上把它撬下來。
羅文：說到這個倒是提醒我了。你身上剛好有金幣嗎？你還欠我上次擲骰子遊戲贏你的錢。
強盜頭子：你他媽的- ...呵呵呵...我會好好享受的。

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Bandit Leader (Dead)
passages.content:
Bandit Leader: Fuck... So close... Just needed... to...kill the... 
brat...
passages.content_zh:
強盜首領：幹……這麼近……只是需要……殺死那個……
臭小子...

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Intro
passages.content:
Rowan: Arrghh!!!
The man stumbled over his feet and he burst 
forward from the forest.

But the fall to the dirt soon turned into an elegant 
roll that returned him to his feet.
Rowan: Ah! Salvation~
Bandit Leader: It's that fucking brat!? Why now of all times?!
Ivan: Don't tell me...?
Satia: Dammit! That cretin... We were distracted.
Rowan: I, a most humbled traveling bard, am at your 
service.
Pup: B- Bard?! You have a mini army after you!
Rowan: Everyone's a critic these days.
Ivan: So you're what they're after, eh?

He seems to be a fair source of information, at 
least. Pup. Satia. Keep the boy safe.
Win Condition: Defeat the Bandit Leader. 

Lose Condition: Anyone gets killed.
Win Condition: Defeat the Bandit Leader. 

Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan or Ivan die
passages.content_zh:
羅溫：啊啊啊！！！
那人絆到自己的腳，從森林裡衝了出來。

但跌倒在泥土裡很快變成一個優雅的翻滾，讓他重新站穩腳步。
羅溫：啊！得救了～
盜賊首領：是那個他媽的小鬼！？為什麼偏偏是現在？！
伊凡：難道是...？
莎提雅：可惡！那個白痴... 我們分心了。
羅溫：我，一個最謙卑的旅行吟遊詩人，為您效勞。
小狗：吟、吟遊詩人？！你後面有一支迷你軍隊在追你啊！
羅溫：現在每個人都是評論家。
伊凡：所以他們要找的是你，是吧？

他似乎是個不錯的情報來源，至少。小狗。莎提雅。保護好那個男孩。
勝利條件：擊敗盜賊首領。

失敗條件：任何人死亡。
勝利條件：擊敗盜賊首領。

失敗條件：小狗、羅溫或伊凡死亡

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Thief Steals
passages.content: The chest contents have been stolen!
passages.content_zh: 寶箱裡的東西被偷走了！

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Tut1
passages.content:
With a proper party in tow, it's time we talked 
about mechanics like the convoy.

The convoy is the inventory for items that do not 
fit in individual character inventories.

Pup, the main character, has access to this at all 
times in battle. Other characters in spaces next to
him can also access it.
The camp menu between chapters will later let you 
freely move items and weapons between the 
convoy and characters. Make sure to use it!
passages.content_zh:
有了適當的聚會，是時候我們談談了
關於車隊等機械師。

車隊是不包含的物品的庫存
適合個人角色庫存。

主角 Pup 完全可以存取此內容
戰鬥中的次數。旁邊空格中的其他字符
他也可以訪問它。
章節之間的營地菜單稍後會讓你
在不同區域之間自由移動物品和武器
車隊和人物。請務必使用它！

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Tut2
passages.content:
With a few good slashes and stabs at the enemy, 
you've probably noticed that the number next to
each characters' weapons have went down.
This is called weapon durability. Weapons have 
limited uses, and you should take care not to burn 
through a good weapon too quickly.
At the same time, you cannot just neglect 
attacking. Along with experience, characters also 
have a Weapon Rank.
There are 5 weapons ranks (E->A). Every use 
increases a unit's experience with the weapon, and 
higher rankings let you equip better weapons.
passages.content_zh:
對敵人進行了幾次猛烈的砍擊和刺刺，
您可能已經注意到旁邊的數字
每個角色的武器都下降了。
這就是所謂的武器耐久性。武器有
用途有限，注意不要燃燒
過快地通過一把好武器。
同時，你也不能忽視
攻擊。除了經驗之外，角色也
有武器等級。
有 5 個武器等級（E->A）。每次使用
增加單位使用武器的經驗，並且
更高的排名可以讓你裝備更好的武器。

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Win
passages.content:
What remained of the bandits scattered in a panic.
Pup: They're getting away!
Ivan: It's fine. With the head cut off, they'll be no major 
trouble any time soon.
Satia: I do hope we gave them a few lengthy nightmares 
to keep them company, at least.
Pup: Right...
Pup: There's still something we need to do, right? Or do 
we already have the full story?
Ivan: The boy said some interesting stuff before, but due 
diligence is half the job.
Pup: Where is he anyways?
My head swiveled to find the man from before 
squatting over the dead body of the bandit leader.
Pup: Forget something?
Rowan: ...
Pup: Ilvanis to... bard man!
Pup: Of course... this was already one of those days. We 
don't even have your name yet, do we?
Satia: True. I do not believe we had a chance.
Rowan: Haha... Serendipitous, isn't it?
Rowan: (Clears throat)
The man spun on his heel all the way to a standing 
position. He found himself looking down on the 
smaller Pup.
Pup: H- Hey... A little close.
Rowan: ...
Rowan: My greatest condolences! Introductions are more 
than just a formality, of course.
Rowan: You may refer to me as Rowan. I am a traveling 
bard from the Kingdom of Cartenan.
Rowan: My journey brought me to Rabaneau so
I could offer my services in aiding
the weary soldiers.
Pup: So basically what we already knew. A bad bard that 
pissed off a group of bandits.
Rowan: A bit unfair of an assessment, do you not think? 
Perhaps a ballad would change your tune?
Pup: Ah, I think it might be your tune that's the issue. 
What with the bandits wanting to kill you.
Rowan: You do wound me, good sir.
Rowan: If anything, my song soothed their aching hearts... 
after I won their life savings in a game of chance.
Pup: That's... probably something we should talk to you 
in more detail about... later.
Pup: Anyways, it's nice to meet you. My name is Anton 
Baranov.
Pup: Along with my father, Ivan, and a comrade, Satia, 
we are all members of the Nightless Crow 
Mercenary Corp.
Rowan: A pleasure.
Pup: We'll see how long that sentiment lasts in this sit-
Pup: ...?!
A feeling of pressure encompassed me from behind. 
A soft... elastic... pressure.
Satia: "Comrade"? So unfamiliar, my little Pup. I thought 
we were closer.
Pup: C- Ca-... Can't... breathe...
Satia: Perhaps it's time we discussed this properly. Why 
not call me "Auntie Satia" from now on?
Pup: Let... me... go...!
Satia: What was that? It's four simple syllables. "AUN-TIE 
SA-TIA"
Pup: Not... Not on... your life...
Satia: ...
Rowan: Haha! What a beautiful display of
camaraderie!
Rowan: Perhaps I could slide-
Ivan: Rowan, was it?
Rowan: Indeed. It's been a pleasure.

Perhaps you'd like payment for your assistance 
here?

I do have my winnings... from...
Rowan: Winnings... from...?
Rowan looked down to find a rope tied around his 
wrists. Ivan finished tightening the knot.
Rowan: ...Pardon?
Ivan: By your account, you are the centerpiece of these 
recent disturbances in the region.

And as you said, we are by the border and the war. 
To say it simply, these matters are not taken
lightly.
Rowan: Am I under arrest, my good sir?
Ivan: Something like that. At least until the matter is 
investigated fully.
Ivan: Just be happy we aren't handing you over to the 
governors. Last time we spoke  there was some 
yelling over "making an example" out of somebody.
Rowan: Ah, so kind of you... my saviors...
Ivan: Pup. Head out and round up the other teams. 
We're heading back to town.
Satia: Say it.
Pup: Aun...tie... fuck you...
Rowan: Serendipitous, isn't it...?
The continent of Ilvanis. The year is 813.

To the east lies the ages old Holy War and crusades 
of the Covenant. Their target being the declining
dynastic nation, the Emerald Empire.
The central plains house the expansionist Republic 
of Rabaneau and their current war against the
Nolvanus Empire.
Westward even more, therein lies the prosperous 
trade hubs along the Crimson Sea, like the city 
state of Lockhart and the Kingdom of Cartenan.
To the south lies the Outlands, a mysterious region 
ill documented in our modern time.

The future days are shrouded in mystery as the 
theaters of war and peace reach stagnation points.

What fate is in the store for this growing world? 
Which levy shall break?

Only the Goddess may truly know.
passages.content_zh:
殘餘的盜賊驚慌失措地逃散了。
Pup: 他們要跑掉了！
Ivan: 沒事。斬首行動後，他們短期內不會有什麼大麻煩了。
Satia: 我真希望我們至少給了他們一些漫長的噩夢來陪伴他們。
Pup: 也是...
Pup: 我們還有什麼需要做的，對吧？還是我們已經知道全部的故事了？
Ivan: 那個男孩之前說了一些有趣的東西，但盡職調查是成功的一半。
Pup: 他人呢？
我轉頭發現之前那個人蹲在盜賊首領的屍體旁。
Pup: 忘了什麼東西嗎？
Rowan: ...
Pup: 伊爾瓦尼斯...吟遊詩人！
Pup: 果然...今天諸事不順。我們甚至還不知道你的名字，對吧？
Satia: 確實。我想我們沒有機會問。
Rowan: 哈哈...真是巧合，不是嗎？
Rowan: (清了清嗓子)
那個人轉身，一直轉到站立的位置。他發現自己俯視著矮小的Pup。
Pup: 欸...有點太近了。
Rowan: ...
Rowan: 我深感抱歉！自我介紹當然不僅僅是個形式。
Rowan: 你們可以稱呼我為Rowan。我是一位來自卡特南王國的旅行吟遊詩人。
Rowan: 我的旅程帶我來到拉巴諾，以便
我可以提供我的服務，幫助
疲憊的士兵們。
Pup: 所以基本上就是我們已經知道的。一個惹惱了一群盜賊的糟糕吟遊詩人。
Rowan: 這樣的評價有點不公平，你不覺得嗎？或許一首民謠可以改變你的看法？
Pup: 啊，我想問題可能出在你的曲子上。畢竟盜賊們想殺了你。
Rowan: 你真傷我的心，好先生。
Rowan: 如果要說的話，我的歌聲撫慰了他們痛苦的心...在我從一場機會遊戲中贏走他們畢生的積蓄之後。
Pup: 這...大概是我們之後需要更詳細地和你談談的事情...
Pup: 總之，很高興認識你。我叫Anton Baranov。
Pup: 和我的父親Ivan，以及一位同志Satia一起，我們都是不眠烏鴉傭兵團的成員。
Rowan: 很高興認識你們。
Pup: 我們走著瞧。

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Ivan → Rowan
passages.content:
Rowan: It's good to see a friendly face.
Ivan: Everything's relative, I suppose.

Your current value, relative to us,
relies on what you know, after all.
Rowan: P- Perhaps I can also offer a melody for your 
troubles?
passages.content_zh:
羅溫：很高興看到一張友善的臉。
伊凡：一切都是相對的，我想。

你目前的價值，相對於我們，
取決於你所知的一切，畢竟。
羅溫：或...或許我也可以為你的煩惱獻上一段旋律？

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Pup → Rowan
passages.content:
Pup: How did this turn out this way?
Rowan: Snake eyes.
Rowan: I am inclined to think their pursuit turned into an 
obsession after I won against their commander in a 
high stakes gamble.
Pup: I didn't need another reason to want to kill the 
guy. How ridiculous.
passages.content_zh:
小狗：怎麼會變成這樣呢？
羅文：蛇眼。
羅文：我傾向於認為他們的追求變成了
我在一場比賽中擊敗了他們的指揮官後的痴迷
高風險的賭博。
小狗：我不需要其他理由就想殺死它
傢伙。多麼可笑。

passages.name: Ch 1's Supply Run - P1
passages.content:
Pup: *Sigh*... *sigh*...
My hand gripped the sword even tighter, and my 
heavy panting subsided while I collected myself.

The figure across from me wore armor from head 
to toe and reflected my own visage.
Armored Figure: Hmph.
I smiled in response. This would be the last blow.
Pup: ...!
With a step forward, the heavy mail felt like 
feathers to my mind and the sword like any other.

His step matched mine and the two curtains of 
steel rallied forth towards a barrage of power 
to end it once and for all.
And so, steel came unto steel, until a winner 
was decided.

It was...
Pup: (Was...?)
Pup: Urgh!
I squirmed as a heavy weight entrapped my body. 

It wasn't long before my senses were jolted 
entirely to consciousness by a tongue swiping 
itself across my face.
Jakson: *Bark*!
Pup: G- Good afternoon to you, too.
In the corner of my vision, I spotted another figure 
to the side of my bedding. This one was 
positioned like he just dropped something.
Norde: You're awake. Good.

We're busier than normal with today's mission. You 
are now tasked with purchasing supplies in town 
for the corp at large.
Pup: What? Since when did we do that solo?
Norde: Jakson has volunteered to accompany you.
Pup: The... dog...? You're not serious, are you?
Norde: Try to finish up before the evening meal. We'll 
be questioning the prisoner at that point.
Pup: W- Wait!
Pup: I guess this is why we're called the 'Nightless 
Crows'... No rest for the weary.
Jakson: *Bark*!
Pup: And you're just excited for dinner? Can't say I 
blame you.
Pup: Might as well get on it.

...
Pup: Jakson... boy... move, please?
Jakson panted out a few chords that almost 
sounded like a chuckle to me. He did eventually 
get off me.
Pup: We could probably hang some of the 
groceries around your neck.
Jakson: *Whine*...
Pup: No complaints. We both know I can't carry a 
week's worth of food for a dozen plus people by 
myself.
Jakson: *Bark*!
The camp was full of a hustle and bustle as we 
made out way through it.
Satia: Pup? I'm lucky to have caught you before heading 
out.
Satia: Thank you for volunteering to handle the supply 
run today. I have a list prepared already for you to 
follow.
Pup: That really isn't the issue here.
My eyes skimmed over the parchment she 
handed me before running off.
Pup: (Seems pretty standard. Though...)
Pup: Boy, you think we should sneak a little more meat 
into the stock?
Jakson: *Bark*!
Pup: I knew you'd be on my side. You're actually a 
pretty good partner for this.
Jakson raised his head like he was trying to 
exude confidence.
Pup: (Enough people to drive the governors into a panic. 
This place is packed.)
We made our way through the village. It had seen 
an influx of people from the local bandit raids in 
the region.
Pup: ...and how about this one?
Jakson: *Whine*...
Pup: Rotten, then?
Merchant: You'd trust a dog over me? I've been at this for 
decades!
Pup: Come on, boy. There are better vendors to peruse.

(This guy is probably just trying to push what stock 
he has left because the mob already got 
everything good.)
The man scoffed, but he quickly found a 
different potential buyer to focus his attention on.

Our footsteps away from there left us at the stall of 
a more well stocked vendor.
Pup: Ma'am. You're not trying to sell rotten fruit, are 
you?
Merchant: By the Goddess, no. Was that basket of apples last 
time not any good?
Pup: Oh, n- no... Sorry, I didn't recognize you. The 
apples were good.
Merchant: Haha... You're not the only one of your mercenary 
corp to stop here. I was blessed with a bit 
more assistance in remembering you.
Pup: I am... sorry.
Pup: Even if it wasn't for that, I'd gladly do business 
here.
I was able to get much of Satia's list from the nice 
merchant lady.
Merchant: Have you been able to bulk up at all?
Pup: ...What?
Merchant: Wasn't that you? The one who wanted to put 
meat on their bones last time?

...

Sorry! That must have been incredibly rude if I 
confused you for another one of your corp!
Pup: It... might have been?
Merchant: I was just wondering if you wanted to buy some of 
my new stock of premium beef?
Pup: ...
I could feel a little drool on my lip as she presented 
a prime steak cut. I had already bought a little 
more meat than usual, but this looked delicious.
Pup: W- What do you think boy?
Jakson: *Bark*!
Pup: We'll if you say so...
Pup: ...
I had opened my wallet only to find its capacity 
coming up short. My hopes sank.
Pup: (Maybe I could get her to come down on the price 
a little? How should I go about this?)
passages.content_zh:
小狗：*嘆氣*...*嘆氣*...
我的手將劍握得更緊，
當我鎮定下來時，沉重的喘息聲逐漸平息。

我對面的人頭戴鎧甲
腳趾並反映出我自己的面容。
裝甲人偶：哼。
我微笑著回應。這將是最後的打擊。
小狗：……！
向前邁出一步，沉重的郵件就像
我心中的羽毛和劍就像其他任何東西一樣。

他的腳步與我的腳步一致，兩扇窗簾
鋼鐵重振雄風
一勞永逸地結束它。
就這樣，鋼鐵對鋼鐵，直到勝利者
決定了。

這是...
小狗：（是……？）
小狗：呃！
當一個沉重的重量壓住我的身體時，我蠕動著。 

沒多久我的感官就震動了
透過舌頭的滑動完全進入意識
它自己劃過我的臉。
傑克森：*吠*！
Pup：G-你也下午好。
視線的餘光裡，我看到了另一個人影
到我的床上用品旁邊。這個是
姿勢就像他剛剛掉了東西一樣。
諾德：你醒了。好的。

我們今天的任務比平常更忙。你
現在的任務是在城裡採購物資
對於整個公司來說。
小狗：什麼？我們從什麼時候開始單獨做這個了？
Norde：傑克森自願陪你。
小狗：那……狗……？你不是認真的吧？
Norde：盡量在晚餐前完成。我們會
那時正在審問囚犯。
小狗：等——等一下！
Pup：我想這就是為什麼我們被稱為“Nightless”
烏鴉……疲倦的人無法休息。
傑克森：*吠*！
Pup：你只是對晚餐感到興奮嗎？不能說我
怪你。
小狗：也許還是繼續吧。

…
小狗：傑克森……男孩……請移動一下？
傑克森氣喘吁籲地吹出了幾個和弦，幾乎
對我來說聽起來像是在笑。他最終做到了
放開我。
Pup：我們也許可以掛一些
脖子上掛著雜貨。
傑克森：*嗚嗚*...
小狗：沒有抱怨。我們都知道我無法攜帶
十多人一週的食物
我自己。
傑克森：*吠*！
我們的營地充滿了喧囂
透過它找到了出路。
薩蒂

passages.name: Ch 1's Supply Run - Choice Part
passages.content:
[Choice]:  Ask for a bulk discount. / Try to leverage your history here. / Feign disinterest to get a discount.
Pup: I would love to buy it, but... I'm a bit short on the 
remaining funds.
Pup: I did buy quite a lot from you already. You wouldn't 
by chance be willing to give a little discount?
Pup: It'd certainly do a lot to make me remember you 
and want to do business with you in the future.
Jakson: *Whine*...
Merchant: Hmm... Well...

I guess it can't hurt. It's not that large of 
a discount.
Pup: T- Thank you!
Pup: I would love to buy it from such a lovely lady, but... 
I'm a bit short on the remaining funds.
Pup: You said you've been getting a lot of my corp 
buying from you lately, right?
Pup: We've been buying a lot... so maybe you'd consider 
giving me a discount on it?
Jakson: *Whine*...
Merchant: Hmm... Well...

I guess it can't hurt. It's not that large of 
a discount.
Pup: Really? Thank you.
Pup: It's a bit much. Looks like a quality product, but I 
don't think I can realistically buy it.

Maybe if it was a little cheaper, but... Oh well.
Pup: Come on, Jakson. We should start heading back.
Merchant: Haha... If you want a discount, then why not just 
ask for it?
Pup: I... uh... mean... I can't afford it so I... shouldn't...
Merchant: You never know what an opportunity can provide 
you until you've at least tried, it after all.

With all the business your group has given me, I 
can give a little bit of a discount.
Pup: I... thank you.
The nice merchant packaged up my purchases and 
helped me hang some of it around Jakson's neck 
like a collar, much to his displeasure.
Merchant: Perhaps this is a bit presumptuous of me, but you 
remind me a bit of my own child.
Pup: I... Pardon?
Merchant: Always trying their best. Trying to live up to their 
expectations. Trying to be a hero like father.
Pup: ...
Merchant: I refer specifically to my own child. You just feel 
like a go getter, too.

Haha... apologies. I jumped ahead a bit much 
there.
Pup: I... won't pretend to know your son's situation well 
enough to compare.
Pup: Need to get going, though. Hopefully we'll be in 
town long enough to speak again.
Merchant: My son?

Haha... I don't have the heart to tell the boy that I 
meant my daughter.
We stopped by a spice shop for preservatives 
with the last remaining funds, and slowly 
found our way back into camp.
Pup: *Pant*... *pant*... There... we... go!
Jakson: *Bark*!
Pup: Just in time for supper, too.
My hand dropped to rustle the fur on Jakson's 
head.
Ivan: Pup, you've returned with provisions?
Pup: I managed to get everything on Satia's list, yes.
Pup: It was no problem.
Ivan: Good.
My father passed by with a light hand tap on my 
shoulder before walking off.
Pup: ...
Jakson: *Bark*!
Pup: Yes, I'm excited for the prime steak we got, too.
Pup: Don't tell anyone and I'll even split it with you.
Jakson: *Soft bark*
Pup: Heh. Good boy.

Now let's see if I can get back to that nice dream 
from earlier. Before supper, at least.

[選項]: 要求大量折扣。 / 試圖利用過去的交易紀錄。 / 假裝不感興趣以獲得折扣。
小狗: 我很想買，但是... 我還差一點錢。
小狗: 我已經跟你買了很多東西了。 你能不能稍微打個折扣？
小狗: 這肯定會讓我記得你，並且未來還想跟你做生意。
賈克森: *哀鳴*...
商人: 嗯... 好吧...

我想這也沒什麼損失。 折扣也不算太大。
小狗: 謝... 謝謝你！
小狗: 我很想跟這麼漂亮的小姐買，但是... 我還差一點錢。
小狗: 你說最近有很多我的公司的人跟你買東西，對吧？
小狗: 我們買了很多... 所以也許你可以考慮給我打個折扣？
賈克森: *哀鳴*...
商人: 嗯... 好吧...

我想這也沒什麼損失。 折扣也不算太大。
小狗: 真的嗎？ 謝謝你。
小狗: 有點貴。 看起來是個高品質的產品，但我不認為我買得起。

如果再便宜一點就好了，但是... 唉。
小狗: 走吧，賈克森。 我們該回去了。
商人: 哈哈... 如果你想要折扣，為什麼不直接說呢？
小狗: 我... 嗯... 我的意思是... 我買不起，所以我... 不應該...
商人: 你永遠不知道機會能給你帶來什麼，除非你至少嘗試過，畢竟。

看在你這群人給了我這麼多生意，我可以給你一點折扣。
小狗: 我... 謝謝你。
這位好心的商人將我買的東西包裝好，並幫我把一些東西像項圈一樣掛在賈克森的脖子上，讓他很不高興。
商人: 也許我有點冒昧，但你讓我想起了我的孩子。
小狗: 我... 抱歉？
商人: 總是盡力做到最好。 努力達到他們的期望。 努力成為像父親一樣的英雄。
小狗: ...
商人: 我指的是我自己的孩子。 你也給人一種積極進取的感覺。

哈哈... 抱歉。 我有點太過頭了。
小狗: 我... 不會假裝

passages.name: CH2 - Intro to ch2
passages.content:
Telegraph: *Click* *click* *click*
Pup: ...
I took a sip of water from my mug. The 
clicking sound stopped.

With a glance to the side, I saw my fellows as 
calm as ever.
Pup: You two... okay?
Norde: I am fine.
Satia: Is something wrong?
Pup: (No one else is getting annoyed by that?)
Pup: No, nothing's wrong. I just-
Telegraph: *Click* *click* *click*
Pup: I- I'm just going to go check on my father...
Satia: ...
Satia: Do you think something happened?
Norde: Something inane, I imagine.
Ivan: And how much money did you win off them? Or at 
least claim to?
Rowan: Enough to treat myself and a lady friend to a 
magnificent meal that night.
Ivan: Again... Specifics, please...
Rowan: That would require me to have counted it.
Rowan: What I received was... more like a burlap sack. With 
a money symbol painted on it.
Ivan: ...
Rowan: I assumed he had previous problems with losing it.
Ivan: ...
Pup: Hello, you two. Going well?
After stepping into their view, I pulled up a chair 
and seated myself.
Ivan: ...
Pup: That bad?
Rowan: I would accommodate you as a new arrival, but...
Rowan: ...alas, I am somewhat tied up at this time.
He waved at me. There was still rope tied tightly 
around his wrists.
Pup: I may regret this, but is there anything I can do to 
help?
Ivan: Doubtful.
Pup: Not even something minor?
Pup: (I need to find an excuse to stay over here. At 
least for a little while.)
Ivan tilted his head in thought.
Pup: What about... if I...

...?
From the corner of my eye, I saw a man in a regal, 
fanciful outfit badgering the barkeep.

After a few seconds, their gaze turned towards us.
Pup: ...?!
Fancy Man: Good day! Good day! Might you be the leader of 
the Dayless Doves?
Pup: You mean Nightless Crows?
Fancy Man: Yes, yes. Whichever.

Now, to answer the question...?
Ivan: ...
Ivan looked him over. After a few seconds to  
consider if he was a threat, he relaxed and then 
spoke.
Ivan: Yes. I am.
Fancy Man: Perfect! We're in need of a good few dirtied hands.

I am from the council of Lockhart, and I have 
a proposal for you.

For the sum of-
Ivan raised his hand to silence the man, and then 
turned to me.
Ivan: Pup. I'll speak to this gentlemen about the job he 
wants done. Take the boy to sit with the others.
Pup: S- Sure.
With a push off the table's edge, I found 
myself back on my own two feet.
Pup: Come on, bard boy.
Grasping at his cloak, I pulled Rowan up along 
with me.
Rowan: Do you not remember my name?
Pup: No time. Hurry up.
I guided Rowan away from the table and could 
only hear a little of the proceeding conversation.
Fancy Man: ...with a birthday coming... need of protection...
Pup: (At least I was able to get something to do in the 
end...)
Pup: (Wait...)
Telegraph: *Click* *click* *click*
Pup: Ngh...!
Rowan: Ah... It's like the pitter patter of a soulful drum~
Satia: Is that what was on your mind before, Pup?
Norde: Like I said. Something inane.
Pup: I- I...
Pup: W- What even is it?
Rowan: What is... the telegraph?
Rowan: Do they not have them in Rabaneau?
Pup: I don't think I've ever seen one before.
Satia: It is a bit unusual to see one in a tavern.
Satia: They've not been around so long as to be 
common. Usually, it's government buildings 
housing them.
Norde: From my understanding, a telegraph line here 
implies it is part of the emergency broadcast 
network.
With the continuing war between Rabaneau and 
Nolvanus, more than a few parties wished for a 
more immediate news cycle.
Rowan: How many of those well wishers reside in Lockhart?
Norde: Yes, I imagine the merchants there would love to 
be able to react more quickly to changing trends.
Norde: I wouldn't be surprised if the main communications 
hub was within that city.
Pup: (So it's a communication method?)
Telegraph: *Click* *click* *click*
Pup: ...But... all it does is click?
Norde: It is an encoded message. There is meaning behind 
the pattern of clicks.
Satia: Can you translate?
Norde: ...I cannot.
Satia: *Giggle*
Rowan: The last message was something about... troop  
movements to the east?
Rowan: That or a new sale on eastern wares?
Satia: My, my... Yet you somehow can?
Rowan: Bits and pieces. It would be ill-advised for a meister 
like myself to not familiarize myself with a new beat.
Rowan: Ah... Perhaps I can send a message of my own?
Norde: Do not get your hopes up. You need red magic to 
be able to create the bursts of energy used in 
the system.
Pup: (A communication method based entirely around 
magic?)
Pup: Wait, does that mean they've got some poor noble 
sitting on the other end? Clicking away day 
and night?
Satia: Well... Not only nobles can use magic. See this 
rascal we picked up today.
Norde: ...?!
Norde: ...He can?
Rowan: Heheh... another bit of plunder from an eventful 
night out.
Rowan: Though, might it be too much trouble to ask for it 
back?
Satia pulled out a small necklace from her pouch.
Satia: And leave our little prisoner armed? No, I think we'll 
hold onto your heirloom for now.
Norde: Good.
Norde: Without an heirloom, no one is a threat to 
use magic.
Rowan: Ah, but shouldn't my aptitude in wielding the 
goddess's blessings be proof of my noble character?
Satia: Nobility is more appearances than character.
Rowan: Ah well... It was worth the attempt...
Pup: ...
I scratched my nose as I eyed the telegraph.
Pup: (I wonder if I could use that magic to stop that 
relentless clicking.)
Pup: Can I try using it?
Norde: No.
Pup: Eh...? So quick...
Pup: (So much for that plan. I wanted to break that 
noisemaker...)
Satia: Most people cannot use magic, anyways. It's 
supposed to be a sign of nobility.
Satia: We can add our friend here to the list of 
exceptions I've seen over the years, though.
She patted Rowan on the head.
Rowan: Hmph. I always knew I was special.
Norde: ...
Norde's look of disbelief seemed to grab 
Rowan's attention.
Rowan: I do not believe we've been introduced.
Rowan: I am Rowan, a traveling bard. Do let me know if I 
can ever serve to soothe your worries.
Norde: ...
Norde: I am Norde. Second in command of the Nightless 
Crows.
Rowan: Oh?
Norde: And that is all you need to know.
Rowan: Are you native of Rabaneau?
Pup: (Huh...? Oh right. He said he's from Cartenan, 
right?)
Pup: (If he's from a far northern kingdom like that,
then perhaps people like Norde could look out of
place to him.)
Norde: Hmph.
Norde just scoffed and returned to sipping on 
his drink.
Rowan: I... meant no offense.
Satia: Don't worry. People can be prickly about their 
pasts.
Ivan: Norde, a question.
Norde: Yes?
Ivan: How long out are we covered for? Money wise?
Norde: As of my last estimates a few days ago? About a 
month.
Pup: ...?!
Rowan: Is that not good?
Ivan: ...
Ivan: We've little choice, then.
Satia: Did something happen?
Pup: Yeah, did that Lockhart council guy tell you 
something weird?
Ivan: He... made a strong offer on a job, but we need to 
be there by tomorrow afternoon.

Norde. Satia. Prepare supplies for a small dispatch 
mission to Crossing's Crown.

The others can stay and complete the protection 
contract for this region while we are there.
Pup: (Really? We never take jobs outside of Rabaneau...)
Norde: Understood.
Satia: Sure thing, boss.
Pup: What about the bard guy?
Rowan: My name is Rowan...
Ivan: Hmm...

Would you prefer to be interrogated by us or by 
the local governors?
Rowan: You, of course. I value the hairs on my head.
Ivan: Then we'll drag him along and finish it up in the 
downtime.

Pup, keep him in line.
Pup: Sure...
Pup: ...?!
Pup: Wait, what?! Why me?
Ivan, Norde, and Satia had already started making 
their way out of the tavern.
Rowan: Ah, what fun we'll have.
Rowan, smile and all, rested his head on 
my shoulder.
Pup: Ugh...
We spent the next day heading westward to the 
crossroads of Nolvanus, Rabaneau, and the 
coastal city states.
After stopping in the city of Crossing's Crown to 
resupply, we took up residence in an old defensive 
outpost.
The Nightless Crows had been hired to act as 
protection on the outskirts.

Lockhart, one of the city states that made up the 
West Auran Alliance, was having a celebration.

It was a city wide birthday party for their 
princess, and they decided to hire extra security.

Such an action was, of course, merely 
precautionary.

Lockhart, due to it's strength as a maritime trade 
hub, had long warded off danger by it's value 
alone.
No one wished the international escalation an 
aggressive move against them would incite.

So, of course, we only committed a portion of our 
numbers to take on the well paying job.

It would be an easy task, after all.
passages.content_zh:
電報機：*喀噠* *喀噠* *喀噠*
小傢伙：...
我從我的馬克杯裡啜了一口水。喀噠聲停止了。

我瞥了一眼旁邊，看到我的夥伴們一如既往地平靜。
小傢伙：你們兩個... 還好嗎？
諾德：我很好。
薩提亞：發生什麼事了嗎？
小傢伙：（只有我一個人覺得那個聲音很煩嗎？）
小傢伙：不，沒什麼。我只是-
電報機：*喀噠* *喀噠* *喀噠*
小傢伙：我- 我只是想去看看我父親...
薩提亞：...
薩提亞：你覺得發生了什麼事嗎？
諾德：我想，是一些無聊的事。
伊凡：那你從他們那裡贏了多少錢？或者至少聲稱贏了多少？
羅文：夠我請自己和一位女士朋友在那晚享用一頓豐盛的晚餐。
伊凡：再說一次... 請說具體一點...
羅文：那需要我數過才行。
羅文：我收到的東西... 更像是一個粗麻布袋。上面畫著一個錢的符號。
伊凡：...
羅文：我猜他以前有丟錢的問題。
伊凡：...
小傢伙：哈囉，你們兩個。一切順利嗎？
走進他們的視線後，我拉了一張椅子坐下。
伊凡：...
小傢伙：這麼糟？
羅文：我本應以新來者的身份款待你，但是...
羅文：...唉，我現在有點脫不開身。
他向我揮了揮手。他的手腕上仍然緊緊地綁著繩子。
小傢伙：我可能要後悔了，但有什麼我可以幫忙的嗎？
伊凡：很難。
小傢伙：就算是一些小事也不行嗎？
小傢伙：（我需要找個藉口待在這裡。至少待一會兒。）
伊凡歪著頭思考。
小傢伙：要不... 如果我...

...？
從我的眼角餘光，我看到一個穿著華麗、奇特服裝的男人在騷擾酒保。

幾秒鐘後，他們的目光轉向了我們。
小傢伙：...？！
花俏男：午安！午安！請問你們是無日鴿子的首領嗎？
小傢伙：你說的是無夜烏鴉吧？
花俏男：是，是。隨便什麼都好。

現在，回答這個問題...？
伊凡：...
伊凡打量著他。在考慮了幾秒鐘他是否構成威脅後，他放鬆了下來，然後說話了。
伊凡：是的。我是。
花俏男：太好了！我們需要一些骯髒的手。

我來自...

passages.name: CH2 - After pg13
passages.content:
Norde: ...and who was it that you had this dinner with?
Rowan: Her name?
Rowan: What was it...? Linda? Lucia? Luna?
Pup: I wonder if she even remembers your name herself.
Norde: Hmm... A better question then. Did she say where 
she was from?
Pup: Why would that matter?
Rowan: Alas, our pleasantries did not expand to such a 
topic.
Norde: Had you met her before this encounter?
Rowan: It was our first meeting.
Norde: ...
Norde: Had anyone approached you about your actions 
during these events? In any capacity?
Rowan: Ah, there it is.

That... that is the real question, is it not?

Did our beloved bard involve himself in grander 
designs within the chaos incited?
Norde: Hm... 

Then you understand well enough.
Rowan: I cannot say anything stood out to me.

Mayhaps you deign me worthy of your worries, 
though? Something may spark a memory within.
Norde and Rowan seemed to stare at each other 
awkwardly until I felt the need to speak up.
Pup: Norde... What is he talking about? Is there
something here I'm not aware of?
Rowan: I imagine an extension of the war.
Rowan: What of it, then? A new wide scale invasion? Into
Nolvanus? Into Rabaneau?

Or perhaps a sprint across a border for an 
Oathbreaker?
Rowan: Ah. Might you be working for the Covenant?
Norde: We are not. We are working for the governors of 
the Rabaneau region we came from.
Pup: Oathbreaker? Aren't those all held in protection by 
the Covenant?
Norde: It is irrelevant. The boy just wants to distract with 
dramatics.
Norde: Again. Have you been approached by anyone that 
seems suspicious at all?
Rowan: Heh.
Rowan: As I said, I have no awareness of such an event.
Norde: Very well. We had a few men checking your story 
at the restaurant.

We'll know if you are trustworthy upon our return.
Rowan: ...
With a scuff of the chair, Norde was on his feet. He 
reached over to place his notes in the group's 
supply pack.
Rowan: Ah, have your comrades returned?
My father and Satia had headed out to conduct 
a patrol.
Norde: I'll go check. Both of you...
Norde: ...both of you stay out of trouble. I rather not 
waste rope securing two people.
Pup: Yeah, yeah.
Rowan raised his tied up wrists, and he gave Norde 
a hearty wave goodbye.
Rowan: What a pleasant conversation.
I grabbed a chair and placed myself across 
from Rowan.
Pup: He can get a stick up his ass when left behind with 
me.
Pup: *Clears throat*
Pup: Let's pick up where he left off.
Rowan: Ah! Shall we have some discourse, then?
Rowan: Excellent. I did have some questions I wished to 
ask of you.
Pup: I'm not that stupid. I'll be the one asking the 
questions.
Rowan: Very well. Do go on.
Pup: (Let's see. What can I say to get some good info 
out of him?)
[Choice]: Offer to assist his goal to help weary soldiers. / Ask to hear the song he claimed to sing. /  Talk about the governors' retaliation.
Pup: You said you came here to help the morale of 
soldiers, right?
Pup: We actually work a lot in those capacities. Assisting 
soldiers, I mean.
Pup: Maybe we can find a way to help each other?
Rowan: Hm... An interesting proposition.
Pup: (I'm gonna regret this.)
Pup: You said that you sang to the bandit group, yes?
Pup: I would be... bereft of context should I leave that 
stone unturned.
Rowan: Ah, does the temptations of the siren's song reach 
you?
Pup: You do know we're trying to resolve this without 
letting the governors do whatever, right?
Pup: It would be... unfortunate if their desire to placate 
the locals' anger fell onto you.
Pup: Something. Anything you can tell us can let us 
better understand where that anger should be 
directed.
Rowan: I trust you to not leave me to a terrible fate that I 
have not earned.
Pup: How about we just-
Pup: ...?!
Pup: Wait, shouldn't they...
Rowan: ...?
passages.content_zh:
Norde：……你和誰一起吃晚餐？
羅文：她的名字？
羅文：那是什麼……？琳達？露西婭？盧娜？
Pup：我想知道她自己是否還記得你的名字。
Norde：嗯……這是更好的問題。她有說在哪裡嗎
她來自？
小狗：為什麼這很重要？
羅文：唉，我們的寒暄並沒有擴展到這樣的程度。 
主題。
Norde：在這次相遇之前你有見過她嗎？
羅文：這是我們第一次見面。
諾德：…
Norde：是否有人就你的行為與你接觸過
在這些事件期間？以任何身分？
羅文：啊，就在那裡。

那……這才是真正的問題，不是嗎？

我們心愛的吟遊詩人是否參與了更偉大的事？ 
設計中煽動的混亂？
諾德：嗯…

那你就夠理解了。
羅文：我不能說有什麼對我來說很突出。

也許你認為我值得你擔心，
不過？有些事情可能會激發內心的記憶。
諾德和羅文似乎互相凝視著
尷尬地直到我覺得有必要說出來。
Pup：諾德……他在說什麼？有嗎
這裡有什麼是我不知道的嗎？
羅文：我想像戰爭會延長。
羅文：那又怎樣呢？一場新的大規模入侵？進入
諾瓦努斯？進入拉巴諾？

或者也許是衝刺跨越邊界
背誓者？
羅文：啊。你可能在為聖約人工作嗎？
諾德：我們不是。我們正在為州長工作
我們來自拉巴諾地區。
小狗：背誓者？那些不都是被保護的嗎？ 
盟約？
諾德：這無關緊要。男孩只是想分散注意力
戲劇性的。
諾德：再來一次。有沒有人接觸過您
看起來很可疑？
羅文：呵呵。
羅文：正如我所說，我不知道有這樣的事件。
諾德：很好。我們有幾個人檢查你的故事
在餐廳。

我們回來後就會知道您是否值得信賴。
羅文：…
隨著椅子的磨損，諾德站了起來。他
伸手把他的筆記放在小組的筆記中
供應包。
羅文：啊，你的同伴回來了嗎？
我父親和薩蒂亞出去指揮
巡邏隊。
北歐：
