Prepare yourself.
passages.content_zh:
伊凡：這本來應該是一項簡單的工作。
伊凡：不過，我不是那種半途而廢的人。 
做好準備。

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Commander (Rowan)
passages.content:
Rowan: Why? Why would they invade?
Rowan: *Sigh*... The fools...
Rowan: For the sake of everyone's happiness. I will do what 
I must.
passages.content_zh:
羅文：為什麼？他們為什麼要入侵？
羅文：*嘆氣*... 蠢貨們...
羅文：為了所有人的幸福。我必須做我該做的。

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Commander (Norde)
passages.content:
Norde: So they are an organized army unit, in the end... 
This will complicate things.
Norde: Perhaps it could serve as a good test of my training, 
at least.
passages.content_zh:
諾德：所以他們終究還是一個有組織的軍隊單位...
這會讓事情變得複雜。
諾德：或許這至少可以作為我訓練的一個好測試。

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Intro
passages.content:
Norde: ...
Pup: S- Stay here. I'll go check what's going-
I turned to see Rowan reaching towards the 
supply pack on the table. He pulled out his 
heirloom. The one that allowed magic.
Pup: ...?!
Pup: H- How did you get free?!
The ropes that were around his wrists were strewn 
across the edge of the table.
Rowan: Ah, are you still here?
Rowan: Then, please allow me to assist. I believe you'll 
require my skills.
Pup: T- The ropes were tight. We... checked that 
recently.
My hands hovered around the grip of my sword.
Rowan: ...

Hm hm... I wonder how you'd react?
Rowan fastened his heirloom necklace around his 
neck and then pulled up his sleeve to reveal 
a bracelet.
It was a bracelet with a small antique key 
connected to it.
Rowan: Eul'avais. Have you heard of it?

It is... 

...an Oathbreaker.
Pup: What?!

(An... Oathbreaker?! Of THE Oathbreakers?!)
Pup: (Then... he's broken the oath to the Goddess?!)

You are... a corrupted soul?
Rowan: I'm sure your concern for my purity would make 
the Covenant proud.
Rowan: Alas, the laws of the Goddess can be quite 
inconvenient at times.
Rowan: Like with certain overeager chastity devices...
Pup: Overeager... w- what now?
Rowan: Such purity yourself. We make a fine pair of yin 
and yang.
Rowan: An Oathbreaker can create miracles and curses 
that defy the laws of the Goddess's domain.

Eul'avais is capable of undoing any restraint. 
Bindings, locks, and beyond.
Rowan spun his wrist as if to showcase the item 
in his possession.
Rowan: Did you notice your friend locked the door behind 
him?
Pup: (What?! Goddess damn you, Norde! I'm not here 
to be babysat!)
Rowan: If you wish to help him...
Rowan: ...well, if you do, I will note that time is not likely 
on our side.
Norde: Bandits... Pillaging, maybe? Even civilians are 
distracted with the festivities, so there is a
sick sense to that logic.
Pup: F- Fine. But if you do as much as raise your hand 
against a single one of us...
Rowan: I wouldn't dare. You are much too... peculiar... to 
lose my sight on now.
Rowan: Shall we?
Win Condition: Defeat all enemies

Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan or Norde die.
passages.content_zh:
諾德：…
小狗：S——待在這裡。我去看看發生了什麼事-
我轉身看到羅文把手伸向
供應包在桌上。他掏出他的
傳家寶。允許魔法的那個。
小狗：……？ ！
小狗：H-你是怎麼獲得自由的？ ！
他手腕上的繩子散落一地
越過桌子的邊緣。
羅文：啊，你還在嗎？
羅文：那麼，請允許我幫忙。我相信你會
需要我的技能。
小狗：T-繩子太緊了。我們...檢查過
最近。
我的雙手懸在劍柄上。
羅文：…

嗯嗯...我想知道你會有什麼反應？
羅文把他的傳家項鍊繫在他的身上
脖子，然後拉起袖子露出
一個手鐲。
這是一個手鐲，上面有一把小古董鑰匙
連接到它。
羅文：Eul'avais。你聽過嗎？

這是...

……背誓者。
小狗：什麼？ ！

（一個……破誓者？！破誓者中的？！）
Pup：（那麼……他就違背了對女神的誓言？！）

你是……墮落的靈魂？
羅文：我確信你對我純潔性的關心會讓
盟約感到自豪。
羅文：唉，女神的法則真是太可怕了。 
有時不方便。
羅文：就像某些過於渴望的貞操裝置一樣...
Pup：太急切了……現在怎麼辦？
羅文：你自己就是這麼純潔。我們是一對很好的陰
和陽。
羅文：破誓者可以創造奇蹟，也可以創造詛咒
違背女神領域的法律。

Eul'avais 有能力解除任何束縛。 
綁定、鎖等等。
羅文旋轉手腕，彷彿要展示該物品
在他的手中。
羅文：你注意到你的朋友把門鎖在後面了嗎
他？
Pup：（什麼？！該死的女神，諾德！我不在這裡
成為保母！ ）
羅文：如果你想幫助他…
羅文：……好吧，如果你這樣做，我會注意到時間不太可能
在我們這邊。
Norde：強盜...掠奪，也許？連平民也是
因慶祝活動而分心，所以有一個
對這種邏輯有病態的感覺。
小狗：F-很好。但如果你盡可能舉手
對抗我們中的一個…
羅文：我不敢。你也太……奇特了吧

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Turn 1
passages.content:
Rowan: If we're to reach him in time, we need to get 
through the locked door.
If Rowan, or any unit with a key or the skill 
"Unlock" move next to a door, they can 
unlock it. The same applies to chests.
Keys are 1 use only, while Rowan's Oathbraker has 
unlimited uses. 

At the same time, only Rowan can make use of the 
Eul'avais he now has in his inventory.
passages.content_zh:
羅溫：如果我們想及時趕到他身邊，我們需要穿過那扇鎖住的門。
如果羅溫，或是任何持有鑰匙或擁有「解鎖」技能的單位移動到門旁邊，他們就可以解鎖它。這同樣適用於寶箱。
鑰匙只能使用一次，而羅溫的破誓者則可以無限次使用。

同時，只有羅溫才能使用他現在物品欄中的 Eul'avais。

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Rescued Norde
passages.content:
Norde: Why is the... person of interest... no longer bound? 
Anton, did you release him?
Pup: What? No, he-
Rowan: I was able to break free myself.
Rowan: There is no need to worry. I simply wish to help.
Rowan: You kind folk are my best bet to not be drawn and 
quartered during my next foray into Rabaneau, 
after all.
Norde: ...
Pup: (We can deal with his situation after everyone else 
is accounted for.)
Pup: You're safe. Now where are the others?
Norde: Yes, let's focus on that.
Norde: Groups of bandits seem to be swarming from the 
east.

They're taking advantage of the celebration to 
loot the surrounding areas. Be alert.
Rowan: Ah, is that the chattering of hooves?
Satia: There are so many of them.
Ivan: It may very well be more than one mercenary corp.
Ivan: Might they be working together?
Jakson: ...?
Jakson's head perked up as he looked across the 
field.
Pup: Is that...?
Norde: It is.
Norde raised his hand to create a signal that 
Ivan replicated.
Norde: Time to regroup.
Ivan: What's your situation?
Norde: We've neutralized what bandits we've come across. 
Others have likely passed the encampment already.
Satia: Our team identified small roving groups heading 
westward.
Norde: The fort had an emergency telegraph.

We should...
passages.content_zh:
Norde：為什麼……有興趣的人……不再受束縛？ 
安東，你釋放他了嗎？
小狗：什麼？不，他——
羅文：我自己能夠掙脫束縛。
羅文：沒必要擔心。我只是想幫忙。
羅文：你們善良的人們是我不被吸引的最好選擇
在我下次進軍拉巴諾時被困住了
畢竟。
諾德：…
Pup：（我們可以在其他人之後處理他的情況
已計算在內。 ）
小狗：你很安全。現在其他人在哪裡？
Norde：是的，讓我們專注於這一點。
Norde：一群強盜似乎從這裡蜂擁而來
東。

他們利用慶祝活動
掠奪週邊地區。保持警惕。
羅文：啊，那是馬蹄聲嗎？
薩蒂亞：有很多。
伊凡：很可能不只一支僱傭兵團。
伊凡：他們可能一起工作嗎？
傑克森：……？
傑克森抬起頭，看向對面
場。
小狗：那是……？
諾德：是的。
諾德舉起手發出信號
伊万重複道。
Norde：是時候重新集結了。
伊凡：你的情況怎麼樣？
Norde：我們已經消滅了我們遇到的強盜。 
其他人可能已經通過了營地。
薩蒂亞：我們的團隊確定了小型流動團體的前進方向
向西。
Norde：堡壘有緊急電報。

我們應該...

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - After enemies appear
passages.content:
Pup: More?
Rowan: Wait... But these are...?
Satia: Soldiers? Where from, though?
Ivan: ...?!
Ivan: *Exhale*...
Ivan: Those... Those are Imperial army uniforms. They're 
from Nolvanus.
Pup: What? I thought... Wasn't it bandits that were 
looting?!
Norde: We need to send a message to Lockhart.
Ivan: Aim for the enemy commander. Disrupt their chain 
of command so we can focus on getting a message 
out.
Win Condition: Defeat the enemy commander.

Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan, Norde or Ivan die.
Win Condition: Defeat the enemy commander.

Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan,or Ivan die.
passages.content_zh:
Pup: 還要？
Rowan: 等等... 但這些是...？
Satia: 士兵？但從哪來的？
Ivan: ...？！
Ivan: *呼氣*...
Ivan: 那些... 那些是帝國軍的制服。他們是從諾爾瓦努斯來的。
Pup: 什麼？我還以為... 不是強盜在搶劫嗎？！
Norde: 我們需要送個訊息給洛克哈特。
Ivan: 瞄準敵方指揮官。擾亂他們的指揮鏈，這樣我們才能專注於發送訊息。
勝利條件：擊敗敵方指揮官。

失敗條件：Pup、Rowan、Norde 或 Ivan 死亡。
勝利條件：擊敗敵方指揮官。

失敗條件：Pup、Rowan 或 Ivan 死亡。

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Tut2
passages.content:
Time for some rescuing! ...What do you mean 
Norde was already rescued? That's actually not 
what I mean.
There is a mechanic in the game called "Rescue".
With it, cavalry and flying type units can shield and 
carry another unit.
It uses up turns, but it can also help move less 
mobile units faster across maps. Both cavalry and 
fliers can also move after picking up the ally.
passages.content_zh:
是時候進行一些救援了！ ……你什麼意思
諾德已經被救了？其實不是這樣的
我的意思是。
遊戲中有一個名為「救援」的機制。
有了它，騎兵和飛行型部隊可以進行護盾和
攜帶另一個單位。
它會增加轉彎，但也可以幫助減少移動
移動單位在地圖上的移動速度較快。無論是騎兵還是
傳單在接載盟友後也可以移動。

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Win con2
passages.content:
Norde: Without their commander, the soldiers have begun 
to scatter.
Pup: Right, if we have a second, then...
I looked over at Rowan. He seemed to be 
dedicated despite his earlier attitude.
Pup: (I guess the Oathbreaker thing can wait...
for now...)
Ivan: It's enough of opening to act, then? 
We should hurry with a message.
Pup: (Right, priorities.)
Ivan: Rowan, correct?
Rowan: Y- Yes?
Ivan: The telegraph. Can you send a message?
Rowan: I can make an attempt.
Rowan placed himself next to the telegraph 
transmitter and held the charm on his necklace 
tightly.
After a deep breath, Rowan began tapping away 
at the device.
Rowan: Huh?

There's... no resistance?
Norde: Dammit... The line's been cut.
Pup: So this... Is this all coordinated?
Ivan stood there for several seconds both 
thinking and calming himself.
Ivan: We'll have to ride for Lockhart.

We've no time to waste.
Ruslan: There it is. Peeking out over the horizon... 
Lockhart.
Steel Wolf: ...
passages.content_zh:
諾德：失去了指揮官，士兵們開始潰散了。
小狗：對，如果我們有時間的話，那麼...
我看向羅文。儘管他之前的態度，他現在似乎很投入。
小狗：（我想破誓者的事可以等等...暫時...）
伊凡：現在開始行動夠了嗎？我們應該趕緊發送訊息。
小狗：（對，優先順序。）
伊凡：羅文，對吧？
羅文：是...是的？
伊凡：電報。你能發送訊息嗎？
羅文：我可以試試。
羅文站到電報發射器旁，緊緊握住他項鍊上的護符。
深吸一口氣後，羅文開始敲擊裝置。
羅文：咦？

沒有...阻力？
諾德：該死...線路被切斷了。
小狗：所以這...這一切都是有預謀的？
伊凡站在那裡好幾秒，既在思考也在讓自己冷靜下來。
伊凡：我們必須騎馬前往洛克哈特。

我們沒有時間可以浪費了。
魯斯蘭：在那裡。從地平線上探出頭來...洛克哈特。
鋼鐵狼：...

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Place Event
passages.content:
Eve: Light! So much brilliant light!
There was a girl with stars practically swimming 
around her head. She was hugging the floor.
Pup: Uh... Are you okay? How long were you in there?
Eve: I don't know. It felt like a year.
Pup: It's sort of a bad time for this. Can you get out of 
here? The town isn't too far away.
Eve: The town...

I don't wanna.
Pup: I didn't realize it was a choice.
Pup: Why are you even here?
Eve: I woke up in a field a bit ago. I'm a bit fuzzy on 
how, but after that I went to town.
Eve: "Be a waitress, it's just like farming" they said.

Well, as a farmer, at least I didn't get locked in a 
prison cell as a prank!
Eve: I think...

They really weren't helpful with my patchy 
memories either.
Pup: This place is just getting progressively more 
dangerous, you know?
Eve: Can I stick around with you nice people? I don't 
want to go back to that town.
Eve: You need a farmer? I've done that before.
Pup: We. Are. On. A. Battlefield.
Eve: Then I can try to fight! I might not be great, but I 
don't think I'd be a hindrance.
Pup: This isn't how saving people is supposed to go...
Pup: I can't control you. Just try to not get hurt, 
please?
Eve: Right!
passages.content_zh:
伊芙：光！如此耀眼的光芒！
有一個星星女孩幾乎在游泳
在她的頭周圍。她正擁抱著地板。
小狗：呃……你還好嗎？你在那裡待了多久？
伊芙：我不知道。感覺就像一年了。
Pup：現在有點糟。你能出去嗎
在這裡？小鎮離得不太遠。
伊芙：那個小鎮…

我不想。
Pup：我沒有意識到這是一個選擇。
小狗：你怎麼還在這裡？
伊芙：我不久前在田野裡醒來。我有點模糊
怎麼樣，但之後我進城了。
伊芙：“當一名女服務員，就像種田一樣”，他們說。

好吧，作為一個農民，至少我沒有被困在
監獄牢房是個惡作劇！
伊芙：我想…

他們對我的問題確實沒有幫助
回憶也。
Pup：這個地方越來越多了
危險，你知道嗎？
伊芙：我可以和你們這些好人待在一起嗎？我不
想回到那個小鎮。
伊芙：你需要一個農夫嗎？我以前也這麼做過。
小狗：我們。是。在。 A、戰場。
伊芙：那我就可以嘗試戰鬥了！我可能不偉大，但我
不要認為我會成為障礙。
Pup：這不是救人的方式…
小狗：我無法控制你。只要努力不讓自己受傷就好
請問？
伊芙：對啊！

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Satia → Rowan
passages.content:
Satia: That necklace...
Rowan: Necklace...? Ah, right.
Rowan: Given the dire circumstances, it seemed only 
appropriate for me to use whatever I could to help.
Satia: Help... who exactly?
Rowan: No need to fret. I am on your side.
Satia: Just remember that if you give me reason to regret 
you having that...
Satia: I'll fix it by ensuring there isn't a neck left for it to 
hang on.
Rowan: I... understand...
passages.content_zh:
莎媞雅：那條項鍊...
羅文：項鍊...？啊，對了。
羅文：鑑於情況如此危急，我覺得我應該盡我所能來幫忙。
莎媞雅：幫忙...究竟是幫誰？
羅文：別擔心。我是站在妳這邊的。
莎媞雅：只要記住，如果你讓我後悔你擁有那東西...
莎媞雅：我會確保再也沒有脖子能讓它掛著，來彌補這一切。
羅文：我...明白了...

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Pup → Jakson
passages.content:
Pup: There you are, boy. Everything go well while you 
were out with the patrol?
I gave Jakson a pet on the head.
Jakson: *Concerned bark*!
Pup: Yeah, we'll take them out. You and me together.
Pup: I'm sure I can get you a nice treat if you try extra 
hard, too.
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
passages.content_zh:
小狗：你來了，孩子。當你一切順利時
和巡邏隊一起出去了嗎？
我給了傑克森頭上一個寵物。
傑克森：*憂心忡忡*！
Pup：是的，我們會把他們幹掉的。你和我在一起。
小狗：我相信如果你多嘗試一下，我就能帶給你美味的款待
也很難。
傑克森：*快樂吠叫*！

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Ivan → Rowan
passages.content:
Ivan: I heard you can encode telegraph messages.
Rowan: In a limited capacity, yes.
Ivan: Good. We may need to rely on you.
Rowan: Are you not going to give me the evil eye like your 
comrades?
Ivan: Do you want me to? Give me a reason, then.
Rowan: Message... taken.
passages.content_zh:
伊凡：我聽說你能編碼電報訊息。
羅文：在有限的能力下，是的。
伊凡：很好。我們可能需要仰賴你。
羅文：你不會像你的同志們一樣給我白眼嗎？
伊凡：你想要我給你嗎？給我個理由啊。
羅文：訊息...收到。

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Pup → Norde
passages.content:
Norde: How did you get past the locked door?
Pup: I... uh...
Pup: (Is this really the time? I'll just keep it on the 
downlow for now.)
Pup: The locks are old and can be knocked open easily.
Norde: Hm...
Pup: Hey! Before I forget... You forgot something.
Pup: Missing your axe? Feeling a little lonely out here 
with just a lance?
Norde: Hm... Thank you, I suppose.
passages.content_zh:
諾德：你是怎麼通過那扇鎖住的門的？
小狗：我...呃...
小狗：（現在真的是說這個的時候嗎？我還是先低調一點好了。）
小狗：那些鎖很舊了，很容易就能敲開。
諾德：嗯...
小狗：嘿！差點忘了...你忘了東西。
小狗：想念你的斧頭嗎？只有長矛在這裡是不是覺得有點孤單？
諾德：嗯... 謝了，大概吧。

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Ivan → Norde
passages.content:
Ivan: Is Pup okay?
Norde: Anton seems to be faring well enough despite the 
scenario.
Ivan: Thank you for looking after him.
Norde: It's no problem. He is your son, in the end.
passages.content_zh:
伊凡：小狗還好嗎？
諾德：儘管情況如此，安東看起來還算過得去。
伊凡：謝謝你照顧他。
諾德：沒什麼。畢竟他是你的兒子。

passages.name: CH3 - Intro
passages.content:
As we saddled our horses two a piece, we began 
our long ride westward for Lockhart.

We were not the first to make that journey this 
day.

First, civilians aplenty made the daytrip into the city 
for the birthday festivities.
Next, bandits began their pillaging. They pushed 
their way further and further into the state's 
borders.
By our best estimation... This was a trap. It was a 
distraction.
As the bandits were causing chaos, the Nolvanus 
Imperial Military slipped through the border.
They took strategic location after strategic location. 
Communications lines were cut.

Even if a message had been delivered in time, it 
would've been about the bandits' incursion over 
any military one.
We rushed as much as we could to the crown 
jewel city state of the West Auran Alliance: 
Lockhart.
It was only a hope that we would make it in time 
to make a difference.
passages.content_zh:
當我們為馬配上兩匹馬鞍後，我們就開始了
我們向西長途跋涉前往洛克哈特。

我們並不是第一個踏上這段旅程的人
一天。

首先，大量平民進入城市進行一日遊
為了生日慶祝活動。
接下來，土匪開始了掠奪。他們推
他們在國家的道路上越走越遠
邊界。
根據我們的最佳估計…這是一個陷阱。這是一個
分散注意力。
當強盜們製造混亂時，諾爾瓦努斯
帝國軍隊溜過邊境。
他們佔據了一個又一個的戰略位置。 
通訊線路被切斷。

即使訊息及時送達，
本來是關於強盜入侵的
任何軍事的。
我們竭盡全力衝向王冠
西奧蘭聯盟寶石城邦：
洛克哈特。
只是希望我們能及時趕到
有所作為。

passages.name: CH3 - After map
passages.content:
Rowan: Fighting has broken out...
Pup: We're too late?
Ivan: Too late to warn the city, yes.
Norde: Should we fall back, then? The mission is a failure.
Ivan: ...
Pup: What?
Pup: (We can't just leave the city to this fate.)
I jumped off the horseback and started towards 
the city proper.
Pup: We should stay and fight!
Norde: Fight what? For what? We are not an army of 
Lockhart, or of any kind.
Ivan: ...
Pup: I- I...
Pup: No. We're not an army...
My shoulders slumped, and my grip on the sword 
handle faltered.
Rowan: Mayhap it is not my place to say...
Rowan: But there are civilians caught between the blades. 
Even more so because of the celebrations.
Pup: Even if we're not... we're here now..
Pup: We can at least try to help keep the people safe.
Ivan: ...
Norde: ...
Norde approached me. He was uncomfortably and 
intimidatingly close.
Norde: ...
Pup: I- It's... It's the right thing to do.
Norde: ...
Norde: That it is.
Norde: A hero's gambit, have you?
Pup: Y- Yeah...
Pup: (Yeah. Like a proper hero.)
I breathed a deep breath as the tension from 
speaking up was let loose.
passages.content_zh:
Rowan: 開打了...
Pup: 我們太晚了嗎？
Ivan: 太晚警告城市了，是的。
Norde: 那我們應該撤退嗎？任務失敗了。
Ivan: ...
Pup: 什麼？
Pup: (我們不能就這樣把城市丟給這種命運。)
我跳下馬，開始往
城市中心走去。
Pup: 我們應該留下來戰鬥！
Norde: 跟誰打？為了什麼打？我們不是
Lockhart的軍隊，也不是任何軍隊。
Ivan: ...
Pup: 我- 我...
Pup: 不。我們不是軍隊...
我的肩膀垮了下來，握劍柄的手也鬆了。
Rowan: 或許不該由我來說...
Rowan: 但有無辜的平民被夾在刀刃之間。
尤其現在還在慶典期間。
Pup: 就算我們不是...但我們現在在這裡...
Pup: 我們至少可以試著保護人民的安全。
Ivan: ...
Norde: ...
Norde朝我走來。他靠得太近，讓人感到不舒服，而且很有壓迫感。
Norde: ...
Pup: 我- 這是...這是正確的事。
Norde: ...
Norde: 確實是。
Norde: 想來一場英雄的豪賭，是嗎？
Pup: 是- 是啊...
Pup: (是啊。像個真正的英雄一樣。)
我深吸一口氣，說出口的緊張感也隨之釋放。

passages.name: CH3 - Pg4 Satia Alive
passages.content:
Satia: Ivan, what was it that Harold used to say all the 
time when he led the Crows?
Satia: "A job's not worth doing if you're not willing to go 
all the way"?
Ivan: Something like that, yes. And you take it as a creed 
for the Crows?
Norde: Sir, shall we map out a plan of action?
Ivan: Hmph. I'm not heartless. Best to not leave the job 
half done, then?
Satia: I think the old boss would be happy if he could see 
this moment.
passages.content_zh:
薩蒂亞：伊万，哈洛德過去常說的那些話是什麼？ 
他帶領烏鴉隊的時候？
薩蒂亞：「如果你不願意去，那麼這份工作就不值得做
一路”？
伊凡：類似的事情，是的。而你把它當作信條
為了烏鴉隊？
Norde：先生，我們可以製定一個行動計畫嗎？
伊万：哼。我不是無情的。最好不要離開工作崗位
那就完成了一半？
薩蒂亞：我想如果老老闆能看到的話他會很高興
這一刻。

passages.name: CH3 - Pg4 Satia Alive
passages.content:
Norde: Sir, shall we map out a plan of action?
Ivan: Best to not leave the job half done, then? Didn't 
Harold used to say that?
Norde: Like a mantra.
passages.content_zh:
諾德：長官，我們是否該擬定行動計畫？
伊凡：最好別把工作做到一半就丟下，對吧？哈洛德以前不是常說這句話嗎？
諾德：像個口頭禪一樣。

passages.name: CH3 - Contiunue
passages.content:
Ivan: That's that, then.

We've been hired to protect Lockhart, her 
princess, and her people.
Ivan: Shall we?
Pup: Definitely!

(We can do this. I can.)
I tightened my grip on my sword.
Ivan: Just... try not to be reckless, please.
Norde: We can start by...
Norde began to quickly set out a rudimentary 
plan for us to follow.
Pup: Right... right...
Rowan: ...
Rowan: ...!?
Rowan: Mi-!
passages.content_zh:
伊凡：那就這樣吧。

我們受僱來保護洛哈特，她
公主和她的人民。
伊万：我們可以嗎？
小狗：絕對是！

（我們能做到。我能。）
我握緊了劍。
伊凡：只是……請盡量不要魯莽。
Norde：我們可以從...開始
Norde 開始快速制定初步的計劃
計劃供我們遵循。
小狗：對……對……
羅文：…
羅文：……！ ？
羅文：咪——！

passages.name: Ch 2's Supply Run - Talk
passages.content:
Merchant: Hmm... *scratches chin*

It looks like the rush from the birthday celebrations 
have died out.

Guess they must've made their way to Lockhart by 
now.
Merchant: Ngh... Eh... My back.
The merchant started to shuffle through his wares 
as he prepared to close up shop for the day.
Merchant: Hm?
He stopped mid stretch, and his head tilted to look 
behind him.
Merchant: Uh... what?
It was...
Pup: H-Hey. Could...
Pup: What did you want again, Norde?
There were two people saddled on a horse.
Norde: A sweet potato.
One was a stern looking man that seemed to be a 
mix of Taikolyn and Einlyn races.
Pup: Right. What about everyone else...?
The other was a young man with a smallish stature.
Norde: Must I do your job for you?
Pup: N- No! I got it.
Pup: Sir, please. One sweet potato... an apple... and... 
and... two loafs of peach bread?
Pup: Is that even right...?
Norde: I... do not know.
passages.content_zh:
商人：嗯... *搔著下巴*

看來生日慶典的熱潮
已經消退了。

猜他們一定是前往洛克哈特了。
商人：嗯... 呃... 我的背。
商人開始翻找他的商品，
準備結束一天的營業。
商人：嗯？
他停下了伸展的動作，頭傾斜著看向
他的身後。
商人：呃... 什麼？
那是...
小弟：嘿... 呃...
小弟：你到底要什麼啦，諾德？
有兩個人共乘一匹馬。
諾德：一個地瓜。
一個是看起來很嚴肅的男人，似乎是泰科林和艾因林混血。
小弟：對了。那其他人呢...？
另一個是身材矮小的年輕男子。
諾德：難道我必須幫你做你的工作嗎？
小弟：不... 不是！我記得了。
小弟：先生，請。一個地瓜... 一個蘋果... 還有...
還有... 兩個水蜜桃麵包？
小弟：這樣對嗎...？
諾德：我... 不知道。

passages.name: Ch 2's Supply Run - Sat Alive
passages.content: Pup: Satia's gonna kill me if we got the orders wrong...
passages.content_zh: 小狗：如果我們搞錯訂單，薩提亞會宰了我的...

passages.name: Ch 2's Supply Run - Sat Death
passages.content:
Pup: The others are gonna be angry if we got the 
orders wrong...
passages.content_zh:
Pup：如果我們得到了，其他人會生氣的
訂單錯誤...

passages.name: Ch 2's Supply Run - New Event
passages.content:
The merchant stood there, still in mid-stretch, and 
looked at the two in bewilderment.
Pup: Sir?!
The boy was holding out money.
Merchant: What's happening now?
Pup: We're in a bit of a hurry. Can we buy the food or 
not?!
Merchant: Hm... I suppose.
The merchant headed over to pack up the items, 
though he did so at a relaxed pace.
Norde: I knew we should've tried the next stall over.
Pup: Come on, come on, come on.
Merchant: ...

*Scratches chin*

Here you go.
The sack of food was snatched up at a feverish 
pace and quickly replaced with coin.
Within a few blinks of the eye, the horse had 
already started to fade from distance.

Though one thing could be heard like a quiet 
whisper in the wind...
Pup: THANK YOU!
Merchant: Hmm... *scratches chin*

You're welcome.
After a relaxed pivot back to the stall, the 
merchant continued to pack his wares.
passages.content_zh:
商人站在那裡，仍在伸懶腰，
疑惑的看著兩人。
小狗：先生？ ！
男孩拿出了錢。
商人：現在發生什麼事了？
小狗：我們有點著急。我們可以買食物嗎？ 
不？ ！
商人：嗯……我想。
商人前去收拾物品，
儘管他這樣做的速度很輕鬆。
Norde：我知道我們應該嘗試下一個攤位。
小狗：來吧，來吧，來吧。
商家：...

*刮傷下巴*

給你。
一袋食物在發燒時被搶走了
速度並很快被硬幣取代。
眨眼間，馬就已經
已經開始從遠處消失。

雖然可以聽到一件事像安靜一樣
在風中低語…
小狗：謝謝！
商人：嗯...*抓破下巴*

不客氣。
輕鬆地回到攤位後，
商人繼續打包他的貨物。

passages.name: CH4 - Scene 1
passages.content:
Villager: What do you think it's about?
Other Villager: I wonder if it has to do with the smoke coming 
from the north a couple days ago?
Another Villager: *Yawn*... Who cares? I just want it to end so I 
can get back to helping with the farm.
A crowd gathered around a small stage.

Creaks accompanied a dip in the chatter of the 
crowd. A figure soon stood atop the stage for 
all to see and hear.
Mayor: Now, now. Calm down everyone. 
The announcement won't come any quicker.
Other Villager: Does this have to do with Lockhart!?
Mayor: *Sigh*... What did I just say?

We are translating the finalized message from the 
telegraph network as we speak.
Charlotte: What did he say? Was it something about 
Lockhart?
Mariel: They haven't started yet, I think?
In the recesses of a darkened alley, two sets of 
ears did their best to listen in from beyond the 
edge of the crowd.
Charlotte: Tsk. If only I could hear it less muffled.
Mariel: That's probably a chance that we wouldn't want 
to take...
Charlotte: I know, I know... But still...
Mayor: ...there it is... begin soon...
Charlotte: I heard that, at least.
Mayor: Here we are, then. Let's get started.
The mayor cleared his throat.
Mayor: "Citizens of our sister city within our Alliance..."

"We of Lockhart apologize for any confusion the 
recent disturbance may have caused. It would 
appear that..."
Mariel: I think he's claiming the same stuff that the 
Imperial General claimed the other day.
Charlotte: Bastards...
Other Villager: Another power struggle in one of the big cities?
Another Villager: *Yawn*... Was just a matter of time.
Villager: Lockhart has been pretty stable, though? I don't 
recall them ever having a leadership shuffle before.

Not in my lifetime, at least.
The chatter of the crowd started to deafen the 
mayor's speech. But...
Mayor: "We are pleased to inform you that the root cause 
of the disturbance has been identified and 
removed."
"As it stands..."
But a few words managed to cut through the noise 
as they bellowed from ear to ear.
Mayor: "...the traitors have been executed."
Mariel: ...
Charlotte: ...
Time seemed to freeze for the two, but a hothead 
thawed through one's stasis quickly enough to 
speak.
Charlotte: I'm going to place a bullet... right through that 
general's eyes...
Mayor: "...the exception lies with two descendants of the 
traitors' lineage."

"They are fugitives from justice."
The mayor cleared his throat as he finished.
Mayor: Soldiers may be passing through in their search of 
these fugitives, so we ask that you comply with 
anything they may need for this effort.
Outside of that, those of you with connections to 
Lockhart may wish to reach out to family or 
business partners.
And... uh... that's it. Let's all make this as painless 
as we can.
The crowd had largely gone quiet. 

What was left of sound was small pockets of 
laughs and grumbling taunts. 

The dispersion of sound was soon followed with 
the crowd itself dispersing.
Mariel: ...
Charlotte: Sis... We... We should head back to the inn. We 
can't stay here anymore.
Mariel: ...
Charlotte: Sis!
Mariel: Y- Yeah. Yeah. We should... do that...
passages.content_zh:
村民：你們覺得會是什麼事？
其他村民：我在想是不是跟幾天前從北方飄來的煙霧有關？
另一村民：*呵欠*...誰在乎？我只想趕快結束，好回去幫忙農務。
人群聚集在一個小舞台周圍。

吱嘎聲伴隨著人群的竊竊私語聲降低。一個身影很快地站在舞台上，讓所有人都能看見和聽見。
鎮長：好了，好了。大家冷靜點。
公告不會因此更快出來的。
其他村民：這跟洛克哈特有關嗎！？
鎮長：*嘆氣*...我剛才說了什麼？

我們正在翻譯來自電報網路的最終訊息。
夏洛特：他說了什麼？是關於洛克哈特的事嗎？
瑪麗埃爾：他們還沒開始吧，我想？
在昏暗的小巷深處，兩雙耳朵正盡力從人群邊緣偷聽。
夏洛特：嘖。如果我能聽得更清楚就好了。
瑪麗埃爾：那可能是一個我們不想冒險的機會...
夏洛特：我知道，我知道...但還是...
鎮長：...就在那裡...即將開始...
夏洛特：至少我聽到這個了。
鎮長：那麼，我們開始吧。
鎮長清了清喉嚨。
鎮長：「聯盟內姊妹城市的市民們...」

「洛克哈特的我們為最近的騷動可能造成的任何困惑道歉。看來...」
瑪麗埃爾：我想他正在聲稱跟前幾天帝國將軍聲稱的同樣的事情。
夏洛特：混蛋...
其他村民：另一個大城市裡的權力鬥爭？
另一村民：*呵欠*...只是時間問題。
村民：洛克哈特一直都很穩定吧？我不記得他們以前有過領導層改組。

至少在我有生之年沒有。
人群的閒聊聲開始淹沒鎮長的講話。但是...
鎮長：「我們很高興地通知您，騷動的根本原因已經查明並已排除。」
「就目前而言...」
但有幾個字設法穿透了噪音，因為

passages.name: CH4 - Scene 2
passages.content:
Pup: ...
My eyes opened, but I didn't move.

With a turn of my head, my eyes looked over to 
see my father sleeping in the other bed. 

The restlessness that had plagued him prior was 
a thing of the past.
Pup: Argh...
Some hair had found itself surprising me as it fell 
into my eyeline. I quickly brushed it aside.
Pup: *Sigh*
With an exasperated sigh, I found myself placing 
my arm over my eyes to block out the light.

I thought back on to the event that happened a 
couple days prior: The attack on Lockhart.

Ever since then, our group had stayed at an inn 
south of the city. We didn't have a plan, but my 
father's injuries made moving him dangerous.
Pup: Why?

(Why did this happen? Why would the Goddess let 
this...)
Pup: ...the Goddess...?
A memory popped into my head.
Rowan: Alas, the laws of the Goddess can be quite 
inconvenient at times.

An Oathbreaker can create miracles and curses that 
defy the laws of the Goddess's domain.
Rowan spun his wrist as if to showcase the item in 
his possession.
Rowan: Eul'avais is capable of undoing any restraint. 
Bindings, locks, and beyond.
Pup: I... almost forgot about that.
In the quiet, I could hear the faint sound of 
plucked strings from beyond the room's door.
Pup: ...and I never told anyone...
Within my next breath, I found my feet touching 
the floor and guiding me to the sound I heard.
As deftly as I could, my steps led to me to a 
doorway to the inn's lobby.
Pup: Hm...
The plucks of strings proved to be louder, and I 
peaked around the corner to see Rowan, Norde 
and others lazing about without much to do.
Pup: (How to approach this? The man... well...)
Pup: Hmm...

(Breaking the Oath to the Goddess is one thing... 
We also found him in suspicious circumstances 
when we first came across him.)
(He and Norde talked about an escalation of the 
war between Nolvanus and Rabaneau, too.)
Pup: (Could he really have had a role in that...? I could 
imagine someone who'd be willing to use an
Oathbreaker to do that, but...)
Pup: (How should I handle this?)
[Choice]: Ask Rowan directly about his intentions / Manipulate Rowan into admitting his intentions / Force Rowan to admit his intentions
Pup: (Dammit, I'll just ask the guy. If he's planning stuff, 
then maybe he is willing to just admit it.)
I rounded the corner to enter the room.
Norde: Anton, there you are. Do you feel rested?
Rowan: Better enough to not have to be dragged every 
which way it seems?
Rowan: Maybe enough so that a little ballad could soothe 
your worries now?
Pup: We need to talk.
I grabbed a chair and pulled myself to a place across 
from Rowan at the table.
Rowan: Perfect. Then I've some questions I'd like to ask of 
you.
Pup: I...
Pup: How about this? A question for a question? We 
each need to answer honestly?
Rowan: That does sound fun.
Rowan: As the guest to this party, I shall take the liberty of 
the first question?
I clicked my tongue quietly, but I nodded in 
agreement.
Rowan: You and your father... from where do you hail?
Pup: "Where I hail from"? You mean where I was... 
born? Or what?
Rowan: Whatever strikes you as most appropriate.
Pup: Hmm...

We've moved about for most of the life I can 
remember.

There was a place we lived at for a while when I 
was really young. You'd have to ask my father for 
specifics.
Rowan: You remember nothing of it?
Pup: Of the place... I remember thinking it was pretty?
Pup: Doesn't really matter. My turn.
Rowan: How about your family
Pup: Question for a question. It's my turn.
Rowan: Ah, very well.
Pup: Alright then. My question is as thus.

Did you have anything to do with the attack on 
Lockhart?
Rowan: ...Where did this come from?
Pup: Is there a problem answering the question?
Rowan: It seems more accusation than question. Would 
you humor my confusion?
Pup: ...
Pup: You... have an Oathbreaker. You suddenly show up 
and everything just went to shit.

All after, you were being suspicious around the 
border, too. Even Norde thought it might have to 
do with the war.
Pup: Just be truthful with me... Did you have something 
to do with the attack on Lockhart?
I could feel the gazes of Norde and others turn our 
way.
Rowan: ...
Rowan: Would I be believed should I utter the word, "No"?
Pup: Why would I believe that you- you...
Pup: Goddess dammit..
Pup: I... I just want to know who we can trust...
Pup: And you...
Pup: (Hmm... I wonder... if I try to talk circles around 
him, would he just cough it up accidentally?)
I rounded the corner to enter the room.
Norde: Anton, there you are. Do you feel rested?
Rowan: Better enough to not have to be dragged every 
which way it seems?
Rowan: Maybe enough so that a little ballad could soothe 
your worries now?
Pup: Tempting, but...
Pup: Perhaps a bit later.
Rowan: Do not be surprised when I remember this detail, 
then~
Pup: Want something to drink?
I paced between Rowan the the inn's tavern 
counter.
Rowan: I would not object to some water.
With a twirl of my hands, I soon found myself 
returning to him with a mug of water.
Rowan: Much thanks to you.
Pup: You pass through inns often in your time?
Rowan: In and out for a time now, yes.

More so as I've found myself zigzagging along the 
border.
Pup: Right, you've been causing some havoc along the 
border.
I glided over to by the door, with my back turned 
to Rowan.
Pup: Where'd you come from before that?
Rowan: Hm...? Cartenan, as I've said.
Pup: I mean, you had to have come through a port or 
Nolvanus territory, no?
Rowan: ...
With a silence to greet me, I turned to Rowan and 
walked over to the table.
Rowan: Does that matter?
Pup: W- Well... If you traveled through inns across the 
land, you must have some stories to tell, right?
Pup: Ever get a chance to break out that little key on 
your wrist?
Rowan: Perhaps... a few times...
Rowan placed down the mug of water he had 
been drinking from.
Pup: ...
Pup: I- I mean... you're walking around carrying an 
Oathbreaker. You must be using it for... good 
reasons?
I could feel the gazes of Norde and others turn our 
way.
Rowan: ...
Pup: C- Causing issues around the border... showing up 
with a forbidden artifact of all things...
Rowan: ...Where did this come from?
Pup: I... *sigh*...

F- Fine. I didn't really plan this out, but...
The screeching of the chair rang in the room as I 
quickly pulled it out to sit across from Rowan.
Pup: You had something to do with the attack on 
Lockhart? Even Norde thought you were up to 
something.
Rowan: ...
Rowan: Would I be believed should I utter the word, "No"?
Pup: Are you... messing with me?
Pup: Goddess dammit...
Pup: (Fuck this, I'm just going to force him to tell me 
what's going on with him.)
I rounded the corner to enter the room.
Norde: Anton, there you are. Do you feel rested?
Rowan: Better enough to not have to be dragged every 
which way it seems?
Rowan: Maybe enough so that a little ballad could-
Rowan: Grk!
Pup: I'm doing great, Norde. Thanks for asking.
Rowan: That is... excellent...
Rowan: ...excellent to hear...
I had grabbed Rowan by his clothes and thrown 
him against the wall. At least, I did so as well as I 
could.
Rowan already was a tall, lanky man. Now with my 
change there was a good head's worth of height 
between us.
Rowan: What do I owe the surprise?
Rowan: Ah, this rough behavior...
Rowan: Should I be worried about getting a bill afterwards?
Pup: You... You still have that... Eul... something, yeah?
Rowan: Is that what this is about?

Why yes. Yes I do. Eul'avais hangs from my wrist as 
we speak.
Pup: Why do you have an Oathbreaker?! And that crap 
you were doing around the border... Is that related 
to it?!
Rowan: I won it in a game of chance.
Pup: Bullshit.

Were you trying to cause a distraction around the 
border?
Rowan: Where has this come from?
Pup: You have an Oathbreaker. You suddenly show up 
and this crap drops all around us.

Were you helping with that invasion of Lockhart?!
Rowan: ...
Rowan: Would I be believed should I utter the word, "No"?
Pup: ...
Rowan: Heh. I'll take that as a no.
Rowan: Do as you wish.
Pup: (Maybe I will...)
My fist rose to a cocked position.

But a few seconds passed and it sat there, shaking 
a little.
Pup: Goddess... dammit...
What little was left of my grip released and I 
stepped away from Rowan.
Norde: An... Oathbreaker...?
Pup: Yeah. Turns out he's not quite an expert with locks 
like you may have thought.
Pup: See the key around his wrist? That's it.
I slumped down into a chair.
Norde: Hmm...
Satia: Pup...
Satia walked over and placed a hand on 
my shoulder.
Satia: Are you sure?
Norde stared daggers at Rowan.
Norde: How do you know?
Pup: He told me. When he got free of his bindings. I... 
thought there were higher priorities to deal with at
the time.
Pup: Who knows what else it could do? What it could've 
made happen in Lockhart?
Pup: He could've been the one to cause... this all.
Rowan: ...
Norde: Hm?
Norde's head turned towards the sound of 
footsteps outside the door.
Two familiar women walked through the opening 
door.
Charlotte: We need to- ...to...?
Charlotte and Mariel came through the door. 
Charlotte stood tall with a purpose, but...
Mariel: ...
...Mariel slinked off into a corner to take a seat.
Charlotte: Did something happen here?
Pup: The bard might've had something to do with the 
Lockhart invasion.
Charlotte: What?
Rowan: Am I allowed to speak for myself?
Charlotte: ...

Quickly.
Rowan: I shall attempt so.
Rowan: On my wrist I possess Eul'avais... an Oathbreaker.

By that, our 'Pup' here-
Pup: You don't get to call me that.
Rowan: *Clears throat*... Our "Mr. Anton Baranov, 
descendent of Ivan Baranov and-"
Rowan: Actually, I've not met your mother, have I?
Charlotte: Quicker.
Rowan: Ah... By that, it is believed I am one of those 
"behind the attack" on Lockhart... in some 
manner or another?
Pup: You were also skulking around the border before.
Rowan: It is not a small border.
Norde: Honestly, we mainly pursued that out of an 
abundance of caution. We didn't have a solid 
reason to think that.
Can't say how it'd translate to the attack, either.
Satia: He's suspicious, but... What about the 
Oathbreaker? What could that mean?
Pup: B- But... The Oathbreaker thing, still!
Charlotte: Hmm... What does it do?
Pup: He said it can undo bindings and locks.
Charlotte: Are you sure?
Pup: Yeah. We've seen it at times. Who knows what 
else it could do?
Charlotte: That's really it? Then he's harmless.
Pup: What? But he-!
Charlotte: He's just got some master key. Don't try to lock 
him up or leave him alone and he'll just be...
Charlotte had paced herself over to Rowan, where 
she leaned down and looked him in the eye.
Rowan: ...
Charlotte: ...and he'll just be a little creepy.
Charlotte: Yeah, you should still throw him over to the 
nearest Covenant you come across, though.
Rowan: Your words... They cut through me like a 
sharpened sword.
Norde: Why are you so confident?
Charlotte: One thing to know about Oathbreakers are that 
they can only do one thing.
Pup: Couldn't it be an exception?
Charlotte: Would be news to me.

It's just the nature of them. They're really good at 
one thing, but that one thing is all they got.
Satia: Where did you learn all that...?
Pup: How would you even know that?
Charlotte: Hmph.
She pointed at herself.
Charlotte: I am an heir to Lockhart. Some stuff is basically an 
open secret when you live in those circles.
I was about to protest once more, but the creak of 
the floorboards interrupted me.
Ivan: She's right.
Ivan: Those things break the Goddess's laws of nature in 
one very specific way. One way unique to each.
Norde: Sir... Should you be...?
Mariel: Ah, why are you-? You need to get back to bed!
Mariel: Your wounds should have you out of commission 
for a lot longer than this?!
Ivan: It's okay. I'm just a bit sore now.
Ivan: If anything, I actually feel good. Almost like a spring 
chicken.
passages.content_zh:
Pup: ...
我睜開了眼睛，但沒有動。

轉過頭，我的視線移到另一張床上，看到父親正在睡覺。

先前困擾他的躁動不安已成過去。
Pup: 呃...
幾根頭髮落入我的視線，讓我嚇了一跳。我趕緊把它們撥開。
Pup: *嘆氣*
我無奈地嘆了口氣，用手臂遮住眼睛，擋住光線。

我想起了幾天前發生的事件：洛克哈特的襲擊。

從那以後，我們一行人就一直待在城市南邊的一家旅館裡。我們沒有計畫，但父親的傷勢使得移動他很危險。
Pup: 為什麼？

（為什麼會發生這種事？女神為什麼會允許這種事...）
Pup: ...女神...？
一段記憶浮現在我的腦海中。
Rowan: 唉，女神的法則有時確實很不方便。

破誓者可以創造奇蹟和詛咒，這些都違背了女神領域的法則。
Rowan 轉動手腕，彷彿在展示他擁有的物品。
Rowan: Eul'avais 能夠解除任何束縛。束縛、鎖，以及更多。
Pup: 我... 差點忘了這件事。
在寂靜中，我能聽到從房間門外傳來微弱的撥弦聲。
Pup: ...而且我從未告訴任何人...
在下一次呼吸中，我發現我的腳接觸到地板，引導我走向我聽到的聲音。
我盡可能輕巧地走著，我的腳步引導我來到旅館大廳的門口。
Pup: 嗯...
撥弦聲變得更大，我探頭看了一下，看到 Rowan、Norde 和其他人懶洋洋地閒晃著，沒什麼事可做。
Pup: (該如何接近呢？這個人... 嗯...)
Pup: 嗯...

（打破對女神的誓言是一回事... 我們第一次遇到他的時候，也發現他處於可疑的情況。）
（他和 Norde 也談到了 Nolvanus 和 Rabaneau 之間戰爭的升級。）
Pup: (他真的有可能參與其中嗎...？我可以想像有人願意利用破誓者來做這件事，但是...)

passages.name: CH4 - Scene 3
passages.content:
My father grabbed a seat as we reluctantly agreed 
to put off dealing with Rowan until we were in 
safer waters.
Charlotte expedited the conversation to her own 
news from the town square.
Charlotte: And with that, we would appreciate an escort to 
the town's limits.

Afterwards, we can be on our way and you on 
yours.
Ivan: Hmm... I've given this some thought.
Ivan bit down on some meat the inn was serving. 
After such a long rest, he appeared famished.
Ivan: The Crows used to have a saying... "A job's not 
worth doing if you're not willing to go all the way", 
I believe.
Ivan: I think I've come to want to live up to that, as the 
current leader.
Satia: *Giggle*, how eerily familiar?
Ivan: At least I do. The rest of you...
Ivan turned towards the other members of the 
Nightless Crows.
Ivan: You're free to return to the rest of the group 
when we have safe passage that way.
Mariel: You really don't have to. This much is plenty.
Pup: I definitely think we should keep helping them.
Pup: (After what happened...)
Rowan: I think it is a beautiful sentiment.
Pup: You don't get an opinion.
Norde: I had already written to the rest of our comrades 
with the assumption we would do as much.
Satia: Was there a doubt that we'd want to help?
Charlotte: I...
Ivan: Plus, how are you going to pay us without the
key to your vaults of riches?
Charlotte: Heh...
Charlotte: Alright. Alright. We shall see this through together, 
then?
Mariel: Thank you... All of you...
Jakson: *Reassuring bark*...
Jakson nuzzled up against Mariel's leg.
Mariel: You, too.
Mariel: We can... make things right.
Norde: Then shall we make our escape as soon as we can?
Ivan: Best not to move without a plan.
Ivan bit another large bite out of the meat.
Ivan: ...or an empty stomach.
Pup: I honestly don't think I've seen you so ravenous 
before, Dad...
Norde: Then, as to a plan, where are we headed? I 
imagine the two options are Rabaneau or New 
Aureria?
Charlotte: Actually...
Charlotte: I don't think New Aureria can help us. They're too 
underdeveloped. No notable trade and no real 
army.
Norde: Then the Republic of Rabaneau?
Pup: It does seem like they'd be all for stopping the 
Empire from controlling Lockhart.
Charlotte: I don't want Rabaneau's help unless absolutely 
needed.
Charlotte: I never want to see another battle within those 
walls.
Pup: It's not exactly much of a choice, though.
Charlotte: Not if we head to Ranakstown first.
Charlotte: From there we could sail to the Kingdom of 
Cartenan and the Holy City of Oadthine.
Charlotte: Nolvanus wants to use Lockhart as a shipping hub 
for their war, right?
Charlotte: But with Cartenan and Oadthine, we could put a 
stranglehold on trade in and out of the city.
Pup: Couldn't the empire just conquer them, too?
Charlotte: They might be to able to take Oadthine without 
Lockhart as a buffer...

But taking a holy city is just asking to be the next 
target of the Covenant's crusades.
Ivan: And Cartenan is the uninvadable country.
I looked at my father in confusion.
Norde: Do you not remember that from our lessons?
Pup: Oh... uh...
Pup: "Cartenan is famous for being invaded multiple times 
by large armies only to repel them easily"...
Pup: Wait...
Rowan: Ah, so we see the difference between retention 
and memory.
Pup: Grr...
Norde: That is correct, Anton.
Norde: The Kingdom of Cartenan is the uninvadable 
country by that legacy.
Charlotte: Exactly.
Ivan: Hmm...

We should head to Rabaneau, still.
Charlotte: But I just said-
Ivan: You did. And it is a clever plan, but one they likely 
have thought of themselves, no?
Ivan: As predictable as force is, a wall will still crumble 
despite the foresight.
Charlotte: Well...
A silence fell onto the group.
Norde: Get the innkeeper, Anton.
Pup: Right...
Soldier: Have you seen...
The man at the door could be heard describing 
Charlotte and Mariel.
Innkeeper: Hmm...
The innkeeper's eyes slid to look out of their 
corners at the two girls.
Innkeeper: No, I can't say I have. I will keep an eye out, of 
course.
Soldier: Thank you for your assistance.
A slight rattle could be heard as the wooden door 
closed, and the innkeeper passed by us without a 
word of his own.
Mariel: Thank you, but... why?
Innkeeper: More trouble than it's worth.

Just leave the money for your tab on the counter 
before you leave.
And with that, the man slipped around a corner.
Charlotte: They already have soldiers here doing rounds?
Norde: No doubt they will be much more thorough on the 
next pass. We should leave immediately.
Ivan: Let's move quickly, then.
Pup: What about you? Are you actually okay to move?
Mariel: Yeah, with your injuries...
Ivan: I do, sincerely, feel perfectly fit to do this.
Pup: (He's just that good, then? That strong... to shake 
off such an injury.)
Pup: Right. Let's get moving then.
passages.content_zh:
我們勉強同意，父親搶了個座位
推遲與羅文打交道，直到我們進入
更安全的水域。
夏洛特加快了自己的談話速度
來自城鎮廣場的消息。
夏洛特：這樣，我們將不勝感激地護送
城鎮的界線。

之後我們就可以上路了，你也可以上路
你的。
Ivan：嗯...我已經考慮過這個問題了。
伊凡咬了一口旅館裡供應的肉。 
經過這麼長時間的休息，他顯得很飢餓。
伊凡：烏鴉隊曾經有一句話…「工作不是
如果你不願意一路走下去，那麼值得做”，
我相信。
伊凡：我想我已經開始想要實現這一目標，因為
現任領導人。
薩蒂亞：*咯咯*，有多熟悉？
伊凡：至少我是這麼認為的。你們其餘的人...
伊万轉向其他成員
不夜鴉。
伊凡：你可以自由地回到隊伍中
當我們能安全通過那條路時。
瑪麗埃爾：你真的沒必要這麼做。這麼多就夠了。
Pup：我絕對認為我們應該繼續幫助他們。
小狗：（那件事發生了之後…）
羅文：我認為這是一種美好的情感。
Pup：你沒有意見。
Norde：我已經寫信給我們其他的戰友了
假設我們會做同樣多的事情。
薩蒂亞：我們是否願意提供協助？
夏洛特：我…
伊凡：另外，如果沒有
你的財富寶庫的鑰匙？
夏洛特：呃…
夏洛特：好的。好吧。我們將一起解決這個問題，
然後呢？
瑪麗埃爾：謝謝你們…大家…
傑克森：*令人安心的叫聲*...
傑克森用鼻子蹭著瑪麗埃爾的腿。
瑪麗埃爾：你也是。
Mariel：我們可以……把事情做好。
Norde：那我們要趕快逃走嗎？
伊凡：最好不要沒有計畫就行動。
伊凡又咬了一大口肉。
伊凡：……或是空腹。
小狗：老實說我沒看過你這麼貪吃
以前，爸爸...
Norde：那麼，說到計劃，我們要去哪裡？我
想像兩個選項是 Rabaneau 或 New
奧瑞利亞？
夏洛特：其實…
夏洛特：我不認為新奧雷利亞

passages.name: CH4 - Scene 4
passages.content:
After we grabbed our gear, the innkeeper let us 
leave via the backdoor.

While Charlotte and Mariel weren't likely to be 
recognized by locals easily, we also didn't want 
to draw attention to ourselves for no reason.
Ivan: Ms. Charlotte, go with Norde. You will likely find him 
quite reliable.

Ms. Mariel, you can go with Pup. You can trust him 
as well.
Ivan: As for our companion no one trusts... 
I'll pair with him.
Rowan: We shall have a lovely, uneventful stroll, then?
Pup: Trusting me with the important task?
Ivan: ...
Ivan's hand landed on the top of my head.
Ivan: Please... Just stay safe.
Pup: No need to worry about me just because I've got 
this illness. 

I can do still hold my own in a-
Ivan: Anton.
Pup: I...
Pup: Okay. I will do my best.
Ivan: Thank you.
Broken off into pairs with each of our guests 
getting an escort, we each took a different route 
out of the town.
My father walked away from me with a back that 
felt like I hadn't seen it in a long time. Like a view I 
hadn't seen since I was young.
Pup: (It doesn't matter what barrier I need to get over. 
If I can't... then there's no point.)
I turned towards Mariel and we moved to our 
route.
Rowan and Ivan walked along the perimeter of the 
town square.
Ivan: Rowan, correct?
Rowan: Forgetful? You've asked as much before.
Rowan: The answer is yes, by the way.
Ivan: When we have ourselves at a safe distance, you 
can make yourself scarce.

Otherwise we will likely be obligated to hand you 
over to the Covenant.
Rowan: ...

I think...
As Rowan spoke the words, his eyes drifted to a 
chest with some soldiers walking away from it.
Rowan: I think we could stand to have some insurance for 
our escape.
Ivan: I could certainly get behind that, but... 
What do you have in mind?
Rowan: I've an inkling of an idea.
Norde and Charlotte crossed the town via the port 
side outskirts.
Norde: Nolvanus has no navy, correct?
Charlotte: Yeah. They don't have many ports that aren't 
frozen over most of the year.
Norde: What of Lockhart? Could they claim use of her 
fleet?
Charlotte: Maybe... I imagine a lot of money would need to 
change hands.
Norde: ...
Norde: *Sigh*... Perhaps now would not be the time, but 
you should find a moment to let yourself grieve.
Charlotte: Oh, I'll grieve.
Charlotte: I'll grieve by putting a bullet through that "Steel 
Wolf"'s head.

Then the general's.

And maybe the Emperor and Empress if they're 
brave enough to show their faces.
Charlotte, with a rage steaming beneath the 
surface, took the lead as they walked through the 
town.
Norde: ...
Mariel and I went a different direction well away 
from the others.
Pup: You know, for such a small village, this place is... 
really developed.
Mariel: What do you mean?
Pup: Ah, well... Most villages I've been to of this size 
don't have tiled roads and the like.
Mariel: Really? I had no idea.
Mariel: I've never been far from Lockhart, outside of my 
schooling.
Pup: (Maybe it has something to do with Lockhart being 
a prosperous trade hub?)
Mariel: I... sort of want to see them.
Pup: The small villages?
Pup: They're really not all that special.
Mariel: No, that was presumptuous of me. There's more 
important things to worry about that my idle 
curiosity.
Pup: ...
Pup: Never say never, I guess. Give it some time.
Mariel wasn't sure what to say, but we were cut 
off by a voice.
Imperial Soldier: Hey, you two...
Pup: (Crap...)
Rowan: And that is the last of my batch.
Rowan slid the top of a crate back into place.
Rowan: A few well timed explosions will serve to draw the 
ear of the soldiers away from our escape.

And no one shall get hurt bar a vegetable or two.
Spinning towards his feet, Rowan's gaze turned 
towards his partner in this endeavor, Ivan.
Rowan: Have you finished yours?
Ivan: ...
Rowan: Hm...?
Rowan turned his gaze, and his eyes settled on a 
target out in the distance.
Rowan: No...
Pup: (This is the meeting point?)
My group approached the meeting point to see 
those that got here before us.
Norde: Did you have any trouble?
Mariel: Well...
Pup: One soldier stopped us to ask about them, but 
didn't seem to realize anything was amiss.
Pup: I think they even had some of the details about 
you two wrong.
Charlotte: That's what they get for organizing a manhunt in 
less than a day.
Satia: Thank the Goddess for poor people management 
skills, haha...
Norde: We can be thankful for that, then.
I looked around to see who was here.
Pup: Where's my father? Is he running... late...?
The sentence ended with me hearing frantic 
footsteps behind me.
Rowan: *Gasp*... I... *pant*... We need to keep moving.
Norde: What happened?
Rowan: *Pant*... that... *pant*... Steel Wolf...
Charlotte: What?
Rowan: Not... much... *pant*... time. We need to move 
before the distraction... goes off...
Pup: Wait...
I looked at the path Rowan ran through for
signs of another person.
Pup: Where's my father?
Rowan: ...
Rowan: I was asked to give you this.
Pup: Huh?
Rowan stepped up to me and placed a small locket 
in my hand.
Pup: Why are you...? What is...?
Then a memory struck me.
My vision sealed shut as the memory dropped 
itself into my mind's eye.
Pup: ...
The pattern on the metal cover somehow felt 
familiar, and I hesitantly opened it.
Pup: ...
Charlotte: You said that "Steel Wolf" is here?
Rowan: Yes. That man and his army. We've not time to 
dwell on it. We need to move.
Charlotte: I'll be the judge of that.
Rowan: Apologies, but the decision has already been made. 
We either move or become the target of the 
soldiers.
Charlotte: Why? What did you do?
Pup: ...
My grip on the locket tightened.
Pup: That man...
My heels pivoted as I turned towards a nearby wall 
to start scaling it.
Norde: The soldiers? Is this related to where Ivan is?
Pup: No... No...
I pulled myself to the top of the wall and pivoted 
once more to the town we had just left.

Off in the distance, a few specks of my vision 
caught my eye at the other edge of the town.
Ivan: ...
Steel Wolf: ...
Pup: There he is!
Norde: Your father?
Pup: And he has company. We need to go help him.
Rowan: We've not the time! He sent me ahead for a 
reason.
Jakson: *Bark*!
Jakson looked up to me from the bottom of the 
wall. He seemed raring to go, as well.
Pup: Yeah, we can do this, boy.
Pup: (How long would it take me to sprint all the way 
over there...?)
Pup: You all can flee if you want, I'm going to-
Pup: Grk!
Something wavered within me as I took the step 
to jump down from the wall.
Rowan: ...there it is... out of time... must leave...
Pup: I... not... again...
My eyes went in and out of focus.
My legs and arms felt depleted of strength, and 
what balance I had was lost.
My hearing felt stilted when suddenly only bits and 
pieces of the outside world reached me.
And my eyes only regained clarity as the last sight 
to greet me was the ground below.
passages.content_zh:
拿好裝備後，旅館老闆讓我們
從後門離開。

雖然夏洛特和瑪麗爾不太可能
很容易被當地人認出來，我們也不想要
無緣無故地引起我們的注意。
伊凡：夏洛特女士，和諾德一起去吧。你很可能會找到他
相當可靠。

Mariel女士，你可以跟Pup一起去。你可以相信他
以及。
伊凡：至於我們的同伴，沒人信任…
我會和他配對。
羅文：那我們就來一次愉快、平靜的散步吧？
Pup：把重要的任務交給我？
伊凡：…
伊凡的手落在了我的頭頂上。
伊凡：請……注意安全。
小狗：不用擔心我，因為我有
這種病。 

我仍然可以堅持自己的立場——
伊万：安東。
小狗：我...
小狗：好的。我會盡力而為。
伊凡：謝謝。
與每位賓客分成兩人一組
得到護送，我們各自走了不同的路線
出城。
父親背著我的背影離我而去
感覺好像很久沒看到了。就像我的風景
從小到大就沒見過。
Pup：（我需要克服什麼障礙並不重要。
如果我不能……那就沒有意義了。 ）
我轉向瑪麗埃爾，我們走向了我們的
路線。
羅文和伊凡沿著場地的外圍走著
城鎮廣場。
伊凡：羅文，對嗎？
羅文：健忘？你以前也問過同樣的問題了。
羅文：順便說一下，答案是肯定的。
伊凡：當我們保持安全距離時，你
可以讓自己變得稀缺。

否則我們可能有義務向您提供
到了盟約。
羅文：…

我認為...
羅文說話的時候，目光飄向了
箱子裡有一些士兵正在走開。
羅文：我認為我們可以買一些保險
我們的逃亡。
伊凡：我當然可以支持這一點，但是......
你有什麼想法？
羅文：我有一個想法。
諾德和夏洛特透過港口穿過城鎮
邊郊。
Norde：諾瓦努斯沒有海軍，對嗎？
夏洛特：是的。他們沒有很多端口
一年中大部分時間都處於冰凍狀態。
北歐：

passages.name: CH4 - Scene 5
passages.content:
............................
Pup: Ugh...
My groggy eyes opened to the sound of horse 
hoofs clomping on the ground.
Pup: We need to... help...?!
Charlotte: Finally awake?
Norde: Anton, are you okay to walk?
Pup: I'm fine. Where's my father? We need to go help.
Norde: It is... too late.
Norde: Ivan and the bard decided to set off some small 
scale explosions in town.

While it served as a distraction during our 
absconsion from it, going back would only 
find the soldiers on high alert.
Pup: ...What?
Rowan: ...
Norde: We must place our faith in Ivan, for now.
Norde: We'll make to Rabaneau, like he was suggesting, 
and wait for him there.
Charlotte: Wait, but I-
Norde: We are past the point of decision making. A voyage 
to Cartenan can come later.
Pup: But we need-
Norde: Anton. We are past the point of decision making.
Pup: ...
Mariel: Hey, everyone... I think there's... soldiers ahead?
All of our eyes shifted to see a small group of 
soldiers on the horizon. They hadn't appeared to 
notice us.
Norde: Princesses, what is along this path to the south?
Norde said as much as he pulled us out of their line 
of sight.
Charlotte: More villages. They're probably searching them, 
too.
Norde: Vigilant we will be, then. Do not let yourself be 
distracted.

Be ready for whatever may turn the corner in front 
of us.
Pup: (Goddess... dammit... I have no choice, don't I?)
I tightly held the locket I was given.
passages.content_zh:
............................
Pup: 呃...
我惺忪的睡眼被馬蹄踩踏地面的聲音吵醒。
Pup: 我們需要... 幫忙...？！
Charlotte: 終於醒了？
Norde: Anton，你還能走嗎？
Pup: 我沒事。我父親呢？我們需要去幫忙。
Norde: 已經... 太遲了。
Norde: Ivan 和吟遊詩人決定在鎮上引爆一些小規模的爆炸。

雖然這在我們逃離時起到了分散注意力的作用，但回去只會發現士兵們高度警戒。
Pup: ...什麼？
Rowan: ...
Norde: 我們現在必須信任 Ivan。
Norde: 我們會去 Rabaneau，就像他建議的那樣，在那裡等他。
Charlotte: 等等，但是我-
Norde: 我們已經過了做決定的時候了。去 Cartenan 的航行可以稍後再說。
Pup: 但是我們需要-
Norde: Anton。我們已經過了做決定的時候了。
Pup: ...
Mariel: 嘿，各位... 我覺得... 前面有士兵？
我們所有人的目光都轉向地平線上的一小群士兵。他們似乎還沒有注意到我們。
Norde: 公主們，這條往南的路有什麼？
Norde 說著就把我們拉出了他們的視線。
Charlotte: 更多村莊。他們可能也在搜索那些村莊。
Norde: 那我們就保持警惕。不要讓自己分心。

準備好迎接任何可能在我們面前轉彎的東西。
Pup: (女神... 該死... 我別無選擇，不是嗎？)
我緊緊握住我被給予的項鍊。

passages.name: CH5 - Scene 1
passages.content:
I took the lead as we exited the town we had 
been staying in.

With a strong step forward, I was officially on our 
path to Ranakstown.
Pup: *Deep breath*...
I slapped my cheeks a few times with vigor.
Pup: LET'S GO!!!
Rowan: Huzzah!
Pup: Not you.
Pup: Actually, why don't you just stay
behind?
Rowan: Did our venerable auditor not give me some well of 
credibility to pull from?
Pup: Who knows? Maybe you mind controlled him with 
your Oathbreaker.
Rowan: Ah, such abuse.
Rowan: If you keep it up, I may even come to enjoy it~
Pup: Can you not?
Charlotte: What are you supposed to be? A morning person?
Rowan: I am a man of many hours.

From day to night to the waning of either, I am 
gladly at your disposal.
Rowan: ...for services of any vice that invites your parlay~
Charlotte: Flirting at the first opportunity from a nearly 
complete stranger? I feel at home already.
Rowan: Mayhap we not have traveled together for long...
Rowan: But our relationship feels like one casted in the 
steel of days past.
Charlotte: Oh no. My loins. They burn.

Quick! Take this!
Charlotte dumped her pack into Rowan's hands.
Rowan: What is-
Rowan: Grk!

T- This weight...
Charlotte: I've always been a big fan of the vice of sloth. 
Thanks for offering your services.
Rowan: This is... not exactly... what I...
Pup: Huh...
Charlotte: What's the staring for? You want to take an extra 
load, too?
Pup: No, just... You're not what I was expecting of a 
princess.
Charlotte: What were you expecting?
Pup: Well... I used to hear fairy tales about princesses. 
Saved by heroes and the like.
Pup: Where they were graceful, kind, elegant...
Charlotte: Do tell me all about how I don't live up to the 
standard.
Pup: Oh! Don't worry. You're no slouch. You're very 
pretty and... well...
Charlotte: Hah. So this was a poor excuse to flirt in the end?
I shook my head in objection, but Charlotte just 
giggled at the action.
Charlotte: You're not the first to try and compare me to a 
proper princess.
Pup: "Proper"? Do you mean you're not one?
Charlotte: In title I am.

For all intents and purposes, Lockhart is a mercantile 
plutocracy.
Charlotte: Some like to debate that it's more akin to a 
kraterocracy given the lack of formal structures.
Charlotte: Which I get. Laws are more akin to individual 
groups' policies, after all.
Pup: Uh...
Charlotte: I like to think of it more a matter of supply and 
demand, though.

When issues arise, the race to the bottom helps 
create innovation and...
Charlotte: ...and the supplier to do so... gets control of that... 
that...
Charlotte stared at me as I myself stared out into
nothingness.
Charlotte: Y- You okay?
Pup: I- I... yeah. I... hear you.

Got to love pluno... stuff...
Charlotte: *Sigh*... It's fine.
Charlotte: My family has the biggest company so we get the 
keys to the castle.
Pup: And... that makes you a princess?
Charlotte: Officially, yes.

But it's more an excuse to give more traditional 
pomp and circumstance to the role.

You're free to rid me from your mental warehouse 
of princess comparisons.
Pup: *Sigh*... I didn't mean it like that.
Charlotte: Well... maybe it'd be easier for us to do that 
anyways. To not to dwell on that sort of stuff.

There are enough distractions as is.
Pup: Yeah, you're right...
I took out my locket.

After taking a deep breath, I clenched it in my 
hand tightly.
Pup: (We can only just keep moving forward.)
Pup: (I have faith in my father. He wouldn't die so 
easily.)
Charlotte: Besides, you might get to see a full fledged princess 
when we get to Cartenan.
Pup: The Kingdom of Cartenan...
Pup: So you've been there? What's it like?
Rowan: Some call it the "Land of a Thousand Summers".
Pup: Ack! Where did you come from?!
Charlotte: Uh... You're still carrying all that?
Rowan: I did offer, despite my otherwise ignored intents.
Rowan: And on the topic of the Kingdom, who better to 
ask than I?
Pup: Right, you did say you were from Cartenan, didn't 
you?
Rowan: You two are getting ahead of yourselves, anyways.

After all, in order to get to Cartenan, there is an 
obstacle in our way.

It is why we head for Ranakstown, no?

To get to Cartenan...
passages.content_zh:
當我們離開我們所在的城鎮時，我帶頭
一直入住.

向前邁出了堅實的一步，我正式加入了我們的行列。 
通往拉納克斯敦的道路。
小狗：*深呼吸*...
我用力拍了幾下臉頰。
小狗：我們走吧！ ！ ！
羅文：哈札！
小狗：不是你。
小狗：事實上，你為什麼不留下來呢？
後面？
羅文：我們可敬的審計師沒有給我一些好處嗎？ 
可信度如何？
小狗：誰知道呢？也許你用精神控制了他
你的誓言者。
羅文：啊，這樣的虐待。
Rowan：如果你堅持下去，說不定我也會來享受呢~
小狗：你可以不嗎？
夏洛特：你應該是什麼樣子？一個早起的人？
羅文：我是一個工作時間很長的人。

從白天到黑夜，再到日暮，我
很高興為您服務。
羅文：…感謝任何邀請你的惡行的服務~
夏洛特：一有機會就調情
完全陌生嗎？我已經有賓至如歸的感覺了。
羅文：也許我們一起旅行的時間不長…
羅文：但我們的關係感覺就像是在
過去的日子裡的鋼鐵。
夏洛特：噢不。我的腰部。他們燃燒。

快的！拿著這個！
夏洛特把包包丟到羅文手裡。
羅文：什麼是——
羅文：天哪！

T-這個重量...
夏綠蒂：我一直很喜歡懶惰的惡習。 
感謝您提供服務。
羅文：這……不完全是……我……
小狗：呃…
夏洛特：盯著什麼？你想要額外的
負載也？
Pup：不，只是…你不是我所期待的那樣
公主。
夏洛特：你在期待什麼？
Pup：嗯……我以前聽過關於公主的童話故事。 
被英雄等人所救。
Pup：他們優雅、善良、優雅......
夏洛特：請告訴我所有關於我如何不辜負
標準。
小狗：哦！不用擔心。你可不是個無精打采的人。你很
漂亮而且……嗯……
夏洛特：哈。那麼這到底是個糟糕的調情藉口嗎？
我搖搖頭表示反對，但夏洛特只是反對
看到這個動作咯咯笑。
夏洛特：你不是第一個試圖將我與一個人進行比較的人
適當的公主。
小狗：「合適」？做

passages.name: CH5 - Scene 2
passages.content:
Nora: ...they'd need to cross the Crimson Sea.
Jude: Or they fled behind the advancing troops of the 
Republic.

Those are your two choices. Cartenan or 
Rabaneau.
Nora: They could have fled directly south as well.
Jude: Those big fox ears on your head just for show?
Nora: Choose your next words carefully, honlyn.
Jude: Ah, what a pain in the ass.
Jude: No, you're right! They'd go south to get help from 
no one.
Jude: Honestly, it's what I'd do if I were them. It'd get 
me to my next paycheck sooner too.
Nora: Hmph.
Nora: And what about you...

...sir?
Steel Wolf: ...
The figure clad in armor had not moved for some 
time.

He stared down at his kill.
Nora: Come on. Stop wasting time on that corpse.

Aren't you supposed to be in charge?
Jude: They probably retreated behind the Rabaneau front 
line before it was pushed back.

It's an old saying. The simplest answer often ends 
up being the truth.
Nora: I wasn't looking for your opinion.
Jude: Argh! You're overcomplicating it.
Jude: Why would they ignore the Republic when that 
opportunity comes waltzing up to them?

Is it really that you just want an excuse to keep 
rushing forward?
Nora: Tsk. We have a job to do.

We need to secure Lockhart so it can properly 
reorganize.
Nora: I won't sit still with such threats still out there.
The two stared each other down.
Steel Wolf: They are no threats.
Jude: Huh? It talked?
Steel Wolf: Their champion is dead.
Nora: And what of it? 

The other fugitives are still out there.
Steel Wolf: Their champion was weak.
Nora and Jude looked on with confusion.
Steel Wolf: Woman clad in red steel.

Are you strong?
Nora: Am I...?
Nora: ...
Nora: I am as strong as I need to be for Lockhart's 
future.
Steel Wolf: Then there is no threat.

Their champion was weak.

Therefore, they are weak.

And there is only one fate awaiting the weak.
The Steel Wolf turned on his heel and began back 
towards Lockhart.
Steel Wolf: Misery and death.

All roads lead to such an end.
passages.content_zh:
諾拉：...他們需要跨越緋紅海。
裘德：或者他們逃到共和國不斷推進的軍隊後方。

這是你的兩個選擇。卡特南或拉巴諾。
諾拉：他們也可能直接往南逃。
裘德：你頭上那對大狐狸耳朵只是裝飾品嗎？
諾拉：說話小心點，混蛋。
裘德：啊，真他媽的麻煩。
裘德：不，妳說的對！他們會往南逃，不向任何人求助。
裘德：老實說，如果我是他們，我會這麼做。這樣我也可以更快領到下一次的薪水。
諾拉：哼。
諾拉：那你呢...

...大人？
鋼鐵之狼：...
這位身著盔甲的人影已經很久沒有動靜了。

他俯視著他的獵物。
諾拉：拜託。別再浪費時間在那具屍體上了。

你不是應該負責的嗎？
裘德：他們可能在拉巴諾前線被擊退之前，就撤退到那條防線後方了。

有句老話說得好。最簡單的答案往往就是真相。
諾拉：我不是在尋求你的意見。
裘德：啊！妳想得太複雜了。
裘德：共和國主動送上門來，他們為什麼要忽略這個機會？

妳是不是只是想找個藉口繼續往前衝？
諾拉：嘖。我們有工作要做。

我們需要確保洛克哈特的安全，以便它能好好重組。
諾拉：我不會眼睜睜地看著這些威脅仍然存在。
兩人互相瞪視。
鋼鐵之狼：他們不是威脅。
裘德：蛤？它說話了？
鋼鐵之狼：他們的冠軍死了。
諾拉：那又怎樣？

其他的逃犯還在外面。
鋼鐵之狼：他們的冠軍很弱。
諾拉和裘德困惑地看著他。
鋼鐵之狼：身穿紅色鋼鐵的女人。

妳夠強嗎？
諾拉：我...？
諾拉：...
諾拉：為了洛克哈特的未來，我必須有多強就有多強。
鋼鐵之狼：那麼就沒有威脅。

他們的冠軍很弱。

所以，他們也很弱。

而弱者只有一個命運在等待著他們。
鋼鐵之狼轉身，開始往洛克哈特的方向走回去。
鋼鐵之狼：悲慘和死亡。

所有的路都通往這樣的結局。

passages.name: CH5 - Scene 3
passages.content:
The group traveled as a whole through the 
southern region of the West Auran Alliance.

While we were on our guard for imperial troops 
catching up to us, none ever did.

Despite this good fortune, our route to Cartenan 
was still blocked by the sea to our north.

The Crimson Sea was infamous for being very 
dangerous to navigate. Few ports offered transit 
across it.
With Lockhart as an enemy, we only had one 
choice of where to seek help.

Ranakstown. The infamous pirate's cove of the 
Crimson Sea.
Norde: Then this would be Ranakstown?
Cainan: That it is. Have you not been?
Charlotte: I imagine most try to avoid pirate hotspots.
Norde: Bandits are nothing new in our line of work.
Norde: Bar the port, this city does have shades of bandit 
country more inland.
Mariel: It certainly has a different aura about it than 
Lockhart has.
Satia: Ah, I didn't get a chance to think about it on our 
way from Lockhart, but the sea air is lovely.

Such a long time since I had the
pleasure~
Pup: My feet are killing me.
Pup: There's bound be an inn nearby, right?
Cainan: Ah, not so fast.
Cainan: If we wish to take a ship in the morning, we'd best 
make contact with a crew before the night takes 
us.
Norde: True. They'd need time to prep.
Pup: Then let's do that.
Our group walked through the city and asked 
around about potential leads.
Pup: (For a pirate town, you'd think they'd be easier to 
find.)
The inquiry seemed to be fleeting.

At least, it seemed that way until...
Young Girl: Sorry, can't say I ever seen no ferry services around 
this place.
A young nekolyn woman had stopped in her day 
to humor our questions.
Norde: We are in... a hurry of sorts.
Norde: Our group would be open to less... formal 
solutions.
Norde: Given the reputation of Ranakstown...
Young Girl: Ugh... those creeps.
Pup: Creeps meaning... pirates?
Young Girl: Shh!
Young Girl: The local guard don't like when people talk about 
them.

But...
Young Girl: If you're that desperate, there's a tavern I work at 
that probably has some of them getting drunk at.
Cainan: It is a start, at the least. Thank you.
Young Girl: I was just headed in for a shift anyways.
Young Girl: Hans! We got some out of towners!
A division of our members entered the tavern and 
were guided by the woman to sit at the bar.
Pup: (This place is... dank...)
A rustle sound met my ears and a man appeared 
from the backrooms.
Hans: Hm? What's up now?
Young Girl: Sir, these guys want to access the secret menu.
Hans: ...Well, then.

What's your poison?
Rowan: My good man. I'll take-
Norde: Info. We need transit north.
Hans: North, eh? Rough waters that way.
Norde: Then we'll need hardy seamen to cover us.
Rowan: Seamen, you say?
I gave Rowan a stink eye.
Hans: Why so desperate to go north?
Norde: ...
Cainan: Are you asking because you actually care?

Or do you just want to confirm our desperation in 
setting a price?
Hans: Hmph.
The room went silent.
Pup: (It felt like a bunch of gazes just peeked our 
way...)
A variety of the patrons started to get up and walk 
out.
Pup: Huh?
Drinks had been dropped in front of each of us.
Young Girl: Consider it a going away gift.
Hans: It her?
Young Girl: Yep.
Pup: What are you talking about?
But it only took another second for my answer.
Charlotte: ...hey...where do you think...
Something had started outside!
Pup: Princess!
Hans: Thank ya very much for bringing her!
Cainan: Then shall we negotiate the hard way?
The gaze in front of me showed me steel on steel.

Cainan had unsheathed his weapon to take on the 
sword slash of the tavern owner.
Norde: Grhhh!!!
Hans: D- Dammit!
Young Girl: Ouch. That looked like it hurt.
Young Girl: Well, nice meeting you all~
Pup: I'm not just going to let you-
I reach out my hand, but-
Pup: Grk!
My head whiplashed back at I was hit in the face.
Pup: ...?!
Before I could regain my bearings, I felt a weight 
land on my shoulders.

My eyesight began to return while I fell to the 
ground from this weight.

The first sight in my vision was that woman jumping 
off my shoulders and over our group towards the 
exit.
Young Girl: Make sure to leave a tip!
She fell out of the tavern through the saloon doors 
and jumped to her feet outside.
Pup: I-... What in the goddess's name just happened?
Rowan: No time. Charlotte and the others are still 
in trouble.
Pup: R- Right.
We rushed out to find a small group of pirates that 
had already been defeated.
Charlotte: Don't you dare fucking touch me, you pieces of 
shit.
Charlotte gave one a hard kick.
Rowan: Ah, by the stars' damnedest, you are alright.
Mariel: W- Why are they attacking? Did your talks go that 
poorly?
Charlotte: As far as business deals go, I'm not a fan.
Cainan: It was a trap. It may even still be.
Cainan: Hmm... did the notice of a bounty make it all the 
way here already?
Pup: Hey! Did a black haired nekolyn run through here?
Charlotte: Nekolyn? The girl from before the meeting?
Pup: Yeah, she was in on it, too.
Satia: If that girl did come out here, then she slipped 
away before we could notice.
Charlotte: If she did, she slipped away before we could 
notice.
Jakson: *Directional bark*!
Jakson pointed towards the port.
Norde: If she wanted to get allies, then the port seems 
like the place for a pirate.
Pup: Then let's let her lead us to a source.
Norde: *Sigh*... Is there truly no other port we could take 
our business to?
Charlotte: Not if we want a boat that can actually get across 
the Crimson Sea in one piece.
Rowan: Then we are decided?
Rowan: To battle!
passages.content_zh:
一行人作為一個整體遊覽了
西奧蘭聯盟南部地區。

當我們為帝國軍守衛時
追上我們，但沒有人追上我們。

儘管有這樣的好運，我們前往卡特南的路線
我們的北部仍然被大海阻擋。

赤海因極度惡劣而臭名昭著
航行危險。很少有港口提供過境服務
穿過它。
有了洛哈特這個敵人，我們就只剩下一個了
選擇去哪裡尋求協助。

拉納克斯敦。臭名昭著的海盜灣
赤紅之海。
Norde：那這裡就是拉納克斯敦（Ranakstown）？
蔡南：原來如此。你沒去過嗎？
夏洛特：我想大多數人都會盡量避開海盜熱點。
Norde：強盜對我們的工作來說並不是什麼新鮮事。
Norde：除了港口，這座城市確實有強盜的影子
國家更內陸。
Mariel：它確實有一種不同的光環
洛哈特有。
薩蒂亞：啊，我沒有機會在我們的網站上考慮這個問題。 
距離洛克哈特很遠，但是海邊的空氣很可愛。

自從我有這麼長時間以來
高興~

Pup：附近一定有一家旅館吧？
蔡南：啊，沒那麼快。
彩南：如果我們想早上坐船，我們最好
在入夜前與工作人員取得聯繫
我們。
諾德：確實如此。他們需要時間準備。
小狗：那我們就這麼做吧。
我們一行人穿過這座城市並詢問
圍繞潛在的線索。
Pup：（對於海盜鎮，你會認為他們會更容易
找到。 ）
詢問似乎轉瞬即逝。

至少，看起來是這樣，直到…
年輕女孩：抱歉，我沒看過周圍沒有渡輪服務
這個地方。
一位年輕的內科林婦女已經停止了她的日子
來幽默我們的問題。
Norde：我們……有點匆忙。
Norde：我們的團隊將對不太正式的...持開放態度
解決方案。
Norde：鑑於拉納克斯敦的聲譽...
年輕女孩：呃……那些令人毛骨悚然的東西。
小狗：小怪的意思是……海盜？
少女：噓！
年輕女孩：當地警衛不喜歡人們談論
他們。

但是...
年輕女孩：如果你那麼絕望的話，我在小酒館工作
