passages.name: CH6 - New Event
passages.content:
WARNING: Cainan is about to leave the party. 
You may want to remove any items of value.
 
Are you ready to move foward?
[Choice]: Yes / No
Tatiana: Ugh... This... stupid... I want to go back in 
my armor, and...
Tatiana's words stopped in her throat as she felt 
something rising.
Pup: Ugh... Does anyone else... feel..
I stopped my words as a wooziness started to wash 
over my mind.
Otis: Oi! If ya gonna hurl, do it over the side!
Mariel: I- It'll be alright... You just need to get used to it.

Maybe we should all get some air?
Charlotte: First timers...
Charlotte: It's probably worth getting them some air.
The chilled sea air burst into the cabin and met the 
first time seafarers' lungs.
Pup: That's... ugh... That helps.
Charlotte: Heh. Try running a merchant shipping company.
Norde: I can only imagine how poorly that'd go.
Pup: Oh... you were out here...
Pup: Maybe inside was better.
A few of the others had already been on deck, 
including Norde, Cainan, and members of Otis's 
crew.
Norde: Helpful.

Especially so if a third of our group would be useless 
in a fight due to sea sickness.
Satia: Now, now... No need to pick a fight just to prove a 
point.
Pup: After all this time, stuff like that out of your mouth 
still sounds vaguely like a threat.
Cainan: What a lovely atmosphere.
Rowan: Indeed. Mayhap we see forgiveness and 
merriment?
Pup: You. Don't. Talk.
Rowan: If you make me.
Pup: Okay... I'm throwing it overboard.
I took a step forward.
Otis: I'll throw ya both overboard if you don't shut ya 
stupid traps.
Charlotte: Maybe the seasickness isn't the worst effect of the 
voyage, but being cooped up for days...
Otis: Argh! I'm never taking on fucking stowaways again.
Charlotte: I paid you way too much for you to be pretending 
we're stowaways.
Otis: Yeah, and you're not getting any refund if I need 
to throw some stowaways overboard.
Charlotte: Hmph.
Norde: *Sigh*...
Rowan: Ha... haha...?
Pup: Nrgh...
An awkward, tense silence fell over the group.
Cainan: Truly, it is a shame I will be leaving this behind.
Pup: ...?
Cainan turned towards the sea.

A ship was visible on the horizon.
Cainan: That is your comrade?
Otis: Ah, I see they're here for the meet up.

They should get ya to Oadthine in one piece.
Pup: Oadthine...
Charlotte: And? Do you think your Covenant buddies will 
decide to help?
Cainan: Most assuredly.
Cainan: The West Auran Alliance was created as a buffer 
zone of city-states for such external threats to the 
Holy City.
It would be odd for them to not care that a Holy 
City's autonomy is thrown into question.
Charlotte: Yeah, well... we need to put some faith into you, 
then. Do us proud.
Cainan: Faith I would gladly accept...
Cainan: Though, perhaps it is better saved to give to the 
Goddess.
The other ship slowly made its way to be in parallel 
with our own.

Cainan, with what luggage he had to bring, 
brought himself to the ramp leading to the other 
ship.
Cainan: Well, then here we are. It was good fighting 
alongside you all.
Cainan: Well, then here we are. It was good to be able to 
work with you all until this point.
Norde: This contact you mentioned from Cartenan... What 
was her relation to you again?
Cainan: Kara Lyons. She is my fiancé.
Charlotte: That's a name I haven't heard in a while.

To think she'd go and get herself a fiancé? I guess 
it was only a matter of time for a girl like her.
Cainan: That it was. At least as it was once we first 
laid eyes on one another.
Norde: And she is a noble that can get us an audience 
with the Queen of Cartenan?
Cainan: Indeed. I have written a letter of introduction, as 
well, so...
The goodbyes continued for Cainan's short stay 
with the group, and he handed an envelope to 
Charlotte.
Pup: ...
I, on the other hand, chose to step aside and 
simply view from a short distance away.
Cainan: ...
Despite that, Cainan walked over to me.
Cainan: No words for our 'to be departed'?
Pup: Would you prefer some?
Cainan: If you do not, then I shall offer some of my own.
Cainan: This world is... unflinching.

It is an unforgiving decadence the typical soul 
leaves in their wake.
Cainan: It is tempting to look back, but no matter what 
you hope to see...
Cainan: ...who you hope to see...
Pup: (Who...? Does he mean...?)
Cainan: ...it is better to keep your eyes facing forward.
Cainan: I suspect the sight to be most unpleasant.
Pup: ... 

I...
A hand lowered on top of my head as Cainan gave 
a soft chuckle.

I wasn't sure how long the moment was, but it 
was over before I could get to my next thought.
Cainan: Good luck, young Pup. Do me proud in your 
struggle.
He turned, and with relaxed steps headed onto the 
other ship.
Pup: ...
Pup: ...
I took a half step backwards, and my hand 
navigated to my pocket.
Pup: (He... No, he's... He's wrong about my father...!)
My hand gripped tightly around the locket I had 
been given by my father.
Charlotte: I think we can trust he'll succeed.
Rowan: Such confidence.
Charlotte: Apparently he's engaged to an old friend of mine. 
One I trust a lot.

If she picked him, then...
The words trailed off as they didn't register to me 
anymore.
Pup: (I just... I just need to keep getting stronger.)
I turned on my heel to head into the ship cabin.
Mariel: Oh... Why are you headed back in? Are you feeling 
better... or...?
Charlotte: He must be feeling a little better if he's headed 
back inside.
Rowan: Hmm...
With that, Cainan's ship disappeared into the 
horizon and day quickly turned to night.
Pup: ...
Pup: Dammit...
The blanket, wrapped tightly around me, started to 
feel like it was suffocating me as I pulled it in more 
and more.
Pup: (I...)
Pup: (I need some air...)
I rolled away from my bedding and the blanket slid 
deftly and messily across the floor I walked upon.
Pup: ...
I sat at the deck's edge and stared out into
the sea.

No thoughts, but I had a feeling as though one 
may force itself out.

So I closed my eyes and leaned back...
...

......

...............................

The locket I had received was gripped tightly in my 
hand.

As I relaxed, the sensations soon became 
exclusively it.

The smooth casing.

The intricate patterns on it's side and likely within 
as well.

Again and again, those were my world.

Until...
Rowan: Truly, a poor place to make your nightly quartering.
My eyes opened.
Pup: ...
Rowan: ...
Rowan stood above me, looking down at me as my 
relaxed self faced the sky.
Pup: Go away.
Rowan: It would be a folly of mine to let a friend catch a 
cold.
Rowan: Particularly if said cold came from falling into the 
chilling sea.
Pup: We're not friends.
Rowan: Allies?
Pup: No.
Rowan: Acquaintances?
Pup: ...
Rowan: Fellow oath bearers of the Goddess?
Pup: ...
Pup: *Sigh*...

From you of all people...
Rowan: Then it would be a poor decision to let a fellow 
oath bearer of the Goddess...
Rowan moved to take a seat next to me.
Rowan: ...fall into the ocean and catch a most frightful 
cold.
Pup: ...
He tried to direct me to sit up and talk, but I just 
stayed staring at the stars in the sky.
Pup: Could you please just...
Pup: (Of all people to not let me be alone? I just want 
to get rid of him.)
I tried to think of what precisely I wanted to say.
[Choice]: Point out that this is pointless. / Joke about nonsense to fill the silence until he leaves / Refuse to even talk to him.
Pup: I don't want to talk to you.

I just want to... be by myself.
Rowan: Then I shall stay here... by myself.
Pup: With you completely realizing how nonsensical even 
saying that is...
Pup: You're not one to listen to reason, are you?
Rowan: I realized in my waning years of life how little words 
truly meant when one had made up their mind.
Pup: ...
Pup: Aren't you my age?
Pup: So when will you get out of my hair?
Rowan: Hmm...
Rowan: When you make me laugh.
Pup: Deal.
I turned my head towards him.
Pup: What's the difference between a mercenary and a 
missionary?
Rowan: ...?
Pup: Not much. Both are gonna introduce you to 
the Goddess, though.
Rowan: ...
I looked back up at the stars, and I focused on one 
as I tried to remember.
Pup: Give a man a fish, he'll eat for a days. But give a 
man a woman...
Pup: He'll eat for a week.
Pup: Maybe more with good rationing.
Rowan: ...
Pup: Oh, I've got a million more terrible jokes. How long 
do you think I've been living with mercenaries?
Rowan: Haha...
Pup: ...Dammit...
Pup: Just go.
Rowan: What an inviting gesture~
Pup: I'm not asking.
Pup: Of all people... I do not want to talk to you.

A heathen, a fool, a..
Rowan: A killer.
Pup: ...
Rowan: I don't blame the difficulty in disassociating me from 
that event.
Pup: ...
With a deep breath, I calmed myself.
I pushed myself up to a sitting position, feeling 
hooked into Rowan's insistence.
Pup: What do you actually want?
Rowan: To not find one more body welcoming the depths 
of the Crimson Sea.

I did say it was dangerous to nap here.
Pup: Then I'm up. Can you leave now?
Rowan: Hmm... Have you slept at all tonight?
Pup: ...
Pup: What do you want?

Why shouldn't I throw you over right now?

Send you and that stupid fucking Oathbreaker to 
the bottom of the sea...
Rowan: Apologies, but...
Rowan: I float.
My breath stopped for a moment as I had to 
actually stop myself from testing that.
Rowan: And I do not know.
Pup: What?
Rowan: I do not know what I want.

From you. From... this.

I saw a soul... a soul ever too lost... and I wanted 
to act.

To sing it a lullaby so it could find a peaceful resting 
spot.
When my mouth opened in response, I couldn't 
find the words.
Pup: I'm going back inside. Do not follow me.
I began to get up and head in, when...
Rowan: Ah... Perhaps this was a...
Rowan: Oh...?
Rowan picked up something I had accidentally left 
behind.
Rowan: This is... that locket.
Pup: Ah...?!
A click came with the locket opening.
Rowan: Is this... our adorable Pup as a pup?!
Pup: Give that back!
I jumped at Rowan and he deftly evaded.
Rowan: To steal this revelation from me at the height of 
interest would be most cruel!
Pup: ...!
I leaped at him again and got awfully close to 
tripping near the ship's edge.
Rowan: This is getting quite dangerous... mayhap we can 
make a deal?
Rowan: Tell me about them. The people in these portraits.
Pup: ...
Rowan: I now know that this is what I want. I will leave 
you alone for as long as you want me to if you 
comply.
Pup: ...
Rowan: And... would you not like to speak your mind on 
them? How long has it been since you had a
chance to?
Pup: ...Fine.
Pup: Once upon a time there was a family.

A father, a mother, and two young boys.

And once upon a time in that time's not too distant 
future... that ended.

The end.
Rowan: Now now. Do try to take it seriously.
Pup: From you, I can't tell if that's a joke.
Rowan: So this in the painting is... you...? And your father 
is with you.
Pup: Yeah. A long time ago.
Rowan: Ivan looks... much the same.
Pup: Without the gray in his hair, yeah.
Rowan: Such a cute little boy he shepherded.
Rowan: Were you as calm as the artist depicted you as? Or 
were you a terror of a pup? Chewing on 
the furniture and all that?
Pup: I don't know.
Rowan: Hmm?

What do you remember, then?
Pup: It was... so long ago. I was very young at the time.
Pup: At a point, everything just feels like... stories. 
Stories you tell yourself to convince yourself 
they were real.
Rowan: ...

Then, in that story and these paintings, that'd 
make this person...
Pup: My mother, Estella.
Rowan: And the other child?
Pup: My older brother, Nikolai.
Rowan: Truly?

I had imagined you to have more of a "twin" aura 
about you.
Pup: What?
Rowan: Regardless... The occupants of this frame of the 
locket...

May I ask of their... current status?
Pup: They're...
Pup: ...stories.
Rowan: Do you mean...?
Pup: We're all stories... in the end.

We are all stories in the end.

We are.
Rowan: ...

Anton. May I ask another question?
Pup: ...
Rowan: Why do you feel the need to be "strong"?
Pup: ...
I closed my eyes as the thought triggered an 
intense feeling.
Pup: I remember bedtimes stories.

Myths and legends of the world.

The heroes that define our ideal of reality. 
Ideal of a person.

There was King Minae the wise, who had strength 
of mind.

The old legends of those that felled the dragons, 
and their strength of body.

Even the more modern, with the great liberator of 
Rabaneau, Kaeden Leopold, and his strength of will.
Pup: Men who did great feats for the benefit of 
many others.

Men truly worthy of their legacy.
Pup: I sometimes hear those stories again when I dream. 
As though my mother was still here to tell them.
Pup: When I think of those, and then see my father...
Pup: I feel like he could put the world on his back and 
keep going.
Pup: I see that and those bedtime stories start to feel so 
real.
Pup: So real that... that I don't think I could forgive 
myself if...
I trailed off.
Rowan: ...
Rowan fiddled with the locket in his hand.
Rowan: I do have a favorite part of stories myself.
Pup: Yeah?
I said weakly, only half acknowledging his presence 
at this point of this talk.
Rowan: This locket.

I've held it twice now. So I feel as though I can 
make this observation with confidence.
Rowan: It is an heirloom.
Pup: What?
My eyebrows sprung up as my attention was fully 
grabbed.
Rowan: Indeed. Much as my own and others, it is a tool for 
performing magical mysteries through the Goddess's
blessings.
If you spent the time to learn the process, you may 
be even able to use it to cast magic yourself.
Rowan: Though mayhap most important of all.
Rowan: It is a classic sign of nobility to have such a blessed 
item passed down within a lineage.
Rowan extended his arm to hand the locket back 
to me.
Pup: ...
He just held it there as I stared.

Only after what felt like a silent eternity did I start 
to slowly move to take it from him.

After I did, my eyes didn't stop staring at it.
Rowan: Indeed, that is my favorite part of a story.

For every story we tell... There is a backstory.

And what wonders and treasures they can hide 
within~
Pup: ...
Pup: ...
My attention was only broken by the sun peeking 
over the horizon.
Pup: Daybreak already...?
Rowan: So many intriguing questions about that locket...
Rowan: It's legacy, and what sort of magic it can conjure.
Rowan turned more directly to me.
Rowan: I do not know if it would suit your chosen fighting 
style, but one can learn to use the magic of 
heirlooms.
Pup: ...
I was only half listening. I was only half allowing 
myself thoughts.

My eyes simply stared out into the breaking sunrise.

Where I saw...
Pup: ...?

(Is that... a figure in the sunlight?)
Rowan: It is a skill to be learned. Over time, and...
Rowan, noticing my more focused gaze, turned in 
that direction.
Rowan: ...?!
Rowan: ...!
A weight rammed into me and threw me to my 
side.

Seconds later, the sound of whooshing air twirled 
by my ear moments before I felt myself crash into 
the wooden planks below.
Pup: ...!
Plastered against the wood, I turned my head up 
to see what had slammed into me.
Rowan: Uh...
Rowan was perched above me with hands to the 
side of my head like a scene out of a romantic 
novella.
Rowan: Fancy meeting you like this~
Pup: What was... What happened?!
Rowan: Magic.
Rowan: Which is impressively on topic given the nature of 
our discussion.
Pup: Are we being attacked?!
Rowan: R- Right... Yes!
Rowan got off me and helped me to my feet.

Swiveling to the attacker, I reached for my sword.
Pup: (Shit! I didn't bring it with me!)
Pup: ...!
Enemy: ...!
The enemy was in striking distance!
Rowan: Now!
The enemy dissipated into flickers of dark and fiery 
shadows.
Pup: Thanks.
Pup: But... what was that?
Rowan: A "shade".

Shades are tricky little rats that can use mirage-like 
shadows to disguise themselves as most any form.

They're a favorite of summoners for that reason.
Pup: Meaning the summoner needs to be nearby. 
Especially if they cast that magic and are controlling 
them.
Rowan: Summoner, yes... Or summoners.
My head turned to the horizon again.
Pup: Another ship.

We need to get the others.
Simon: Heheh... I assume the forward group has begun 
their assault?

Has their little ship been put up in flames?
Summoner: My associate appears to have started the attack, 
yes.
Simon: Excellent! A decisive battle at daybreak...

It shall be a wonderous headline for the news 
cycle.

A truly beautiful sight!

Let us sail the high seas! To glory!

愚蠢的陷阱。
夏洛特：也許暈船還不是最嚴重的影響

夏洛特：我付你太多錢，讓你無法假裝
我們是偷渡客。

把一些偷渡客丟到海裡。
夏洛特：哼。
諾德：*嘆氣*...
羅文：哈……哈哈……？
小狗：呃…
眾人陷入尷尬、緊張的沉默。
蔡南：確實如此

passages.content:
Pup: (So, how to do this dance thing...)
Pup: (Or, you know, I could just go for a win in a less 
nonsensical way.)
Pup: (Not like she wants to hear me out...)
Pup: Ugh...
Reagyn: Shall we begin?
Reagyn raised her weapon in an intentional way 
that seemed to be part of the sports’ rules, so I 
followed suit.
Head Noble: Now! Begin!
In order to correctly "dance", Pup must step into all 
red squares in one turn. 

Dancers' ability allow units to move again. Move the 
dancers next to Pup to use this ability.
passages.content_zh:
Pup: (所以，該怎麼跳這個舞呢...)
Pup: (或者，你知道的，我可以就用比較不荒謬的方式贏得勝利。)
Pup: (反正她也不想聽我說...)
Pup: 呃...
Reagyn: 我們開始吧？
Reagyn 以一種刻意的方式舉起她的武器，這似乎是運動規則的一部分，所以我照做了。

為了正確地「跳舞」，Pup 必須在一回合內踏入所有紅色方格。

舞者的能力允許單位再次移動。將舞者移動到 Pup 旁邊以使用此能力。

passages.name: CH7 - Charsimatic
passages.content:
Pup: ...!
Reagyn: ...!
As I followed the prompts I was given to move, I...

...was outpacing her.

Not at first, but by the end of the dance...

Pup Baranov!
Reagyn: Hmph. That surprised me. I should’ve taken you

She turned away in a bit of a huff.
Pup: See what a battle hardened warrior can do?
Charlotte: I didn’t actually think you had it in you.
Kara: An impressive display of finesse.
Pup: Hm? Of what?
Kara: Ah... It isn’t so important.
+1 Charisma Points
passages.content_zh:
小狗：...！
蕾根：...！
當我跟隨指示移動時，我...

...超越了她。

一開始沒有，但到了舞的尾聲...
貴族首領：結束了！結果...是...小狗·巴拉諾夫獲勝！
蕾根：哼。真讓我驚訝。我應該更認真看待你的。
她有點生氣地轉身離開。
小狗：看到身經百戰的戰士能做什麼了嗎？
夏洛特：我真沒想到你有這本事。
卡拉：令人印象深刻的精湛技巧。
小狗：嗯？什麼？
卡拉：啊...沒那麼重要。
+1 魅力點數

passages.name: CH7 - Direct
passages.content:
Head Noble: Why did...? That... That would be a disqualification.

Lady Charlotte... Why did...?
Charlotte: I- I’m so sorry. Pup just... Or Anton is very new to 
all this, I just...
The two trailed off out of my earshot.
Pup: What? It’s a duel. We’re supposed to fight each 
other.
Pup: I didn’t go for a fatal attack!
Kara: Anton... do please let it go.
Reagyn: ...A brute, as expected.
Pup: ...!
Charlotte: This was my fault. I just let my mouth run and the 
Lord got the wrong impression.
Pup: *Sigh*...
+1 Direct Points
passages.content_zh:
貴族首領：為什麼…？那……那將被取消資格。

夏洛特女士……為什麼……？
夏洛特：我——我很抱歉。小狗隻是......或者安東是很新的
這一切，我只是...
兩人的聲音漸漸消失在我的聽不到的地方。
小狗：什麼？這是一場決鬥。我們應該各自戰鬥
其他。
Pup：我沒有發動致命攻擊！
卡拉：安東……請放手吧。
Reagyn：……果然是個野蠻人。
小狗：……！
夏洛特：這是我的錯。我只是讓我的嘴巴流淌，然後
主得到了錯誤的印象。
小狗：*嘆氣*...
+1 直接積分

passages.name: CH7 - FInish map
passages.content:
Head Noble: And with that, we can move onto our main event. 
Please, can everyone move along to the arena 
field?
Pup: *Sigh*... What other runaround have we got to 
deal with?
Charlotte: Well, it should be more straightforward this time, 
at least.
Head Noble: Now! Let us begin... the wargame...!
As we approached our destination, a familiar face 
came into view.
Norde: How did the banquet go?
Pup: Norde, there you are. And here I was hoping we’d 
gotten rid of you.
Norde: I’m inclined to assume it went poorly.
Pup: Hmm... feels like home again already.
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
Pup: I knew you’d be on my side.
Jakson: *Unsure whine*...?
Jakson shifted his head back and forth, like he was 
unsure of what stance to take.
Pup: Ah, you’ll come around.
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
Charlotte: It went better than I imagined, but worse than I’d 
have hoped.
Kara: From my understanding, despite some hiccups, it 
has been a net positive endeavor.

Best to continue that momentum, yes?
Norde: Noted and considered.

The Crows are fully prepared to assist with the next 
stage of this event.
Pup: Well, I wouldn’t get your hopes up that it’ll be 
something fun.
Charlotte: I imagine this part will play more to your liking.

貴族領袖：那麼，我們可以進入我們的主要活動了。
請大家移動到競技場上？
小不點：*嘆氣*... 我們又得應付什麼鬼把戲？
夏洛特：嗯，至少這次應該會比較直接。
貴族領袖：現在！讓我們開始... 戰爭遊戲...！
當我們接近目的地時，一張熟悉的面孔映入眼簾。
諾德：宴會進行得如何？
小不點：諾德，你在這裡啊。我還希望我們已經擺脫你了呢。
諾德：我傾向於認為進行得不太順利。
小不點：嗯... 感覺又像回到家一樣了。
傑克森：*開心的叫聲*！
小不點：我就知道你會站在我這邊。
傑克森：*不確定的嗚咽聲*...？
傑克森左右搖頭，好像不確定該採取什麼立場。
小不點：啊，你會想通的。
傑克森：*開心的叫聲*！
夏洛特：比我想像的要好，但比我希望的要糟。
卡拉：根據我的理解，儘管有些小問題，但總體來說是一個積極的努力。

最好繼續保持這種勢頭，對吧？
諾德：已記錄並考慮。

烏鴉軍團已完全準備好協助進行本次活動的下一階段。

夏洛特：我想這部分會更符合你的喜好。

passages.name: CH7 - Pup → Reagyn
passages.content:
Pup: You know, the Crows are pretty great if you get to 
know them.
Reagyn: A noble’s responsibility is to serve their people.
Reagyn: Yours is to make money.
Pup: I’ve... I could stand to be more involved in those 
meetings.
Pup: It doesn’t mean we all do it out of greed, though.
Reagyn: Yet that conflict of interest remains as the core 
tenet of your approach to life.
Pup: Really, a noble of all people shouldn’t throw stones 
in glass-
Suddenly a burst of applause interrupted my words.
Head Noble: And that is the end! The result... It is a... tie?
As we had talked, I had been able to mirror 
her movements.
Reagyn: Hmph. You could’ve been worse.
She turned away in a bit of a huff.
Pup: See what a battle hardened warrior can do?
Charlotte: Wow, you actually kept up.
Kara: Quite the potential with finesse.
Pup: Hm? With what?
Kara: Ah... It isn’t so important.
+1 Diplomatic Points
passages.content_zh:
Pup: 你知道嗎，如果你真的了解渡鴉幫，他們其實很棒。
Reagyn: 貴族的責任是為人民服務。
Reagyn: 而你的責任是賺錢。
Pup: 我... 我應該更積極地參與那些會議。
Pup: 但這不代表我們都是出於貪婪才這麼做。
Reagyn: 然而，這種利益衝突仍然是你生活方式的核心原則。
Pup: 說真的，貴族更不應該在玻璃屋裡丟石頭——
突然一陣掌聲打斷了我的話。
領頭貴族：結束了！結果是... 是... 平手？
當我們交談時，我一直能夠模仿她的動作。
Reagyn: 哼。你表現得還不算太差。
她有點生氣地轉身離開。
Pup: 看到一個身經百戰的戰士能做什麼了嗎？
Charlotte: 哇，你居然跟上了。
Kara: 很有潛力，而且很精巧。
Pup: 嗯？什麼潛力？
Kara: 啊... 沒那麼重要。
+1 外交點數

passages.name: CH7 - Start
passages.content:
Kara: ...and the crop production was up about 5% this 
year.

The farmers’ delegate surmised it was due to 
weather pattern timing.
Avalina: Excellent. I am pleased to hear such positive results 
from our nation’s hard work.
The rays of light peppered a sea of stars across the 
marbled floors of the palace.

Above that cosmic starscape stood a pair of 
black heels, and further up still a graceful visage 
of a face.
Kara: The delegate did wish to pass along a sentiment.

One of pride for the work the farmers of Cartenan 
had put in this last season.
Avalina: Ah... that is...
Avalina: Hmm...
A finger of consideration went to the chin of 
another figure. This one was raised above the tide 
of light by a throne.
She was cloaked within a flowing, elegant ensemble 
of green and white, with it emblazoned with 
striking accents of gold and royal purple.
She was Avalina. The Queen of Cartenan.
Avalina: If you’ve the chance, do please return my 
agreeability to the sentiment.
Kara: Of course, your majesty.
Kara shuffled through her papers to move onto a 
new topic.
Kara: As for movement of bandit activity, there are some 
developments from our international scouts.

In Rabaneau, the bandits were seen moving toward 
the northern border.

In the Empire, the movement was towards the 
capital.

In New Aureria, they were-
Avalina: Yes, yes. Make a note to increase the scout corp.’s 
bonus fund.

We wouldn’t want them to get too demotivated in 
such boredom filled days.
Kara: Noted.
Kara then straightened out her papers and lowered 
them.

Her gaze shifted so she was addressing the Queen 
directly.
Kara: The trend seen in the reports is of bandits moving 
northward.
Avalina: Indeed? Then that really only points to one place.
Kara: Under conventional wisdom, I would agree.
Avalina: Oh~ I wonder if the Empire is reaching their 
breaking point, then?
Avalina: That tiresome, endless war they have with the 
Republic is becoming too much?

To think they would need to hire reinforcements 
just to secure their homeland.
Kara: Your majesty, I do believe that-
Avalina: You have been such a treat to have, filling in as my 
secretary these last couple months, Miss Lyons.
Avalina: Or should I say “Mrs. DeClares” instead?
Avalina: It will be a shame when we must let you go.
Avalina: Must such a silly thing as marriage stop you from 
serving in the royal court?
Kara: I appreciate the sentiment, your majesty.

But it would be poor optics to have the wife of a 
Covenant Auditor working for any government.
Avalina: Ah... truly the greatest of shames.
The Queen leaned in her seat along with a sigh.
Avalina: Then mayhap regale me with this newest gossip 
that has reached the court.
Kara: I am not sure what you refer to...?
Avalina: The visitors from abroad!
Avalina: A daring escape from an attack on the high seas. A 
princess in the crosshairs of fate.
Avalina: The servants speak of it like a novelette~
Kara: ...
Kara: Yes, Lady Charlotte Stewart of Lockhart has 
recently arrived in the city.

She has an appointment to petition the court in 
the coming week.
Kara: Lockhart’s situation is deteriorating. It might be 
better to have that meeting sooner over
Avalina: Of course not.

All things in their due process. It is what separates 
us from the savages of the Outlands and the like.
Kara: ...
Avalina: I am sure Lady Stewart would agree. She was such 
a pleasant woman when we last met.
Kara: ...
Kara: As you wish, your majesty.
Avalina: Now, do continue this story of heroism and drama.
Avalina: Lady Stewart arrived with her retinue in tow? 
Shimmering in the heat of battle worn days?
Kara: The servants certainly do have a... way with words.
Kara: But yes. She was accompanied by a hired band of 
mercenaries to escort her.

The “Nightless Crows”, as I have been told.
Avalina: Such a daring group they must be.

Such... resilience they have shown! 
I must applaud it.
Kara: Yes, from what I have been told, they are an 
impressive sort.
 
It would be easy to describe them as ones that 
would be difficult to knock down.
Pup: I- I’m getting knocked down!
Pup: W- What... What the fuck?!
Castel: ...
Castel: Ah... well...
Castel: Language, please.
Pup: WHAT. THE. FUCK?!?!
My distress came from the very thing that had 
decimated my balance. The very apparent thing 
now anchoring me to the ground.
The giant pair of breasts that had grown from my 
very own chest.
Pup: These... Why are they so massive?!

They’re bigger than my head!

N- No... they’re...
Pup: They’re bigger than my DOG!
Pup: They’re the size of a damned boulder!
I floundered around some, trying to get up from 
this position like a turtle flipped onto its back.

The professor, who was there to assist me in this 
endeavor of offsetting the curse’s effects, looked 
on with an apathetic scowl.
Castel: *Sigh*...
Pup: Didn’t you say you were going to make them 
smaller?!
Castel: I did. Or it should have.
Castel: Cosmetic magic is a very precise science.

The technique I used is meant to take the fatty 
matter of the breasts and simply... put 
it somewhere else.
Such is the wonders of combining types of magic 
together. Anything is possible.
Pup: ...Really?
I gave the professor a hostile glare, and I motioned 
towards the giant mounds of flesh that stopped me 
from even getting up.
Castel: Hmm... Yes, it did behave differently than the 
norm.
Castel: And I do not know where that extra matter even 
came from...

Was it the “curse” and its impact?

Or is it because I haven’t done this much before?
As the professor’s words started to trail off into 
mumbling, I squinted harder at him.
Pup: What was that last part?
Castel: Nothing of import.

For now, I can attempt to undo what I did before.
Pup: *Glare*...
Castel: Unless you’d prefer to simply stay in this state.
Pup: F- Fine... Please undo the changes to my... my... 
m- my...!
Castel: “Breasts”...
Pup: Y- Yeah... please...
The professor started to get into position and my 
attention returned to the source of the problem.
Pup: These... things...
The more I focused on them, the more I noticed 
the sense of touch I had in them. They were part 
of my body, after all.
After breaking though the buttons of my shirt, 
they were exposed to the air, and...
Pup: ...

I- If... you could hurry.
Castel: Yes, yes.
Pup: *Sigh*... Thank the Goddess that worked.
The lumps on my chests were now normal. Or as 
normal as they could be given the circumstances.
Castel: “After reversal, the patient’s breast size returned to
approximately a smaller B cup size once more.”
Castel read out the note as he wrote it.
Pup: I... No, it’s more like... larger... A... cup.
Castel: “Consider recommendation for therapeutic 
sessions.”
Pup: ...
The professor put away his notes and approached 
me again.
Castel: Now, we’ll need to try another one. You said your 
hair had also changed?
Pup: You want to try again? After all that?
Castel: Yes. It proved reversible, and we’ve only the single 
data point.
Castel: I am also much more experienced with this 
procedure.

I guarantee you this one will work.
Pup: ...
Pup: Uh...

(I... I don’t have better options, do I...?)
Pup: ...
Pup: F- Fine...
Castel: Hmph. No need to be hesitant. You can trust in 
me, Professor Castel Balreig.
Castel: I am a professor of the Royal College. We shall solve 
this puzzle.
Kara: ...
Kara entered the lab and was making her way 
through the lounge and observation room.
Kara: Professor Balreig, are you ready to-
Kara: Hm...?
Kara went to grab the doorknob for the inner lab, 
but something caught her eye.

Something blue. Something light blue.

Almost like overgrown grass, puffs of light blue 
poked through the bottom of the closed door.
Kara: ...
Kara turned her head towards the windows of the 
observation room.

The blinds for it were closed to cut off view, but 
there was something at its edges...

Puffs of light blue.
Kara: Is that...?
Pup: *Muffled yelling*!
Castel: *Muffled yelling*!
Deadened yelling from unclear sources came from 
within the room.
Kara: ...
Kara’s hand hesitated inches away from the 
doorknob.
Kara: Hm...?
But as she hesitated, the sight of the puffs of 
blue retracting caught her attention.

From the corner of her eye, they slipped away 
back into the room like they were never there
in the first place.
Kara: Lovely how things can handle themselves 
sometimes.
She reached for the doorknob.
Pup: *Pant*... *pant*...
Pup: You... almost suffocated me...?!
Castel: Ah... that was...unexpected...
Kara: A good day to you both.
Pup: *Pant*... Kara...?
Castel: Welcome, Miss Lyons.
Kara: Professor Balreig. Mr. Baranov.
Pup: Ah... that feels weird.
Pup: Could you not refer to me like that?
Kara: Miss Baranov, then?
Pup: N- No... I meant not so formally.
Pup: Just “Anton” is fine
Kara: Of course.

Professor Balreig, how are the experiments going?
Castel: We’ve acquired some very useful data today.
Pup: Really? That’s your take away?
Castel: Science can often be a matter of trial and error 
when wading through the unknown.
Kara: Are you done for the day? I am here to retrieve 
Anton, after all.
Castel: Yes, I think that will be fine. There should be 
enough data for me to analyze and come up with 
an action plan.
Pup: Oh, don’t even dare. There’s no way I’m coming 
back after THAT.
Pup: You’d have to be crazy to even consider it.
Kara: Then we will be on our way. See you tomorrow.
Castel: My best wishes. I’ll see you both bright and early.
Pup: ...
Pup: You’re all...

Argh!
I turned on my heels and started to march out of 
the room.
Kara: Have a good evening, professor.
Castel: Mhm.
Having settled into the carriage to head back to 
the hotel, I leaned over to stare at the passing city 
out the window.
Pup: *Indistinct mumbling*...
Kara: ...

Hmm...

Nothing will change unless you make the effort to 
change it.
Pup: Hm? Aren’t you quick to speak up...
Pup: Ah, whatever. What would you know about it in 
the first place?
Kara: I know you’re currently afflicted with the effects of 
an Oathbreaker.

One that rewrites the rules of your being to 
change your very nature.

To have you “consumed by your weakness”, 
whatever that may be seen as within the eyes of 
the beholder.
And in your case, you’ve seen that play out as 
femininity being your “weakness”.

Perhaps you had a father as an outstanding role 
model.

Or lacked a mother to show you how strength can 
come from other avenues.

Am I on the right track?
Pup: Well... There was... Satia and some others, I guess.
Pup: But... they’re not exactly heroes.
Pup: They’re no Thame and Raiga, the hero Elva, or 
even a Kaeden Leopold. 

It’s just... I can’t pretend they can live up to that 
sort of true, world changing strength.
Pup: We have real living and breathing heroes in front of 
us changing the world and...
Pup: I can’t just pretend it isn’t there.
Kara: ...
Kara cleared her throat before continuing.
Kara: Regardless of the specific source, to be impacted so 
means the source is a matter of subconscious.

It means that it draws from an innate part of your 
worldview. A part that cannot be changed as 
is convenient to.
Pup: Like... an ideal?
Kara: Yes. Like an ideal.

The sort one may draw from the mythical heroes 
you described.
Kara: One can understand and even acknowledge the 
fallacy of it, but that does not mean the 
underlying source changes so easily.
Pup: ...Yeah...
Kara: Nothing will change unless you put in the effort to 
change it, though.
Pup: Right... I do know that. I do.
Kara: ...
Kara simply smiled a gentle, caring smile as the 
thoughts jumped through my head.
At least, I properly turned back in from the 
window.
Pup: ...

How... How did you do that? Figure all that out in a 
couple days?
Pup: Argh... Rowan told you about our recent chat, 
didn’t he? I’m gonna maim that guy, I swear...
Kara: Chat...?
Kara: I can assure you, Alexei has not mentioned 
anything of the sort to me.

As for why...
Kara: You are not the first to see the world as such. 
Though...
Kara: I cannot speak to if any had it backfire so 
intrinsically before.
Pup: “Alexei”? That again...
Pup: You know, if you’re just making all that stuff up...

That he’s the prince of the Empire. That you two 
went to school with him.
Pup: If you just want to mess with Charlotte, you can 
tell me.
Pup: She does seem like she’d be fun to tease, with you 
being her friend and all.
Kara: *Giggle*... I can assure you that we’ve yet to 
speak a falsehood.
Kara: Any humor derived from it is from the fact that she 
truly did not notice.
Pup: I... You mean... 

Really?
Kara: Indeed.

...
Kara: And... it can be fun to tease her... at times.
Pup: Hah... I can imagine...
The two of us sat there in a progressively 
uncomfortable silence.

The clicks of the carriage wheel just made a pitter 
patter as they crossed the brick road.

Until... they stopped.
Pup: (We’re here?)
But before my eyes could be pulled to the carriage 
window, a voice interrupted me.
Kara: Anton... I know we have just met, so forgive me 
the discourtesy.
Pup: Oh no... Did I do something?
Kara: My own guiding light is one of potential. The 
potential of humanity itself.
Kara: So it makes me sad to hear that you judge that 
potential as limited.
Pup: Oh... I didn’t... You know I don’t mean it like that, 
right?
Pup: It’s nothing personal. I’m not expecting you or 
anyone else to be a legendary hero.
Kara: I know. Nor do I mean what I said about myself, 
either.
Kara: It’s about you.

I believe you’ve potential beyond your imagination, 
the same as any of our brethren.
Pup: ...
Kara: I would love to see what your potential blooms 
into.
After giving a gentle smile, Kara place her hand on 
mine in a considerate manner.

She stood up from her seat in the carriage and 
started to make her way outside of it.
Pup: ...
Pup: (Potential...)

(I’ve always known I could... That I can... That I 
have to... but...)
Pup: (Nowadays, sometimes I feel like...)
Pup: Haha... potential is just potential after all.

You got to actually make good on it.
Pup: Just look at our “prince” named Rowan.
Rowan: Just look at what “prince”, now?
Pup: Ah...?!
With the sudden intrusion, I quickly found my 
startled face outside of the carriage and in front of 
our hotel.
Rowan: What a statement to hear from my dear friend!
Pup: I- I’m sorry, I...
Pup: Wait, I hated you like half a week ago.

You know what! I stand by it.
Pup: Just look at...
Floundering a bit for the words, I waved my hands 
about the side of his silhouette for emphasis.
Pup: ...look at... all of... that!
Pup: Whatever... the word is for that...?
Charlotte: You mean the ‘homeless bard’ thing he’s got 
going?
Pup: Yes! That! That exactly!
Rowan: To be doubled up on by such dear comrades of 
mine! The thought of it just...
Rowan: Hmm...
Rowan: Actually, this reminds me of a time during one 
weekend where a lovely married couple asked me 
to-
Pup: I’m going to stop you there as I throw up a little.
Charlotte: And do not even dare joke about the idea of that 
being a fetish for you, too, or I swear to 
the Goddess...
Pup: Isn’t your claim that you’re supposed to be a 
prince?
Pup: You cannot tell me this is somehow a move 
towards your potential.
Rowan: Can I not?
Charlotte: No.
Rowan: Ah... well, you assume this is my final form.
Rowan: One day we will all throw aside these garbs and 
shroud ourselves in truly exquisite threads~
Pup: What sort of fever dream is that?
Pup: It sounds like he’s just trying to get us naked.
Rowan: You’ve simply never seen me ‘clean up’, as it were.
Rowan: Oh Kara, my friend, do tell them of my wonder, 
would you?
Kara: Hmm...
Rowan: K- Kara...?
Kara: I will let you get comfortable in the hole you’ve 
dug.
Rowan: Truly, you would abandon me as well?!
Without Kara coming to his defense, Charlotte and 
I found ourselves cornering Rowan with little 
resistance.
Pup: ...!
Charlotte: ...!
Rowan: ...!
Kara: *Giggle*...
Kara watched us three bicker like the school 
children she had once known multiple of us as, 
content to watch it play out.
And so the days passed us by, as we waited for the 
meeting with the Queen.
Kara: And here is the floral district, where...
Pup: There’s another district? How big is this place?
Tatiana: I bet they’re hiding the slums from us...
Tatiana: Hmph, I can just find ‘em myself.
Jakson: *Happy Bark*...!

*Panting out the carriage window*...!
We were brought on more city tours.
Castel: Have you ever heard of the “placebo” effect?
Pup: Uh... no...?
Castel: Ah, then do I have the perfect cure for your 
condition.
I attended more lab sessions to try to counter the 
curse.
Rowan: Now now, dear Pup. You cannot spend all day in 
the changing room~
Pup: Why are you of all people rushing me?
Pup: I was expecting-
Pup: ...!?
Satia: *Sigh*... Of course.
Otis: Argh, Goddess’s damned willy.
Mariel: I- I mean, this is fine, too... I guess...
Charlotte: Hah... I knew he’d not have the balls to do it.
Kara: You assume the thought even occurred to him.
Pup: What are... Why are... Where are you all going?
Rowan: I believe they are disappointed to see you not don 
a “bikini” over a simple thick shirt.
Pup: W- What? But they’re...
Rowan: Women?
Rowan: Do not worry, it is but benign curiosity among 
them.
Rowan: And some non-benign curiosity.

Mayhap more malignant.
Rowan: I’ll let you sort the matters of which is which~
And between these other daily routines, we were 
guided on trips to local tourist locations.
Every hour of every day was met by the exciting 
grandeur of this vast, flourishing city.
Pup: Every single hour...
Pup: Every single day...
Pup: Every single hour...
Pup: Every single day...
Pup: Every single hour...
Pup: Every single day...
Pup: Every single hour...
Pup: Every single day...
Pup: Every
Pup: single
Pup: hour
Pup: Every
Pup: single
Pup: day
Pup: Every
Pup: single
Pup: hour
Pup: Every
Pup: single
Pup: day
Pup: STOP!
..............
Satia: P- Pup...?
Rowan: ...?
Pup: We keep doing this every hour of every day.

We keep having this red carpet rolled out for us 
and we still aren’t getting anywhere!

It’s.... It’s just-...!
..............
The group around me was silent.
Kara: Every hour of every day...?
Kara: You have slept since you’ve arrived, have you not?
Pup: Yes! You know what I...
Pup: *Sigh*...
I took a deep breath, and calmed my rhetoric.
Pup: It’s been the better part of a week.

Why are we still waiting to meet the Queen?
Kara: As Charlotte’s group, the scheduled meeting to 
petition Queen Avalina is...
Kara, with a pocket calendar in hand, showed us 
the exact date.
Kara: The Kingdom of Cartenan takes great pride in their 
customs.

The formality of proper court procedure is among 
those.
Pup: And what, the appointment got delayed?
Norde: No, that date matches the one we were given 
when we arrived.
Pup: How is that...?
Pup: This place has been messing with my head.
Kara: The meeting with the Queen will come in due 
time. Patience is a virtue.
Rowan: Is this not a prime opportunity to relax? I cannot 
imagine such a moment will occur again 
anytime soon.
Kara: A persuasive point, Alexei.

Could this not pose an opportunity that you did not 
anticipate?
Pup: I mean...
Pup: Maybe. I sort of get that.
Pup: But... these are people’s lives that are in the 
balance.

Shouldn’t every day count?
Charlotte: I agree.
Charlotte, who had been strangely quiet until now, 
approached Kara with an determined posture.
Charlotte: I think we’ve been patient and pampered enough 
for one war.

The Kingdom has always been like this, I know. I’ve 
visited before.
Charlotte: But is there really no way to expedite this process? 
At all?
Kara: ...
Kara began to open her mouth like she was about 
to give a prepared answer, but she stopped 
herself.
Kara: I... 

I do not believe the Queen would be receptive to 
it if you pressed the issue.
Charlotte: There has to be something.
Charlotte: How about some social gathering where we could 
“accidentally” bump into her?
Kara: ...
She just shook her head.
Kara: If you push, it will backfire.
And with those words, the group fell into a 
thoughtful silence.
Rowan: Then shall we return on our journey to a midday 
meal?
Pup: I... guess...
Kara: ...

There isn’t...

Hmm...
Kara: Perhaps there is one thing that can be done.
Charlotte: Really?!
Charlotte: If anyone could figure it out...
Kara: I cannot get you an earlier audience.

But you do not have to sit on your hands until that 
day. You can work towards improving your odds at 
a successful petition.
Pup: Heh? What does that even mean?
Norde: You mean to imply that we could make an 
impression beforehand?
Kara: Indeed.

A kingdom places her majesty above all.
Kara: But such a social ladder means the voices in her 
orbit are quite well defined.

Her matter of influence... is predictable.
Charlotte: That could really help.

Leave it to Kara to go all “spymaster” on the 
problem.
Rowan: Ah, that could be fun, indeed. I remember hearing 
about these before.
Pup: Fun? Wait, how does that...?
Pup: I- I feel like I’m missing something.
Kara: It is not so complicated, after all.
Kara turned her head to me with a hint of a 
mischievous smile starting to form on her face.
Kara: One can simply ‘schmooze’ the nobility...
Kara: ...with a game.
Later that afternoon, our group was escorted to a 
facility shortly outside the city limits.

As we approached in a carriage...
Pup: “Sport”... That’s a... word?
Pup: What is a sport? I thought you said we were going 
to use a game to get on the nobles’ good side?
Kara: A sport is a more specific version of a game. It 
refers to one where the activities involve 
physical competition.
Tatiana: Leave it to nobles to make up random words for 
things that already exist.
Norde: What an odd culture.
Pup: Yeah... Just sounds like fighting to me...
Mariel: I remember there being a few clubs for it when I 
was in the Royal College.

Typically you had the people aiming to be knights 
be pretty active in them.
Charlotte: It was pretty popular when we were at the 
academy, right Kara?

All the wannabe knights loved it.
Kara: Indeed. It is a popular activity for knights in the 
kingdom.

The country is quite peaceful, after all, and 
wargames are preferable to war.
Pup: Knights...?
Rowan: Ah, it seems the Pup has taken the bait~
Pup: Hey, I didn’t say anything.
Pup: (Not that it doesn’t sound interesting...)
Pup: Well, we just need to focus, right?
Rowan: Of course, of course.
The carriage stopped at our destination: a fancy 
stone facility out in an open field.

It was quite large, specifically to hold a large field, 
as I was told.

We began to approach the entrance proper.
Security: Welcome. You are Lady Stewart’s appointment?
Charlotte: Lucky boys. You get two "Lady Stewarts" for the 
price of one.
Mariel: We’re glad to make your acquaintance.
Charlotte: ‘Lady Stewart’, right here.
Kara: Yes, this is the group I sent word about. We’ll be 
joining in the festivities for the day.
Security: Very good. Then we’ll just...
The security guard turned his head towards those 
in the back of our group.
Norde: ...
Security: If it would be possible, could your hired hands wait 
at the field for the main event?
Otis: Eh? Been a while since I had the red carpet rolled 
out for me like this.
Pup: Hired... what? Norde and them aren’t...
Charlotte: Really, you don’t get it?
Charlotte leaned in and pulled me aside for a 
second.
Charlotte: They’re not actually asking, by the way.

Just consider it a matter of respect.
Pup: Oh... O- Okay...?
Charlotte stopped whispering to me and turned 
back to Norde and the other non-homlyns in our 
group.
Charlotte: Everyone. If you wouldn’t mind...
Norde: Very well.
Otis: Pfft. Whateva’. I knew this was a comin’.
Tatiana: What, you think I’m gonna steal the silverware?
Jakson: *Confused whine*...?
Satia: Norde, I am really sorry that they’re being like this.
Norde: It’s fine. I do not believe anyone is truly surprised 
by this.

Given the reason for our visit, it wouldn’t be wise 
to test our luck, either.
Charlotte: I appreciate it, everyone.
Pup: No one surprised? I’m just confused.
I said so under my breath.
Pup: (Why would we send away a good chunk of our 
fighting force before we start a wargame “sport” 
thing?)
Norde led a fairly notable part of our regiment, 
Crows and others, towards a different part of the 
facility.
Pup: (Well, whatever. We’ll work it out.)
Host: ...Charlotte Stewart, heiress of the Stewart Works 
conglomerate and future head of the 
Lockhart Council.
Charlotte: ...
From the dark room, Charlotte disappeared into a 
crack of light. One created by a set of heavy 
curtains being opened as she exited.
Pup: (W- Wait...?! What is this? I thought we were 
supposed to do some wargame thing?!)
Rowan: Do not fret. All good festivities must start with a 
banquet.
Rowan: And... You will likely be sat away from the major 
nobility in attendance.

Your faux pas will only be minorly detrimental to our 
effort.
Pup: My... My what?!
Host: And now, of the Volkov Imperial Family...
Rowan: Ah, that would be me up next.
Pup: W- Wait, what words did you just say?! Those can’t 
be real!
Host: In attendance with Lady Stewart... Prince Alexei 
Volkov of the Nolvanus Empire.
Rowan: ...
With a wink and a sly smile, Rowan gracefully 
dipped through the curtains as well.
Pup: But... what is...?
Satia: Do try to just follow my or Lady Kara’s lead.

It may not be obvious, but I had notable training 
on proper manners when I was younger.
Kara: Take a deep breath. There is no need to worry. It 
is just a meal, after all.
Pup: R- Right... Right... Just a meal... Right...
Host: Introducing Lady Kara Lyons of the Kingdom’s Lyons 
lineage.
Kara: ...
Kara gave me a reassuring smile before passing 
through the heavy curtain herself.
Pup: (Just a meal, just a meal, just a meal...)
Host: In attendance with Lady Stewart for today’s 
festivities, we have the Nightless Crows Mercenary 
Company.
Introducing Gentleman Anton Baranov, the leader 
of the group.
Pup: (Just a meal...)
I moved through the curtain.
Pup: ...
Pup: (Just a meal! Just a meal!)
I exited to the dining area and immediately felt the 
gazes of dozens in my direction.
Host: Oh...? Sorry, I mean Lady... Anton Baranov? Is 
that...?
Pup: Gentleman was fine!
I angrily whispered to the nearby host.
Host: Apologies. Gentleman Anton Baranov, introduced.
Pup: *Sigh*...
Turning my eyes back to the dining room, a 
thought occurred.
Pup: (Wait, what do I do now?!)
I saw Charlotte and Rowan at a large, fancy table 
with a number of other also fancy looking nobles.

My eyes scanned the area, until...
Kara: ...
...I saw Kara motioning for me to join her at a 
smaller, less notable table to the side.
Pup: (Thank the Goddess!)
I scurried over, stiff as a board with nervousness, to 
the seat she had motioned me towards.
Pup: Thank you thank you thank you!
As I thanked Kara in hushed whispers, she only 
signaled for me to not get too loud.
Kara: You did well.
The rest of our group’s introductions were finished, 
and a thought occurred to me.
Pup: Hey, Kara... Why aren’t you sitting with Charlotte 
and Rowan?
Kara: My family here in the Kingdom is a minor noble 
lineage.

So, my standing is more in line with honored guests 
such as yourself.
Pup: Huh...
The introductions went on, and it moved on past 
the Crows and back to other invited nobles from 
the kingdom.
Host: Introducing Lord Flynn Coslett. Heir to the Coslett 
lineage.
I saw a young man exit from a different curtain 
than we had exited before.
Flynn: ...
He was wearing what looked like a purple colored 
uniform. It stood out from what other nobles were 
wearing.
Host: And introducing Lady Reagyn Coslett, also of the 
Coslett lineage.
A young woman exited as well.
Reagyn: ...
She was also wearing a similar style of uniform. It 
was as though the two uniforms were meant to 
match.
Satia: ...”Coslett”?
Host: Both Lord and Lady Coslett are graduates of the 
Theodal Royal College as of this week.
With this announcement of a milestone, a light 
applause rose from the nobles in attendance.

Flynn gave a short bow and Reagyn a customary 
curtsey, before they moved from the spotlight they 
were provided.
They moved to their seats... which were...
Flynn: ...
Reagyn: ...
Pup: ...
Pup: H- Hello.
Reagyn: A good day to you.
Flynn: Y- Yeah. A good day to you.
Kara: Congratulations on your graduation.
Satia: To be graduating already. It must feel like time is 
flying by.
Flynn: Maybe a little too quick at times.
Reagyn: Thank you for the sentiment, Lady Kara.
Reagyn: It feels like it has been forever since you visited the 
school.
Kara: I really should try to make more time for that.
Reagyn: Nonsense. You’ve been appointed as an attendant 
to the Queen herself.

Such an honor should be given the utmost effort 
and focus.
Flynn: I recall when I heard about the appointment. 
Everyone at home was very impressed.
Pup: You really know just about everyone, don’t you 
Kara?
Reagyn: “Lady” Kara.
Pup: R- Right... Lady Kara.
Kara: *Giggle*
After some time, we finally did get food, but...
Kara: The other fork.
Pup: Oh, uh... this one?
Kara: Closer, but still another fork.
Pup: But I only have the...
Pup: (Wait, this is a fork?!)
Pup: ...
Pup: (At least I can eat now, I think?)
I plunged my fork into the meat slab in front of me. 
With a swift shift, I was in position to start cutting 
a piece.
Satia: Pup, your grip. You should be doing that 
underhanded.
Kara: Anton. Your grip. You should attempt it with an 
underhand grip.
Pup: Underhand... what? The fork?
Kara: Indeed.
Kara: Or the knife...?
Pup: Well, which is it...?
Kara: It depends on which hand is your dominant hand.
Pup: Huh...?
Pup: (Just... I’ll have to bear with it.)
Flynn: It... uh... It can be... a learning curve.
Reagyn: ...

So this is the force tasked with keeping a princess 
safe?
Pup: ...
Flynn: Sis, that’s...
Kara: Now, Lady Reagyn, is that really appropriate?
Reagyn: I offer it as a sincere criticism.
Pup: ...

Because I didn’t know which fork to use?
Reagyn: Because you neither know nor care why it is 
important.
Pup: ...
Reagyn: ...
Flynn: Today was supposed to be relaxing...
The sound of 'spoon to glassware' interrupted our 
stare-off.
Head Noble: Welcome to all our esteemed guests of the day.

Especially to those that I have not had the pleasure 
of greeting this fine day.
The noble was at the head of the fanciest table, 
with Charlotte and company within sight near him.
Charlotte: ...didn’t mean that...
She was near him... in a clear panic.
Head Noble: Before we give it our all on the field, it is per the 
rules to decide the starting positions via a “Knight’s 
Roundtable”.
And in such fair sporting measures, I would like to 
introduce our volunteer from Lady 
Charlotte’s team...
“Pup Baranov”!
Kara: Oh dear. Did she forget to use your proper name 
when talking to the Lord?
Pup: Volunteer for... what?
Head Noble: And for my team, we shall stay with our choice of 
Lady Reagyn Coslett.

Do us proud, our young compatriot!
Reagyn: ...
I turned my head back to Reagyn.
Pup: So what was I...
passages.content_zh:
卡拉：……今年農作物產量增加了約 5%
年。

農民代表推測這是由於
天氣模式計時。
阿瓦麗娜： 太棒了。我很高興聽到如此積極的結果
來自我們民族的辛勤工作。
光芒灑滿星辰大海
宮殿的大理石地板。

在那片宇宙星空之上矗立著一對
黑色高跟鞋，再往上還是曼妙的容顏
一張臉的。
卡拉：代表確實希望傳達一種觀點。

卡特南農民的工作感到自豪之一
上個賽季投入了這個。
阿瓦莉娜：啊……那個……
阿瓦莉娜：嗯…
一根手指放在下巴上
另一個數字。這個被提出來了
寶座旁的光。
她穿著飄逸、優雅的套裝
綠色和白色的，上面裝飾著
引人注目的金色和皇家紫色。
她就是阿瓦麗娜。卡特南女王。
阿瓦麗娜：如果你有機會，請歸還我的
對情緒的認同。
卡拉：當然，陛下。
卡拉翻閱著她的文件，進入了一個
新話題。
卡拉：至於匪徒活動的動向，有些
我們的國際球探的動態。

在拉巴諾，人們看到土匪向
北部邊境。

在帝國，運動的方向是
資本。

在新奧雷裡亞，他們是—
阿瓦麗娜：是的，是的。記下增加偵察兵團的
獎金基金。

我們不希望他們過於消極
這樣的日子充滿了無聊。
卡拉：注意到了。
卡拉然後整理她的文件並放下
他們。

她的目光一轉，正對著女王說話。 
直接。
卡拉：報告中看到的趨勢是土匪正在移動
向北。
阿瓦麗娜：確實如此？那麼這實際上只指向一個地方。
卡拉：按照傳統觀念，我同意。
阿瓦麗娜：喔~我想知道帝國是否已經達到他們的目標
那麼，突破點呢？
阿瓦麗娜：他們與
共和國變得太多了？

認為他們需要雇用增援

passages.name: CH7 - Story start
passages.content:
Pup: ...just volunteered for?!
The switch from the banquet into a mini-arena was 
fast as servants zoomed about.

Reagyn was standing across from me, seeming to 
be prepared for a fight.
Pup: What is...? Didn’t someone say the word “Knight” 
somewhere?
Pup: Ah! Are we finally going to actually duel?!
Reagyn: I can’t imagine you standing much of a chance.
Pup: Let’s see how much you actually know about 
proper swordplay, then!
Kara: No, Anton. It is a ceremonial fight. It is more akin 
to ‘dance’.
Pup: Huh...?!

The Goddess’s underwear, you’re ruining duels, 
too?!
Reagyn: You should watch your tongue in these esteemed 
halls.
Charlotte: Pup, I’m... Yeah, I didn’t mean for this.

One thing led to the other, and the Lord 
misinterpretted what I was saying.
Kara: Just try to follow the rhythm.

This is a sport unto itself, and you’re aiming to get 
“points”.

We can act as support, but not participate directly.
Pup: Ugh... Fine. I’ll try to figure this out.
passages.content_zh:
Pup: ...就這樣自願參加了？！
僕人們迅速移動，宴會廳瞬間變成了一個小型競技場。

瑞根站在我的對面，看起來已經準備好戰鬥了。
Pup: 這是...？剛剛是不是有人提到「騎士」這個詞？
Pup: 啊！我們終於要來一場真正的決鬥了嗎？！
瑞根: 我實在無法想像你有什麼勝算。
Pup: 那就讓我看看你對真正的劍術了解多少吧！
卡拉: 不，安東。這是一場儀式性的戰鬥。更像是「舞蹈」。
Pup: 蛤...？！

女神的內褲啊，妳們連決鬥都要毀掉嗎？！
瑞根: 在這莊嚴的殿堂裡，你最好注意你的言辭。
夏洛特: Pup，我...唉，我不是這個意思。

事情就這樣一件接著一件發生，領主誤解了我的意思。
卡拉: 試著跟上節奏就好。

這本身就是一項運動，你的目標是獲得「分數」。

我們可以提供支援，但不能直接參與。
Pup: 嗚...好吧。我會試著搞清楚的。

passages.name: CH8 - New Event
passages.content:
Win Condition: Defeat all enemies
Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan, Charlotte, Kara die
passages.content_zh:
勝利條件：擊敗所有敵人
失去狀態：小狗、羅文、夏洛特、卡拉死

passages.name: CH8 - Avalina appears
passages.content:
Queen Avalina and her dispatched knights entered the
village from the mountain trails nearby.
Avalina: Good. Now move the package to-
Avalina: ...?!
She stared down our group with a look of surprise and
anger.
Kara: ...
Avalina: Men, focus on dispatching the Imperial riffraff.
Knight: Yes, your majesty.
Pup: (Hm...? Those guys look different...)
passages.content_zh:
阿瓦琳娜女王和她派遣的騎士進入了
村莊附近的山路。
阿瓦麗娜：好。現在將包移至-
阿瓦莉娜：……？ ！
她一臉驚訝地看著我們這群人
憤怒。
卡拉：…
阿瓦麗娜：各位，集中精力消滅帝國的痞子吧。
騎士：是的，陛下。
Pup：（嗯……？那些傢伙看起來不太一樣……）

passages.name: CH8 - New Event
passages.content:
Bandit: Argh!
The bandit fell to the ground.
Villager: T- Thank you!
She said as she bolted away.
Pup: Well, at least she's safe.
Rowan: This town is one housing a royal vacation home? 
Your queen must enjoy the tranquility.
Kara: ...

It is... a cover.
Pup: Cover for... what?
Kara: It is not my place to say. But if she is here for why I
believe she is... then she will need the assistance.
Charlotte: Hmm... Is that so?
Norde: Then we'll hear it from the horse's mouth, I imagine.
Norde opened his medicine and downed the liquid.
Pup: ...
I felt around in my gear for my own.
Pup: (Not yet... I don't need it. Not yet.)

Let's not waste anymore time!
passages.content_zh:
強盜：啊！
強盜倒在地上。
村民：謝...謝謝你！
她說完就跑走了。
小狗：嗯，至少她安全了。
羅文：這個鎮上有一間皇室度假別墅？
你們的女王一定很喜歡這裡的寧靜。
卡拉：...

那...是個幌子。
小狗：幌子...為了什麼？
卡拉：我不該說。但如果她來這裡的原因跟我
想的一樣...那她會需要協助。
夏洛特：嗯...是這樣嗎？
諾德：那我們我想我們會從當事人那裡聽到真相。
諾德打開他的藥，喝了下去。
小狗：...
我在我的裝備裡摸索著自己的藥。
小狗：（還不用...我還不需要。還不用。）

我們別再浪費時間了！

passages.name: CH8 - Place Event
passages.content:
Fancy Man: Thanks for coming to our rescue!

I recently saw a gryphon knight flying over the 
mountains... didn't look like one of the Queen's 
soldiers... 
She might have something to do with all this... but 
maybe I am just paranoid. 

Again, thanks for saving us.
passages.content_zh:
時髦男子：感謝你們前來救援！

我最近看到一個獅鷲騎士飛越山脈... 看起來不像女王的士兵...
她可能跟這一切有關... 但也許我只是太過疑神疑鬼。

再次感謝你們拯救了我們。

passages.name: CH8 - Kara → Reagyn
passages.content:
Reagyn: ...
Kara: It is your decision to make.
Reagyn: I didn't say anything.
Kara: I asked Charlotte to help because her allies are less
likely to be beholden to those feelings of loyalty.
Kara: But I will not blame you for acting on them.
Reagyn: ...

Acknowledged.
passages.content_zh:
雷金：…
卡拉：這是你的決定。
雷金：我什麼也沒說。
卡拉：我請夏洛特幫忙是因為她的盟友較少
可能會受到這些忠誠感的影響。
卡拉：但我不會怪你對它們採取行動。
雷金：…

已獲承認。

passages.name: CH8 - Flynn → Rowan
passages.content:
Flynn slashed away at a bandit, and they fell down
seemingly dead.
Flynn: *Pant* ... *Pant* ...
Flynn: T- They're... dead...?
Rowan: Do not dwell on it.
Flynn: Oh- ... Prince Alexei, you...?!
Rowan: Do not dwell on it.

Look to the next target. Remember they wish to 
kill you.
Flynn: But...
Rowan: Remember what they wish to do to you, your 
loved ones, and your country.

Do not let yourself get distracted.
Flynn: O- Okay... I'll try.
passages.content_zh:
弗林砍向一個強盜，他們倒下了
看起來已經死了。
弗林：*褲子* ... *褲子* ...
Flynn：他們──他們……死了……？
羅文：別想太多了。
弗林：噢——……阿列克謝王子，你……？ ！
羅文：別想太多了。

展望下一個目標。請記住他們希望
殺了你。
弗林：但是…
羅文：記住他們想對你做什麼，你的
所愛的人和你的國家。

不要讓自己分心。
Flynn：哦-好的...我會嘗試的。

passages.name: CH8 - Mariel → Jakson
passages.content:
Jakson: *Notifying Bark*!
Mariel: I'll be right there!
Mariel jumped towards the direction of the bark and
quickly started her healing magic's process.
Mariel: It'll be okay...
The injured villager there slowly gained their vitality
back.
Jakson: *Vigilant growl*...
Villager: T- Thank you...!
Mariel: Just get to safety.
The villager did as they were told, and headed off.
Mariel: Good job, boy. Let me know if you find any others.
Jakson: *Determined bark*!

passages.name: CH8 - Satia → Otis
passages.content:
Otis: Tsk! These scabs can just die.

What sort o' deplored souls would take on this sort 
o' job?!
Satia: I can't imagine it as that different than you 
sinking ships.
Otis: Heh. I knew what scum I was targettin'. None of 
'em lot didn't deserve their fate.
Satia: I wonder.
Otis: Wonder all you like, momma bird. Will be true til my
timely death.
Satia: No. I more wonder if these bandits have those 
among them that think the same as you.

That they're just attacking people who deserve it.
Otis: Eh. Why'd ya gotta bring that gray area mishmush 
into this?
Satia: Perhaps it's a matter of the mood I'm in.

Not everyone will have sparkling memories of this
country.
Otis: Ya don't say...?
passages.content_zh:
奧提斯：嘖！這些人渣去死一死算了。

到底是什麼樣的可悲靈魂會接這種工作啊？！
莎提亞：我不覺得這跟你擊沉船隻有什麼不同。
奧提斯：哼。我知道我鎖定的是什麼樣的敗類。他們那群人沒有一個不該有那種下場。
莎提亞：我很好奇。
奧提斯：妳想怎麼好奇就怎麼好奇吧，老媽子。這會是真的，直到我壽終正寢。
莎提亞：不。我比較好奇這些強盜裡面，有沒有人跟你想的一樣。

他們也覺得自己只是在攻擊那些罪有應得的人。
奧提斯：欸。妳幹嘛把這種灰色地帶的混亂東西扯進來？
莎提亞：或許這只是我現在的心情使然。

不是每個人都會對這個國家有美好的回憶。
奧提斯：妳說什麼...？

Norde: Then you are also compelled to silence.
Charlotte: I'm not about to spill a potential state secret if it
isn't relevant. Even if it isn't my own.
Norde: ...

Understood.

明白了。

passages.name: CH8 - Story
passages.content:
Pup: ...
I stared at the sight of soldiers mobilizing.
Regiments were forming their units, and orders 
were barked all about.
But...
It was silent.
The clamor of the hustling scene was overwhelmed 
by the indomitable silence of my own thoughts.
Pup: ...
Pup: *Exhales*...
I felt the pressure flow away as I breathed out.
And I hesitated, if just for a second, to breathe
again.
Pup: (We can do this.)
Some time before...
Avalina: ...You DARE set foot here as such?!
Kara: Your majesty...
Avalina: This is a sacred place of authority and history.

It is not to be disrespected without expectation of
capital repercussions.
Kara: I do hope you understand that I wouldn't have 
done it if the security of the Kingdom didn't 
depend on it.
Avalina: ...!

You make such a claim... over bandits...?!
Rowan: Sigh

... As said, it is but a ploy.
Rowan: You do not know the minds of those whom wish 
your reign disturbed.
Avalina: And when does the plea of a con artist ever not 
appeal to the ignorance of a target?

You act as though you have no motivation to drag 
my peace into the frenzy of war.
Charlotte: We want to help you save your kingdom. Then 
we can figure out if you'll help Lockhart.
Mariel: We've already seen enough death... We wouldn't 
want more.
Avalina: ...
The Queen stood in perfect composure as her 
silence betrayed her antagonism.
Avalina: Then make your case.

But to waste the court's time will be considered 
the crime it is.

Do remember that.
Kara: Of course, your majesty. 

I wouldn't have brought them here if such an 
end result was in the cards.
Charlotte: Well, we're happy to have your cooperation for the 
time being, then.
Kara: As noted, the belief is that the Empire is 
attempting a similar gambit as they did with 
Lockhart.
Under the guise of bandit raids, they transition the
drama of the endeavor into a proper military attack.

It allows them to dictate the strategy of the early
moments of conflict and place the target on their
heels.
Charlotte: It happened to my home. I know too well how 
much damage those moments of uncertainty can 
do.
Avalina: Why would they be foolish enough to conduct 
such a shaky strategy twice?
Charlotte: Because that's what everyone said about the idea 
in Lockhart.

As it was happening.
Avalina: ...
Charlotte: The good news is that the Nightless Crows just 
happened to have been witness to both this and 
that occasion.
Anton, if you could approach?
Pup: (Just a little longer...)
I was positioned in the back, away from the actual
discussion.
Unlike Charlotte and the other nobles, I stayed with
the rest of the Crows external to the session of 
royal court.
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte: Anton, we need you to join us and come over 
here.

...
Charlotte: PUP...!
Pup: ...!?
Charlotte: Pup, please come tell the Queen about it.
Pup: R- Right... Yeah...
I approached and stood at a stark attention as I 
began to talk.
Kara: Thank you very much for your assistance with this.
Charlotte: Anton here was there when it happened.
Avalina: Then, Anton Baranov of the Nightless Crows... Tell 
me of this ordeal.
Pup: I am... Anton Baranov. I currently act as...
I began to recount the story, but...
Pup: And the telegram lines. They were.. And then... 
then...
Mariel: P- Pup...!?
Rowan: M-...! A- Anton!
Mariel, Rowan, and a number of medical 
professionals jumped to assist my unconscious self.
Rowan: Mi-...! A- Anton!
Rowan and a number of medical professionals jumped to
assist my unconscious self.
Kara: Had it gotten that bad?
Avalina: Wh- What is this?!
Charlotte: An aftereffect of the scars left from Lockhart.
Kara: It seems the commander of the Imperial forces 
wields an Oathbreaker as a weapon.
Avalina: ...?!
Kara: Mr. Norde. It seems we have no better option.
Norde: ...
Norde turned his head towards the queen.
Avalina: ...

Very well. It may approach.

And... speak, if it must.
Norde approached the group as I had.
And he faced the queen with eyes unflinching.
Norde: ...
Back in present time.
Pup: ...
With a delicate touch, my fingers fidgeted with a 
small glass bottle in my fingers.
In it existed a liquid with a slight glow to it.
Pup: (Thank you, Kara. I don't know how you did it, 
but...)

(With this I can fight.)
Kara: This will not cure you. This will not ease your
symptoms.

It will, however, stop them from getting worse for 
a time.

And that is all it will be. Time. Time that you must
make the most of.
Pup: How did you...?
Kara: Promise everyone you will not allow yourself to die.

Promise.
Pup: ...
Pup: Okay. I promise.
Kara: Good.
A glint of light from the rising sun flickered on the
curves of the glass bottle.
Pup: (With this...)
Pup: (With this I have time to fight. To help.)
I drew it close as I felt a sincere elevating 
hope around me.
Pup: (But not yet. I can still wait.)

(I need to make the most of the time I have. 
Before this curse takes me out of the battle.)
The vial would only give me time. I decided that it
would be best used at strategic moments to stop 
the worst case scenarios.
So I stuffed it into a secure pouch on my gearset.
And with that, my eyes traveled towards the
preparations of the various military and mercenary
companies here.
Norde: ...
Satia: ...
Charlotte: ...?
Otis: ...!
Pup: (The rest of the Crows are making their final
preparations to move out.)

(If I remember correctly... Kara also gave Otis and
Norde some medicine for the weakness symptoms.)
Pup: (The rest of the Crows are making their final
preparations to move out.)

(If I remember correctly... Kara also gave Norde some
medicine for the weakness symptoms.)
My eyes wandered further.
Reagyn: ...!
Flynn: ...?
Reagyn: ...!
Flynn: ...?
Pup: (The Kingdom's nobility is being mobilized as well.)
Pup: (Though I think those two were assigned to 
accompany us after they fought with us before?)

(They'll probably join with the Crows soon
enough.)
Pup: (Hopefully the Goddess watches over them.)
My eyes continued to pan over the scene.
It was all a similar view, until...
Avalina: ...
Pup: (The Queen? She's mobilizing, too?)
Pup: ...
The queen had mounted a horse while 
I had the thought pass through my mind.
Pup: Maybe she really believes in the threat now?
Kara: I believe she does.
Pup: ...?!
Kara had appeared at my side.
Kara: Apologies for the surprise.

And thank you again for your assistance to the 
Kingdom.
Pup: Of course... And thanks for the medicine as well.
Pup: You'll have to teach me how to make it when this 
is done.
Kara: Haha... Some family secrets are not mine to divulge.
Pup: Speaking of family... Will you be joining yours? It
looks like the nobility is being mobilized.
Pup: Or are you here to go join the Queen in her 
efforts?
Kara: I have been assigned to be an escort to Charlotte 
and her company. So we shall remain allies on the 
field for a time.
Pup: Good to have your reliable self along for the ride,
then.
Pup: Hmm...
As I said as much, I saw several knights also 
preparing their horses for travel.
Pup: (If she's headed off for the front lines, you'd think
she'd want her trusted advisors with her, though.)
Kara: It is odd.
Pup: S- Sorry?
Kara: Queen Avalina does appear to believe the threat is
real.

Tell me. What would you do if your home was 
threatened like Lockhart was?
Pup: Uh... That's quite a question. I don't know. I'd do
everything I can to protect it. I'd probably...

(Huh... Wait...)

I'd... protect my home. The city itself.
Kara: Indeed. So why is our head of state riding off into 
the distance if she truly believes the threat true?
Pup: That's... probably beyond my paygrade.
Kara: ...
Kara stood there staring out at Queen Avalina's
regiment as they began to move from the 
mobilizing area.
Kara: Anton Baranov. You said before you acted as
representative of the Nightless Crows, did you not?
Pup: Well, sort of. We haven't actually talked about it.
Pup: We're just waiting until... until my father catches 
up to the group again.

(It would be pointless to discuss it... It would.)
Kara: Then, as acting representative of your fellows...
Kara had broken her eyeline from the queen and 
turned to me.
Kara: I have a request of you Nightless Crows.
Norde: "Follow the Queen"...
Kara: Yes. She will need help.
Our group had headed off, but were riding to 
where Kara believed the Queen had set off to 
instead.
Charlotte: And because we are allies outside of the nobility 
here, we can help without feeling like we're 
betraying any loyalty.
Pup: This far out, though... This seems really out of the
way and it isn't like it'd be a frontline for an
invasion.
Flynn: To even leave the capital and palace without her
leadership...
Reagyn: Is she abandoning it?
Pup: She wouldn't flee? She doesn't seem the sort.
Kara: I do not believe she is doing that.
Kara: I hesitate to speak on it without being sure, but...
Rowan: Hmm...
Charlotte: I'm sure she has good reason to be here.
The horizon gave way to the sight of our 
destination, and our ride didn't last much longer.
And what stood before us was a sleepy village at 
the base of a mountain.
Charlotte: Not to be rude, but... here?
Kara: This is Karotown. It is a small rustic town.

I also believe the Queen is rumored to have a 
vacation home situated here.
Rowan: Does she? What an interesting coincidence.
Villager: Ahhh!!!
Bandit: ...!
Norde: Bandit raids.
Pup: No time to waste!
passages.content_zh:
小狗：...
我凝視著士兵動員的景象。
部隊正在組成單位，命令聲四處叫喊。
但是...
一片寂靜。
喧囂的場景被我內心那不可動搖的寂靜所淹沒。
小狗：...
小狗：*呼氣*...
我呼氣時，感到壓力消散。
我猶豫了一下，哪怕只是一秒，才再次呼吸。
小狗：（我們可以的。）
在不久之前...
艾瓦莉娜：...妳竟敢以這種姿態踏足此地？！
卡拉：陛下...
艾瓦莉娜：這裡是神聖的權威與歷史之地。

若不尊重，必將面臨死刑的後果。
卡拉：我希望您能明白，如果不是為了王國的安危，
我不會這麼做的。
艾瓦莉娜：...！

妳竟為了區區盜匪...提出這種說法...？！
羅文：唉

... 如我所說，這只是一個計謀。
羅文：妳不了解那些希望擾亂妳統治的人的想法。
艾瓦莉娜：何時騙子的懇求，不曾訴諸目標的無知？

妳們的行為，彷彿沒有任何動機，要將我的和平拖入戰爭的瘋狂之中。
夏洛特：我們想幫助妳拯救妳的王國。然後
我們可以弄清楚妳是否會幫助洛克哈特。
瑪莉耶：我們已經見過夠多的死亡了... 我們不
希望再有更多。
艾瓦莉娜：...
女王保持著完美的鎮定，她的
沉默暴露了她的敵意。
艾瓦莉娜：那就提出妳們的理由。

但浪費法庭的時間，將被視為
應有的罪行。

請記住這一點。
卡拉：當然，陛下。

如果會導致這種結果，我不會帶他們來這裡。
夏洛特：那麼，我們很高興能暫時得到妳的合作。
卡拉：如前所述，我們認為帝國
正試圖採取與對付
洛克哈特類似的策略。
他們以盜匪襲擊為幌子，將
事件的戲劇性轉變為真正的軍事攻擊。

這讓他們能夠主導早期
衝突的戰略，並讓目標措手不及。
夏洛特：的確發生了。

passages.name: CH8 - Closing Story
passages.content:
Avalina: Burn to ash.
Bandit: Rraghh!!!
Avalina: Good riddance.
Knight: Your majesty, I believe that was the last of them.
Avalina: Thank you. Prepare the container for transport to 
the capital.
Knight: Yes, ma'am.
Several knights joined the queen by her side. One 
of them was holding a heavy metal case.
Pup: *Pant* ... I can... I'm okay.
Pup: Hm...?

(That case? Is that what they're here for?)
Avalina: Move with me.
Queen Avalina started on her way out of 
the village as though we weren't there.
Kara: Your majesty.
Avalina: ...
She stopped.
Avalina: How dare you?
Kara: Y- Your majesty, I only-
Avalina: I can be lenient... if the punishment leads to the
proper reform.

Will it?
Kara: I am... 

I only wished to support you...
Avalina: Then we will speak again later. Return your forces 
to their assignments.
The Queen began forward again.
Kara: ...
Kara: Then I will stop pretending.

Did you secure "it"?
Avalina: ...?!
Her forward march had come to an abrupt stop.
Avalina: What?

What did you just say?
Kara: Is "it" inside that case? Was it secured before it was
too late?
Avalina: My dear Kara... You are a wonderfully bright young
woman.

But to try and manipulate your regent into 
providing you information you have no right to 
know...
Queen Avalina raised her hand as though she was 
about to have the knights attack.
Pup: W- What the...?! What's happening?!
Rowan: Ah, so she was pulling on that string.
Rowan: *Sigh*... What a sour note to come from that 
pluck.
Pup: String?
Kara: The fan.
Avalina: ...!?
Avalina: How do you...?!
Kara: I can assure you. I only wish for the best for the
Kingdom and the world.

Hiding it in the capital is a risk too great for your
plan. The empire could already have infiltrators 
ready to destroy it.
They know you'd want to bring it there.
Avalina: ...

Men. At arms.
Knight: Ma'am!
Pup: W- What?! Why are you...!?
The Queen and Kara stared at each other, as 
though an execution was prepared to go off on a 
hair trigger.
Kara: ...
Avalina: ...
......
Charlotte: Pft. How stupid.
Avalina: ...?!
The queen's eyes shot daggers at Charlotte.
Charlotte: What? You think she's a traitor?
Charlotte: We've only met the handful of times before, but 
even through that I know you're better than this, 
Avalina.
Avalina: You dare...
Charlotte: You've surrounded yourself with too many yes-men 
if you think Kara figuring it out is some devious act.
Charlotte: I bet you have merchants that could work it out in 
the kingdom.
Pup: Work out... what's in the case?
Rowan: Indeed. After all, it's an open secret among
the noble circles of most countries.

Rumors are inevitable.
Rowan: What little faith one has in their attendants to think
they could not put two and two together?
Pup: Meaning what's in the case is...
Charlotte: An Oathbreaker.
A murmur began within the knights accompanying 
the queen.
Knight: A... we're transporting... what?
Avalina: ...
Kara: ...
Pup: What...?!

That's... blasphemous... and...

Would the Covenant stand for that?
Rowan: Openly.
Rowan: The Oathbreakers pre-date the Covenant. 

Naturally, powerful entitles like kings and emperors 
would hoard them.

And of the most powerful ones? Ones strong 
enough to say... win a war?
Rowan: Why would they ever hand those over to the 
Covenant? Unholy as they be.

So stands the deterrents of the land. A dirty 
secret that keeps the peace.
Pup: Then...
The equation solved in my mind. I knew what two 
plus two equaled.
Pup: The kingdom is... "the uninvadable country"... 
because of...
Rowan: An Oathbreaker, yes.
Charlotte: A shame Lockhart is too modern to carry that sort 
of history.
Pup: So that means the empire has one too? 
Is it... that key of yours?
Rowan: Hah! No, that is truly the loot of a bygone night of
festivity.
Pup: Then... that sword. The Steel Wolf's sword?
Rowan: ...

No. That one is new.
Rowan: I do not know where it came from.
Kara: Your majesty. I only wish to help.

The capital is too dangerous of a place to transfer it
to.
Avalina: ...
The queen took a step back, but her raised hand 
from before did not waver.
The hair trigger was still ready to be pulled.
Pup: (Are you crazy...?)
My own hand went to my sword hilt.
Avalina: ...
Kara: ...
Knight: ...
Pup: ...
Pup: ...?!
The ground quaked beneath our feet.
With my head on a swivel, it didn't take long to see
what the disturbance was.
Tatiana: The fuckin' mountain's fuming?!
Norde: That is smoke rising from it's peak?
Satia: It's... like it's on fire?!
Charlotte: Is it on fire?!
Kara: The volcano is erupting.
Pup: "Volcano"? Is that another made up noble word?!
Rowan: It is... new to me as well.
Kara: A volcano is a mountain that does... that.
She said, motioning to the rising smoke from it's 
top.
Kara spun back to the Queen.
Avalina: No... No no no. This is too soon.
Kara: Queen Avalina. Your mountain is exploding.
Avalina: ...
Knight: Y- Your majesty. What do we do?!
Avalina: ...

Create a defensive formation. Do not let the 
traitors near.

Prepare to open the case. I must act fast.
Kara: ...
A curtain of steel blanketed the view between 
Kara's glare and the Queen herself.
Avalina: Be careful with it.

We need to be deliberate... and...

...then we need... to...
Nora: Rrraghhhh!!!
Avalina: Ah...!
Knight: Your majesty!
Atop a gryphon, a figure had swooped in with 
eyes trained on the queen.
Knight: *Pant*... Thank the Goddess I was in time.
Avalina: I- I... I...!
Nora: ...
Nora's strike had clashed with the defensive 
maneuver of the knight by the queen's side.
Charlotte: Isn't that...?!
Pup: That mercenary from Lockhart! The one hired by 
the empire!
Nora: ...
Nora: Hmph.
Nora: NOW!!!
Pup: (Arrows?)
Norde: Move!
I jumped to the side as an arrow narrowly missed 
my face.
My jumbled vision managed to catch the sight of 
most of my allies doing the same.
Knight: Your majesty!
Avalina: ...!?
Knight: Agk!
The knight crumped to the floor as an arrow 
pierced cleanly through his neck.
And the queen stumbled to the ground, otherwise
unharmed due to the heroics.
But as the chaos of the scene played out...
Pup: The case...?!
The case came tumbling with the rest, and 
something fell out as it fully opened.
An ornate looking fan landed into the dirt and mud.
Pup: (Is that it?)

(The Oathbreaker that "could win a war"?!)
Nora: Fall into formation!
Nora and her gryphon were blocked from grabbing 
it, so she ordered a basic retreat to regroup.
Her move came with another rumble of the ground.
Pup: (And there's that.)

What else do you want to throw at us this-
Pup: This... time...
Pup: (If that mercenary from Lockhart's invasion 
is here...)

(Then... couldn't that...)

(Couldn't... that... mean...)
Pup: ...
My head turned slowly.
Inch by inch, it swiveled towards the village 
entrance.
I didn't want to look.
Pup: ...
But then I caught sight of something.
There. At the very edge of my perception.

士兵們。拿起武器。
Knight: 陛下！
Pup: 怎- 怎麼了?! 你們為什麼...!?
女王和卡拉互相凝視著，彷彿一場處決即將一觸即發。
Kara: ...
Avalina
