passages.name: CH9 - Map 1
passages.content:
Kara: It is truly a pleasure to see you all still safe.
Satia: Especially you, my little Pup! I was so worried!
Satia had burst forward and grabbed me 
from behind.
Pup: Argh!
Up on my feet a bit too quickly, a slight dizziness
threw off my balance.
Pup: Y- Yes. All fit as a fiddle.
Pup: Now...
I slipped out of her grip.
Pup: We need to keep moving.
I looked down ever so slightly and saw the main 
source of my balance problems.
Satia: Aw...
Pup: We shouldn't stand around for too long.
Rowan: Do we have a plan of where to go?
Rowan: Shoot me for being the voice of reason, but 
perhaps it'd be best to stop to catch our breath?
Rowan: Between planning and... members of our group 
likely needing a slight adaptation period...
Pup: You, too?
Pup: It's fine. I won't let it be a distraction.

There are more important things to worry
about over something too far in to stop.
Rowan: That's not quite what I meant.
Rowan: A long trek through mountains with two newly 
endowed allies with you...
Rowan: I imagine one of our more well equipped ladies can
speak to the nature of such a journey, even for 
those well adjusted to it.
Kara: ...
Charlotte: ...
Rowan: Alas, am I wrong? Shoot me for being the voice of
reason, not for being the messenger of it.
Otis: Aye. There's likely gonna be trouble it brings at
first.
Pup: I already figured out some ways to support them 
from when I was trying to hide it before.
Norde: Hmm...
Pup: Unless, Rowan, you were hoping they'd be jiggling 
out of my shirt.
Rowan: ...
Rowan: ...
Pup: You know what, if it gets us out of here quicker, 
feel free to stare all you want.
Pup: I'm personally more concerned about the scattering 
of bandits and soldiers in the area.
Kara: True... Though, they do not look to be pursuing 
us, at least.
Pup: It'll probably be difficult to get all of us through
here without engaging them, though.
Norde: Yes, let's move with the intent to clear the way as 
the front line. Then the rest of our forces can 
follow.
Pup: Let's do that then.
Norde: ...
Norde and myself started directing people into
positions.
Rowan: ...

That... offer...

Does it expire...?
Rowan: Ah, wait, where did everyone go?! Wait for me!
Win Condition: Defeat all enemies.
Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan, Charlotte or Kara die.
passages.content_zh:
卡拉：很高興看到你們都還安全。
薩蒂亞：尤其是你，我的小小狗！我很擔心！
薩蒂亞衝上前抓住了我
從後面。
小狗：啊啊！
站起來有點太快，有點頭暈
讓我失去了平衡。
小狗：是——是的。一切都像小提琴一樣適合。
小狗：現在…
我掙脫了她的掌控。
小狗：我們需要繼續前進。
我稍微低頭一看，看到了主要的
我的平衡問題的根源。
薩蒂亞：噢…
小狗：我們不應該站太久。
羅文：我們有去哪裡的計畫嗎？
羅文：因為我是理性的聲音而開槍打死我，但是
也許我們最好停下來喘口氣？
羅文：在規劃和...我們小組的成員之間
可能需要一段短暫的適應期...
小狗：你也是嗎？
小狗：沒關係。我不會讓它成為一種幹擾。

還有更重要的事情要擔心
關於某件事太遠而無法停下來。
羅文：我的意思不完全是這個意思。
羅文：和兩個新來的人一起長途跋涉穿越山脈
賦予你盟友...
羅文：我想我們的一位裝備更精良的女士可以
談論這樣的旅程的本質，即使是為了
那些適應它的人。
卡拉：…
夏洛特：…
羅文：唉，我錯了嗎？開槍打死我，因為我是
原因，而不是作為它的使者。
奧蒂斯：是的。可能會帶來麻煩
首先。
Pup：我已經想出了一些方法來支持他們
從我之前試圖隱藏它的時候開始。
諾德：嗯…
小狗：除非，羅文，你希望它們會搖晃
從我的襯衫裡出來。
羅文：…
羅文：…
Pup：你知道嗎，如果它能讓我們更快離開這裡，
隨意凝視你想要的一切。
Pup：我個人比較關心散射
該地區的土匪和士兵。
卡拉：確實……不過，他們看起來並不在追求
至少我們。
Pup：讓我們所有人都度過難關
不過，這裡沒有與他們接觸。
Norde：是的，讓我們帶著掃清道路的意圖前進吧
前線。然後我們剩下的部隊就可以
跟隨。
小狗：我們來做吧

passages.name: CH9 - Map 1 to 2
passages.content:
Pup: There we go.
Tatiana: Eh, now what? Just walk through the mountains?
Charlotte: Where does that leave us for next steps? Just keep
walking?
Kara: There is a village at the true border to the empire.

As predictable as it may be... so long as we stay
moving then we can take advantage of it for a 
short resupply.
Norde: Then we-
Pup: We can do that then. No time to waste.
Norde: ...
We moved across the foot of each mountain 
as we found our way to a nearby village.
On the outskirts of the village...
Reagyn: Finally, someplace with walls.
Reagyn: This snow and cold is... so very inefficient...
Charlotte: A village with walls... and warmth? Thank the 
Goddess.
Kara: We should move quickly to resupply and get going.
Norde: What are the chances they are lacking in supplies 
for us to purchase?
Kara: Too many unknowns to say for sure.
Mariel: H- Hopefully they have some underlayers we can stock up
on for warmth...
Kara: Though if the cold is getting to those of us less used
to the climate, they may have options.
Pup: (Well, she's not wrong...)
After a slight chill ran through me, I looked around
and saw some of the people that had joined us.

A few were clearly not handling it well.
Those from Cartenan or the south seemed 
particularly flustered.
Kara: Anton, do you also wish to partake?
Pup: Me...?
Pup: I... No, this coat is plenty.
Rowan: It would give you the opportunity to revitalize your
wardrobe.
Charlotte: Yeah, that thing hasn't fit well since Lockhart. And
now...
Pup: I...
Pup: No, that's unnecessary.
Charlotte: As a girl myself, all I can say is that thing looks
especially uncomfortable to move around in.
Pup: W- We're talking about warmth for a trek through 
the mountains.
Pup: We don't have time to be worrying about irrelevant
things now.
Norde: ...
Pup: In fact, let's just keep moving. I can check the
southern buildings and-
Norde: No, I imagine horseback would be quicker.
Pup: Well, it'd be quickest to just start-
Kara: Wait.
Kara: The village is in danger.
Satia: Crows... Move! There isn't time to waste!
Charlotte: We need to save them!
Win Condition: Defeat all enemies
Lose Condition: any villager die, Pup, Rowan, 
Charlotte, Kara die.
Warning: do not save over your save, use a 
different slot.
passages.content_zh:
Pup: 好了。
Tatiana: 呃，現在呢？就這樣穿過山脈？
Charlotte: 接下來我們該怎麼辦？就一直走下去？
Kara: 在帝國真正的邊界有一個村莊。

雖然可能很可預測... 只要我們保持
移動，我們就可以利用它來進行短暫的
補給。
Norde: 那我們-
Pup: 那我們就這麼做吧。沒有時間可以浪費了。
Norde: ...
我們沿著每座山的山腳移動
，找到了通往附近村莊的路。
在村莊的郊外...
Reagyn: 終於，有個有牆的地方了。
Reagyn: 這雪和寒冷... 真是非常沒有效率...
Charlotte: 一個有牆... 又溫暖的村莊？感謝
女神。
Kara: 我們應該趕快補給然後離開。
Norde: 他們缺乏我們可以購買的
物資的可能性有多大？
Kara: 有太多未知數無法確定。
Mariel: 希- 希望他們有一些我們可以儲備的保暖
內層...
Kara: 雖然如果寒冷正在影響我們這些不太適應
這種氣候的人，他們可能會有其他選擇。
Pup: (嗯，她說的沒錯...)
一陣寒意掠過我，我環顧四周
，看到了加入我們的一些人。

有些人顯然不太能適應。
那些來自卡特南或南方的人似乎
特別慌張。
Kara: Anton，你也想參與嗎？
Pup: 我...？
Pup: 我... 不，這件外套很夠了。
Rowan: 這會給你一個機會來重振你的
衣櫥。
Charlotte: 是啊，自從洛克哈特之後，那東西就穿不太合身了。而且
現在...
Pup: 我...
Pup: 不，那沒必要。
Charlotte: 作為一個女孩，我只能說那東西看起來
特別不舒服，難以移動。
Pup: 我- 我們在談論穿越
山脈的保暖問題。
Pup: 我們現在沒時間擔心無關緊要的
事情。
Norde: ...
Pup: 事實上，我們繼續前進吧。我可以檢查
南邊的建築物，然後-
Norde: 不，我想騎馬會更快。
Pup: 嗯，最快的方法就是直接開始-
Kara: 等等。
Kara: 這個村莊很危險

passages.name: CH9 - Map 2 to 3
passages.content:
Pup: *Pant*... There we go.
The last of the beasts went down and the villagers 
were safe.
Villager: T- Thank you! You've helped avert a tragic end for 
our friends and family.

Is there anything we can do to express 
our gratitude?
Pup: Y- Yeah. You're welcome.
Norde: We were actually looking for a chance to resupply.
Pup: R- Right. Could you possibly help with that?
Kara: Most importantly, we were looking to acquire 
thermal layering that our group could use.
Villager: Aye, we do have our share of that. Follow me.
The mayor introduced us to a local shop that 
stocked what we needed, and we gladly paid full 
price for the supplies we wanted.
Pup: Thank you.
Pup: We can't spend too long here, so we'll be off 
sooner over later.
Villager: You'd be welcome back here at any time!
And with that, we continued on into the mountains.
We moved deliberately through the mountains.
Kara: Taking less traveled paths will make it more difficult
to follow us.
Or so had been said prior.
Pup: (It does mean that the path is not as well 
maintained, though...)
Pup: (Which... can make it more difficult to traverse...)
My own idle mind looked down to my body's recent
changes.
Pup: (Needing time to adapt, they said...?)
I looked back towards the others and the rest of 
the Nightless Crows with us.
Pup: (I really can't afford to let it distract me.)
We were slowly exiting a mountain pass into a 
valley, and there were more than a few that were 
handling it differently.
Turning to some of the others worn out 
by the hike...
Pup: Hey, can you switch places with...
Pup: ...Yeah, I think it'll help pace out the...
I started to direct the Crows in a way I thought 
could mitigate their fatigue.
Rowan: Hmm...?
Rowan: Oh, Pup, what initiative you take.
Pup: Huh? What does that mean?
Rowan: I mean it as a sincere compliment.
Kara: It is true you have been much more proactive than 
I had seen previously.
Charlotte: This isn't some side effect of the curse, is it?
Pup: I... I mean...
Pup: ...

I'm just trying to play my part.
Charlotte: Hmm... It feels like more than that.
Satia: Because of...?
Pup: It's not really complicated.
Pup: Someone needs to step up because of... recent events.
Pup: I might as well.
Kara: It is important to remember that-
Rowan: Ah... what was what?!
Kara: Avalanche?
Kara: Quickly! Move!
The valley opening was blanketed by a cascade of 
the winter's wrath.
We had noticed quickly enough to get people 
moving out of its pathway, but...
Norde: Is everyone alright?
Crow: M- Maybe?! We need to take a count.
It would take some time to know for sure.
Pup: Shit, this isn't good.

(Clearing this to get everyone through the path 
would be a big delay for us, even if everyone was 
safe.)
Kara: Take your count and start digging out the snow 
just in case anyone is stuck beneath.

Once we're confident everyone is safe, we can 
carve out a path through.

And after that-
Norde: I think some of those steps will have to wait.
Castel: It appears the local wildlife was drawn to the noise...
Rowan: More beasts? They must have noticed the noise.
Pup: If they're hungry, we're gonna have to hold out for a
bit.
Norde: Crows, a group of us needs to form a defensive 
line.

The rest of you focus on saving those caught in 
the snow.
Win Condition: Survive for 8 turns
Lose Condition: Pup, Charlotte, Rowan, Kara die
Warning: do not save over your save, use a 
different slot.
passages.content_zh:
小狗: *喘氣*...呼...好了。
最後一隻野獸倒下了，村民們
安全了。
村民: 謝...謝謝你們！你們幫助我們避免了
親朋好友們的悲劇。

我們能做些什麼來表達
我們的感激之情嗎？
小狗: 沒...沒事。不用客氣。
諾德: 我們其實正想找個機會補給。
小狗: 對...對了。你們能幫忙嗎？
卡拉: 最重要的是，我們想獲得一些
我們團隊可以使用的保暖衣物。
村民: 哎呀，我們這裡確實有一些。跟我來。
村長把我們介紹到一家當地的商店，
裡面有我們需要的東西，我們也很樂意支付全額
購買我們想要的補給品。
小狗: 謝謝。
小狗: 我們不能在這裡待太久，所以我們會
盡快離開。
村民: 隨時歡迎你們回來！
就這樣，我們繼續進入山區。
我們謹慎地在山中移動。
卡拉: 走人跡罕至的路會更難
被追蹤。
之前是這麼說的。
小狗: (但這也意味著路況不太好...)
小狗: (這...可能會讓行走更加困難...)
我漫不經心的思緒轉向了我身體最近的
變化。
小狗: (他們說...需要時間適應...？)
我回頭看了看其他人和與我們同行的
不眠之鴉的其他成員。
小狗: (我真的不能讓它分散我的注意力。)
我們正慢慢地從一個山口進入一個
山谷，有些人對此的反應
不太一樣。
轉向一些因徒步而疲憊不堪的
其他人...
小狗: 嘿，你們可以和...
小狗: ...嗯，我想這有助於調整...
我開始指揮鴉群，以我認為
可以減輕他們疲勞的方式。
羅文: 嗯...？
羅文: 喔，小狗，你真有主動性。
小狗: 蛤？這是什麼意思？
羅文: 我是真心稱讚你。
卡拉: 確實，你比
我之前看到的更加積極主動。
夏洛特: 這不是詛咒的副作用吧？
小狗: 我...我的意思是...
小狗: ...

我...

passages.name: CH9 - Liebra recruitment
passages.content:
Ah...?! What's this?
A faint light came from the heirloom on them.
The ground beneath our feet slowly rose and 
collected into a humanoid form.
With a flash of a greenish magical aura, it melded 
into a form more resembling a person.
Liebra: ...
Liebra: ...
Pup: W- What just happened there?!
Kara: It appears a summoning occurred...?
Pup: The green magic thing?!
Kara: It must've reacted to a capable heirloom? 
Though...

Acting on such a hair trigger is a surprise unto
itself.
Pup: So, who is...?
Liebra: ...
The woman stretched out like she had awakened 
from a long and deep sleep.
Liebra: To traverse a world in this form...
Liebra: Hmph. To think of that even being possible...
Pup: (Uh... something about her presence is 
intimidating...)

Hello. Who are... you...?
Liebra: I am Liebra.
Liebra: I suspect, more specifically... Liebra... NOT of this
land.
Liebra: How have you created my image in a way that walks
within this world?
Pup: You were... summoned via green magic?
Pup: I'm probably not the best person to ask...
Liebra: Ah, what a cute flustered face you have.
Pup: What's that supposed to mean?
Liebra: Nothing to dwell on. Simply...
She raised her hands and flames flickered on her
fingertips.
Liebra: Would you like some assistance with the beasts 
that place you in peril?
Pup: I'm not going to say no to help...
Pup: But what do you want in return?
Liebra: Nothing too complicated.
Liebra: I wish for entertainment.
Liebra: So do put on a good show~
passages.content_zh:
啊...？ ！這是什麼？
一道微弱的光芒從他們身上的傳家寶上散發出來。
我們腳下的地面慢慢升起
收集成人形。
伴隨著一道綠色的魔法氣息閃過，它融合了
變成更類似人的形式。
莉布拉：…
莉布拉：…
小狗：什-剛剛發生了什麼事？ ！
卡拉：看來發生召喚了……？
小狗：綠色魔法的東西？ ！
卡拉：它一定是對一件有能力的傳家寶做出了反應？ 
雖然...

如此一觸即發的行動令人驚訝
本身。
小狗：那麼，誰是…？
莉布拉：…
女人就像醒了一樣伸了個懶腰
從漫長而深沉的睡眠。
Liebra：以這種形式穿越世界…
莉布拉：哼。想想這甚至是可能的......
Pup：（呃…她的存在是
嚇人…）

你好。你……是誰？
莉布拉：我是莉布拉。
Liebra：我懷疑，更具體地說...Liebra...不是這個
土地。
Liebra：你是如何以行走的方式塑造我的形象的
在這個世界裡？
Pup：你是……被綠色魔法召喚的？
Pup：我可能不是最好的提問者…
Liebra：啊，你那張驚慌失措的臉多可愛。
小狗：這是什麼意思？
莉布拉：沒什麼好糾結的。簡單地說...
她舉起雙手，火焰在她身上閃爍
指尖。
Liebra：你需要一些關於野獸的幫助嗎？ 
這會讓你陷入危險嗎？
Pup：我不會拒絕幫忙...
小狗：但是你想要什麼回報呢？
Liebra：沒什麼太複雜的。
莉布拉：我想要娛樂。
Liebra：那就好好表現吧~

passages.name: CH9 - Map 3 to 4
passages.content:
.........
...........!
Crow: Anton! Norde! Everyone!
Pup: Ah!?
I turned to see the Nightless Crows breaking 
through the mounds of snow that had blocked the 
path.
Pup: You've broken through?!
Norde: Excellent. Now we should have enough man power 
to scare them off.
Crow: Right! We're on it!
Pup: Now...
Norde: ...everyone...
Pup: ...attack!
Norde: ...attack!
Flynn: Thank the Goddess... What sort of animals can live 
in these conditions?
Charlotte: Thank the Goddess... That was exhausting...
Rowan: Mayhap this is a time to seek a warm place to 
sleep?
Norde: Finding somewhere warm might be difficult.
Charlotte: At this point I'm more concerned about the animals
getting hungry again.
Kara: It is certainly advisable to move from this area 
before bunkering down.
Pup: Night will fall soon, so let's be quick about it.
The rescue efforts had identified a few missing 
people, but each of those men were found safely 
in the snow by the end.
With that sigh of relief, our exhausted group 
moved again to find a better place to make camp 
for the night.
We moved from the most recent mountain pass 
into another valley.
Kara: This area appears to have promise.
Charlotte: Goddess do I hope you're right.
Norde: It looks defensible, at least.

We can-
Pup: The site over there is good for the main tent, we 
can-
Norde: We can set the shift guard posts over there and...
Pup: ...
Norde: ...
Crow: ...

Thank the Goddess you two at least agree on 
WHAT to do...
Rowan: I think we should take care of the imperial troops
first.
Pup: What?!
Jude: ...
Charlotte: Yeah, I recognize some faces and armor styles over
there.
Norde: I suppose that it was only a matter of time since 
we crossed the border.
Kara: We could go around.
Rowan: Ah, well, there is an addendum I'd like to make to 
my observation.
Rowan: I may have noticed them because I saw a soldier
frantically running in the direction opposite of us.
Pup: One more fight then...
Win Condition: Defeat all enemies
Lose Condition: Pup, Kara, Charlotte, Rowan die
Warning: do not save over your save, use a 
different slot.
passages.content_zh:
…………
…………！
克勞：安東！諾德！每個人！
小狗：啊！ ？
我轉身看到不夜鴉正在破碎
穿過阻擋道路的雪堆
路徑。
小狗：你突破了？ ！
諾德：太棒了。現在我們應該有足夠的人力
嚇跑他們。
烏鴉：對啊！我們正在努力！
小狗：現在…
諾德：……大家……
小狗：……攻擊！
諾德：……攻擊！
弗林：感謝女神…什麼樣的動物可以生存
在這些條件下？
夏洛特：感謝女神…真是太累了…
羅文：也許現在是時候尋找一個溫暖的地方
睡覺？
Norde：找到溫暖的地方可能很困難。
夏洛特：現在我更關心動物
又餓了。
卡拉：當然建議離開這個區域
在下沙坑之前。
Pup：夜幕馬上就要降臨了，我們快點吧。
救援工作已確認數名失蹤者
人，但每個人都被安全找到
最後在雪地裡。
疲憊不堪的我們一行人鬆了一口氣
再次搬家，尋找更好的地方紮營
過夜。
我們從最近的山口搬走了
進入另一個山谷。
卡拉：這個領域似乎有希望。
夏洛特：女神，我希望你是對的。
Norde：至少看起來是有道理的。

我們可以——
Pup：那邊的場地很適合做主帳篷，我們
可以——
Norde：我們可以在那裡設置值班崗哨，然後…
小狗：…
諾德：…
烏鴉：…

感謝女神你們兩個至少同意
該怎麼辦...
羅文：我認為我們應該照顧帝國軍隊
首先。
小狗：什麼？ ！
裘德：…
夏洛特：是的，我認出了一些臉孔和盔甲樣式
那裡。
Norde：我想這只是時間問題
我們越過了邊界。
卡拉：我們可以到處走走。
羅文：啊，好吧，我想補充一點
我的觀察。
羅文：我可能注意到了他們，因為我看到了一名士兵
瘋狂地向我們相反的方向跑去。
小狗：那就再打一場吧…
勝利條件：擊敗所有敵人
失敗條件：Pup、Kara、C

passages.name: CH9 - Elliot Rec1.5
passages.content:
Elliot: ...

What is that noise...? It isn't thieves, is it?
passages.content_zh:
艾略特：…

那是什麼聲音……？這不會是小偷吧？

passages.name: CH9 - Elliot Rec2
passages.content:
Elliot: Huh...?
Elliot: Wait, no, that isn't yours to take!
Elliot: Return it, now.
passages.content_zh:

艾略特：等等，不行，那不是你能拿走的！
艾略特：現在，還回來。

passages.name: CH9 - Jude 1/2 hp
passages.content:
Jude: *Sigh*... I am not paid enough for this.
Jude: Imperial summoner, you're in charge.
Summoner: I have a name, you know?
Summoner: ...And he's gone.

Pfft. He was an amateur anyways.

This will be the perfect opportunity to show why I
should be in charge!

Summoning magic...!

...?!

I think... I got... a big one...!
Summoner: Haha~! That'll show 'em.
passages.content_zh:
裘德：*嘆氣*... 這工作根本沒給我足夠的薪水。
裘德：帝國召喚師，你負責。
召喚師：我有名稱的，你知道嗎？
召喚師：...然後他就走了。

切。反正他只是個菜鳥。

這將會是個完美的機會，來證明我
應該負責！

召喚魔法...！

...？！

我想... 我召喚出... 一個大家伙...！
召喚師：哈哈～！這下讓他們瞧瞧。

passages.name: CH9 - Map 4 Fin
passages.content:
Pup: *Pant*... that... has to be the last of it...
Kara: The area appears clear, at least.

Just in time for...
Charlotte: *Sigh*... Morning already...?
Norde: No rest for the weary.
Norde: This area is also compromised. We need to find 
another place for camp.
Rowan: *Siiiigggghhhhhh*........
Elliot: ...
Kara: Elliot, was it?
Elliot: My name is Elliot Elvanus of the holy country, 
Aureria.

I am here as a representative of the Covenant.

I wanted to request that you return the 
Oathbreaker. The one I assumed was picked up 
by... accident.
Pup: So you're still on about that? That we picked up
something like that?
Pup: It wasn't like you were asking before.
Elliot: I mean the coin that one of you picked up before.

It was given to me as part of my Covenant
responsibilities.
Pup: Heh... a coin? As an Oathbreaker?
Kara: It is possible.
Charlotte: I have heard myself that Oathbreakers "could be
anything", technically.
Elliot: That is true.

I am an Oathkeeper acting as a squire to the 
Covenant auditor Cainan DeClares.

I've been traveling the Imperial north as he covers 
the southern regions.
Elliot: I was... surprised to hear that you may be his
fiancé...

Despite those doubts... too much in my memory 
seemed to confirm it for me to deny it.
Kara: It was a pleasure to meet you before in Oadthine, 
even if it was for a short time.
Elliot: So that was you.

What... What brings you here? And you're fighting 
the Imperial troops?
Charlotte: What, have you not heard about the war with 
Lockhart and Cartenan?
Elliot: The... what?
It turned out that Elliot was isolated enough from
world news to only now hear of these events.
We explained as best we could.
Elliot: What a predicament to be roped into...
Kara: We do what we must, after all.
Elliot: Indeed. It is a worthy cause.

May I join it?
Kara: I... wouldn't want to pull you from your duties.
Elliot: It would be irresponsible of me to turn a blind eye
when presented with such a dilemma and a chance 
to help.
Elliot: There is... a sense of romance and adventure to it, 
as well.
Elliot: I would give my bow and arrow to this endeavor, if
you'll have me.
Pup: Are we in a position to say no?
Elliot: I would likely be forced to pursue the return of
Eul'unta if you do not.

If I come with, myself and Lady Kara can ensure 
that it is not abused before the end of this conflict.
Rowan: Yes, we wouldn't want anyone behind Covenant 
jail bars for improperly wielding an Oathbreaker, 
after all.
Kara: I, for one, would be happy to have you along.

It will be a delight to get to know my fiancé's
subordinate.

I imagine you have all sorts of interesting stories to
tell about his activities.
Elliot: I will do what I can to make it entertaining, then.
Elliot has joined the party!
With that, we moved once more to find a safe place to
make camp.
passages.content_zh:
小狗：*喘*...那...一定是最後一次了...
卡拉：至少這個區域看起來是乾淨的。

正好趕上...
夏綠蒂：*嘆氣*...早上已經...？
Norde：疲倦者不得休息。
Norde：這個區域也受到了損害。我們需要找到
另一個露營的地方。
羅文：*Siiiigggghhhhhh*........
艾略特：…
卡拉：艾利歐特，是嗎？
艾略特：我的名字是聖國的艾略特·埃爾瓦努斯，
奧雷裡亞。

我以盟約代表來到這裡。

我想請求你歸還
背誓者。我以為被撿到的那個
出於……意外。
Pup：那你還在繼續說這個嗎？我們撿到的
類似的東西？
Pup：這不像你之前問的。
艾略特：我指的是你們之前撿到的那枚硬幣。

它是作為我的契約的一部分給予我的
責任。
小狗：呃……一枚硬幣？作為一個背誓者？
卡拉：有可能。
夏洛特：我自己聽說誓言破壞者「可能是
任何東西”，從技術上來說。
艾略特：確實如此。

我是守誓者，扮演侍從的角色
聖約審計員Canan DeClares。

當他報道時我一直在帝國北部旅行
南部地區。
艾略特：我……很驚訝地聽到你可能是他的
未婚夫...

儘管有這些疑問……我的記憶中有太多
似乎證實了我的否認。
卡拉：很高興之前在奧德辛見到你，
即使只是很短的時間。
艾略特：原來是你啊。

什麼……什麼風把你吹到這裡來了？而你在戰鬥
帝國軍？
夏洛特：什麼，你沒聽過與美國的戰爭嗎？ 
洛哈特和卡特南？
艾略特：那個……什麼？
事實證明，埃利奧特已經足夠孤立了
世界新聞現在才聽到這些事件。
我們盡力解釋了。
艾利歐特：陷入了多麼尷尬的困境…
卡拉：畢竟我們做了我們必須做的事。
艾略特：確實如此。這是一項值得的事業。

我可以加入嗎？
卡拉：我……不想讓你逃避你的職責。
艾略特：如果我視而不見是不負責任的

passages.name: CH9 - Place Event
passages.content:
Pup: There we go.
Tatiana: Eh, now what? Just walk through the mountains?
Charlotte: Where does that leave us for next steps? Just keep
walking?
Kara: There is a village at the true border to the empire.

As predictable as it may be... so long as we stay
moving then we can take advantage of it for a 
short resupply.
Norde: Then we-
Pup: We can do that then. No time to waste.
Norde: ...
We moved across the foot of each mountain as we found
our way to a nearby village.
On the outskirts of the village...
Reagyn: Finally, someplace with walls.
Reagyn: This snow and cold is... so very inefficient...
Charlotte: A village with walls... and warmth? Thank the 
Goddess.
Kara: We should move quickly to resupply and get going.
Norde: What are the chances they are lacking in supplies 
for us to purchase?
Kara: Too many unknowns to say for sure.
Mariel: H- Hopefully they have some underlayers we can stock up
on for warmth...
Kara: Though if the cold is getting to those of us less used
to the climate, they may have options.
Pup: (Well, she's not wrong...)
After a slight chill ran through me, I looked around
and saw some of the people that had joined us not
handling it well.
Those from Cartenan or the south seemed 
particularly flustered.
Kara: Anton, do you also wish to partake?
Pup: Me...?
Pup: I... No, this coat is plenty.
Rowan: It would give you the opportunity to revitalize your
wardrobe.
Charlotte: Yeah, that thing hasn't fit well since Lockhart. And
now...
Pup: I...
Pup: No, that's unnecessary.
Charlotte: As a girl myself, all I can say is that thing looks
especially uncomfortable to move around in.
Pup: W- We're talking about warmth for a trek through 
the mountains.
Pup: We don't have time to be worrying about irrelevant
things now.
Norde: ...
Pup: In fact, let's just keep moving. I can check the
southern buildings and-
Norde: No, I imagine horseback would be quicker.
Pup: Well, it'd be quickest to just start-

STAGE DIRECTION> BEAST ENEMIES TO DEFEAT AND VILLAGER
ALLIES TO PROTECT ENTER AT THEIR PLACES IN EACH VILLAGE
LOCATION

...Fuck it. The wife will be happy with flowers this

I've been taking care of another mercenary that got

Hmm... Oh, are they one of yours?

羅文：這會給你一個重振你的活力的機會
衣櫃。

山。
Pup：我們沒時間擔心無關緊要的事情
現在的事情。
諾德：…
Pup：事實上，我們繼續前進吧。我可以檢查
南部的建築物和-
Norde：不，我想騎馬會更快。
Pup：嗯，一開始是最快的──
卡拉：等等。
舞台指導> 擊敗野獸敵人和別墅

Mariel: ...

瑪莉耶爾：...

小傢伙：我們有更重要的事要專注。

passages.name: CH9 - Charlotte → Kara
passages.content:
Charlotte: Hey, Kara. I just wanted to say that I'm happy that
you're sticking around with us.
Charlotte: Leaving your country like that can't be easy. I'd
understand if you turned around and went back 
now, but...
Charlotte: I appreciate it. Truly.
Kara: A lovely sentiment. Thank you for saying as much.
Charlotte: I do mean it that I'd understand if you turned 
around right now...

I wouldn't want you coming with us out of some 
sense of obligation.
Kara: I can assure you that isn't the case.
Kara: What I see is the greatest opportunity to make a
difference in this conflict.
Kara: The Kingdom cannot be changed from its fate 
unless something more fundamental is solved.
Kara: I guess I would phrase it as...

"All roads lead to Lockhart"

...and I rather be in a position to have a hand in 
that fate than struggling in a losing battle.

It is the most I can do for Cartenan now.
Charlotte: You've put a lot of thought into this.
Kara: There are few decisions I make lightly.
Charlotte: Then let me double the appreciation I gave before.
Thank you.
passages.content_zh:
夏洛特：嘿，卡拉。我只是想說我很高興
你和我們在一起。
夏洛特：像這樣離開你的國家並不容易。我會
明白你是否轉身回去
現在，但是…
夏洛特：我很感激。確實。
卡拉：一種可愛的情感。謝謝你說了這麼多。
夏洛特：我的意思是如果你轉身我會理解
現在周圍...

我不希望你和我們一起出去
義務感。
卡拉：我可以向你保證事實並非如此。
卡拉：我看到的是創造一個最好的機會
這場衝突中的差異。
卡拉：王國的命運無法改變
除非有更根本的問題得到解決。
卡拉：我想我會把它表述為...

“條條大路通洛克哈特”

……我寧願能夠參與其中
這種命運勝過在一場失敗的戰鬥中掙扎。

這是我現在能為卡特南做的最多的事了。
夏洛特：你對此花了很多心思。
卡拉：我很少會輕易做出決定。
夏洛特：那麼讓我加倍之前的感激。
謝謝。

passages.name: CH9 - Satia → Norde
passages.content:
Norde: Satia... I need to ask..
Satia: You want to know my opinion on Pup's recent 
change?
Norde: At least it's obvious enough to draw your interest.
Satia: Then I'd ask... which change?
Norde: The behavior, of course.
Norde: Anton has never been one to try and be a leader 
of the Crows.
Satia: I do think I understand it.

I'll ask you... Why haven't you taken up the 
leadership of the company?
Norde: I regularly take on responsibilities with the
organization of it all.
Satia: And everything else?

Why did you never try and be THE leader of the 
Crows?
Norde: Because there was always-
Norde: ...
Norde: Because Ivan was always there.
Satia: I do not know if Pup really wants to step up like
this... Time will tell...

For now, I think it helps to keep his mind off of it...

...while also trying to fill the shoes that were lost.
Norde: Hmm...
passages.content_zh:
諾德：莎緹雅... 我需要問妳...

諾德：至少這夠明顯，能引起妳的興趣。
莎緹雅：那我會問... 哪個改變？

諾德：安東從來就不是那種會想當烏鴉領導者的人。

我來問你... 為什麼你沒有接下公司的領導權？

為什麼你從來沒有試著成為烏鴉的領導者？
諾德：因為一直有...
諾德：...
諾德：因為伊凡一直都在。

目前，我認為這有助於讓他不去想它...

...同時也試圖填補失去的空缺。
諾德：嗯...

Tatiana: Brr...
Tatiana shrunk to within her armor like a turtle.
Tatiana: Much better...
Reagyn: How well does that work?
Tatiana: Hm?
Tatiana: Ah, is the little noble girl jealous?
Reagyn: No, I-
Reagyn: Nevermind, this isn't worth it.
Reagyn: After everything in Cartenan recently, I don't have 
the patience.
Reagyn: I can't imagine you'd understand, so you can focus 
your attention elsewhere.
Tatiana: ...

Nah, I get it.

Waking up with everything you cared about fallin' 
to pieces around you...
Tatiana: My best take on it all would be simple...

Sometimes you gotta rebuild or find a new place to

Reagyn: I... appreciate the thought. Though I'm not sure 
you entirely get my family's situation and obligations 
to-
Tatiana: Sure I do.

Here, I'll even let you use my armor to warm up

You're small enough that the both of us could fit.
Reagyn: I...
Reagyn: I honestly can't tell if you're trying to antagonize

I'll be optimistic and assume the latter.
Reagyn: But... I'm not going to share your armor with you...
Tatiana: We'll get that noble stuffiness out of ya at some

Tatiana: 嘶...
Tatiana 像隻烏龜一樣縮進她的盔甲裡。
Tatiana: 好多了...

Tatiana: 嗯？

醒來時發現你所關心的一切都

Tatiana: 我對這一切最好的理解就是...

有時候你必須重建，或者找個新的地方

你完全了解我家的情況和義務
-

來，如果你需要，我甚至可以讓你用我的盔甲來取暖
。

你夠小，我們兩個都能塞進去。
Reagyn: 我...
Reagyn: 我真的搞不清楚你是在想激怒
我還是想對我好。

我會樂觀地認為是後者。
Reagyn: 但是... 我不會和你共用你的盔甲...
Tatiana: 我們總有一天會把你那貴族氣息給改掉的。

passages.name: CH9 - Castel → Flynn
passages.content:
Castel: I must say, I am surprised you've followed this 
group this far.
Flynn: Uh... Sorry?
Castel: I mean no insult. I mean no compliment either.
Castel: I simply expected a noble of the Kingdom to be 
more hesitant to leave it behind.
Castel: My own birth was across the continent, so that
patriotism amongst the nobles was always an 
enigma to me.
Flynn: I don't think it's too complicated.

The kingdom was... is... a bastion worth 
protecting. It is a people worth protecting.

I was always taught that I, as a noble, have an
obligation to protect it.
Flynn: If the best option I have to fix my country's 
problems is outside of the country, I have no qualm 
doing so.
Castel: Hmph. I guess I must have simply misjudged how 
that patriotism was directed, then.
Flynn: Maybe it is... a bit.
Flynn: But... as scared I am of the responsibility of being a
Lord one day...

I do truly want to do right by their happiness.

Even if we all moved to another country... I'd want
them to thrive.
Castel: Hmm...
Castel: I think that is wonderful. I can see the value.

It must be comforting to have that sense of 
purpose.
Flynn: "Terrifying"... That's the word I'd choose.
Castel: I think by your words alone that I know you'll do
wonderfully.
Flynn: I hope you're right...
passages.content_zh:
Castel：我必須說，我很驚訝你竟然關注了這個
組到此為止。
弗林：呃……抱歉？
Castel：我沒有侮辱的意思。我的意思也不是讚美。
卡斯特：我只是期望王國的貴族
更猶豫是否要把它拋在腦後。
卡斯特：我自己出生在整個大陸，所以
貴族的愛國精神始終是
對我來說是個謎。
Flynn：我認為這並不太複雜。

王國曾經……是……一座值得的堡壘
保護。這是一個值得保護的民族。

我總是被教導說，作為一個貴族，我有一個
保護它的義務。
弗林：如果最好的選擇是解決我的國家的問題
問題在國外，我沒有疑慮
這樣做。
卡斯特：哼。我想我一定是誤判如何
那麼，愛國主義是有針對性的。
Flynn：也許是……有一點。
弗林：但是……我很害怕，因為我有責任成為一名
主有一天...

我真的很想為他們的幸福做對的事。

即使我們都搬到另一個國家...我想要
他們茁壯成長。
卡斯特爾：嗯…
Castel：我認為這很棒。我可以看到價值。

有這樣的感覺一定會讓人感到安慰
目的。
Flynn：「可怕」…這就是我選擇的詞。
Castel：我想僅憑你的話我就知道你會做的
太棒了。
弗林：我希望你是對的......

passages.name: CH9 - Story OP 1
passages.content:
It was not fine.
It was NOT FINE.
IT
WAS
NOT
FINE
Soldier: Y- Your majesty, I simply meant-
Alexei IV: Traitor.

Take him to the deepest dungeon.

If he resists, slit his throat there and then.
Soldier: Wait, no, all I did was-!
The soldier's vision was blanketed in darkness.
And his muffled pleas were drowned out by the 
heavy sound of plate armored guards dragging him 
away.
Alexei IV: ...
Alexei IV, the emperor of the Nolvanus Empire, 
slowly lowered again onto his throne.
And he sat there.
Alexei IV: ...
Silently.
...............
Simon: Hmm...

That is one way to react to news of a resounding
victory.
Alexei IV: ...
His eyes turned slowly towards Simon.
Simon: I... mean no insult.
Simon: You are most wise, of course.
Alexei IV: That beast...
Alexei IV: He... DESTROYED THE OATHBREAKER!
An audible crackling sound could be heard.
The emperor's fingers dug into his throne to the 
point of splintering it ever slightly.
Ruslan: Sir. We are not aware of why he did so. It may 
have been a strategic necessity.
Alexei IV: ...
Simon: Or it may be a ploy. He could've have faked its
destruction and kept it for himself.
Alexei IV: ...
Ruslan: There is no need to inject such inciting, baseless
speculation.
Simon: "Baseless"? What man of good sense would let 
such a treasure be destroyed?

It does not take a tactician to see the thread of
logic.
Alexei IV: I should've kept a closer eye on that one...
Ruslan: Has that boy ever been disloyal before?

He even returned to serve his country after his 
time in the crusades.
Ruslan: He was under no obligation to... and he did so in its
hour of need.
Simon: Hmph. Such loyalty yet these are the results he brings?
Ruslan: ...
Ruslan: How have you fared in your "Lockhart Princess" problem?
Simon: Progressing. No thanks to your beast, either.
Alexei IV: I should have kept a closer eye on that one.

Even as a child...

...was he plotting against me?
Inessa: Plotting against US.
The click of heels pierced through the dreary 
silence.
Inessa: The things the help will say!
Ruslan: ...My emperor and empress. I ask of you to not 
panic in this time.
Inessa: Not panic? That bastard child is running out and 
about.

The maids are saying he is with the enemy!
Simon: Bastard child?
Ruslan: The crown prince? Or...?
Inessa: Of course it's him.
Inessa: They say 'the Prince of Nolvanus' appeared in the

Avalina: You... that dragon... Where did it even go?

What...  *pant*... are you planning...?
Steel Wolf: ...
With a slight tilt of his head, the Wolf looked at the
Queen's arm.
A glistening patch of bloody red from the recent
exchange of blows.
Avalina: Answer...!
Steel Wolf: ...
But, he simply... sheathed his sword.
Avalina: P- Please... Why... Why have you...?!
Steel Wolf: It does not matter.
Avalina: W- What?!
He simply turned and start walking away.
Steel Wolf: The seed is sown.
Avalina: You can't-
She started to rise to her feet to chase after him.
But a select number of guards blocked her path.
Nora: Not another movement.
What remained of the Queen's guard managed to 
pull her back into safety from Nora and the others.
Avalina: No... No no no...
Steel Wolf: She is of no threat.

She is weak.
The Steel Wolf turned back to Nora.
Steel Wolf: You may continue your own task. It aligns with 
that man's goals, after all.
Nora: You mean...?
Nora: Thank you.
Steel Wolf: ...
The Steel Wolf didn't stick around to listen.
He had turned his back to the scene and was 
already gone.
Nora: I will make the most of it. I must secure the future 
of my home and family.

passages.content:
*Drip*
*Drip drip*...
Pup: ...
My eyes fluttered open like I had awoken from
hibernation.
Everything felt new to me from my surroundings 
to my...
Pup: ...
I got up... slowly...
Pup: Argh...

(That's... sore... everywhere...)
Up on my feet a bit too quickly, a slight dizziness
threw off my balance.
Pup: Ah...!
Pup: Shit... One more time...
Much more deliberately, I got to my feet.
Pup: *Sigh*... better.
I looked down ever so slightly and saw the main 
source of my balance problems.
Pup: ...
Looking around where I was, there was a variety of
equipment and rubbish.
Pup: (Some sort of cave based storehouse? A mine, 
even? It sounds... familiar.)

(Someone probably mentioned it when I was 
halfway to the Goddess earlier.)
Not too far away, there was a dirty but large mirror
shard.
Pup: ......
I stepped in front of it.
Pup: ...

......

.........
Pup: *Sigh*...
Pup: ...
My hands fidgeted as I looked.
I didn't know what to do with them.
Pup: Okay.

..................

Okay.
I turned away from it.
It had served its purpose.
I pushed aside the makeshift door to the cave only 
to be greeted with the sun spilling over the 
horizon.
Pup: (Sunrise... or sunset?)
My gaze slowly scanned the area, until I saw...
Norde: ...and they'll be here within the hour? Along with 
the rest of the Crows and our stragglers?
Charlotte: Yeah, Kara said there were a few other stragglers 
from the kingdom's army that wanted to join, too.
Pup: Join who?
Charlotte: Pup? You're up?
Norde: You're fine to move?
Pup: Sure. And you?
Norde: I'm... well rested.
Charlotte: Yeah, are you sure you don't need more sleep? It's
still early.
Pup: All the more reason for us to get moving quickly.

You're our client, and our job is to keep you safe.
Pup: I can imagine you've still got people chasing after
you.
Norde: That is true. That griffin rider was amongst the 
imperial group this time, unfortunately.
Pup: The fox-eared woman, right? She seemed to want 
our client's head, so...
Norde: If she is leading other flying type units, they may be
able to make up ground quickly.
Pup: See? Scale brains over here agrees, so I must be right.
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte stood there, quiet for a moment, unsure 
of how to respond.
Charlotte: Are you sure?

We all saw what happened.
Pup: I...
Pup: ...

It's fine. I'm a girl.

What's the point in acting like it's going to
develop in any other way?

.........
Pup: Make a joke, if you'd like.
Pup: I'm not gonna let it distract me anymore, though.
Norde: ...
I turned to the side and reached down to pick up a
readied sword.
Pup: There we go.
A nice tug fastened it to my gear.
Charlotte: ...

There is that, but... I mean... I more meant...
Norde: ...
Norde closed his eyes as if flinching ever so slightly
from the topic being brought to the forefront.
Pup: ...
I turned back to Charlotte.
Pup: I'm not gonna let it distract me anymore.

There's more important things to take care of
than to spend my time fretting over the
end of this curse's effects.
With one last tightening, I was ready to move.
Pup: Don't worry. We'll keep you and your sister safe.
Pup: Don't worry. We'll keep you safe.
I stepped past Charlotte as I started to make my 
way from the temporary camp at the mine.
Pup: Was the plan to meet here, or meet further along 
our path so we don't lose as much time?
Norde: The idea proposed was that there are two main
recognizable regroup points along the way. Here, 
and...
Norde started to walk with me.
Charlotte: But...

...
Charlotte: ...

Didn't you just note that I was the client in this
partnership?
Pup: ...?
Charlotte: Shouldn't I get the final say on when we rest and 
not rest?

I'm not going to let you just-
Norde: No, Anton is right.
Norde: There physically isn't time to dwell on any of your
concerns.
Norde: Speak as we move, or save it for another time.
Pup: I vote for the less distracting choice.
Charlotte: And when will "another time" be?
Norde: When you are safe.
Pup: Yeah, I can... fix it at that point.

When the job is done.
I gave an affirming nod before spinning on my heel 
and returning to the path forward.
Pup: (And when the Wolf is skewered...)
[Choice]: 
The Kingdom had met a challenge that appeared
insurmountable.
The trump card that their military strategy was built
around was gone, and they were forced to fight a 
losing battle.
Our own escape was one of acknowledged defeat.
We had no ally for Lockhart to seek within the 
Kingdom of Cartenan anymore.
The choice left to the Nightless Crows was one to
retreat and seek safety.
Yet the path forward was one directly through the
Empire itself.
We were between a rock and a hard place, and we 
were scattered from the recent flight from the 
ongoing war.
Satia, Rowan, and other allies among the Crows 
and associates had regrouped and met us at 
the designated meeting point.
Rowan and other allies among the Crows and 
associates had regrouped and met us at the 
designated meeting point.
Lady Kara and other stragglers from the Kingdom 
decided join the mission to retake Lockhart, as 
aimless as we were in the moment.
Those were the small victories we could take from 
our efforts in the Kingdom.
What was left was a simple choice.
The choice to keep moving forward.

Pup: 我可以想像你們仍然有人在追趕。

passages.name: CH9 - Story end 1
passages.content:
With the last of our conflicts sorted, we were able 
to move slightly off course to find an opening to 
setup camp in.
It was open enough to have strong sightlines if an
attack was about to happen, and with escape 
routes to all directions.
So we went about setting up camp.
As we did, a conversation spurred from our 
unanswered questions.
Charlotte: Of course we had to run into imperial troops in all
this mess.
Rowan: When in Nolvanus, you'll see Nolvanans.
Charlotte: Sure. And welcome home... Alexei.
Rowan: I always did prefer the eternal spring of the 
kingdom. Truly a tragic loss.
Charlotte: Crown prince of the invading empire here, folks.
Kara: Alexei, are you aware of notable defensive 
structures along the border?
Rowan: Alas, no. Cartenan never posed a realistic invasion
threat.

Many imperial generals would likely question if 
they'd die in these mountains before reaching the 
empire proper.
Elliot: I was also surprised to see troops in the area.

I've been here for some time, and they've been 
few and far between.
Reagyn: Lady Kara, are you suggesting that as where the 
man retreated to? A military outpost?
Norde: You are suggesting that swordsman retreated to a
military outpost?
Kara: It was what I was hoping for.
Pup: You want there to be a military outpost nearby?
Kara: Well, it may be favorable to an alternative...
Kara: Elliot, the man ran off farther into the mountains.

I assume that rings a bell for you?
Elliot: Hm...?
Elliot: Oh... The Vault?
Elliot: You think the empire is tampering with a local 
Vault?
Kara: That man ran off farther into the mountains...

I've only heard rumors, but some say there is a 
Vault deeper within.
Pup: A Vault... that sounds familiar.
Rowan: It is where the Covenant seals away Oathbreakers 
to stop misuse of them.

They are scattered and often hidden for said
safekeeping.
Pup: Right... I think that Cainan guy said something 
about them before.
Elliot: I visited the Ashen Fox at the Vault earlier on my
trip.

The facility was in good order at the time.
Elliot: But if a proper military force were to attack it...
Norde: They also might simply be part of the Kingdom 
invasion force.
Norde: Stragglers that got left behind in the movement of 
an entire army.
Kara: A valid point.
Pup: We know how dangerous one Oathbreaker can be 
in the wrong hands. Do we really want to take that 
chance?
Kara: Also valid.
Norde: We already have a mission. What would you do if 
we run into the better part of an army?
Kara: Probably less valid.
Pup: We're not going to just run into it without thinking.
Pup: And worse case, if that dragon shows up then we 
take down the Wolf's stupid fucking dragon.
Kara: I'm not even sure how that could be valid.
Norde: ...
Pup: ...
Charlotte: *Sigh*...
Charlotte: Now now. Aren't I the client?
Charlotte: Hey, aren't Vaults protected by former famous
crusaders?
Elliot: Yes, the Ashen Wolf is stationed at the Border 
Mountain Vault.

He was quite acclaimed in the crusades decades 
ago. That's why the Covenant recruits them, after 
all.
Kara: Yes, the Covenant will recruit crusade heroes to 
ensure the security of the Vaults.
Charlotte: Then between a potential strong ally and whatever
Oathbreaker is inside...

I have every reason to head over and petition the 
guy for whatever help he has sympathies enough 
to offer.
Especially if we're already nearby.
Pup: Hmm...
Norde: Hmm...
Charlotte: So says the client. Understood?
Pup: Yes, ma'am.
Norde: Understood.
Charlotte: Good. Then we'll go do that next.

...
Charlotte: *Sigh*... After at least a few hours of actual sleep.

我只聽到傳聞，但有人說有

它們分散且常常隱藏起來
保管。
