裘德一動也不動地站著，準備拔劍。
他的對面，是一個籠罩在陰影中的男人。 
裘德盟友的支柱和鮮血。
他向前走去，走進了光亮之中。
阿蒂克斯：在肉體中。
裘德： 至少大部分是。
裘德盯著阿迪克斯的右臉。
儘管頭髮遮住了部分部位，
他的頭的三分之一看起來已經石化了
與他臉部其他部位的鱗片形成對比。
裘德：讓我想起曾經讀過的一段歷史
書。

我猜這就是你的 Dralleus 的結果？
裘德：或者……不，背誓者。這就是你所說的。
阿蒂克斯：我還以為翡翠帝國太忙了
與十字軍作戰，攻擊對手的金庫
大陸的一側。
裘德：不。只是一個失去的兒子並被拋棄。
我來這裡是為了做一份工作。
裘德拔出劍。
裘德：我們可以用簡單的方法，也可以用困難的方法來做到這一點。
阿蒂克斯：…

passages.name: CH10 - Jude (Active)
passages.content:
Jude: You’re that group from the  mountains...
Jude: Argh... that guy really was all  talk, then?
Jude: Am I being paid to do everything?
passages.content_zh:
裘德：你們是從山上下來的那群人...
裘德：呃... 那傢伙果然只是嘴上說說而已嗎？
裘德：難道所有事情都要我來做嗎？

passages.name: CH10 - Jude (Dead)
passages.content:
Jude: *Pant*... Dammit. I... I am...  not... *pant*... paid 
enough for  this.
Jude: Time to retreat!
passages.content_zh:
裘德：*氣喘吁籲*...該死。我...我...沒有...*褲子*...付錢
足夠了。
裘德：是時候撤退了！

passages.name: CH10 - Atticus (Dead)
passages.content:
Atticus: Argh...! That... was not...
Atticus: Everyone... hold you ground... I  need to... catch 
my breath...
passages.content_zh:
阿提克斯：呃...！那...不是...
阿提克斯：各位...守住陣地...我需要...喘口氣...

passages.name: CH10 - Jude Att no invin
passages.content: Jude: I must hurry this up...
passages.content_zh: 裘德：我必須快點…

passages.name: CH10 - Battle Talk & Events
passages.content:
Soldier: Argh!
Charlotte: That's the guard down.
Kara: The vault should be towards the deepest part of 
the facility.

We should regroup and make our way there.
Soldier: Ugh... D- Dammit!
Rowan: Soldiers to defeat, then? So the battle is ongoing
here?
Pup: Yeah, we weren't too late.
Pup: They said it'd probably be towards the back when 
we were planning this.

Let's move there and we can regroup to help the 
locals here.
Atticus: Mmm...
Jude: You're... stronger than they said you'd be.

Aren't you supposed to be half stone?
Atticus: Hmm...
Atticus: Ah... I suppose that's true.
Atticus: All it means is that I can put more force into my 
good side, no?
Jude: Annoying...
Atticus: Do you want another shot at hitting my blindside?
Jude: ...
Jude: Argh... They don't pay me enough for this.
Jude: Nora promised me stroganoff... Still nothing.
Atticus: Perhaps I can offer you a warm soup when we're done?
Jude: You can't afford me, so no can do. You know how this
ends.
Atticus: Very well.
Win Condition: Defeat all enemies
Lose Condition: The vault is breached, Charlotte, 
Pup, Rowan, Kara die
passages.content_zh:
士兵：呃啊！
夏洛特：守衛倒下了。
卡拉：金庫應該在設施最深處。

我們應該重整隊伍，前往那裡。
士兵：呃... 該...該死！
羅溫：所以還有士兵要打敗囉？看來戰鬥還在持續中？
小不點：是啊，我們還不算太晚。
小不點：他們說計畫的時候，就說可能在後方。

我們移動到那裡，然後重整隊伍來幫助這裡的居民。
阿提克斯：嗯...
裘德：你...比他們說的還要強。

你不應該是半石人嗎？
阿提克斯：嗯...
阿提克斯：啊...我想的確是。
阿提克斯：這只代表我可以把更多力量放在我好的那一側，不是嗎？
裘德：真煩人...
阿提克斯：你想再來一次攻擊我的盲點嗎？
裘德：...
裘德：呃啊...他們給我的錢不夠做這個。
裘德：諾拉答應我的俄式牛肉...還是沒有。
阿提克斯：或許我們結束後我可以請你喝碗熱湯？
裘德：你請不起我，所以免了。你知道這會怎麼結束。
阿提克斯：好吧。
勝利條件：擊敗所有敵人
失敗條件：金庫被攻破，夏洛特、小不點、羅溫、卡拉死亡

passages.name: CH10 - Breached Vault
passages.content:
Atticus: No...!
Pup: It was breached...?!
Charlotte: Can we do anything?!
Soldier: Move, move, move!
The imperial troops flooded into the chamber and
blocked our ability to intercept them.
Pup: (It's too late...)
passages.content_zh:
阿蒂克斯：不……！
Pup：被破壞了…？ ！
夏洛特：我們能做點什麼嗎？ ！
士兵：移動，移動，移動！
帝國軍湧入議事廳，
阻止了我們攔截它們的能力。
小狗：（太晚了…）

passages.name: CH10 - Player reach reach ATT
passages.content:
Pup: The fighting is all over...
Atticus: ...
Pup: W- We're here to help!
Atticus: ...
Atticus: Very well.

Protect the Vault door.
Pup: S- Sure.
passages.content_zh:
Pup: 戰鬥都結束了...
Atticus: ...
Pup: 我- 我們是來幫忙的！
Atticus: ...
Atticus: 很好。

保護金庫門。
Pup: 痾- 好的。

passages.name: CH10 - Jude p1
passages.content:
Unknown_4294967295: And that one goes down.
Unknown_4294967295: Huh?
There was a partially completed dish on the kitchen
table.
It sat there, seeming to waft about an aroma like it
was fresh.
As best as one could tell, a denizen of the Vault 
was preparing a meal only be to chased off.
Then, an imperial soldier got cocky and tried to 
finish it themself.
Unknown_4294967295: ...

Maybe if I add this as a final touch?
Pup: And that one goes down.
Pup: Huh?
There was a partially completed dish on the kitchen
table.
It sat there, seeming to waft about an aroma like it
was fresh.
As best as one could tell, a denizen of the Vault 
was preparing a meal only be to chased off.
Then, an imperial soldier got cocky and tried to 
finish it themself.
Pup: ...

Maybe if I add this as a final touch?
Pup: ...
Pup: It’s been a while since I’ve had a home cooked 
meal like that...
Pup: No, I can’t get distracted by that. I am a 
professional mercenary. I need to act like it.
No, I can’t get distracted by that. I am 
a professional mercenary. I need to act like it.

I gripped my hand and took a defiant pose.

...

*Grooowl*...
Pup: (No, I need to stay strong.)
Pup: (It isn’t even something I like... like a sweet would 
go great right about now-)
Pup: (No. I can’t let a craving overcome me.)
As I continued on, the thoughts crept into my 
mind and became stronger, shifting between 
cravings until...
Pup has aquired a Sweet Tooth!
...the curse worked its magic without me even 
noticing.
passages.content_zh:
Unknown_4294967295：那個就掉下來了。
Unknown_4294967295：嗯？
廚房裡有一個半成品的盤子
表。
它坐在那裡，似乎飄蕩著類似的香氣
很新鮮。
據人們所知，避難所的居民
正準備著飯菜卻被趕走了。
然後，一名帝國士兵變得趾高氣揚，試圖
自己完成。
未知_4294967295：...

也許我可以將其添加為最後的修飾？
Pup：然後那個就掉下來了。
小狗：啊？
廚房裡有一個半成品的盤子
表。
它坐在那裡，似乎飄蕩著類似的香氣
很新鮮。
據人們所知，避難所的居民
正準備著飯菜卻被趕走了。
然後，一名帝國士兵變得趾高氣揚，試圖
自己完成。
小狗：…

也許我可以將其添加為最後的修飾？
小狗：…
小狗：好久沒吃過家常菜了
飯就這樣...
Pup：不，我不能因此而分心。我是一個
職業僱傭兵。我需要表現得像這樣。
不，我不能因此而分心。我是
職業僱傭兵。我需要表現得像這樣。

我握緊我的手，做出挑釁的姿勢。

…

*咕嚕貓*...
小狗：（不，我需要保持堅強。）
Pup：（這甚至不是我喜歡的東西…就像甜食一樣
現在就一切順利-)
小狗：（不，我不能讓渴望戰勝我。）
當我繼續前進時，這些想法悄悄滲入我的腦海
心靈變得更堅強，在之間轉換
渴望直到...
小狗已經學會吃甜食！
……即使沒有我，詛咒也發揮了魔力
注意到。

passages.name: CH10 - Captain Dead
passages.content:
Soldier: The captain is dead!

Damn it! 

 Kill them all!!
Atticus: I came here as soon as I could.
passages.content_zh:
士兵：艦長死了！

該死！

殺光他們！！
阿提克斯：我一收到消息就趕來了。

passages.name: CH10 - Active → Jude
passages.content:
Jude: Argh, more of you. I'll just have to take you out 
and-
Jude: Huh...?
A delectable aroma wafted into the area.
Jude: ...
Pup: ...
Jude: ...
Jude: ...
.........
Pup: Do you...
Pup: Do you want this food?
Jude: Of course not.
Jude: Raise your weapon.
Pup: ...
Jude: ...
.........
...*Groooowwwlllll*...
Pup: Any chance you'd retreat for it?
Jude: ...
Pup: Wait, might you?
Jude: O- Of course not.
Pup: You know, you're not exactly fighting for a just 
cause.
Jude: I don't care.
Pup: A mercenary following the money.
Jude: You couldn't afford me.

What I seek isn't simple to just buy me with.
Pup: ...

Is it... the food?
Jude: I said to raise your weapon.
.........
...*Grrrooowwwwllllll*...
Pup: Such a shame.
Pup: We're a mercenary company. We're well traveled 
and know lots of recipes.
Pup: Not to mention there's this bard in our group. He's
well traveled across the continent.
Pup: And also a noble from Cartenan. She always seems 
to know the best place to eat in any town she 
visits.
Pup: Best of all? THE heir to the Lockhart Stewart
mercantile group. She can bankroll it all.
Jude: ...
Pup: So how well has your current arrangement been 
going?
Jude: ...
.........
Pup: One nice meal for you a month. Anything you want.
Jude: ...
Jude: One fine dining meal a day.
Pup: 1 every week.
Jude: 4 a week.
Pup: 2 a week.
Jude: 3.
Pup: 2 a week and I'll throw in this meal that caught your
eye.
Jude: ...
Jude: Deal.
Jude joins the party!
Jude: My name is Judais Cato Gaius del Aeneus Tiberius...
*munch* ...
 
But you are free to call me Jude.
Jude: I am a mercenary from the Emerald Empire out in 
the east...  *munch*... and have no loyalty to the 
Nolvanus Empire here.
Jude: We'll be good friends so long as our deal is satisfied.
Pup: Good to have you on board with us this time, Jude.
Pup: (I hope Charlotte won't be too mad about me 
making this deal...)
passages.content_zh:
裘德：啊，又是你們。我只好解決掉你們
然後-
裘德：蛤...？
一股誘人的香氣飄了過來。
裘德：...
小不點：...
裘德：...
裘德：...
.........
小不點：你...
小不點：你想要這食物嗎？
裘德：當然不是。
裘德：舉起你的武器。
小不點：...
裘德：...
.........
...*咕嚕嚕嚕嚕*...
小不點：有沒有可能為了它撤退？
裘德：...
小不點：等等，你會嗎？
裘德：我- 我當然不會。
小不點：你知道，你並不是為了正義而戰。
裘德：我不在乎。
小不點：一個追逐金錢的傭兵。
裘德：你們付不起我。

我所追求的並不是單純用錢就能買到的。
小不點：...

難道是...食物？
裘德：我說舉起你的武器。
.........
...*咕嚕嚕嚕嚕*...
小不點：真是可惜。
小不點：我們是傭兵團。我們走遍各地，知道很多食譜。
小不點：更別提我們團裡還有個吟遊詩人。他可是走遍了整個大陸。
小不點：還有一位來自卡特南的貴族。她似乎總是知道任何城鎮裡最好吃的地方。
小不點：最棒的是？洛克哈特·史都華商業集團的繼承人。她可以資助一切。
裘德：...
小不點：所以你目前的安排怎麼樣？
裘德：...
.........
小不點：一個月給你一頓好吃的。任何你想要的。
裘德：...
裘德：一天一頓精緻餐點。
小不點：一週一頓。
裘德：一週四頓。
小不點：一週兩頓。
裘德：三頓。
小不點：一週兩頓，我再加碼給你這頓吸引你目光的餐點。
裘德：...
裘德：成交。
裘德加入了隊伍！
裘德：我的名字是裘達伊斯·卡托·蓋烏斯·德爾·埃涅阿斯·提貝里烏斯...
*嚼嚼* ...

但你可以叫我裘德。
裘德：我是來自東方翡翠帝國的傭兵... *嚼嚼*... 對這裡的諾爾瓦努斯帝國沒有任何忠誠。
裘德：只要我們的交易得到滿足，我們就會是好朋友。
小不點：很高興這次能有你加入我們，裘德。
小不點：（我希望夏洛特不會因為我做這筆交易而太生氣...）

passages.name: CH10 - Pup → Charlotte
passages.content:
Pup: There you are!
Charlotte: Great, you all made it through safely.
Pup: Was there ever a doubt?
Charlotte: So many.
Pup: Ack. This curse hasn't slowed me down, you know?
Charlotte: Keep talking like that and it might do so in overdrive
instead.
Pup: F- Fine...
Pup: Let's just do what we came here to do.
passages.content_zh:
小狗：你來了！
夏洛特：太好了，你們都安全通過了。
Pup：有沒有懷疑過？
夏洛特：這麼多。
小狗：嗯。這個詛咒並沒有讓我放慢腳步，你知道嗎？
夏洛特：繼續這樣說話，超速行駛時可能會這樣
相反。
小狗：F-很好...
Pup：我們就做我們來這裡要做的事吧。

passages.name: CH10 - Rowan → Mariel
passages.content:
Mariel: Rowan...! You all are alright.

How about Pup? Are they okay?
Rowan: I do feel your care and love.
Rowan: Even if not for me.
Mariel: That's now what I...
Rowan: Our dear Pup seems to be putting the nature of 
their situation to the side.

For better or worse, it is an attempt to delay and
refocus on the task at hand.

And... I would say the effort seems sincere, as we 
were worried about.
Rowan: I can say less on if that effort will bear fruit.
Mariel: Also as we feared.
Mariel: Well... we'll just do what we can to support Pup.
Rowan: I am in full agreement.

I would not care for the sight of them to feel...
unrecognizable, after all.
Mariel: Same~
passages.content_zh:
瑪麗埃爾：羅文……！你們都沒事。

普普呢？他們還好嗎？
羅文：我確實感受到了你們的關心和愛。
羅文：即使不適合我。
瑪麗埃爾：這就是我現在...
羅文：我們親愛的小狗似乎把本性
他們的處境就在一旁。

無論好壞，它都是一種試圖拖延和
重新專注於手邊的任務。

而且......我想說，這種努力似乎是真誠的，因為我們
擔心。
羅文：關於這項努力是否會取得成果，我可以少說一些。
Mariel：正如我們所擔心的那樣。
Mariel：嗯...我們會盡我們所能來支持Pup。
羅文：我完全同意。

我不會在意看到他們的感覺...
畢竟認不出來了
瑪麗艾爾：同上~

passages.name: CH10 - Elliot → Atticus
passages.content:
Elliot: Atticus. You are still alive.
Atticus: Hm... You again.
Atticus: Did you not leave for Cartenan after the inspection?
Elliot: I ran into this mercenary group on my way.
Elliot: Atticus, it sounds as though Oathbreakers are being
abused.
Atticus: Hmm... So nothing new.
Elliot: At the very least, I want to stop the opportunity 
for another to be subjected to that.
Atticus: Heheh, you did seem like a good kid before.
Atticus: Very well, be sure to keep up. Your form there 
should help.
Elliot: I'll do my best.
passages.content_zh:
艾略特：阿提克斯。你還活著。
阿提克斯：嗯... 又是你。
阿提克斯：你不是在檢查完畢後就前往卡特南了嗎？
艾略特：我在路上遇到了這個傭兵團。
艾略特：阿提克斯，聽起來誓約者們正被
虐待。
阿提克斯：嗯... 所以沒什麼新鮮事。
艾略特：至少，我想阻止另一個人遭受
那種待遇的機會。
阿提克斯：呵呵，你之前看起來確實是個好孩子。
阿提克斯：好吧，務必跟上。你現在的狀態
應該會有幫助。
艾略特：我會盡我所能。

passages.name: CH10 - Kara → Atticus
passages.content:
Kara: Mr. Atticus Ranasseur. It is good to meet you.
Atticus: Excuse me, young miss. Who might you be?
Kara: Kara Lyons, of the Cartenan Lyons household.
Atticus: I... cannot say I am aware of them.
Kara: Nor is there any need to be.

I've followed your work through the historical 
tellings of the Crusades and beyond.

I simply wish to say it is a pleasure to meet you
properly.
Atticus: Hmm...
Atticus: Ah, same in return, then.
Atticus: Though I wish it could be under better 
circumstances.
Kara: I will delight in the meeting regardless.
passages.content_zh:
卡拉：阿蒂克斯·拉塞爾先生。很高興認識你。
阿蒂克斯：對不起，年輕的小姐。你可能是誰？
卡拉：卡拉·萊昂斯，卡特南·萊昂斯家族的成員。
阿蒂克斯：我……不能說我知道他們。
卡拉：也沒有必要。

我一直在追尋你的工作歷史
十字軍東徵及其後的故事。

我只想說很高興認識你
正確地。
阿蒂克斯：嗯…
阿蒂克斯：啊，那麼同樣的回報。
阿蒂克斯：雖然我希望它能在更好的條件下
情況。
卡拉：無論如何，我都會很高興這次會面。

passages.name: CH10 - Jude → Reagyn
passages.content:
Reagyn: You! Prepare to fall, fiend!
Jude: Hmm...
Jude: Aren't you with the Crows?
Reagyn: ...
Reagyn: Yes?
Jude: So am I.
Jude: Well, now I am.
Reagyn: ...
Reagyn: Are you attempting to bamboozle me?
Jude: Attack me, if you like.
Jude: It's starting to feel like it'd be less of a pain if we
need to go through all this "switching sides" drama.
Reagyn: ...
Reagyn: I'll be watching you. Carefully.
Jude: Yay.
passages.content_zh:
Reagyn: 你！準備好墜落吧，惡徒！
Jude: 嗯...
Jude: 你不是烏鴉的人嗎？
Reagyn: ...
Reagyn: 是啊？
Jude: 我也是。
Jude: 嗯，現在是了。
Reagyn: ...
Reagyn: 你想唬弄我嗎？
Jude: 攻擊我吧，如果你想。
Jude: 感覺我們需要經歷這些「轉換陣營」的戲碼，還不如直接開打省事。
Reagyn: ...
Reagyn: 我會盯著你的。仔細地。
Jude: 耶。

passages.name: CH10 - Satia → Castel
passages.content:
Satia: Mr. Castel Balreig. I have a question.
Castel: Oh, so formal.
Castel: What does our fair Crow have for me today?
Satia: Anton. Pup.
Satia: How far are you from helping with this curse?
Castel: ...
Satia: You did experiments when we were in the 
Kingdom's capital, no?

Surely you have lead enough to mitigate it and give
peace of mind for a little bit.
Castel: ...No.
Castel: I wish I did. It would be a great help with my own
status.
Castel: But I've no intention to give up.
Satia: ...Alright.

...
Satia: Alright.
passages.content_zh:
莎提雅：卡斯提爾·巴爾雷格先生。我有個問題。
卡斯提爾：喔，這麼正式。
卡斯提爾：我們美麗的烏鴉今天有什麼指教？
莎提雅：安東。小狗。
莎提雅：你離能幫忙解除這個詛咒還有多遠？
卡斯提爾：...
莎提雅：我們在王國首都的時候，你不是做了實驗嗎？

你肯定有足夠的線索可以減輕它，讓人稍微安心一下吧。
卡斯提爾：...沒有。
卡斯提爾：我希望我有。那對我的地位會有很大的幫助。
卡斯提爾：但我沒打算放棄。
莎提雅：...好吧。

...
莎提雅：好吧。

passages.name: CH10 - Norde → Tatiana
passages.content:
Tatiana: Eh... So that Atticus guy. He's a taikolyn, yeah?
Working with the Covenant.
Norde: So it seems.
Norde: I am not distinctly aware of many, let alone all
crusaders...
Norde: Non-homlyns do receive the honor it seems.
Tatiana: Honor? Working with the Covenent of all things?
Tatiana: Seems more like a sellout to me.
Norde: ...

He is our ally. Treat him with respect.
Norde: At least for the time being. I am not here to tell 
you what to think, after all.
Tatiana: Hmph...
passages.content_zh:
塔蒂亞娜：呃...那個阿蒂克斯那個傢伙。他是太鼓林，是嗎？
與盟約一起工作。
諾德：看來是這樣。
Norde：我並不清楚很多，更不用說全部了
十字軍...
Norde：非霍林人似乎確實獲得了榮譽。
塔蒂亞娜：榮譽？與萬物聖約合作？
塔蒂亞娜：對我來說，這更像是一種背叛。
諾德：…

他是我們的盟友。尊重他。
Norde：至少目前是這樣。我不是來告訴你的
畢竟你會怎麼想。
塔蒂亞娜：哼…

passages.name: CH10 - Flynn → Otis
passages.content:
Flynn: So... the Covenant was hiding an Oathbreaker... so
close to the kingdom?
Otis: Heh. Expect it, lad.

That's what that lot does. All secrets and shit.
Flynn: But... so close to the kingdom.
Flynn: The empire theoretically could've grabbed it before
even attacking.
Otis: But they didn't.
Flynn: And... that's a good point. Why is that?
Otis: Eh, probably just isn't as useful as you'd think.

Shite is an Oathbreaker, not Zened himself.
Flynn: But isn't your... current state due to one?
Otis: Yeah, well, not all of 'em are gonna be like that.
Otis: They lock the things away cause they break the
Goddess's laws, not cause they all will break the
world.
Flynn: Right... that makes sense...
Flynn: Though, why do they want it now, then?
Otis: I really have no idea, lad.
passages.content_zh:
弗林：所以……星盟隱藏了一名破誓者……所以
離王國很近？
奧蒂斯：呵呵。期待吧，小伙子。

這就是那批人所做的。所有的秘密和狗屎。
Flynn：但是……距離王國如此之近。
弗林：理論上帝國本來可以抓住它
甚至攻擊。
奧蒂斯：但他們沒有。
Flynn：而且……這是一個很好的觀點。這是為什麼？
Otis：呃，可能只是沒有你想像的那麼有用。

希特是個破誓者，而不是澤尼德本人。
Flynn：但是你現在的狀態不是一個原因造成的嗎？
奧蒂斯：是的，好吧，並不是所有人都會這樣。
奧蒂斯：他們把東西鎖起來，因為他們破壞了
女神的法則，不是因為她們都會違反
世界。
弗林：對……有道理…
Flynn：那麼，他們為什麼現在想要它呢？
奧蒂斯：我真的不知道，小伙子。

passages.name: CH10 - New Event
passages.content:
Blood dripping to the ground, muffled footsteps
haphazardly sounded out from the wounded
warrior.
Defeated Soldier: *Pant*... *pant*...

Need to get back to... *pant*... camp...

I need to... Huh?
Jude: *Pant*...  *pant*...
Jude: Need to... fuck... this is a deeper wound than I
thought...
Jude: Huh...?
A sound from a distance caught his attention, and 
he slipped behind a nearby tree.
Soldier?: Here it is.
Other Soldier: Excellent.
A small trinket was handed from one to the other.
Other Soldier: I'll be sure to get this to our shared acquaintance.

Do you have an excuse prepared for why the 
Imperial garrison failed to get it?
Soldier?: Yes, that mercenary that was in charge. We'll place 
the blame on him.

By the time anyone confirms that it really was
retrieved, it'll be too late.
Defeated Soldier: W- What...?
*Snap*...!
Defeated Soldier: H- huh?!
Jude: What? Aren't those some of the soldiers from my
command...?
*Snap* ...!
Jude: ...?!
A twig snapped beneath his foot.
Soldier?: Hm? Is that...?
Other Soldier: Heh. Better take care of that loose end.
They turned to approach.
Defeated Soldier: W- Wait, I can... I can...!
Jude: *Pant* ... Crap... I don't stand a chance... in this
condition.

After all this bullshit... am I really gonna... like
this...?
Jude: F- Fuck it.... I...!
passages.content_zh:
鮮血滴落地面，沉悶的腳步聲
從受傷的戰士身上
漫無目的地響起。
戰敗士兵：*喘*... *喘*...

必須回到... *喘*... 營地...

我需要... 蛤？
裘德：*喘*... *喘*...
裘德：需要... 該死... 這傷口比我想像的還深...
裘德：蛤...?
遠處傳來的聲音引起了他的注意，
他躲到附近的一棵樹後。
士兵？：找到了。
其他士兵：太好了。
一個小飾品從一人手中交到另一人手中。
其他士兵：我一定會把它交給我們共同的熟人。

你有準備好藉口，解釋為什麼
帝國駐軍沒能拿到它嗎？
士兵？：有，那個負責的傭兵。我們會把
責任推到他身上。

等到有人確認它真的被
取回時，就太遲了。
戰敗士兵：怎、怎麼會...?
*喀嚓*...!
戰敗士兵：蛤、蛤？！
裘德：什麼？那些不是我
指揮下的士兵嗎...?
*喀嚓* ...!
裘德：...？！
他腳下踩斷了一根樹枝。
士兵？：嗯？那是...?
其他士兵：呵呵。最好解決掉那個麻煩。
他們轉身靠近。
戰敗士兵：等、等等，我可以... 我可以...!
裘德：*喘* ... 糟了... 我沒有勝算... 在這種
情況下。

經歷了這麼多鳥事... 我真的要... 這樣
結束了嗎...?
裘德：去他的.... 我...!

passages.name: CH10 - New Event
passages.content:
We Nightless Crows pushed forward through the
mountainous pass.
Once outside of the more treacherous path, we 
setup camp away from the well trodden trails.
Despite this, an inkling of danger became quite
clear...
There was strange movement by the imperial 
forces.
Strange movement that may indicate a play at...
Pup: ...a Vault?
Elliot: To the north, there is the Border Mountain Vault.

If there was a target in the area, it would be that.
Kara: To our north lies a Covenant Vault.

I am unaware of any other potential targets in the
area.
Pup: A Vault specifically being...?
Rowan: A Covenant stronghold.
Rowan: One with a dangerous treasure within...
Charlotte: An Oathbreaker, right?

Cainan... Kara's fiancé... He was a Covenant auditor,
right?
Elliot: Correct. I am his assistant in that endeavor.

We are the quality control for protection of
Oathbreakers. We check each Vault to ensure it is
secure.
Elliot: My recent visit did not indicate any issues... but an
army attacking, especially if they catch Atticus off
guard...
Kara: He is, indeed. He travels between Vaults and 
ensures they are secure.
Kara: Though, an army assault on a none- the-wiser Vault
is...
Pup: That means that they're protecting an Oathbreaker
there?
Pup: What... What sort of one? Is it like that... You 
know, the sword?
Kara: Not necessarily. There isn't a known limit to the
potential effects of an Oathbreaker.
Rowan: Like my own being a 'master key' of sorts.
Pup: Right...
Flynn: More importantly, it should be secure, correct? The
Covenant leaves no stone unturned to protect
Oathbreakers.
Norde: More importantly, is this Vault properly secured? I
can't imagine the Covenant would leave it without a
defender.
Elliot: The defensive mechanisms were operational when I
checked last.

And Atticus, the Guardian, was as diligent as the
protection plans expect of him.
Kara: Most likely they have it well maintained and with a
Guardian stationed there.
Norde: A Guardian... All Vaults have one, correct?
Pup: Guardian...? That sounds familiar.
Pup: (I've heard that before. It sounds familiar.)

(They're the people in charge the Vaults, I'd 
assume?)
Satia: Guardians are often recruited from heroes in the
Crusades to the east.

They... should be as strong of warriors as one could
hope to lead that effort.
Norde: Guardians are recruited from the heroes of the
Crusades.
Norde: Amongst them are the greatest warriors and 
heroes of our era.
Rowan: Yes, as the moniker Steel Wolf may imply, we've 
met... at least one.
Rowan: While he may not be a Guardian, he must be a 
Crusader of significant renown to earn that title.
Kara: At least two. My fiancé is called the "Azure Rook" at
times.
Pup: ...

And... the 'Storm Ram' would be another?
Satia: Where... did you hear that?
Norde: You've heard that name?
Pup: From... the Steel Wolf. He said it.
Pup: That's... my father, right? It was my father.
Norde: ...
Norde: Ivan Baranov. "The Storm Ram"
Norde: ...and former Covenant Guardian.
Pup: ...

(I thought so.)
Charlotte: ...
A silence fell over the group.
.........
Pup: Then we need to make sure this place is safe?
Pup: I mean... Imagine another thing like that sword out
there. Not an option we can allow.
Pup: (Yeah... if we're going to end this, then we can't 
have more of those in the hands of the enemy.)
Charlotte: Y- Yeah...

Between that and a potential ally, it makes sense 
to make a detour there.
Elliot: Then shall we move out?

We shall meet up with another guardian... 
The Ashen Fox.
Charlotte: Yeah, we can do this. We should start moving.

Let's head to the Vault and meet the Guardian that
protects it.
passages.content_zh:
我們不夜鴉奮勇前進
山口。
一旦走出更危險的路，我們
在遠離人跡罕至的步道的地方紮營。
儘管如此，危險的預兆還是變得​​相當明顯。
清楚...
帝國有奇怪的動作
力量。
奇怪的動作可能表明......
小狗：……避難所？
艾略特：北邊是邊境山地窖。

如果該地區有目標的話，那就是那個。
卡拉：我們的北邊有一個聖約金庫。

我不知道該領域還有其他潛在目標
區。
Pup：避難所具體是…？
羅文：聖約人據點。
羅文：一個體內藏著危險寶藏的人…
夏洛特：背誓者，對嗎？

該南……卡拉的未婚夫……他是聖約審計員，
對嗎？
艾略特：正確。我是他在這項工作中的助手。

我們是品質管制的保障
違背誓言的人。我們檢查每個金庫以確保它是
安全。
艾利歐特：我最近的訪問沒有表明任何問題......但是
軍隊進攻，特別是如果他們抓住阿迪克斯
守衛...
卡拉：他確實是。他在避難所之間旅行
確保它們是安全的。
卡拉：不過，軍隊襲擊了一個不明智的避難所
是…
Pup：這表示他們正在保護一個背誓者
在那裡？
小狗：什麼……什麼樣的？是這樣嗎……你
知道嗎，劍？
卡拉：不一定。沒有已知的限制
背誓者的潛在影響。
羅文：就像我自己是一把「萬能鑰匙」一樣。
小狗：對啊…
Flynn：更重要的是，它應該是安全的，對嗎？的
盟約不遺餘力地保護
違背誓言的人。
Norde：更重要的是，這個金庫的安全措施是否正確？我
無法想像聖約會在沒有
後衛。
艾略特：當我
最後檢查。

守護者阿迪克斯和守護者一樣勤奮
保護計劃對他寄予厚望。
卡拉：很可能他們維護得很好並且有
守護者駐守在那裡。
Norde：守護者……所有避難所都有一個，對嗎？
小狗：顧

passages.name: CH10 - New Event
passages.content:
The travel was not lengthy, and we approached 
the hidden Vault.
Soldier: ...
Otis: Ugh... They did come this way.
Rowan: Imperial soldiers.
Charlotte: Yeah... Are they doing patrols?
Kara: Ah... So you are recognizing militaristic patterns 
now? That is a good skill to have.
Charlotte: Y- Yeah...?
Charlotte: It's just a matter of experience.
Pup: The patrol seems stationary.
Norde: That, or they are segmenting their coverage.
Kara: In an area this isolated, would they be able to 
sustain that cadence?
Pup: I mean... if they have enough people, then sure.
Rowan: Or if they have any beasties to cover the gaps.
Rowan: Not a dragon in sight... yet.
Pup: They're not gonna have a dragon... again...
Pup: (No, that'd be crazy...)
Reagyn: Assuming the dragon didn't stop here.
Norde: Assuming the dragon's retreat didn't lead it here.
Our conversation stalled.
.........
Rowan: A patrol means they're organized and here with intent.
Kara: Yes. That is true, Alexei.

Meaning they're executing an operation, or... have
already done so.
Charlotte: We should hurry.
Kara: Despite us acting as a scouting unit ahead of the 
other Crows...

We'd be best served to get through the holes in 
the patrol by splitting up.
Norde: Are you sure? This is a heavily forested area.
Norde: The poor sightlines stand out. As though the 
location was chosen... or designed... for that 
purpose.
Norde motioned to the trees, and a brief look did 
make it clear that seeing anything from a distance 
would be difficult.
It was a big part of why we could get as close as 
we did without the Imperial troops detecting us.
Norde: I would doubt anyone's ability to improvise should
things not go to plan here.
Pup: Then, our patron Ms. Stewart...

How do you want to approach this? How should 
we split up?
Charlotte: Oh, that'd b- be simple.
Charlotte: I...
Charlotte fidgeted around.
Charlotte: Wait, maybe...
Her hand had landed on her pack, and slipped in to 
pull out something I had not seen before.
Charlotte: How about this baby?
Rowan: Ah, yes. Truly a marvel you have there~
Pup: ...
Pup: Why do you have that?
Rowan: Or... a more appropriate question. What is it?
Charlotte: It- It's a flare gun.
Charlotte: You see, it gets loaded with mini-red magic
incendiaries that-
Kara: It'll work.
Kara: What about splitting up?
Charlotte: ...

Kara, I... shall delegate to you.
Norde: Delegating that choice is wise.
Kara: I do have an approach in mind...
passages.content_zh:
旅程並不漫長，我們接近了隱藏的寶庫。
士兵: ...
奧提斯: 呃... 他們確實往這邊來了。
羅文: 帝國士兵。
夏洛特: 耶... 他們在巡邏嗎？
卡拉: 啊... 所以妳現在能辨識軍事模式了？這是個很棒的技能。
夏洛特: 呃... 是嗎...?
夏洛特: 這只是經驗問題。
小狗: 巡邏隊似乎是靜止的。
諾德: 要不就是他們在分割他們的覆蓋範圍。
卡拉: 在這麼偏遠的地區，他們能夠維持這種節奏嗎？
小狗: 我是說... 如果他們有足夠的人手，那當然可以。
羅文: 或者他們有任何野獸來填補空隙。
羅文: 還沒看到龍... 至少現在還沒。
小狗: 他們不會有龍的... 再次...
小狗: (不，那太瘋狂了...)
瑞根: 假設龍沒有在這裡停下來。
諾德: 假設龍的撤退沒有引導牠到這裡。
我們的對話停滯了。
.........
羅文: 巡邏意味著他們是有組織且有目的而來的。
卡拉: 是的。沒錯，阿列克謝。

意味著他們正在執行一項行動，或者... 已經執行過了。
夏洛特: 我們應該趕快。
卡拉: 儘管我們是走在其他烏鴉前面的偵察部隊...

我們最好分開行動，穿過巡邏隊的漏洞。
諾德: 妳確定嗎？這裡是一片茂密的森林。
諾德: 不良的視線非常明顯。彷彿這個地點是為了這個目的而選擇... 或設計的...。
諾德朝樹木示意，簡單一看就能清楚地發現，從遠處看到任何東西都很困難。
這也是為什麼我們能夠在帝國軍隊沒有發現我們的情況下，盡可能靠近的原因。
諾德: 我懷疑如果事情沒有按計劃進行，有人能夠即興應變。
小狗: 那麼，我們的贊助人史都華女士...

妳想如何處理？我們應該如何分開？
夏洛特: 喔，那很簡-簡單。
夏洛特: 我...
夏洛特不安地扭動著。
夏洛特: 等等，也許...
她的手落在了她的背包上，並滑進去拿出了一些我以前沒見過的東西。
夏洛特: 如何啊

passages.name: CH10 - New Event
passages.content:
Splitting into multiple groups, I found myself with a
few familiar faces.
The plan was straightforward.
We'd each approach from different directions and 
use the flare gun to coordinate our attack.
Outside of our advanced party...

The other Crows were securing an escape route in 
case things went south quickly, along with stealthily 
thinning out the patrols.
Deliberately, we made our way to our designated 
spot.
Pup: Guard is at 5 o'clock.

If we're right about the timing, he'll move in...
5...4...3...2...

Go.
We each shuffled as stealthily as we could through 
the thick forest.
Otis: We movin'. Not a sign of the next one.
Crow: No sign of a new patrol yet.
Pup: Good. Let's not stop here.
We weaved deliberately for a while longer, keeping
track of our foot placements to make sure we
were headed in the right direction.
Crow: And... adjust now.
Pup: ...
Rowan: So... Pup... you are ready for this, yes?
Pup: Yes.
Rowan: Well, when it was mentioned that your father was 
a Guardian, I thought that maybe...
Pup: H- Hey Elliot. I was meaning to ask you something.
Rowan: ...
Elliot: Yes?
Pup: How do you transform yourself when you're fighting?
Pup: No one is making a big deal out of THAT, but 
you're literally changing entirely.
Elliot: Ah, my gray magic?
Elliot: It isn't... anything uniquely complicated.
Elliot: It is gray magic. Which is a combination of red, 
blue, and green magic.

The Covenant teaches that the prayers of our 
ancestors are held deep within our heirlooms...
Elliot: And you can use the three branches of magic to 
create an echo of that lineage to envelop yourself 
in it.
From the energy of red magic, the divine 
manifestations of blue, and the creation nature of 
green magic...
You can extend that legacy to face the challenges 
of today.
Rowan: And such an act transforms you into a woman?
Elliot: ...

Yes.
Rowan: Well, it is a blessing of your familial heritage, so
perhaps you can indulge in-
Elliot: A- And to answer a likely additional question...
Elliot: No, not all heirlooms can do this. Each heirlooms 
holds potential for a set of red, blue, or green 
magic.
Many only have one, let alone all three.
Pup: R- Right.
I kept my eyes forward, but I nodded a slight 
thanks towards Elliot.
Pup: Actually, what's that over there?
Pup: Shouldn't I be asking you that about your first time
back here in the empire?
Rowan: ...
Rowan: I suppose the reality hasn't entirely settled in, that
is true.
Rowan: Mayhap it because I am not familiar with this
mountainous region?
Rowan: Or, to the contrary, because...
As I was turned away, I felt a lingering gaze from
Rowan.
Rowan: No... I don't believe... Perhaps...
Pup: W- What?
Rowan: You said you had a sibling, correct?
Pup: Ah... Well, I may have...
Pup: Oh wait, w- what's that?
Tatiana: That the place?

Yeah, that's gotta be it.
Crow: That is our target, there in the distance.
We exited to the final perimeter before the facility.
Our group would need to hide here until we saw the
signal.
Rowan: Hmm...
Pup: ...

Have you heard any signs of an ongoing fight?
Crow: Negative.

But given it's a Vault, it could be soundproofed 
better than the normal fortress.
Pup: Hmm...
I leaned back into my hiding place.
Pup: (No sign of a battle so far...)

(That could mean a great situation or a worst case
scenario.)

(The patrols were still cycling, so...)
Rowan: Then this curse...

You are confident is not still weakening you?
Rowan: After seeing the fight with the dragon and since, 
there is certainly a risk best not ignored.
Pup: ...
I kept my eyes scanning the horizon.
Pup: Forget about it. Just treat me as I am, a girl.

I'm not letting myself use it as an excuse anymore.

And... It'd be even worse if its distracting you all,
as well.
My hand fell down to my sword hilt.
Soldier: ...?
We went silent as a patrol passed by our hiding 
place.
..........
Crow: Based on the previous routes, the opening is in...
three minutes.
Pup: Pass the confirmation back to the rear line support
unit. We have a straight shot from here.
Rowan: Hmm...

Mayhap... it is for the best that you are 
approaching it as such.
Otis: It ain't fixing shit.
Pup: (What...?)
Crow: I- I'll go and relay the data, then.
The Nightless Crow silently head back along our 
path.
Otis: Eh, not like I'm sayin' you're doing a bad thing.
Otis: Not sure what else ya can do but just accept it and
move on.
Otis: Just ain't gonna fix shit.
Rowan: Ah... My fairest Otis, this isn't the time to be that
forceful about it...
Pup: I'm not trying to fix it.

...

(Two minutes...)
I tried to keep the timer going in my head as we
talked.
Pup: So long as it stops being a distraction, that is what I
want.
Otis: Then be careful lassie.
Pup: (Two fifteen... two seventeen...)
Otis: If ya do find a way to kill it in its tracks, it may
just shift targets.
Pup: W- What?
Rowan: As the Pup said... what do you mean?
Otis: Ya know, I figured once I got over hatin' the neko 
lot that it'd stop.

I thought it did, for a time...

But... lately I've been feeling like I can't hold my
drink like I used to.
Pup: ...
Pup: Huh?
Rowan: Your alcohol tolerance... has diminished...?

Are you sure it wasn't because of your smaller 
stature?
Otis: Woouldn't it of hit me before recently, then?!
Pup: ...
I felt like I was getting pulled into their
conversation.
Pup: (Just ignore it... I need to focus.)
Otis: Nah, nah... this feels like the curse again.

Maybe it's not hittin' as hard, but...
Pup: (Two... uh... fifty...?)
Rowan: Are you quite sure...?
Otis: Aye, but maybe it don't matter.
Otis: I only gained when I mellowed out, despite the
situation. Best to leave it be if that's the Pup's
wish.
Rowan: Hmm...
Rowan: Mayhap ignoring it is for the best.
Pup: *Sigh* ...
Crow: I- I'll go and relay the data, then.
The Nightless Crow silently head back along our path.
Rowan: Do not mistake my concern for lack of faith.
Rowan: By my words, I intend to convey that your 
approach is ideal.

This curse eats away at your sense of self, fighting
against it.
Rowan: By all means, ignoring it may slow it the most...
Pup: ...

(Two minutes...)
I tried to keep the timer going in my head as we
talked.
Pup: Exactly. You get what I'm thinking.
Pup: Just... leave it be.
Pup: I could name many things more important to focus on.
Rowan: I- Indeed...
Rowan: ...
Pup: (Two... fifty...?)
Rowan: ...
Rowan: I will try my utmost.

Mayhap it be like watching my own family change 
before my eyes at time, but... I will attempt to-
Pup: (Could you just...!)
Pup: (Wait, was that... three minutes?)
Pup: Move...!
I moved from the hiding spot...!
Pup: ...?!
Soldier: ...

Wait, who are...
As I jumped out, I stumbled into a patrol.
Pup: Ah... Uh...
Rowan: ...?!
Rowan was about to instinctively jump towards me, 
but another pulled him back.
Who are you? Are you from the facility?
Pup: I... well...
Pup: (Think of something...!)

(He sees... a girl, right?)

(Maybe...)
[Choice]: Act like I’m a lost girl / Try to charm the guard / Act like a mercenary for hire
Pup: H- Hey, Mister...

I- I was... I think I'm lost...?
I shrunk down a little as I said it, and I raised my
voice as though it was about to break.
Soldier: Lost? What are you doing out here?
Pup: I don't know. I was with family and... a day ago, 
I...

Sir, could you get one of your supervisors out here? 
I think...  *Sniff* ...
Soldier: I mean... I can't just.. I... Maybe I can... can...

Wait.

Why do you have a sword?
Pup: ...
Pup: ...
Pup: Fuck it.
My hand lowered to my sword.
Pup: Rowan!
Rowan: R- Right!
Soldier: Argh!
Pup: Pant
...
Pup: Sigh
...
Rowan: Excellent work~
Rowan: Though those acting skills...
Pup: Oh, f- finally~
Pup: I've been looking for you all day.
Soldier: W- What? Who are you?
Pup: Didn't the commander tell you?
Pup: He gave us permission to have...
Pup: To have a... romantic... date...?
Soldier: ...What?
Pup: D- Do you wanna touch my boob?!
Soldier: ...Lady, I'm gonna need to ask you to come with me.
Pup: Hahaha... But... don't you want to...
Pup: ...
Pup: Fuck it! You should've just taken the deal!
My hand lowered to my sword.
Pup: Rowan!
Rowan: R- Right!
Soldier: Argh!
Pup: *Pant* ...
Pup: *Sigh* ...
Rowan: Excellent work~
Rowan: Though the offer to touch your breast...
Pup: There you are.

Head back to camp. I've been directed to take 
over your patrol.
Soldier: Uh... What? Who are you?
Pup: One of the mercenaries your company picked up in 
the capital.
Pup: The commander wanted to talk to you, so they 
sent me to cover.
Soldier: I... Why would the commander want to talk?
Pup: Something about a pay discrepancy, I think.
Soldier: W- What? At now of all times?

It's not like we're in the capital. We out here in the
middle of-

Wait, we didn't go to the capital.
Pup: I... didn't say which capital?
Pup: *Sigh* ... It was always gonna come to this.
Pup: Fuck it...
My hand lowered to my sword.
Pup: Rowan!
Rowan: R- Right!
Soldier: Argh!
Pup: *Pant* ...
Pup: *Sigh* ...
Rowan: Excellent work~
Rowan: Though it does make me wonder if you've been to 
the imperial capital, in reality?
Pup: Not the time.

 
Even more not the time than before.
Pup: *Sigh* ... Seriously. Just focus on the mission. I 
beg of you.
Rowan: Yes, of course. Mayhap I had gotten too 
comfortable with the idea of being on a battlefield.
My shoulders slouched.
I just wanted to forget about this curse for once.
Crow: Anton, sir- Or uh, ma'am. I just got back from the
line. They-

Wait, what happened here?
Pup: Uh...
Pup: We may have a more limited time frame to start 
the assault.
Elliot: Then should we move immediately into the Vault?
Rowan: Apologies, but might that mean we need to find another
hiding place?
Pup: We should probably just start our assault on the 
Vault.
Pup: Charlotte mentioned that 'flare' thing, but the 
others were right. We'll probably not see a signal.
Pup: This forces our hand, so we should-
Pup: ...?!
A streak of brilliant red filled the blue sky.
Flickering and sparkling, it traveled from the other
side of the vault and over our heads.
Pup: W- What was that?!
Pup: It isn't the dragon, is it?!
Rowan: No.

It was the signal.
Otis: Ah, we be ready to take some heads, then?
Pup: Right... we need to move.

Now.
Pup: Really...?
Pup: Then... we need to move.

Now.
passages.content_zh:
分成多個小組，我發現自己有一個
幾個熟悉的面孔。
這個計劃很簡單。
我們各自從不同的方向接近並
使用信號槍來協調我們的攻擊。
在我們先進黨之外...

其他烏鴉正在確保逃生路線
情況很快就惡化了，而且悄悄地
減少巡邏。
我們特意前往指定地點
現貨。
Pup：警衛在 5 點鐘方向。

如果我們的時間安排得當的話，他就會搬進去…
5...4...3...2...

走吧。
我們每個人都盡可能偷偷地拖著腳步走過
茂密的森林。
奧蒂斯：我們要出發了。沒有下一個跡象。
Crow：還沒有新巡邏隊的跡象。
小狗：好。我們不要停在這裡。
我們故意編織了一段時間，保留
追蹤我們的腳的位置，以確保我們
我們正朝著正確的方向前進。
Crow：然後……現在就調整。
小狗：…
羅文：所以……小狗……你準備好了，是嗎？
小狗：是的。
羅文：嗯，當有人提到你父親是
守護者，我想也許…
小狗：H-嘿艾略特。我本來想問你一件事。
羅文：…
艾略特：是嗎？
Pup：打架的時候你會如何改變自己？
Pup：沒有人會小題大作，但是
你真的徹底改變了。
艾略特：啊，我的灰魔法？
Elliot：這並不是……什麼特別複雜的事。
艾略特：這是灰魔法。這是紅色的組合，
藍色和綠色魔法。

聖約教導說，我們的祈禱
祖先深深地藏在我們的傳家寶裡…
艾略特：你可以使用魔法的三個分支
創造一種血統的迴響來包圍你自己
在其中。
來自紅色魔法的能量，神聖
藍色的表現形式以及創造本質
綠色魔法...
您可以延續這項傳統來應對挑戰
今天的。
羅文：這樣的行為會讓你變成一個女人嗎？
艾略特：…

是的。
羅文：嗯，這是你家族遺傳的祝福，所以
也許你可以沉迷於——
Elliot：A- 並回答一個可能的附加問題...
艾爾

passages.name: CH10 - New Event
passages.content:
Atticus: ...
Soldier: Argh!
Pup: That's...  *pant*... I think that's all of them?
Kara: At least amongst those that did not flee...

We should reinitiate contact with the rest of the 
Crows to see how well our net caught those in 
retreat.
As Kara said the words, the stone faced man 
turned towards us.
Atticus: ...
Norde: ...
Norde: I will reconnect with the rest of the Crows, then.
Norde stepped away, but the space he occupied 
was not long left unattended.
Atticus: Hmm...
A tall older man stepped towards us, towering 
above me.
He was clearly taikolyn, with scales like I had seen 
on Norde, including a beard like formation of them.
Most strikingly...
Elliot: Atticus Ranasseur. Guardian of the Border Mountain
Vault and Ashen Fox of the Crusades...
Atticus: The Covenant's man... Elliot, was it?
Elliot: It seems we were in time to help.
Charlotte: So you're this Vault's Guardian? I've heard about you
lot.
Atticus: Hmm...

Atticus. Atticus Ranasseur.
Charlotte: Please to meet you. I'm happy we made it in time.
Atticus: Hmm... I thank you for it.
I could see it through the swaying strands of hair
across his face...
A stone eye.
Pup: H- Hello...
Based on the movement of his body and what I 
could see, it looked like the better part of his  
right side was turned to stone.
Charlotte: Hello. I am Charlotte Stewart of the city state of
Lockhart.
Mariel: I'm Mariel Stewart, of the same.
Charlotte: The others with me are the Nightless Crow mercenary
company.
Atticus: Including him?
A familiar yet unfamiliar man walked up 
alongside us.
Jude: ...
Atticus's hand leaned onto his hilt.
Jude: *Sigh*... the battle's over. Could you calm down?
Charlotte: Why is... he here? And alive?
Pup: Uh... I might have made an offer?
Pup: Y- You know mercenaries can be bought, right?
Charlotte: ...

How much?
Jude: I'm not a cheap date.
Charlotte: Mmm...
Pup: Haha... hahaha...
Atticus: And your loyalties?
Jude: Never had any loyalty to them. I'm from the 
Emerald Empire.
Atticus: Normally being from the 'Oathless Empire' would be
reason enough for me to cut you down.
Jude: A fitting statment from a former crusader...
Emphasis on the "former".
Atticus: ...
Jude: ...
Charlotte: I'm not gonna pay you if you start a fight.
Jude: What did I do?
Rowan: Attempt to kill us on multiple occasions~
Jude: *Sigh*...
Jude rubbed the back of his neck wearily.
Atticus: ...
Atticus: Hmph. Not bad.
Atticus: I think he's sincere.
Jude: This is out of my paygrade.
Without another word, Jude casually walked off.
Jude: Gotta be... a kitchen around here... somewhere...
...and mumbled just within earshot before 
disappearing into the facility.
Atticus: Many unfamiliar faces amongst you.
Pup: We... normally operate out of Rabaneau.
Atticus: Hmm...
Atticus: Understood.

My thanks, once more, to you all.
The group fell silent with some indistinct nods of
affirmation in response.
Atticus: That's that, then.
Charlotte: So, uh... I was wondering if we could talk about my
mission.
Atticus: First things first, I need to check on the Vault.
Atticus turned and slowly stepped towards the 
Vault door.
Atticus: Now... I just need to do this and...
Atticus: Now... I just-
Atticus: ...?!
Charlotte: Are you okay?
Atticus: Ah... nothing too bad. No need to worry.

I must simply be still feeling the strikes from that
fight before.
Charlotte: I could help-
Atticus: No, I need to.
Back towards our group, I leaned over to the 
others.
Pup: Why is... Why is his body like that?
Kara: The stone?
Pup: Yeah.
Rowan: I imagine it must be the Oathbreaker, no?
Pup: Could they really do-
I looked down at myself.
Pup: I guess so.
Pup: Is he not protected from it? Why would the 
Covenant station people here if they're not?
Kara: Eul'dusa. I believe that was the name I read in the
files.
Rowan: Does our big sister have the details already memorized?
Kara: An item that grants wishes, of a sort.

At the very least, it appeared to shift the nature of
luck in the favor of the wish.
Kara: Though, the closer one gets to that wish, the more
their body petrifies.
Pup: Really...?
I looked back to the Vault Door.
Atticus: And... there.
Atticus: ...
He entered the heavily fortified room 
and then towards the alter within.
Secured within it...
Atticus: Good.

I can rest easy.
Atticus returned from the dark of the vault.
Atticus: Now, to the second most important task.
Charlotte: ...
Kara: ...
Pup: ...
..........
Atticus: Would you like to stay for supper?
We took up the old Guardian on his offer.
Collecting the Crows, we split out forces with the
locals of the Vault to clean up the site and prepare 
a meal for all.
Due to the size of the group, a bonfire type meal 
was planned.
Charlotte: A bonfire~
Rowan: Shall I sing a song?
Charlotte: Abso-fucking-lutely not.
From the line to get our meals, I watched as 
Charlotte and Rowan were carefree around 
the flames.
Pup: Should we really be doing this?
Pup: We're still being chased.
Norde: Maybe...
Norde: We did make good time. And we are at a Vault 
that they would not expect us to go to.
Norde: I... imagine that should give enough pause to allow
this.
Norde: Though, at the heart of it, the bigger concern is...
Norde: Why did they attack this Vault?
Charlotte: I mean... for the Oathbreaker, right?
Rowan: You suspect foul play of some sort?
Charlotte: How about you? Am I paying you enough to talk?
Jude: Sure, but they didn't pay me enough to tell me 
why.

Our orders were to retrieve it and deliver it to a
specified location.
Kara: That location being...?
Jude: Southeast of here. It was a nondescript 
drop off location.
Kara: Hmm... So more parties could be involved...
Norde: My concern more heavily involves the timing.
Flynn: That's what I was thinking, too.
Flynn: Like... why attack after the invasion?

If the goal is to steal an Oathbreaker to use it, then
you'd do it before attacking Cartenan...
Kara: As in, the fact that it comes after the invasion of 
the Kingdom?

If they were to steal it to use it... then yes that
would have been more advantageous.
Charlotte: Hmm... But it IS still an Oathbreaker. They're not
going to use it as a paperweight.
Kara: Yes, the question becomes of what purpose that it 
could still serve that it did not serve before.
Charlotte: Hmm...
Pup: ...
My eyes wandered over to the circle of Charlotte, 
Kara, Norde, and others.
Pup: (They're probably talking strategy. Maybe I should 
go over anyways?)
I had just sat down with meal in hand.
Pup: (Charlotte just said to get my food and relax a bit. I
could do that in their discussion?)
Pup: ...
Pup: *Sigh*... No, she'd probably just shoot me with the
flare gun.
I looked back down to my food, fork lightly 
poking at the sustenance.
As I pieced out a bite with the fork, the heat and
aroma spilled out and made my surroundings feel 
like a blanket.
Pup: ...
Pup: ...
I took a bite, and I savored the 
home wrought flavors.
Pup: (I... didn't expect Atticus to be here with his
wife...)
My eyes drifted up to look around.
The halls we fought in felt transformed just from 
the atmosphere alone.
Even the otherwise foreboding sight of the Vault 
door felt more cozy than before.
Pup: ...
My eyes lingered on that Vault door.
The aroma of my meal seemed to block out my 
other senses.
Pup: .........
Like bristles in the edge of my mind...
An image of a similar door.
But from a lower perspective.
A image of wonder and curiosity.
.......
Anton.
I turned.
Estella: There you are.
Estella: You know you're not supposed to be over here.
She lowered herself and took my hand in her own.
Estella: Now, where is Nikolai?

Were you two acting out one of my stories again?
And she started to pull me forward.
Step by step.
Step... by...
My head turned towards the sound.
Pup: ...?
My eyes focused in on some shrubbery along the 
wall.
Pup: (Did I hear something?)

(Or... maybe...?)

.........
Mariel: Pup... there you are.
Pup: Oh... Mariel.
My head whipped back from the sound.
Mariel: You got some of the food before it ran out. That's
good~
Pup: Did they run out?
Mariel: No, but it smells so good that I can't imagine 
anyone not wanting seconds.
Mariel: If I learn how to cook properly, I'll have to learn
this one, too.
Charlotte: So that's where you ended up.
Pup: Oh... Charlotte.
My head whipped back from the sound.
Charlotte: You resting properly?
Pup: Of course.
Charlotte: Because you've not done any real relaxation outside 
of sleep since Cartenan...
Pup: I- I know. I know I need to take the opportunity 
to relax to stay in my top form.
Charlotte: Hmm...
I could only chuckle softly.
Alongside her was Satia.
Satia: Mmm~

What a wonderful blend of flavors.
She was nibbling at her meal even as she entered 
the scene.
Pup: It seems a lot of people like the food today.
Pup: Well, never ask me to cook for the Crows again if
that's our new standard.
Satia: Oh, you could learn to cook it.
Satia: I'd love a 'Pup version' of this dish~
Satia: You can have some of mine if it'll help you 
memorize how it should taste.
Satia picked up her fork and guided it towards me.
Pup: ...
Pup: *Sigh*...
Satia: *Giggle* ...
Both of them sat down next to me.
With much hesitation, she sat down next to me.
For my own part, I sliced off another bite 
from my own dish and savored the taste 
again.
Mariel: You... look like you're feeling better.
Pup: Thanks.
Mariel: Are there... any aches or pains?

Maybe I should conduct another health checkup? 
Has anything changed since then?
Charlotte: You look better than before.
Pup: Thanks...
Charlotte: You can thank me. Great leader Charlotte saves the 
day.
Pup: ...
Charlotte: Or... not? Are you okay? Should we get you 
another check-up?
Pup: I'm fine...
Pup: I'd think you'd understand that being a girl isn't a
medical emergency.
Satia: Well, it has its moments.
Satia put her plate down to her side, and leaned 
over to set her head on my shoulder as though 
she was going to take a nap.
Satia: Just...
Comfortably nuzzled up against me, her words 
were both soft and clear to me.
Satia: Just let me know if it ever is.

I'll always be here for you.
Pup: ...
Pup: You really shouldn't worry about me that much. 
Aren't you getting a bit old for the big sister bit?
Satia: Don't be selfish. I'll love you no matter how much 
you want to resist it.
Pup: *Sigh*...
Mariel: We all just want to help.
Mariel: We can only imagine how strange and scary what 
you've gone through is...
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte: Well, sometimes you got to take care of others so 
they take care of themselves.
Pup: I...
A slight silence fell over us.
Pup: I just want to do what needs to be done.

I just... want to focus on what's actually important.
Pup: Just... can we talk about literally anything else?
Mariel: Well...
.........
Mariel: I guess... Norde said something about your father 
being a Guardian like Atticus.
Mariel: Have you ever been to one of these Vaults? Like 
how Atticus's wife is here with him.
Charlotte: Hmm... Well, there was one thing.
Charlotte: Atticus has got his family here. If your father was a
Guardian, was that before your time, or...?
Pup: ...

I can't say I know.
Pup: Norde probably knows better. You can ask him if-
Atticus: A Guardian, you say?
Atticus: Of what Vault?
Atticus had entered the scene and seated himself 
into a relaxed position.
Atticus had entered the scene and gingerly seated
himself into a relaxed position, protecting his injury
from the battle.
Pup: No idea. It's news to me.
Atticus: Hmm...
Satia: I cannot say I know that much myself.
Satia: ...
Without moving her head, Satia's eyes shifted over 
in my direction.
I took a bite of the dish, avoiding eye contact and
distracting myself with the food.
Mariel: Well, Pup's father was named Ivan, right?
Mariel: Ivan... Baranov? Yeah, that sounds right.
Atticus: ...Baranov?
Mariel: Y- yes, sir... Pup is 'Anton Baranov'...
Charlotte: The extent that I know is that his name was Ivan
Baranov and he ran the Nightless Crows.
Atticus: ...Baranov?
Charlotte: Yeah? Is there something wrong with that.
Pup: ...
Atticus: You are... Ivan Baranov's child? The Storm Ram's child?
Pup: ...Yeah.
Atticus: Hmm...

That's...

That's good.
Pup: What?
Satia: Did you know Ivan?
Pup: You're talking as if you knew him...
Atticus: Well, we only met the once... and I heard of his
exploits in the crusades...

But there were... rumors. Claims, as it were.
Atticus: Seeing the Storm Ram's child is in good health is a
calming thought in light of that, though.
Mariel: Rumors? How would that be related to Pup here?
Charlotte: Rumors? What does that mean?
Atticus: Oh, it must've been... over a decade ago.
Atticus: A rumor went around that an Oathbreaker had 
been stolen from the Crekskia Vault...
Atticus: ...stolen by the Guardian who protected it.
Mariel: A Guardian... Are you implying that that Guardian
was...
Charlotte: A Guardian... meaning that Guardian was...
Atticus: ...Ivan Baranov, yes. The Storm Ram.
Atticus: The only official word I heard was that the Vault 
was closing indefinitely.
Atticus: More... morbidly beyond that... the rumor had 
another element it. It wasn't just that he had 
stolen it, but...
Atticus: ...they said he killed his entire family in the process
of doing so.
Mariel: ...
Charlotte: ...
Satia: ...
Pup: ...
My hand had held still for a while. I wasn't even
pretending that I could focus on eating.
Atticus: It gives my heart some calm and peace to see his child
alive and well.
Atticus: It is good... to see that rumor was just a rumor.
Mariel: Hey... Pup...? Is this... something you already knew
about?
Charlotte: Hmm... Mind if I ask if you already knew about this?
Pup: ...

...No.
My hand gripped my fork tighter to the point of
it having a slight shaking motion.
Pup: This is all... news to me. I hadn't heard any of it
before.

My father never really talked about the past.

And my memories of when I was really young are... 
bits and pieces, at best.
Atticus: Hmm...
Atticus: Well, try to take solace in that you being here 
proves it was a rumor.
Pup: ...Does it?

You said something happened at this Vault, right?
Atticus: True. I've never seen the truth of it for myself.

Hmm...
Atticus himself moved his good arm over to the
petrified one, and he rubbed it a little as he 
became contemplative.
Atticus: You know... Crekskia won't likely be too far outside 
of your path.
Pup: ...?
Rowan: It is true.
Rowan slipped into our circle, as though he was
listening the whole time.
Rowan: Crekskia is a small northern village here in the
empire.

If we wish to go to Rabaneau without getting near 
the imperial capital, then it would be near our ideal 
path.
Atticus: Indeed.

So... if you wish to pursue the truth of it...

...that... that will be your chance.
Pup: ...I...
Pup: I...
passages.content_zh:
Atticus: ...
士兵: 呃啊！
小狗: 這... *喘氣*... 我想這就是全部了吧？
卡拉: 至少在那些沒有逃跑的之中...

我們應該重新與其他的
烏鴉們聯繫，看看我們的網子抓住了多少
撤退的人。
卡拉說完，那張面無表情的臉
轉向了我們。
Atticus: ...
諾德: ...
諾德: 那麼，我會重新與其他的烏鴉們聯繫。
諾德離開了，但他所佔據的空間
並沒有空置太久。
Atticus: 嗯...
一個高大的年長男子走向我們，高聳
在我之上。
他顯然是泰科林人，有著像我在
諾德身上看到的鱗片，包括像鬍鬚一樣的鱗片。
最引人注目的是...
艾略特: 阿提克斯·拉納瑟爾。邊境山脈
寶庫的守護者，以及十字軍東征的灰燼狐狸...
Atticus: 盟約的人... 艾略特，是嗎？
艾略特: 看來我們及時趕來幫忙了。
夏洛特: 所以你是這個寶庫的守護者？我聽說過你們
這群人。
Atticus: 嗯...

阿提克斯。阿提克斯·拉納瑟爾。
夏洛特: 很高興認識你。我很高興我們及時趕到。
Atticus: 嗯... 我感謝你們。
我可以透過他臉上搖曳的髮絲
看到...
一顆石化的眼睛。
小狗: 嗨...
根據他身體的移動和我所
能看到的，他右半邊的大部分
都變成了石頭。
夏洛特: 你好。我是洛克哈特城邦的
夏洛特·史都華。
瑪麗埃爾: 我是瑪麗埃爾·史都華，也是同一個地方的。
夏洛特: 和我在一起的其他人是無夜烏鴉傭兵
團。
Atticus: 包括他？
一個熟悉又陌生的人走到了
我們身邊。
裘德: ...
阿提克斯的手按在了他的劍柄上。
裘德: *嘆氣*... 戰鬥結束了。你能冷靜下來嗎？
夏洛特: 為什麼... 他在這裡？而且還活著？
小狗: 呃... 我可能提出了個提議？
小狗: 你- 你知道傭兵是可以被買的，對吧？
夏洛特: ...

多少錢？
裘德: 我可不是個廉價的約會對象。
夏洛特: 嗯...
小狗: 哈哈... 哈哈哈...
Atticus: 還有你的忠誠？
裘德: 從來沒有對他們有任何忠誠。我來自
翡翠帝國。
Atticus: 通常來

passages.name: CH10 - New Event
passages.content:
Blood dripping to the ground, muffled footsteps
haphazardly sounded out from the wounded
warrior.
Defeated Soldier: *Pant*... *pant*...

Need to get back to... *pant*... camp...

I need to... Huh?
Jude: *Pant*...  *pant*...
Jude: Need to... fuck... this is a deeper wound than I
thought...
Jude: Huh...?
A sound from a distance caught his attention, and 
he slipped behind a nearby tree.
Soldier?: Here it is.
Other Soldier: Excellent.
A small trinket was handed from one to the other.
Other Soldier: I'll be sure to get this to our shared acquaintance.

Do you have an excuse prepared for why the 
Imperial garrison failed to get it?
Soldier?: Yes, that mercenary that was in charge. We'll place 
the blame on him.

By the time anyone confirms that it really was
retrieved, it'll be too late.
Defeated Soldier: W- What...?
*Snap*...!
Defeated Soldier: H- huh?!
Jude: What? Aren't those some of the soldiers from my
command...?
*Snap* ...!
Jude: ...?!
A twig snapped beneath his foot.
Soldier?: Hm? Is that...?
Other Soldier: Heh. Better take care of that loose end.
They turned to approach.
Defeated Soldier: W- Wait, I can... I can...!
Jude: *Pant* ... Crap... I don't stand a chance... in this
condition.

After all this bullshit... am I really gonna... like
this...?
Jude: F- Fuck it.... I...!
passages.content_zh:
血滴落在地上，腳步聲低沉
傷者隨意傳出
戰士。
被擊敗的士兵：*喘氣*... *喘氣*...

需要回到...*喘氣*...營地...

我需要……嗯？
裘德：*褲子*...*褲子*...
裘德：需要……幹……這是比我更深的傷口
以為...
裘德：啊…？
遠處傳來的聲音引起了他的注意
他溜到附近的一棵樹後面。
士兵？ ：就是這裡。
其他士兵：非常好。
一個小飾品從一個人手中遞給了另一個人。
其他士兵：我一定會把這件事告訴我們共同的熟人。

你有沒有準備好一個藉口來解釋為什麼
帝國駐軍沒拿到？
士兵？ ：是的，負責的那個傭兵。我們將放置
歸咎於他。

當有人證實這確實是
收回來，就太晚了。
戰敗士兵：什、什麼…？
*折斷*...！
戰敗士兵：哈、哈？ ！
裘德：什麼？那些不是我的一些士兵嗎？
命令...？
*折斷* ...！
裘德：……？ ！
一根樹枝在他腳下折斷了。
士兵？ ：嗯？那是……？
其他士兵：呵呵。最好處理好這個未解決的問題。
他們轉身接近。
戰敗士兵：等、等等，我可以……我可以……！
裘德：*氣喘吁籲*...糟糕...我沒有機會...在這件事上
條件。

說了這麼多廢話之後……我真的會……喜歡嗎？
這……？
裘德：幹－－幹……我……！

passages.name: CH10 - New Event
passages.content:
Charlotte: *Yawn*...
Charlotte pulled herself up from her bedding.
Charlotte: Is stone better than dirt below the bedding...?
Charlotte: *Sigh*... Neither.
Her head turned and eventually laid her eyes on a
figure approaching her.
Atticus: Charlotte Stewart.
Charlotte: Huh?
As Atticus continued to talk, Charlotte went to
pull herself to her feet.
Atticus: I have a request to make of you...
Charlotte: *Yawn*... Good morning.
Charlotte: What do you need?
Atticus: ...
Atticus's hand moved to rest on his weapon.
Atticus: I wish to accompany your group.
Atticus looked away a bit meekly. His hand rubbed
around where he had been wounded.
Atticus: I need you to add another goal to your journey.
Charlotte: W- What? Why?
Atticus: ...

The Oathbreaker is gone.
Atticus joins the team!
passages.content_zh:
夏洛特: *呵欠*...
夏洛特從她的寢具上起身。
夏洛特: 石頭比寢具下的泥土好嗎...?
夏洛特: *嘆氣*... 都一樣。
她的頭轉動，最終將目光落在一個
朝她走來的人影上。
阿提克斯: 夏洛特·史都華。
夏洛特: 蛤？
當阿提克斯繼續說話時，夏洛特起身
站立。
阿提克斯: 我有個請求想拜託妳...
夏洛特: *呵欠*... 早安。
夏洛特: 你需要什麼？
阿提克斯: ...
阿提克斯的手移到他的武器上。
阿提克斯: 我希望加入妳們的隊伍。
阿提克斯有點溫順地看向別處。他的手揉了揉
他受傷的地方。
阿提克斯: 我需要妳們在旅程中增加一個目標。
夏洛特: 什- 什麼？為什麼？
阿提克斯: ...

背誓者已逝。
阿提克斯加入了隊伍！

I jumped to Rowan, pushing him down to the ground with

passages.name: CH11-1 - Story Intro
passages.content:
Breathe.
Breathe.
...BREATHE!
Pup: *Gasp* ...!
I breathed in deeply and desperately tried to 
fill my lungs with air.
It was like I hadn't breathed for an eternity.
Pup: ...Where... am I...?
The thought crept through my mind as my 
breathing slowed.
Slowly, but surely, my eyes drifted through 
the area.
Pup: (It's like... a mine?)
Pup: (No, it's more like... tunnels. Like the sort built to
move through a building...)
Pup: (Half finished, but...)
I stood there for a moment.
I didn't know why, but...
Pup: Have I... been here before?
So I took a step.
And in that moment... from around a corner...
I saw them.
Nikolai: Haha~
Anton: ...
Two figures burst from the cavernous corridor,
sprinting around the corner and out of view.
Pup: That is... That was...

...
Pup: That was...
That was...
Anton: ...that was me.
In the blink of an eye, I was the figure that
I saw running about before.
Anton: (Wait... why am I... a kid again?)
Estella: Anton! Nikolai!
Anton: That voice...
Estella: Come back! It's too late for this.
Anton: Is that... really...

...mom?
As the thought passed through my head, I felt a 
hand on my wrist.
Nikolai: C'mon, Anton!
Anton: Nikolai...
Nikolai: We gotta keep moving!
Anton: But, what about...
Estella: Where are you?! It's dangerous down here!
Anton: It's... dangerous down here?
Nikolai: Heheh~ Don't worry.

I'll protect you.
Anton: You...?
Nikolai: Of course. It's what a big brother does, isn't it?

I'll protect you, Anton. No matter what.
Anton: ...
Anton: Okay...
I felt a tug on my wrist.
Nikolai: Heheh~
Anton: Ah...!
And I was pulled along into the corridor.
Nikolai and I ran through the tunnels, passing all
sorts of strange structures and unfinished
construction.
It felt like an eternity.
An eternity of our play.
Anton: Haha...
But as we turned one more corner...
Anton: Nikolai...?
My brother disappeared.
Anton: Nikolai... where are you...?
My heart began to beat faster and faster, and my 
walk picked up into a run.
Anton: Nikolai!

...

MOM...!
Turning corners and corners and more corners...
Anton: *Pant* *pant* *pant*...!
 

WHERE... ARE... YOU!?
Anton: ...?!
I turned another corner.
I entered a more constructed part of the tunnels.
Before me stood a stone wallway.
Cold.
Empty.
It was... THAT hallway.
Anton: Nikolai...?
I walked forward.
I shouldn't have.
Anton: Mom...?
I stood in front of a door.
I shouldn't have.
Anton: Are you... in there...?
I put my hand on the door.
I shouldn't have.
Anton: ...
Pup: ...
Pup: Nikolai...! Mom!
I stuck my hand out... grasping at anything I could 
get ahold of.
Pup: Please... don't... don't...!
My arm extended as much as I could.
Anything.
Please.
Pup: ...
My hand was grasped by another's.
Aegis: ...
I looked on at Aegis, who looked at me with 
an expressionless face.
Aegis: Are you okay?
Pup: Y... Yeah...

Yeah, I'm okay. I'm... okay.
Aegis: Are you sure?
Aegis took his other hand and raised it to my face.
Pulling it away, a tear shone in the light.
Pup: I'm... crying?
The dam broke.
Pup: No, I'm... okay...
Tears streamed down my face.
Aegis: ...
Aegis stepped forward.
Pup: ...?
Aegis had hugged me.
Aegis: It'll be okay.

It will be okay.
There was something comfortable about it. 
Welcoming, and warm.
So I hugged him back.
Pup: ...
Aegis: It wasn't your fault.
Pup: *Sniff*...
I released Aegis, and he did too in return.
Wiping my face, my crying has reached its 
conclusion.
Pup: I know... it wasn't...
Pup: I just...
I couldn't respond. My thoughts were 
too scattered.
But my mind did focus on one thing, as I stared 
on at the figure in front of me.
Aegis: ...
As I looked on him, the thought came into focus.
Pup: Aegis...
Pup: Who are you... really?
Aegis: ...
[Choice]:  / 
Our journey brought us from the mountain range 
that saddled the border between the Empire
and the Kingdom.
Charlotte: ...but why would they steal it?
Charlotte's words were given an extra edge of 
concern.
We had traveled away from the Vault, but we had 
not stumbled upon any leads.
Atticus: Hmm... unclear on why.

Oathbreakers are powerful, but they are simply a
singular tool to achieve one thing.
Kara: Per Atticus's words before we left...

While Oathbreakers are powerful, they are but a 
single tool for a single type of task.
Norde: Implying the need was specific.
Norde: Which, if identified, could narrow down the 
suspects.
Satia: Then the power of this Oathbreaker is...?
Charlotte: So what does the Oathbreaker do?
Atticus: "Eul'dusa" was its name.
Kara: "Eul'dusa", as I understand.
Kara: From my research, it is a "wish granting" type.

It operates by shifting the luck of the user to
create favorable results...

It also has a drawback.

The closer one comes to thir ultimate goal, the 
more one will become petrified.
Atticus: Indeed...
Rowan: That, I would say... is... less than useful.
Kara: It is more than a little vague.
Kara: But petrification is no laughing matter.
Elliot: There is an old legend of a village entirely turned to
stone.
Elliot: From my understanding, the Covenant attributes it 
to that Oathbreaker.
Kara: Some foreboding myths focus around such a consequence.
Charlotte: Meaning it's someone who is okay with that consequence?
Rowan: Or has subordinates to take on that risk for them...
Rowan: *Sigh*... I am at a loss of words to dictate all 
whom that could apply to, even within the 
Empire alone.
Rowan: Though, it does match with the simple answer of it
being the Imperial Court to have ordered the raid 
and theft.
Mariel: But... did they know that it caused petrification 
when they stole it?
Mariel: It could be someone who had no idea...
Charlotte: It does pose the question on if the thief even 
knew it would do that.
Elliot: The Imperial Court should be aware of the nature 
of the Oathbreakers stored within their country.
Norde: Would the Empire not be aware of the 
Oathbreakers in its borders?
Rowan: Indeed. I can confirm they would be aware.
Charlotte: But it WAS an Imperial Regiment that attacked the
Vault, yeah?
Charlotte: That leaves it being an official order or a rogue
element.

Would a random rogue officer go after an 
Oathbreaker?
Norde: Hmm...
The group calmed to a quiet after that.
While the possibility of it being a rogue element
within the forces were not without potentiality...
...each and every one of them knew the more 
commonplace understanding and treatment of 
Oathbreakers for the population.
And how preposterous it sounded to say that 
someone would steal a blighted item off what the 
Covenant taught civilians about them.
Flynn: Hey... Anton, right? Or Pup? Do you have any 
thoughts to share?
Pup: ...
Flynn: A- Anton?
Kara: Pup, any thoughts?
Pup: ...
Charlotte: Hey, Pup, you're being talked to, you know?
Pup: Huh?

I... think... Norde has a good point.
Pup: (Whatever Norde said is probably a good idea...)
I stepped back a little more from the group, trying 
to disengage myself from the conversation.
Charlotte: Hmm...
Pup: I'll... go scout ahead a bit.
Tapping my sheathed sword, I give a brief smile 
before heading off.
Kara: Something on Pup's mind?
Rowan: I have an idea.
Satia: Must we travel through... that place?
Norde: Then we are committed to route our travels through...
that place?
Kara: It is by and far the most expedient route if one 
wishes to avoid the Imperial Capital.
Rowan: That is true.

The north is a snowy tundra without many roads.
Rowan: At least, not many roads that do not lead to the
capital...
Atticus: Well, the Storm Ram's child cannot escape it 
forever.

Be it answers or terrors... that place does will not
fade away.

Forever on their road, it is. The town of...
Kara: Pup cannot escape it forever.
Kara: I do not know what answers lie there for Pup...

What answers lie in...
Pup: ...Crekskia.
I stepped onto the snow with a crunch.
Pup: ...
Our travels through the Empire had largely brought 
us through barren or snow coated landscapes.
I breathed out, and I saw my breath.
Pup: Crekskia is...

It's... where I grew up before the Crows.
Stepping forward, the crunch of the snow 
beneath my feet seemed to match the beat 
of my heart.
Pup: It's... fine.
I had been having strange dreams lately.
I wasn't sure if they were for real, or not.
More and more they had felt real, and more 
engraved onto my mind.
Pup: That place wasn't...
The most engraved image was of a scene. A grim 
scene that sent shivers up my spine.
I stopped.
Pup: That wasn't... Crekskia, was it?
Pup: ...
Rowan: Greetings, my friend~
Pup: Ah...?!
Rowan: I was asked to accompany you on your scouting 
mission.
Pup: R- Right...
I tried stepping back, but the crunch of 
the snow was enough to surprise me in 
my tense state.
Pup: *Sigh*...
Pup: Sure, let's scout then.
We stepped forward and walked along the path.
Pup: ...
Rowan: So... about our destination.
Pup: The Republic-Empire border?
Rowan: Haha, you know what I mean...
Rowan: Before that.
Pup: ...
Rowan: We talked once before of your family.

Of regrets you had in how you didn't remember 
them.
Pup: ...
Rowan: Do you wish to learn more? Remember more?
Pup: ...
I stopped again.
Pup: I don't know.
Pup: Sometimes I feel like that might be worse.
Rowan: Truly? Why then do you feel-
Pup: Wait.

There's something in that bush.
I laid my hand on my sword and stepped towards it.
Pup: ...
...and swung!
Pup: There it is!
[Choice]:  /
passages.content_zh:
呼吸。
呼吸。
...呼吸！
小狗：*喘氣* ...！
我深深地吸了一口氣，拼命地想用空氣填滿我的肺。
感覺好像我已經永恆沒有呼吸了。
小狗：...我在...哪裡...?
當我的呼吸放緩時，這個想法悄悄地爬上我的腦海。
慢慢地，但肯定地，我的目光掃視了這個區域。
小狗：（這裡像...礦坑？）
小狗：（不，更像是...隧道。像是那種為了
在建築物中移動而建造的...）
小狗：（半成品，但是...）
我站在那裡片刻。
我不知道為什麼，但是...
小狗：我...以前來過這裡嗎？
所以我踏出了一步。
就在那一刻...從一個角落...
我看到了他們。
尼古拉：哈哈～
安東：...
兩個身影從寬敞的走廊中衝出，
衝過轉角，消失在視線之外。
小狗：那是...那是...

...
小狗：那是...
那是...
安東：...那是我。
眨眼間，我就變成了我
之前看到的那個奔跑的身影。
安東：（等等...我為什麼會...又變成小孩了？）
艾絲黛拉：安東！尼古拉！
安東：那個聲音...
艾絲黛拉：回來！太遲了。
安東：那是...真的是...

...媽媽？
當這個想法掠過我的腦海時，我感覺到一隻
手抓住了我的手腕。
尼古拉：走吧，安東！
安東：尼古拉...
尼古拉：我們得繼續走！
安東：但是，關於...
艾絲黛拉：你們在哪裡？！這裡很危險！
安東：這裡...很危險？
尼古拉：呵呵～別擔心。

我會保護你的。
安東：你...？
尼古拉：當然。這就是哥哥該做的，不是嗎？

我會保護你的，安東。無論如何。
安東：...
安東：好吧...
我感覺到我的手腕被拉了一下。
尼古拉：呵呵～
安東：啊...！
然後我被拉進了走廊。
尼古拉和我跑過隧道，經過各種
奇怪的結構和未完成的
建築。
感覺像永恆。
我們玩耍的永恆。
安東：哈哈...
但當我們轉過另一個彎角時...
安東：尼古拉...？
我的兄弟消失了。
安東：尼古拉...你在哪裡...?
我的心開始跳得越來越快，我的
腳步加快，變成了跑步。
安東：尼古拉！

...

媽媽...！
轉

hostiles about.

Flynn: Thank you, Lady Kara. As usual, you know just what to
say.

Pup: *Pant*... *pant*...
Rowan: Might I ask what that was?
Otis: Ya two still alive? Can't have been too bad.
Norde: You two should be more careful around wild animals/
Pup: No, I think those are scout beasts.
Kara: Tracking animals?
Pup: Yeah. They were too... organized for wild animals.
Pup: They had to be trained.
Charlotte: So what does that mean?
The chatter died down, as people 
became thoughtful.
Kara: So we've lost much of our lead.
Norde: You think it's that flier woman?
Charlotte: The mercenary that was chasing us from Cartenan?
Nora: ...
Kara: Even if we're being paranoid, we should act on it.
Charlotte: You're not wrong, but... that does mean that we 
can't do what we discussed.
Pup: What?
Kara: Yes, that option is off the table.
Kara: It would be much too time consuming to deviate 
from the roads and keep ourselves supplied, 
unfortunately.
Kara: We must traverse through Crekskia.
Pup: ...
Pup: ...

...Okay.
Pup: Okay.
[Choice]:  / 
What do you remember?
I sat against a rock, and my legs curled up a bit
towards my body.
Pup: What do I remember?

...
Pup: It can be hard to tell... what is memory and what is
imagination anymore...
Aegis: You do not need to rush it.
Pup: I guess...
I calmed myself down, trying to scour my mind
for what scraps of it remained within.
Memories.
Memories of Crekskia.
Memories of my family.
Pup: There was this one time... I think...
Pup: My brother was playing hero. And I was... the 
damsel in distress.
Pup: Not literally. I was like a villager or something.
Aegis: 'Hero'...?
Pup: Yeah, based on old fairytales and bedtime stories 
my Mom told us.
Aegis: It gives a warm feeling to the heart.
Pup: One of my favorites was about Tuvae the 
Shepherd.

The story of a simple shepherd who was able to 
hold off an army, and guide his people to safety.
Pup: Ah... I always wanted to be Tuvae but Nikolai 
wanted to play that too...

I often was the one shepherding the 'townsfolk' to
safety.
Aegis: It appears to give you warm memories as well, 
despite that role.
Pup: Of course, he was my brother and we-
Pup: ...
I stopped as I realized how easily that memory 
had flowed.
Just one thread pulled and the yarn of a tale 
formed within.
Pup: (But... only of the stories we were told?)
Aegis: What were their names?
Pup: What?
Aegis: The names of your mother and brother.

It appears curiosity beckons me, as well.
Pup: ...

My mother's name was Estella, and my older 
brother's name was Nikolai.
Aegis: ...

What do you believe became of them?
Pup: ...
I opened my mouth. The grim reality of the 
thought crept onto my mind.
But I couldn't say it.
Aegis: I see.
Aegis lowered his hand and placed it on my head.
With a rustling motion, he patted my head.
Pup: ...
Pup: ...
He didn't feel like a stranger. It was familiar and
comforting.
But I raised my own hands to remove his 
all the same.
Aegis: ...?
Pup: I... appreciate it.
And I moved his arm down, away from my head.
Pup: I think... I'm there.
I closed my eyes.
And took a deep breath.
Pup: ...
I opened my eyes.
Pup: I think... I'm ready to try.
[Choice]:  / 
I stepped at an even pace.
Pup: ...
My thoughts were numb, but not dormant.
Pup: (Crekskia...)
My memories were little to none of the place.
What I remembered, if anything, was emotions.
The emotions of stories.
Kara: Pup?
Pup: ...
Kara: ...Anton?
Pup: Hm?
I turned to see Kara walking at my side.
Pup: Oh, hello.
Turning my head a few degrees more, a similar 
sight met me from my rear flank.
Satia: ...
Mariel: ...
Charlotte: ...
...looking at Kara and me.
Kara: You appear distracted.
Pup: I'm fine.
Kara: This village is one you are familiar with, yes?
Kara: I've not been exposed to specifics, but... it seems
safe to say based on our time with Atticus.

The rumors of your father are rumors, but the
underlying connection...
Pup: ...Yes, I grew up there.
Pup: Before my father and I joined the Crows, at least.
Kara: As I speculated.

This village is a place of bad memories for you, 
then?
Pup: No.
Kara: Then... the distracted moments and restless sleep?
Pup: I said I'm fine.
Kara: You say as much, but I am far from the only one to
notice.
Pup: ...
I turned my eye back a bit once more.
Charlotte: ...
Kara: I do not know if it is the combination of the two, 
or this topic is more impactful...

...but the group has noticed a lot more little signs 
of problems lately. Too much to be ignored.
So I peeked back once more.
Charlotte: *Mouthing YES*
Pup: ...

I said I'm fine. With being a girl, and with coming
back here.
Kara: The 'girl' one does seem more likely to be true 
now.
Kara: While I was not sure of it at the time, your recent
signs of frustration have dwarfed those prior...
Pup: I...
That was not what I expected her to say.
I was left a bit speechless as a mixture of 
emotions stumbled about my mind.
Was it a urge to correct her? Or a feeling of relief?
Pup: Just... please don't let me distract everyone else.
Pup: I can handle myself without costing us the mission.
Kara: The most sure way to stop it from distracting others...
Kara: ...would be to allow them to help.
Pup: I...
Kara: Particularly now, when the risk is around the 
corner.

We are capable of getting you a place to rest, and
letting you sleep your way through our visit to the
village.
Pup: ...
My mind had words for that. What those words 
could be was a mystery, but I fought the urge to 
open my mouth.

passages.content:
After spending the morning training up our advance
unit, we arrived on scene.
As we did, we found the Fort approach to be a
combination of the plains and hills we had seen so 
far.
The mines weren't readily apparent, but we could 
see a scattering of beasts and remnant soldiers.
Pup: (They're still probably around from previous fights in
the area...)

Hmm...
I turned to our group.
Pup: We're as prepared as we can get for this. Be ready. 
Be vigilant.
The group I had assembled nodded back.
And that included...
Charlotte: ...
Pup: You know... I said it before, but you don't need to
stick your neck out for this task.
Rowan: It is... a dangerous affair.
Kara: And one that is important to pick the right 
personnel for.
Pup: Yeah...
Mariel: Yeah, sis. We have Lockhart to save, right?

I get why you may feel the urge to now, but... 
You don't need to take this risk.
Charlotte: Thank you, Mariel. You know me so well, but... 
that also means you'll get why I need to say this.
Charlotte: I agree with Kara.
Charlotte: I am the most experienced person here with 
bleeding edge technology. These landmines are 
something I've seen before.
Pup: You're not... wrong.
Charlotte: And... what would it make me if I was equipped to 
help and decided to throw the task onto someone 
else for the sake of my safety?
Pup: ...
Kara: ...
Rowan: *Sigh*...
Charlotte: I'm happy you all understand.
Mariel: ...
Pup: (I'll... try to keep an eye on if her needing sleep
puts her at risk...)
