...在我意識到之前，他反而開始嗅我了。
Pup: 蛤...?

有什麼不對勁嗎？
Jakson: *好奇的嗚咽*...
Pup: 我...聞起來不像地雷吧...?
Pup: 還是...
Pup: 還是我聞起來像...女人...?
Jakson: *滿足的吠叫* ~
Pup: ...這到底是什麼意思啊？

passages.name: CH12 - Satia → Rowan
passages.content:
Satia: I hear you gave Pup a pep talk.
Rowan: Mayhap it not be the right phrase for it...
Rowan: But yes, I tried to encourage her.
Satia: Thank you for it.
Satia: But... "her"?
Rowan: Hm?
Satia: Are you not realizing you're saying that?
Satia: Calling Pup "her".
Rowan: I have...? I guess I did.

My apologies.
Satia: Well, do just keep an eye on Pup. They may not 
enjoy it, but I can't say either way yet.
Rowan: Indeed. She may not know either.

Or... they may not know.
Satia: Thank you.
passages.content_zh:
薩蒂亞：我聽說你為小狗做了鼓舞士氣的演講。
羅文：也許這個詞不太適合…
羅文：但是，是的，我試著鼓勵她。
薩蒂亞：謝謝你。
薩蒂亞：但是……「她」？
羅文：嗯？
薩蒂亞：你沒有意識到你在這麼說嗎？
薩蒂亞：稱小狗為「她」。
羅文：我有……？我想我做到了。

我很抱歉。
薩蒂亞：好吧，請留意小狗。他們可能不會
享受它，但我還不能說。
羅文：確實如此。她可能也不知道。

或者……他們可能不知道。
薩蒂亞：謝謝。

passages.name: CH12 - Otis → Norde
passages.content:
Otis: So how about you?
Norde: What about me?
Otis: The pup and me ain't the only ones who got hit by 
the curse here.

You're subject numero tres.
Otis: So, ya got questions?
Norde: ...
Otis: The pup also isn't the only one I'm an elder to, ya
know?
Otis: You've clearly been around the park a few times,
but I've got a couple decades on ya, at least.
Norde: ...
Otis: Ya know I am just trying to help.
Norde: No. I do have questions.

Just not now. Not here.
Otis: What a mature, measured response ya got.
Otis: *Sigh*... Borin'
passages.content_zh:
奧蒂斯：那你呢？
諾德：那我呢？
奧蒂斯：小狗和我並不是唯一被擊中的人
詛咒在這裡。

你是第 3 號對象。
奧蒂斯：那麼，你們還有什麼問題嗎？
諾德：…
奧蒂斯：小狗也不是我唯一的長輩，是的
知道嗎？
奧蒂斯：你顯然已經去過公園好幾次了，
但至少我還有幾十年的時間。
諾德：…
奧蒂斯：你知道我只是想幫忙。
Norde：不，我確實有問題。

只是現在不行。不在這裡。
奧蒂斯：你的回答多麼成熟、謹慎。
奧蒂斯：*嘆息*...Borin'

passages.name: CH12 - Jude → Reagyn
passages.content:
Reagyn: Hmm...

So... that mercenary learned how to disarm them 
in... the crusades...?
Jude: Don't.
Reagyn: Excuse me?
Jude: Don't think of going to the crusades yourself.
Reagyn: Who are you to tell me that?
Jude: Someone from the other side of that graveyard.

No matter what your Covenant tells you, there is 
no honor to be won there.
Jude: Only what might deteriorate your humanity.
Reagyn: ...
Reagyn stumbled for the second, but soon enough...
Reagyn: I was only offering idling thoughts.

I do not need the opinions of a man from the 
Emerald Empire.
Jude: As you say, ma'am.
passages.content_zh:
Reagyn: 嗯...

所以...那個傭兵學會解除他們武裝的技巧是在...十字軍東征時期...?
Jude: 別。
Reagyn: 請問？
Jude: 別想著自己去參加十字軍東征。
Reagyn: 你憑什麼命令我？
Jude: 一個來自那片墓園另一邊的人。

無論你的盟約告訴你什麼，那裡沒有榮譽可言。
Jude: 只有可能讓你人性墮落的東西。
Reagyn: ...
Reagyn 第二次語塞，但很快地...
Reagyn: 我只是隨口想想而已。

我不需要來自翡翠帝國之人的意見。
Jude: 如您所願，女士。

passages.name: CH12 - Atticus → Kara
passages.content:
Atticus: You seem quite knowledgable despite being so far 
from Cartenan.
Kara: I can give full credit to the Queen's willingness to
let me travel.
Atticus: Is that so? I assume it was limited to political
missions?
Kara: Largely, though there were a few occasions I had 
free time.

I'd be happy to give your recommendations on
restaurants if you ever are planning a vacation.
Atticus: I'd appreciate that.
passages.content_zh:
阿提克斯：儘管離卡特南這麼遠，妳似乎相當博學。
卡拉：我得完全歸功於女王願意讓我旅行。
阿提克斯：是嗎？我猜想這僅限於政治任務？
卡拉：大致上是，不過有幾次我有空閒時間。

如果你們有計畫度假，我很樂意給你一些餐廳推薦。
阿提克斯：我很感激。

passages.name: CH12 - Tatiana → Castel
passages.content:
Tatiana: Why was I picked for the minefield mission?
Castel: Why was I picked for the minefield mission?
They said at the same time.
Tatiana: You too?
Castel: So it seems...
Tatiana: Well, let's at least make sure they don't regret
picking us.
Castel: Or... we could let them focus on the mines?
Tatiana: I though ya were supposed to be smart?
Castel: I am not equipped to disarm a mine while being attacked
by enemies...!
Tatiana: Then I'll watch your back.
Castel: Oh... thank you...
Castel: Wait, no, that's not the problem...!
passages.content_zh:
塔蒂亞娜：為什麼我被選去執行雷區任務？
Castel：為什麼我被選去執行雷區任務？
他們同時說。
塔蒂亞娜：你也是嗎？
卡斯特爾：看來…
塔蒂亞娜：好吧，我們至少要確保他們不會後悔
選擇我們。
Castel：或者…我們可以讓他們專注於地雷？
塔蒂亞娜：我以為你應該很聰明？
卡斯特：我沒有能力在受到攻擊時解除地雷的武裝
被敵人...！
塔蒂亞娜：那我會照顧你的。
卡斯特爾：哦……謝謝你……
卡斯特：等等，不，這不是問題……！

passages.name: CH12 - Flynn → Elliot
passages.content:
Elliot: I wonder... if I target my bow just right...
Flynn: Please don't try it.
Elliot: You're right. One wrong move and I could activate 
a different one.
Flynn: You... listened...?
Flynn: Thank you.
Elliot: Good advice comes from good sources.
passages.content_zh:
艾略特：我在想...如果我把弓瞄準得夠準...
弗林：拜託別試。
艾略特：你說得對。一個錯誤的動作我就可能啟動
另一個機關。
弗林：你...聽進去了...？
弗林：謝謝你。
艾略特：好的建議來自好的來源。

passages.name: CH12 - New Event
passages.content:
Nora: Mm...
Nora sat on a rudimentary chair with her hands 
and feet securely bound.
The hot light of a magical lamp shone down onto
her, creating the main light source in the room.
Norde: Name, homeland, occupation.
Norde sat across from her.
Nora: .........

Nora Nicollet. Lockhart. Mercenary.
Charlotte: Mercenary for the Empire.
Charlotte stepped into the edges of the light.
Nora: Mercenary for liberating Lockhart.
Charlotte: Because Imperials are the epitome of freedom and
liberty.
Nora: They've done it before.
Norde: Yes, from the Emerald Empire.
Norde: The same can be said for most of the continent.
Charlotte: Lockhart, included.
Norde: What we need to know...

...is what the Empire is planning.
Nora: ...
Norde: We can wait.
Nora: ...

I'm not an Imperial.
Charlotte: Heh. So they didn't trust her enough to tell her.
Nora: I won't betray Lockhart.
Charlotte: Too late.
Nora: .........

For which of us is it too late, Princess?
Charlotte: ...
Nora: ...
The two stared at each other, daggers pointed at 
each others' souls.
Norde: The question we want answered isn't-
Charlotte: What did they offer you?
Norde: Stewart, we don't need to engage in-
Charlotte: It's fine. I'm used to her random jabs at this point.
Norde: That's not...
Charlotte: So... what was the price of selling out Lockhart?
Nora: You mean, "what was the price of the traitors' 
heads?"

The price of the cretins who stomp all over an 
entire city to line their pockets with gold?
Charlotte: ...?!
Norde: Stop. We aren't trying to-
Charlotte: Who are you to try and speak for the people of 
Lockhart after you brought war to its streets?!
Nora: What do you think those streets are paved with?

It's the blood, sweat, and tears of everyone BUT 
you.
Nora: You've never seen a friend go to work one day and 
not return, have you?
Charlotte: What...?
Nora: An "accident".

At the docks. The factory. The proving grounds.
Nora: Swept aside, and the next desperate soul steps up 
to fill their place.
Charlotte: What? 

No, I've seen those reports and those 
numbers were down.
Nora: Listen to the words coming out of your mouth.
Charlotte: ...
Nora: You don't see us as people, do you?

Who do you think are desperate enough to take 
those jobs?

The nekolyn, caizlyn, einlyn...
Nora turned to Norde.
Nora: Taikolyn and plenty of mixed, too.
Norde: ...
Norde sat in their calm and did not take the bait.
Nora: I was lucky enough to work my way into a 
mercenary core.
Nora: Yet still I'm forced to watch family - siblings - be at
their mercy.

The mercy of your vile parents.

At your mercy.
Charlotte: ...
Nora: ...
Charlotte: Raargh!
Charlotte turned on her heel and disappeared into 
the shadows.
Nora: Good riddance.
Norde: ...
Mariel: ...they're taking a long time.

Are they...?
Charlotte: ...!
Charlotte burst out of the tent, and she strutted
angrily past those standing outside.
Mariel: ...? Charlotte?
Mariel broke into a trot as she tried to catch up to
Charlotte.
Mariel: Did it go... poorly?
Charlotte: .........
Charlotte stopped.
Mariel: I heard bits and pieces.

"Lockhart"... "Parents"...

..."Nekolyn"...
Mariel opened her mouth to continue, but she 
struggled to say the next words.
Mariel: Sis, you know I think you're the best person 
to lead Lockhart.

I would never try to...
Mariel trailed off, and the two stood there in silence
for several seconds.
Charlotte: Mariel, I love you.

I don't deserve...
Mariel: I love you, too.
Mariel started to take a step forward to hug 
Charlotte, but Charlotte turned a step away.
And Charlotte's shoulders pitched up and down as 
she tried to control her breathing.
Charlotte: *Inhale*...
And Charlotte's shoulders pitched up and down as 
she tried to control her breathing.
Charlotte: Mariel... Mom... Dad...

I love you. I do.
She breathed out, and her hand jittered as she 
resisted tightening it into a fist.
.........
Charlotte: *Exhale*...
She took a breath once more, and a few more of 
those seemed to settle her heart.
Charlotte: We will save Lockhart.
Charlotte: No matter who we need to save it from.
[Choice]:  / 
Our group had managed to subdue the forward 
attack team sent by the pursuing imperial force.
Nora, the mercenary leading it, was now in our 
custody.
She was not alone. We kept a handful of the 
enemies as prisoners for the sake of extracting 
info on the Empire's plans.
Actions like attacking the Kingdom of Cartenan or
stealing Oathbreakers from Vaults were still
unexplained.
We dragged along the prisoners that seemed to 
have a better chance of having answers.
And the others were left by to be handled by the
village of Crekskia.
Pup: From what they told us, the other troops were 
stripped of their military gear and sent home with a 
sack of supplies.
We Nightless Crows headed south as we continued 
on our journey towards the Republic of Rabaneau.
If the main force of Imperial troops was still 
chasing us, we had days of time on them.
So we continued to seek out allies for Lockhart.
Without the Kingdom, the Republic was the best
alternative.
A hesitance was born from the Republic being the
Empire's actual enemy in this war.
They had a vested interest. 

But it was also far from an impartial one.
Asking their help would come with a cost.
Charlotte: Lockhart will not be some vassal state to a waring
nation that wants a trade port.
Our journey was not at its end.
But...
The mountains of Nolvanus were a distant memory.
Charlotte: Ugh...
Charlotte let out a tired moan to the tempo of the
convoy's step.
Kara: Are you feeling well? You've not come down with 
an illness, have you?
Kara leaned a bit from her horse, as though trying 
to get a closer look at Charlotte over on her horse.
Charlotte: Yeah. Just... tired.
Kara: The interrogation?
Charlotte: No.
Rowan: Mayhap it be sleeping in the same camp as people 
who wish to kill you?
Charlotte: ...Maybe.
Pup: Or... what we've all just been through...
Pup: *Yawn*...
Pup: ...we've all just been through a lot lately.
Rowan: I would say other events explain your own tiredness.
Pup: I...
Pup: ...Maybe.
Kara: You've sharpened your intuitions, Alexei. It is a
pleasure to see you blossom so.
Rowan: I thank you, dear Kara.
Rowan: Though I do sincerely wish I could flex those 
muscles in happier times.
As the words came out, it resonated with 
many of us.
Pup: (Well, it's not like we're in a bad situation.)

(We've got a straight shot to the Republic, and 
we've got prisoners to extract info from.)
Pup: (Then again...)
I turned my head to the other three's horses.
Each of their gazes were turned away from one 
another in a blend of anxiety and thoughtful 
trances.
Pup: (We haven't really... done much.)
Pup: (How much closer are we to actually helping 
Lockhart since we left?)
Pup: (We've questions. And more questions. And...)
Rowan: What a voluptuous look upon our dear Pup's face?
Pup: ...
Pup: One of those words don't fit.
Rowan: I simply mean to suggest that you've more notable
reasons that would disturb your sleep recently.
Rowan: How have you adapted to not sleeping on your front?
Pup: I... I didn't do that before anyways...
Kara: I had been meaning to ask.
Kara: You've been more somber since we left Crekskia.

How are you?
Pup: I'm... fine.

I'm me.
Pup: Whatever that is, at the end of the day, that'll 
keep being true.
Pup: You don't need to worry on that.
Charlotte: I feel like I've heard that speech before.
Pup: Well, not like I meant it, then.
Pup: Back then I was just trying to push it to the side. It
was just me giving up on it and focusing on doing 
the job.
In reality, I'm still... well...
Pup: I'm still... me...
Pup: That's inevitably going to require me to face the 
job we need to do as me, too.
Pup: ...whatever that means about who that 'me' is and
what... implications are attached to it.
Rowan: Like the two hardy breasts that accompany you on 
that journey?
Pup: ...
Charlotte: Rowan...!
Pup: No... it's fine...
I looked down.
Pup: These are me. A part of me.
Their weight was an ever present sensation.
Each trot of the horse reminded me of them.
Pup: They're not going to just disappear...
Rowan: Good.
Charlotte: ...
Rowan: It is good that Pup is embracing being self-reflective
and not rejecting herself.
Charlotte: ...what do you mean by that?
Pup: (..."herself"...?)
Rowan: I am not blind. Nor were you all.

Regardless of the specifics, Pup danced between 
stances of wishes and 'would-be's.

One is not obligated to face their true self.
Rowan: Nor can one be forced to take that road of self-
reflection.
Rowan: But everyone does deserve to love oneself.

And the first step of such an endeavor is to 
let oneself be their true self.
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte: Right...
Charlotte turned away and her daggered stare was
removed from Rowan.
Her hat seemed to settled down, as though the 
tension escaped with the air pressure.
Kara: I am proud of you, Alexei. To be able to say those
words.
Rowan: You are one of the shoulders I stand atop of, 
my dear friend.
The two smiled at each other, but Rowan returned 
to his serious demeanor when he turned back 
towards me.
Rowan: Pup... Anton...

You've road ahead of you.

No matter where that road takes you... No matter 
what you learn about it's destination...

I will support you in that, to the ends of Ilvanis.

Whether that be defying the Goddess herself to 
undo that curse, or otherwise.
Kara: I think that's a beautiful sentiment.
Kara: You have allies from all over the world it seems. Not
to mention the Crows like Satia.
Kara: You have allies from all over the world it seems. Not
to mention the Crows.
Kara, with a beaming smile, turned towards me.
Kara: I'd be happy to count myself amongst those allies.
Pup: ...
Kara: What do you...
Kara: ...what do you... think...?
Kara's words were kind as she continued to talk.

But... my clouded mind had lingered, and her
speech was background noise that trailed off.
Pup: ...

..."herself"...
The word slipped quietly out of my mouth.
Kara: Hm...?
Rowan: Mayhap our dear Pup delves into her own 
reflection?
Rowan: Even moreso, could she be daydreaming of a new
wardrobe?
Pup: ...?!
Kara: Stranger tides have turned before this day...
Pup: Very funny. This outfit works well enough when
tailored. I'm used to it.
Rowan: You say such things...
Rowan: But are you even wearing a br-
Pup: B- But...! Just because I say that doesn't mean
I can't do... something...!

Uh... perhaps... headwear?
Pup: I could try like a hat or something? Maybe...?!
My eyes darted to try and grasp a more solid idea.
Pup: M- Maybe a headband...? Like Rowan...?
Kara: If your hair is getting in the way, we could try to 
tie it up with a ribbon?
Pup: ...or maybe just a hat?
My eyes had shifted to another target. It was one 
in a thoughtful daze.
Charlotte: ...
Pup: I could try a hat?
Pup: Charlotte, could I...?
Rowan: I would not...
I drifted my horse closer to her own, and I started 
to reach out my hand.
Charlotte: ...?!
...but she snapped at me, as though silently 
hissing, and knocked my hand away.
Pup: C- Charlotte...?
Rowan: I could've told you that such a move was unwise.
Rowan: Our Lady Stewart here loves her hats.
Rowan: I do not think I've seen a day in my life where she
wasn't wearing one.
Kara: Both of the sisters had a nickname before they
established themselves in the academy.

"Hat Girl" for Charlotte, and "Ribbon Girl" for Mariel.
Kara: A lot of the freshmen had a nickname before they
established themselves in the academy.

"Hat Girl" for Charlotte.
Rowan: A nickname, you say? In a sense...

It was a nickname from... the days before anyone 
knew who anyone else was...
Pup: I guess... I've never seen her without it.
Pup: (I wonder...)
Charlotte: Don't even think about it.
Both of Charlotte's arms had raised to the elastic 
of her hat, and she gripped it tightly with both.
Rowan: My fair Pup, you may try on my headband if the 
fancy drives you so.
Pup: Uh...
Kara: Alexei...

Do you wash that headband?
As the discussion wandered off, so did the three 
horses carrying Rowan, Kara, and myself.
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte was still gripping the elastic of her hat.
Though...
Charlotte: ...
...without losing that grip, her aura changed from 
a tense anger to a somber melancholy.
Her horse had sensed her unease, and the two lost
ground on the rest of us.
So...
Charlotte was left by herself and with her 
thoughts.
Charlotte: I should...

I should talk to Mariel.

Or...
Charlotte: I should...

I should talk to someone.

Or...
She gripped her hat a little tighter, and the tips of
the loose beret seemed to stand on edge.
Charlotte: "...the first step of such an endeavor is to let
oneself be their true self..."
[Choice]:  / 
Norde: What of other collaborators? Their motivations?

Mercenaries don't like playing front line soldier,
after all.
Nora: ...I think you know the answer.
Norde: ...that everyone has a price.
Both of their heads turned subtly from the noise of
someone entering.
Charlotte: ...
...and turned more as she entered the light.
Norde: It would probably be best for you to step outside.

If you want to-
Charlotte: I want to ask her a couple questions.
Norde: ...
Charlotte: Please.
Norde: .........

Very well.
Norde stood up, and stepped to the side for 
Charlotte to take a seat.
Charlotte: ...
Nora: ...
Charlotte: Who are your collaborators?
Nora: I answered this already.
Charlotte: Collaborators in Lockhart.
Nora: Do you really want that answer... princess?
Charlotte: ...
Nora: ...
Nora: The answer is "everyone".
Nora paused again, waiting for a reaction.
...but not getting one.
Nora: Do you think a soul in that city hopes for you to
return?
Nora: All we did was take the lid off the boiling pot.

Every worker, from homlyns to non-homlyns, 
would welcome new management.

All the parasites your family surrounded themselves
with? Biting at the chance to get you out of the 
way.
Nora: And don't think the rumors about your sister and 
you didn't make their way to the slums, too.
Charlotte: ...
Nora: The prodigal younger sister... the 'better' sister...
the one that should be heir.
Nora: Even your own genes are tainted by piranha from 
within.
Nora: Though... I guess you don't need to worry about that
anymore.
Nora said it smugly, as though she knew Charlotte
better than herself.
Charlotte: ...
But Charlotte stayed stone-faced. She listened
carefully, neither admitting nor denying it.
Nora: ...so my collaborators?

Anyone and everyone.

Lockhart is your enemy.

You are the enemy of Lockhart.
Charlotte: ...

Maybe...

Maybe we should be.
Charlotte: Years of that lie...

Of not being worthy from what even I thought
disqualified us.

We should've...
Nora: ...?
Charlotte: No. That's not it.

I should have. Not we.

Because, in the end...

I AM the enemy.

I am the enemy of Lockhart.
[Choice]:  / 
We soldiered on as a group, moving through 
the small villages that made up the imperial 
countryside.
Much of the region was made up of hills and 
forests, and the land started to level out the 
more we made our way to the south.
And with that leveled land...
...came an influx of farmland.
Pup: You know... I just noticed that we saw very few 
farms before now.
Norde: The Crows avoided working in the empire...
Norde: But, its topography makes it so the most suitable 
land for farming is concentrated towards the south.
Pup: Right around the border...
Rowan: And right around the war, yes. A war that the 
Empire is slowly losing, at that.
Rowan: One can imagine the spark for wanting to occupy a 
major trade hub like Lockhart...
Pup: Yeah...
Our horses settled at the bottom of a hill, and 
ahead of us rode more of the Crows.
As my eyes shifted up towards the forward group,
one of their own turned back towards us.
Reagyn: Military fort in view!
Crow: Military fort in view!
Satia: There it is.
Norde: There it is.
Up the hill, the forward team looked on.
Reagyn: That's the Republic fortification?
Crow: That's the Republic fortification we were aiming for?
Kara: Yes. The main staging point for the Republic's war
effort in the area.

Though, technically, we've already crossed the 
border.
Mariel: I imagine it'd be difficult to take a military fort and
move it with the front lines...
Crow: If any commander ever asked me to pick up a 
military fort and move it along with the front lines...

I'd desert the army then and there.
Charlotte: ...
The trot of horses accompanied our group reaching 
the hill's apex.
Pup: So that's the Republic fort...
Crow: Quite a sight.
Pup: Yeah...
I turned back to the voice.
Other Crow: Quite a sight indeed...
...and found a couple Crows leering at me.
Pup: ...?!
Pup: ...!
The two turned away, and they started 
trotting their horses back down the hill.
Pup: *Sigh*...
Otis: Fuckin' asses.
Pup: So... I wasn't just imagining it?
Otis: ...
Otis: Ya get used to it, lass.
Otis rubbed his neck.
Kara: ...
Even I could feel Kara's disapproving glare at the two.
Pup: So... I wasn't just imagining it?
Kara: It can be a bit of a curse to start noticing that they
notice...
Kara: But it does get easier to ignore them as time goes on.
Charlotte: If you're lucky, you won't have to get used to it.
Charlotte turned on her horse, and she started 
back down the hill, too.
Charlotte: I know we might push you at times to try things 
you wouldn't have had the chance to otherwise...

But we do want you to feel like your body is... 
in your best interest?
Charlotte: Not sure how to phrase that best...
Pup: No... it's... it's okay.
Pup: No matter how I tried to run... 

This is me, like I said before.
Pup: The good and bad are just... on full display.
Charlotte: Well...

Is it a bad thing to you? For this to be 'Pup'?
Pup: I... Maybe. I don't know.
Pup: The curse did do this me. It may know best...
Kara: The curse targets your perceived greatest 
weakness though. Do you think it's a weakness?
Pup: ...who am I to argue?
Charlotte: Yeah...
Charlotte: Sometimes you just need to just do your best with 
the hand you're given.
Rowan: ...
The group had a silence about it.
The seconds dragged on as the various Nightless 
Crows started disembarking horses and unloading 
equipment.
Otis: Bunch'a hogwash.
Pup: What?
Otis: I don't let this damn curse tell me who I am.
Otis: As if some ears are actually gonna slow me down.
Pup: Didn't you also get a bunch shorter...?
Otis: And I still can sink an entire navy ship on my own.
Pup: Uh...
Otis: The big difference now is I can take a dick from 
both ends like a world beater, and top a gal like 
she's runnin' outta style!
Pup: ...
I didn't know what to say.
Otis dropped off his horse and pulled its reigns.
Otis: Point bein' that this damn curse doesn't tell ya who
you can be. 

All it does it face you with the lass that ya are
today.
Otis: Just face what it shows ya, and use it to straddle 
the curse into submission.
Pup: ...and that's... what you did?
Otis: Ya got this.
Otis patted the side of my horse.
Rowan: I once heard a bedtime story from my brother.
Pup: What?
Rowan: We did not grow up in our youth together, but he 
used to love the stories his mother told him.
Rowan: There was one about a king who turned the 
supposed weaknesses of his land into strength.
Pup: Isn't that...?
Rowan: Indeed, a story about the Empire's founding. It's 
how I started to love my homeland when I arrived 
there.
Pup: Yeah. I remember being told that one when I was young,
too...
Rowan: I thought you might recognize it. You seemed to love
those stories.
Pup: Y- Yeah...
I didn't know what to say.
Rowan dropped off his horse and pulled its reigns.
Rowan: The curse isn't an arbiter of you, my friend.

It can only show the you of now. Not what you'll 
mold your future into.
Pup: ...and what do you think that future will be?
Rowan: A good one.
Rowan patted the side of my horse.
And I watched him trot off with his horse to the 
place the other Crows were gathering.
Kara: Take the time you need.

The fort is less than half a day away, and we'll have 
a safe haven for a time after we introduce 
ourselves.
Kara's horse stepped past me and towards the 
group building the temporary camp.
I could hear her give some orders as she moved.
Kara: ...have a few men scout the last trek of the...
But soon enough, she was too far away for me to 
make out the words she said.
Pup: ...
I breathed in.
And I breathed out.
Pup: (I get what they're saying.)

(It makes sense.)

(...but...)

...
I raised my hands to pull on the horse reigns.
And I followed the others to the forming campsite.
Charlotte: ...
[Choice]:  / 
Charlotte: ...
Nora: ...
Charlotte anxiously tapped her finger.
Charlotte: Well? What does the Empire plan to do with Lockhart?
Nora: Save it.
Charlotte's finger stopped.
Charlotte: Sure, but that implies it's not already saved.

You hate me. 

You hate my family. 

You hate the entire system.
Charlotte: I can't imagine you'd want a weasel like Simon in
charge.
Charlotte: With his... stupid creepy goatee...
Nora: ...
Charlotte: Whatever you think is gonna happen is something 
that makes him temporary.

...whether he knows it or not.
Nora: ...
Charlotte: ...
The tapping continued as Charlotte became visibly
restless again.
Nora: It burns at your soul, doesn't it?

Seeing whatever cursed future you imagined die 
with your lineage.
Nora: An heiress to failure.
Charlotte: ...
It stopped again. Charlotte's finger was still.
Charlotte: *Sigh*... I guess it's just an assumption that they
even told you the truth...
Nora: ...
Charlotte: ...What about you?
Nora: Huh?
Charlotte: Where would you guide Lockhart's future to?

Forget anything anyone might have told you about 
their plans.
Nora: What are you...?
Charlotte: How would you do it?

How would you save Lockhart?
Nora: ...
[Choice]:  / 
Pup: *Yawn*...
As I stepped from my tent, my hand raised to my 
mouth as the yawn wearily slipped out.
Crow: Ah, excuse me.
A fellow Crow passed me by, almost hitting me.
Pup: Hm...?
My head swiveled in a few directions as I tracked 
him and a few others rushing by.
It didn't take long for me to notice an unexpected
sight.
Pup: ...on the hill?
Kara: ...and you are sure on that?
Norde: ...to the extent we can trust our scouts.
Crow: Hayzus saw this out in the Crusades.

He may have not earned a title, but he knows 
what he's talking about on this.
Pup: What's up?
I stepped into the circle of people that were 
chatting away.
Norde: Mines.
Pup: Your... what?
Norde: As in landmines.
Kara: It seems these parts of the battlefield have had 
more... stringent lines set.

Whether it be the Empire or Republic, someone has
coated the Fort's approach with landmines.
Crow: Could be both. One starts it. The other adds their 
own while the other side still feels complacent.

One of our guys managed to set one off out of 
range. There seems to be a lot.

Some were the classic explosive powder tech. 
Others seemed more like they were primed with 
magical power.
Kara: To think the fighting had escalated here to this
extent...

Deploying prototype weaponry of that nature...
Pup: Hmm...

(If there's just hidden bombs in front of the fort,
then the important part to us is...)
Pup: We have no safe path directly to the fort?
A silence fell over the group.
Kara: Not without a multi-day detour.
Norde: Which risks additional Imperial forces catching up to
us.
[Choice]: We’ll send someone to make contact. / Maybe we leverage our experience? / We can push our way through it.
Pup: Hmm...
Pup: Maybe we find a way through and connect with 
the Republic soldiers?
Norde: I suppose you were sheltered from these sorts of
dangers as a child... even if you stood with the 
Crows in that time.
Pup: I mean, didn't someone just say that one of them 
was able to be set off safely?
Pup: If we can ally ourselves with the Republic troops, 
they could get the rest of us through safely.
Pup: Hmm...
Pup: There is still technically a safe path through, right?
Norde: I suppose you were sheltered from these sorts of
dangers as a child... even if you stood with the 
Crows in that time.
Pup: I mean, didn't someone just say that one of them 
was able to be set off safely?
Pup: It sounds like we have that experience. We should
leverage it.
Pup: Hmm...
Pup: Why not just push forward and find a safe path through?
Norde: I suppose you were sheltered from these sorts of
dangers as a child... even if you stood with the 
Crows in that time.
Pup: I mean, didn't someone just say that one of them 
was able to be set off safely?
Pup: I'm not afraid of some danger. We're mercenaries.
Crow: Y- Yeah... But Heyzus is super experienced 
with these. I have no idea how simple it is.
Kara: Hmm...
Norde: It'd be best for us to take the detour, and hope 
that route isn't also blocked.
Kara: Actually...

It may be possible.
Norde: ...?
Kara: Could you retrieve the man who has experience in
detecting mines?
Crow: S- Sure?
The Crow threw out a thumbs up, and he headed 
off down the hill.
Kara: If the prototype mines are what I think they are...

I believe Charlotte and I have the expertise to have
the advantage.
Norde: ...are you sure?
Kara: Enough to attempt it.
Pup: So we can train up a small advanced force to try 
and clear out a path?
Norde: It depends how long we take...

But... I suppose that one could at least test 
out this approach in the time we'd take to 
prepare for the detour.
Kara: My thought exactly.
Pup: I can gather a group for that, while everyone else
packs up camp.
As the words exited my mouth, I felt a presence 
come up from behind.
Charlotte: Morning.
Pup: ...morning, Charlotte.

You look...
She looked like she hadn't slept all night.
Charlotte: What's being discussed? You'll work on what while 
the Crows prep to move?
Kara: To start from the beginning...
[Choice]:  /

魔法燈的熾熱光芒照耀在

passages.name: CH12 - Story
passages.content:
Heyzus: ...! Where... did...
Imperial: Just go down, you swine!
Heyzus: Wait... aren't you the-
Nora: ...
Nora burst forth on her griffin, speeding past the
clash between the Crow and Imperial.
Heyzus: Crap...! They're the prisoners...!
Mariel: *Pant*...  *pant*...
Mariel: Hey... Heyzus...!
Heyzus: Don't worry about me, I've got this!

They went after your sister!
Mariel: ...
Mariel looked back between Heyzus and 
the path forward.
Heyzus: Go!
Mariel: ...Thank you.
And she sprinted off.
Imperial: Maybe you should pay attention to the blade in 
front of you...!
Nora and a few of the other imperial mercenaries
swiftly made their way through the minefields.
Their self-preservation be damned...
Nora: ...
But they managed through with little damage 
thanks to the path paved by the Crows.
It wasn't long until they were on top of us.
Pup: We've made good progress, all things considered.
Charlotte: I agree.
Mariel: I'll always be impressed by your technical 
skill, sis.
Charlotte was near me, and I turned towards 
her only to see her still stone-faced.
Pup: (It's probably best that she's... focused...)
Pup: (She has done nothing but a good job so far.)
I turned towards where we were heading.
Pup: Ya know... we're not in that much of a hurry.
And I turned back towards Charlotte.
Pup: Maybe we can take a break and-
Pup: ...!?
Nora: ...!
From the corner of my eye, a blur came into frame.
The blood red armor triggered my fight or flight, 
and I stepped forward.
Charlotte: ...?!
With one arm, I pushed Charlotte to the side...
Nora: ...
Pup: ...!
...and I drew my sword with the other.
The clash pushed me back, and I managed to 
keep my footing.
Pup: The fox eared mercenary...
Mariel: Her...
Charlotte: ...but how?
Charlotte had fallen to the ground, and she looked 
at the two of us with blades pointed to each 
other.
Nora: There's been enough talking.
Charlotte: But... we... I...
Charlotte: Argh...!

So be it!
From her prone position, Charlotte reached for her
holster and her gun.
Charlotte: W- What?
Out of the corner of her eye, a distinct red glow 
came from beneath the dirt.
Charlotte: A landmine?!
Pup: What?!
Nora: ...!
Pup: ...!
I inserted myself between the fox eared mercenary 
and Charlotte.
With a few slashes, we pushed each other back 
once more.
Mariel: A m- mine?! Can you disarm it?!
Pup: Of course it's a mine... Can you disarm it?
Charlotte: T- Trying...! I'm trying!
She said so, slowly moving her hands as to not 
trigger it fully.
Nora: ...
Mariel: Sis! ...Charlotte!
Mariel stepped over the horizon, and she yelled out 
as she reached us.
Nora: Heh.
Nora flipped her lance grip.
Pup: (Is... she gonna throw it?)
I tracked her aim, and she was clearly aiming 
for the mine with the hopes of setting it off.
Pup: (Dammit...!)
I took a step forward...!
...and my foot sunk into the ground.
Pup: Huh...?!
Nora: What...?!
My eyeline slipped beneath the floor.
Pup: (I'm... falling...?!)
The voices of the others' dismay was washed away 
by the explosions rumbling the earth.
And they got quieter as I fell.
When would it stop?
When did I pass into unconsciousness?
[Choice]:  / 
Pup: *Inhale*...!
Pup: *Pant*... *Cough*! *Pant*...
I stared up at the light filtering from above.
Pup: (...a cave?)
My body was covered with dirt and small pieces of
rubble.
Pup: Argh...
With my vision wavering in and out, I moved to 
clear the rubble away.
And with a grunt, I pushed myself up to a sitting
position.
That, though, was not without a realization.
Pup: (Metal...)
A cold feeling pulsated through my hand as I used 
it to push myself up off the ground.
The ground was cold, and - distinctly - metallic.
Charlotte: What is this...?
I turned to Charlotte's voice.
She was safe.
Even her hat stayed on, as though a miracle.
Mariel: Oww...
Imperial: Guh...
Crow: Was that a cave-in...?
I looked around and we seemed lucky enough to 
not have any large pile ups of debris to bury 
anyone.
Though, the reason for that became clear with
Charlotte's words.
Charlotte: Is this a train?!
Pup: A... what?

Like the thing you travel on?
Pup: (Down... here?)
I pushed myself to my feet, and the hum of the
vehicle's magical motor vibrated into my feet.
Charlotte: In that direction...
She looked towards the underground tunnel that 
the train came from.
It was pointed at Lockhart.
Pup: Why would you build a train underground?
Charlotte: Better yet... how did they do so this quickly?
Nora: Don't play dumb, 'princess'.
Our fox eared enemy brought herself to her feet, 
with rubble falling aside aplenty as she did.
Nora: The subterranean train system had been a work in
progress for years.

I had friends who worked in these damned tunnels.
Charlotte: What? Who... Who did that?
But even as the words left her mouth, Charlotte 
seemed to realize with a whisper.
Charlotte: Simon... or one of the others who had sold out 
Lockhart to the Empire.
Nora: Don't pretend you weren't planning it.
Charlotte: ...
Mariel: Planning... what?
Charlotte: What do you mean by that? Planning what?
Nora: ...
Nora raised her weapon.
A collection of the mercenaries and Imperials from
outside and within the trains started to gather to 
her sides.
They also turned towards us.
Nora: You were always planning to drag Lockhart into war.
[Choice]:  /
passages.content_zh:
Heyzus: ...! 這裡...是...
帝國兵: 給我下去，你這豬玀！
Heyzus: 等等...你不是那個-
諾拉: ...
諾拉騎著她的獅鷲獸衝出，快速掠過
渡鴉和帝國兵之間的衝突。
Heyzus: 糟了...! 他們是囚犯...!
瑪莉耶: *喘氣*... *喘氣*...
瑪莉耶: 嘿... Heyzus...!
Heyzus: 別擔心我，我搞得定！

他們追你的妹妹去了！
瑪莉耶: ...
瑪莉耶回頭看了看Heyzus和
前方的路。
Heyzus: 快走！
瑪莉耶: ...謝謝你。
然後她衝了出去。
帝國兵: 或許你該注意一下你面前的刀刃...！
諾拉和一些其他的帝國傭兵
迅速地穿過雷區。
他們的自保之心真是該死...
諾拉: ...
但多虧渡鴉開闢的道路，他們幾乎毫髮無傷地
通過了。
沒過多久，他們就追上我們了。
小不點: 考慮到所有情況，我們進展得不錯。
夏洛特: 我同意。
瑪莉耶: 我總是對你的技術
感到印象深刻，姊姊。
夏洛特就在我附近，我轉向
她，卻看到她仍然面無表情。
小不點: (她最好還是...專注...)
小不點: (到目前為止，她做得很好。)
我轉向我們前進的方向。
小不點: 妳知道...我們其實沒有那麼趕時間。
然後我轉回頭看著夏洛特。
小不點: 或許我們可以休息一下，然後-
小不點: ...!?
諾拉: ...!
從我的眼角餘光，一個模糊的身影進入了視線。
血紅色的盔甲觸發了我的戰鬥或逃跑反應，
我向前踏出一步。
夏洛特: ...?!
我用一隻手把夏洛特推到一邊...
諾拉: ...
小不點: ...!
...然後我用另一隻手拔出了劍。
撞擊把我推了回去，但我設法
站穩了腳步。
小不點: 狐狸耳朵的傭兵...
瑪莉耶: 她...
夏洛特: ...但怎麼會？
夏洛特摔倒在地，她看著
我們兩個刀刃相向。
諾拉: 說夠多了。
夏洛特: 但是...我們...我...
夏洛特: 啊...!

就這樣吧！
從她俯臥的位置，夏洛特伸手去拿她的
槍套和她的槍。

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Start of Battle
passages.content:
Norde: Enemy troops litter the cityscape.

Many citizens have fled here for safety, but many 
still are trying to make the voyage.
Pup: The soldier we met before is leading the effort to 
thin the herd of enemies, right?
Rowan: And when they reach a breaking point, then comes 
the grand finale?
Norde: I am surprised that you are still here.
Rowan: The best way to pen the chorus of glorious victory 
is to storm the enemy myself, no?
Ivan: No storming, charging, or singing of any kind.
Rowan: Very well. It will wait for a better time.
Norde: To note, the enemy appears to be hiring  
mercenaries of their own, and they may have 
some aces up their sleeve.
Norde: Avoid them if possible. There is little more to make 
a mercenary dangerous than not yet having 
their paycheck for the day.
Ivan: Our mission is to shepherd the people to safety and 
keep those within covered. Be vigilant.
Win Condition: Survive until sentry arrives. 
Lose condition: 3 villagers die, Pup, Ivan, Rowan die
passages.content_zh:
Norde：敵軍在城市景觀中亂丟垃圾。

許多市民為了安全逃到這裡，但也有許多人
仍在努力航行。
Pup：我們之前遇到的那個士兵正在帶頭努力
消滅敵人，對嗎？
羅文：當他們達到臨界點時，就會出現
大結局？
Norde：我很驚訝你還在這裡。
羅文：書寫光榮勝利大合唱的最佳方式
就是自己去強攻敵人，不是嗎？
伊凡：禁止任何形式的衝鋒、衝鋒或唱歌。
羅文：很好。它將等待更好的時機。
Norde：要注意的是，敵人似乎正在招聘
他們自己的僱傭兵，他們可能有
他們有一些王牌。
Norde：如果可能的話，避開它們。沒什麼好做的了
僱傭兵比沒有僱傭兵更危險
他們當天的薪水。
伊凡：我們的使命是引導人民安全並得到保障
把在裡面的人蓋起來。警惕。
勝利條件：生存到哨兵到來。 
失敗條件：3名村民死亡，Pup、Ivan、Rowan死亡

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Charlotte Joins
passages.content:
Female Voice: ...not going... wait around...
Another Voice: ...too dangerous... guards handle...
Civilian: Stage one complete.
Mariel: Y- You shot him!
Charlotte: Serves him right, the 3rd rate assassin from a 3rd 
rate country.
Charlotte holstered her smoking pistol.
Charlotte: I'm tired of cowering in fear. Sis, how about we 
take-
Murmurs arose from the crowd of Lockhart citizens 
around the two girls.
Civilian: Is that... Did she just...?
Civilian: The princess?! Did something happen in the 
estate?!
Charlotte: Ah- Uh... Well...
Mariel: Charlotte, we should head back inside. It's 
dangerous out here.
Charlotte: You don't need to follow me, but I'm
not going to stand idly by.
Charlotte: I rather find the person I need to grind under my 
boot to make this stop.
Charlotte: Who is in charge out here?!
Ivan: The Lockhart princess and her younger sister?

You do know we are trying to keep you and yours 
safe, yes?
Ivan: *Sigh*... But you'd be safer helping us than 
running off on your own, too...
Charlotte: Such pleasantly expedited negotiations. I'm sure 
we'll work well together.
Charlotte: Mariel, if you want to stay away from the fighting, 
then go back inside with Mother and Father or help 
heal the people gathered here.
Mariel: I mean... I...
Mariel: I'll help, too! J- Just tell me what I need to do!
Charlotte and Mariel were recruited!
Win Condition: Survive until sentry arrives. 
Lose condition: 3 villagers die, Pup, Ivan, Rowan die
Charlotte or Mariel die.
passages.content_zh:
女聲：...不...不會...等下去...
另一個聲音：...太危險了...讓守衛處理...
市民：第一階段完成。
瑪麗艾爾：妳...妳開槍打了他！
夏洛特：活該，三流國家的三流刺客。
夏洛特將冒煙的手槍放回槍套。
夏洛特：我厭倦了畏縮在恐懼中。姊姊，不如我們-
洛克哈特市民的竊竊私語從兩位女孩周圍的人群中傳出。
市民：那是...她剛才...?
市民：公主殿下？！莊園裡發生了什麼事？！
夏洛特：啊...呃...這個...
瑪麗艾爾：夏洛特，我們應該回到裡面。外面很危險。
夏洛特：妳不需要跟著我，但我
不會袖手旁觀。
夏洛特：我寧願找到那個我需要踩在腳下
才能阻止這一切的人。
夏洛特：這裡誰負責？！
伊凡：洛克哈特公主和她的妹妹？

妳們知道我們正在努力保護妳們和妳們的家人，對吧？
伊凡：*嘆氣*...但幫助我們比妳們自己亂跑更安全...
夏洛特：如此愉快且迅速的談判。我相信我們會合作愉快。
夏洛特：瑪麗艾爾，如果妳想遠離戰鬥，那就和母親和父親一起回到裡面，或者幫助治療聚集在這裡的人們。
瑪麗艾爾：我的意思是...我...
瑪麗艾爾：我也會幫忙！告...告訴我需要做什麼！
夏洛特和瑪麗艾爾被招募了！
勝利條件：存活到哨兵抵達。
失敗條件：3位村民死亡，小狗、伊凡、羅文死亡
夏洛特或瑪麗艾爾死亡。

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Bonus for Allys
passages.content: You received bonus experience for saving civilians.
passages.content_zh: 您因拯救平民而獲得了獎勵經驗。

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Bonus for Allys
passages.content: You received bonus experience for saving civilians.
passages.content_zh: 你因為拯救平民而獲得額外經驗值。

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Bonus for Allys
passages.content: You received bonus experience for saving civilians.
passages.content_zh: 您因拯救平民而獲得了獎勵經驗。

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Win con1
passages.content:
Lockhart Sentry: There we go. We've made a path.
Ivan: Hm?

It looks like the Lockhart soldiers are regrouping 
around the mansion. Let's fall back and join them.
passages.content_zh:
洛哈特哨兵：我們開始了。我們已經開闢了一條路。
伊凡：嗯？

看起來洛哈特士兵正在重新集結
豪宅周圍。讓我們退後加入他們吧。

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Charlotte → Rowan
passages.content:
Rowan: Why, hello there. How have you fared on this 
waning day, young miss?
Charlotte: We've got a jokester now? Whoever you are, 
there is a fight to focus on.
Rowan: Oh?
Charlotte: Heh. Unless you're offering to be a human shield.

We've never tested if this prototype pistol could 
shoot a round through two bodies, after all.
Rowan: As tempting as the offer is... Alas, I do require this 
body should I wish to sing the song of victory.
Rowan: I will step aside.
Charlotte: Good.
Charlotte: Stay alive, will you? I want to hear that song when 
we're done here.
Rowan: I will do my utmost.
passages.content_zh:
羅溫：唷，妳好啊。在這逐漸消逝的一天，這位年輕小姐過得如何？
夏洛特：我們現在多了個愛開玩笑的？不管你是誰，現在該專注於戰鬥。
羅溫：喔？
夏洛特：呵呵。除非你打算當個人肉盾牌。

我們還沒測試過這把原型手槍能不能一槍穿透兩個人呢，畢竟。
羅溫：這提議聽起來很誘人... 可惜，我還需要這副身軀來吟唱勝利之歌。
羅溫：我會退到一邊。
夏洛特：很好。
夏洛特：活下去，知道嗎？我希望我們結束後能聽到那首歌。
羅溫：我會竭盡所能。

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Pup → Mariel
passages.content:
Mariel: H- Hello?
Pup: Oh, one of the Lockhart girls.
Pup: No need to fear. I- ..I'll protect you.
Mariel: Protect? You?
Pup: Sorry?
Mariel: N- Nothing!
Pup: Just stay behind me when you can. I can take 
these rabble no problem.
Mariel: You'll be a great protector, I'm sure. Just lead the 
way.
Pup: Of course.
I ran off to the next fight.
Mariel: I got to make sure he stays safe.
passages.content_zh:
瑪麗埃爾：餵——餵？
小狗：噢，洛克哈特女孩之一。
小狗：不用害怕。我-..我會保護你。
瑪麗埃爾：保護？你？
小狗：對不起？
瑪麗埃爾：不——沒什麼！
Pup：如果可以的話就待在我身後吧。我可以帶
這些烏合之眾沒問題。
Mariel：我確信你會成為一個優秀的守護者。只要帶領
方式。
小狗：當然。
我跑去參加下一場戰鬥。
Mariel：我必須確保他的安全。

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Jakson → Mariel
passages.content:
Mariel: Aw~ A cute puppy. Are you lost?
Jakson: *Confused whine*?
Mariel: I suppose you're not quite a puppy, but a grand ol' 
beautiful furball.
Mariel: Where are your owners? We should-
Mariel: Huh...?!
An enemy soldier appeared from behind a corner
Mariel: N- No!
Jakson: *Angry bark*!
Jakson leaped at the enemy, quickly disarming him 
and knocking him out.
Jakson: *Angry growl*...
Mariel: ...C-... C- Cute puppy...
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
passages.content_zh:
瑪莉耶爾：哎呀～ 好可愛的小狗狗。你迷路了嗎？
傑克森：*困惑的嗚咽*？
瑪莉耶爾：我想你不太算是小狗狗了，而是一顆年邁又
美麗的毛球。
瑪莉耶爾：你的主人在哪裡？我們應該-
瑪莉耶爾：咦...？！
一名敵方士兵從角落後方出現
瑪莉耶爾：不- 不要！
傑克森：*憤怒的吠叫*！
傑克森撲向敵人，迅速解除他的武裝並擊昏他。
傑克森：*憤怒的低吼*...
瑪莉耶爾：...可-... 可- 可愛的小狗狗...
傑克森：*開心的吠叫*！

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Pup → Ivan
passages.content:
Ivan: How are you holding up, Pup?
Pup: I'm... *Pant*... good.
Ivan: Fall back if you start to lose momentum.
Pup: Right, right...
Pup: Let's go! We can do this!
I started off ahead of my father and back into the 
fray.
Pup: (We can do it. I can do it. We're strong. I'm... 
going to be strong.)
Ivan: ...
passages.content_zh:
伊凡：你還好嗎，小狗？
小狗：我……*喘氣*……很好。
伊凡：如果你開始失去動力，就退後一步。
小狗：對對對…
小狗：我們走吧！我們可以做到這一點！
我先於父親出發，然後又回到了
磨損。
小狗：（我們能做到。我能做到。我們很強大。我...
會變得堅強。 ）
伊凡：…

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Norde → Satia
passages.content:
Satia: Ah, this almost makes me nostalgic
for Belven.
Norde: What? You mean that warzone?
Satia: A crossroads of three nations... A city at their 
center?
Norde: If the Republic shows up now, the city will truly 
burn to it's foundation, you know?
Satia: Hehe~ ...Perhaps.
Satia: Ivan and Pup weren't even with the Crows back 
then. A lot of time has passed.

You and I were closer to fresh recruits around 
then, too
Satia: That's nostalgia for you, I guess.
Norde: Hmph. I suppose I can understand... a little.
passages.content_zh:
莎提雅：啊，這幾乎讓我想起貝爾芬了。
諾德：什麼？妳是指那個戰區嗎？
莎提雅：三國的交匯點... 一座位於它們中心的城市？
諾德：如果共和國現在出現，這座城市真的會被燒成灰燼，妳知道嗎？
莎提雅：呵呵～ ...或許吧。
莎提雅：伊凡和小狗當時甚至還沒加入烏鴉。已經過了很久了。

妳和我當時也比較像是剛加入的新兵
莎提雅：這就是懷舊吧，我想。
諾德：哼。我想我能理解... 一點點。

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Focus on Lord
passages.content:
Deployment Tutorial
In the Deployment/Battle Prep Menu you will be 
able to choose your units and manage their 
inventory. 
Select or deselct units in the UNIT menu.

Manage their inventory in the MANAGE Menu. You 
can also use items and other things from your base. 

To move your units around, right click to see the 
map and then right click to move your units around.
passages.content_zh:
部署教學
在部署/戰鬥準備選單中，你將能夠
選擇你的單位並管理他們的
物品欄。
在單位選單中選擇或取消選擇單位。

在管理選單中管理他們的物品欄。你
也可以使用來自你基地的物品和其他東西。

要移動你的單位，右鍵點擊以查看
地圖，然後右鍵點擊以移動你的單位。

passages.name: CH3 Pre Battle - Cont
passages.content:
Rowan: Watch out!
Pup: Huh...?
Pup: I- I... shit...
Pup: That flew right by my head!
Lockhart Sentry: Imperial scum.
Lockhart Sentry: You. Targets of this bandit. Are you friend or foe?
Pup: Who are-
Norde: We are the Nightless Crows mercenary corp. We 
were hired to help protect the city.
Lockhart Sentry: In the city itself? Bloody gold fingers had no faith, 
did they?

*Sigh*... Though I could hardly blame them at this 
point.
Pup: W- We want to help the civilians!
Lockhart Sentry: Good enough.

The people have been evacuated largely to the 
north around the governor's mansion.

If your group could reinforce that position, it would 
do a lot to let the rest of us clear out these cretin.
Ivan: Understood. We will head to the mansion, then.
Pup: R- Right... Thank you!
passages.content_zh:
羅文：小心！
小狗：啊……？
小狗：我-我...該死...
小狗：它就從我頭上飛過！
洛哈特哨兵：帝國敗類。
洛哈特哨兵：你。這個強盜的目標。你是朋友還是敵人？
小狗：誰是——
諾德：我們是不夜鴉僱傭兵團。我們
被雇用來幫助保護這座城市。
洛克哈特哨兵：在城市裡？該死的金手指沒有信仰，
他們是嗎？

*嘆氣*...雖然我很難怪他們
點。
Pup：W-我們想幫助平民！
洛哈特哨兵：夠好了。

民眾已大部分疏散至
總督府周圍向北。

如果你的團隊能夠強化這個立場，那麼它就會
做很多事情來讓我們其他人清除這些白痴。
伊凡：明白了。那我們就前往宅邸吧。
Pup：R- 好的...謝謝！

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Nora (Ivan)
passages.content:
Ivan: You've not the look of an Imperial soldier. Are you 
another hired mercenary?
Nora: I'd put up your guard, if I were you. You're not 
close to dropping mine.
passages.content_zh:
伊凡：你看起來不像帝國士兵。你是嗎
另一個僱傭兵？
諾拉：如果我是你，我就會提防你。你不是
差點就要丟掉我的了。

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Nora (Norde)
passages.content:
Nora: You'd stand with these... monsters?
Norde: Are those ears just for show? I stand with those I 
trust, of course.
Norde: Besides, I see only one monster in front of me. The 
one fighting for this atrocity.
Nora: Tsk... Self-destructive fool.
passages.content_zh:
諾拉：妳要跟這些...怪物站在一起？
諾德：那些耳朵只是裝飾品嗎？我當然是跟信任的人站在一起。
諾德：而且，我眼前只看到一個怪物。就是那個為了這場暴行而戰的人。
諾拉：嘖... 自取滅亡的蠢貨。

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Nora (Mariel)
passages.content:
Nora: Target 2 acquired.
Nora: I'd say it's nothing personal, but... well...
Mariel: I'm not afraid... I'm not afraid of you b- bullies!
passages.content_zh:
諾拉：目標 2 已鎖定。
諾拉：我會說這沒什麼私人恩怨，但是... 嗯...
瑪莉耶：我不害怕... 我不怕你們這些... 霸... 霸凌者！

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Nora (Charlotte)
passages.content:
Nora: Target 1 acquired.
Charlotte: Oh, are you part of this too? Are you another 
assassin?
Charlotte: I'll gladly use you as target practice for the damned 
"Wolf" later.
Nora: As self serving as one would expect.
Nora: For Lockhart!
passages.content_zh:
諾拉：目標 1 已獲得。
夏洛特：噢，你也參與其中嗎？你是另一個嗎
刺客？
夏洛特：我很樂意用你作為該死的靶子練習
後來的《狼》。
諾拉：正如人們所期望的那樣自私。
諾拉：為了洛哈特！

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Nora (Active)
passages.content:
Nora: Mercenaries fighting for the "princesses"? Fine, you 
will share their fate.
passages.content_zh:
諾拉：傭兵為「公主」而戰？好吧，你
將分享他們的命運。

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Nora (Dead)
passages.content:
Nora: It's no good. I have to retreat... This isn't the end 
of this!
passages.content_zh: 諾拉：不行了。我必須撤退... 這還沒完！

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Steel Wolf (Ivan)
passages.content:
Steel Wolf: Death... would suit you well.
Ivan: I know.
passages.content_zh:
鋼鐵之狼：死亡...很適合你。
伊凡：我知道。

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Steel Wolf (Pup)
passages.content:
Pup: Everyone keep going!
Pup: I- I can hold him off!
Steel Wolf: What an... empty visage.
passages.content_zh:
小狗：大家繼續加油！
小狗：我、我可以擋住他！
Steel Wolf：多麼……空洞的面孔。

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Steel Wolf (Rowan)
passages.content:
Rowan: The "Steel Wolf", is it? You've fought on the front 
lines of the crusades, too?
Steel Wolf: ...

No exceptions.
Rowan: Crap... it's no use trying to ask questions.
passages.content_zh:
羅文：「鋼鐵之狼」嗎？你也參與過聖戰前線的戰鬥？
鋼鐵之狼：……

沒有例外。
羅文：糟了……問問題沒用了。

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Sat Alive
passages.content: Satia: What's the rush for?
passages.content_zh: 薩蒂亞：急什麼？

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - SatDed
passages.content: Norde: Why are you hurrying?
passages.content_zh: 諾德：你急著去哪裡？

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Battle start
passages.content:
Norde: That... man...
Ivan: We're evacuating ourselves and these two girls to 
outside the city.
Norde: "The Steel Wolf"...?
Rowan: You know who that man is?
Charlotte: Do tell.
Norde: His armor looks similar to a man I've read about fairly 
recently.

A crusader that was extremely deadly and gained 
the nickname "Steel Wolf".
Rowan: Crusader? From out in the-
Ivan: There is no time for this!
Ivan: Norde, can we escape to outside of Lockhart?
Norde: They've created a perimeter, but it is thin.

It appears more meant to take the city than to 
entrap those within.
Norde: We'll have to break through their line, however.
Ivan: Then that's the plan. Break their line and get out.

Do whatever you can to stay alive, everyone.
Win Condition: Escape
Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan, Charlotte, Mariel,  Ivan 
die
passages.content_zh:
諾德：那個……男人……
伊凡：我們正在疏散我們自己和這兩個女孩
城外。
諾德：「鋼狼」…？
羅文：你知道那個人是誰嗎？
夏洛特：請告訴我。
Norde：他的盔甲看起來很像我讀過的一個人
最近。

一個極度致命並獲得勝利的十字軍
綽號“鋼狼”。
羅文：十字軍？從外面——
伊万：沒時間了！
伊凡：諾德，我們能逃到洛哈特外面嗎？
Norde：他們已經創造了一個邊界，但它很薄。

它似乎更傾向於佔領這座城市而不是
將那些人困在其中。
Norde：但是我們必須突破他們的防線。
伊凡：那就是這個計劃。打破他們的防線並出去。

大家盡一切努力活下去。
獲勝條件：逃脫
失去狀態：Pup、Rowan、Charlotte、Mariel、Ivan
死

passages.name: CH3 Inter - Lockhart Sentry (Steel Wolf)
passages.content:
Lockhart Sentry: How... wretched! I will end that stain you place on 
existence itself!
Steel Wolf: ...
passages.content_zh:
Lockhart Sentry: 多麼... 悲慘！我會終結你加諸於存在本身的汙點！
Steel Wolf: ...

passages.name: CH3 Inter - Lockhart Sentry (Dead)
passages.content: Lockhart Sentry: How... How did- did...?
passages.content_zh: 洛克哈特哨兵：怎... 怎麼... 怎麼會...？

passages.name: CH3 Inter - Opening
passages.content:
Lockhart Sentry: My ladies, are you alright?
Mariel: We've been... managing.
Charlotte: Let's just get to the point. What's the situation? 
How are we faring?
Lockhart Sentry: Very well, then.

The invading force inside the city has only stragglers 
remaining.
Ivan: I do believe I saw some of the soldiers retreating 
for the city limits.
Pup: Victory, then? We won?
Rowan: I do wonder...
Lockhart Sentry: Mercenary, are you suggesting what I think you 
are?
Ivan: Hm... The amount of men they'd have to hire to 
supplement the Nolvanus regiment would be 
absurd.
Ivan: That, and the soldiers they'd need to divert from 
their war with Rabaneau...
Pup: Wait? What would they need those sorts of 
numbers for?
Rowan: Surrounding the city, no?
Pup: S- Surrounding... What? How?!
Charlotte: Could they actually manage that?
Lockhart Sentry: Well... If they focus on strategic points, then it's 
not unfeasible.
Ivan: Even then, their numbers couldn't be enough to 
manage it.
Rowan: Or they simply wished to project such intent onto 
our weary minds?
Mariel: M- Maybe they were just retreating? It doesn't 
need to be some dastardly plan, right?
Charlotte: We're not about to just imagine up an answer.
Charlotte: You said we've just stragglers left? Dedicate some 
men to scout the outskirts of the city.
Lockhart Sentry: That would be most wise, my lady. For such a bold 
move as invasion, this has felt too... simple.

It would be best to-
He was cutoff by the approach of marching feet.
Rowan: It was only a matter of time.
passages.content_zh:
洛哈特哨兵：女士們，你們還好嗎？
Mariel：我們一直在…管理。
夏洛特：我們進入正題吧。什麼情況？ 
我們過得怎麼樣？
洛哈特哨兵：那麼，很好。

城內的侵略軍只有散兵游勇
剩餘。
伊凡：我相信我看到一些士兵正在撤退
對於城市範圍。
小狗：那麼勝利呢？我們贏了？
羅文：我確實想知道…
洛哈特哨兵：僱傭兵，你的建議是我認為的嗎
是？
伊凡：嗯...他們需要雇用多少人才能
補充諾瓦努斯團將是
荒謬的。
伊凡：那個，以及他們需要轉移的士兵
他們與拉巴諾的戰爭...
小狗：等等？他們需要什麼？ 
數字為?
羅文：在城市周圍，不是嗎？
Pup：S——周圍……什麼？如何？ ！
夏洛特：他們真的能做到嗎？
洛克哈特哨兵：嗯……如果他們專注於戰略點，那就是
並非不可行。
伊凡：即便如此，他們的人數也不足以
管理它。
羅文：或者他們只是希望將這種意圖投射到
我們疲憊的心靈？
Mariel：M-也許他們只是在撤退？事實並非如此
一定有什麼卑鄙的計劃吧？
夏洛特：我們不只是想出一個答案。
夏洛特：你說我們只剩下散兵游勇了？奉獻一些
男子到城郊偵察。
洛哈特哨兵：那是最明智的做法，女士。對於如此大膽的
移動即入侵，感覺太……簡單了。

最好是——
他被行進的腳步聲打斷了。
羅文：這只是時間問題。

passages.name: CH3 Inter - After march
passages.content:
Charlotte: Speak of the devil.
Pup: Is that guy a Nolvanus general?
Ivan: Yes. Do not interfere.
Ruslan: Am I speaking to a representative of the current 
Lockhart government?
Mariel: "Current"...?
Charlotte: Whatever you want to say, you can say it to me.
Ruslan: Charlotte Stewart? Heir to the Stewart Works 
conglomerate that runs the Lockhart government.

And Mariel Stewart? 2nd child of the Stewart 
Works leading family.
Charlotte: Out with it, or get out of our city.
Ruslan: Hmph...
Ruslan: Charlotte and Mariel Stewart. You and others of 
the Stewart Works group are under arrest for 
treason against Lockhart.
Charlotte: What did you just say? Choose your next words 
carefully.
Ruslan: I, as representative of the Nolvanus government, 
act as a patron to the Lockhart City Council.

Hearing of the havoc your family has caused with 
it's duplicitous dealings with the Republic...
The general motioned to the damaged cityscape 
around him.
Ruslan: ...the Emperor had no choice but to intervene 
when requested by the council itself.
Lockhart Sentry: How dare you besmirch the good name of Lockhart 
and the Stewarts!
Mariel: That's... why would they...?
Charlotte: What a bunch of- of...! ...of catshit!

When I get my hands on the necks of those 
backstabbing, scheming bastards...
Rowan: To go to such ridiculous lengths...
Pup: No one's ever going to believe that story.
Ivan: They don't need to.
Ivan: Now calm down.
Pup: Grh...
Ruslan: What say you? Will you cooperate peacefully?
Charlotte: I... will never...
Charlotte: *Sigh*...
Charlotte: We Stewarts will never bow to your invasion. Of 
that, I can say sincerely from the heart of every
one of us.
Ruslan: Very well. By force, then.
Ruslan: Best of luck, young stewards of Lockhart.
Charlotte: Get back here and die like the pitiful coward you 
are!
Charlotte stood with a smoking pistol at the end of 
her outstretched arm.
Charlotte: Goddess... damn it!
Mariel: Th- They're going to attack again?
Pup: There's no way he thinks anyone is going to buy 
that story.
Mariel: But he said it with such confidence...
Pup: Well... It could be a bluff.
Pup: Yeah. Maybe they've lost and this is a desperation 
play to bluff their way to victory?
Rowan: ...
Lockhart Sentry: My ladies, I will organize a scout to ascertain the 
situation.

You two. Please return to the mansion. Your 
parents must be worried sick.
Charlotte: I am no child. We are no children.
Lockhart Sentry: My lady...
Mariel: If... If they really have an army around the city, is it 
even safe inside?
Ivan: Some of my comrades left to do another pass. 
They should be returning soon.

If there are troops at the perimeter, they may have 
noticed and investigated.
Lockhart Sentry: Then perhaps we can-

...can...
We turned to the mansion as a silhouette began to 
take shape in the darkness.
Pup: Who is... that?
A screech enveloped our ears. Step by step, steel 
grinded the stone below.
A relaxed cadence of metal clicked with each step 
the figure took.
passages.content_zh:
夏洛特：說到魔鬼。
Pup：那傢伙是諾瓦努斯將軍嗎？
伊凡：是的。不要干涉。
魯斯蘭：我是在跟現任代表說話嗎？ 
洛克哈特政府？
瑪麗埃爾：「現在」…？
夏洛特：無論你想說什麼，都可以對我說。
魯斯蘭：夏洛特·史都華？史都華作品的繼承人
管理洛克哈特政府的企業集團。

瑪麗爾·史都華呢？史都華家族的第二個孩子
工作領導家庭。
夏綠蒂：要嘛就滾出去，要嘛滾出我們的城市。
魯斯蘭：哼…
魯斯蘭：夏洛特和瑪麗爾·史都華。你和其他人
史都華工廠集團因罪名被捕
對洛哈特的叛國罪。
夏洛特：你剛才說什麼？選擇你的下一個詞
仔細地。
魯斯蘭：我身為諾瓦努斯政府的代表，
擔任洛克哈特市議會的贊助人。

聽到你的家人造成的破壞
這是與共和國的兩面性交易......
將軍指著受損的城市景觀
他周圍。
魯斯蘭：……皇帝別無選擇，只能幹預
當理事會本身提出要求時。
洛克哈特哨兵：你怎麼敢玷汙洛克哈特的好名聲
還有史都華一家！
Mariel：那是……為什麼他們會……？
夏洛特：真是一群——！ ……狗屎！

當我把手放在那些人的脖子上時
背後捅刀、陰謀的混蛋…
羅文：竟然走得這麼荒唐…
Pup：沒有人會相信這個故事。
伊万：他們不需要。
伊凡：現在冷靜點。
小狗：呃…
魯斯蘭：你說什麼？你們會和平合作嗎？
夏洛特：我……永遠不會……
夏洛特：*嘆氣*...
夏洛特：我們史都華人永遠不會屈服於你的入侵。的
我可以真誠地對每個人說
我們中的一員。
魯斯蘭： 很好。那就用武力吧。
魯斯蘭：祝你好運，洛哈特的年輕管家。
夏綠蒂：回到這裡，像你這個可憐的膽小鬼一樣去死吧
是！
夏洛特站在最後，手裡拿著一把冒煙的手槍。 
她伸出的手臂。
夏洛特：女神……該死！
瑪麗埃爾：他們──他們又要進攻了？
小狗：他認為不可能

passages.name: CH3 Inter - Wolf Appears
passages.content:
The ill-defined shadow stepped forward, where 
dulled metal met the flickering lights of the 
moonlit city.
The figure stopped. He was trailed by a sword 
dragged haphazardly across the ground.
Ivan: ...

Friend of yours?
Mariel: He's not one of the guards.
Rowan: What? Then... is he associated with the Empire?
Pup: Huh...?
Something had caught my eye.
Charlotte: Another 3rd rate assassin?
Charlotte raised her pistol.
Charlotte: Who are you?
Pup: (What is that? It's almost like... a trail?)
Steel Wolf: ...
Charlotte: Talk. Now.
Steel Wolf: ...
Steel Wolf: You've already sent away the one willing to 
negotiate.
The voice was muffled and echoed through the 
helmet. It felt far away, in both sound and spirit.
Pup: (A trail of... something... It's like footprints. That 
and more coming from where the sword 
was dragging.)
Pup: ...?!
A flicker of the candlelight reflected a color more 
clearly than before.

Crimson.
Pup: Blood?!
Several heads turned my way with the declaration.
Charlotte: What?
Steel Wolf: ...
Charlotte's eyes dotted towards what I had 
noticed.
Charlotte: What... What did you do inside?
Steel Wolf: ...
He did not respond, as his gaze was still fixed in the
direction of me and my father.
Pup: (He... Did he...?)
Charlotte: What did you do!?
Steel Wolf: ...
The helmet turned towards her, with a creak to 
pierce the silence.
Steel Wolf: You know what.
Charlotte: You... YOU-!
passages.content_zh:
那模糊不清的影子向前走去，在
黯淡的金屬與月光照耀的城市
閃爍的燈光交會之處。
那人影停下了。他身後拖著一把劍，
隨意地在地上拖行。
伊凡：...

妳的朋友？
瑪麗耶：他不是守衛。
羅文：什麼？那... 他跟帝國有關聯嗎？
小狗：蛤...?
有什麼東西吸引了我的目光。
夏洛特：又一個三流刺客？
夏洛特舉起了她的手槍。
夏洛特：你是誰？
小狗：（那是什麼？簡直就像... 一條痕跡？）
鋼鐵之狼：...
夏洛特：說話。現在。
鋼鐵之狼：...
鋼鐵之狼：你們已經趕走了那個願意
談判的人。
那聲音聽起來悶悶的，並在
頭盔中迴盪。感覺很遙遠，無論是聲音還是精神。
小狗：（一條... 某種東西的痕跡... 就像腳印。
而且更多是從劍
拖行的地方傳來的。）
小狗：...？！
燭光的閃爍比之前更清楚地
反射出一種顏色。

深紅色。
小狗：血？！
幾顆頭隨著我的宣告轉向我。
夏洛特：什麼？
鋼鐵之狼：...
夏洛特的目光點向我
注意到的地方。
夏洛特：你... 你在裡面做了什麼？
鋼鐵之狼：...
他沒有回應，因為他的目光仍然
注視著我和我的父親。
小狗：（他... 他...？）
夏洛特：你做了什麼！？
鋼鐵之狼：...
頭盔轉向她，發出刺穿
寂靜的吱嘎聲。
鋼鐵之狼：妳知道的。
夏洛特：你... 你-！

passages.name: CH3 Inter - After battle
passages.content:
Mariel: What... just... happened?
Charlotte: He just...
Pup: Even more blood...
Rowan: Who are you?!
Steel Wolf: ...
Ivan: This isn't good.
Ivan: Everyone. Retreat. We'll head to the exterior of 
the city.
Pup: But that guy just-
Rowan: As much as I wish otherwise, he is right.
Pup: D- Dammit!
Mariel: Y- You... You... What did you do... i- inside?
Charlotte: ...!
Charlotte still had her pistol raised. Her arm shook 
without relenting.
Ivan: RUN!
Mariel: ...
Charlotte: ...
Steel Wolf: ...
The man lifted his sword off the ground.
Steel Wolf: Run.
Mariel: Charlotte, w- we should go.
Charlotte: Don't think this is the end of this. You will pay for 
this.
Steel Wolf: ...?

I wonder... is it the years, or...?
Ivan: ...
Steel Wolf: ...or have I found you?
passages.content_zh:
瑪莉耶爾：剛...剛才...發生了什麼事？
夏洛特：他剛...
小狼：更多血...
羅文：你們是誰？！
鋼鐵之狼：...
伊凡：這不妙。
伊凡：所有人。撤退。我們前往城市外圍。
小狼：可是那傢伙剛-
羅文：儘管我希望不是這樣，但他說的對。
小狼：可-可惡！
瑪莉耶爾：你...你...你...你在裡面做了什麼...什-什麼？
夏洛特：...！
夏洛特仍然舉著她的手槍。她的手臂不停地顫抖。
伊凡：跑！
瑪莉耶爾：...
夏洛特：...
鋼鐵之狼：...
那人將劍從地上舉起。
鋼鐵之狼：跑。
瑪莉耶爾：夏洛特，我-我們該走了。
夏洛特：別以為這樣就結束了。你會為此付出代價的。
鋼鐵之狼：...？

我在想...是歲月，還是...?
伊凡：...
鋼鐵之狼：...還是我找到妳了？

passages.name: CH3 Post - Lockhart Soldier (Steel Wolf)
passages.content:
Lockhart Soldier: How... wretched! I will end that stain you place on 
existence itself!
Steel Wolf: ...
passages.content_zh:
洛哈特士兵：多麼……可憐！我會消除你留下的污點
存在本身！
鋼狼：…

passages.name: CH3 Post - Lockhart Soldier (Dead)
passages.content: Lockhart Soldier: How... How did- did...?
passages.content_zh: 洛哈特士兵：怎麼……怎麼……？

passages.name: CH3 Post - Opening
passages.content:
Charlotte: Dammit!
Norde: Anton.
Pup: Right!
Mariel: Thank you.
Pup: (Already?!)
Ivan: Let's keep moving!
I turned my head toward my fellows.
Pup: (Are we going to make it at this rate?)
My head about faced.
Pup: (Maybe I could distract-)
Pup: ...?!
Pup: That... That was close.
Steel Wolf: ...
Pup: You... You picked the wrong person to die to...
I grabbed my sword and landed on my feet.
Pup: Fall!
Pup: ...!
My sword clattered against the stone beneath our 
feet, and I had fallen to a knee.
Pup: I won't let you-
Steel Wolf: Weak.
His arm raised to pierce forth one final strike.
Pup: Crap...!
I clenched my eyes shut and braced myself for 
what seemed like an eternity.
And with eternity and a second came the stinging 
pain of steel unto flesh. It buried itself within my 
shoulder.
Pup: Grh!
Pup: ...

Is that... Is that it?
Through the pain, I grabbed onto the blade of the 
sword and it cut into my hand...
Pup: You...
...and pulled the shallow dearth of steel from 
my flesh!
Pup: Is that all you-
Pup: ...have...?
Pup: Father?!
Steel Wolf: Oh...?
Pup: W- What are you doing?!
Ivan: Pup... Flee...
Footsteps accompanied the desperate growls from 
my father.

Step by step, he was driving the Steel Wolf back 
with a grip on the sword itself.
Steel Wolf: Do you wish to die?
Ivan: Pup, now!
Pup: I can help!

(Where's my sword, I can-)
Pup: ...?!
My vision blurred and wavered.

Thoughts dispersed as pain struck through my 
mind.
Pup: I... can...
Ivan: Ngh!
The sword twisted ever so slightly.
Steel Wolf: So I am to be ignored, 'hapless' crow?

All these years since Crekskia, and not even a 
word?
Ivan: Crekskia? How could you know... about that?
Steel Wolf: Am I to be forgotten, as well? After being thrown 
aside?

It seems the worth of our memory is much the 
same.

Let me shepherd you to your existence as one.
Ivan: Ah- ...Argh!!!
Ivan: Pup... go...
Pup: No, I can... I...
Pup: I can... I... I...
A stinging headache wrapped itself around my head 
and what energy I had drained to nothing.
Pup: I...
Norde: ...get away from...not be allowed to...
Norde: Grk!
Lockhart Soldier: ...get the princesses...

...them safe...

...hold him off...
With a scene crumbling around me, the shadows
of new and familar actors entered the stage.

As they did, my body gave in to pressures and 
pain beyond my understanding.

I felt weak. Weaker than I ever had before.
passages.content_zh:
Charlotte: 該死！
Norde: Anton。
Pup: 沒錯！
Mariel: 謝謝你。
Pup: (已經？！)
Ivan: 我們繼續走！
我轉頭看向我的夥伴們。
Pup: (照這個速度我們能趕上嗎？)
我的頭轉了回來。
Pup: (或許我可以分散他的注意力-)
Pup: ...？！
Pup: 好... 好險。
Steel Wolf: ...
Pup: 你... 你選錯了要殺的人...
我抓起我的劍，雙腳落地。
Pup: 倒下吧！
Pup: ...！
我的劍撞擊到我們腳下的石頭，我單膝跪地。
Pup: 我不會讓你-
Steel Wolf: 弱。
他的手臂抬起，準備刺出最後一擊。
Pup: 糟了...！
我緊閉雙眼，準備迎接彷彿永恆的時刻。
隨著永恆和一秒過去，鋼鐵刺入血肉的刺痛感襲來。它深深地刺入我的肩膀。
Pup: 呃！
Pup: ...

這... 這樣就結束了嗎？
透過疼痛，我抓住劍刃，它割傷了我的手...
Pup: 你...
...並將淺淺刺入我血肉的鋼鐵拔出！
Pup: 這就是你-
Pup: ...的全部了嗎？
Pup: 父親？！
Steel Wolf: 哦...？
Pup: 你- 你在做什麼？！
Ivan: Pup... 快逃...
腳步聲伴隨著我父親絕望的低吼。

一步一步地，他緊握著劍，將鋼鐵狼逼退。
Steel Wolf: 你想死嗎？
Ivan: Pup，現在！
Pup: 我可以幫忙！

(我的劍在哪，我可以-)
Pup: ...？！
我的視線模糊且搖晃。

思緒消散，疼痛襲擊我的大腦。
Pup: 我... 可以...
Ivan: 唔！
劍稍微扭動了一下。
Steel Wolf: 所以我就該被無視嗎，「不幸的」烏鴉？

自從克雷克斯基亞以來這麼多年，甚至連一句話都沒有？
Ivan: 克雷克斯基亞？你怎麼會知道... 關於那件事？
Steel Wolf: 我也該被遺忘嗎？在被拋棄之後？

看來我們記憶的價值是差不多的。

讓我引導你走向你作為一體的生命。
Ivan: 啊- ...啊啊啊！！！
Ivan: Pup... 走...
Pup: 不，我可以... 我...
Pup: 我可以... 我... 我...
一陣刺痛的頭痛包裹著我的頭，我僅存的精力都耗盡了

passages.name: CH3 Post - After card
passages.content:
Nameless Voice: Another story? It's not even nightfall yet.

Ah, okay, okay. What story have I not told you 
two, then?

What about... the legend of Thame and Raiga? Of 
more heroes from before the Emerald Age?

Thame was a prince of nowhere, exiled to the 
farthest reaches of civilization.

He spent his days in peace until a messenger landed 
before his gaze. A messenger that told of war.

He was called to action, but refused it. He simply 
wished for a quiet life.

War would not give it to him, though. His quaint 
village of exile burned away from the march 
of conquest.
In his anger, he reclaimed a sword of royal 
succession, and led an army through many battles 
to the doorsteps of the perpetrators.
And so they burned as well.

Thame had struck at the heart of the villains. Every 
weakness was an untold story to unravel the 
enemy.
His army continued its march to his land of origin, 
where he found his brother Raiga sitting on the 
throne.
But Raiga created a shield against Thame's strikes. 
A shield that would not crack.

With every failure, Thame's desperation grew 
and grew.

It grew until the sword thrust once more into the 
shield, only to crack itself.

So desperate to find a weakness of his brother, 
Thame had succumb to his own.

And the world knew peace, for a time.

A peace where the resilient shield glimmered in the 
sunlit sky from sea to shining sea.

From these legends came two Oathbreakers... 
Eul'raiga and Eul'thame.

One a symbol of ideals. The other a warning, like 
a double edged sword.

That even the greatest of us have cracks that can 
consume our very being.
Light filtered through the morning sky to awaken 
me.

My eyes opened, though my vision was fleeting in 
such stupor.
I forced myself out of the bed.
Pup: (What was that... dream? That memory? It's so 
hazy now.)
My arm leaned against the wall to assist my sore 
body.
And as if by instinct, I looked.
Pup: ...
Pup: ...!?
Pup: What?
I grabbed both sides of the mirror as I saw a new 
image reflect back at me.
Pup: (Is that... me?)
My hair had lengthened. My face had softened. My 
body was simply smaller than I knew it to be.
Pup: (Am I imagining it?)
My breathing increased tempo.
Pup: I- I have to be imagining it, right?
I had swiveled to remove the mirror from my view.
Pup: O- Oh...
...only to see the other bed in the room with 
someone sitting by it.
Mariel: Sorry, did I wake you?
Pup: ...No.
My eyes shifted to see the person resting in the 
second bed.
Ivan: ...
I could see him breathing from where I was. 
It was hampered, but it was breathing 
nonetheless.
Mariel: Oh, that's good.
Mariel: And... it's not your imagination.
She pointed her finger around her face to refer to 
the changes I saw.
Mariel: I was able to heal your wounds the best I could, 
but I don't know what happened there.

It's not like any disease or magic I know of.
Pup: R- Right... Right..
Mariel: Your father... He is your father, right? His wound
was worse. He's stable, but he'll likely struggle
just to stay awake as he is.
I felt what strength I had slip away as I leaned 
against the wall with my back.
Mariel: It'd be best to get what rest you can. It sounds 
like we won't be able to stay in this village much 
longer.
Mariel: Also, I just wanted to say something before I 
forget, too.

Thank you. For everything you were able to do.
For what all of you were able to do.
Mariel: For everything... you could do...
Pup: Yeah. It was... the least...
Pup: (Wait, didn't her parents...?)
Mariel had turned to continue treating my father.
Mariel: ...
Pup: ...
I slid down along the wall, and I found myself 
sitting on the floor.
Pup: ...it was... the least I could do...
Pup: ...
I averted my eyes towards the dawn peeking 
through the window.
passages.content_zh:
無名之聲：又要說故事？現在還沒到晚上呢。

啊，好吧，好吧。那我還沒跟你們兩個說過什麼故事呢？

要不要說...關於塔姆和萊迦的傳說？關於翡翠紀元之前的更多英雄？

塔姆是個無名小國的王子，被流放到文明的最遠端。

他過著平靜的生活，直到一位使者降臨在他眼前。一位帶來戰爭消息的使者。

他被召喚去戰鬥，但他拒絕了。他只想過平靜的生活。

但戰爭不允許他這麼做。他那寧靜的流放村莊，被征服的軍隊燒毀了。
在憤怒之下，他重新拿起了王室繼承的劍，並率領軍隊經過多次戰鬥，直抵罪魁禍首的家門口。
於是他們也被燒毀了。

塔姆擊中了惡棍的核心。每一個弱點都是一個未被訴說的故事，可以瓦解敵人。
他的軍隊繼續向他的故土進軍，在那裡他發現他的兄弟萊迦正坐在王位上。
但萊迦創造了一個盾牌來抵擋塔姆的攻擊。一個不會破裂的盾牌。

隨著每一次失敗，塔姆的絕望越來越深。

它不斷增長，直到劍再次刺向盾牌，卻只讓劍本身裂開。

塔姆太渴望找到他兄弟的弱點，以至於屈服於自己的弱點。

世界因此獲得了和平，一段時間的和平。

在那段和平中，堅韌的盾牌在陽光普照的天空中閃耀，從海到閃耀的海。

從這些傳說中誕生了兩個破誓者...尤爾萊迦和尤爾塔姆。

一個是理想的象徵。另一個是警告，就像一把雙刃劍。

即使是我們中最偉大的人，也有可能吞噬我們存在的裂痕。
光線穿過早晨的天空，喚醒了我。

我睜開了眼睛，但在這種昏迷狀態下，我的視力很模糊。
我強迫自己起床。
小狗：（那是什麼...夢？那段記憶？現在這麼模糊。）
我的手臂靠在牆上，以支撐我痠痛的身體。
彷彿出於本能，我看了看。
小狗：...
小狗：...！？
小狗：什麼？
我抓住鏡子的兩側，因為我看到了一個新的影像。

passages.name: CH3 Post - Enemy convo
passages.content:
Imperial Soldier: General, sir, the remaining resistance has been 
taken care of.
Ruslan: A shame. So much unnecessary bloodshed.
Ruslan: What about the Stewart Works group?
Imperial Soldier: Only the two daughters are unaccounted for.

After... well... the... t- the events of last night.
Steel Wolf: ...
Ruslan: Fled among a retinue of mercenaries, have they?
Ruslan: They won't get far with three of their number 
crippled and cursed.
He looked over to the Steel Wolf, as if expecting a 
response.
Ruslan: Hmm... "Steel Wolf"...
Ruslan: I need to mediate the transition process here in 
Lockhart.

Are you up for a hunt?
Steel Wolf: ...

Yes.
Ruslan: Then I'll leave you with some soldiers and two of 
the better mercenaries we've recruited. It should 
help you think like them.
Ruslan: You two. Get out here.
Nora: I'm ready to move out.
Jude: Yo.
Steel Wolf: ...
Nora: Wait up! Shouldn't we discuss a plan of action?
Jude: Eh, so noisy.
The three had quickly paced themselves away from 
the scene.
Imperial Soldier: Sir, are you sure you want to let... him take care of 
such an important mission?
Ruslan: Honestly, I'm not sure if that man could lose in a 
fight. He may even be excessive for this.
Ruslan: Besides, I've never seen the man speak so many 
words as what was reported.
Ruslan: Call me curious... and perhaps a little selfish.
Ruslan: With Lockhart in tow, I'd like to spend a little time 
enjoying it, after all.

To bask in the glow of the light from the end of 
the tunnel.
passages.content_zh:
帝國士兵：將軍，長官，剩下的抵抗已經結束了
得到照顧。

鋼狼：…

魯斯蘭：他們的三個人不會走太遠
殘廢並受到詛咒。
他看向鋼狼，彷彿期待著
回應。

洛克哈特。

你準備好去狩獵了嗎？

是的。
魯斯蘭：那我就留給你一些士兵和兩個
我們招募的更好的傭兵。應該
幫助您像他們一樣思考。

裘德：呃，太吵了。
三人很快就遠離了
現場。
帝國士兵：先生，您確定要讓…他來照顧嗎？

文字與報道內容相同。

魯斯蘭：有洛哈特在身邊，我想花點時間
畢竟，享受它。

沐浴在從盡頭而來的光芒中
隧道。

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Start-Story
passages.content:
Charlotte: I imagine they're treating all the towns like they're 
just some strategic objective.
Mariel: Or... worse.
Norde: Unfortunately there is little we can do bar 
continuing to move.
Rowan: We could liberate them.
Pup: Quiet.
Pup: But why couldn't we help them?
Norde: Giving ourselves up would likely not stop them from 
taking advantage of the town. Especially in the 
other towns around the area.
And it would be recklessly dangerous to try to take 
them on directly.
Pup: (I wonder...)
Mariel: The ones in the villages are likely to be on high 
alert, too.
Don't get spotted! Unless you really want to.
But the question becomes how to know where
is safe and where is not?
If you left click on an enemy, a red aura will appear. 
This means that the unit can attack any one of 
those squares. 
If you right click anywhere on the map, a yellow 
aura will appear on all enemies. This is all 
enemy's ranges combined.
The red and yellow auras can be set at the same 
time to track both "all dangerous areas" and a 
specific enemy's "dangerous area".
Use this liberally! Knowing the attacking options of
your opponent can be the difference between 
life and death!
In this map, some enemies are on high alert and 
could call for reinforcements if you are spotted by 
them!
Norde: We should keep moving. Head south to the border 
to Rabaneau.
Win Condition: Escape!

Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan or Charlotte die.
passages.content_zh:
夏洛特：我想他們對待所有城鎮都像對待他們一樣
只是一些戰略目標。
Mariel：或者……更糟。
Norde：不幸的是我們無能為力
繼續移動。
羅文：我們可以解放他們。
小狗：安靜。
Pup：但是為什麼我們不能幫助他們呢？
Norde：放棄自己可能不會阻止他們
充分利用城鎮優勢。尤其是在
該地區週邊的其他城鎮。
嘗試採取行動將是魯莽的危險
他們直接上。
小狗：（我想知道…）
Mariel：村子裡的人可能都很高
也警惕。
別被發現！除非你真的願意。
但問題是如何知道在哪裡
哪裡安全，哪裡不安全？
如果你左鍵點擊敵人，就會出現紅色光環。 
這意味著該單位可以攻擊任何一個
那些方塊。 
如果你右鍵點擊地圖上的任意位置，會出現一個黃色
所有敵人身上都會出現光環。這就是全部
敵人射程的總和。
紅色和黃色光環可以同時設置
是時候追蹤「所有危險區域」和
特定敵人的「危險區域」。
隨意使用這個！了解攻擊選項
你的對手可能是兩者之間的區別
生與死！
在這張地圖中，有些敵人處於高度戒備狀態
如果您被發現，可以呼叫增援
他們！
Norde：我們應該繼續前進。向南前往邊境
到拉巴諾。
獲勝條件：逃脫！

失敗條件：小狗、羅文或夏洛特死亡。

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Weakness Activate 1st
passages.content:
Pup: Crap... that feeling again...
Norde: I... am...

Try... to not faint from it again.
Norde said as much while his fist tightened to the 
point of shaking.
Pup: I... won't...

I won't faint.
Pup: (This will pass... I just... need to concentrate and 
avoid danger until it does.)
Feeling weak? That familiar feeling might become
all to common of a companion for Pup and co.

Those struck by a particular person's sword are
afflicted with a state of being. A state of being
that can bring on bouts of feeling weak.
It isn't a mechanic that will impact you on every
map, but rather specific maps during the story.

With that, each of these map's exact impact 
on Pup and others will change with unique
mechanics to fit the story.
In this map, you will receive a debuff. 
     -2 to speed 
     -2 to skill.
passages.content_zh:
Pup：很糟糕……又是那種感覺……
諾德：我……我……

試著……別再暈倒了。
諾德一邊說著，一邊握緊了拳頭。 
搖動點。
小狗：我…不會…

我不會暈倒的
Pup：（這會過去的...我只是...需要集中註意力
避免危險，直到危險發生為止。 ）
感覺虛弱嗎？那種熟悉的感覺可能會變成
對小狗和同伴來說，這一切都是共同的伴侶。

被特定人的劍擊中的人是
受一種存在狀態的困擾。一種存在狀態
這會帶來一陣陣的虛弱感。
它不是一個會影響你每一個面向的機制
地圖，而是故事中的特定地圖。

這樣，每張地圖的確切影響
Pup 和其他人將改變獨特的
適合故事的機制。
在此地圖中，您將收到一個減益效果。 
     -2 速度
     -2 技能。

passages.name: CH4 Battle - All Vill safe NH TF
passages.content:
Pup: Was that all the villages around here?
Charlotte: There may be more to the south, but that's 
everything in the immediate area.
Norde: How unnecessarily reckless.
Mariel: Thank you for letting us make the effort, though.
Mariel: Thank you for letting us make the effort, though.
Charlotte: Thank you for helping these places.
Norde: There was quite literally no way for me to resist at 
a point.
Charlotte: A little less of a load to put on the shoulders of 
everyone is a good thing.
Pup: Plus it makes for some good practice for me to put 
some hair on my chest.
I chuckled away at my thought and I felt a surge 
of pride from my strength in this task.
Pup: Uh...
Then I felt something weird.

I felt itchy.
Charlotte: Did I just see something fall out of your jacket?

I pulled off my jacket and saw a rain of hair 
fall out of it.

Pup: I...?!
My eyes gazed down on a set of smooth arms. The 
hair had fallen out.
Rowan: Your body hair...?

Pup: Why...?!
Norde: That is... concerning.

The event had caught me off guard, and I couldn't

"No Body Hair" TF Aquired!?

小狗：那是這裡附近所有的村莊了嗎？
夏洛特：往南邊可能還有，但這已經是附近所有的了。

瑪麗耶爾：不過還是謝謝妳讓我們盡一份心力。
瑪麗耶爾：不過還是謝謝妳讓我們盡一份心力。

我感覺很癢。

小狗：什麼...

小狗：我...？！
我的目光落在光滑的手臂上。毛髮都掉光了。
羅文：你的體毛...？
羅文：說什麼「長點毛在胸膛上」？這種疾病的喜劇時機真是太棒了。
小狗：為什麼...？！
諾德：這...令人擔憂。
諾德：不過，這更有理由繼續前進。
小狗：我只是...說不出話來...
這件事讓我措手不及，我只能再次跟著隊伍前進。
「無體毛」轉變獲得！？

傭兵？報告一定是真的，諾爾瓦努斯正在雇用傭兵來增加他們的人數。
小狗: 如果你是共和國的人，我們有一些客人你可能會想見見！
拉巴諾偵察兵: 我需要撤退並讓主力部隊知道...

你們這些帝國敗類永遠無法逃脫這種背叛！
夏洛特: 他剛剛對我們大吼大叫，好像我們是帝國的一份子？！

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Continue Midpoint
passages.content:
Geoffrey: There it is. The Imperial Army. They've really done

near Lockhart.

Geoffrey: 在那裡。帝國軍隊。他們真的做到了。

這些條件可能很簡單，像是和他們說話。或者它們可能很複雜，像是... 我們現在先別深入探討。
無論如何，留意可能性！
Pup: 也許我們可以強行突破...？

（我不想去一個我父親可能不會跟來的地方，但是... 我們還有什麼選擇？）
新目標：找到新的逃生方法！

失敗條件：Pup、Rowan、Charlotte 或 Cainan 死亡。
