Unknown_4294967295: *Sigh*... Maybe there's something useful in here?
passages.content_zh:
村民：噢，謝謝！你救了我們！你是我們的大膽
英雄們！
Unknown_4294967295：這是我們至少能做的。別擔心——
村民：給，拿著這個！還有這個！
一些隨機的東西開始填滿所有人的手
可用。
Unknown_4294967295：我-我...我該怎麼辦...
事情還在繼續。並繼續...
村民：哦，非常感謝我們的英雄！現在就一起去吧
帶著你的寶藏！
於是我們就匆匆忙忙地走了，消失在人們的視線裡。
未知_4294967295：...

這根本就是那傢伙的垃圾啊…
Unknown_4294967295：*嘆氣*...也許這裡有什麼有用的東西？

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Place Event
passages.content:
Unknown_4294967295: Down that one goes.
Villager: Where they at!? I'll... I'll...

Oh, the soldier is already down.
Unknown_4294967295: No problems here.
Villager: Guess I don't need this anymore...
The villager tossed the weapon he was holding 
into our hands before nonchalantly pivoting 
back into his house.
Unknown_4294967295: Wait, is he grateful or not?
passages.content_zh:
Unknown_4294967295: 那個傢伙倒下了。
村民: 他們在哪！？我...我...

喔，士兵已經倒下了。
Unknown_4294967295: 這裡沒問題。
村民: 看來我不再需要這個了...
村民將他手裡的武器丟到我們手上，
然後若無其事地轉身走回他的房子。
Unknown_4294967295: 等等，他到底是要感謝還是怎樣？

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Place Event
passages.content:
Villager: Why'd you have to kill the guy?! They're probably 
just going send another and blame us!
Unknown_4294967295: We're just trying to help and-
Villager: Get out! You've caused enough trouble!
Random objects started getting thrown in our 
direction.
Unknown_4294967295: Okay! We're leaving!
passages.content_zh:
村民：你為什麼要殺了那傢伙？ ！他們可能是
只是再派一個來怪我們！
Unknown_4294967295：我們只是想提供幫助並且-
村民：出去！你已經惹了夠多的麻煩了！
隨機物體開始被丟進我們的
方向。
Unknown_4294967295：好的！我們要走了！

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Active → Cainan
passages.content:
Cainan: Fleeing the violence, are you? It does appear quite 
senseless here.

I've just set off on my way myself, so perhaps I can 
escort you?
Pup: Well, we're not exactly going to say "no" to the 
assistance in all this chaos.
Cainan: I know of a nice town to the west. It should be 
out of the crossfires of this battle.
Cainan: Ah, but where are my manners?
Cainan: I am Cainan DeClares, an arbiter for The Holy Oath's 
Covenant to the Mother Soul.

I am at your service.
Cainan was recruited!
passages.content_zh:
凱南：你們也是為了躲避戰火而逃離的嗎？這裡的確是毫無意義的暴力。

我正要出發，或許我可以護送你們？
小犬：嗯，在這種混亂的情況下，我們當然不會拒絕協助。
凱南：我知道西邊有個不錯的城鎮。應該可以避開這場戰鬥的交火。
凱南：啊，但我真是失禮了。
凱南：我是凱南·迪克萊斯，聖誓母魂盟約的仲裁者。

我隨時為你們效勞。
凱南加入了隊伍！

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Active → Cainan
passages.content:
Cainan: Fleeing the violence, are you? It does appear quite 
senseless here.

I've just set off on my way myself, so perhaps I can 
escort you?
Unknown_4294967295: Well, we're not exactly going to say "no" to the 
assistance in all this chaos.
Cainan: I know of a nice town to the west. It should be 
out of the crossfires of this battle.
Cainan: Ah, but where are my manners?
Cainan: I am Cainan DeClares, an arbiter for The Holy Oath's 
Covenant to the Mother Soul.

I am at your service.
Cainan was recruited!
passages.content_zh:
該南：逃離暴力，是嗎？看起來確實相當
這裡毫無意義。

我自己才剛上路，所以也許我可以
護送你？
Unknown_4294967295：好吧，我們不會對
在這一切混亂中提供援助。
蔡南：我知道西邊有個不錯的小鎮。應該是
脫離了這場戰鬥的交火。
該南：啊，但是我的禮貌呢？
凱南：我是凱南‧德克拉雷斯，聖誓的仲裁者
與母親靈魂的契約。

我隨時為您服務。
蔡南被招募了！

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Pup → Charlotte
passages.content:
Charlotte: I need to ask... What did you see when you 
climbed that wall?
Pup: It... It was two people standing together like 
they were about to fight...
Pup: That... "Steel Wolf" along with my father.
Charlotte: So he really was there.
Pup: Yeah. I... hope my father can take care of him. Or 
get away at least.
Charlotte: I... knew the feeling, yeah.
Pup: There's been too much of this. We'll get him one 
way or another.
Charlotte: That's been the plan all along.
Pup: Good.
passages.content_zh:
夏洛特：我需要問...你爬上那面牆時看到了什麼？
小狼：那...那是兩個人站在一起，好像要打起來一樣...
小狼：那個...「鋼鐵之狼」跟我父親。
夏洛特：所以他真的在那裡。
小狼：嗯。我...希望我父親能應付他。或者至少能逃脫。
夏洛特：我...我懂那種感覺，嗯。
小狼：已經發生太多這種事了。我們無論如何都會找到他。
夏洛特：這一直是我們的計畫。
小狼：很好。

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Norde → Rowan
passages.content:
Norde: Ugh...
Rowan: If I am not mistaken... you were struck by that 
Steel Wolf as well back in Lockhart.

When you were creating an opening for your leader 
to flee.
Norde: What of it?
Rowan: An inkling, nothing more.

Be sure not to push yourself beyond any limits.
passages.content_zh:
諾德：呃…
羅文：如果我沒記錯的話…你對此感到震驚
鋼狼也回到了洛克哈特。

當你為你的領導創造一個空缺時
逃跑。
諾德：那又怎樣？
羅文：僅此而已。

一定不要讓自己超出任何限制。

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Jakson → Pup
passages.content:
Pup: Grk...! Gotta keep... going...
Jakson: *Worried Whine*...
Pup: I'll be fine... Just a bit dizzy.
Pup: And weak in the hands... and legs...
Pup: I'll be fine.
Jakson: *Doubtful bark*!
Pup: Then if I'm not, I'll rely on you to do what you 
need to, yeah?
Jakson: *Determined bark*!
passages.content_zh:
小狗：咕...！必須...繼續...走...
傑克森：*擔憂的嗚咽*...
小狗：我沒事...只是有點暈。
小狗：而且手...和腳...沒力氣...
小狗：我會沒事的。
傑克森：*懷疑的吠叫*！
小狗：如果我真的不行了，我就靠你去做你該做的，好嗎？
傑克森：*堅定的吠叫*！

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Rowan → Cainan
passages.content:
Cainan: What brings you here, Al-
Rowan: Ah! No need to say anything unnecessary.
Rowan: I go by my birthname these days. You may call me 
Rowan.
Cainan: Hm... Then, "Rowan"... What brings you here? Are 
you with them?
Rowan: I've been wandering for a time. For now, I follow in 
the steps of an intriguing image.
Rowan: You see it too, no?
Cainan: Perhaps. There is a certain resemblance to be had 
there.
Rowan: You should have seen him a few days before. After 
Lockhart and the strike of that sword...
Cainan: Strike of a sword?

...
Cainan: I suspect the continuation of this conversation best 
be had when we arrive in a safe haven, no?
Rowan: Of course, of course.
passages.content_zh:
凱南：什麼風把你吹來了，阿...
羅溫：啊！沒必要說那些多餘的。
羅溫：我最近都用我的本名。你可以叫我羅溫。
凱南：嗯... 那麼，「羅溫」... 什麼風把你吹來了？你和他們是一夥的嗎？
羅溫：我已經流浪一段時間了。目前，我追隨著一個引人入勝的景象。
羅溫：你也看到了，不是嗎？
凱南：或許吧。的確有幾分相似。
羅溫：你應該在幾天前見過他。在洛克哈特和那劍擊之後...
凱南：劍擊？

...
凱南：我認為這個對話最好等我們抵達安全的地方再繼續，如何？
羅溫：當然，當然。

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Otis (Pup)
passages.content:
Otis: Hahaha! You kittens ain't half bad, ya know?
Pup: How the hell are you swinging around that big 
axe?!
Otis: Decades of experience, kid. Decades of experience.
Pup: But... Y- You don't look any older
than me...
Otis: Hey, sometimes girls like us got to make ends 
meet.
Pup: Again with that nonsense...
Pup: Ack! It doesn't matter if you mistake me for a girl. 
You'll be going down soon enough.
passages.content_zh:
奧蒂斯：哈哈哈！你們小貓還不錯，知道嗎？
小狗：你到底是怎麼繞那麼大的？ 
斧頭？ ！
奧蒂斯：幾十年的經驗，孩子。數十年的經驗。
Pup：但是...你-你看起來不老
比我...
奧蒂斯：嘿，有時候像我們這樣的女孩必須維持生計
見面。
小狗：又胡說八道了…
小狗：嗯！即使你把我誤認為女孩也沒關係。 
很快你就會下去。

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Otis (Active)
passages.content:
Otis: You're mighty well organized. Lockhart troops or...
Otis: Well, you don't need to answer.
Otis: I can figure out anything I feel like when we're 
done.
passages.content_zh:
奧蒂斯：你的組織能力很強。洛哈特部隊或...
奧蒂斯：嗯，你不需要回答。
奧蒂斯：當我們在一起時，我可以弄清楚我的感受
完成了。

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Otis (Dead)
passages.content:
Otis: Grk! Really? This was supposed to be a trap, ya 
kids!

To think that princess was able to turn the tides.
Otis: Heh. At this point it's more fun when I get key 
hauled anyways.
Otis: Wonder what set them on this course?
passages.content_zh:
奧提斯：格！真的假的？這本來應該是陷阱，你們這些小鬼！

想不到公主居然能扭轉局勢。
奧提斯：呵呵。到了這種地步，被押走反而更有趣了。
奧提斯：真想知道是什麼讓他們走上這條路？

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Bennett (Active)
passages.content: Bennett: You owe me... like 6 bushels of apples!
passages.content_zh: 班尼特：你欠我...大概 6 蒲式耳的蘋果！

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Bennett (Dead)
passages.content:
Bennett: Aw dammit... I knew that crap alcohol would be 
the death of me...
Her body started to disintegrate.
Pup: She's disappearing?
Charlotte: Sort of... sort of like a summoned ally?
Pup: Dammit, they're still coming. We can work through 
that later!
passages.content_zh:
班尼特：噢該死……我就知道垃圾酒精會是這樣的。 
我的死...
她的身體開始崩潰。
小狗：她失蹤了？
夏洛特：有點……有點像召喚的盟友？
Pup：該死，他們還是來了。我們可以透過
稍後再說！

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Start
passages.content:
Pup: (So that girl went to the port, right?)
Otis: That Lockhart lass is wanted dead or alive!

Whichever one of you dirtbags sacks her gets the 
prime cut of meat tonight!
Many Pirates: YEAH!!!
Pup: I got a bad feeling about this.
Charlotte: A little late on that premonition?
Win Condition: Defeat Otis
Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan, Charlotte die
passages.content_zh:
Pup: (所以那個女孩去港口了，對吧？)
Otis: 那個洛克哈特小妞，無論死活都要抓到！

你們這些人渣，誰能幹掉她，今晚就賞他最好的肉！
Many Pirates: 喔!!!
Pup: 我有不祥的預感。
Charlotte: 這預感是不是有點太晚了？
勝利條件：擊敗 Otis
失敗條件：Pup、Rowan、Charlotte 死亡

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Drunk
passages.content:
Some pirates are drunk. This means their 
movement is reduced.
passages.content_zh:
有些海盜喝醉了。這意味著他們的
運動減少。

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Alley Ev 1
passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!
...found a local lottery ticket?
Pup: It's a winner?!
Pup: ...for only a little money.
Unknown_4294967295: It's a winner?!
Unknown_4294967295: ...for only a little money.
passages.content_zh:
我們的部隊進入了巷弄，然後...！
...發現了一張本地彩券？
小狗：中獎了？！
小狗：...只有一點點錢。
Unknown_4294967295：中獎了？！
Unknown_4294967295：...只有一點點錢。

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Alley Ev 2
passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!
Pirate: Ah, there they are!
Pup: That's not good...
Unknown_4294967295: That's not good...
passages.content_zh:
我們的部隊進入小巷然後…！
海盜：啊，他們在那裡！
小狗：這樣不好…
Unknown_4294967295：這不好......

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Alley Ev 3
passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!

There's a store at the end of the hallway.
passages.content_zh:
我們的部隊進入了巷弄，然後...！

走廊盡頭有一間商店。

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Alley Ev 4
passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!
Fellow Crow: Welcome, comrade. The Nightless Crows fly 
together.
passages.content_zh:
我們的部隊進入小巷然後…！
烏鴉同胞：歡迎，同志。不夜烏鴉飛翔
在一起。

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Alley Ev 5
passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!
Bennett: YEAH?! How do you like- like... them apples!?
Pirate: Fucking bitch! You owe me- *hic*... You owe me a 
beer!
Bennett: No! You...
Bennett: You... owe me... like... zzzzz...
She started sleeping on her feet.
Pirate: Give me my money!
Bennett: ...!

Give me my apples!
passages.content_zh:
我方部隊進入了巷弄，然後...！
班尼特：耶？！你覺得這招～這招...如何啊！？
海盜：他媽的賤貨！妳欠我～*嗝*...妳欠我一杯
啤酒！
班尼特：不！你...
班尼特：你...欠我...就說...zzzzz...
她開始站著睡著了。
海盜：還我錢來！
班尼特：...！

還我蘋果！

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Alley Ev 6
passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!
Pirate: I'm eating steak tonight! Hahaha!
Pup: These guys...
Unknown_4294967295: These guys...
passages.content_zh:
我們的部隊進入小巷然後…！
海盜：今晚我要吃牛排！哈哈哈！
小狗：這些傢伙…
Unknown_4294967295：這些傢伙…

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Alley Ev 7
passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!

There's a store at the end of the hallway.
passages.content_zh:
我們的部隊進入了巷弄，然後...！

走廊盡頭有一間商店。

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Alley Ev 8
passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!
Nothing.
Pup: There should be something here?
Unknown_4294967295: There should be something here?
They looked around for some time.

They didn't find anything.
passages.content_zh:
我們的部隊進入小巷然後…！
沒有什麼。
小狗：這裡應該要有什麼東西吧？
Unknown_4294967295：這裡應該有什麼？
他們環顧四周一段時間。

他們什麼也沒找到。

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Alley Ev 9
passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!
Pirate: You...?! YOU...?!
Pup: That can't be good...
Unknown_4294967295: That can't be good...
Pirate: YOOOUUUU.....?!!?!

Magnificent bastard!

Have a... *hic*! ...a tip.
He slid some money towards us before passing out.
passages.content_zh:
我們的部隊進入了巷子，然後...！
海盜：你...？！你...？！
小弟：這可不妙...
Unknown_4294967295：這可不妙...
海盜：你...？！

你這個了不起的混蛋！

拿去... *嗝*！...小費。
他在昏倒前把一些錢推向我們。

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Alley Ev 10
passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!
Nothing.

Did you expect more?

Expectations are a double edged sword.
passages.content_zh:
我們的部隊進入小巷然後…！
沒有什麼。

你還期待更多嗎？

期望是一把雙面刃。

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Alley Ev 11
passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!
It was a half open box of weapons.
Pup: Isn't this one pretty rare?
Unknown_4294967295: Isn't this one is pretty rare?
passages.content_zh:
我們的部隊進入了巷弄，然後...！
那是一個半開的武器箱。
Pup: 這個是不是挺稀有的啊？
Unknown_4294967295: 這個是不是挺稀有的啊？

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Alley Ev 12
passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!
Pirate: Heheh...
The pirates snapped their fingers in a rhythm like 
they were trying to set the mood for the fight.
Pup: I feel like you're referencing something I don't 
get...
Unknown_4294967295: I feel like you're referencing something I don't 
get...
passages.content_zh:
我們的部隊進入小巷然後…！
海賊王：呵呵…
海盜打響指的節奏就像
他們試圖為戰鬥營造氣氛。
Pup：我覺得你在引用一些我沒有提到的東西
得到...
Unknown_4294967295：我覺得你在引用一些我沒提到的東西
得到...

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Place Event
passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!
Shop Owner: Ah, yes. The one foretold to conquer the world...!

Or something like that. Hurry up, I need to close 
up.
passages.content_zh:
我們的部隊進入了巷弄，然後...！
店家老闆：啊，沒錯。就是那位被預言將征服世界之人...！

還是類似那樣的。快點，我要打烊了。

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Place Event
passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!
Shop Owner: Eh? Be quick. I was just about to close up for the 
day.
passages.content_zh:
我們的部隊進入小巷然後…！
店主：嗯？快點。我正要關閉
一天。

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Charlotte → Rowan
passages.content:
Rowan: ...
Rowan placed himself in Charlotte's view.
Charlotte: Line of sight, please.
Rowan: Do you really not...?
Charlotte: Busy, bard. I really don't have time to make fun of 
you.
Rowan: I suppose some things truly never change.
passages.content_zh:
羅溫：...
羅溫將自己置於夏洛特的視線範圍內。
夏洛特：別擋視線，拜託。
羅溫：妳真的不...?
夏洛特：忙著呢，吟遊詩人。我真的沒時間取笑你。
羅溫：我想有些事情是真的永遠不會改變。

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Pup → Bennett
passages.content:
Pup: You... feeling better?
Bennett: A lot, actually. Thanks.
Bennett: This place is really not good for my health 
considering my history with alcohol.
Pup: Yeah... that... I've never tried it.
Bennett: And don't! That crap is the worst.
Bennett: Soothing, smooth... it's all just a trap.
Bennett: A delicious... intoxicating trap...
Pup: (Is this what they call a relapse?)
Bennett: Thanks again, though.
Bennett: I just sort of showed up here randomly. Not sure 
what's going on.
Bennett: You guys give me an excuse to get my bearings in 
relative safety, and I'll gladly help you out 
with... whatever is happening here.
passages.content_zh:
Pup：你……感覺好些了嗎？
貝內特：其實很多。謝謝。
班奈特：這個地方確實對我的健康不好
考慮到我的酗酒史。
Pup：是啊……那個……我從來沒有嘗試過。
貝內特：別這樣！那個垃圾是最糟糕的。
貝內特：舒緩、順利……這一切都只是個陷阱。
貝內特：一個美味的…令人陶醉的陷阱…
Pup：（這就是他們所謂的舊病復發嗎？）
貝內特：不過，再次感謝。
Bennett：我只是隨機出現在這裡。不確定
發生了什麼事。
貝內特：你們給我一個藉口讓我了解自己的狀況
相對安全，我很樂意幫助你
與…無論這裡發生什麼事。

諾爾德：小心點。畢竟，他們會追殺你們兩個的。

existent.

塔蒂亞娜：夥計，這個地方就是個垃圾場。

Unknown_4294967295: 冷靜點！
班尼特: 他媽的蘋果在哪裡？！

Unknown_4294967295: 我們...我們會買些蘋果給你！

Unknown_4294967295: 你想撤退到安全的地方嗎？

passages.name: CH 4 Post battle - Scene 6
passages.content:
Cainan: So Lockhart has fallen into Imperial hands?
Cainan: I imagine the High Seat in Oadthine must be 
panicking as we speak.
Pup: Who exactly were you again?
Cainan: As before, I am Cainan DeClares. I am an arbiter for 
The Holy Oath's Covenant to the Mother Soul.
Pup: "Arbiter"?
Cainan: It would take some time to discuss in detail, but...
Cainan: You may think of me as a hand of the Covenant. I 
travel the lands to ensure that our operations in 
towns, Vaults, and the like go well.
Cainan: While I am not one to handle political affairs, this 
has certainly had it's tendrils go beyond that benign 
of a topic.
Charlotte: I've met a few Covenant arbiters in the past. 
They're like a fancy auditor.
Cainan: That we are.
Pup: So you're an expert on all things the Goddess and 
such?
Pup: How about stuff like... the Oathbreakers?
I eyed over to Rowan, who was sitting somewhat 
to the side of the main group.
Rowan: ...?
Rowan: ...
...who only took the opportunity to smile 
in response.
Cainan: I certainly have a significant knowledge base to pull 
from, yes.

I assume you ask because of that sword from your 
story in Lockhart?
Pup: Uh... no. Wait, what about a sword?
Cainan: You were struck by sword with a diamond shaped 
hilt, yes? Then have felt bouts of weakness 
through your body since?
It matches a phenomena I know of.
Pup: Wait, wait... This is some sickness I picked up. My 
father and Norde didn't have the same symptoms 
as me.
Norde: I... should note that I have felt dizzy and 
lightheaded at times myself.
Cainan: "Eul'thame, the weakness cursing sword". 

Have you heard of it?
Pup: Eul'thame...?
???: Thame had struck at the heart of the villains. Every 
weakness was an untold story to unravel the 
enemy.
So desperate to find a weakness of his brother, 
Thame had succumb to his own.

From these legends came two Oathbreakers... 
Eul'raiga and Eul'thame.

One a symbol of ideals. The other a warning, like a 
double edged sword.

That even the greatest of us have cracks that can 
consume our very being.
Pup: The legend of Thame and Raiga...?
Cainan: You've heard of that fable? It's not commonly told 
outside of the old lands anymore.
Pup: Yeah... bedtimes stories from way back, I think.
Cainan: Regardless of the reality of it, the story embodies 
the nature of Eul'thame well.

It is the weakness cursing sword.

Those struck with it are cursed to be consumed by 
their greatest weakness.
Cainan: That is the law of the Goddess's domain it warps 
and defies. 

The law that establishes the wall between the
soul and the world beyond.
Pup: What? What does that even mean?

How are you so sure of that?
Cainan: One of my roles is to watch over the Vaults and 
their associated Guardians.
Pup: The what?
Rowan: I suppose they are not common knowledge, are 
they?
I turned my head to glare at Rowan.
Rowan: Vaults are fortresses built to protect the most 
dangerous of Oathbreakers.

Guardians are the handpicked warriors tasked with 
keeping them safe from the world outside.
Cainan: Basically, this knowledge is a prerequisite to 
doing my job well.
Pup: R- Right...
Norde: "Consumed by their greatest weakness"... Anton, 
Ivan, and I were all struck in battle by it.
Cainan: It will vary from person to person.
Cainan: For most, to be "consumed by their weakness" 
means a slow and painful death, though.
Satia: How does one remove this curse, then?
Norde: And a cure for this state of being?
Cainan: Well... cures for it are... 

It is an Oathbreaker. Do remember that.

Perhaps manipulating the source can reverse the 
effect?
Norde: No cure, then?
Cainan: The effects may be able to be masked, as well?
Pup: Grr... I...
I slammed my hands on the table and pushed 
myself to my feet.
Pup: Then I'll just become strong enough that I have no 
weaknesses!
The screech of the chair I was sitting in echoed 
through the room as it fell to the ground.
Pup: I'll just play by its own rules and win!
Norde: Hm...
Charlotte: Mr. DeClares, do you know of a facility that could 
help mask the symptoms, as you said?

Maybe the Royal College in Cartenan?
Charlotte had basically ignored my outburst and 
just continued on with the conversation on her 
own.
Cainan: From this location? It is certainly your best option.
Charlotte: Then we'll hit two birds with one stone. We'll head 
to Cartenan for both this curse and to petition
assistance for Lockhart.
You think the Covenant would be agreeable to 
helping reclaim Lockhart?
Cainan: I couldn't imagine those in the Holy City wanting 
anything more than a return of the status quo.
Charlotte: Then let's make that two birds and a wolf with one 
stone, yeah?
Pup: What about... What about my father? The farther 
we go the harder it will be for him to follow us.
Norde: Well... we do actually have protocol for this sort of 
scenario.
Norde: I will leave a coded message with the innkeeper  
here. It should inform any Nightless Crow that  
comes.
This should also apply to the others still in Rabaneau 
that I contacted before.
Pup: Wait, but how does he know to start here?
Norde: It is... not a perfect solution.
Charlotte: If you want to stay here and wait for him, I won't 
stop you.
Pup: I... I... don't think...
Charlotte: We'll be to Cartenan as soon as we're properly 
rested and supplied.
Cainan: Then we are once more headed in the same 
direction?

Perhaps we should plan this out in more detail?
Charlotte: Gladly.
Pup: ...
As others stood up from their seats, I found myself 
falling back into one.

Footsteps felt distant as the group had a goal 
to follow.
Pup: Dad...
I took out the locket that had been passed along 
to me.

My fingers wrapped around it...
Pup: ("Consumed by your greatest weakness"...)
...and squeezed as tightly as I could.
passages.content_zh:
蔡南：那麼洛哈特已經落入帝國之手了？
Cainan：我想 Oadthine 的高座一定是
我們說話時感到驚慌。
Pup：你到底是誰？
Cainan：和以前一樣，我是 Cainan DeClares。我是仲裁者
與母親靈魂的神聖誓言。
小狗：「仲裁者」？
彩南：詳細討論還需要一些時間，但是…
該南：你可能會認為我是聖約人的手。我
走訪各地以確保我們的業務
城鎮、避難所等都進展順利。
彩南：雖然我不是處理政治事務的人，但這
它的捲鬚肯定已經超越了良性
的一個話題。
夏洛特：我過去見過幾位聖約仲裁者。 
他們就像一位出色的審計員。
蔡南：我們就是這樣。
Pup：所以你是女神所有事情的專家，
這樣的？
Pup：像……破誓者這樣的東西怎麼樣？
我看了看羅文，他坐在那裡
到主力團的一邊。
羅文：……？
羅文：…
……誰只抓住機會微笑
作為回應。
Cainan：我當然有豐富的知識基礎可以藉鏡
從，是的。

我猜你這麼問是因為你的那把劍
洛哈特的故事？
小狗：呃……不。等等，劍呢？
彩南：你被菱形劍擊中了
刀柄，是嗎？然後感到一陣陣無力
從那以後通過你的身體？
它符合我所知道的一個現象。
Pup：等等，等等……這是我得的病。我的
父親和諾德沒有相同的症狀
就像我一樣。
Norde：我……應該注意到我感到頭暈並且
我自己有時也會頭暈。
凱南：「尤瑟姆，弱點詛咒劍」。 

你聽過嗎？
小狗：尤爾瑟姆……？
？ ？ ？ ：泰姆擊中了惡棍們的心。每個
弱點是一個不為人知的故事
敵人。
如此拼命尋找弟弟的弱點，
泰姆屈服於他自己的。

從這些傳說中誕生了兩個破誓者…
尤爾萊加和尤爾薩姆。

一是理想的象徵。另一個是警告，例如
雙刃劍。

即使是我們中最偉大的人也有

passages.name: CH 4 Post battle - Scene 7
passages.content:
Ivan: ...
Steel Wolf: ...
Ivan: ...
Steel Wolf: Hm...?

You've lost your gray, old man.
Steel Wolf: Is this the core of your demise?

Your wanting... spinning in futility.
Imperial Soldier: Sir! We've had a report that the targets have 
cleared the battlefield.
Steel Wolf: I do not care.
Imperial Soldier: But sir, we-
The soldier fell into ground, blood pooling 
around his body.
Steel Wolf: I. Do. Not. Care.
Ivan: ...?!
Seeing an opportunity, Ivan rushed towards his 
target with his lance angled for a killing blow.
And it...!
Ivan: ...!

...
Ivan: I...
The lance stopped mid flight. The tip of steel 
served only to tap the armor of the Steel Wolf 
with the lightest touch.
Ivan: I... can't...

I've already killed you once.
Steel Wolf: Hmph.
A metal clad hand raised to grab the shaft of the 
weapon.
Steel Wolf: Even as you become a phantom of those days, you 
waver on these regrets.

Your gray took your wounds with it, but not your 
weakness.
Ivan let go of the lance, leaving only one hand 
to remain with a grip on it.
The lance broke in two as the Steel Wolf's grip 
shattered the shaft of it.
Ivan: I... I can't...
Ivan faltered backwards before falling to his knees.
Ivan: I can't... be the one to kill you... not again...
Steel Wolf: Weak.
The Steel Wolf turned on his heels to face 
the defeated Ivan.
Steel Wolf: Of your folly, that is among the least.
Ivan: I failed you. I failed all of you.

I only ever wanted...

...for you all to be happy.
Tears streamed down Ivan's face as he watched 
the Steel Wolf raise his sword.
Steel Wolf: No phantoms of your past will save you this time.
Ivan's eyes closed.
Steel Wolf: For those sins you've conducted.

And the sins you've created.

Let you be excised.

And a better world composed from your ashes.

...

Goodbye.
passages.content_zh:
伊凡：...
鋼鐵狼：...
伊凡：...
鋼鐵狼：嗯...?

你迷失了方向，老頭。
鋼鐵狼：這就是你滅亡的核心嗎？

你的慾望...徒勞地旋轉著。
帝國士兵：長官！我們收到報告，目標已經清空戰場。
鋼鐵狼：我不在乎。
帝國士兵：但是長官，我們-
士兵倒在地上，鮮血在他身邊匯聚。
鋼鐵狼：我。不。在。乎。
伊凡：...?!
看到機會，伊凡朝他的目標衝去，長槍的角度瞄準了致命一擊。
然後...！
伊凡：...!

...
伊凡：我...
長槍停在半空中。槍尖僅僅是輕輕地碰觸了鋼鐵狼的盔甲。
伊凡：我...不能...

我已經殺過你一次了。
鋼鐵狼：哼。
一隻金屬包裹的手抬起，抓住了武器的槍桿。
鋼鐵狼：即使你變成了那些日子的幽靈，你仍然在這些遺憾中徘徊。

你的灰色帶走了你的傷口，但沒有帶走你的軟弱。
伊凡放開了長槍，只留下一隻手仍然緊握著它。
長槍斷成了兩截，鋼鐵狼的握力粉碎了槍桿。
伊凡：我...我不能...
伊凡向後踉蹌，然後跪倒在地。
伊凡：我不能...成為殺死你的人...不能再次...
鋼鐵狼：軟弱。
鋼鐵狼轉身面對被打敗的伊凡。
鋼鐵狼：在你的愚蠢之中，這只是最微不足道的一個。
伊凡：我辜負了你。我辜負了你們所有人。

我只想要...

...你們所有人都能幸福。
眼淚順著伊凡的臉頰流下，他看著鋼鐵狼舉起了劍。
鋼鐵狼：你過去的幽靈這次不會拯救你。
伊凡閉上了眼睛。
鋼鐵狼：為了你犯下的罪孽。

以及你創造的罪孽。

讓你被清除。

並從你的灰燼中組成一個更美好的世界。

...

再見了。

passages.name: CH 4 Post battle - Scene 7.1
passages.content:
Pup: ...
I laid on the bed, and drifted to sleep with my 
hand tightly grasping the locket.
Even as my mind lost its grip on the world around,
my own grip only tightened more.
My blurry vision focused on a sight that seemed 
dream like.
Pup: What is...?
Around me stood a sea of darkness.

Stars glimmered and faded.

Islands among the abyss were barren and 
incomplete.
Pup: Am I dreaming?
Pup: Hm...?
A the sound of whooshing air turned my attention 
to my backside.
Aegis: ...
A silhouette had appeared from nowhere. 

It was as if it wasn't even fully formed without 
hands or feet to speak of.
Pup: Who are you, now?
Aegis: ...
It's mouth opened, but it didn't seem capable of 
finding the words.
Pup: Can you not speak?
Aegis: ...
It gritted its teeth out of frustration.
Pup: Do you want something from me?
Pup: I- I don't know... Maybe you could mime an 
answer?
Aegis: I...
Pup: Oh?
Aegis: I wish to...

I wish to protect you.
Pup: ...
I didn't know what to make of it, so I rubbed my 
eyes.
Pup: ...?
The silhouette had disappeared as quickly as it 
appeared.

Bewildered, I rubbed my eyes again.
But this time... 

...I woke up.
passages.content_zh:
小狗：…
我躺在床上，和我的孩子一起睡著了
手緊緊抓住墜子盒。
即使我的思緒失去了對周遭世界的控制，
我自己的抓得更緊了。
我模糊的視線聚焦在似乎
夢想般。
小狗：什麼是…？
我的周圍是一片黑暗的海洋。

星星閃爍又暗淡。

深淵中的島嶼荒蕪貧瘠
不完整。
小狗：我是在做夢嗎？
小狗：嗯……？
呼嘯的空氣聲引起了我的注意
到我的背後。
艾吉斯：…
不知從哪裡出現了一個人影。 

就好像它還沒有完全成形一樣，沒有
手或腳可說。
小狗：現在你是誰？
艾吉斯：…
它的嘴張開了，但似乎沒有能力
尋找詞語。
小狗：你能不能別說話？
艾吉斯：…
它因沮喪而咬牙切齒。
小狗：你想從我這裡得到什麼嗎？
小狗：我-我不知道...也許你可以模仿一下
回答？
艾吉斯：我…
小狗：哦？
艾吉斯：我希望…

我想保護你。
小狗：…
我不知道該怎麼辦，所以我揉了揉我的臉
眼睛。
小狗：……？
人影也快的消失了
出現了。

我一臉茫然，又揉了揉眼睛。
但這次...

……我醒了。

passages.name: Ch 3-4's Supply Run - Talk
passages.content:
Clock: *Tick*

*Tick*

*Tick*
Pup: ...
My heart beated to the tick of the clock.
Ivan: ...
Quiet breaths formed the chorus to stand beside it. 
It was a calm and peaceful chorus.
Pup: ...
For my part, I stared at the ceiling with my 
thoughts being washed away by the melody.
Clock: *Tick*

*Tick*

*Tick*
Mariel: Oh, sorry. 

Anton, right? You're still here?
Pup: Yeah...
Pup: I'm... sick, right?
Pup: I should keep rested.
Mariel: Actually, maybe you should...
Pup: That's what you said, right? Illness?
Mariel: Do you still feel weak?
Pup: A little, maybe. Can't say I feel like moving.
I shifted my sleeve over my eyes to block out the 
light.
Mariel: Hmm...
Mariel: Get up. Let me check you over. Maybe that will 
settle your mind?
After some prodding, I did eventually place myself 
on my own two feet again.
Mariel: Hmm...
Mariel sized up my body and took out a tape 
measure. I lifted my arms to my side so she 
could have room to work.
Mariel: Arm length... hair length... They both seem the 
same.

At least since that first change after Norde
and the soldiers saved you two.
She quickly jotted down the numbers on a sheet 
of paper.
Pup: Where did you even learn all this?
Mariel: Along with healing magic, I learned the 
fundamentals of medicine when I was at the 
academy.
Pup: "Academy"
Mariel: Theodal Royal College. I attended there as a 
student.

I've actually been considering going back for a 
couple years of advanced courses in the field.
Mariel took the tape measure and wrapped it 
around my waist.
Mariel: That's about the same, too...
Pup: So that's... like a school, or something?
Mariel: Yeah... do you not...?
Pup: I've not been to a school since Sunday school.
Pup: Even back then it was just when I could. We were 
always on the move.
Mariel: I...
Pup: I'm not stupid or anything. I was given plenty of 
lessons by Norde, Satia, and... my father.
Both of our eyes drifted to the side.
Pup: How's... he doing?
Mariel: Much better, I think. Miraculous given what all
happened to him, even.
Mariel: But it can be difficult to understand the extent of 
internal injuries, so we can't be too cautious.
After she was finished with measurements of my 
waist, she started to go a bit lower.
Pup: Oh! Y- You don't need to check there.
Mariel: I was measuring your thighs.
Mariel: My, oh my...
Pup: R- Right... My bad.
Mariel wrote down the last of her measurements.
Mariel: Everything seems to be the same as last time I 
checked.
Pup: I guess my rest must be killing it.
Pup: I'll just head back to bed, then.
I started to slink back into bed before I felt a tug 
on my sleeve.
Mariel: Actually, I was thinking...
Mariel: Maybe it'd be a good idea to get you some new 
clothes.
Pup: What?
Mariel: Those clearly don't fit you anymore.
Pup: They're fine.
Mariel: They're clearly not.
Pup: I already had the exam. Just let me sleep.
My body crawled back into the bed.

passages.content:
I turned the corner towards the door to make my 
way out of the Inn.
Pup: I said I didn't need anymore help.
Charlotte: You said for the "princess" to follow you. You didn't 
say which.
Charlotte: Plus, it sounds fun.
I was about to say something when a figure 
carrying several bags turned the corner in front 
of us.
Norde: A retinue of princesses, it seems?

Should I assume your health is improved, Anton?
Pup: Yeah, we were just heading out to buy some-
Norde: Good, then here.
A small list was pushed into my hands.
Pup: What's this?
Norde: Supplies. You can acquire the 2nd batch while 
you're out.

The others should be able to supplement your loss 
in strength, yes?
Pup: I- I'm not any weaker.
Norde: Hm...
Norde just walked by me without an additional 
word.
Pup: Dammit. That guy sometimes.
Mariel: I mean, you should be weaker since you loss some 
muscle mass, right?
Charlotte: Not that we have a good comparison from before.
Pup: I'll go back to the inn. I swear I will.
Charlotte: Fine, fine.
Back behind our path, Norde placed his bags down.
Norde: ...
He rubbed his shoulders as though they were sore 
from carrying them.
In a short while, we found ourselves at the local 
tailor's shop.
Pup: Now that I think on it, why are you two even 
here?
Mariel: To help?
Pup: It's just clothes. I'll probably just get a new shirt 
and pants anyways.
Charlotte: Why do I get the feeling you're not exactly up to 
date on fashion?
Pup: I've higher priorities than "fashion".
Pup: Plus, what help are you two? I need to try on stuff 
to see what fits best now myself.
Mariel: What do you mean?
Mariel: I have your measurements right here?
Mariel held up her notepad from the check-up 
before.
Pup: Uh- I...
My mouth just held itself agape.
Charlotte: Nice job, sis.
Charlotte: Now, then. We'll grab some stuff. You go wait over 
there. Any type you want?
Pup: Wait, no. I'm not agreeing to-
Charlotte: Not gonna work.

Last chance. Want anything in particular? Or we'll 
just pick out a nice dress for you.
Pup: I...
Fumbling out words in a slight panic, I said...
[Choice]: Something classy / Something with personality / Something cool
Pup: I... I don't know. Something like what I have. With 
a coat and the basics.

Just... simple and... I guess classy, okay?
Pup: I... I don't know. Something like what I have. With 
a coat and the basics.

Just... something with personality, I guess?
Pup: I... I don't know. Something like what I have. With 
a coat and the basics.

Just... something cool? Like a mercenary would 
wear?
Charlotte: That's plenty for us to go on.
Mariel: We'll get you something nice.
Pup: But...
I reached out, but I felt my motivation to resist 
slowly crumble. It wasn't long before I moved to a 
changing room.
Pup: ...
Pup: Grr...
I sat in a changing room getting impatient.
Pup: Girls, you there?
Charlotte: Someone's got no patience.
Charlotte: You know what? 

Let's not make him wait any longer if he's in that 
much of a rush.
Mariel: But what about the cut? It isn't meant for...
Charlotte: I'm sure it'll fit.
Pup: Girls...? Are you...?
Pup: Ah!
The changing room curtain opened to show 
Charlotte and Mariel outside with a shirt in hand.
Charlotte: Nice enthusiasm. Happy to hear you're so 
raring to go on this now.
Pup: ...
Mariel: We'll go get you a few coat options while you try 
that on.
Charlotte: Something nice and classy, then?

It'll go well with a white shirt, heheheh...
Charlotte: Something with a little flair, then?

It'll go well with a white shirt, heheheh...
Charlotte: Something cool and makes you look like you mean 
business, then?

It'll go well with a white shirt, heheheh...
Charlotte's sinister laugh was clearly in jest, but it 
still gave me an uneasy feeling.
Pup: *Sigh*... J- Just get on with it already, won't you?
Mariel: We'll be right back! You can try on the shirt while 
we're away.
Mariel: Let us know if- ...if anything seems off.
Pup: *Sigh*... Let's get this over with.
I undressed and threw on the shirt they brought.
Pup: (A little... tight around the waist?)
Pup: Yeah, this feels a bit... off.
With my sigh, my feet brought me over to look in 
the mirror.
Pup: W- What?

(That looks...)
Pup: (I didn't recognize myself at first...)
The changes were small, but they were enough to 
make me feel like I saw a different person entirely 
when I first looked in the mirror.
It was my first real time that I looked at the 
changes in depth. Especially so to have it 
without my normal gear.
Pup: (At first I thought I saw a girl... well, a boyish girl, 
but...)
My tightened fist loosened as I raised it to touch 
the glass.
Pup: (Are those my nipples sticking out?)
My other hand raised to feel my chest.

There wasn't much there, but my focus on it made 
me hyperaware of a feeling below each nipple.
Pup: (It's like a tight... hard feeling.)
Thoughts raced through my mind, but they kept 
returning to my first impression.
Pup: (Looked like a girl... looked like a girl...)
I shook my head as I tried to rid myself of the 
thought.
Pup: (No, I don't. I don't... I... don't...)
Pup: No, no no no... I'm still me.
Pup: Y- Yeah... I'm still... I'm still me.

This shirt just fits... oddly.
Charlotte: How do you like this-
Charlotte: What?!
Mariel: Oh... I...
Mariel: Are you sure you don't want measurements around 
there?
Charlotte: W- Why aren't you wearing any pants!?
Pup: Why are- Why...
I ducked behind a dresser in the room to hide 
myself.
Pup: It's a changing room!
Charlotte: We only gave you a shirt!
Pup: Who cares!? Get out!
Pup: I don't need new clothes. I don't need anything 
new.
Mariel: But those clothes don't fit. What if it gets worse, 
still?
Pup: N- No Way. It won't.
Pup: If anything I'll make sure it reverses. It's just a 
matter of training.
Pup: W- Who needs new clothes at that point?! 
It's just a waste of money!
Mariel: But...
I stormed off and left the two princesses behind.
Charlotte: Oh no, don't go~ 

Mariel was definitely about to get through to you.
Mariel: Why'd you have to go into the changing room?
Charlotte: Hmph. I wasn't in the wrong, and I can wait for his 
apology to me.
Mariel: *Sigh*... A waste of a day. Who knows how much 
time we have left before they start looking for us
here?
Charlotte: Ah, well. I had fun, at least.
Charlotte: You?
Mariel: I mean...
Mariel: A little... I guess.
Charlotte: Maybe we'll get a chance to try again in the 
future?
passages.content_zh:
我把轉角轉向門口，讓我的
走出旅館的路。

我正要說什麼，這時一道人影
提著幾個袋子在前面拐過一個彎
我們。

我應該假設你的健康狀況有改善嗎，安東？
Pup：是的，我們只是出去買一些——
Norde：好，那就到這裡吧。
一張小單子被塞到我手裡了。
小狗：這是什麼？
諾德：物資。您可以獲得第二批，同時
你出去了。

其他人應該可以彌補你的損失
在實力上，是嗎？
Pup：我──我一點也不弱。
諾德：嗯…
Norde只是從我身邊走過，沒有額外的幫助
詞。
小狗：該死。那個傢伙有時。
Mariel：我的意思是，你應該變得更弱，因為你失去了一些
肌肉量，對嗎？
夏洛特：並不是說我們和以前有很好的比較。
小狗：我要回客棧了。我發誓我會的。
夏洛特：好吧，好吧。
諾德回到我們的路後面，放下行李。
諾德：…
他揉著肩膀，好像肩膀很酸痛
從攜帶它們。
不一會兒，我們就到了當地
裁縫店。
Pup：現在想來，你們兩個為什麼會扯平呢？ 
在這裡？
瑪麗埃爾：幫忙？
小狗：只是衣服而已。我可能會買一件新襯衫
無論如何還有褲子。
夏綠蒂：為什麼我覺得你不太適合
時尚約會？
Pup：我比「時尚」更重要。
Pup：另外，你們兩個能幫什麼忙？我需要嘗試一些東西
看看現在什麼最適合我自己。
瑪麗埃爾：你什麼意思？
瑪麗埃爾：我這裡有你的尺寸嗎？
瑪麗埃爾舉起檢查時的記事本
之前。
小狗：呃-我...
我的嘴張得大大的。
夏綠蒂：幹得好，姊姊。
夏洛特：現在，那麼。我們去拿一些東西。你去等一下
那裡。有你想要的類型嗎？
小狗：等等，不行。我不同意——
夏洛特：不行。

最後一次機會。想要什麼特別的東西嗎？或者我們會
只是挑選一個好的博士
