Kara: 撤退！

我們需要...
我開始按照命令撤退，但是...
小狗: ...！
騎士: 快走... 我們... 擋住他們...！
小狗: (不...！還...沒！)
我的視線從我的感官中消失。
我僅存的意識感覺到有人抓住
我，在我倒下之前。
Norde: ...到馬那裡...騎上去...
Kara: ...可以往...東...

...到...山脈...
...
......
..............
在我們撤退時，我的意識時斷時續。
但有一段對話設法進入我的腦海。
Reagyn: ...我們的家...會發生什麼事...?
Charlotte: ...王國...會發生什麼事...?
Kara: ...
Kara: ...現在已是不可避免的事了...

passages.name: CH11-2 - Nora (Pup)
passages.content:
Pup: You don’t even understand where you
are, do you?
Nora: What are you rambling on about?
Pup: Listen clearly with those ears of
yours.

This is not a place you are welcome. You’ve no 
right to step foot in here.
Nora: As if I care. I fight for my home.
Pup: And today, I fight for one of mine.
passages.content_zh:
小狗：你根本不懂你在哪裡
是嗎？
諾拉：你在胡言亂語什麼？
小狗：用耳朵聽清楚
你的。

這不是一個不歡迎你的地方。你沒有
踏入這裡就對了。
諾拉：好像我很關心似的。我為我的家而戰。
小狗：今天，我為我的一個而戰。

passages.name: CH11-2 - Nora (Charlotte)
passages.content:
Charlotte: Hmph. Welcome to Crekskia, fox.
Nora: I see Princess A has picked up more
than just oppression from her vile
parents.
Charlotte: You don’t get to talk about my
parents.
Nora: If their sins are too much for you
to burden...
Nora: ...I’ll relieve you of them!
passages.content_zh:
夏綠蒂：哼。歡迎來到克雷斯基亞，狐狸。
諾拉：我發現 A 公主從她邪惡的
父母那裡學到的，不只是壓迫而已。
夏綠蒂：你沒資格談論我的
父母。
諾拉：如果他們的罪孽對你來說太過
沉重...
諾拉：...我會替你卸下它們！

passages.name: CH11-2 - Nora (Mariel)
passages.content:
Mariel: You...
Nora: The younger “princess”, is it?
Mariel: How... How could you do this?
Mariel: The amount of people who have died... Lockhart... 
Cartenan...

You’re just spreading death and destruction 
everywhere.
Nora: The war is not mine to fight. I fight for Lockhart.
Mariel: What?! But you’re the one who brought war 
against our home!
Nora: You know nothing of Lockhart.

I will fight for her future.

Threats to that future must be removed.
passages.content_zh:
瑪麗埃爾：你…
諾拉：年輕的“公主”，是嗎？
瑪麗埃爾：你……你怎麼能這麼做？
瑪麗埃爾：死了多少人……洛哈特……
卡特南...

你只是在傳播死亡和破壞
無處不在。
諾拉：戰爭不是我要打的。我為洛哈特而戰。
瑪麗埃爾：什麼？ ！但你是戰爭的始作俑者
反對我們的家！
諾拉：你對洛哈特一無所知。

我會為她的未來而奮鬥。

必須消除對未來的威脅。

passages.name: CH11-2 - Nora (Jude)
passages.content:
Nora: Tsk... you.
Jude: Nora.
Nora: How can you stand there? Acting as though you 
aren’t a traitor?
Jude: Traitor to who? The Empire?

Or to your own personal objectives?
Nora: ...
Jude: The Empire should pay their bills more promptly.

And you’re just one of many amongst the Imperials 
that owe me a good meal.
Jude: *Sigh*... Not that I’ll have a chance to cash out 
those favors.
Nora: Quiet. You chose your side. This ends now.
Jude: Stronger women than you have tried.
passages.content_zh:
諾拉：咳……你。
裘德：諾拉。
諾拉：你怎麼能站在那裡？表現得像你一樣
不是叛徒嗎？
裘德：背叛誰？帝國？

還是為了自己的個人目標？
諾拉：…
裘德：帝國應該更及時地支付帳單。

而你只是眾多帝國人中的一員
那欠我一頓美餐了。
Jude：*嘆氣*...並不是說我有機會兌現
那些恩惠。
諾拉：安靜。你選擇了你的立場。這件事現在結束了。
裘德：比你嘗試過的更堅強的女人。

passages.name: CH11-2 - Nora (Active)
passages.content:
Nora: You lot... I am tired of you blocking my path...
Nora: Out of my way!
passages.content_zh:
諾拉：你們這些人... 我已經厭煩你們擋我的路了...
諾拉：給我滾開！

passages.name: CH11-2 - Nora (Dead)
passages.content:
Nora: Ugh...! This...
Nora: I’m not letting you get away AGAIN.
Nora: I’ll have to fall back...
passages.content_zh:
諾拉：嗚...！這...
諾拉：我不會再讓你逃走了。
諾拉：我得撤退了...

passages.name: CH11-2 - Story
passages.content:
Charlotte: Where did Pup go?!
Kara: Do try to keep your wits about you.

With the troops about, we must be vigilant.
Charlotte: To think they would barge in here after us... 
Argh...

And where did HE go, too?
Soldier: Yeah, it's one of those mercs!
Pup: An Imperial soldier?!

(Speak of catching me off guard!)
The soldier, weapon already the ready, 
planted their foot to strike.
Pup: ...!
Soldier: ARGH!!!
Rowan: I am here to save the day~
Pup: W- What are you doing here?!
Rowan: May it be more appropriate to ask why there 
are Imperial troops here?
Rowan: Or why YOU are down here.
Pup: Well... it's...
Rowan: Complicated, yes.
Rowan: At this time, there are better enemies to best than
those questions, I'd think.
Pup: Hah... Fair.
I grabbed the hilt of my sword.
Pup: Nothing's gonna stop me from helping with my blade.
This is a fog of war map. This means that the units 
will appear as you explore the map, this includes 
your units.
Win Condition: Defeat Enemy Commander by Exit
Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan, Charlotte or Kara die
passages.content_zh:
夏洛特：小狗去哪了？
卡拉：一定要保持理智。

部隊在附近，我們必須提高警覺。
夏洛特：沒想到他們會在我們之後闖入這裡...
啊啊…

他也去了哪裡？
士兵：是的，就是那些傭兵之一！
Pup：帝國士兵？ ！

（說得讓我措手不及！）
士兵，武器已經準備好了，
他們站穩腳跟，準備發動攻擊。
小狗：……！
士兵：啊！ ！ ！
羅文：我是來拯救世界的~
小狗：你-你在這裡做什麼？ ！
羅文：也許問為什麼會更合適
帝國軍在這裡嗎？
羅文：或者說你為什麼在這裡。
小狗：呃……這是……
羅文：是的，很複雜。
羅文：此時，有比這更好的敵人
我想這些問題。
小狗：哈...公平。
我抓住了我的劍柄。
小狗：沒有什麼能阻止我用我的刀片幫忙。
這是一張戰爭迷霧地圖。這意味著單位
當您探索地圖時將會出現，其中包括
你的單位。
勝利條件：透過退出擊敗敵方指揮官
失敗條件：小狗、羅文、夏洛特或卡拉死亡

passages.name: CH11-2 - Boss Room
passages.content:
Nora: There they are...

No mercy for that coward traitor of a princess.

If I must, I'll end her threat to my home myself.
passages.content_zh:
諾拉：他們在那裡...

別對那個膽小鬼叛徒公主手下留情。

如果必須，我會親手了結她對我家的威脅。

passages.name: CH11-2 - Active → Maid
passages.content:
Maid: D- Don't hurt me! Don't steal from me! They forced 
us in here!

I don't know where we are! Go harass that weird 
maid instead!  *Sniff*...
passages.content_zh:
女僕：D-別傷害我！別偷我的東西！他們強迫
我們在這裡！

我不知道我們在哪裡！去騷擾那個奇怪的人
女僕代替！  *聞一聞*...

passages.name: CH11-2 - Flynn → Maid
passages.content:
Maid: Hm...? I thought I grabbed more from those guys 
when I pickpocketed them...?

Oh, uh, hello! Please don't hurt me!
passages.content_zh:
女僕：嗯...？我還以為我從那些傢伙身上偷了更多東西...？

喔，呃，你好！請不要傷害我！

passages.name: CH11-2 - Goldilocks → Maid
passages.content:
Maid: Hm...? I thought I grabbed more from those guys 
when I pickpocketed them...?

Oh, uh, hello! Please don't hurt me!
passages.content_zh:
女僕：嗯……？我以為我從那些人那裡得到了更多
當我偷竊它們時......？

哦，呃，你好！請不要傷害我！

passages.name: CH11-2 - Macy → Maid
passages.content:
Maid: Hm...? I thought I grabbed more from those guys 
when I pickpocketed them...?

Oh, uh, hello! Please don't hurt me!
passages.content_zh:
女僕：嗯...？我還以為我從那些傢伙身上偷了更多東西呢...？

喔，呃，你好！請不要傷害我！

passages.name: CH11-2 - Active → Maid
passages.content:
Maid: You! Are you one of them!? Fighting and stealing, 
you lot! Let me give you a piece of my mind!

Oh, you aren't? Are you SURE? First we have that 
weird maid show up, then the Imperial troops...
passages.content_zh:
女僕：你！你是他們中的一員嗎！ ？打架、偷竊，
你們這群人！讓我跟你講講我的心聲吧！

哦，你不是嗎？你確定嗎？首先我們有那個
奇怪的女僕出現，然後帝國軍隊…

passages.name: CH11-2 - Flynn → Maid
passages.content:
Maid: Hm...  *Glares intently*...

At the mess ... This place could use a cleaning...

*Sigh*...
passages.content_zh:
女僕：嗯... *眼神銳利地瞪著*...

看著這髒亂的樣子... 這地方該打掃一下了...

*嘆氣*...

passages.name: CH11-2 - Goldilocks → Maid
passages.content:
Maid: Hm...  *Glares intently*...

At the mess ... This place could use a cleaning...

*Sigh*...
passages.content_zh:
女僕：嗯... *眼神銳利地瞪著*...

看著這團亂... 這地方該打掃一下了...

*嘆氣*...

passages.name: CH11-2 - Macy → Maid
passages.content:
Maid: Hm...  *Glares intently*...

At the mess ... This place could use a cleaning...

*Sigh*...
passages.content_zh:
女僕：嗯…*凝視著*…

在混亂中......這個地方需要清潔......

*嘆氣*...

passages.name: CH11-2 - Active → Maid
passages.content:
Maid: Hey. What's up?

Yeah, no worries from me. I'm used to being stolen
from.

You're not gonna steal from me? Well at least 
you're better than that weird maid.
passages.content_zh:
女僕: 嘿。怎麼啦？

是啊，我沒差啦。我早就習慣被偷東西了。

你不會偷我的東西？ 喔，至少你比那個怪女僕好多了。

passages.name: CH11-2 - Flynn → Maid
passages.content: Maid: Could've just asked for it.
passages.content_zh: 女傭：本來可以直接要求的。

passages.name: CH11-2 - Goldilocks → Maid
passages.content: Maid: Could've just asked for it.
passages.content_zh: 女僕：直接說一聲就好啦。

passages.name: CH11-2 - Macy → Maid
passages.content: Maid: Could've just asked for it.
passages.content_zh: 女傭：本來可以直接要求的。

passages.name: CH11-2 - Active → Maid
passages.content:
Macy: Hm? Oh, greetings. Are you the master of this 
abode? I can start cleaning soon.

No? Why am I here you ask? I would be delighted 
to answer. I am here due to the group of maids I 
work as a part of being pushed here by troops.
What is wrong with my voice? I do not think 
anything is strange with my voice, but I will correct 
it as soon as I am able.
I will attend to that as soon as I finish cleaning this
area. Thank you dear masters and mistresses.
passages.content_zh:
梅西：嗯？喔，您好。您是這間房子的主人嗎？我可以開始打掃了嗎。

不是嗎？您問我為什麼在這裡？我很樂意回答。我是因為我所屬的女僕團被軍隊推到這裡來的。
我的聲音怎麼了嗎？我不覺得我的聲音有什麼奇怪，但我會盡快修正。
我會在打掃完這個區域後立刻處理。謝謝您們，親愛的主人們和女主人們。

passages.name: CH11-2 - Flynn → Maid
passages.content:
Macy: Hm~mm~hm~mm~

Welcome. I'll be right there. First I must finish
dusting this area.
Macy: Hm?
Macy: H- Hey?! Why do you have that?!
Charlotte: Wait, what is this?
Macy: It's a chip that I need to keep being an effective maid
and-!
Macy: Wait... why was I being a maid...? Last I remember 
I was fighting... Elaine?

...Where am I?
Charlotte: Uh... Crekskia?
Macy: Oh Crekskia! That's...
Macy: What is a Crek-shika?
Kara: Are you okay? What this... strange item doing something
to you?
Macy: I think I'm okay now. Just made me compulsively 
want to act like a maid for a while...
Macy: I don't think I did anything too bad before you got 
it off, like-
Macy: ...sign a contract.
Macy took out a perfectly maintained piece of paper.
Charlotte: Hm? A contract?
Kara: A "Notice of Debt"... Hmm...
Macy: I'm starting to remember signing this now... I'm
screwed now if I don't re-equip that chip and be a
super-maid again...
Charlotte: What? Why?
Kara: According to the paper, debt incurred at a 
restaurant and inn.
Macy: What am I supposed to do when I wake up buck 
naked in the middle of a snowy field?

I found an inn that offered me a good meal and a
night's stay...
Macy: Next thing I know I have a contract shoved in my 
face! One that would multiply my debt by 1000 if 
broken!
Macy: Between debt and my maid mind... of course I 
didn't think twice before signing it...
Charlotte: That's not a thing.
Macy: ...
Macy: What? I think I misheard you.
Kara: Indentured Servitude Contracts like this have been
illegal since the Covenant became the dominant 
cultural power.
Macy: Cove-what?
Charlotte: Goods that can't be reclaimed - like food or housing 
- are goods a merchant needs to get payment for 
upfront.
Real merchants want to get paid, not life debt 
people.
Macy: What.
Kara: This Imperial seal on the contract looks shoddily
forged, too.
Macy: Meaning I never needed to spend the last couple months
as a maid...

...
Macy: Well, I guess I'm happy I got skilled with these
knives~
Macy grabbed back the contract and ripped it up with a
vigor.
Then she grabbed the electronic looking chip and
stomped it beneath her heel.
Macy: That jerk is gonna regret having me learn knifework...!
Charlotte: If this guy did this to other people, then he's on 
my shitlist, too.
Macy: Wait, but now I don't have food or a place to 
sleep...
Macy: I guess I do have clothes now.
Macy: A maid outfit...
Macy: Are you guys hiring, maybe?
Charlotte: I- Uh... Well, I guess we can always use more help?
Macy: Thank God I met you all!
Kara: You mean "the Goddess", no?
Macy: "Goddess" what now?

...
Macy: You know what, forget I asked. This hurts my head 
to think about.
Macy has joined the party!
passages.content_zh:
梅西：嗯~嗯~嗯~嗯~

歡迎。我馬上就到。首先我必須完成
對這個區域進行除塵。
梅西：嗯？
梅西：嘿-嘿？ ！為什麼你有那個？ ！
夏洛特：等等，這是什麼？
梅西：這是我繼續成為高效女僕所需的籌碼
還有——！
梅西：等等……為什麼我要當女僕……？最後我記得
我在戰鬥……伊萊恩？

……我在哪裡？
夏洛特：呃……Crekskia？
梅西：噢，克雷斯基亞！那是...
梅西百貨：什麼是 Crek-shika？
卡拉：你還好嗎？這是什麼……奇怪的東西在做什麼
對你來說？
梅西：我想我現在還好。簡直讓我著迷
想暫時當女僕…
梅西：我不認為在你得到你之前我做了什麼太糟糕的事
把它關掉，就像是——
梅西：……簽約。
梅西拿出一張保存完好的紙。
夏洛特：嗯？合約?
卡拉：「債務通知」…嗯…
梅西：我現在開始記得簽了這個…我
如果我不重新裝備那個晶片並成為一個，現在就完蛋了
又是超級女僕…
夏洛特：什麼？為什麼？
卡拉：根據該文件，債務發生在
餐廳和旅館。
梅西：巴克醒來後我該怎麼辦
赤裸裸地站在雪地中央？

我找到了一家旅館，為我提供了一頓美餐和一個
晚上住...
梅西：接下來我知道我的合約裡塞滿了一份合約
臉！如果我的債務增加 1000
壞了！
梅西：在債務和我的少女心之間……當然我
簽前沒有多想...
夏洛特：那不是事。
梅西：…
梅西：什麼？我想我聽錯你的話了。
卡拉：像這樣的契約勞役契約已經
自《公約》成為主導以來就非法
文化力量。
梅西：海灣－什麼？
夏洛特：無法回收的物品 - 例如食物或住房
- 是商家需要付款的商品
預先。
真正的商人想要得到報酬，而不是一輩子的債務
人們。
梅西：什麼。
卡拉：合約上的印章看起來很粗劣
也是偽造的。
梅西：這意味著我不需要花最後幾個月
作為女僕...

…
梅西：嗯，我想我很高興我能熟練這些
刀~
梅西百貨

passages.content_zh:
Macy: 嗯～嗯～嗯～嗯～

歡迎光臨。我馬上過去。首先我必須先把
這個區域的灰塵擦乾淨。
Macy: 嗯？
Macy: 欸- 欸？！妳為什麼會有那個？！
Charlotte: 等等，這是什麼？
Macy: 這是我要維持有效率的女僕所需要的晶片
而且-！
Macy: 等等...我為什麼會是女僕...? 我最後的記憶
是我在戰鬥... Elaine？

...我在哪裡？
Charlotte: 呃... Crekskia？
Macy: 哦 Crekskia！那是...
Macy: 什麼是 Crek-shika？
Kara: 妳還好嗎？這個...奇怪的物品對妳做了什麼？
Macy: 我想我現在沒事了。只是讓我有一段時間強迫性地
想要表現得像個女僕...
Macy: 我想在妳拿走它之前我沒有做任何太糟糕的事情，像是-
Macy: ...簽訂合約。
Macy 拿出了一張保存完美的紙。
Charlotte: 嗯？合約？
Kara: 一張「債務通知」...嗯...
Macy: 我開始記得簽署這個了...如果我不重新裝備那個晶片並再次成為
超級女僕，我就完蛋了...
Charlotte: 什麼？為什麼？
Kara: 根據這張紙，債務發生在一家
餐廳和旅館。
Macy: 當我赤身裸體地在雪地裡醒來時，我應該怎麼辦？

我找到了一家旅館，他們提供我一頓美食和
一晚的住宿...
Macy: 接下來我就發現一張合約塞到我臉上！如果
違約，債務會增加 1000 倍！
Macy: 在債務和我的女僕思維之間...我當然
沒有三思而後行就簽了它...
Charlotte: 那是不可能的。
Macy: ...
Macy: 什麼？我想我聽錯了。
Kara: 像這樣的賣身契合約自從盟約成為
主要的文化力量以來就已經是非法的了。
Macy: 盟-什麼？
Charlotte: 無法收回的商品 - 像是食物或住宿
- 是商人需要預先獲得付款的商品。
真正的商人想要獲得報酬，而不是終身債務
的人。
Macy: 什麼。
Kara: 這份合約上的帝國印章看起來也很粗製濫造，
是偽造的。
Macy: 意思是說我根本不需要花過去幾個月
當女僕...

...
Macy: 好吧，我想我很開心我精通了這些
刀具～
Macy 咕

passages.name: CH11-2 - Pup → Kara
passages.content:
Kara: Ah, you are alive.
Kara: That is encouraging.
Pup: Not gonna fall here.
Pup: Not then, and not now.
Kara: "Then"...?
Pup: Ah... it's unimportant. Especially in the middle of a
fight.
Pup: But it's good to see you, Kara. Thank you for what
you've done today.
Kara: ...Of course.
passages.content_zh:
卡拉：啊，你還活著。
卡拉：這令人鼓舞。
小狗：不會掉在這裡。
Pup：過去不是，現在也不是。
卡拉：「然後」…？
小狗：啊……這不重要。尤其是在中間
戰鬥。
小狗：但是很高興見到你，卡拉。謝謝你什麼
你今天已經完成了。
卡拉：……當然。

passages.name: CH11-2 - Pup → Charlotte
passages.content:
Charlotte: I'm gonna have you executed, Pup.
Pup: It's good to see you, too, princess.
Charlotte: *Sigh*... No more running off, yeah?
Pup: I'll try.
Charlotte: Isn't that comforting, haha...
Charlotte: Maybe I'll have to dock your pay next time?
Pup: H- Hey... Don't go that far...
passages.content_zh:
夏洛特：我會處決你的，小狗。
小狗：很高興也見到妳，公主。
夏洛特：*嘆氣*... 不准再亂跑了，知道嗎？
小狗：我會試試。
夏洛特：真令人安心，呵呵...
夏洛特：下次或許我該扣你薪水？
小狗：欸- 欸... 別這樣啦...

passages.name: CH11-2 - Pup → Satia
passages.content:
Satia: Pup!
Satia ran up to me and quickly wrapped me in 
a tight hug.
Pup: S- Satia?!
Pup: W- What are you doing?
I blurted out the words and Satia nuzzled against
me in a happy bliss.
Satia: Quiet. I earned this. You earned this.
Pup: I- I...
Pup: *Sigh*...
Pup: It's good to see you, Satia. I'm happy you're safe.
I hugged her back quickly, and soon enough we 
swiveled to face any incoming enemy... back to 
back.
passages.content_zh:
薩蒂亞：小狗！
薩蒂亞跑向我並迅速將我包裹起來
緊緊的擁抱。
小狗：S-薩蒂亞？ ！
小狗：你-你在做什麼？
我脫口而出這句話，薩蒂亞用鼻子蹭了蹭
我處於幸福的幸福之中。
薩蒂亞：安靜。這是我賺到的。這是你應得的。
小狗：我、我…
小狗：*嘆氣*...
小狗：很高興見到你，薩蒂亞。我很高興你安全了。
我迅速回抱她，很快我們就
旋轉以面對任何來襲的敵人...回到
回來。

passages.name: CH11-2 - Pup → Norde
passages.content:
Norde: Anton.
Pup: Norde.
Norde: Did you find what you needed?
Pup: Hmm... Maybe. It may be a matter of time to really 
know though.
Pup: I... think so, at least. Or am nearly there.
Norde: Good.
Norde: Now, shall we take down these Imperials?
Pup: Yeah, I'm up for that.
passages.content_zh:
諾德：安東。
小狗：諾德。
Norde：你找到你需要的東西了嗎？
小狗：嗯……也許吧。真正實現可能只是時間問題
雖然知道。
Pup：我……至少是這麼認為。或者我快到了。
諾德：好。
Norde：現在，我們要打倒這些帝國嗎？
小狗：是的，我準備好了。

passages.name: CH11-2 - Rowan → Charlotte
passages.content:
Charlotte: Huh?! Why are you here?
Rowan: Et tu, dear Charlotte?
Rowan: You should ask that question of the troops.
Charlotte: I know the answer to that already. They're trying 
to kill me.
Rowan: A fair answer...
Rowan: Then shall I protect you, my dear friend?
Charlotte: We'll see if you can.

Maybe I'll protect you?
Rowan: I look forward to being in your debt~
passages.content_zh:
夏洛特：蛤？！你怎麼在這裡？
羅文：就連妳也這樣，親愛的夏洛特？
羅文：妳應該去問那些士兵才對。
夏洛特：我早就知道答案了。他們想殺了我。
羅文：一個公平的答案...
羅文：那麼，我來保護妳，我親愛的朋友？
夏洛特：我們就看看你能不能做到。

也許我會保護你？
羅文：我很期待欠妳人情呢～

passages.name: CH11-2 - Mariel → Satia
passages.content:
Mariel: Satia! Are you alright?
Satia: Yes, dear. I am in good condition.
Satia: One ready to rid us of this threat to you, your 
sister, Pup, and...
Mariel: And to you!
Mariel: I'll do my best to keep you safe, as well.
Satia: Sweet as that is, they are after you and others. I 
am but a wall in their road to that.
Mariel: And a beautiful and valuable wall at that!
Mariel: I'm not afraid of these people not anymore. Not 
with you all around.
Satia: ...
Satia: *Giggle*... Very well, shall we fight them 
together, then?
Mariel: Yeah!
passages.content_zh:
瑪莉耶爾：莎提亞！妳沒事吧？
莎提亞：是的，親愛的。我狀況很好。
莎提亞：我準備好為妳、妳的妹妹、小狗，還有...
瑪莉耶爾：還有妳！
瑪莉耶爾：我會盡我所能保護妳的安全。
莎提亞：妳的心意我很感激，但他們是衝著妳和其他人來的。我只不過是他們路上的阻礙。
瑪莉耶爾：而且是個美麗又珍貴的阻礙！
瑪莉耶爾：我不再害怕那些人了。有你們在，我什麼都不怕。
莎提亞：...
莎提亞：*咯咯笑*...好吧，那我們一起並肩作戰，如何？
瑪莉耶爾：好啊！

passages.name: CH11-2 - Jude → Otis
passages.content:
Jude: You were awoken as well?
Otis: Gah, yeah. That hollering bard screaming up and 
down the village.
Jude: Ah... same.
Otis: But ya actually came? Didn't think ya would fight 
your ol' crew.
Jude: It is... awkward.
Jude: Some of them still owe me a debt, too...
Otis: Heheh~

Maybe some lootin' will make ya lot even, then?
Jude: That's... maybe a bit much.
Jude: I'm not that sort of mercenary.
Otis: Ah, more loot for me, then. Maybe I'll buy ya 
somethin' tasty?
Jude: ...I wouldn't say "no" to that.
passages.content_zh:
裘德：你也醒了？
奧蒂斯：啊，是的。那個大喊大叫的吟遊詩人尖叫起來
下村子。
裘德：啊……一樣。
奧蒂斯：但是你真的來了？沒想到你會打架
你的舊船員。
裘德：這……很尷尬。
裘德：他們中的一些人還欠我一筆債…
奧蒂斯：呵呵~

那麼，也許有些搶劫就能讓你們扳平比數？
裘德：這……也許有點多了。
裘德：我不是那種唯利是圖的人。
奧蒂斯：啊，那麼給我更多的戰利品。也許我會買你
有什麼好吃的嗎？
裘德：……我不會對此說「不」。

passages.name: CH11-2 - Jakson → Atticus
passages.content:
Atticus: This place... Yes, this is a Vault.
Jakson: *Whimper*...
Atticus: There, boy.

Well get your owner out of her safely.
Jakson: *Appreciative bark*
Atticus: Though you still look nervous...

Perhaps you can sense that this place was 
important to the Pup child...?
Jakson: *Determined bark*
passages.content_zh:
阿蒂克斯：這個地方……是的，這是一個避難所。
傑克森：*嗚咽*...
阿蒂克斯：在那裡，孩子。

好吧，讓你的主人安全離開她。
傑克森：*讚賞的吠聲*
阿蒂克斯：雖然你看起來還是很緊張…

也許你能感覺到這個地方
對小狗來說很重要......？
傑克森：*確定的樹皮*

passages.name: CH11-2 - Elliot → Tatiana
passages.content:
Tatiana: Eh, what a place for the Covenant to build. This is a
Vault?
Elliot: Technically.
Elliot: This place appears unfinished, though?

Perhaps they were building out a maze as a 
protective measure...? It is safer than a straight 
tunnel to the Vault.
Tatiana: What a damn waste.
Elliot: The Covenant takes the protection of 
Oathbreakers seriously.
Tatiana: Hmph. Clearly didn't work here.
Elliot: I... suppose not.
passages.content_zh:
塔蒂亞娜：欸，真會選地方，聖約竟然在這裡建造。這是個
金庫？
艾略特：嚴格來說是。
艾略特：不過，這個地方看起來好像沒完工？

或許他們正在建造一個迷宮作為
保護措施...？這比直接通往金庫的
隧道更安全。
塔蒂亞娜：真是他媽的浪費。
艾略特：聖約非常重視對
背誓者的保護。
塔蒂亞娜：哼。顯然在這裡沒用。
艾略特：我...我想也是。

passages.name: CH11-2 - Castel → Reagyn
passages.content:
Castel: Intriguing... An entire labyrinth... just to protect an
Oathbreaker.
Reagyn: Shouldn't you be focusing on that at this time?
We've hostiles about.
Castel: Ah, such is true. But one cannot take my curiosity. 
I would not be me.
Castel: Do you not see these tunnels and rooms and have 
a rush of wonder for its nature? Its purpose?
Reagyn: Not particularly.

We're not here to gawk. We're here to do a job.

If we're not trying to work towards saving my 
homeland, it is not worth what time and resources 
I have.
Castel: Ah, but that is the key. To understand is to be able 
to achieve your goals more effectively.
Castel: See those wooden structures supporting the 
tunnel? What if we were to destroy them?
Castel: What if the enemy was to destroy them?
Reagyn: That is... true.
Reagyn: Then I'll leave such observations to you.
Castel: Of course.
passages.content_zh:
卡斯特爾：真有趣... 整個迷宮... 只是為了保護一個
背誓者。
瑞根：你現在不應該專注在那上面嗎？
我們周圍有敵意。
卡斯特爾：啊，說的是沒錯。但你不能奪走我的好奇心。
不然我就不是我了。
卡斯特爾：你難道沒看到這些隧道和房間，並對它的本質感到
一陣驚奇嗎？它的目的？
瑞根：沒有特別。

我們不是來觀光的。我們是來工作的。

如果我們不是為了拯救我的
家園而努力，那就不值得我花費時間和資源。
卡斯特爾：啊，但這才是關鍵。理解才能更有效地
達成你的目標。
卡斯特爾：看到那些支撐
隧道的木製結構了嗎？如果我們摧毀它們會怎樣？
卡斯特爾：如果敵人摧毀它們會怎樣？
瑞根：這... 倒是真的。
瑞根：那我就把這些觀察交給你了。
卡斯特爾：當然。

passages.name: CH11-2 - Flynn → Kara
passages.content:
Flynn: This place is so dark and dank...
Kara: Be strong, friend. They are as blinded as we are.
Flynn: Lady Kara...
Flynn: I understand, but... they're organized. 
We just woke up.
Kara: They're also coming off a lengthy chase. They are 
tired and we are rested.
Kara: Do no fret. They do not have the advantage. We 
do.
Flynn: That's...
Flynn: Thank you, Lady Kara. As usual, you know just 
what to say.
passages.content_zh:
弗林：這個地方又黑又濕…
卡拉：堅強點，朋友。他們和我們一樣盲目。
弗林：卡拉女士…
Flynn：我明白，但是…他們是有組織的。 
我們剛醒來。
卡拉：他們也剛結束了一場漫長的追逐。他們是
累了，我們休息了。
卡拉：別擔心。他們沒有優勢。我們
做。
弗林：那是…
弗林：謝謝你，卡拉女士。像往常一樣，你知道
說什麼。

Nora: Save your words.
Mariel: I wasn’t going to say anything.

I know you’ve closed off your heart.
Nora: I am not...

No. I’m not here to convince you.
passages.content_zh:
諾拉：記住你的話。
瑪麗埃爾：我什麼也不想說。

我知道你已經封閉了你的心。
諾拉：我不是…

不，我不是來說服你的。

passages.name: CH12-2 - Nora (Jude)
passages.content:
Nora: ...
Jude: Give up on trying to call me a traitor.?
Nora: You’re just another enemy.
Jude: I suppose so.

This is for the best.
passages.content_zh:
諾拉：...
裘德：放棄試圖說我是叛徒了嗎？
諾拉：你只是另一個敵人。
裘德：我想是吧。

這樣最好。

passages.name: CH12-2 - Story Intro
passages.content:
Charlotte: I didn't have anything to do with it!
Nora: It's a shame the tunnel collapsed. Perhaps it was
because of the minefield...?
Charlotte: Are you even listening?
Mariel: I don't think she is...
Pup: She isn't.
Nora: ...

I can hear your blathering. But it doesn't matter.

After all the pain Lockhart was put through... 
to weaponize us.
Charlotte: I already said-
Nora: I've seen it with my own eyes.

These tunnels. Your parents' involvement.
Charlotte: ...what?
Mariel: Our parents wouldn't...
Nora: As though I'd believe your crocodile tears of today.
Nora: It's only a shame we couldn't repurpose this 
atrocity of a war machine into a tool to save 
the city.
Charlotte: You mean the Empire would use these to...

How dare you-
Pup: Stop. She really isn't listening.
Nora: ...
Charlotte: But... I want to... help Lockhart.
Mariel: Yeah, me too.

She's a part of Lockhart.
Pup: Including her?
Pup: ...
I settled into a fighting stance.
Nora: ...
As did Nora and her allies.
Pup: I'll do what I can so neither of you need to 
"hurt Lockhart", at least.
Pup: I'll do what I can so you don't need to 
"hurt Lockhart", at least.
passages.content_zh:
夏洛特：我跟這件事一點關係都沒有！
諾拉：隧道崩塌真是可惜。或許是因為
地雷區的關係...？
夏洛特：妳有在聽嗎？
瑪莉耶：我不覺得她有...
小狗：她沒有。
諾拉：...

我聽得到妳們的廢話。但那不重要。

洛克哈特承受了那麼多痛苦...
卻被武器化。
夏洛特：我已經說過-
諾拉：我親眼所見。

這些隧道。妳們父母的參與。
夏洛特：...什麼？
瑪莉耶：我們的父母不會...
諾拉：好像我會相信妳們今天流的鱷魚眼淚一樣。
諾拉：只可惜我們無法將這個
戰爭機器的暴行，改造成拯救
城市的工具。
夏洛特：妳的意思是帝國會用這些來...

妳竟敢-
小狗：停。她真的沒在聽。
諾拉：...
夏洛特：但是...我想...幫助洛克哈特。
瑪莉耶：對啊，我也是。

她是洛克哈特的一部分。
小狗：包括她？
小狗：...
我擺出了戰鬥姿勢。
諾拉：...
諾拉和她的盟友也一樣。
小狗：我會盡我所能，讓妳們都不需要去
「傷害洛克哈特」，至少。
小狗：我會盡我所能，讓妳們都不需要去
「傷害洛克哈特」，至少。

passages.name: CH12-2 - Enemy 1
passages.content:
Nora's Merc: Argh...!

Just... Just finish me off.
Pup: Just stay down and you'll get to live.
Nora's Merc: Tsk... dammit. Now the Princess's goons want to
humiliate us.
Pup: We can't win this, can we?
Nora's Merc: My home of Lockhart is more important than your 
half baked gesture.

I know how this story ends.
Pup: With as many people alive as we can.

I'm not going to hurt Charlotte and your all's 
Lockhart anymore than necessary.
passages.content_zh:
諾拉的梅露可：啊啊……！

只是...就結束我吧。
小狗：只要趴下，你就能活下去。
諾拉的傭兵：嘖……該死。現在公主的暴徒想要
羞辱我們。
Pup：我們贏不了，不是嗎？
諾拉的傭兵：我洛哈特的家比你的家更重要
半熟的手勢。

我知道這個故事的結局。
Pup：我們要盡可能地活著。

我不會傷害夏綠蒂和你的一切
洛哈特已經不必要了。

passages.name: CH12-2 - Enemy 2
passages.content:
Nora's Merc: Ah, s- stupid bitches.

Just end it.
Charlotte: ...
Nora's Merc: I'm not some bleeding heart from your cursed city.

End it now.
Charlotte: ...

Rowan's Empire deserves a good fate, too. 
The people included.
Charlotte swiftly took her gun and hit the man on 
the back of the head.
He fell, knocked out, and Charlotte turned towards 
the battle again.
passages.content_zh:
諾拉的傭兵：啊，這些－－愚蠢的母狗。

結束吧。
夏洛特：…
諾拉的傭兵：我不是你們被詛咒的城市裡的一顆流血的心。

現在就結束吧。
夏洛特：…

羅文帝國也值得擁有美好的命運。 
人也包括在內。
夏洛特迅速拿起槍，朝那個男人射擊。 
後腦勺。
他摔倒了，被撞倒了，夏綠蒂轉向
再次戰鬥。

passages.name: CH12-2 - Enemy 3
passages.content:
Nora's Merc: Dammit... at least we won't be the last...

We'll reclaim Lockhart for its people. No matter 
what!
Mariel: That's my line.
Pup: I think that's Charlotte's line.
Nora's Merc: What do any of the so called Princesses of Lockhart
know of it?

*Spits*...! Nothing!
Mariel: I know its my home.
Mariel: And I know everyone there deserves a happy 
ending to this all.
Mariel: You included.
Pup: It's not just your home.

Don't speak as though you are the only one to 
decide its fate.
Nora's Merc: ...
The Lockhart mercenary gritted his teeth...
...then passed out.
passages.content_zh:
諾拉傭兵：該死...至少我們不會是最後一個...

我們會為人民奪回洛克哈特。不論
如何！
瑪麗耶：那是我的台詞。
小狗：我覺得那是夏洛特的台詞。
諾拉傭兵：那些所謂的洛克哈特公主們
又懂什麼？

*吐口水*...！什麼都不懂！
瑪麗耶：我知道那是我的家。
瑪麗耶：而且我知道那裡的每個人都值得擁有一個快樂的
結局。
瑪麗耶：包括你。
小狗：那不只是妳的家。

別說得好像只有妳能
決定它的命運。
諾拉傭兵：...
洛克哈特傭兵咬緊牙關...
...然後昏了過去。

passages.name: CH12-2 - Enemy 4
passages.content:
Charlotte: *Pant*... *pant*...
Nora's Merc: T- Take that...

...I won't... give up... now...

...for my home, I need to...
Charlotte: *Pant*... *pant*...

Neither of us... speak for Lockhart.
Nora's Merc: I won't... give it up to you...!
Charlotte: And I won't give it up to invaders.
Charlotte: I hope we can talk one day... on the future of our
home.
Charlotte pulled back her gun, and she knocked 
out the enemy mercenary.
passages.content_zh:
夏洛特：*褲子*...*褲子*...
諾拉的傭兵：T、拿著那個…

....我不會...放棄...現在...

....為了我的家，我需要...
夏洛特：*褲子*...*褲子*...

我們倆都不代表洛哈特說話。
諾拉的梅露可：我不會…把它交給你…！
夏綠蒂：我不會把它交給入侵者。
夏綠蒂：我希望有一天我們能談談......關於我們的未來
家。
夏洛特拔出槍，敲了敲門
消滅敵方僱傭兵。

passages.name: CH12-2 - Nora First Defeat
passages.content:
Nora: *Pant*...  *pant*...
Charlotte: *Pant*...  *pant*...
The two stared at each other, but their stand-off 
was stained with the reality of their dwindling 
endurance.
Charlotte: Will you... listen... already?!
Mariel: We're trying to save Lockhart!
Charlotte: We want to save Lockhart!
Nora: ...

We need no saviors...
Nora: ...least of all from oathbroken demons!
Nora had a second wind!
passages.content_zh:
諾拉：*喘*... *喘*...
夏洛特：*喘*... *喘*...
兩人互相瞪視，但她們的對峙卻被逐漸消逝的
耐力染上了現實的色彩。
夏洛特：妳... 願不願意... 聽聽我們說話？！
瑪麗埃爾：我們正在拯救洛克哈特！
夏洛特：我們也想拯救洛克哈特！
諾拉：...

我們不需要救世主...
諾拉：...尤其是來自背誓惡魔的救贖！
諾拉恢復了精力！

passages.name: CH12-2 - New Event
passages.content:
Nora: N- *Pant*... No...
Nora's armor rattled against itself as she fell to a
knee.
Pup: *Pant*... Did we... get her...?
Mariel: It's... over...
My stance was faltering, but we had won.
Charlotte: Are you finally... going... to listen...?!
Charlotte aggressively stepped past me and toward 
Nora.
Nora: ...
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte slowly raised her gun.
And it was directed straight at Nora's head.
Charlotte: Can you please... just... listen...?
Nora: ...
Nora looked back and forth, only to see her allies
being apprehended by the rest of us.
It was complete defeat.
Nora: I don't...

I don't... accept the word of traitors...
Nora had fallen down entirely as exhaustion had 
fully taken her.
She stared to the sky through the hole we created
above.
Nora: .........
Pup: That armor feeling a bit heavy now?
Mariel: After all that... it may be hard to even move...
Charlotte: I didn't know anything about these tunnels.
Nora: Trying to rewrite history as a victor already?
Charlotte: No... I...
Charlotte: Argh...!
Nora: ...
Nora's eyes shifted to the skies above.
The sky was painted in the hues of a sunset.
Nora: ...I'm sorry, everyone.

I'm sorry, Malcus.

I'm sorry, Kiolna.

Sis didn't manage it.
Nora: I entrust you all... with our future...
And she closed her eyes.
Pup: Are you asking for us to end it?
Nora: Do what you must to a non-homlyn that's worn out 
their use.
Charlotte: I do not want to kill you!
Charlotte stepped forward and kicked Nora's leg 
out of frustration.
Mariel: Sis... maybe not... the best time...
And the words stuttered out of Mariel.
Both seemed their most frustrated self despite the
victory.
Pup: Careful...
Charlotte seemed her most frustrated self despite the
victory.
Nora: ...

Spare me the tantrum.
Charlotte: I'm not...
Charlotte: *Exhale*...
Charlotte let herself calm down.
The seconds ticked by.
Charlotte: I want to... I want to save the same people you 
want to save.
Nora: You want to return to your posh life.

To continue trampling over us.

Even if some homlyns get caught up with the non-
homlyns.
Charlotte: I want... to make Lockhart safe.

To remove its enemies so we can all pursue the 
city's future... together.

For everyone.

And...
Charlotte: ...if one of those enemies is me... so be it.
Nora: ...
Nora's eyebrows furrowed.
The dismissive look on her face only deepened.
The battle was over.
We had won.
But to Charlotte...
Charlotte: ...
...she was on the edge of defeat.
Charlotte: ...
She took a deep breath.
And with a pause...
She turned back to us.
Charlotte: ...
With a gentle smile on her face.
Mariel: Sis... are you...?
Charlotte: I think I have to. If it is what I must do...
then I will.
Mariel: I...
Charlotte: ...
Mariel: ...

Charlotte, you don't have to prove anything to 
anyone.

You don't need to...

You can... You could...
Charlotte: It's okay, sis. I should've done this a long time ago.
Charlotte: And I'm sorry.
Charlotte: I'm sorry for the trouble this is going to cause.
Pup: What... do you mean?
Charlotte: It's something I should've done a long time ago.

So...
Charlotte: I'm sorry.
Charlotte turned back to Nora.
Charlotte: Here.
She extended her hand.
Nora: ...
Nora made no move.
Charlotte: Very well.
Charlotte: Could you help her up?
Imperial: Huh? But...
Charlotte: You are her allies.
Mercenary: A- Alright...
The two were watched closely as they walked over 
from the Crow that was guarding them.
They helped Nora rise to her feet.
She didn't resist, but she made no effort to help. 
So her allies continued to hold her up.
Crow: S- Sure?
A couple of the Crows we were with lifted 
Nora to her feet.
She didn't resist, but she made no effort to help. 
So the Crows continued to hold her up.
Charlotte: Thank you, you two.
Nora: So you want to make a show of it.

Just finish it.
Charlotte: I will.

I will save Lockhart.

And I will finish what I must on that path.
Nora: ...
Charlotte: *Inhale*...
She took a long, deep breath.

Charlotte's shaking hand settled with it.
Charlotte: I will save Lockhart.

I will save ALL of Lockhart.
Charlotte: That includes you.

That includes all of Lockhart. Each and every person 
is what makes Lockhart what it is.
Charlotte: That includes you.

You are part of what makes Lockhart what it is.
Nora: ...what?
Mariel: Oh, sis...
Pup: That's... what was below her hat this whole time?
Charlotte's truth was on full display.
Her ears stayed stable atop her head, 
determination radiating from her aura.
Nora: You're... nekolyn?
Charlotte: It... is a recessive trait in my family.
Nora: They'd never let you be in charge of Lockhart.

Never.
Charlotte: Exactly.

I was supposed to take this truth to the grave.

My parents loved me too much to take away my 
birthright over it.

No matter what happened. No matter how many 
times I failed...

Even when I had a genius little sister who did
everything I could do better...

They never stopped trusting in my ability to care 
for my home.

Trusting me to love Lockhart just as they did.
Nora: They... could've just not wanted the bad publicity...
Charlotte: Then do it.
Nora: What...?
Charlotte: Publish this reality in every newspaper from Zdara to
Aurelia.

Burn the Stewart legacy to the ground, and make 
sure I could never recover the status quo you so 
loathed.
If this is the path I must take to save Lockhart, 
then so be it.
Charlotte: So long as Lockhart is safe and thrives, I'd like to
think my parents would be proud of us.
Charlotte: And even if not...
Charlotte: Then I found something more important than their 
pride.
Mariel: ...
Mariel stepped up and gently wrapped her arms 
around Charlotte in a hug.
Charlotte: Sis...?
Mariel: I'm proud of you.
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte: Thank you. I'm proud of you, too.
Charlotte: After all this time, you always...
And Charlotte hugged her back.
Pup: I guess I don't really get it.

Homlyns, nekolyns... all that feels strange to get so
worked up over.
Pup: But...
Pup: That speech did make me want to fight a bit 
harder for Lockhart.
I stepped forward with a smile to greet 
Charlotte with.
Charlotte: Thank you.
And behind me was a clamoring of fellow voices 
from the group.
Many of those Crows, who were removed from the 
dynamics of a flashpoint city such as Lockhart...
We stood shoulder to shoulder.

We trusted each other with our lives.

We trusted each other with our futures.
Charlotte: All of you...
Charlotte froze a bit.
And we could see her ears twitch like a nervous 
tick.
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte: Right... this is...
Charlotte: *Sigh*... That feels... less...
Charlotte adjusted the hat, and I noticed how she
tensed up her ears to help it stay on.
Pup: Haha...
Charlotte: Quiet, you.
Charlotte turned back to Nora.
Nora: .........
Charlotte: I just... want to talk.

For Lockhart.
Charlotte: And for everyone who calls it home.
Nora: ...

I...

...

Okay.

We can... talk.
Nora: ...

I...

...

Was it... 

...all for nothing?
[Choice]:  / 
Kingdom of Cartenan - Royal Palace
Avalina: ...
Advisor: Your Majesty... We've another report of...
Avalina: ...

Of... what?
Advisor: Of... another refugee group of citizens has arrived
from the north.
Avalina: ...
Her hand reached for a loose sword near 
the throne.
But before she could consider throwing it, the door
rumbled open.
Soldier: Your Majesty!
A soldier ran into the throne room, and he was 
holding a scroll.
Avalina: What do you interrupt me with?

This had better be good.
Soldier: I- It's a message.

Delivered directly from a man of the faith.

A message from the Covenant.
[Choice]:  / 
Republic of Rabaneau - Seat of the Director
Rep. Soldier: "This message is sent in good faith, as the 
oathbearers of the Goddess may attest."

"In the name of the Goddess, we call for peace in 
these lands. We are prepared to push for this 
reality."
"In one week from the appointed delivery of this
message, the Oadthine cathedral shall be 
designated location."
"We formally invite all parties of this conflict to a
seat at the negotiating table."

"Under the guiding light of the Goddess, we shall 
make peace and prosperity for all her people."
The Republic soldier closed the scroll.
Geoffrey: What do you make of it?
Leopold: It is as she predicted.

They have been busy. The both of them.
Geoffrey: Then, my Prime Director... how shall we act on it?

Will the Republic send a representative?
Leopold: Hmm...

I shall attend myself.
Geoffrey: Are you sure?
Leopold: Yes. This is my duty.

I imagine she will attend as well.

It would be unbecoming of our nation's grand 
project if we were to not.
Geoffrey: I understand, sir.

I can imagine how it may undermine the effort if 
they were treated as unworthy of the savior of 
Rabaneau.
Unworthy of the legendary Kaeden Leopold... 
The Prime Director of the Republic.
Leopold: ...
[Choice]:  / 
Nolvanus Empire - Imperial Palace
Alexei IV: AARGHHHH!!!!!

A... PEACE summit?!

What cretin crawled behind my back to stab me so!
Inessa: To think... calling on the Covenant... it is treachery,
I tell you.
Inessa: I bet it was that bastard child who did it.
Ruslan: My emperor and empress.
Ruslan: Setback to our efforts it may seem... this may be 
an opportunity.
Simon: Indeed.
Simon: If ever there was a time to bargain, it'd be when 
the Goddess puts her neck on the line for the sake 
of peace.
Ruslan: Please do not speak on this...
Ruslan: But... yes. We could demand the return of the
farmlands.

Reparations for rebuilding our agriculture
infrastructure.
Simon: And you don't even need to let go of Lockhart.
Alexei IV: Grrr.......!
Emperor Alexei breathed raggedly, slowly turning 
to the two advisors.
Simon: And even if they insist on Lockhart being 
independent again...

Well, just make sure I stay in charge and you won't
lose your influence.
Alexei IV: ...
Inessa: I rather burn it down before surrendering our right 
to it.
Simon: ...
Alexei IV: No.

I shall attend this summit.
He turned to Ruslan.
Alexei IV: The Empire is eternal. Our sun will never set.

And those who undermine our light will see their 
head on a pike.
Ruslan: ...
Alexei IV: That is an order to see through, general.
Ruslan: Yes, my emperor.
Alexei IV: ...
And the emperor stormed past Ruslan and Simon.
Inessa: I shall retire to my quarters. I am bereft of energy.

Such... draining times.
And she quickly stepped out of the throne room 
as well.
Simon: Hmm...

Your answer... Does that mean you have an idea of 
who arranged this peace talk?
Ruslan: ...

Do not speak to me.
And so the last of the Imperials exited.
Simon: Heh. No matter.

I still have my trump card.
[Choice]:  / 
Republic/Imperial Border - Republic Base
Lieutenant: T- That's... How did a chasm get that big!?
Kara: We assume it is a result of the landmines making 
the ground unstable.

Lockhart has been digging underground tunnels for
trains to travel through.
Kara: A... tactic. To levy surprise attacks across the
warring countries.
Lieutenant: That's... nuts. How do they think of that stuff?
Kara: Most importantly... What do you figure may happen 
when the tunnel goes beneath the minefield?
Lieutenant: That... big chasm over there?

Should we send people in?
Kara: Once they realize we know, they will detonate
explosives to seal the tunnel.
Lieutenant: Right... Yeah, that makes sense.
Kara: Thank you for receiving us on such short notice 
despite that.
Lieutenant: Y- Yeah... princess of the trade city and all. 
Seemed like a no brainer.

.........

Actually, do you know?
Kara: Know what?
Lieutenant: We just received word this morning. There's going 
to be a peace summit.

I can't imagine the princess of Lockhart wouldn't be
invited.
Kara: .......

And where is it being held?
Lieutenant: Oadthine. The Holy City of the West.

We got word that we needed to create a safe 
route to Oadthine for the Prime Director.
Kara: The leader of the Republic is attending?
Lieutenant: Yeah. It must be serious if the legendary Kaeden
Leopold is taking action.
Kara: Yes. It is a well informed conclusion to come to.

.........
Kara: Then... we shall meet the Prime Director there.
Kara: To find peace... in Oadthine.
Nora has joined the party!
[Choice]:  / 
West Auran Alliance
Oadthine, the Holy City of the West
The Seat of the Goddess
Cainan: Such... tiring work, this.
Cainan sat in the halls of the grand cathedral.
He stared out the window as he watched the sun 
set in the distance.
Cainan: To move the hearts and wills of giants themselves...
Cainan: We shall all sit down together for the sake of peace.
Cainan: It is but a dream to those embroiled in this hundred
year war.
Cainan: Moved to reality by these very hands.

One would call it a miracle.

Others the will of the Goddess.
Cainan: But those who saw it done will say it be what it 
truly is.
He turned his head to within the halls.
Cainan: Now, my fellow traveler on this path.

What would you call it?
.........
Cainan: No need to be shy.
Cainan: What would you call it?
.........
Wolf: Inevitable.
Cainan: And that is the correct answer.
Cainan: This reminds me of when I tutored you in your youth.
Cainan: Such nostalgic days, those were.
Cainan got to his feet without an ounce of fear in 
his movement.
After a few more steps, he laid his hand down on 
the Steel Wolf's shoulder, giving it a firm pat.
Wolf: ...
Cainan: ...
Cainan: I trust you shall fulfill your role in this... agreement?
Wolf: I shall.
Cainan: We shall expect the Empire to attend? Emperor and all?
Wolf: They will.
Wolf's hand settled on the Oathbreaker sword 
sheathed at his hip.
Wolf: They are a slave to their weakness.
Cainan: Splendid.
Cainan: It has been nothing but a pleasure, as usual.
Cainan casually and gracefully returned to the 
window seat he called home but a minute before.
Wolf: ........
...and the Steel Wolf turned as well.
Exiting the scene.
Cainan: .........

Hahaha...

What a glorious path we tread upon.

To lead us to here.

Where we are but steps from the ascent...
Cainan: ...to the finale.

passages.content:
The sizzle of grilled sausages wafted through the 
air as a bundle was plopped down onto my plate.
Pup: (Those smell great. It's been a while, too)
Norde: You're lucky. Those were the last batch.
I looked down at the three pieces of meat I held.
Pup: Aren't they a little... burnt?
Norde: ...
Pup: Thank you for the food!
Norde: *Sigh*
Pup: This looks like a good place.
I dropped myself to sit against a solemn tree. It 
was peaceful away from the camp.
Pup: ...
Pup: (Did I hear something?)
A blink of the eyes and a turn of the head later, 
a new sight stood before me.
Jakson: *Pant*
Pup: Hey boy, what are-
Pup: H- HEY!
Jakson: *Munch*
A sausage was gulped down in one bite. 
He licked his lips and I jumped to my feet 
with two sausages still in hand.
Pup: Jakson! Bad!
Jakson turned to me, hungrily...
Pup: What are you looking at?!

YOU just stole from me! I'm not giving you another 
bite!
Jakson: *Whine*
Jakson turned his head, pleading innocence.
Pup: Not one nibble!
Pup: (Have I lost him? Does he think he's a hunter or 
something now?)
I hesitantly took a seat, readying myself to eat 
my meal.
Pup: ...
Pup: (The tall grass?! I'll be ready this time!)
The plate swiftly launched upwards as my arms 
extended it beyond the reach of the tall grass. I 
stared vigilantly for Jakson to make his move.
Pup: ...
A bird flew out of the tall grass.
Pup: ...
Pup: *Sigh*... It was just a bird... It was just a...
As my body relaxed, I had turned my head back 
towards the plate at the end of my outstretched 
arms.
Jakson: *Munch munch*
And then there was one.
Pup: Jakson! This is my meal!
I jumped to my feet and Jakson didn't move at 
first.
Pup: ...
Pup: Do not... follow me... Stay!
Pup: ...
Pup: Good boy.
With a single sausage left in hand, I sprinted as far 
as my legs could carry me.
Pup: *Pant*...*pant*...

(Did I finally lose the 'mighty hunter'...?)
I looked at the ever cooling sausage still on 
my plate.
Pup: (Cold or no, it's still mine!)
Through my ragged breaths, I caught a sight in my 
peripheral along the horizon.
Pup: ...
Jakson: ...
Pup: ...
Jakson: ...
Pup: Just try to take it from me!
I shoved the full sausage down my throat until 
half lay hanging out of my mouth.
Pup: Hfff! Nwff Whfft?!
(Ha! Now what?!)
...the sausage jiggling as I blurted out my 
muffled declaration.
Jakson: *Bark*!
The dog burst into a full sprint like he was on 
the battlefield.
Pup: ...!?
The next thing I knew, a heavy dog was on top of 
me and the sausage was ejected upwards.
Pup: Urgh!
It hung in the air for what seemed like 
forever before dropping into the gullet 
of one Jakson.
Jakson: *Munch*
Pup: ...
Pup: *Sigh*... I will get you for this...
I shifted myself up to sit next to him. Within a few 
seconds, I instinctively started petting him on the 
head.
Jakson: *Happy panting*
Pup: So... what did you think?
Pup: A little burnt, right?
Jakson: *Confused whine*?
Pup: Right? I knew you'd agree with me, at least.

我的盤子。

passages.content:
Norde: ...and they need to meet within the hour.
Ivan: Understood. I'll head out soon.
The two bid their farewells, and Ivan turned 
to enter a nearby tent.
Ivan: ...
The hum of a boiling pot matched the steam 
circulating around the tent.
Ivan's hand reached for the lid of the boiling pot.
Ivan: ...
Ivan: ...!?
Satia: Guess who?
Ivan: *Sigh*... Aren't you a bit old to be
doing this?
Satia: If you get it wrong, then you owe me a gold 
piece~
Ivan: Satia. I am not playing this game.
With hands removed from Ivan's eyes, Satia moved 
between him and the boiling meal.
Satia: Oh? I thought you liked to gamble.
Ivan: News to me.
Satia opened the lid herself and steam burst out.
Satia: And how long do you figure this has been cooking?
Ivan: ...
Satia used some tongs to pull out the fish meat 
held within.
Satia: What if you got sick? What if you went down and 
left the Crows without their commander?
Ivan: ...
A knife entered Satia's grip as she expertly diced 
the meat.
Satia: Better yet, what if you left your little Pup all alone?
Ivan: I imagine he'd be in good hands.
Satia: Regardless...
With a twirl, Satia's hand sprinkled a variety of 
spices across the meal.
Satia: Some days I wonder what Harold was thinking 
leaving the Nightless Crows under your command...
Ivan: ...
Satia: ...
Ivan: Are we done, then?
Satia: Obviously not.
Ivan: What's left then? What do you want?
Satia: A complete and utter reformation doesn't seem like 
too much to ask for?
Satia pulled a piece of packing paper and string 
from a nearby supply box.
Ivan: When you get to my age, it can become 
more dangerous than not to start doubting your 
instincts.
Satia: Yes, yes... "Old dogs can't learn new tricks". 
You've said as much before.
Ivan: Then may I have my meal?
Satia's hands weaved back and forth as the string 
became taught around the now packaged fish.
Satia: *Sigh*... Very well.
One packaged fish meal dropped into Ivan's hands.
Ivan: Thank you very much. Have a good evening.
Ivan promptly pivoted on his foot towards the 
tent's entryway. A flap of the door later and 
Satia was by herself.
Satia: Some days with him...
Satia took a few breaths to calm herself. 

With a flick of her wrist, a small pouch flipped from 
within her sleeve to her hand.
Satia: *Giggle*... The wonders of-
Satia: Gk...!?
Satia's arm with the pouch fully extended and she 
pinched her nose closed.
Satia: Ugh... That is... much more rancid than I 
remember. I need to prepare a new one.
Satia: Oh well. He probably won't even notice it until the 
slice hits his bowels.
Satia: Maybe even an old dog would be motivated to 
learn some new tricks after that.

伊凡：我想他會得到很好的照顧。
薩蒂亞：無論如何…
薩蒂亞的手一旋轉，撒上了各種各樣的東西。 
整頓飯的香料。
薩蒂亞：有時候我想知道哈羅德在想什麼
把不夜鴉交給你指揮…
伊凡：…
薩蒂亞：…
伊凡：那我們結束了嗎？
薩蒂亞：顯然不是。
伊凡：那還剩下什麼？你想要什麼？
薩蒂亞：徹底的改革似乎不存在
要求太多？
薩蒂亞拉出一張包裝紙和繩子
從附近的補給箱。
伊凡：等你到了我這個年紀，就可以了
比不開始懷疑自己更危險
本能。
薩蒂亞：是的，是的…「老狗學不到新把戲」。 
你之前已經說過很多了。
伊凡：那我可以吃飯了嗎？
薩蒂亞的雙手像繩子一樣來回編織
圍繞現在包裝好的魚進行教學。
薩蒂亞：*嘆氣*...很好。
一份包裝好的魚粉就落到了伊凡的手裡。
伊万：非常感謝。祝你晚上愉快。
伊万立即 piv

passages.name: SP: Jakson x Ivan C - New Event
passages.content:
A shadow slipped through the night, sliding across 
the soft glow of light from within the camp's tents.
A dog sat in front of one of the tents. It's head 
dropped down as it relaxed it's body.
The glow of the tent faded to black, and the 
shadow disappeared into the darkness.
Jakson: ...
The dog's head bolted up at the sound.

The click of metal accompanied moonlight 
shimmering off a steel blade.
Jakson: *Growl*...
As the blade unsheathed, the dog met it with a 
quiet yet audible growl.

The sword stayed locked into placed, and only after 
several tense seconds did it return to its sheathe.
Jakson: ...
The dog stared intently at the shadow as it stared 
back.
With a step backwards, the shadow moved into 
the moonlight.
Ivan: ...
Another step back left Ivan having once more 
retreated into the dark.
Jakson: ...
Jakson stayed at attention for several minutes 
longer before finally relaxing.
The crowd moaned and swayed as the notable 
number obscured several presences.
Ivan: ...
Ivan moved deliberately to ensure he moved 
inconspicuously through the crowd.

His eyes had focused on one person in particular.
They were by a stall, haggling with a merchant.

With a click, a sword began to slide from 
it's sheathe.
Jakson: *Growl*
Jakson had placed himself between Ivan and his 
target.
Ivan: ...
Ivan raised his head to see a handful of the busy 
crowd turn and stare in their direction.

With a click once more, the weapon was put away 
and Ivan disappeared into the mass of people.
Jakson: ...
Jakson still stared into the crowd.
Pup: Everything okay, boy?
A familiar scene.
Jakson: *Growl*
Ivan: ...
The glow of the tent had faded into the shadows, 
leaving only the moonlit shine of the blade.

A step forward.
Jakson: *Growl*!
The growling intensified.

So too did the shine of the blade grow wider 
as the full length came into view.
Jakson: *Bark*...
A soft bark. It was a warning.
Ivan: ...
Another step.
Jakson: *Growl*!
Jakson launched himself forward towards the 
commander of the Nightless Crows.
Ivan: Urk...!
Ivan raised his arm to intercept, but it created a 
well sized target for teeth to bear down on.
Ivan: ...!
The scene played at a standstill, and a few drops of 
crimson splashed on the dirt below.
Ivan: You broke the skin?
Ivan dropped the weapon, and Jakson's grip on 
his arm went away.
Shuffling back to the nearby fence, Ivan lowered 
himself down to sit against it.
Ivan: You did well, but...
Ivan: You do realize he'll never learn this way, right?
Ivan eyed the nearby tent.
Jakson: ...
Jakson just sat by the commander, happily 
wagging his tail with the dissipating tension.

Ivan's free hand lowered to the top of the 
dog's head.
Ivan: *Sigh*... Maybe... he doesn't need to be ready 
for that.
Ivan: So long as you're here to keep protecting him, at 
least.
Jakson: *Happy panting*
Ivan: I hope you continue to look after him no matter 
what happens.

Thank you for all these years. And for the years to 
come.
passages.content_zh:
一道黑影滑過夜空，掠過營帳內透出的柔和光芒。
一隻狗坐在其中一個帳篷前。牠放鬆身體，頭垂了下來。
帳篷的光芒漸漸消失，融入黑暗之中，黑影也隨之消失。
Jakson: ...
狗聽到聲音，頭猛然抬起。

金屬的摩擦聲伴隨著月光，在鋼製刀刃上閃爍。
Jakson: *低吼*...
隨著刀刃出鞘，狗以低沉卻清晰的吼聲回應。

劍仍然卡在鞘中，經過幾秒鐘的緊張對峙後，才回到鞘中。
Jakson: ...
狗專注地盯著黑影，黑影也回望著牠。
黑影向後退了一步，走進月光中。
Ivan: ...
再退一步，Ivan再次退回黑暗之中。
Jakson: ...
Jakson保持警戒狀態幾分鐘後，終於放鬆下來。
人群呻吟著，搖擺著，眾多身影遮蔽了幾個存在。
Ivan: ...
Ivan刻意移動，確保自己能不引人注目地穿梭於人群中。

他的目光鎖定了一個人。
他們在一個攤位旁，與商人討價還價。

隨著一聲輕響，一把劍開始從劍鞘中滑出。
Jakson: *低吼*
Jakson把自己擋在Ivan和他的目標之間。
Ivan: ...
Ivan抬起頭，看到一小部分忙碌的人群轉過身來，盯著他們的方向。

隨著又一聲輕響，武器被收回，Ivan消失在人群中。
Jakson: ...
Jakson仍然盯著人群。
Pup: 一切都還好嗎，孩子？
熟悉的場景。
Jakson: *低吼*
Ivan: ...
帳篷的光芒已經消失在陰影中，只剩下刀刃在月光下的閃耀。

向前一步。
Jakson: *低吼*!
吼聲變得更加強烈。

隨著刀刃完全出鞘，刀光也變得更加耀眼。
Jakson: *吠*...
輕輕一聲吠叫。這是警告。
Ivan: ...
再一步。
Jakson: *低吼*!
Jakson朝著指揮官猛撲過去

passages.name: SP: Rowan x Ivan C - If in CH2
passages.content: Earlier in the Rabaneau Tavern...
passages.content_zh: 早些時候在拉巴諾酒館...

passages.name: SP: Rowan x Ivan C - New Event
passages.content:
Ivan: And?
Rowan: The Kingdom of Cartenan.
Ivan tapped the quill in his hand on the table. It's 
beat was quiet, but audible within the sleepy 
tavern.
Ivan: Where in Cartenan are you from?
Rowan: Cambre. On the outskirts.
The taps of the quill calmed.
Ivan: And you've lived there all your life?
Rowan: Home is where the heart is.
Quill taps.
Ivan: ...
Rowan: I've left the country at times in my life, if that is 
what you pursue.
Ivan: Alright.

What brings you to Rabaneau?
Rowan: Have I not spoken of it?
Rowan: To quell the pains of war with a song of healing.
The tapping stopped, but a sigh echoed in 
the sleepy tavern.
Ivan: And how has that gone?
Rowan: Ah... Some wounds are best left closed, no?
Ivan: Where did you train in this so called singing?
Rowan: So the dagger slices ever deeper...
Ivan: And an answer?
Rowan: Hmm... Where did I learn to sing?
Rowan: Along the winds of the spring skies, I suppose?
The scribbling of words by the pen 
stopped abruptly.
Ivan: ...
No tapping resumed, but the quill - feather and all - 
softly dropped to the table's surface.
Ivan: What's your favorite color?
Rowan: Color?
Rowan: Raspberry.
A silence grated on Ivan.
Ivan: Favorite food?
Rowan: Orange.
The silence was broken by the wood of a chair 
scuffing across the ground.
Rowan: Mr. Savior-Crow-Man?
Ivan lowered himself haphazardly to the chair once 
more. This time, he had a wooden mug in hand.
Ivan: ...
Rowan: ...
Ivan took a sip from the mug.
Rowan: Well if we insist on that endeavor, then...
Rowan: May I perhaps have a
Ivan: Age?
Rowan: Old enough to love life.
Ivan: So not old enough to know your ass from your 
nose.
Ivan: You've met my son. Even I know how foolhardy 
that age can be.
Rowan: Ah, yes. The industrious "Anton", was it? Or 
perhaps "Pup"?

An interesting child that one is.
Ivan: Hmm...
With dramatic swing, Ivan gulped down the 
remains of the mug. It echoed as it was 
slammed down on the table.
Ivan: Let's start from the beginning.

Name?
Rowan: Ah, tedium.
Ivan: ...
Rowan: ...

Rowan. Rowan MacKinnon
Ivan: Homeland?
Rowan: Once more, the Kingdom of Cartenan.
The little village of Cambre.
Rowan: Perhaps I should ask the same. Where
are you from?
Ivan: Reason for being in Rabaneau?
Rowan: Where did this "Anton" and you find your way 
from?
Ivan: ...
Rowan: "Baranov". It is not of Rabaneau, is it?
Rowan: A tad more... Nolvanian.
Ivan: ...
Rowan: Perhaps even more than that. 
Perhaps even a hint of-
Ivan: Crekskia.
Rowan: ...
Rowan: ...Pardon?
Ivan raised the mug once more, aiming at the little 
left within.
Rowan: ...Crekskia...

The Vault? The Vault at...
Ivan: ...
Rowan stared at Ivan's eyes and looked for a sign 
to doubt.

But it never came, and Rowan slumped back into 
his chair.
Rowan: Do know I answered your questions without a lie.
Ivan: But did you answer honestly?
Rowan: ...
What silence there was rattled away with the 
tumbling of the empty mug from Ivan's hands.
Rowan: I...
Rowan: Perhaps you are one that can understand?

That some wounds are best left closed...

That some pieces of a past... are best left 
forgotten.
passages.content_zh:
伊凡：然後呢？
羅文：卡特南王國。
伊凡用手中的羽毛筆輕敲桌面。那
節奏很輕，但在昏昏欲睡的
酒館裡還是聽得見。
伊凡：你來自卡特南的哪裡？
羅文：坎布雷。在郊外。
羽毛筆的敲擊聲平靜了下來。
伊凡：你一輩子都住在那裡嗎？
羅文：家是心之所在。
羽毛筆敲擊聲。
伊凡：...
羅文：如果這是你想追問的，我這輩子有時會離開那個國家。
伊凡：好吧。

是什麼讓你來到拉巴諾？
羅文：我沒說過嗎？
羅文：用療癒之歌平息戰爭的痛苦。
敲擊聲停止了，但一聲嘆息在
昏昏欲睡的酒館裡迴盪。
伊凡：那進展如何？
羅文：啊...有些傷口最好還是保持封閉，不是嗎？
伊凡：你在哪裡接受過這種所謂的歌唱訓練？
羅文：所以匕首越刺越深...
伊凡：答案呢？
羅文：嗯...我在哪裡學會唱歌的？
羅文：我想，是沿著春日天空的風吧？
筆尖寫字的沙沙聲
突然停止了。
伊凡：...
沒有恢復敲擊聲，但羽毛筆——連同羽毛——輕輕地掉落在桌面上。
伊凡：你最喜歡的顏色是什麼？
羅文：顏色？
羅文：覆盆莓色。
沉默讓伊凡感到刺耳。
伊凡：最喜歡的食物？
羅文：橘子。
椅子在地上摩擦的聲音打破了沉默。
羅文：救世主-烏鴉-先生？
伊凡漫不經心地坐回椅子上。這次，他手裡拿著一個木製馬克杯。
伊凡：...
羅文：...
伊凡從馬克杯裡喝了一口。
羅文：好吧，如果我們堅持要這樣做，那麼...
羅文：我可以要一個
伊凡：年齡？
羅文：足夠愛生活。
伊凡：所以還沒老到能分清屁股和鼻子。
伊凡：你見過我兒子。連我都明白那個年紀有多麼愚蠢。
羅文：啊，是的。勤奮的「安東」，是嗎？或者也許是「小傢伙」？

真是個有趣的孩子。
伊凡：嗯...
伊凡誇張地一飲而盡馬克杯裡
剩下的東西。馬克杯重重地
摔在桌子上，發出迴響。
伊凡：讓我們從頭開始。

名字？
羅文：啊，乏味。

passages.name: SP: Jakson x Norde C - New Event
passages.content:
Norde: Good. I'm back in time for supper rations.
Norde: Hmm...
Norde: I wonder who is on cooking duty today?
Norde: *Sigh*...
Norde slumped into a seat around the warm 
campfire.
Norde: Hm...? What was...
Norde turned to not see anything behind him.
Norde: ...

My imagination, maybe?
Fellow Crow: Norde, not gonna have any? The duck is great 
today.
Norde: ...Duck? We didn't purchase any duck meat lately.
Fellow Crow: Uh... Don't know what to tell ya.
Norde: Who is on cooking duty today?
Fellow Crow: I dunno. Maybe- Oh, hey boy.
Jakson: *Panting*
Norde: Jakson... do you need something?
Jakson: *Bark*!
Fellow Crow: I think he wants your order?
Norde: Excuse me?
Fellow Crow: Don't worry about it. Just get him some of the 
duck.
Jakson: *Happy Bark*!
Norde: Why is the dog taking food orders?
The other man just shrugged his shoulders.
Norde: Then I must inter-
Norde's effort to raise to his feet was cutoff by him 
hearing something from the nearby cooking tent.
Pup: DUCK!?
Pup: Why... Why is everyone ordering... duck?

We don't have any duck!
Jakson: *Bark*!
Pup: Norde? Then...
Pup: Does that mean we should have duck? Did I forget 
it when I was at the market?
Pup: Uh... What do we have left that might taste like 
duck? Even a little?
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
After a few short minutes, the flap of the tent  
burst open with a brown fuzzball now in sight.
Jakson: *Bark muffled by carrying food*...
A small bowl was dropped into Norde's hands.
Norde: ...
It was mostly empty. Distinct bite marks were left 
on multiple pieces of meat.
Jakson: *Licks lips*
Norde: Jakson...
Norde: I... would recommend showing this to your owner.
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
Grabbing the bowl, Jakson headed back to the 
tent.
Pup: What? They already want seconds?!
Pup: W- What's left to...
Norde: ...
Norde was soon on his feet.
Fellow Crow: Not hungry?
Norde: An itch at the back of my mind has stolen my 
appetite.
Fellow Crow: Eh. Your loss.
Pup: Haha! This... Now this could work!
Norde made his way over to the bulletins for the 
corp.
Norde: After all the effort I put into putting together a 
rotation for these....
Norde: Who is on duty and left that idiot to use a dog as a 
waiter?
His eyes scanned the sheet for the current day.
Norde: ...Hans... Illec... and...
Norde: ...
Jakson: *Bark muffled by carrying food*...
To the side of Norde's leg was Jakson. He was 
carrying a new bowl.

The bowl held a bread roll with lettuce and pickles 
adorning it.

It looked a little like a duck.
Norde: ...
Norde's eyes returned to the sheet.
Norde: ..."Jakson"...
Jakson: *Happy bark*!

*Whine*...?!
The shattered dinnerware bounced across the 
ground, and the bread fell into the dirt as well.
Norde: ...
Norde: *Stomach growling*...
Norde: This... must be my punishment for botching the 
duty rotation...
passages.content_zh:
諾德：好。我回來得正好，可以吃晚餐。
諾德：嗯…
Norde：我想知道今天誰負責做菜？
諾德：*嘆氣*...
諾德癱倒在溫暖的座位上
營火。
諾德：嗯……？什麼是...
諾德轉過頭去，卻發現身後沒有任何東西。
諾德：…

也許是我的想像？
烏鴉同伴：諾德，不打算吃嗎？鴨子很棒
今天。
諾德：……鴨子？我們最近沒有買鴨肉。
烏鴉同胞：呃……不知道該告訴你什麼。
Norde：今天誰負責做菜？
烏鴉同伴：我不知道。也許——哦，嘿男孩。
傑克森：*氣喘吁籲*
Norde：Jakson...你需要什麼嗎？
傑克森：*吠*！
Crow同胞：我想他想要你的訂單？
諾德：對不起？
烏鴉同伴：別擔心。給他一些
鴨子。
傑克森：*快樂吠叫*！
Norde：為什麼狗狗要接受食物訂單？
另一個人只是聳了聳肩。
Norde：那我必須──
諾德想要站起來的努力被他打斷了
聽到附近的烹飪帳篷有什麼聲音。
小狗：鴨子！ ？
Pup：為什麼...為什麼每個人都點...鴨子？

我們沒有鴨子！
傑克森：*吠*！
小狗：諾德？然後...
小狗：這是否意味著我們應該吃鴨子？我忘記了嗎
我在市場的時候嗎？
小狗：呃...我們還剩下什麼嚐起來像
鴨子？甚至一點點？
傑克森：*快樂吠叫*！
幾分鐘後，帳篷的門簾打開了。  
突然裂開，一粒棕色的毛球就在眼前。
傑克森：*樹皮因攜帶食物而悶悶不樂*...
一個小碗落到了諾德的手裡。
諾德：…
裡面大部分都是空的。留下明顯的咬痕
多塊肉上。
傑克森：*舔嘴唇*
諾德：傑克森…
Norde：我...建議向你的主人展示這個。
傑克森：*快樂吠叫*！
傑克森抓起碗，走回餐廳。 
帳篷。
小狗：什麼？他們已經想要秒了？ ！
小狗：W-還剩下什麼...
諾德：…
諾德很快就站了起來。
烏鴉同胞：不餓嗎？
Norde：我內心深處的渴望偷走了我的心
食慾。
烏鴉同學：嗯。你的損失。
小狗：哈哈！這...現在這可以工作了！
諾德走了過來

passages.name: SP: Pup x Ivan C - New Event
passages.content:
Ivan: ...and that makes three bushels of apples.
Pup: Grh!
Pup: There... we... go...
Pup: We finishing early this time?
Ivan: Yes. Now to weapon maintenance.
Pup: ...
Ivan continued to note down marks on his 
paperwork. He looked up after a few seconds 
of me hesitating.
Ivan: Pup?
Pup: Weapon maintenance. Got it.
Pup: (Maybe I can make it in half the
time this time?)
Pup: Grh!
With a thud, I dropped a greatsword next to me. 
Ivan leaned down to inspect it.
Pup: (Next one. Quicker this time.)
Ivan: Hmm... There's a small chip in...
Ivan: ...
Pup: And... there!
This time an axe lay at my father's feet.
Pup: Last one... to be accounted for...
fully sharpened.
Pup: Argh... How'd we do? We make good time this 
time around?
Ivan: Good enough. Thank you.
Pup: And... uh... How about me? I make good time 
myself?
Ivan: You did well. Make sure you get rested. 
Tomorrow's a long day, too.
Pup: Right... Will do...
I watched as my father dipped into a nearby tent.
Pup: ...

(He does have the entire group to worry about, 
after all.)

(...an entire group... to protect...)
An image of a silhouette covered in an onslaught of 
light popped into my head.
Pup: (Like usual, I just need to be strong like a proper 
man that can hold his head high.)

(To be strong like him. That's my step one. To be 
strong like a mercenary leader)
I clenched my hand into a fist.
Pup: (Step one... to no longer being weak.)
The air rushed out of my lungs along with the 
tension in my body.

I rubbed my biceps. They were quite sore from 
rushing around all day.
Pup: And that starts with a proper rest.
Pup: (I'll take the initiative in tomorrow's mission too.)
Pup: (I need every chance I can get to train and 
challenge myself.)
Ivan: ...
Ivan was scribbling down notes on parchment.
Norde: Are the plans for tomorrow's mission prepared?
Ivan: Not... quite...
Norde: I thought you were just needing to finalize them 
earlier this-
Norde: Ah. That's it.
Ivan: I believe if we deploy this group this way, then-
Norde: Then Anton will be in less danger of a surprise 
attack.
Norde: How many nights have you done this
dance this week?
Norde: Why not just take the princess off the frontlines?
Ivan: The others wouldn't accept it.
Ivan: Nor would he.
Norde: And we've passed a point of no return on those, 
then?

It was inevitable, I suppose.
Ivan: ...
Ivan: ...
Ivan scratched out what he had just written down.
Norde: Here. I'll help. It'll go quicker that way, at least.
passages.content_zh:
伊凡：……這可以生產三蒲式耳蘋果。
小狗：呃！
小狗：那裡……我們……走……
Pup：這次我們提前結束了？
伊凡：是的。現在進行武器維護。
小狗：…
伊凡繼續在他的身上記下標記。 
文書工作。幾秒鐘後他抬起頭來
我在猶豫。
伊凡：小狗？
小狗：武器維護。知道了。
小狗：（也許我可以用一半的時間完成
這次？ ）
小狗：呃！
砰的一聲，我身邊的一把大劍掉了下來。 
伊万俯身檢查。
小狗：（下一張。這次快一點。）
伊凡：嗯...裡面有一個小晶片...
伊凡：…
小狗：還有……那裡！
這次，一把斧頭放在我父親的腳邊。
Pup：最後一個…待查明…
完全銳化。
Pup：啊……我們怎麼樣？我們度過了愉快的時光
時間大約嗎？
伊万：夠好了。謝謝。
Pup：還有……呃……我呢？我玩得很開心
我自己？
伊凡：你做得很好。確保你得到休息。 
明天也是漫長的一天。
小狗：好的…會的…
我看著父親鑽進附近的帳篷。
小狗：…

（他確實要擔心整個團隊，
畢竟。 ）

（……整個群體……保護……）
一個剪影的圖像被猛烈的攻擊所覆蓋
光突然出現在我的腦海裡。
Pup：（像往常一樣，我只需要像正常人一樣堅強
能昂首挺胸的人。 ）

（像他一樣堅強。這是我的第一步。成為
像僱傭兵首領一樣強大）
我將手握成拳頭。
小狗：（第一步…不再軟弱。）
空氣隨著呼吸一起從我的肺部衝了出來。 
我的身體緊張。

我揉了揉我的二頭肌。他們非常痛苦
整天到處奔波。
Pup：這要從適當的休息開始。
Pup：（明天的任務我也會主動。）
小狗：（我需要每一次訓練的機會
挑戰自我。 ）
伊凡：…
伊凡正在羊皮紙上寫著筆記。
Norde：明天的任務計畫準備好了嗎？
伊凡：不……完全……
Norde：我以為你只是需要敲定它們
早些時候——
諾德：啊。就是這樣。
伊凡：我相信如果我們這樣部署這個小組，那麼——
諾德

passages.name: SP: Pup x Satia C - New Event
passages.content:
Pup: ...!
The blade in my hand sliced through the air as I 
paced my way through a training routine.
Pup: ...!

There!
Pup: *Exhale*...
Pup: (Another ten on those and-)
Pup: Ow!
A stinging pain broke me out of the pattern.
Pup: What was that for?!
Satia: Hmm... Nope. Not good. Not good at all.
Satia was holding up the hair she had plucked from 
my head towards the sun above.
Pup: Huh?
Pup: This is... new.
Satia: Expect the unexpected?
Satia: But truly... Such a shame. It's like you try to bring 
misfortune upon yourself at times.
She went back to looking at the strand of hair.
Pup: You don't say...?
Pup: (Does she just want to rile me up?)
Pup: (Or... Is this what I think it is?)
Satia: A shame, a shame. It seems we'll
have to do a thorough-
Pup: Expect the unexpected!
Satia: ...?!
A sword, handle first, was lobbed towards Satia.
She caught it in her bewilderment, but I had 
already made a sprint for an exit.
Satia: Pup! Get back here!
Pup: *Pant*... did I... lose her?
I turned.
Satia: ...!
Pup: Crap!
Pup: This time. There's no way she-
I turned a corner.
Satia: ...
Pup: Every time!
Pup: (She's still hot on my tail... What now?)
Pup: (Oh, that's an idea.)
Pup: (If I can just swim across the river, she might not 
even want to follow!)
Satia: What are you doing?!
The water splashed around me as I dived into
the nearby river.
Pup: (Perfect, now I just need to...)
Pup: (Wait, what the...? What's that?)
Pup: (Dammit, not now!)
Fellow Crow: Hey, Satia.
Satia: Good afternoon.
Other Crow: Big catch today?
Satia: It was a feisty one, for sure.
Satia made her way through the camp dragging 
along a large net.
Satia: And...!
Satia dumped out the contents of the fishing net.
Pup: ...

Ow.
Satia: Shall we get started?
Pup: I just wanted to do my daily training. Is that so 
unreasonable?
Satia: You should've thought of that before you made it 
even worse.
Satia: Your hair smells like raw fish.
Pup: ...?
I took a sniff of some of my hair.
Pup: ...?!
Pup: (Yeah, that's bad.)
passages.content_zh:
Pup: ...!
我手中的劍劃破空氣，我來回踱步進行訓練。
Pup: ...!

有了！
Pup: *呼氣*...
Pup: (再練個十次就-)
Pup: 哎唷！
一陣刺痛打斷了我的節奏。
Pup: 妳幹嘛啦？！
莎緹雅正舉著她從我頭上拔下來的頭髮，朝著上方的太陽看著。
Pup: 蛤？
Pup: 這... 倒是新鮮。
莎緹雅：期待意想不到的事？
莎緹雅：但說真的... 真可惜。有時候妳就像在自找麻煩。
她又回去看那撮頭髮。
Pup: 妳說什麼...?
Pup: (她只是想惹我生氣嗎？)
Pup: (還是... 這是我想的那樣？)
莎緹雅：可惜啊，可惜。看來我們得徹底-
Pup: 期待意想不到的事！
莎緹雅：...？！
一把劍，劍柄朝前，被丟向莎緹雅。
她困惑地接住了劍，但我已經衝向出口了。
莎緹雅：Pup！給我回來！
Pup: *喘氣*... 我... 甩掉她了嗎？
我轉身。
莎緹雅：...！
Pup: 糟了！
Pup: 這次。她絕對不可能-
我轉過一個彎。
莎緹雅：...
Pup: 每次都這樣！
Pup: (她還是緊追不捨... 現在該怎麼辦？)
Pup: (喔，有個主意。)
Pup: (如果我能游過這條河，她可能根本不想跟過來！)
莎緹雅：妳在幹嘛？！
我跳進附近的河裡，水花四濺。
Pup: (完美，現在我只需要...)
Pup: (等等，這是...？那是什麼？)
Pup: (可惡，不是現在！)
同伴烏鴉：嗨，莎緹雅。
莎緹雅：午安。
其他烏鴉：今天收穫不錯？
莎緹雅：確實是個精力充沛的傢伙。
莎緹雅拖著一個大漁網穿過營地。
莎緹雅：然後...！
莎緹雅倒出了漁網裡的內容物。
Pup: ...

哎唷。
莎緹雅：我們開始吧？
Pup: 我只是想做我的日常訓練。這有這麼不合理嗎？
莎緹雅：妳早該在讓事情變得更糟之前想到這點。
莎緹雅：妳的頭髮聞起來像生魚。
Pup: ...？
我聞了一下我的一些頭髮。
Pup: ...？！
Pup: (對啊，糟透了。)

passages.name: SP: Pup x Satia C - Pup TG3
passages.content:
Satia: With... well, everything's that has happened, it's 
even more important for you to properly take care 
of it.
At worst, you'll draw more illadvised attention to us 
if you don't.
passages.content_zh:
Satia：隨著......好吧，一切都已經發生了，它是
對您來說更重要的是妥善照顧
它的。
最壞的情況是，您會為我們帶來更多不明智的關注
如果你不這樣做。

passages.name: SP: Pup x Satia C - Pup less than3
passages.content:
Satia: You don't exactly have a bald head. Hair care has 
it's importance.

How long ago was it that you decided to let your 
hair grow out some? Before all this started.
Satia: I said then that you'd need to actually take care of 
it, yes?
passages.content_zh:
莎提雅：你可沒有光頭。頭髮護理可是很重要的。

你決定開始留長頭髮是什麼時候的事？在一切開始之前。
莎提雅：我那時候就說過，你得好好照顧它，對吧？

passages.name: SP: Pup x Satia C - Continue
passages.content:
Pup: I guess. It's not like my hair stunk when you came 
to me earlier, though.
I shifted myself to a sitting position.
Satia: Hair maintenance is more than just how it smells. 
It's a duty to yourself.
Satia: If there's anything you should try to not take after 
your father with, it's these sorts of habits.
Satia: And if you let me teach you properly, then you 
wouldn't need me to hassle you over it.
Pup: I...
Pup: (I didn't want to do it because I wanted to finish 
my training. This is going to take hours.)
Pup: (Well it's going to take hours with a lesson or 
not...)
Pup: I... guess. Fine.
Satia: Perfect!
Satia rustled through a nearby box.
Satia: I actually stumbled upon this mixture lately. They 
say it will make your hair smell like a flower.
Pup: You... don't say?
Pup: A better smell than fish, I suppose.
passages.content_zh:
小狗：我猜。你來的時候我的頭髮並不臭
不過，早些時候對我來說。
我把自己換成坐姿。
Satia：頭髮保養不只是它的氣味。 
這是對自己的責任。
薩蒂亞：如果有什麼事情你應該盡量不要做的話
你父親就有這樣的習慣。
薩蒂亞：如果你讓我正確地教你，那麼你
不需要我來麻煩你。
小狗：我...
Pup：（我不想這樣做，因為我想完成
我的訓練。這將需要幾個小時。 ）
小狗：（嗯，一堂課要花幾個小時或
不……）
小狗：我……猜想。美好的。
薩蒂亞：完美！
薩蒂亞沙沙地翻過附近的一個盒子。
薩蒂亞：我最近偶然發現了這種混合物。他們
說它會讓你的頭髮聞起來像花。
小狗：你……不說嗎？
小狗：我想，比魚的味道好聞。

passages.name: SP: Ivan x Norde C - New Event
passages.content:
Mariel: ...
A glow arose from a bracelet on Mariel's arm. 
Through it, she was channeling divine healing.
Norde: Ms. Stewart? How goes it? Have they stabilized?
Mariel: Stable, yes. Your boss is still in a precarious
state, however. I've healed their wounds
with my blessings the best I can.
In the most optimistic case, they'll likely need 
plenty more rest and recovery, though.
Mariel looked over at Pup, who was on the bed she 
was not attending to.
Pup: ...
Mariel: Nightmares and all.
Norde: Is that so?
Norde: You have my thanks. We were lucky to have a Blue 
magic user to assist us.
Mariel: It's nothing. Especially after you helped my sister 
and me as you did.
Ivan: It... wouldn't do to understate it, Norde. 
We... really are thankful.
Mariel: A- Ah. You really shouldn't be up. You need to go 
back to sleep.
Ivan: In a short while, yes.
Mariel: You're going to hurt yourself. This time I may
not even be able to keep you alive.
Ivan: I imagine Norde came with the hopes that I would 
be stirring, though.
Norde: There is... truth in that.
Mariel: I...
As Mariel looked between the two faces,
it seemed as though the decision was 
already made.
Mariel: Let me know immediately if anything even
starts hurting a little.
Ivan: I certainly will. It is appreciated. 

We should be done shortly.
Ivan: Fairing well?
Norde: I am the same as ever.
Ivan: You have a bandage sticking out of your sleeve.
Norde: ...
Norde: Wounds are to be expected in battle.
Ivan: I'm happy to see you can be so lively. It's a good 
sign.
Norde: Are you truly in a position to be so worried about 
others?
Ivan: Ah... This? I'm not worth the worry.
Norde: Sir...
Ivan: Enough of that. You came to ask a question, I 
assume?
Norde: ...Very well.
Norde: That man. That "Steel Wolf". Do you know him?
Ivan: Hard to say.
Ivan: ...He mentioned Crekskia, though.
Norde: What?
Norde: Sir. I know it may be hard to talk about... But if 
ever there was a time to open up about that 
event, then this is it.
Ivan: ...
Ivan: No. That is my sin to bear.

Whatever may come of it, I will shoulder it.
Norde: ...How long as it been? Nearly 25 years?
Norde: From when you saved me? From when you gave 
me my name?
Ivan: That still? Like I said, I said you should "head 
north", haha...
Norde: Ever since then, I've spent every day aiming 
towards being like your example.
Norde: You are... my guiding star.
Norde: Sir, if I've taken even one correct step along that 
path, I'd like to use that strength to assist.
Ivan: Haha... I am a poor star to guide you to what you 
want to be.
Norde: With all due respect, that is not for you to decide.
Ivan: True. Very true.
Ivan: Then I ask you to not risk your goals for the 
mistakes of this... tired old man.
Ivan: If you wish to use that strength for something... 
then... keep my son safe, like we've discussed 
before.
Norde: Of course. I didn't plan to abandon that promise.
Ivan: Some things are worth more...

...are worth... worth more than...

...more than...

...
Ivan had fallen asleep from the exhaustion.
Norde: ...
Norde: Sir. I don't plan to give up on you so easily.
passages.content_zh:
瑪麗埃爾：…
馬裡爾手臂上的手鐲發出光芒。 
透過它，她正在引導神聖的治療。
諾德：史都華女士？進展如何？他們穩定了嗎？
Mariel：穩定，是的。你的老闆仍處於不穩定狀態
然而，狀態。我已經治癒了他們的傷口
盡我所能地祝福。
在最樂觀的情況下，他們可能需要
不過，還有更多的休息和恢復。
瑪莉爾看著小狗，他正躺在她的床上。 
沒有註意到。
小狗：…
Mariel：惡夢等等。
諾德：是這樣嗎？
諾德：謝謝你。我們很幸運擁有藍色
魔法用戶來幫助我們。
瑪麗埃爾：沒什麼。尤其是在你幫助了我妹妹之後
和我一樣。
伊凡：諾德……輕描淡寫一點也不為過。 
我們……真的很感激。
瑪麗埃爾：啊——啊。你真的不應該起來。你需要走了
回去睡覺。
伊凡：很快，是的。
瑪麗埃爾：你會傷害自己的。這次我可能
甚至無法讓你活著。
伊凡：我想 Norde 是帶著我的希望而來的
不過，要激動人心。
Norde：這是……事實。
瑪麗埃爾：我…
當瑪麗埃爾看著兩張臉時，
似乎這個決定是
已經做了。
Mariel：如果有任何事情請立即告訴我
開始有點痛。
伊凡：我當然會的。值得讚賞。 

我們應該很快就能完成。
伊万：還好嗎？
Norde：我和以前一樣。
伊凡：你的袖子上有一條繃帶。
諾德：…
Norde：戰鬥中受傷是意料之中的事。
伊凡：我很高興看到你這麼活潑。這是一個很好的
標誌。
Norde：你真的有必要這麼擔心嗎？ 
其他人？
伊万：啊……這？我不值得擔心。
諾德：先生…
伊万：夠了。你是來問問題的，我
假設？
諾德：……很好。
諾德：那個男人。那個「鋼狼」。你認識他嗎？
伊万：很難說。
Ivan：……不過他提到了 Crekskia。
諾德：什麼？
諾德：先生。我知道這可能很難談論...但如果
曾經有過一次敞開心扉談論這件事的時候
事件，那麼就是這樣。
伊凡：…
伊娃

passages.name: SP: Pupx Jack B - Begining
passages.content:
Pup: ...
Jakson: ...
Pup: ...
Jakson: ...
Pup: ...
Jakson: ...
I blinked.
Pup: ...!
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
Pup: Dammit...
I blinked rapidly. My eyes stung from the staring 
contest.
Pup: Fine. Take the bedding. It's not like I haven't slept 
on the ground before.
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
Norde: Hello, you two.

We just had a messenger deliver the receipt for a
successful bedding purchase.
Pup: Perfect timing, Norde.
Norde: It isn't as though I had any control over it.
Norde: Though... of what I can control, I am surprised by 
the need for another set.
Norde: I could have sworn that the recent supply refresh 
purchased enough to suit our current numbers...
Pup: Ah... well...
I looked over at Jakson while trying to not let 
Norde notice.
Pup: (He never counts Jakson in those, since he's a 
dog.)
Pup: Mistakes like that are bound to happen sometime... 
yeah?
Norde: ...
Norde: Regardless, the bedding needs to be picked up 
from the nearby town.
Pup: It's not here?
Norde: Yes. Like I said, we heard from a messenger.
Norde: It's in your hands now.
Pup: Tsk.
Pup: (Why not send it instead of a messenger?)
Jakson: *Confused whine*...?
Pup: Looks like we've got a mission to complete before 
the day's out.
After trekking to the nearby town, we had 
procured the admittedly mediocre sleeping cot.
Tying it up like a backpack, we headed out to 
return to camp.
Pup: There we go. Let's head back, boy.
Jakson: *Happy pant*
Pup: (While we're here, maybe we should pick up some 
other supplies.)

(Aren't we running low on... on...)
Pup: (What was it again? It was-)
Pup: ...!?
Jakson: *Bark*!
Pup: Grk!
Pup: (A... horse? With some riding it?)

Yeah! You run away! You- You..!
Pup: *Sigh* ...Damn that asshole. He sort of looked 
drunk, even.
I turned, only to see the cot snapped in two and 
off to my side.
Pup: ...
My body slumped down fully onto the ground.
Pup: I'll just sleep here.
I had no energy while my body ragdolled in
exasperation.

Jakson approached me and started to lick my hand.
Jakson: *Confused whine*...?
Pup: The ground is the ground wherever you go. Why 
not just embrace it for once in my-
Pup: ...?!
A heavy, furry weight plopped down on top of me.
Pup: Jakson... please... get off?!

Sort of... hard to breath...
Jakson: *Panting*
Pup: F- Fine! I'll head back! Is that what you want to 
hear?!
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
Pup: I wasn't really going to sleep here, you know?
Jakson: *Confused whine*...?
The cold of the night could be felt on my skin. It 
felt like getting to sleep would be a true challenge 
for me this time.
Pup: ...
Pup: Ugh...

(What timing for a particularly cold night...)
I couldn't do much else outside of shiver and pull 
the blanket up more.
Pup: ...?
Or so I thought. The blanket pulled itself back.
Pup: (No, that doesn't make any... sense...)
Jakson: ...
A certain brown fuzzball was sliding himself into the 
blanket with me.

Jakson slid all the way to the top. He didn't do 
much else as he laid down into a sleeping position.
Pup: (That's... warm...)
The blanket didn't fit properly now, but I found 
comfort in cuddling up with the teddy bear in front 
of me.
The living, breathing, slobbering teddy bear.
Pup: ...
Pup: ...
The night wore on and sleep started to take me.

Sleepy thoughts faded as my consciousness left 
me.

The sounds of existence blending into eternity.

And the darkness of it became absolute.
So every tick of a second carried on and on...

...Until a final twinge of the mind burst from the 
rapidly disappearing crack of the mind.
Pup: (Why don't we just both move to the bed?)
Pup: ...?!
Pup: Urgh...
 Dammit.
passages.content_zh:
Pup: ...
Jakson: ...
Pup: ...
Jakson: ...
Pup: ...
Jakson: ...
我眨了眨眼。
Pup: ...！
Jakson: *開心的吠叫*！
Pup: 該死...
我快速地眨著眼。我的眼睛因為盯著看而刺痛。
Pup: 好吧。拿走寢具吧。反正我又不是沒睡過地上。
Jakson: *開心的吠叫*！
Norde: 你們好，兩位。

我們剛收到信使送來的收據，證明寢具購買成功。
Pup: 正好，Norde。
Norde: 這又不是我能控制的。
Norde: 雖然...就我能控制的部分來說，我很驚訝還需要另一套。
Norde: 我還以為最近的補給刷新已經買夠了，足以應付我們目前的人數...
Pup: 啊...嗯...
我看向 Jakson，同時試著不讓 Norde 注意到。
Pup: (他從來沒把 Jakson 算進去，因為牠是隻狗。)
Pup: 這種錯誤總有一天會發生...對吧？
Norde: ...
Norde: 無論如何，寢具需要從附近的城鎮取回。
Pup: 不在這裡嗎？
Norde: 是的。就像我說的，我們是從信使那裡聽說的。
Norde: 現在掌握在你們手裡了。
Pup: 嘖。
Pup: (為什麼不直接送來，而是派信使？)
Jakson: *困惑的嗚咽*...?
Pup: 看來我們在今天結束前還有個任務要完成。
在跋涉到附近的城鎮後，我們買到了那張說實話很普通的睡墊。
像背包一樣綁起來，我們出發返回營地。
Pup: 好了。我們回去吧，孩子。
Jakson: *開心的喘氣*
Pup: (既然我們在這裡，也許我們應該買一些其他的補給品。)

(我們是不是快用完了...用完了...)
Pup: (是什麼來著？是什麼-)
Pup: ...！？
Jakson: *吠叫*！
Pup: 呃！
Pup: (一...一匹馬？上面還有人騎著？)

好啊！你跑吧！你- 你...！
Pup: *嘆氣* ...該死的混蛋。他看起來有點醉了，甚至。
我轉過身，卻看到睡墊斷成兩截，掉在一旁。
Pup: ...
我的身體完全癱倒在地上。
Pup: 我就睡在這裡。
我沒有力氣，我的身體在沮喪中像個破布娃娃一樣。

Jakson 靠近我，開始舔我的手。

passages.name: SP: Pup x Cainan C - Begining
passages.content:
Pup: Hm... Not a bad price...
ShopKeep: Are you gonna buy something or not?
Pup: Maybe. I'm undecided.
ShopKeep: Kid, it's been over an hour.
Pup: W- Well...
Pup: Then the answer is no if you're going to be like 
that. I'm not going to buy shit from here.
I stormed off feeling like steam was rising from 
my ears.
Pup: Who does that guy think he is?
My aimless march brought me in front of a café.
Pup: (Something soothing actually sounds really nice 
right now)
With a paid for tea in hand, I found a corner of the 
shop to park myself in.

It wasn't long before I looked up to see a familiar 
face in front of me.
Cainan: Ah, one of those... mercenaries. The Dayless 
Doves, was it?
Pup: ...Nightless Crows...
Cainan: Ha! Much cooler.
Pup: I didn't name the thing.
Cainan: Would you mind some company? I just ordered a 
cup myself.
Pup: Do what you want.
Cainan: My thanks.
Cainan grabbed one of the chairs and sat himself 
down. A café staff member dropped off his own 
cup of tea soon after.
Pup: ...
Cainan: Hm...

So...

You are worried for your father?
Pup: No. He'll be fine. He's strong, after all.
Cainan: Is that so?

Who is your father then?
Pup: What? Why does that matter?
Cainan: I may hail from the Covenant, but I can offer no 
salvation for you or him. That is your burden to 
carry.
So I wished to know of him and the traits that 
inspire such confidence. To tell you how founded 
your belief in him is.
Pup: I...
Pup: ...
I bit my lip a little.

I wanted to hear him tell me it'd be alright, but 
there was the very real chance he wouldn't.
Pup: ...

My father is Ivan Baranov. Leader of the Nightless 
Crows.

He's... stalwart and powerful.

He's protected me all my life.
Pup: He's strong. He's always been the strongest person 
I've known.
My fist tightened enough that I started to lose 
feeling in it.
Cainan: ...

"Ivan Baranov"?
Pup: Yeah. What about it? I'm Anton Baranov.
Cainan: It has been a long time since I've heard that name. 
So he became a mercenary?
Pup: W- What? You... knew my father?
Cainan: It would be odd if I didn't in my line of work.
Cainan: With your striking hair color, I should have figured 
you were his child. Quite the resemblance.
Pup: In your "line of work"? With the Covenant? My 
father was a mercenary.
Cainan: Has he never told you of his time before then?
Cainan: "Ivan Baranov", the Storm Ram.

He was a hero of the Crusades and given the 
position Guardian within the ranks of the Covenant.

His role was to watch over an Oathbreaker to 
ensure it wasn't used for foul measures.
Cainan: And you are right. He was strong. Perhaps the 
strongest of them all.
Pup: I...
I looked down to see my cup of tea shaking ever 
so slightly, so I placed it down on the table.
Pup: ...

A- And... How did you know him?
Cainan: I said before that I am an arbiter of the Covenant, 
yes? That I travel to organize and conduct reviews 
of members like the Guardians?
We met through that role.
Pup: ...
My breaths began to become heavy. I tried to calm 
myself.
Cainan: He was among the nicest men I had ever known. I 
was honored to call him my friend.
Cainan: If your father is truly the Ivan Baranov I know, then 
he will make it to you.

He is as you said. Truly strong.
Cainan: I, at least, think you can rest easy, son of the 
Storm Ram.
Pup: I...!
In a frenzy, I jumped to my feet and accidentally 
knocked my cup of tea to the ground.
Pup: I- I... I'm sorry. I need to go.
Dumping some money on the table for the tea and 
the broken cup, I rushed out of the café.
Cainan: Hahaha...
Cainan: ...

So that is the person that child grew up to be?
Cainan: Ah, perhaps it isn't so surprising, given the 
connection.
A café employee frantically shifted between 
apologizing the other patrons and trying to clean 
up.
All the while, Cainan sat there and calmly sipped on 
his tea.
passages.content_zh:
Pup: 嗯... 價格還不錯...
店主: 你到底要不要買東西？
Pup: 也許吧。我還沒決定。
店主: 小鬼，已經超過一個小時了。
Pup: 我- 我...
Pup: 如果你要這樣的話，那答案就是不要。我才不會在這裡買任何東西。
我怒氣沖沖地走開，感覺耳朵都快冒煙了。
Pup: 那傢伙以為他是誰啊？
我漫無目的地走著，來到了一間咖啡廳前。
Pup: (現在來點舒緩的東西聽起來真不錯)
付了錢買了茶，我找到咖啡廳的一個角落坐了下來。

沒過多久，我抬頭就看到一張熟悉的面孔在我面前。
Cainan: 啊，其中一個... 傭兵。無日之鴿，是嗎？
Pup: ...無夜之鴉...
Cainan: 哈！酷多了。
Pup: 我又沒取這個名字。
Cainan: 不介意我作陪吧？我也剛點了一杯。
Pup: 隨便你。
Cainan: 多謝。
Cainan拉了一張椅子坐了下來。很快地，一位咖啡廳的服務生送來了他的茶。
Pup: ...
Cainan: 嗯...

所以...

你擔心你的父親？
Pup: 不會。他會沒事的。他很強壯，畢竟。
Cainan: 是嗎？

那麼，你的父親是誰？
Pup: 什麼？這有什麼關係？
Cainan: 我或許來自聖約，但我無法為你或他提供任何救贖。那是你必須承擔的重擔。
所以我希望了解他，以及那些激發你如此信心的特質。告訴你你對他的信念有多麼堅定。
Pup: 我...
Pup: ...
我輕輕咬了咬嘴唇。

我想聽他說一切都會沒事，但很有可能他不會這麼說。
Pup: ...

我的父親是伊凡·巴拉諾夫。無夜之鴉的首領。

他... 堅定而強大。

他保護了我一生。
Pup: 他很強壯。他一直是我認識的人之中最強壯的。
我的拳頭握得太緊，開始失去知覺。
Cainan: ...

「伊凡·巴拉諾夫」？
Pup: 對啊。怎麼了嗎？我是安東·巴拉諾夫。
Cainan: 很久沒聽到這個名字了。所以他成了傭兵？
Pup: 什- 什麼

passages.name: SP: Pup x Mariel C - Begining
passages.content:
Pup: One, two, three!

One, two... three!
Pup: *Pant*
Drops of water fell back to the surface and left 
ripples among the otherwise static depths.
Pup: One more set...
I readied my sword once more, but my focus was 
broken by the sound of approaching footsteps.
Mariel: Pup? Up early for some training?
Pup: Ah, Mariel?
With her here, I shift my sword to a passive 
position.
Pup: Yep. Training to improve the quickness of my 
strike.
Mariel: At the shoreline?
Pup: My father once showed me how he could slice 
through the water.

Here...
Tightening the grip on my sword, I wound up a 
rising slice.
Pup: Hah!
...but it crashed into the water, kicking up a bunch 
of the liquid to fall back down in a mini shower.
Mariel: Oh~ Explosive!
She clapped a little.
Pup: Wait, no. It's not supposed to do that...
Pup: If I swing it fast enough, I should be able to slice 
cleanly through the water.
Mariel: I think it looked cool.
Pup: Thanks, I guess
I sheathed my sword.
