Pup: What brings you here?
Mariel: I'm delivering a note from Charlotte.
With a few steps forward and an outstretched 
hand, Mariel handed off a small piece of 
parchment to me.
Mariel: Good luck with your training!
Mariel ran off, clearly in a hurry.
Pup: T- Thanks...
Pup: (A note from the head princess?)
I unfolded the paper and a couple short sentences 
were unveiled.
Charlotte's Note: Stop buying extra meat. We're not your bank.
Pup: ...?!
Pup: Blasphemy.
With a huff to my step, I soon found my way back 
to camp.

It was long enough of a walk for my head to cool 
down some.
Pup: (Maybe I could convince her that the meat is a 
good idea?)
Pup: ...?!
I had turned a corner and ended up running into 
someone.
Mariel: O- Ow...
Pup: Oh crap! I'm so sorry!
Mariel: No, it's my bad. I was rushing to find the medical 
supplies.
Pup: I was rushing, too.

Here.
I extended my arm and helped her to her feet.
Pup: Did someone get hurt?
Pup: B- Besides you...?
Mariel: No, it's about inventory.
Pup: (Oh, that's probably why Charlotte sent that note.)
Pup: Want me to show you where we keep them?
Maybe something there could make you feel 
better?
Mariel: I think I'm fine, but I'll gladly take your offer.

These are the supplies we were looking for.
Pup: Hm...

We don't actually keep all of this on hand. We'd 
need to go to town to get everything.
Mariel accepted my offer and started following me 
to the area between camp and a nearby town.
Mariel: So... If you don't mind me asking. What were you 
in a rush for?
Pup: (She would know what's in the note, right?)
Pup: I wanted to meet with your sister after I saw the 
note she sent.
Mariel: You wanted to meet privately with my sister... 
after she sent you a note...?
Mariel: Charlotte... so brazen...
Pup: Yeah, that's one word for it. Could feel my head 
heat up when I read it.
Mariel: Y- You don't say?
I turned to see Mariel not really paying attention 
to her surroundings.
Pup: Where did that-
Pup: Look out!
Pup: S- Stupid drunk horse riders.
My eyes focused on the scenario. I had pushed 
Mariel out of the way and we both toppled to the 
ground.
Mariel: O- Ow... That one might actually sting tomorrow.
I laid on top of her, with our positioning being easily
misunderstood without the context.

My eyes drifted to her outfit, which was rustled to 
a messy state. 

It wasn't compromising, but it was suggestive.
Mariel: Thank you. *Giggle*... That could have been much 
worse.
Pup: S- Sorry, let me just-
Charlotte: What... is going on here?
Pup: ...?!
Mariel: N- Nothing's happening!
Pup: Yeah, there was a horse and-
Charlotte: Get up.
Pup: R- Right...
I jumped to my feet, and Charlotte helped Mariel 
to her own.
Mariel: There was a horse that almost hit me. Did you hear 
it?
Charlotte: Hm... I guess I did hear something when I was 
walking this way.

Fine. I made a bad assumption. My apologies.
Charlotte: Don't do anything stupid.
Charlotte stared daggers at me as she turned to 
walk back to camp.
Mariel: Didn't you want to talk with her in private?
Pup: Now... Now's probably not a good time. Not after 
that.
Mariel: What? Why not strike while the iron's hot?
Pup: I- I'm sure it'll... *clears throat*.. I'm sure it'll come 
up later.
Mariel: That's.. That's...
Mariel: Then I'll just have to do it myself.
Mariel walked up close to my face with a look of 
excitement plastered across her own.
Mariel: Don't worry about it, then.

I'll do my best to make sure you have an amazing 
romance.
Mariel, in her excitement, started skipping off 
towards the town for the medical supplies.
Pup: "Romance"? Did she... Did she just...
Pup: (...c- confess to me...?!)
I felt my eyesight become unfocused a little along 
with my guard dropping.
Pup: (No way... She couldn't be interested in me. She's 
a princess.)

(Maybe it's some slang that nobility use?)

(Slang for... some sort of meat?)
Pup: It- It's gotta be...
passages.content_zh:
小狗：一、二、三！

一二三！
小狗：*褲子*
水滴落回水面並離開
在原本靜止的深度中激起漣漪。
小狗：還有一套…
我再次舉起劍，但我的注意力集中在
被接近的腳步聲打破了。
瑪麗埃爾：小狗？早起參加訓練嗎？
小狗：啊，瑪麗埃爾？
有她在，我將劍轉為被動
位置。
小狗：是的。訓練以提高我的速度
罷工。
瑪麗埃爾：在海岸線嗎？
小狗：我父親曾經向我展示過他如何切片
透過水。

這裡...
我握緊劍，一發
上升切片。
小狗：哈！
……但它墜入水中，踢起一堆
液體在迷你淋浴中回落。
瑪麗埃爾：喔～爆炸了！
她輕輕鼓掌。
小狗：等等，不行。它不應該這樣做...
小狗：如果我揮得夠快，我應該可以切片
乾淨地穿過水。
瑪麗埃爾：我覺得它看起來很酷。
小狗：謝謝，我想
我收劍入鞘。
小狗：什麼風把你吹到這裡來了？
瑪麗埃爾：我正在轉達夏洛特的一張紙條。
向前邁了幾步，伸了個懶腰
手上，瑪麗埃爾遞出了一小塊
羊皮紙給我。
Mariel：祝你訓練順利！
馬裡爾跑開了，顯然很匆忙。
小狗：謝謝…
小狗：（首席公主的紙條？）
我展開那張紙，上面寫著幾句話
被揭開面紗。
夏洛特的注意事項：停止購買額外的肉。我們不是你的銀行。
小狗：……？ ！
小狗：褻瀆。
我氣喘吁籲地走著，很快就找到了回去的路
去露營。

步行時間夠長，足以讓我的頭腦冷靜下來
下降一些。
小狗：（也許我可以讓她相信肉是
好主意？ ）
小狗：……？ ！
我拐過一個彎，最後遇到了
某人。
瑪麗埃爾：嗚——嗚…
小狗：哦糟糕！我很抱歉！
瑪麗埃爾：不，是我的錯。我急忙去找醫生
用品。
小狗：我也很著急。

這裡。
我伸出手臂，扶她站起來。
小狗：有人受傷了嗎？
小狗：B-除了你…？
Mariel：不，這是關於庫存的。
Pup：（哦，這可能就是為什麼夏洛特

passages.name: SP: Pup x Satia B - Begining
passages.content:
Pup: ...23... 24... I think that's all of them?
I put away my notepad as I finished my inventory 
rounds for the day.
Pup: ...
Pup: Hah...
My hands reflexively brought themselves to my 
shoulders.
Pup: (Must still be sore from my workout earlier?)
Pup: Good thing I'm done for the day, then.
With a pivot on my heel, I made my way for a tent.
Pup: (Where did I put that-)
Pup: ...?!
I felt a pressing, cushioned feeling pressed against 
my back.
???: Guess who~
Pup: The cold, slimy hands of death?
???: ...

"Slimy"?
Pup: In- In a good way?
Pup: Ow!
Satia: Too far.
Pup: S- Sorry...
I rubbed the stinging feeling on the back of my
head as I probed Satia face for whether she
accepted the apology.
Pup: Did you need something?
Satia: So cold... and slimy.
Satia: What if I simply wished to spend time with my 
favorite Crow?
Pup: I'm sure Norde is around here somewhere.
Satia: Oh, he can be quite cold. That is true. But he's not 
nearly as slimy.
Pup: I... I said I was sorry.
Satia: Well if the rumors on the sliminess aren't true, 
mayhap you have grip enough to carry a few items?
Satia: They're quite heavy, and I was hoping for some 
help from our premiere soldier of fortune.
Pup: Boxes? S- Sure. I can help.
Satia led me to the edge of camp.
Pup: *Grunt*! There... G- Got it. Where to?
Satia: Hm... Where best to put it?
Pup: O- Of course... no hurry.
Satia: How gallant of you~
Pup: ...
Pup: W- What is even in this?
Satia: Oh, that's where it should go. Follow me.
Our path led us to the armory tent. Inside were a 
few stations for changing, and Satia led us into the 
woman's changing area.
Pup: There... we... go...
An audible thud filled the room as the box hit the 
ground.
Pup: Why here?
Satia: It had some storage space still open.
Satia: Actually, while we're here, could you help check 
this armor shipment? It's a different supplier 
than we've used in the past.
Pup: Ah... That's why it's so heavy.
Pup: Sure. I was just doing inventory earlier anyways.
Satia gave me some space as I stripped down to 
my smallclothes.
Satia: While we're here, I was also hoping to talk to you 
about something serious.
Pup: Yeah?
Satia: I've noticed others among the Crows being... 
distracted by you.
Pup: Yeah, this new outfit is a bit... eye-catching
Pup: What, my outfit? It's a bit big on me now, but it's 
not that bad.
Satia: No, not your clothes.
Satia: Hmm... Let's say this?
Satia: Pup's "puppies" have been bouncing about all over 
the place.
Pup: Those weren't *my* puppies.
Pup: Not to mention they were starved. I wouldn't 
blame them for bouncing around when they're
all excited for a meal.
Satia: I...
I had finished undressing and had placed my 
clothes in a pile to the side.
Satia: ...
Satia: Breasts, Pup. Breasts.
Pup: Uh...

(Wait, is she-)
Satia: Tits. Tatas. Bazongas.
Satia: The premium melons of flesh that you've freed to 
swing from your chest.
My face reddened.
Pup: C- Could we not talk about this?
Satia: You can't let them just bounce around without 
support!

You're going to hurt your back. They might even 
start sagging later on.
Pup: W- Who knows what'll happen when we resolve all 
this with Wolf and such?
Pup: We just need to beat Wolf! Or I can overcome the 
weakness. It's... It's not like this will stay like this.
Satia: And what if you end up with back pain and saggy 
breasts for life?
Pup: We... We're not going to discuss this.
Satia: Hmph. Very well.
Pup: Seriously, do you try to give me stress?
I spun towards the box to open it and retrieve the 
full armor set.
Pup: What?
Pup: (It's full of ROCKS?!)

(Rocks and...)
I lifted up a piece of fabric that was both all too 
familiar and all too alien to me.
Pup: Satia, what is the-
With a pivot, I turned to see my clothes were 
gone.
Pup: ...?!
Pup: SATIA?!
Satia: "Auntie" Satia, thank you very much.
The voice stifled giggles from beyond the changing 
area's doorway.
Pup: What are you doing? Where are my clothes?!
Satia: Making a very pretty bonfire outside.
Pup: I... I...
Pup: Those clothes were a gift!
Pup: How could you just burn my clothes?!
Satia: Leverage is a tricky thing, isn't it?
Satia: Maybe you could stand to use some more support?
Pup: What?
I looked down to the bra I was still holding.
Pup: You know I'm just going to leave at this rate? I'll 
have a chance to grab something from the supply.
Satia: And I wonder who might have the key to that 
particular chest?
I heard a metallic jingle along with her voice.
Satia: Oh? Is that a visitor I hear? They sound mere 
minutes away?
Satia: Did I mentioned I invited Charlotte here as well?
Pup: I...
Pup: I- I'll just make a break for it.
Satia: *Giggle*... It's not that big of a camp. She and 
everyone else would get quite a show.
Satia: The rumors that could spread. A vile pervert on the 
loose!
Pup: I- I...
Pup: Hm?
A sort of humming sound caught my attention. It 
was like an approaching voice.
Charlotte: (Inaudible speech)
Satia: Oh Pup. Why are you- Oh, how daring.
Pup: F- Fine! Deal! Just get the clothes ready!
Satia: *Giggles*
Pup: (Now how do you...)
With a defeated sigh, I put on the bra. I wore one 
hoop, then the other... but then the back part 
was open.
Pup: (Wait. What the... Really, how do you...)
Pup: Urgh!
After some struggle, I finally managed to clasp the 
back part of the bra by myself.
Pup: It's on! Clothes!
A bundle of cloth rolled through the flap of the 
changing area's door.
Pup: (My normal clothes!)
Another sound of a moving tent flap interrupted 
my revelation.
Charlotte: So what did you need?
Pup: ...?!
I rushed to get my normal clothes on like the wind.

Just as I was throwing on the last piece, I heard 
the changing room's doorway open.
Charlotte: Ah, Pup! Sorry. I didn't realize anyone was in here.
Pup: H- Hey Charlotte. Nothing... weird happening here.
Charlotte: In the woman's changing area? I think- ...think...
Charlotte: Oh?
Pup: W- What?
Charlotte: Satia finally convinced you to wear a bra? Good for 
you.
Pup: How do you...?
Charlotte: Really? Did you not realize how obvious it was that 
you weren't before?
Charlotte: Like I said, good for you.
As I stood there wordless and dumbstruck, 
Charlotte walked around me to take one of the 
rocks from the box.
Charlotte: Apparently this region has some useful minerals. 
Satia got me a sample to see if starting a mine
would be a good idea.
Charlotte: Talk to you later.
Charlotte left and I was left with the sound of 
the tent flap to accompany me collapsing to 
the floor.
Pup: Hahhhhhh-
Footsteps brought a familiar face to look down 
upon my exhausted expression.
Satia: Hm...
She bent down and poked me in the cheek.
Satia: It only gets easier from here.
Pup: ...
Pup: I really hope so. I really do.
passages.content_zh:
Pup：...23...24...我想這就是全部了？
完成庫存後我收起了記事本
當天的輪次。
小狗：…
小狗：哈…
我的手反射性地伸向我的
肩膀。
Pup：（之前運動的時候一定還酸痛吧？）
Pup：幸好我今天的工作已經結束了。
我腳跟上有一個樞軸，朝帳篷走去。
Pup：（我把它放在哪裡了-）
小狗：……？ ！
我感到一種壓迫感、緩衝感壓在我身上
我的背。
？ ？ ？ ：猜猜是誰~
小狗：死亡之手又冷又黏？
？ ？ ？ ：……

「黏糊糊的」？
Pup：在－以一種好的方式？
小狗：噢！
薩蒂亞：太遠了。
小狗：S-對不起…
我揉了揉後背的刺痛感
當我探查薩蒂亞的臉，看看她是否
接受了道歉。
小狗：你需要什麼東西嗎？
薩蒂亞：好冷……而且黏糊糊的。
薩蒂亞：如果我只是想和我的孩子共度時光怎麼辦？ 
最喜歡烏鴉？
Pup：我確信 Norde 就在這附近的某個地方。
薩蒂亞：哦，他可能很冷。確實如此。但他不是
幾乎一樣黏糊糊的。
Pup：我……我說我很抱歉。
薩蒂亞：好吧，如果關於黏液的傳言不是真的，
也許您有足夠的抓力來攜帶一些物品？
薩蒂亞：它們很重，我希望有一些
來自我們首屈一指的財富戰士的幫助。
小狗：盒子？ S-當然。我可以幫忙。
薩蒂亞帶我來到營地邊緣。
小狗：*咕嚕聲*！那裡... G- 明白了。去哪裡？
Satia：嗯...放在哪裡最好？
小狗：噢——當然……不急。
薩蒂亞：你真是英勇啊~
小狗：…
小狗：這——這裡面到底是什麼？
Satia：哦，那是它該去的地方。跟我來。
我們的路通往軍械庫帳篷。裡面有一個
換乘站很少，薩蒂亞帶領我們進入了
女更衣區。
小狗：那裡……我們……走……
當盒子撞到地板上時，房間裡充滿了一聲巨響。 
地面。
小狗：為什麼在這裡？
薩蒂亞：它還有一些儲存空間仍然開放。
薩蒂亞：事實上，我們在這裡的時候，你能幫忙檢查一下嗎？ 
這批裝甲運輸？這是不同的供應商
比我們過去使用過的。
小狗：啊……所以才這麼重。
小狗：當然。反正我之前只是在做庫存。
薩蒂亞給了我一些空間

passages.name: SP: Pup x Satia A - Begining
passages.content:
Pup: Flanking approaches... Supply line...?
My head hurt a bit when I tried to process a recent 
lesson from Kara on battlefield strategy.
Pup: (Ah... Things really get complicated when you have 
a lot of people in a conflict.)
Pup: Hm?
Pup: (That smell...)
A hot bowl of stew dropped itself into my hands. I 
had been waiting in line for dinner.
Pup: (The evening is getting a bit cold, so this would hit 
the spot near the campfire.)
Fellow Crow: Pup. Made it in time for dinner?
Pup: I'd never miss it when we're having this stew.
I plopped myself down onto a bench by the 
campfire next to the other Nightless Crow.

He seemed to be finishing up his own meal.
Fellow Crow: I'll... I'll leave you to your little romance with your 
meal.
Pup: Ah, come on!
He started on his way.
Pup: More like a sibling relationship, if anything~
I raised the spoon, only to be interrupted by the 
sound of a familiar click of a boot.
Pup: (No! Not now!)
My body froze, as if I was hoping the foreboding 
feeling would go away if I pretended it wasn't 
there.
Satia: Pup! I thought I saw that flash of red cloth pitter-
patter past me before.
Pup: W- What brings you here...?
Pup: (Be careful. Be very careful!)
Satia: I could smell the stew from a mile away. It's a nice 
smell in the waning day.
Pup: Well, I was actually just about to-
Satia: It... reminded me of the old days.
Pup: ...

That so...?
Satia placed herself down in the seat the other 
Nightless Crow had just vacated.
Satia: You know that stew recipe pre-dates myself or 
Norde joining the Crows?
Pup: Wow. This is an old recipe.
Satia: ...
Pup: I take it back.
Pup: I just mean... I remember eating this as a kid.
Pup: Back when my dad used to chase me around 
because he feared that I'd trip onto a sword's 
edge.
Satia: *Giggle*
Satia: You were so cute then. I do miss those days.
Pup: I sometimes wonder if I'd go back if given the 
chance...
Satia: No need. In a roundabout way, you're back to 
being cute like then, again.
Pup: Th- That's not what I meant.
Satia: Or maybe you always were and the cute little Pup 
never went away?
Pup: Yeah. That helps. Thanks.
Satia: The more things change, the more they stay the 
same.
Pup: Speak for yourself. These things are a killer with the 
weight.
Pup: (I could only imagine how bad it'd be if they were 
still as big as before.)
Pup: Speak for yourself. These things weigh a ton.
Pup: I really don't know how you girls manage to carry 
them around all the time.
Satia: I'm sure you'll get use to it.
Satia: Though, I have to say...
Pup: (That look isn't good. Did I fall into another trap?!)
Satia: Your new outfit looks quite nice. A bit breezy, 
maybe?
Pup: (That's... got to be a leading question?)
Pup: No, it's nothing like that. Just a matter of getting 
used... to... all the flappy bits?

The skirts and stuff. They can be comfortable and 
all that?
Satia: ...
Pup: (W- Was that the wrong answer?)
Satia: I'm happy to hear you think that. Skirts and dresses 
can be a girl's best friend.
My eye twitched a little. It still felt very weird to 
have that directed at me.
Satia: They can also be a girl's worst enemy at times.
She motioned downwards.

I looked down to match.
Pup: Huh? Did I... Did I step in something?
Satia: ...
Satia stood up and walked over to me.

Her hands lowered onto my knees...

...and closed them.
Satia: A well adjusted young lady...
Satia: ...does not sit with her legs wide open.
Pup: S- Sorry?
Pup: Wait, but I have spats for that?
Satia: That's not the issue.
Satia: Maybe it's time for a pop quiz?
Pup: (Trap sprung! Trap sprung!)
Satia: Have you been taking care of your hair? Brushing it 
like I showed you?

How about your clothes? Are you cleaning them 
properly? They will show dirt more easily than your 
old clothes.
What about skin... shampoo... nails...
Pup: I mean- I...
My head went in circles as the standing Satia 
towered over me.
Pup: I've been brushing my hair daily! With the- With the 
brown- No, green brush!
Pup: From top to bottom!
Satia: It's from bottom to top.
Satia: And why would the color matter?
Pup: I... mean... atmosphere...?
Pup: Plus, I've been changing between my sets of 
clothes each day!
Satia: While folding them like I showed you?
Pup: "Fold"?
Satia: ...
Pup: I- I'm sorry! I'm no good at being a girl!

I- I'm just a failure at this, too!
My eyes closed and my hands sprung up as if in 
submission.
Satia: *Sigh*
An eye of mine peeked open with the silence.

Satia wasn't standing in front of me anymore.
Pup: Hm?
I turned my head to the side and-
Pup: What?!
Satia: I'm sorry.
An encircling feeling of pressure and warmth was 
placed upon me.

Satia was hugging me.
Satia: I'm being too harsh on you., aren't I?
Satia: It can be hard for me to understand how big the 
learning curve can be, but all girls go through it at 
some point.
Satia: And you make a lovely girl.
Pup: I...
I hugged her back.
Pup: You keep calling me that, haha...
Satia: A very pretty girl.
Pup: Actually, could you not?
Satia: The envy of every woman and the focus of every 
man's eyeline.
Pup: You're loving this, aren't you?
Satia: I mean it. I think you make a lovely girl. Do you not 
want to be?
Pup: I do. It just... feels like another ideal I can't live up 
to.
Pup: How in Ilvanis have you been able to manage this all 
for your whole life?
Satia backed away from the hug and looked me 
straight in the eye.
Satia: It's a matter of accepting and knowing who you 
are.

A woman’s body takes a lot of care, yes. But I can 
assure you it's worth it.

Few things that are worth it will come easily.
Pup: It's easy to say that, but...

(I could ask... I mean, does that really have a 
chance of backfiring now?)
Pup: Could you- Could you... teach me? Properly? All the 
things I never learned on how to be a girl?
Satia: Of course.
Satia: And I'll try to make sure we take it at your pace.

So you can take each step towards becoming a 
woman you can be proud of.
Pup: T- Thank you.

(Maybe she really isn't as bad as I thought?)
Satia: First lesson is bathing together~
Pup: *Sigh*... I take it all back.
Norde: Ladies.
I turned my head.
Pup: (Oh, did I just react to that without hesitation?)
Norde: Kara wanted to confirm some things with us. Do 
you have a minute?
Pup: Sure.
I stood up and began after Norde. Turning to Satia 
before I left, I said my farewell.
Pup: I'll talk to you later...

...Auntie Satia.
Satia: ...?!
I quickly pivoted to trail in Norde's footsteps, but 
gave a wave on my path.
Pup: Better etch that into your memory! It's the only 
one you'll get.
Satia: *Giggle*
Satia's head shifted to the stew that was left cold 
and half eaten.
Satia: I'll miss these times, too...
passages.content_zh:
Pup: 側翼進攻... 補給線...？
當我試圖理解卡拉最近上的戰場策略課時，我有點頭痛。
Pup: (啊... 當衝突牽涉到很多人時，事情真的會變得複雜。)
Pup: 嗯？
Pup: (這味道...)
一碗熱騰騰的燉湯自動掉進我手中。我一直在排隊等晚餐。
Pup: (傍晚有點冷，所以在營火旁喝這個一定很棒。)
同袍夜鴉：Pup。趕上晚餐了？
Pup: 有這燉湯我絕不會錯過。
我一屁股坐在營火旁的長凳上，旁邊是另一位夜無眠鴉。

他似乎正在享用自己的晚餐。
同袍夜鴉：我... 我讓你好好享受你和晚餐的浪漫時光。
Pup: 哎呀，別這樣嘛！
他開始離開。
Pup: 更像是兄弟姐妹情誼，如果有的話～
我舉起湯匙，卻被熟悉的靴子聲打斷。
Pup: (不！不是現在！)
我的身體僵住了，彷彿我希望如果我假裝它不存在，那種不祥的感覺就會消失。
莎緹雅：Pup！我好像看到一抹紅色布料從我身邊輕快地跑過去。
Pup: 妳、妳來這裡做什麼...？
Pup: (小心點。非常小心！)
莎緹雅：我從一英里外就聞到燉湯的味道了。在日暮時分聞到這種味道真好。
Pup: 嗯，我其實正要-
莎緹雅：它... 讓我想起了過去的日子。
Pup: ...

是嗎...？
莎緹雅坐在另一位夜無眠鴉剛離開的座位上。
莎緹雅：妳知道這燉湯的食譜比我和諾德加入夜鴉還要早嗎？
Pup: 哇。這是個古老的食譜。
莎緹雅：...
Pup: 我收回。
Pup: 我只是說... 我記得小時候吃過這個。
Pup: 那時候我爸爸總是追著我跑，因為他怕我會絆倒在劍刃上。
莎緹雅：*咯咯笑*
莎緹雅：妳那時候真可愛。我真的很懷念那些日子。
Pup: 我有時候會想，如果有的話，我會不會回到過去...
莎緹雅：不需要。以一種迂迴的方式，妳又變回像那時候一樣可愛了。
Pup: 這、這才不

passages.name: SP: RowanxCainanC - Talk
passages.content:
A figure stood on a street corner.
Rowan: So stands the horizon's valiant winds~

Swept up with blossoms so twilight rescinds~

Day by daybreak~

Passes us by~

Night by midnight~

Counters with questions of why~
Rowan: ...
The small crowd that had formed around Rowan 
stood still.

And stayed still for longer still.
Villager: ...is that... it?
A light, hesitant applause rose from the onlookers. 

The crowd soon dispersed with a small set of coins 
having found their way into Rowan's donation bag.
Rowan: ...
Rowan: Another brilliant performance.
Cainan: A performance? Is that what that was?
Cainan stepped forward from the dispersing crowd.
Rowan: The glittering of bronze and silver at my feet is 
proof enough.
Cainan: Of your skill?
Rowan: Of happiness.
Rowan: Appreciation that reflects a little joy being sparked 
within the world.
Cainan: Interesting. Interesting.
Cainan pulled out a gold coin and dropped it into 
the donation bag.
Cainan: Consider it a reflection much the same, though 
perhaps not so directly from the song.
Rowan: Every bit of light brightens the world.
Rowan: Such light is the light of the Goddess, no?
Cainan: You do well to refuse me the option of disagreeing, 
haha...
Cainan: Though, if this is your normal income... it would be 
difficult to travel as you have.
Rowan: There are... other sources of revenue for those 
that wander.
Cainan: Few of legal certainty, I imagine.
Cainan: Was joining this band of mercenaries meant to give 
you financial stability?
Rowan: It was an unexpected boon. That much is sure.
Rowan hummed a melody that cut through the
silence of a pause.
Cainan: You know...

I barely recognized you when we met again. You 
could be considered a new person in more ways 
than one.
Rowan: I feel...
Rowan: ...liberated.
Rowan: You may say I've thrown off those chains that 
weighed me down.
Cainan: Poetic.
Cainan: Do your parents know? I can't imagine this would 
please them.
Rowan: I would think news made its way home long ago. 
Maybe before journey's start?
Rowan: But I'll hold their disapproval as a badge of pride.
Rowan: After the trouble they've caused...
Rowan just sighed dramatically while Cainan 
acted unfazed.
Rowan: So what twists has your life been through since 
we last met?

I likely was away when you last visited, no?

Mayhap you even have knowledge of... Mikhail?
Cainan: What of him?
Rowan: You are not aware? I had thought that since he 
headed to...

Ah, no matter.
Rowan: I will not burden you needlessly, then.
Cainan: Hmm...
Cainan: Is that what drives you to action?

You are looking for him? Is that the motivation for 
following this group, even?
Rowan: ...

There is no need for you to-
Cainan: Nonsense. I've known the boy for as long as I've 
known you.

While I haven't heard anything as of now, I'll be 
sure to keep my ear to the ground should anything 
surface.
Rowan: I...
Cainan: You needn't say a word.
Cainan placed his hand on Rowan's shoulder.
Cainan: We'll do what we can to keep Mikhail's light of 
happiness faced towards to the days ahead.
Rowan: ...
Rowan: T- Thank you... sir...
Cainan: ...
Cainan smiled a large smile before heading off 
on his way.

Rowan, on the other hand, stared down at the 
donation bag with an uncertain look on his face.
Rowan: ...
passages.content_zh:
一個身影站在街角。
羅文: 如此屹立著，地平線英勇的風~

被花朵席捲，暮色也消退~

日復一日~

從我們身邊流逝~

夜復午夜~

用疑問反擊，為了什麼~
羅文: ...
聚集在羅文周圍的小群眾
靜止不動。

而且靜止了更久。
村民: ...就...這樣？
一陣輕微、猶豫的掌聲從旁觀者中響起。

人群很快散去，一小堆硬幣
找到了通往羅文捐款袋的道路。
羅文: ...
羅文: 又一次精彩的演出。
凱南: 演出？那就是那玩意兒？
凱南從散去的人群中走了出來。
羅文: 我腳下閃爍的青銅和白銀
足以證明一切。
凱南: 證明你的技巧？
羅文: 證明快樂。
羅文: 證明那份欣賞，反映了在世界中被點燃的一點喜悅。
凱南: 有趣。有趣。
凱南掏出一枚金幣，丟進了
捐款袋裡。
凱南: 把它當作同樣的反映，雖然
或許並非直接來自歌曲。
羅文: 每一點光都照亮世界。
羅文: 這樣的光，不就是女神的光嗎？
凱南: 你做得很好，不給我反駁的機會，
哈哈...
凱南: 不過，如果這是你正常的收入...你很難像你一樣旅行。
羅文: 對於那些
四處遊蕩的人來說，還有...其他的收入來源。
凱南: 我想，很少是合法的。
凱南: 加入這支傭兵團，是為了給你
財務上的穩定嗎？
羅文: 這是一份意想不到的恩惠。這是肯定的。
羅文哼了一段旋律，劃破了
沉默的停頓。
凱南: 你知道嗎...

我們再次相遇時，我幾乎認不出你。你
可以被認為是一個全新的人，在多方面都是。
羅文: 我感到...
羅文: ...解放。
羅文: 你可以說我已經擺脫了那些
束縛我的枷鎖。
凱南: 詩意。
凱南: 你的父母知道嗎？我無法想像這會
讓他們高興。
羅文: 我想消息早就傳回家了。
也許

passages.name: SP: Rowan x Eve C - Talk
passages.content:
Eve: Didn't they say there was going to be a 
"celebration" tonight?
Eve: I guess this will be peaceful after all.
Five minutes later...
Rowan: And so...~

The midnight wanders wearily~
Fellow Crow: *Whistles* Encore!
Fellow Crow 2: Haha! Bravo! I didn't know you could butcher that 
song so badly!
Rowan: Thank you, my dear fans! Thank you!
Shortly away from the singing and dancing...
Pup: And then the guy took a swing at me. Then he-
Charlotte: Then he missed?
Pup: S- Shut up. I'm telling the story.
Pup: So it turned out that his weapon wasn't sharpened 
properly, so it...
Shortly away from that still...
Eve: W- What is this... What is this a celebration of...?
Fellow Crow: Who gets next dibs on singing?
Rowan: Ah... I have an idea!
Rowan: Our dear beloved Eve... Would you?
Eve: Eek!
Charlotte: Did she faint?!
A blur of pink, blue, and brown could be seen 
literally rolling away from the festivities at a 
fevered pace.
Pup: I think that's more a tactical retreat...
Rowan: Oh my...
The blur of rolling stopped and jumped to its feet.
Eve: *Pant*... *pant*...
Eve: *Breathes in*

*Breathes out*
For a few minutes, Eve simply stood there to
catch her breath.
Rowan: Have you managed to calm yourself?
Eve: I won't let you-
Eve jumped to an awkward defensive stance.
Eve: Oh, you're not a monster.
Eve: I just wanted some fresh air, I guess...
Rowan: I suppose even a flower can get tired of the sun, 
after a time.
Eve: Uh... yeah?
Eve: That is why the night is important for them.
Eve: The seasons are probably a lot more impactful, 
though.
Eve: Unless you're an alrune... You'd be surprised how 
much sun they can handle.
Rowan: Hah! Such an avalanche of words.
Rowan: Are you sure you don't wish to take the stage 
tonight? Mayhap with melodies of flowers?
Eve: Oh, I don't sing.
Eve: Besides, you had plenty of good options for who 
could sing next. The guy before you was pretty 
good.
Rowan: Bah humbleness!
Rowan: Surely a flower sprouts forth from every seed?
Eve: *Chuckles*... I think you'd be surprised.

Some plants don't even have flowers. Plus flowers 
without seeds.
Eve: That's a whole different topic, though...
Rowan smiled and nodded along absentmindedly.
Eve: Did you just come out here to talk to me about 
flowers and fruit?
Eve: Are you interested in gardening, maybe?
Rowan: I came to water a withered flower.
Eve: You all seemed to be having fun at the party. Are 
you sure you want to talk about this now? Don't 
you want to go back?
Rowan: Yet a flower arrangement is not at its pinnacle with 
one member missing, no?

Would you like to return together?
Eve: Oh, I'm okay. I'll slip into my tent later on.
Eve: I'm not really the... word talking sort of person...
Rowan: I've yet to see any trouble with the words you rain 
down upon me.
Eve: I'm pretty used to talking to... unique individuals...
Eve: It can take time to meet them, but they've all 
become close friends.
Eve: Honestly, I really miss them.
Rowan: Mayhap we become close much the same?
Rowan: I know a traditional dance that is said to evaporate 
the stress of the day.
Eve: Oh, that sounds nice! Maybe you could teach it to 
me?
Rowan: Gladly!
Rowan: First of all, it a dance of the night. One to be 
performed in one's formal birthday attire.
Eve: Birthday... attire? Like your PJs? I guess I've worn 
them on my birthday before?

This place might be weirder than the farm, though. 
Shouldn't that be used for sleeping?
Rowan: Sleep. Yes. We would sleep together.
Rowan: It would be dance to tire our souls and wipe away 
the exhaustion of the day into the blissful slumber.
Eve: Oh~ I get it.
Rowan: Right, then shall we- ?
Eve: A good exercise always gets me into the sleeping 
mood.
Rowan: I...
Rowan: I guess that is true, but...
Rowan: I meant to sleep... together. As a pair.
Eve: Like... in the same tent?
Eve: There's not that much room, but I guess its okay if 
that's how the dance works.
Rowan: To casually accept as we reach the point of no 
return? I knew I liked you.
Eve: Well it's just two guys sleeping together. Is that a 
weird thing here?
Rowan: A... man, you say?
Eve: Oh, wait... You didn't...?

It's the dress, right?
Eve: A dear friend gifted it to me, so...
Rowan: Say no more. I am not objecting.
Rowan: A rose is more beautiful with a thorn or two, after 
all.
The two met again at Rowan's tent.
Rowan: You are... with company of sorts?
Eve was carrying an extra sleeping bag.
Eve: I wouldn't want to get a cold from sleeping on the 
ground.

Don't worry! We can set it up after the dance.
Eve dropped it in front of the tent.
Rowan: I...
Eve: So how does the dance go? Are the steps 
complicated?
Rowan: I really should be more... direct... at times...
Eve: Sorry?
Rowan: Nothing of import.
Rowan: Now, there is a dance I learned of during my 
wandering.

They say it is several thousand years old and passed 
down by the people of the east island, Nodhan.
Eve: Oo~ Really? That's neat.
passages.content_zh:
Eve：他們不是說會有一個
今晚「慶祝」？
Eve：我想這終究會是和平的。
五分鐘後…
羅文：所以…

半夜疲憊地徘徊~
烏鴉同胞：*口哨聲*再來一次！
烏鴉同胞2：哈哈！太棒了！我不知道你能把它宰掉
歌太難聽了！
羅文：謝謝你們，我親愛的粉絲們！謝謝你！
距離歌舞表演不遠了…
Pup：然後那傢伙朝我揮了拳。然後他——
夏洛特：然後他失手了？
小狗：S-閉嘴。我正在講這個故事。
Pup：原來他的武器沒有磨利
正確地，所以它...
距離那還有不久.....
Eve：這──這是什麼……這是慶祝什麼……？
烏鴉同胞：誰有下一個唱歌的權利？
羅文：啊……我有個主意！
羅文：我們親愛的伊芙……你願意嗎？
伊芙：哎喲！
夏洛特：她暈倒了嗎？ ！
可以看到模糊的粉紅色、藍色和棕色
從字面上滾滾遠離慶祝活動
狂熱的步伐。
Pup：我認為這更像是一種戰術撤退…
羅文：哦天哪...
翻滾的模糊物停止了，跳了起來。
伊芙：*褲子*...*褲子*...
伊芙：*吸氣*

*呼氣*
伊芙只是站在那裡幾分鐘
屏住呼吸。
羅文：你平靜下來了嗎？
伊芙：我不會讓你——
伊芙跳到一個尷尬的防禦姿勢。
伊芙：哦，你不是怪物。
伊芙：我想我只是想要一些新鮮空氣...
羅文：我想即使是花朵也會厭倦陽光，
一段時間後。
伊芙：呃……是嗎？
伊芙：這就是為什麼夜晚對他們來說很重要。
Eve：季節的影響可能更大，
不過。
Eve：除非你是alrune...你會驚訝地發現
他們可以承受大量的陽光。
羅文：哈！如此大量的言語。
羅文：你確定不想上台嗎
今晚？也許伴隨著花的旋律？
伊芙：哦，我不唱歌。
Eve：此外，對誰來說，你還有很多好的選擇。 
接下來可以唱歌了。你之前的那個男人很漂亮
好。
羅文：呸，謙虛！
羅文：每顆種子都會開出花朵嗎？
伊芙：*咯咯笑*...

passages.name: SP: Satia x Jak C - Talk
passages.content:
Satia: There we go.
Satia placed down an axe on the weapon rack.
Satia: Now, with that organized, I should-
Jakson: *Bark*!
Satia stumbled back in surprise, and she almost 
knocked over the weapons she had just organized.
Satia: Phew...
Satia: Jakson? I didn't notice you enter. Did you need 
something?
Satia: Actually, maybe you shouldn't stand so... so...
Jakson had walked up to Satia to the point he was 
standing right next to her.
Satia: You shouldn't... stand so... so...
Satia: ...CLOSE! ACHOO!
Satia flailed back from her sneeze.
Satia: No!
One by one, the weapons acted like dominoes as 
they plunged to the ground.
Satia: Ah... fuck nuggets...
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
Satia: Maybe you... you should.
Satia: ACHOO!
Satia: Please wait outside.
Jakson: *Curious whine*?
Satia hurriedly fixed the mess while Jakson
stepped outside.
Satia: ACHOO!
Satia: Ack!
Drops of hot grease flew upward from the pan 
after Satia's surprise sneeze.
Satia: Hot hot! That... might burn...
She turned to see...
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
Satia: J- Jackson... Could you... wait outside?
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
Jakson happily complied and moved away from 
Satia.

She sighed with a feeling of relief and went back to 
her cooking.
Satia: It doesn't look like it was ruined?
Satia: Thank the Goddess... This was going so well.
Satia shook the pan over the fire and shuffled the 
meat around inside it.
Satia: Hmm...?
A sound had pulled her attention.
Satia: What was-
Satia: ACHOO!
Satia: The food!
As Satia's eyes scanned down to where the meat 
had fallen, she was immediately greeted with 
something else.
Jakson: *Munch* *munch* *munch*
Satia: ...
Satia: Again?
Jakson: *Laugh-Like Whine*
Satia: ...
Satia: Jakson...

You wouldn't be doing this on purpose, would 
you?
The dog looked up while throwing puppy-dog eyes 
at Satia.
Satia: Don't think I'm so easily bewitched.
Jakson: *Huff*
Satia: Do it again and you're not getting-
Satia: ACHOO!
Satia: ...and you're not getting dinner.
Jakson just scoffed and went back to eating.
Satia: *Sigh*... is this going to be a trend?
Satia: You were quite sneaky about it. Where are you 
when I-
Satia: Oh... I have an idea.
Her eyes went down to the inattentive furball 
below.
Jakson: *Munch* *munch* *munch*
Satia: So you want food? Maybe without the trouble of 
this prank of yours?
Jakson: *Curious whine*?
Satia: You just need to do something for me every once 
in a while.
A few days later...
A Nightless Crow threw some playing cards on 
the ground.
Fellow Crow: Argh! Again?

You sure you didn't magic up the Goddess to use 
you as a vessel tonight?
Satia: I'm just channeling her luck, haha...
Satia pulled in the pot for the card game hand. The 
coins jiggled as they fell onto her pile of winnings.

Soon enough, another hand was dealt among the 
circle of Crows.
Satia: ...
Satia looked at her hand. It was quite good. Maybe 
not perfect, but very good.
Satia: Getting a bit late. Maybe we should turn in after 
this hand?
She rolled her shoulder a couple times.
Fellow Crow: Heh. I still got to get my paycheck back.
Satia: You're free to try.
Satia: ...
Satia stared at her cards.

But her eyes shifted upwards as a figure moved in 
the background.
Jakson: ...
He moved slowly and deliberately around the group 
of card players.
Fellow Crow: Last chance to bet.
Jakson passed by Satia's back.
Satia: Well maybe I should up the-
Satia: ACHOO!
Fellow Crow: Come on, Jakson. You know she gets like that 
around you.

Come here, boy. Don't bother her.
Satia: It's... *sniff*... quite alright.
Satia: I think I'll fold.
Fellow Crow: What? Dammit...
Satia: What did you have?
The Crow laid down his hand to show how lucky 
and unbeatable his hand was that round.
Fellow Crow: Eh... at least I got a little of that Goddess's luck in 
the end.
The group dispersed with the game ending.
Satia: Same time next week?
Jakson discreetly approached Satia.
Satia: Thanks, boy.
She gave Jakson a pet and pulled out some 
meat for him to snack on.
Jakson: *Happy whine*
Satia: I never would've thought he'd have that sort of 
hand. I would have lost there for sure.
Jakson: *Munch*
Satia: ACHOO!
Satia: Now, for next time, the pattern will be a bit 
different. We can...
passages.content_zh:
薩蒂亞：我們開始吧。
薩蒂亞將一把斧頭放在武器架上。
薩蒂亞：現在，安排好了，我應該-
傑克森：*吠*！
薩蒂亞驚訝地向後退了一步，她差點就
打翻了她剛剛整理的武器。
薩蒂亞：呼…
薩蒂亞：傑克森？我沒注意到你進來了。你需要嗎
東西？
薩蒂亞：事實上，也許你不該這麼站著…所以…
傑克森走到薩蒂亞面前，直到他
就站在她旁邊。
薩蒂亞：你不應該…站得那麼…那麼…
薩蒂亞：...關閉！啊呼！
薩蒂亞從噴嚏中猛地向後退了一步。
薩蒂亞：不！
一件一件的武器就像骨牌一樣
他們跌倒在地。
薩蒂亞：啊……操金塊……
傑克森：*快樂吠叫*！
薩蒂亞：也許你……你應該。
薩蒂亞：阿呼！
薩蒂亞：請在外面等一下。
傑克森：*好奇的哀鳴*？
薩蒂亞趕緊收拾殘局，而傑克森則忙著收拾殘局。
走出去。
薩蒂亞：阿呼！
薩蒂亞：嗯！
滾燙的油脂從鍋裡向上飛濺
在薩蒂亞驚訝地打噴嚏之後。
薩蒂亞：熱熱熱！那……可能會燃燒……
她扭頭一看…
傑克森：*快樂吠叫*！
Satia：J-Jackson...你能...在外面等一下嗎？
傑克森：*快樂吠叫*！
傑克森高興地答應了，然後離開了。 
薩蒂亞.

她鬆了口氣，然後又回家了。 
她的廚藝。
薩蒂亞：看起來不像是被毀了？
薩蒂亞：感謝女神……一切進展順利。
薩蒂亞在火上晃動平底鍋，然後攪動鍋子
裡面有肉。
薩蒂亞：嗯……？
一個聲音吸引了她的注意。
薩蒂亞：那是什麼——
薩蒂亞：阿呼！
薩蒂亞：食物！
當薩蒂亞的眼睛向下掃到肉的地方時
摔倒後，立刻迎接她的是
其他的東西。
傑克森：*蒙奇* *蒙奇* *蒙奇*
薩蒂亞：…
薩蒂亞：再來一次？
傑克森：*笑聲般的哀鳴*
薩蒂亞：…
薩蒂亞：傑克森…

你不會是故意這樣做的
你？
狗抬起頭，同時投擲小狗的眼睛
在薩蒂亞.
薩蒂亞：別以為我那麼容易著迷。
傑克森：*生氣*
Satia：再做一次，你就不會－－
薩蒂亞：阿呼！
Satia：……你不吃晚餐了。
傑克森只是嗤之以鼻，然後就走了

passages.name: SP: Satia x Norde C - Talk
passages.content:
Satia: ...
Satia walked through the setting night in the 
quiet and still camp.
Satia: ...?
A sound like a whisper came from a tent she was 
passing.
Satia: ...
Fellow Crow: ...and you... want it...
Fellow Crow: But yeah, I can grab that.
Norde: Thank you.
The Crow turned to notice Satia.
Fellow Crow: Didn't see you there, Dunaid.

Need something from town? I'm headed out 
to pick up a-
Norde: ...
A raised hand from Norde stopped the man from 
talking.
Fellow Crow: Uh... I guess you can ask, instead.

Still, need anything?
Satia: I appreciate the offer, but I'm good.
Fellow Crow: Gotcha. I'll be off.
The Nightless Crow walked out of the tent.
Satia: You're sending him off to wander through the 
night to town?
Norde: Are we not supposed to be "Nightless"?
Satia: *Gasp*! A joke? From grumpy face Norde of all 
people?
Satia: D- Did something happen?
Norde: *Sigh*... Of course not.
Norde: Now, may I-
Satia placed herself between Norde and the exit.
Satia: What did you send him to get?
Norde: Nothing to put you in a rush to find out.
Norde tried to sidestep Satia. She repositioned 
herself again.
Satia: ...
Norde: I really must...
Satia: I could chase after him myself.
Norde: ...There is no... need.
Satia: Maybe I could even distract him from finishing the 
job you sent him on?
Norde: *Sigh*... Fine.
Norde: A mantlet.
Satia: Sorry?
Norde: A mantlet.
Satia: I heard.

Why would we need one? Those are shields meant 
for adjustable fortifications.
Norde: Since Lockhart, I have felt...
Norde: No... We have objectively found ourselves passing 
through more populated areas than normal.
Satia: Right... We ARE new to most of these places.
Satia: Are you worried about the villages getting attacked 
because of us?

If so, we can just run away and pull the attacking 
forces away from the villages.
Norde: Even then...
Satia: Who would carry the mantlet? They are not small 
nor light.

We'd need more than one to provide a true 
defense, too.
Norde: Even... then...
Satia: What would the populace think if we just carried 
those into town? Maybe they'd think we're 
expecting a seige?
Norde: EVEN... THEN...!
Norde: Even then... I wish to be prepared. Prepared for 
what seems inevitable.
A silence fell over the two.
Satia: *Giggle*
Satia: You don't get like this often.
Norde: *Sigh*...
Satia: Protecting the populace, though...?

Admirable, but we'd have to give priorities to the 
Crows.
Satia: Trying to play guardian can be a bit foolish at 
times...
Norde: May I leave?
Satia: Oh... I remember now.
Norde: I am leaving now.
Norde tried to pass around Satia, but she took hold 
of an arm to block safe passage.
Satia: Hellena.
Young Norde: I... I want to join you! To join the Nightless Crows!
Harold: What's this now, boy?
Satia: I remember the scene quite clearly.

A village, mostly burned to the ground... a young 
man, standing with several small children hiding 
behind his back...
Norde: ...
Harold: Want to make a difference in the war? Join the 
army.
Young Norde: I tried... I tried again and again and again and... 
and...
Satia: He had saved those children. They were strangers 
to him, but when the soldiers came to the village, 
he stood tall.
Satia: *Giggle*... I remember you looking cute as you 
puffed out your chest.
Norde: Is that how you remember it?
Young Satia: Why would the army take a lizard? They don't want 
savages.
Satia: It has...

It has been more than a few years since then. I 
was new in the Crows myself at the time.
Harold: Satia... hold your tongue.

*Sigh*... What is it that you want, boy? The 
reason you ask?
Young Norde: I want to make a difference. If he was here... this 
would have never happened...

I want to become strong enough to make a 
difference!
Harold: Valiant. 

But do you know what mercenaries normally 
do?

It isn't a business of saving children.
Young Norde: I just need... something... to take that first step...
Harold: Hmm...
Young Satia: You're not really going to do this?
Harold: Boy, what's your name?
Young Norde: Norde.
Harold: Norde what?
Young Norde: "Norde" is all I need.
Harold: Very well, Norde of the Norde lineage.

Consider yourself a Crow.
Young Norde: ...

Thank you.
Norde: Is there a point to this story?
Satia: A very important point.

You've done this before.

Throw yourself into the fire to fight for a hopeless 
cause.

I just want to make sure you're not going to kill the 
Crows to save a couple children you never met
before.
Norde: ...
Norde: Strength in inaction is no strength at all.
Satia: What?!
Norde was freed from Satia's grip after a quick 
movement.
Satia: Strength is... like...

Strength is like the ability to... protect those you 
love!
Satia's words fell on deaf ears with Norde exiting 
the tent before she could think of what she 
wanted to say.
Satia: You want to be like that?
Satia: Maybe I should bring Pup in on this conversation?
Norde: Please don't overcomplicate this.
Satia: Oh dear Pup, we've got a new thing for you to 
carry as we travel~

It's a portable wall as big as you!
Norde: Tsk... that could work for your intent...

Fine. What is your price?
Satia: Oh, we're bigger than that this time.
Satia: Pup~
Norde: D- Dammit!
passages.content_zh:
薩蒂亞：…
薩蒂亞在夜色中漫步
安靜，仍然露營。
薩蒂亞：……？
類似耳語的聲音從她所在的帳篷傳來。 
通過。
薩蒂亞：…
烏鴉同胞：……而你……想要它……
Crow同胞：但是，是的，我可以抓住它。
諾德：謝謝。
烏鴉轉身注意到薩蒂亞。
烏鴉同伴：沒在那裡看到你，杜奈德。

需要從城裡帶點東西嗎？我要出門了
拿起一個-
諾德：…
諾德舉起手阻止了那人
說話。
Crow同胞：呃……我想你可以問一下。

還需要什麼嗎？
薩蒂亞：我很感激這個提議，但我很好。
烏鴉同胞：明白了。我就走了。
不夜鴉從帳篷裡走了出來。
薩蒂亞：你要送他去流浪
晚上進城？
Norde：我們不應該是「不夜城」嗎？
薩蒂亞：*喘氣*！一個笑話？來自脾氣暴躁的北歐人
人？
Satia：D-發生什麼事了嗎？
Norde：*嘆氣*...當然不是。
Norde：現在，我可以──
薩蒂亞站在諾德和出口之間。
薩蒂亞：你派他來是為了得到什麼？
Norde：沒什麼能讓你急於找出答案。
諾德試圖避開薩蒂亞。她重新定位
又是她自己。
薩蒂亞：…
諾德：我真的必須…
薩蒂亞：我自己可以追他。
Norde：……沒有……必要。
薩蒂亞：也許我甚至可以分散他完成任務的注意力
你派他去做的工作？
Norde：*嘆氣*...好。
諾德：護盾。
薩蒂亞：抱歉？
諾德：護盾。
薩蒂亞：我聽說了。

為什麼我們需要一個？這些都是盾牌的意思
用於可調節的防禦工事。
Norde：自從洛克哈特之後，我感覺到了…
Norde：不……我們客觀地發現自己已經通過了
透過比平常人口更多的地區。
薩蒂亞：是的……我們對這些地方的大部分都是陌生的。
薩蒂亞：你擔心村莊遭到攻擊嗎
因為我們？

如果是這樣，我們就可以逃跑並拉開進攻
部隊撤離村莊。
諾德：即便如此…
薩蒂亞：誰來承擔這個責任？它們並不小
也不光。

我們需要不只一個來提供真實的
防守也是如此。
諾德：即使……那麼……
薩蒂亞：那會怎樣？

passages.name: SP: Tatiana x Rowan C - Talk
passages.content:
Old Woman: T- Take it! Just take it and leave!
In an alleyway, an old woman's hand extended out.

It held a sparkling golden necklace with a beautiful 
ruby in its center.
A Bandit: Shit ain't a heirloom, is it?
A Bandit too: Yeah. Noble asses like you got that shit right?

Don't even think about trying to track us.
with your shitty magic!
The two men stood in the only path of retreat 
that the woman had. They were already holding 
a purse.
Old Woman: No magic! My damn brother got that thing...
A Bandit: Hmph.
He snatched the necklace from her.
A Bandit too: Nice doing business with you, then.
Slipping into a nearby abandoned building, the two 
bandits started to search through the purse they 
had also stolen.
A Bandit: Not bad.

Not bad at all...
A Bandit too: Think maybe she's got friends and-
A Bandit: Ack!
A metal hand burst through a nearby wall! 

It grabbed the man by his throat!
A Bandit too: What the fuck?!
A hollow voice echoed in the building.
Tatiana: Drop the crap and make yourself scarce.
A Bandit too: Who the fuck are you? The army?!
Tatiana: Don't make me say it twice.
A Bandit: D- D- Do what... it- it says...!
Both of the bandits dropped their loot.

Tatiana released her grip.
A Bandit: *Gasp*!

Run!
Like scared rats, the bandits scattered out of the 
building.
Tatiana: Perfect.
Not too long after, a crowd formed in the nearby 
street.
Soldier: On the ground! Hands where I can see them!
Old Woman: Y- Yes. Those were the men!
A Bandit: I swear! We don't got nothin'!
A set of eyes looked on the scene. They gazed 
from where the hushed whisper's of the crowd
resonated.
Tatiana: Heh. And you'll never get it back
Rowan: Mayhap that be the case.
Tatiana: ...!?
She jumped back a step in shock.
Tatiana: Oh, it's you...

Why are you here?
Rowan: I stake out the street corners on all the towns we 
visit. They are my stage, after all.
Tatiana: Okay... Sure. Whatever.
Tatiana started to turn away from the gathering.
Rowan: You don't need to do this, you know?
Tatiana: ...
She stopped for a second before continuing on.
Rowan: *Sigh*...
With a skip in his step, Rowan caught up with 
Tatiana.
Rowan: It is admirable to help that old lady, but...
Rowan: Would it not be best to avoid any action that
draws such attention to oneself?
Tatiana: It wasn't for her.
Tatiana stopped dead in her tracks, and Rowan 
almost lost his balance when trying to mimic her.

She turned to her side to see a youthful homeless 
boy sleeping at the inlet of an alleyway.
Rowan: Ah...
Tatiana: ...
Tatiana looked around to make sure no one was 
watching.

She bent down and lowered the gold necklace into 
a small donation bag sitting next to the sleeping 
youth.
Carefully, she covered it up with the little other 
donations he had gotten recently.
Tatiana: There...

Let's go.
Rowan: Of course.
Rowan silently followed Tatiana as she quietly 
distributed some of the stolen noble wealth to the 
poor of the city.
Their day ended as they retreated to an isolated 
alley.
Rowan appeared both excited and distraught.
Rowan: What to do? What to do?

For such a daring endeavor... 
Yet one of dauntless risk all the same!

Ah! But I must...!
Tatiana: Shh! Do you want to cause a scene?
Rowan: My dearest Tatiana!
Rowan's hands exploded upwards and grabbed 
onto the sides of Tatiana's shoulders.
Tatiana: ...
She didn't like it.
Rowan: We two are stuck between a rock and a hard-
Rowan: Ah... Ack! Grgh...!
Two metal gauntlets had jumped out of Tatiana's 
pack and grabbed tightly onto Rowan's wrists.

Inch by inch, the gauntlets painfully and forcefully 
pushed Rowan's arms back into a vulnerable 
position.
Tatiana: Don't touch me.
Rowan: Ack- Acknowledged.
Tatiana: Just say what you need to say.
Rowan: Then... I suppose I have two questions.

First...
Rowan: Have you ever used these in foreplay before?
Tatiana: Second question.
Rowan: Ah, well... It is simply a matter of what was 
discussed prior.

You are best served by laying low for some time, 
yes?

These acts are only a risk to yourself and the group 
as a whole.
Tatiana: I'm not going to stop, if that's what you're asking.
Tatiana: Not like I'm not trying to lay low. I went after the
bandits instead of the noble bitch directly.

*Sigh*... You're saying I should leave and shit, 
right?
Rowan: Well, then mayhap we could...
Rowan: Actually, these gauntlets are starting to make me 
feel numb. Could you...?
Tatiana: Are you going to get weird again?
Rowan: That... is not a promise I can make.
Tatiana: Then be quick about it for your blood flow's sake.
Rowan: Then... if you wish to steal from the rich... then 
I may have a more promising solution?

Not as valiant and dashing as your crusade 
from before was, but...

There is more than one way to steal from the 
rich and powerful.
Tatiana: Huh? What do you mean?
With Tatiana being surprised, the grip of the 
gauntlets was released.
Rowan: Ah... much better.
Tatiana: What are you talking about? 
"Other ways to steal from the rich?"
Rowan: Many a ways.

If I may present one as example alone?
Rowan waited, and Tatiana nodded for him to 
continue.
Rowan: Excellent.
Rowan moved his hands around in a whimsical 
fashion, only to end up with a playing card in his 
grip.
Rowan: Have you ever heard of...
He turned the card to show it as the Ace of 
Hearts.
Rowan: ...the heart of the cards?
passages.content_zh:
老婦人：T- 拿去！拿去然後滾！
在一個小巷裡，一位老婦人伸出了手。

她手上拿著一條閃閃發光的金項鍊，中間鑲著一顆美麗的
紅寶石。
強盜：這玩意兒不是傳家寶吧？
另一個強盜：對啊。像妳這種貴族老屁股才會有這種東西，對吧？

別想著追蹤我們。
用妳那爛魔法！
兩個男人站在老婦人唯一的退路上。他們已經拿著
一個錢包了。
老婦人：沒有魔法！那是我該死的哥哥給我的...
強盜：哼。
他從她手中搶走了項鍊。
另一個強盜：那生意就做到這囉。
兩個強盜溜進附近一棟廢棄的建築物，開始搜刮他們
也偷來的錢包。
強盜：不錯嘛。

非常不錯...
另一個強盜：妳覺得她會不會有朋友，然後-
強盜：呃！
一隻金屬手從附近的牆壁中爆出！

它掐住了那個男人的喉嚨！
另一個強盜：他媽的什麼鬼？！
一個空洞的聲音在建築物裡迴盪。
塔蒂亞娜：放下垃圾，然後滾遠點。
另一個強盜：妳他媽的是誰？軍隊嗎？！
塔蒂亞娜：別讓我說第二次。
強盜：D- D- 照... 照它說的做...！
兩個強盜都丟掉了他們的贓物。

塔蒂亞娜鬆開了她的手。
強盜：*喘氣*！

快跑！
像受驚的老鼠一樣，強盜們四處逃竄，離開了
建築物。
塔蒂亞娜：完美。
不久之後，附近街道聚集了一群人。
士兵：趴在地上！手放在我看得見的地方！
老婦人：Y- 是的。就是那些人！
一雙眼睛注視著這一幕。他們從人群
竊竊私語的地方凝視著。
塔蒂亞娜：哼。而且妳永遠也拿不回它了
羅文：或許是這樣吧。
塔蒂亞娜：...！？
她震驚地往後退了一步。
塔蒂亞娜：喔，是你啊...

你來這裡做什麼？
羅文：我會在我們拜訪的所有城鎮的街角駐足。畢竟，那是我的舞台。
塔蒂亞娜：好吧... 隨便。
塔蒂亞娜開始轉身離開人群。
羅文：妳不需要這樣做的，妳知道嗎？
T

passages.name: SP: Charlotte x Mariel C - Talk
passages.content:
Charlotte: Hmph.
Charlotte fiddled with the gadget in her hand. The 
flickers of the firepit melded with the fire stained 
sky that curtained the scene.
Charlotte: What's the point of a mobile telegraph station if 
you can't handle the magic input?

If I could get this to work, we wouldn't have to 
rely on carriers and... and...
Charlotte: Argh! Dammit...
Charlotte: They really had the gall to claim the development 
of this was finished.
Charlotte, without looking, turned and reached 
towards a small work surface she had setup 
nearby.
Charlotte: Maybe... the energy storage needs to be 
expanded?

Maybe it... it...
Charlotte: ...it...?
Charlotte's head turned as the item she reached 
for didn't slide into her hand.
Charlotte: The power cell was definitely there.
Charlotte turned on her firepit adjacent seat and 
towards the camp around her.

It was mostly empty after people hustled to get 
some rest after a recent battle.
Pup: Here. This remedy typically helps with burns and 
blood loss.
Though, there was one set of people lined up 
directly in Charlotte's eyeline.
Charlotte: That one probably wouldn't be helpful...
The pair happened to be a pair of two.
The conversation included another.
Mariel: I didn't think you'd be able to get it so quickly.
Charlotte: Now her? She can probably help.
Mariel: Thank you. This is just what the doctor ordered.
Pup: My pleasure.
Charlotte stood up and stepped within earshot of 
the two.
Charlotte: Sis, would you happen to have seen-
Mariel: Oh, Charlotte. Good night to you, too!
Charlotte: ...happen to have seen... a power cell...?
With a tilt of the head, Charlotte watched as Mariel 
ducked into a nearby tent.
Charlotte: Hmm... What's she in a rush for?
Pup: You need something, too?
Charlotte: Maybe. You see where my power cell went?
Pup: A power what?
Charlotte: ...
Pup: I- If you lost something, then maybe you dropped 
it in that last fight?
Pup: It did just happen before we got back to camp.
Charlotte: Don't you have a stick to swing around or 
something?
Pup: Hey. Practice does makes perfect.
Charlotte: At swinging a-
She stopped herself.
Charlotte: *Sigh*... Sure, you go perfect that.
Pup: Heh. Just watch me.
Charlotte was met with the gaze of someone 
heading off to grab a sword.
Charlotte: Did I really drop it?

Mariel might have seen if I did.
Charlotte: She went in here, right?
Charlotte had begun to enter the tent quietly, 
but her thoughts were interrupted by an 
unexpected scene.
Mariel: Come on... You can... make it...
A small flash of light burst from the ground where 
Mariel's hands had steadied.

Beside them, the glow of a power cell could been 
seen flickering away its remaining light.
Charlotte: ...
Another burst of light.

Another burst.

Another.

And then none.
Mariel: *Pant*...
Mariel took a few deep breathes.

After a few tense seconds, she relaxed back into 
sitting on the ground.
Mariel: ...
Her shoulders slumped down.
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte's hand reached to fully open the tent's 
door, but she hesitated for a second.
Mariel: ...?!
Charlotte: Sis?
There was a slight twinge in her voice.
Mariel: C- Charlotte...
Mariel scooted herself over to block the view of 
what she was performing the magic on.
Charlotte: I'm... I'm looking for a power cell. I thought maybe 
you saw it recently.
Mariel: Y- Yes, actually.. I found this on the ground, 
actually... It was already dead, actually.
Charlotte: Then perhaps it isn't the one I'm thinking of.
Mariel: Perhaps, yeah... Maybe Pup saw something?
Charlotte: That I doubt.
Mariel: Always worth asking, right?
Charlotte: True. Which reminds me that I had another 
question.
Charlotte: How's that bird doing?
Mariel: You... You saw?
Charlotte just nodded.
Mariel: No good...

It got hit by some stray magic in the last fight, 
and... and...

I'm sorry. I didn't want to appear like I was being 
wasteful.
Charlotte: It's very... you, I suppose. I guess I can't blame 
you for trying.
Charlotte: Knowing you, you probably almost saved it, too.
Mariel: ...
Charlotte lowered herself to pick up the 
spent power cell.
Charlotte: Hmm...

Do we have anyone that can charge these things?
Mariel: ...
Charlotte: Compatible heirlooms aren't that common...
Mariel: I- I want to give it a funeral!
Mariel: ...
Mariel looked down at the ground and tensed up 
even more.
Charlotte: ...

Why?
Mariel: I just... want to give it closure. Let it greet the 
Goddess on a better note than... than this...
Charlotte: But... it's a...

*Sigh*...
Mariel: I want to... give it closure...
A short silence fell between the two. Charlotte 
fiddled with the power cell.
Charlotte: How did this work, again?
Mariel: What?
Charlotte: The power cell. How did you use it in your healing 
magic?
Mariel: Well... From what I learned at the academy...
Mariel: You can have it release the elemental energy in a 
short burst.

If the heart starts and you can get healing magic 
off in time, then...

Then... Then there's a chance that...
Mariel trailed off into whispers.
Charlotte: I think I'm going to get this recharged.

Maybe we can get another one. So you can have 
one on hand.
Mariel's eyes turned downward.

Charlotte's hand was left untaken.
Charlotte: Sis... It's a bird.
Mariel didn't move.
Charlotte: *Sigh*...
The hand receded and Charlotte turned towards 
the tent's entryway.
Charlotte: Waste your time, then.
Mariel: ...
Mariel turned downwards to gently close the bird's 
eyes.
Mariel: Maybe I could make a gravestone?

Or...

Or maybe a few of them...
passages.content_zh:
Charlotte: 哼。
Charlotte把玩著手中的裝置。營火的閃爍光芒與染紅天空的火焰交融，籠罩著整個場景。
Charlotte: 如果不能處理魔法輸入，那行動電報站還有什麼意義？

如果我能讓它運作，我們就不需要依賴信使和...和...
Charlotte: 呃！可惡...
Charlotte: 他們竟然有臉聲稱這個東西已經開發完成了。
Charlotte頭也不回地轉身，伸手去拿她附近設置的小工作檯上的東西。
Charlotte: 也許...需要擴大能量儲存？

也許它...它...
Charlotte: ...它...？
Charlotte轉過頭，因為她要拿的東西沒有滑入她的手中。
Charlotte: 電池明明就在那裡。
Charlotte轉身離開營火旁的座位，看向她周圍的營地。

在最近的戰鬥後，人們匆匆忙忙地去休息，所以營地大部分都是空的。
Pup: 這裡。這種藥通常有助於治療燒傷和失血。
不過，有一群人直接排在Charlotte的視線範圍內。
Charlotte: 那個大概沒什麼幫助...
這兩人剛好是一對。
對話中還包括另一個人。
Mariel: 我沒想到你能這麼快拿到。
Charlotte: 現在是她？她可能可以幫忙。
Mariel: 謝謝你。這正是醫生開的藥。
Pup: 不客氣。
Charlotte站起身，走到兩人能聽到的範圍內。
Charlotte: 姊，妳有沒有看到...
Mariel: 喔，Charlotte。晚安！
Charlotte: ...有沒有看到...一顆電池...？
Charlotte歪著頭，看著Mariel鑽進附近的一個帳篷。
Charlotte: 嗯...她這麼急著做什麼？
Pup: 你也需要什麼嗎？
Charlotte: 也許。你有看到我的電池去哪了嗎？
Pup: 電池是什麼？
Charlotte: ...
Pup: 我- 如果你掉了東西，也許你把它掉在上次的戰鬥中了？
Pup: 戰鬥才剛結束我們就回到營地了。
Charlotte: 你沒有棍子可以...

passages.name: SP: Pup x Mariel B - Talk
passages.content:
Mariel: Next was... in the medical tent?
Mariel rounded a corner in the camp and 
a sight fell before her eyes.
Mariel: Is that...?
Pup: It's a matter of... morale...
Charlotte: Morale for who? You?
Pup: I'm among those counted, yes.
Pup: I don't think you want to do a thorough census on 
people who enjoy meat from our ranks.
Mariel: Is it... is it time?

Is Charlotte about to be confessed to?
Mariel ducked behind one of the larger nearby 
crates.
Mariel: What are they saying...?
She leaned a little forward, but it was to no avail.
Mariel: Mrrgrr...
After a short while of steaming in her frustrations, 
Mariel's hands rose.
Mariel: *Hand Puppets*
Left Hand: I wonder what they're up to?
Right Hand: It must be the awaited confession!
The hand opened and closed along with the words 
coming out of Mariel's mouth.
Mariel: *Clears throat*
Mariel: *Hand Puppets*
She looked on at the two and saw their mouths 
moving. She followed along with the seeming 
flow of their conversation.
"Charlotte": P- Pup? What brings you here?
"Pup": My dear Ms. Stewart...
"Pup": No. Charlotte, my dearest of all!
"Charlotte": Ah, you mustn't!
"Charlotte": I am a princess of Lockhart! And you are but a 
mercenary!
"Charlotte": Such a thing would be forbidden!
"Pup": Then... You know of my... my feelings?
"Charlotte": I can only speak of my idling speculation.
"Charlotte": But...

Should you say the words, then I might...
"Pup": Hush, my dearest. It is but words.

I will offer you no obligations of reciprocation.
"Pup": No worlds are left closed to you. It is... It is your 
decision to make.
"Pup": And more to say and extra words here because I 
am still talking.
"Charlotte": Pup... I...
"Pup": Charlotte. I love you.
"Charlotte": I love you too!
"Pup": *Kissing noises*
"Charlotte": *Kissing noises*
Mariel closed her eyes before giggling gleefully 
and softly to herself.
Mariel: I'm sure it'll go well.

Or went well, I suppose?
Pup: You're sure what went well?
Mariel: Ah!
She jumped back a step.
Pup: You... okay?
Mariel: I've been well... I... Oh, right.
Mariel tidied up her clothes.
Mariel: How'd it go with Charlotte?
Pup: That? Same as ever.
Mariel: You... You've done it before?
Pup: Well, yeah. We need to buy meat often. It's like a 
constant negotiation to try and keep it in supply.
Mariel: Wait, then you didn't... confess to her?
Pup: ...
I blinked a few times.
Pup: Huh?
Mariel: After all this time and nothing?
Pup: ...
I blinked a few more times.
Pup: Could you go back a step?
Before she said a word on my request,
I felt her hand on my arm, and I was
pulled into the nearby tent.
Pup: Wh- What now?
Mariel pulled me in and looked around to confirm no 
one else was there at the time.
Mariel: How have you not confessed yet?
Pup: Confessed? Confessed what to who?
Mariel: It's okay. You don't need to play dumb. Your 
secret's safe with me.
Pup: What if... What if I am that dumb?
Mariel: You just need some practice to get the butterflies 
out of your system, right?
Mariel started to lean in very close to me.
Pup: Uh... well...
I turned slightly to noticed I was backed into a 
corner.
Mariel: Why not use me to practice? Just come out and 
say "I love you"!
Mariel got even closer. It was to the point that she 
was very far into my personal space.
Pup: I...

(Thoughts... slowing...)
Mariel: Just say it once and it'll be easier the second time!

I can help you with the steps after that too, if you 
like.
Pup: That's... a... thing...
My heart was racing enough that it seemed like 
Mariel might be able to hear it from so close.
Mariel: One time. That's all you need. Just say "I love you."
Pup: I... I...
Mariel: You can do it!
Pup: I lo- I looovv...

I... love you... Mariel...
Mariel: ...
Over the beating of my own heart, I felt like I could 
hear a 'thump' come from Mariel herself.
Mariel: That's...
She turned her face and backed away from me.
Mariel: G- Good job.
She started to make her way out of the tent.
Mariel: Great job! You'll do great!
I was alone in the tent watching the flaps of the 
entryway swish back and forth.

Silence was left to accompany the beating drum 
that was my heart.
Pup: ...

Good... Good talk...
passages.content_zh:
Mariel：接下來是……在醫療帳篷裡？
馬裡爾繞過營地的一個角落，
一道景像出現在她的眼前。
瑪麗埃爾：那是……？
Pup：這是一個…士氣的問題…
夏洛特：誰的士氣？你？
Pup：是的，我也在其中。
Pup：我認為你不想進行徹底的人口普查
我們隊伍中喜歡吃肉的人。
瑪麗埃爾：是……是時候了嗎？

夏洛特要被告白了嗎？
馬裡爾躲在附近較大的一輛車後面
板條箱。
瑪麗埃爾：他們在說什麼…？
她身體前傾了一些，但沒有什麼用。
瑪麗埃爾：先生…
在經歷了短暫的沮喪之後，
馬裡爾舉起雙手。
馬裡爾：*手偶*
左手：我想知道他們在做什麼？
右手：一定是等待的告白！
手隨著話語張開又合攏
從瑪麗埃爾嘴裡說出來。
瑪麗埃爾：*清清喉嚨*
馬裡爾：*手偶*
她看著兩人，看到了他們的嘴
移動。她跟著看似
他們的談話流程。
「夏洛特」：Pup？是什麼風把你吹到這裡來的？
「小狗」：我親愛的史都華女士…
「小狗」：不，夏洛特，我最親愛的！
「夏洛特」：啊，你不可以！
《夏洛特》：我是洛哈特的公主！而你不過是一個
僱傭兵！
《夏洛特》：這樣的事是被禁止的！
「小狗」：那……你知道我……我的感覺嗎？
《夏洛特》：我只能說說我的無謂猜測。
《夏洛特》：但是…

如果你說出這句話，那我可能...
「小狗」：噓，我親愛的。這不過是言語而已。

我不會向您提供任何回報的義務。
「小狗」：沒有任何世界對你關閉。這是……這是你的
做出的決定。
「Pup」：還有更多要說的和額外的話，因為我
我還在說話。
《夏洛特》：小狗……我……
“小狗”：夏洛特。我愛你。
《夏洛特》：我也愛你！
「小狗」：*接吻聲*
「夏洛特」：*接吻聲*
瑪麗埃爾閉上眼睛，開心地咯咯笑起來
並輕聲對自己說。
Mariel：我確信一切都會順利。

還是我想進展順利？
Pup：你確定什麼事情進展順利嗎？
瑪麗埃爾：啊！
她向後跳了一步。
普

passages.name: SP: Tatiana x Rowan B - Talk
passages.content:
Villager: Really? Isn't that 6 pieces up from last week?
Merchant: What can I say? Market sways how the market 
sways.

Blame the cronies in Lockhart if you really need 
someone to throw shit at.
Villager: But apples went up last week too.

Now that I think on it, didn't they go up the week 
before that, too?
Merchant: Are you going to buy? I don't have time to explain 
market economics to every hick passing through.
The merchant said as he lazily slumped back 
into his chair.
Merchant: Or maybe go to another stall?
Villager: I did. They had the same price...
Merchant: And that, my dear simpleton, is supply and demand.

Instead of thanking me for my market low, 
generous prices, you complain and complain.
Villager: I- I only said one other stall had the same price. Not 
all of them.
Merchant: ...

And?
Villager: I- I'll... Guard!
The villager scampered up to a nearby guard.
Villager: Guard, uh, sir! I think the merchants are fixing their 
prices.
The guard turned towards the merchant.

He waved at him to leave and the guard nodded.
Villager: What are you...?
Footsteps met the villager's ears while the guard 
walked away.
Merchant: Now. I heard you needed some apples? Heheheh...
After locking up his stall for the today, the 
merchant started on his way home through a 
nearby alleyway.
Merchant: Another good day. Those villagers are getting 
annoying though.

Simple in the mind and simple in the pocketbook. 
They're not paying as much as they used to.
Tatiana: H- Hello, sir!
Merchant: Argh! You nearly have me a heart attack.
The merchant grabbed at the alley wall after 
jumping back from surprise.
Tatiana: Really? Have I got the product for you!
Tatiana: Wait, no... That comes later...
Merchant: Product? What are you on? Just head back to your 
parents, little girl.
Tatiana: ...
Tatiana: I am not a... "little girl"... I am a merchant like 
yourself.
Tatiana could hear a dull sound in her ear as she 
grinded her teeth through the smile.
Merchant: Hah! A failing merchant maybe.
Tatiana: Such a... h- handsome man, you are. You've had 
your share of love and passion with the ladies?
Merchant: Ah, that sort of "merchant".

You're acceptable, I guess.
Tatiana: No, no no no. Not what I mean.
Tatiana: I mean, you've surely known the intoxicating 
sensation of love and passion many times.
Tatiana hesitated a little, remembering a phrase 
repeated to hear in rehearsal.
Tatiana: And likely... have... provided... bountiful pleasure to 
many a woman.

I... could clearly tell... being a woman.
Merchant: Huh... 7/10 for the compliment. 3/10 on the pitch. 
Go on.
Tatiana: Thank the goddess...
Tatiana let out an exasperated gust of air.

She then pulled out a fancy box with ornate 
metal lining.
Merchant: Oo~... What have you here?
Tatiana: It's a new collaboration by the Theodal Royal 
College and Lockhart.

A Potion of Love~
Tatiana unlatched the box and it sprung open to 
reveal...!

...a fairly plain flask with a red liquid inside.
Rowan: I spent all the budget on the carrying box, already.
Tatiana: Imagine how desperate people would be to get 
their hands on this product?

All you need to do is to drink a dose, and everyone 
around you will become instantly attracted to one
another.
Merchant: Hmm... Interesting concept, but I call bullshit. I'd 
know if there was a "love potion" out there.

I'm not some no name merchant. Me? I have 
connections.
Tatiana: Have you seen the obscene wealth some of the 
Lockhart nobles have?

This was kept under lock and key for their private 
use.
Tatiana: Until a recent occupation set some dominoes in 
motion.
Merchant: Hmm... I could actually see that...
The merchant picked up the flask and started 
examining it.
Merchant: Surely it'd be simple to prove with a demonstration, 
though?
Tatiana: A... demonstration?
Merchant: Simple, right?
Tatiana: Y- Yeah. Easy peasy.
Merchant: Then how about...
The merchant scanned the nearby area.
Rowan: He'll look about the area and immediately see me 
standing out from the crowd.
Merchant: That guy.
He pointed to Rowan.
Rowan: He'll identify me as a handsome man that would be 
difficult to woo so easily.
Merchant: He'd be a hard one for even you to stomach, yeah?

Shabby. And has been around all day causing ear 
ache for everyone.
Tatiana: D- Demonstration it is.
Tatiana turned from the merchant and headed 
over to Rowan
Rowan: Ladies, please. I am about to start another 
performance.
A couple woman were loitering around his 
performance spot.
Tatiana: You lose the bet.
She said, whispering it so the merchant couldn't 
hear.
Rowan: What? How could he not be enamored
with my visage?
Rowan made exaggerated, dismissive gestures like 
he was perplexed by a request Tatiana had made.

The merchant looked on, satisfied.
Tatiana: I expect payment in full for the bet.
Tatiana handed over the potion to Rowan. Rowan 
shrugged merrily has he took it.
Rowan: Ah, such is life.
Rowan: Do remember the script in question is now flipped 
between us.
Tatiana: Fine.
Rowan, making a spectacle of it, chugged down 
the potion.
Rowan: ANYTHING FOR A FAN!
The loud, clear message caused the merchant's 
eyebrow to raise.
Tatiana: Are YOU okay. Good SIR?!
Tatiana was not a good actress.
Tatiana: Maybe you should lie-
Tatiana: *Gasp*, sir, you...
Rowan: Perhaps it'd be better for me to ask if you are 
alright?
Tatiana: Oh right...
Tatiana cleared her throat.
Tatiana: I am perfectly fine, oh angel of mine.

From ground to bright blue sky!

You have picked me out from a vine!

Sacred elixir rain from up high!
The other women got up and started getting close 
to Rowan, as well.
Rowan: Naturally, the women around us will use it as an 
excuse to approach me as well.
Tatiana: No, they won't.
Rowan: Then we shall pay them.
Tatiana: You already spent our entire budget!
Tatiana: Please be mine! Oh sweet green haired maiden! 
Or... uh... Gentleman!
Tatiana started to approach for a kiss, but her 
hesitancy led Rowan to jumping in to kiss her by 
surprise.
Tatiana: ...?!
It was just a quick kiss, but to Tatiana it felt
much longer.

Slowly she backed away, shaking a little.

The encounter ended and Tatiana tried to keep up 
a lovesick appearance until she exited a set radius 
around Rowan.
Tatiana: Ugh... that was...
Merchant: That was truly disgusting.

I'll take all you have. If you've got any set aside for 
other regions, I want that too.
Tatiana: I... I'll see what I can do.
Merchant: And as a favor for taking your entire stock... We 
never met, you hear me?
Tatiana: Who are you again?
A few days later.
Rowan: So, how do you feel about it now?
Tatiana: Ask me again and I actually will break your 
kneecaps.
Rowan: But you were excellent!

A blooming lily to to be displayed at the theater!
Rowan: Anyone would be nervous their first time. I just 
wrote it into the script.
Tatiana: Script my ass. You kissing me wasn't part of the 
plan.
Rowan: Hm?
Tatiana: Next time you try that I'll kick your teeth out.
Rowan: Shh. I think I heard something interesting at that 
table over there.
Villager 2: Have you heard about it? A group of merchants 
had their stands attacked.

I think it included that guy you were talking about.
Villager: Seriously? They probably deserved it.
Villager 2: Yeah. And even better, once the commotion was 
over, the guards arrested THEM for disturbing the
peace!
Villager: Wow... So that's why fruit prices have gone down?

I fucking knew they were doing something 
underhanded.
Rowan: Wow indeed. Right, Tatiana?
Tatiana: ...y-...es....
Rowan: I am truly sorry. The place is a bit loud, I couldn’t 
hear you.
Tatiana: Yes! You were right!
Tatiana: Tsk. Are you happy now?
Rowan: If you are happy, then I am radiant.
Tatiana: I guess it's cleaner than my normal M.O.

Figuratively and literally.
Tatiana: Though I wish I could've seen it...
Tatiana: Maybe we could join the bandit smashing next 
time?
Rowan: Old habits die hard?
passages.content_zh:
村民：真的嗎？這不是比上週增加了6件嗎？
商人：我能說什麼？市場如何左右市場
搖擺。

如果你真的需要的話，就怪罪洛哈特的親信
向某人丟屎的人。
村民：但是蘋果上周也漲了。

現在我想了一下，這週不是漲了嗎
在那之前也是嗎？
商家：你要買嗎？我沒有時間解釋
市場經濟給每個路過的鄉巴佬。
商人懶洋洋地向後倒去，說。 
坐在他的椅子上。
商人：或者去別的攤位？
村民：我做到了。他們的價格是一樣的...
商人：親愛的傻瓜，這就是供給和需求。

與其感謝我的市場低位，
價格優厚，你抱怨再抱怨。
村民：我、我只是說另外一個攤位也有同樣的價格。不
他們所有人。
商家：...

還有？
村民：我、我會……守衛！
村民跑到附近的守衛身邊。
村民：警衛，呃，先生！我認為商家正在修復他們的
價格。
守衛轉向商人。

他揮手示意他離開，守衛點點頭。
村民：你是什麼…？
守衛的腳步聲傳入村民的耳中
走開了。
商人：現在。我聽說你需要一些蘋果？呵呵呵...
今天鎖定攤位後，
商人開始通過一條回家的路
附近的小巷。
商人：又是美好的一天。那些村民正在得到
雖然很煩。

頭腦簡單，錢包簡單。 
他們支付的費用不像以前那麼多了。
塔蒂亞娜：H- 您好，先生！
商人：啊啊啊！你差點讓我心臟病發作。
商人抓住胡同的牆後
從驚訝中跳了回來。
塔蒂亞娜：真的嗎？我幫你找到產品了嗎！
塔蒂亞娜：等等，不……那是稍後的事……
商家：產品？你在做什麼？回到你的
父母，小女孩。
塔蒂亞娜：…
塔蒂亞娜：我不是…「小女孩」…我是一個商人
你自己。
塔蒂亞娜聽到她的耳邊傳來沉悶的聲音。 
她微笑著咬牙切齒。
商人：哈！失敗的商人

passages.name: SP: Otis x Cainan C - Talk
passages.content:
Otis: Ye- e- e- e- eah, baby!

That meat carves so smoothly. You can see the 
blood shimmer~
Otis: Now this...
Otis: Now this is a meal!
The steam of the freshly carved meat wafted into 
the nostrils of a drooling Otis.

A knife stabbed into the ground, freshly bloodied 
by the act.
Otis: Ah~
Otis fell limp to the ground with meat and bottle in 
hand.
Otis: Meatier morsel than has ever met my mouth? Meet 
my beer and the sun!

What great company. Alas, such company calls for 
the perfect lunch.
He took a swig of the beer.
Otis: Ah...
Otis: ...

Perfect, eh? Maybe not quite? Somethin's a 
missing, I'd say.
Otis: What have we here?
Otis: You wouldn't happen to be on death's door, are 
you?
A face appeared in Otis's skyward eyeline. Cainan 
looked down on the limp body below.
Otis: Eh? You're blocking the sun.
Cainan: Then you are not in need of medical attention?

You have gone limp in the middle of a field. It is a 
natural inquiry, no?
Otis: Can’t a laddie-or-lassie eat a meal in the dirt without 
someone ass-uming they are lyin’ six lengths under 
it?
Cainan: Then you are in good spirits. That is good news.
Cainan: Might I recommend eating arrangements less... dirt
orientated?
Otis: Heh, a little dirt never hurt no one.
Cainan: If you say so.
Otis: Snarky little bastard, aren't you?

Really, what at this point could possibly do ol' Otis 
in?
Otis: Not even the damned demonic moon's curse could 
kill me!
Cainan: I imagine some individuals here doing well at such a 
task.
Otis: Hah! I've heard of stranger tides, yeah.

Would not even mind a cocky son-of-a-bitch coming 
over here and giving me a tussle!

Their blood could make a half decent condiment for 
my meal.
Cainan: You paint... quite a picture.
Otis: Hmm...

Matter-of-the-fact... stay right there and don't 
move a muscle.
Cainan: ...?
Otis raised his hands and made them into "L"s that 
formed a "frame" around Cainan.
Otis: Them's the look.
He took another drink as he shifted to a sitting 
position.
Otis: You'll do. Come on and sit with me.

Have some meat and be merry for once in your life.
Cainan: I appreciate the offer, but why?
Otis: A perfect meal isn’t perfect without the wrong 
company to enjoy it with!
Cainan: "Wrong... company"...? Not the "right" company?
Otis: Nothing is “right” when you're with bastards and 
scalawags, like you and I!

No need to deny it.
Cainan: ...
Cainan: I do suppose we'd make an odd pair. A bit of an 
"odd couple" paradigm, at that?
Otis: Ha! With that murderous look in your eyes?

Nothing makes a meal more spicy and delectable 
than the threat of death looming over it.
Cainan: ...Is that so? I can't say I appreciate said 
sentiment.
Cainan: "Murderous" seems more apropos to you, though? I 
am a man of faith, after all.
Otis: Oh-ho-ho~ We got a choir boy, then?
The bottle of beer jolted upward again as more 
alcohol flowed into Otis.
Otis: Am I wrong, though? It isn’t like we are ‘lightly 
tickling’ the bastards that get in our way.
Cainan: Those I pass I judgment on are those that broke 
their oath to the Goddess.

I do not take such a responsibility lightly.

From my days in the crusades to my responsibilities 
as an auditor, I will not regret my service of the
Goddess.
Otis: The crusades?
Otis: Oh, did you get one of those fancy smancy titles? 
What was it?
Cainan: *Sigh*...
Cainan: Some call me the "Azure Rook", yes.
Otis: And why's that? What'd you do?
Cainan: I gained a reputation for strategy and tactics. My 
tales were one of wit, valor, and intellect.
Otis: So you were REALLY good at figuring out how to 
kill people?
Cainan: ...
Otis: No need to be so moody. If anything I'm in awe of 
it.
Cainan: Am I not allowed to disagree with your... 
assessment?
A knife stabbed into a slab of meat.
Otis: Eh, call it an instinct.

Come on, killer. Sit down and be merry.
Otis stuck out the stabbed meat towards Cainan.
Cainan: ...
Cainan: I'll bite.

Both your food and your "bait".
Cainan reached past the outstretched meat to grab 
the clean slab of meat still in Otis's other hand.
Otis: Eh?
Cainan: What's wrong? Dirt never hurt anyone, no?
Otis: Yeah, yeah.
Cainan sat down onto the ground and retrieved a 
clean cloth from his pack.

He placed it on the ground and prepared it to use 
as a placemat for the meat.
Cainan: What brings a person to be such a... 'scaredy-cat' 
around a Covenant faithful?
Otis: Hmm... I guess it'd be...
Otis pointed the tip of the knife towards his eyes.
Cainan: The eyes? My eyes?
Otis: It ain't that complicated. I've seen the bullshit 
plenty.

As Otis the merchant and Otis de pirate, people 
were never that complicated.
Otis: Intuition's a skill. If it means you ain't the one 
holdin' the satchel in a raw deal, then ya good.
Cainan: A healthy skepticism for your “fellow man” is not an 
ill thing to have.
Otis: What I'm saying is that it's the little things.

Maybe it's an unhealthy gait, ‘dem being weighed 
down by their weapon hidden behind their back.

Maybe it is what they are wearing, a clean pair of 
boots that shows they are richer than they are 
tellin’ ya.
Otis: Or, my favorite, the eyes they walk in and share 
with ya.
Cainan: I get the first two, but...the eyes?
Otis: The eyes are the window to the soul, mister 
“man-o’-faith”!

They tell a life story in all your pretty, citrus-colored 
glory, killer!
Cainan: Hmm...
Otis: For most people, they shine like uncut gems, rich 
for the taking!

For the folks around us, these mercenaries, they 
are dulled with apathy. They've got their fill.
Otis: Most got a flicker of starlight in their eyes, like you 
and I.
Cainan: Are you suggesting I am a damned soul?
Otis: Ain't we all?
Otis: Those sitting up in the night sky are just 'dem that 
aren't scrapping at salvation down here, yeah?
Otis: It ain't that hard to see the flicker of that 
damnation in the eye.

You've seen the Little Blue Hound and Miss High 
Horse?
Cainan: You mean... the young Anton and Lady Charlotte?
Otis: They got that hunger. That somethin' missin'.

It's like when they stare down ya, their souls flicker 
out tryin' to grasp at anything and everything to
fill what's missin'.
Otis: It's a bit different for bastards like you and I.
Cainan: ...
Otis: We don't hunger. We crave.

Flesh, food, gold, and glory... There ain't no 
satiatin' it.

There's always more. There's the endless abyss 
from top to bottom.
Otis drank another swig of beer.
Otis: When I look in the mirror, I see starlight alright. It's 
deep. All the way down.
Otis: Same when I turn your way, killer.
Cainan: Or mayhap your impulse control has been lost from 
the alcohol.
Otis: Hey, hey! This smaller body might be more a 
lightweight than my old one, but I’m barely buzzed.
Cainan: An amusing thought, as much as your “intuition” is. 
If this is it “buzzed”, I’d woe to see it when you
are actually drunk.
Otis: Then let's get you in on this action!

Let out “Murderous Drunkard Cainan”, all ‘em 
ambitions laid out to bear!
Cainan: I am not one to drink much even as a social 
obligation. I've no plans to indulge myself as such.
Otis: Tsk. Now 'dem's how you tell me you're 
untrustworthy.
Otis: Sure I can't tempt you to?
Cainan: That is... a mighty cut.
Cainan: It was only a matter of time when you played with 
your food as such.
Otis: Argh! Goddess's pinky that stings!

Could ya do something instead of actin' like ya my 
mother?
Cainan: It looks clean enough of a cut. With some medical 
care it should heal soon enough.
Cainan patted Otis near the wound.
Otis: Grk! Do ya have to do that?!
Cainan: What can I say? I had a "craving" to do as much.
Cainan chuckled and rose to his feet. He started 
towards the camp to get a healer and medicine.
Otis: Ay... Of all the ways to ruin a nice lunch...
Cainan: ...
As he walked, he pulled out his sword.

The sun shined brilliantly off of it, and he positioned 
it to see the reflection of himself in the blade.
Cainan: Windows to the soul, huh?
Cainan: What tomfoolery...
passages.content_zh:
奧蒂斯：是的，呃，呃，呃，寶貝！

這肉切得真光滑。您可以看到
血色閃爍~
奧蒂斯：現在這個…
奧蒂斯：現在這是一頓飯了！
剛切好的肉，熱氣騰騰地飄進
流著口水的奧蒂斯的鼻孔。

一把刀插在地上，鮮血淋漓
通過該法案。
奧蒂斯：啊~
奧蒂斯軟軟地倒在地上，手裡拿著肉和瓶子。 
手。
奧蒂斯：比我嘴裡吃過的還要多肉嗎？見面
我的啤酒和陽光！

多麼偉大的公司。唉，這樣的公司要求
完美的午餐。
他喝了一大口啤酒。
奧蒂斯：啊…
奧蒂斯：…

完美，嗯？也許不完全是？東西是一個
失蹤了，我想說。
奧蒂斯：我們這裡有什麼？
奧蒂斯：你不會剛好就在死亡之門，對嗎？ 
你？
奧蒂斯仰望天空的眼線中出現了一張臉。蔡南
低頭看著下面癱軟的身體。
奧蒂斯：嗯？你擋住了陽光。
彩南：那你不需要就醫嗎？

你已經癱軟在田野中央了。它是一個
自然的探究，不是嗎？
奧蒂斯：小伙子或小女孩不能在泥土裡吃一頓飯嗎？ 
有人假設他們在六呎以下
它？
彩南：那你心情很好。這是個好消息。
Cainan：我可以建議飲食安排少一點......泥土嗎
面向？
奧蒂斯：呵呵，一點點污垢不會傷害任何人。
蔡南：如果你這麼說的話。
奧蒂斯：你這個小混蛋，不是嗎？

真的，奧蒂斯現在能做什麼？ 
在？
奧蒂斯：就連該死的魔月詛咒也無法做到
殺了我！
Cainan：我想這裡有些人在這樣的方面做得很好
任務。
奧蒂斯：哈！我聽說過奇怪的潮汐，是的。

甚至不介意一個自大的王八蛋來
在這裡跟我打架！

他們的血可以做半點像樣的調味品
我的飯。
蔡南：你畫的……畫得很漂亮。
奧蒂斯：嗯…

事實上...留在那裡，不要
移動肌肉。
凱南：……？
奧蒂斯舉起雙手，做出「L」狀
在該南周圍形成了一個「框架」。
奧蒂斯：他們的外表。
當他坐下時，他又喝了一杯酒。 
位置。
奧蒂斯：你會的

passages.name: SP: Nora x Jude c - Talk
passages.content:
A splurge of rice and meat landed on my plate.
Pup: Thanks.
It didn't look particularly appetizing.
Pup: (This slop again.)
Nora: I replaced a rice portion with some beans. Beans 
are an excellent food for those training.
Pup: (She... does well with the ingredients she works 
with.)
Nora: Next.
I walked away, but a shadow of orange got caught 
in the corner of my eye.

Turning back to look, I saw a plate with more of 
said orange than mine.
Nora: I replaced some rice with an extra vegetable 
serving.
Charlotte: Ugh... carrots? Really?
Nora: Eat a little and world might be a little more clear to 
you.
Nora: Anyways, you should stop avoiding them or your 
health will deteriorate.
Charlotte: ...
Nora: Next.
I turned my head back to see another person lining 
up for food.
Jude: Crap. She's cooking again...
Pup: It's not...
An ominous odor rose from my food.
Pup: It's not that bad...
Jude: You do recall I signed up with you guys specifically 
to get away from her cooking, right?
Pup: I- I'll let Charlotte know to expand your cuisine 
budget a little.
Jude: Dammit...
I sat down to eat, and Charlotte soon joined me.

Charlotte had started trying to separate the carrots 
from the rest, but the mix was too elaborate to do 
so effectively.
Pup: You might as well just eat the carrots.
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte: Wanna play a game?

Each time I win, you trade some rice for a carrot.
Pup: And each time I win, you actually have to eat a 
carrots?
Charlotte: What? No, I wouldn't-
Pup: Better not hesitate. It's two carrots per now.
Charlotte: ...

Fine.
Pup: What's the game?
Charlotte: I didn't think that far ahead.
Pup: *Sigh*, let's make it simple, then.
Pup: How about we bet on that?
I pointed to Jude approaching Nora for food.
Pup: What he gets. How much of it he eats. What Nora 
does. That sort of stuff.
Charlotte: Deal. That's an easy one.
Charlotte: I bet that...
Jude: Hello. Miss. Cook.
Nora: Are you going to hold your tongue this time?
Jude: ...
Nora: Good.
Nora dumped a half portion onto Jude's plate.
Jude: Half...?
Jude: Are you just being cheap?
Nora: Cheap is sustainable. It keeps a group running, from 
families to armies.
Jude: Still... half...?
Nora: I gave you the amount you finished last time. Don't 
waste it.
Jude: Whatever.
*Crunch*
Charlotte: Ugh...
Charlotte slowly chewed the carrot as she tried to 
keep it away from her taste buds.
Pup: You're just going to taste it more that way.
Charlotte: Shut up, you-
Charlotte: ...?!
She quickly gulped down the food she was 
chewing after she got a distinct taste of the carrot.
Charlotte: After she went out of her way to customize 
entrees, I figured she'd be all about making him eat 
a serving.
Pup: I might have... mentioned something about Jude's 
high cuisine budget to her...
Charlotte: ...
Nora, finished with her duties, grabbed her 
portions.

Her plate was a mishmash of whatever was left and 
had a lighter serving than standard.
Nora: ...
After eying Jude tucked away in a corner, she sat 
herself across from him.
Nora: Now, that wasn't so bad, was it?
Nora: Wait, you've barely touched it?!
Jude: I'm eating it... at my own pace.
Nora: Then take a bite.
Jude: ...
Jude: I- I can't do it with you watching me.
Nora: You're eating, not going to the bathroom.
Jude: Tsk.
Nora: Have you even tried it? Are you not hungry?
Nora: And to think you wanted a full serving.
Jude: ...
Jude's stomach growled.
Jude: I'll invoke my right to silence.
Nora: *Sigh*... You need to eat. You'll die otherwise.
Jude: So be it.
Nora: Could you stop acting like a little kid?
Nora: What is so wrong with the food?
Jude: You sure? You yelled at me the last time we tried 
this.
Nora: Just answer.
Jude: *Sigh*
Jude: The beans are poorly marinated. The vegetables 
are insipid and old.

The meat is gamey and cooked to be more char 
than actual meat.
Jude: And none of it has any seasoning whatsoever.
Nora: We need salt and such for preservatives. We can't
