waste it on the food itself.

We're not... We're not the decadents of Lockhart.
Charlotte sneezed in the background.
Jude: What's the point of food if it doesn't taste good?
Nora: To live.
Jude: A life not worth living, maybe...
Nora: The food is good enough. It's tolerable.

Why do you have to be like this?
Jude: ...
Jude nibbled on a few chewy pieces of meat.
Jude: Do we have any rice left?
Nora: You haven't even finished what's on your plate.
Jude: Trade me, then.

I'll take some of your extra rice and you can have 
the rest of my mystery meat.
Nora: If it'll get you to actually eat...
The two swapped parts of their servings.
Jude: Thanks. This'll be plenty.
Jude stood up from his seat.
Nora: You're still at this?
Jude: Nah. With this I might be able to make some rice 
pudding.
Jude: Finally...
Jude skipped off towards the kitchenette area.
Nora: D- Don't touch tomorrow's supplies!
Charlotte: Rice pudding?
Pup: Don't even think about it. You've still got like 10 
carrots to get through from our bets.
Charlotte: Hmm...
Charlotte: I think I'll get some rice pudding.
Charlotte jumped to her feet.
Pup: But the bet?
Charlotte: Sue me, I'm a decadent.
She said as she slipped away with Jude.
Pup: *Sigh*...
passages.content_zh:
一堆米飯和肉掉到我的盤子上。
小P: 謝了。
看起來不太開胃。
小P: (又是這堆餿水。)
諾拉: 我把一部分米飯換成了一些豆子。豆子對訓練的人來說是極好的食物。
小P: (她... 確實很擅長用現有的食材。)
諾拉: 下一位。
我走開了，但一抹橘色映入我的眼角。

轉頭看去，我看到一個盤子裡橘色的東西比我的還多。
諾拉: 我把一些米飯換成了一份額外的蔬菜。
夏洛特: 呃... 紅蘿蔔？真的假的？
諾拉: 吃一點，世界可能會更清晰一點。
諾拉: 總之，你應該停止迴避它們，否則你的健康會惡化。
夏洛特: ...
諾拉: 下一位。
我轉回頭，看到另一個人排隊領食物。
裘德: 糟了。她又在煮飯了...
小P: 也沒...
一股不祥的氣味從我的食物中升起。
小P: 也沒那麼糟...
裘德: 你還記得我加入你們就是為了擺脫她的廚藝，對吧？
小P: 我- 我會讓夏洛特知道，稍微增加你的伙食預算。
裘德: 該死...
我坐下來吃飯，夏洛特很快也加入了。

夏洛特開始試圖把紅蘿蔔從其他東西中分離出來，但混合得太複雜了，無法有效地做到。
小P: 你還不如直接吃掉紅蘿蔔。
夏洛特: ...
夏洛特: 要玩個遊戲嗎？

每次我贏了，你就用一些米飯換一根紅蘿蔔。
小P: 每次我贏了，你就要真的吃掉一根紅蘿蔔？
夏洛特: 什麼？不，我不會-
小P: 最好別猶豫。現在是兩根紅蘿蔔一局。
夏洛特: ...

好吧。
小P: 玩什麼遊戲？
夏洛特: 我沒想那麼遠。
小P: *嘆氣*，那就簡單點吧。
小P: 我們賭那個怎麼樣？
我指著正在走向諾拉領食物的裘德。
小P: 他會拿到什麼。他會吃多少。諾拉會做什麼。諸如此類的事情。
夏洛特: 成交。這很簡單。
夏洛特: 我賭...
裘德: 你好。廚... 小姐。
諾拉: 這次你會管住你的舌頭嗎？
裘德: ...
諾拉: 很好。
諾拉倒了一大堆

passages.name: SP: Otis x Mariel C - Talk
passages.content:
Pup: Urgh... That stings.
Pup: Do we really need to do this? It isn't that bad.
Mariel: If we let injuries go unattended, they'll just build up 
into bigger ones down the line.
Pup: I guess...
A burst of blue magic sparkled from her heirloom.
Mariel: All done. Thankfully your wound was very light.
Pup: You're going down your list of everyone, right? 
Should I grab the next person?
Mariel: I believe you were the last holdout.
Mariel: Wait... unless..
Mariel stepped over to her medical ledger and 
flipped through her notes.
Mariel: Actually, I don’t think Otis has ever reported for 
one of these.
Pup: Sounds about right.
Mariel: What was that?
Pup: Did I say that out loud?
Mariel: Clearly and articulately.

Do elaborate.
Pup: ...
Pup: I don't know... He's like a cat, right? Just... that 
sort of thing.
Mariel: Really? Petty stereotypes? I didn't think you had it 
in you.
Pup: I- I'm not trying to say all nekolyn are...
Mariel glared a little harder.
Pup: A- Are like... that...
Pup: Just that cantankerous guy.
Pup: Freaks out when you touch him, licks his wounds, 
sneaking extra fish when we have it...
Pup: I'm sure you're right. I'm just jumping to 
conclusions. You should go do an exam 
anyways.
Mariel: I'll choose to ignore the parts not about the 
medical exam then.
Mariel: I'll get him healthy if its the last thing I do!
Pup: Well, if you need bait...

Don't forget to bring some fish.
Mariel: Sorry! I hope I'm not interrupting anything!
Otis: *Yawn*... Nay, just about ta’ settle in for a wee 
nap is all.
Otis rolled onto his hands and knees and began to 
stretch his arms in a very catlike manner.
Mariel: Uh...
Mariel raised an eyebrow at the odd behavior, but 
decided not to comment.
Mariel: I was just hoping to do the regular medical exam. 
You know, just like everyone else?
Otis: Sounds like that sort of custom, ya.
Mariel: Then shall we...?
Otis: I'll be good, lassie.

Been in fights worse than anythin’ your pretty head 
could imagine. An old neko like me can be takin’ 
care o’ himself.
Mariel: But wouldn't you be better off if I-
Otis: Sorry, lass. But now ya startin' to interrupt my nap.
Otis began to draw the tent flap to cut out Mariel's 
access.
Mariel: W- Wait...
A familiar idea popped into her head.
Mariel: You can have my grilled fish ration.
Otis perked up immediately.
Otis: Er, what’s that now?
Mariel: Hrm? Oh, nothing.

I'm not a big fan of fish, so I was thinking of sharing 
my portion when the day for it comes up.

But since you’re a big strong pirate and all, I doubt 
you really need it.
Otis: No need for acts. A pirate I may be, but I also be a 
merchant, aye?
Otis: I can sniff out that quid pro quo when you serve it 
up.
Mariel: Then... is it a deal? Fish for medical care?
Otis bit his lip and seemed to be weighing his 
options.
Otis: ...
Otis: Blast it... You actually make a fair bargain...
Otis: Fine! I accept.

Now... as soon as we get that fish, you can...
Mariel: Nope! Exam first. Now, even.
Otis: Argh...
In the near future...
Mariel: Hm?

When did we run out of milk? I
thought we just resupplied?
Mariel: *Sigh*... Water it is then?
Mariel closed up the supplies and turned away in a 
hurry.

As she rounded a corner, something caught her 
attention from the corner of her eye.
Mariel: Wait... Is that Otis...?
Off in the distance was Otis with a cup filled with 
milk.
Otis: ...
Mariel: Oh, it was just Otis that finished off the milk.

That's good to... know...
Mariel: ...?
*Lick*
Mariel: ...What?
Otis had stuck his tongue in the milk and lapped it 
up like a cat.
Mariel: Did he... That was really cute...
Mariel: No, no... That was just a coincidence...
Otis did it again.
Mariel: I need to get going...

Maybe we should keep more milk in stock...?
Mariel: Then we also need...
Mariel turned the corner as she approached another 
shop.
Otis: Argh. This itch...
Otis was walking front of her.
Mariel: An itch? I have a remedy that he might like?
Mariel: Or...
Otis had scooted up to a nearby building and 
started scratching himself by rubbing up on it.
Mariel: Does he normally...
Mariel rubbed her eyes.

But Otis had already rounded the corner and left by 
the time she finished.
Mariel: Huh...?
Otis: Urgh...
At a dining spot, Mariel found Otis in discomfort.
Mariel: Are you okay? You don’t look so good.
Otis grabbed a napkin from nearby and seemed to 
cough up something into it.
Otis: Bleh…er, apologies, lass. It just be a hair-
Otis: Just a... somethin' in my throat.
Otis dropped the napkin into the fire and paced off 
from his finished dinner.

Mariel turned to see the napkin burning, only to 
notice small strands sticking out of it.
Mariel: Hair...ball...?
Mariel: I- It couldn't be...
Mariel: Another glancing cut.
Mariel covered her mouth and released a yawn.
Mariel: Sorry. It's just been a long day.
The princess moved to ministrations of other parts 
of Otis.

Otis turned towards his cut and...

...gave it a lick?
Mariel: What are you doing?
Otis: Doing what?
Mariel: ...
Mariel blinked and shook her head.
Mariel: N- Nothing...
Mariel: It really has been a long day...
Mariel pushed aside the tent flap and entered to 
see...
Otis: ZZZzzzzz...
Mariel: Oh, is this not my... I'm... sorry...
Her words trailed off as it appeared Otis stayed fast 
asleep.
Mariel: *Sigh*...
She sat down near him.
Mariel: This is my tent. You need to-
Otis: *Purrr*...
Otis had shifted in his sleep to nuzzle against Mariel.
Mariel: Cute...
Mariel: Oh... N- No... I'll just... just sleep in your tent.
Jumping to her feet, Mariel was soon out of the 
tent.

Otis's eyes opened.
Otis: ...
Otis: Haha...
Otis: So there I was, axe clenched in me one good 
hand...
Pup: (There's Otis's story time.)
As I approached, my foot slipped on some mud and 
I stumbled forward.
Otis: *Hiss*!
Pup: Argh! What'd you scratch me for?!
Otis: For falling all over me like a drunk barmaid right in 
the middle o me story!

Was jus’ gettin’ to the best part, too!
Pup: Whatever...
I stumbled over to the edge of the group and 
Mariel followed me.
Mariel: Wow, you're bleeding.
Mariel: Otis really can be like... that... can't he?
Mariel: I have my heirloom in my tent. Just wait a second.
She headed off towards her tent and I doubled 
back to Otis.
Pup: You didn’t have to actually scratch me, you damn 
salty pirate!
Otis laughed heartily and slapped me on the back.
Otis: Salesmanship, lass. Salesmanship
Pup: Then I expect hazard pay. Backpay, even.
Otis: Greedy little kid, aren't ya?
Otis: A merchant's word is his coin, though.

Here ya go. Best coin I've spent since joinin' ya lot, 
anyways.
Pup: Yeah, just don't overdo it.
I took the money and pocketed it before I heard 
the sound of footsteps approaching.
Mariel: Here, Pup. Let me see it.
Pup: Right... It isn't too bad...

It's uh... not the first time...
passages.content_zh:
Pup: 呃... 好痛。
Pup: 我們真的需要這樣嗎？其實沒那麼糟。
Mariel: 如果我們放任傷勢不管，它們只會累積成更大的問題。
Pup: 我想也是...
一道藍色的魔法從她的傳家寶中閃耀而出。
Mariel: 完成了。幸好你的傷口很輕微。
Pup: 你在照著名單幫大家檢查，對吧？ 我該去叫下一個人嗎？
Mariel: 我相信你是最後一個堅持的人了。
Mariel: 等等... 除非...
Mariel走到她的醫療記錄本旁，翻閱著筆記。
Mariel: 實際上，我不認為 Otis 曾經來做過這種檢查。
Pup: 聽起來很像他會做的事。
Mariel: 你說什麼？
Pup: 我說出來了嗎？
Mariel: 清晰且有條理。

請詳細說明。
Pup: ...
Pup: 我不知道... 他就像隻貓，對吧？ 就... 那種感覺。
Mariel: 真的嗎？ 膚淺的刻板印象？ 我沒想到你會有這種想法。
Pup: 我- 我不是想說所有貓人都是...
Mariel的眼神變得更加嚴厲。
Pup: 是- 是像... 那樣...
Pup: 只是那個脾氣暴躁的傢伙。
Pup: 你碰他他就嚇壞，舔自己的傷口，我們有魚的時候偷吃...
Pup: 我相信你是對的。我只是妄下結論。你還是應該去做個檢查。
Mariel: 我會選擇忽略那些與醫療檢查無關的部分。
Mariel: 我會讓他恢復健康的，就算這是最後一件事！
Pup: 嗯，如果你需要誘餌...

別忘了帶些魚。
Mariel: 抱歉！我希望我沒有打擾到你！
Otis: *呵欠*... 沒事，正準備小睡一會兒。
Otis用手和膝蓋撐起身子，開始像貓一樣伸展手臂。
Mariel: 呃...
Mariel對這種奇怪的行為挑了挑眉，但決定不發表評論。
Mariel: 我只是想做個例行性的醫療檢查。 你知道的，就像其他人一樣？
Otis: 聽起來像是一種習俗，是吧。
Mariel: 那我們開始...？
Otis: 我很好，小姑娘。

經歷過的戰鬥比你那美麗的腦袋能想像的還要糟糕。 像我這樣的老貓能...

passages.name: SP: Otis x Mariel B - Talk
passages.content:
Mariel: Honestly... How do you even get like this?
Mariel: I'm going to run out of... mh! ...bandages at this 
rate!
Otis: Keh!
Mariel tightened the bandage a bit too 
enthusiastically and then turned to rummage 
in her bag.
Otis: Are ya daft, lass?

Dem's no glory without guts in berserkin'.
Mariel froze and slowly turned to Otis.
Mariel: ...
Despite the daggers from Mariel's eyes, Otis simply 
shrugged.
Otis: Keh! Again!? Too tight.
Still staring, Mariel had went to tighten the 
bandages further.
Mariel: In my medical opinion, less blood loss will result in 
less ridiculous words coming out of you.
Otis: And how'd you stranglin' me suppose to help 
that?!
Mariel: Don't pretend you don't know what blood pressure 
is.
Otis: It does have a familiar ring to it...
Otis: Ack!
With a another tightening of a bandage, Otis lashed 
out at Mariel.

She instinctively leaned away from the scratching 
motion.
Mariel: Otis... B- Bad kitty!
She leaned in and clapped her hands right in front 
of his face.
Otis: ...
Mariel: ...
Mariel: ...
Otis: Lass... I didn't know you were like that...
Mariel: W- What?
Otis: Did ya... really just say that?
Mariel: Say... w- what? But you... You went to scratch me 
like some... tomcat?
Otis: For shame, lass.
Mariel: I know, I know. The whole “cat thing” with 
Nekolyn is an ugly stereotype. It's just that-
Mariel: What about the milk stuff and... the h- hair...
Mariel: ...the hairball...
Otis: Are you imaginin' things? Misremembering them, 
even?
Mariel: I... I mean...
Mariel's mouth moved like she was about to say 
something, but her expression became regretful.
Mariel: Never mind. I’m sorry.

And after I scolded Pup about it, too…
Otis: Pup?
Pup: He's like a cat, right? Just... that sort of thing.
Mariel: I took the words too close to heart...
She fidgeted some as she looked away regretfully.
Mariel: I ended up... wanting your actions to be more 
catlike, it seems...
Otis: That so, lass?
Otis: Ah well, I think I've got the appropriate 
punishment.
Otis turned away and pointed to his head.
Otis: Exposit therapy, or somethin' what have you?

Face your sins head on by doubling down on them.
Mariel: I'm not... sure what you mean?
Otis: Pet me like ya damn cats.
Otis: Now that ya regret ya actions, do them again to 
rub some salt in the wound.

That way ya don't do it again.
Mariel: Oh, I couldn't... I would want to make you go 
through that.
Otis: Just do it already! I can take it!
Mariel: I...
Mariel raised her hand.

Slowly but surely, she started to pet Otis.
Otis: ...

Heh... now she'll...
Otis sat there trying to keep a straight face.
Mariel: You’ll probably think this is silly, but it made me a 
little... nostalgic.
Otis: Hm?
Mariel: When I was a young girl, I really wanted a pet 
kitty.

My parents forbid it, though. They... 
understandably would not sway on that 
for good reason.
Otis: That so?
Mariel: In hindsight, maybe I tried to subconsciously live 
out my childhood fantasy through you.
Otis: ...
Mariel gave another petting stroke and Otis's ear 
twitched a little.
Otis: ...
Otis sat there, with facial expressions twitching on 
his face like he was jumping between thoughts 
rapidly.
Otis: Well, then we'll just have to-
Otis: *Clears throat*...
Otis: We'll just have to keep up this theraputanical 
doing, then, yeah?
Mariel: I don't understand?
Otis: That be the port side of it, but on the starboard... 
tis been a long time since I’ve heard such a story.
Otis: Tell ya what.

This whole thing started with a deal, so why not be 
lettin’ it end with one?
Mariel: What kind of deal?
Otis: I'll let ya get this out of your system with more 
private sessions like this.
Otis reached behind him and pulled Mariel's hand 
back to a position to keep petting him.
Otis: That... That'd work. Ah...
Otis: In return, you pamper me when ya can. An offerin', 
of a sort.
Mariel: Like bring you extra fish and milk and stuff?
Otis: Hey now, lass.
Mariel: S- Sorry...
Mariel began to pet even more.
Otis: Milk ain't bad for the bones.
Otis: But I do love a good fish.
Otis: Not cause of the neko trite, mind ya.
Otis: I've lived most of my life on the sea. It's good for a 
bit of glorious nostalgia.
Mariel: I think... I think that could work.
Otis: Now get o’er here. I’m still bleedin’.
Mariel: Oh, right.
Mariel reached back to her supplies and towards 
Otis again.
Mariel: There, all done.
Otis: Thank ye, girl. Now, if ye don’t mind...
Otis plopped down into Mariel's lap.
Otis: Theraputetics time proper now.
Mariel: Eep! What are you…

Oh, I get it.
She began stroking Otis’ head gently.
Mariel: Good... uh... kitty...?
Otis: *Purring noises*
I began to trod off in the direction of Otis’ tent.
Pup: (Crap, I'm out of loose coin after losing that 
hand...)
Pup: (I wonder if Otis has any more jobs? I do have an 
idea to mess with Mariel he might like.)
Mariel: Pup?
Pup: Ack!
I jumped back from the sudden blonde girl surprise.
Mariel: Are you okay?
Pup: Yeah, you just startled me.
Mariel: Sorry about that. But why so jumpy? Sneaking off 
somewhere?
Pup: N- No...
Mariel: Really? Since the only thing in that direction is Otis' 
tent.
Pup: Y- You know the cantankerous guy. Likes to 
scratch and lash out and... ya know...

Thought I might ask him to calm it down?
Mariel: Hmm...

You know... A little birdy told me you've been 
losing at cards a lot recently...
Pup: I mean... I guess...?
Mariel: ...
Pup: ...
Mariel: ...
Mariel: So... Otis has been paying your card game debts in 
return for help messing with me?
Pup: Ah... that...
Pup: So he told you?
Mariel: Nope. You did. Just now.
Pup: Oh.
Pup: OOOOHHHHH?!
Pup: I- I deny everything...
Mariel: Aahaha... Pup, you’re just too genuine to function 
as much of a liar.
Mariel: Some like that sort of thing though...
Pup: Huh...?
Mariel: Nothing. Have a good night.
Mariel began walking off without another word.

There seemed to be an unusual spring in her step.
Pup: (Is she happy about something?)
Mariel: I suppose it all worked out in the end.
Pup: ...
Pup: (I'm still broke, aren't I...?)
passages.content_zh:
Mariel：老實說……你怎麼會變成這樣？
Mariel：我快用完了……嗯！ ...繃帶在這
率！
奧蒂斯：咳！
瑪麗埃爾也把繃帶收緊了一些
熱情地然後轉向翻找
在她的包包裡。
奧蒂斯：姑娘，你傻嗎？

沒有狂暴的勇氣，他們就沒有榮耀。
馬裡爾愣住了，慢慢地轉向奧蒂斯。
瑪麗埃爾：…
儘管馬里埃爾的目光充滿了匕首，奧蒂斯只是
聳聳肩。
奧蒂斯：咳！再一次！ ？太緊了。
馬瑞爾仍然盯著，已經去收緊了。 
進一步包紮繃帶。
Mariel：根據我的醫學觀點，失血較少會導致
少說可笑的話。
奧蒂斯：你怎麼掐死我的？ 
那個？ ！
馬裡爾：別假裝你不知道血壓是多少
群島
奧蒂斯：確實有一種熟悉的感覺…
奧蒂斯：嗯！
隨著繃帶再次收緊，奧蒂斯鞭打了
在馬裡爾外面。

她本能地避開了抓撓
運動。
瑪麗埃爾：奧蒂斯...B-壞小貓！
她傾身向前拍了拍手
他的臉。
奧蒂斯：…
瑪麗埃爾：…
瑪麗埃爾：…
奧蒂斯：女孩……我不知道你是這樣的……
瑪麗埃爾：什——什麼？
奧蒂斯：你……真的是這麼說的嗎？
Mariel：說……什麼？但你...你竟然去抓我
像一些... tomcat？
奧蒂斯：真丟臉，姑娘。
瑪麗埃爾：我知道，我知道。整個“貓事”
Nekolyn 是一個醜陋的刻板印象。只是這樣——
Mariel：那牛奶和...h-頭髮呢...
瑪莉埃爾：……毛團……
奧蒂斯：你在想像事情嗎？記錯了他們，
甚至？
瑪麗埃爾：我……我是說……
瑪麗艾爾的嘴動了動，似乎正要說什麼
但她的表情卻變得遺憾。
瑪麗埃爾：沒關係。對不起。

在我也為此責罵了小狗之後…
奧蒂斯：小狗？
小狗：他就像一隻貓，對吧？只是……之類的事情。
Mariel：我把這句話看得太深了…
她有些坐立不安，遺憾地移開了視線。
Mariel：我最終...希望你的行為更加
貓似的，看來…
奧蒂斯：是嗎，女孩？
奧蒂斯：啊，好吧，我想我已經找到合適的
懲罰者

passages.name: SP: Charlottte x Ben C - Talk
passages.content:
Charlotte: "America"...?

What's that? A town?
Bennett: Uh... Something like that.
Bennett: If it doesn't ring a bell, then it isn't important.
Charlotte: Never heard of it... Does that make you from the 
Outlands down south?
Bennett: I... doubt it, but who knows? Too much is a 
mystery to me.
Bennett: Not like this is the first time I've woken up not 
knowing where I am.
Charlotte: We'll make sure no one takes advantage of you 
while you're with us, at least.
Bennett: "Take advantage" of me...?
Charlotte: Right, like those pirates back at that tavern we 
found you at.

Trying to prey on a vulnerable girl like that. It 
makes me sick.
Bennett: I guess that makes sense.
Bennett: Maybe I was just too drunk to process it like 
that...?
Charlotte: They didn't steal anything from you, did they?
Bennett: Not sure I have anything to-
Bennett: ...?
Bennett had reached back to a pocket when she 
stopped talking.
Bennett: ...
Pulling out a shiny small rectangular object, 
Bennett stared at it without much expression 
on her face.
Charlotte: So they didn't just take everything, at least? 
What've you got there?
Bennett: ...
Charlotte: Hello? Bennett, you okay?
Bennett: Hm?
Bennett: Oh- Oh... yeah. Nothing important. I didn't have 
anything valuable on me anyways.
Bennett quickly stowed away the object again.
Bennett: Well, that's enough for today. I think I'm going to 
crash for a while.
Bennett jumped up to her feet and started off 
towards her tent.
Charlotte: Hm...
As Charlotte was waking up the next day, she saw 
Bennett wander out of camp.
Charlotte: So obvious.
Charlotte: She does seem sort of... out there. Maybe I should 
keep an eye on her just in case anyone weird 
comes along?
Bennett: ...
Charlotte: She's... looking at that thing again.
Bennett: ...one bar...?
Charlotte: Why is she holding it up to the sky...?
Bennett: How is it here...?
Charlotte: Hm? Did I see... light coming off it? 
No... that couldn't...
Bennett: Are there just frequencies similar to a radio tower 
or something?
Bennett: ...
Bennett: Maybe this really is a waste of time?
Sighing, Bennett put the object back into her 
inventory.
Charlotte: ...
Bennett: Ack! What... What are you-!?
A face greeted her as she looked up,
and she jumped back in a fright.
Bennett: *Sigh*...
Bennett: Are you trying to kill me?
Charlotte: Doing a good enough job of that yourself.

I stopped trying to hide that I was following you a 
while ago.
Bennett: You... what?
Charlotte: Is this how it happened before we met you? How 
you got pulled into all that in Ranakstown?

You just... wandered off in the middle of the night 
with no care for your own safety?
Bennett: ...I can take care of myself. You don't need to 
worry.
Charlotte: It's common sense. You're a pretty girl by yourself 
at night.

You're inviting unnecessary danger. 
It is just reckless.
Bennett: I... I mean...
Bennett: I guess... I've never really thought about that 
before.
Charlotte: *Sigh*... Of course!
Charlotte: What's so important that you needed to do this, 
anyways? I might as well help.
Bennett: You really don't need to-
Charlotte: Tell me.
Bennett: You really don't...
Charlotte stared daggers into Bennett.
Bennett: *Sigh*... If you insist.
Bennett took the object out.
Bennett: This is a device from where I am from. A phone.

It's a device used to communicate with others. It 
wirelessly transmits electromagnetic waves.

Those waves are transmitted over certain bands 
of frequency constantly by a radio signal tower.

And...
Charlotte: ...
Bennett: See, this is more of a pain to you than not.
Charlotte: No... just... I'm not sure what half those words are.
Bennett: Haha... ha...
Bennett: The point is that my phone is indicating it is picking 
up a weak signal.
Bennett: It isn't actually... you know... working as a phone, 
though, despite that.

So I was trying to figure out why.  Since 
I wouldn't expect that to be possible here.
Charlotte: Hmm...
Charlotte rubbed her temples.
Charlotte: You're not like... a secret genius or something, 
are you?
Bennett: God no.
Charlotte: Hmm... signal...?

Is it anything like magic lines?
Bennett: Now you've got me at a loss...
Charlotte: They're conduits for magical energy.

Some more modern tech pulsates the flow of magic 
to encode information.
Bennett: It might be... similar...ish...
Charlotte: Here, let me...
Charlotte, before Bennett could react, grabbed the 
phone from her.
Bennett: No, no no no! Don't-
Charlotte: So it's like a light of some sort?

"Twitter"... "Discord"... What are all these symbols 
on it?
Charlotte: Huh?! It moved?! Why did it all move?!
Bennett: That's a complicated question to answer and-
Charlotte: Why is there an image of naked ladies on-
Bennett: NO! NO NO NO!
Bennett reacted like a snake snapping at its victim 
as she grabbed the phone back from her.
Bennett: Never that! Th- That's... That's private!
Charlotte: What did I just...

What... in the Goddess's name was that?
Bennett: Completely inconsequential, that's what it was!
Bennett: It's going to run out of battery soon anyways. So it 
really doesn't matter.
Charlotte: I could get you more power cells.
Bennett: Are they DC voltage?
Charlotte: Are they what?
Bennett: Then oh well! We tried!
Bennett started taking steps back.
Bennett: Like you said, we shouldn't be out alone at night.
Bennett: Seriously... don't worry about it. 
You have bigger problems.
Bennett: Have a nice night!
Charlotte: Yeah... you... too...
Bennett: Ugh... What... is...

What is that weight?
Bennett: Oh crap, did I change again?
Bennett rose from her sleeping position to view the 
world around.
Bennett: Wait, no. No I didn't.
Something's in my way...
Bennett: The hell is up with this...
Bennett: This box?!
A heavy box had been placed on top of the 
sleeping Bennett.
Charlotte: Morning.
Charlotte scavenged among the box's contents.
Charlotte: So explain what you said yesterday again.
Bennett: Are you still going on about that...?

It really is-
Bennett: Ugh... Can you get this box off me?
Charlotte: Are you going to cooperate?
Bennett: ...
Charlotte: I've got all day.
Bennett: Are you sure? You have so many more important 
things to spend your time on.
Bennett: My issues are mine, not yours...
Charlotte: I don't hear an answer~
Bennett: Ha... haha... Of course this'd happen.
Bennett: Fine. If you want to so bad that you're gonna force 
the issue, then I guess I should.
Charlotte: Perfect. Then let's start with this step by step. 
Power was a concern, yeah?
Bennett: Probably.
Bennett looked out towards the ragtag setup 
Charlotte had quickly cobbled together.
Bennett: Heh... haha...

Hey... You got... potatoes here?
Charlotte: ...Why?
Bennett: I don't know... Just sort got the vibe of a "science 
fair" for a second there.
Charlotte: Science... fair...?
Charlotte: That sounds... fun. What is that?
Bennett: Maybe I should... just shut up...
passages.content_zh:
夏洛特：「美國」…？

那是什麼？一個城鎮？
Bennett：呃……類似的事情。
Bennett：如果沒有引起注意，那就不重要了。
夏洛特：從來沒聽過…這會讓你從
南邊的外域？
貝內特：我……對此表示懷疑，但誰知道呢？太多是一個
對我來說很神秘。
貝內特：這不是我第一次醒來不是
知道我在哪裡。
夏洛特：我們會確保沒有人佔你的便宜
至少當你和我們在一起的時候。
貝內特：「利用」我…？
夏洛特：是的，就像我們那家酒館裡的那些海盜一樣
找到你了。

試圖這樣掠奪一個脆弱的女孩。它
讓我噁心。
貝內特：我想這是有道理的。
貝內特：也許我只是喝得太醉了，我無法像這樣處理它
那……？
夏洛特：他們沒有偷你的東西，對嗎？
Bennett：不確定我有什麼要-
班尼特：……？
當貝內特把手伸回口袋時，她
不再說話了。
貝內特：…
拉出一個閃亮的長方形小物體，
班尼特面無表情地盯著它
在她的臉上。
夏洛特：所以他們至少沒有拿走一切？ 
你那裡有什麼？
貝內特：…
夏洛特：餵？貝內特，你還好嗎？
貝內特：嗯？
貝內特：噢——噢……是的。沒什麼重要的。我沒有
無論如何，任何對我有價值的東西。
班尼特趕緊將那東西重新收了起來。
Bennett：好了，今天就到這裡了。我想我會
崩潰了一段時間。
貝內特跳起來並開始走動
走向她的帳篷。
夏洛特：嗯…
隔天夏洛特醒來時，她看到
貝內特走出營地。
夏洛特：太明顯了。
夏洛特：她看起來確實有點……在那裡。也許我應該
留意她以防萬一有人奇怪
來了？
貝內特：…
夏綠蒂：她……又在看那個東西了。
貝內特：……一個酒吧……？
夏綠蒂：她為什麼要把它舉向天空…？
本內特：這裡怎麼樣…？
夏洛特：嗯？我有看到……光從上面發出嗎？ 
不……那不能……
貝內特：是否只有類似收音機的頻率

passages.name: SP: Otis x Satia C - TODO - Parnips
passages.content:
???: Argh!

Haha! Down with you!

F- Fall back!
Otis: Nyahaha, men! Get every last crate!
Make it quick, this boat will be
going down any second now!
Noble Merchant: W- Why are you doing this?!
Otis: Why not!? The men be restless. And
who am I to deny such a plunder as
yours?
Noble Merchant: Nekolyn bitch, you’ll pay for this!
You clearly don't know who you're
stealing from!
Otis: Failing memory, have you? 
That'd be my line.
Noble Merchant: What are you...? Is your brain
rotten from lapping the rancid
phalli of these barbarians?!
Otis: Ah shucks. You do be doing me a
favor by making this even more fun~

On my mark!
The pirates let out a cheer in unison.
Otis: Three!
Noble Merchant: Your ship?! You truly are unhinged!
Otis: Two!
Noble Merchant: You'll destroy it!
Otis: One!
Noble Merchant: You truly wish to carve your own
ship through mine?!
Otis: Like a pig.
Otis: NOW!
Crow A: Stop.
Crow A: That didn't happen.
Crow B: Just imagine the risk-reward of
destroying your own ship...
Crow A: Yeah, for some extra bacon.
Crow C: I mean... it could have happened.
Crow B: Don't encourage him.
Otis: Ha! You lot would do the same if you
knew the guy's supply chain.
Crow A: Eh... We're professionals. I mean...
really? All that over bacon?

Some crispy bacon is good in the
morning, but a ship is way more
useful long term.
It's like...
Crow C: Like two bacon?
The Nightless Crow got his head thwacked for the 
comment.
Crow B: And that's all assuming what you 
said was even true.
Otis: Ye of little faith.

Give a little more and you could be
eating like royalty.
Satia: *Clears throat*...
Otis: Ah! If it isn't the mama bird
herself. How long've you been there?
Satia: Long enough to see your little tale
fall apart.
Crow B: Wait, should we bail before we get
caught in the crossfire?
Crow A: Nah, no way! I've never seen a
proper 'cat fight' before, let alone
half-a-literal one.
Satia gave a judgmental glare at Otis.
Otis: Scary. 

Not afraid your face will get
stuck like that?
Otis: Pretty as it'd be.
Satia: Half-assed flirting? I guess it is
true what they say about pirates.
She slid onto a nearby seat to sit down.
Otis: Eh?
Satia: That you're the bandits of the sea.
Satia: No brains. No honor. No common sense
enough to work an honest day's work.
Otis: But a good fuck, yeah?
Satia: ...
Satia: You'd think a women's intuition
would offer you even a little sense.
Otis: Careful about the scowl, birdy. I
know from my ol' body how
permanent...
Otis traced his hand in a line around his eyes.
Otis: ...wrinkles can be.
Satia: You've lost more than wrinkles in your face.
Satia: Your old shriveled up balls only
live on through your gall to brag
about damaging civilian supply lines.
Otis: Ack! They were basically asking for
it!
Otis: No guards worth a damn, a drunkard
at the helm... 

Easy targets, the lot of them.
Otis: And can you really say 'no' to bacon?
Satia: What a poor little kitten. Did someone forget to 
feed you and your brutes?
Otis: Ay! At least me men have the balls
to take what they want.
Otis: You still trying to baby that little
Puppy-dog you've got leashed up
here?
So scrawny, ya starvin’ ‘em!
Otis: ‘Please, mama bird, I need some
more…!’ they must cry every night!
Satia: ...
Satia's head turned slowly towards Otis.
Satia: ...
Otis: ...
Crow C: Why'd they stop talking?
Crow B: SHH! They might kill us!
Otis: Fine. Lines not to cross...
Satia: So the embers of sense flicker their final, dying 
flame.
Otis: That they have, mama.
Satia: Must you? I have... 

...never been a mother.
Otis: Now that’s a lie-and-a-half! What other
sort of scoundrel fusses over
scrubbing teeth?
Satia: Everyone has their reasons. 

Ones I have no interest in sharing with
your kind.
Otis: Neko-kind?
Satia: Murderer-kind.
Otis: Tsk. All that shite lost was his boat and bacon.
Crow C: *Gasp*! So he did ram it?
Crow A: Shut it!
Otis: And maybe... one or two men... Or three...
Otis: But ya must really like the smell of
noble dick to jump on one so willingly.
Satia, in the middle of taking a sip from her drink, 
stopped as she was.
Satia: ...
Satia: My distaste is for the method.

As I said, you're like any bandit.

Mindless violence.
Otis: So the violence is fine if ya got
yourself an excuse?
Otis: Sent by the big bad noble to do 'is biddin'?
Otis: At least fight for yourself, would ya?
Satia, still frozen mid sip, started 
moving again.

She took a deep breath.
Otis: What? Cat got your tongue?
Satia: This is going nowhere.
Satia: I don't believe you're even capable
of fighting like a proper Crow can.

You cannot fight to a tactic. A
purpose. A path forward for everyone
to be safe and thrive.
Otis: That a challenge? Not even a hard one!
Satia: More like a test.
Satia: To see if you're a liability. If you're a bandit to
your core when things truly matter.
Otis: Raising the stakes, eh? Now I sort of wanna do it 
when ya got me blood boilin' like this.

Willing to sweeten the deal? Put some bacon on 
top to wet the appetite?
Satia: Sure, I'll answer whatever propositions
your 'kind' may have.
Otis: Not just that, birdy.

WHEN I win? I get that AND...
Otis: ..and...
Otis recoiled back a little as he looked to 
ponder his current thought more.
Satia: Heh... Cat got your tongue?
Otis: Fuck it.
Otis: If I win...

Then I get ta fuck ya!
Satia: ...
Satia: Excuse me?
Crow A: Rest-in-pieces, Otis…
Crow B: It’s like she’s deadset on diggin’
her own grave…
Crow A: She?
Crow A: Shite. Which was it again? I can't
keep track anymore.
Otis: I've never mounted a Mama Bird
before.

I expect ta see the goddess up in
the skies with ya!
Satia: ...Incorrigible.
Otis: Heheh.
Satia: Very well. If you don't fail miserably, as you will, we 
can do whatever nonsense you've dreamed up.
Otis: For real?
Otis: I'm not going to let ya forget this, ay.
Satia: Save the date, then.
Otis: I'll be looking forward to it.
Otis's hand reached out, and then Satia extended 
her own to confirm the deal on.

Both had devious looks on their faces, like 
they were stifling laughs.

They turned on their heels, and the laughing 
started leaking out as they walked away 
from each other.
Crow A: ...What the hell was that…?
Crow B: I... don't know..
Crow A: You think we're gonna get pulled in on that fight? 
The one they end up staking the bet on?
Crow B: I... hope so...? Maybe...?
Crow C: Hmm...

You know, this really puts me in the
mood for some bacon.
passages.content_zh:
???: 呃啊！

哈哈！去死吧你！

撤...撤退！
Otis: 尼哈哈，弟兄們！把每一箱都搬走！
快點，這艘船馬上就要
沉下去了！
貴族商人: 為... 為什麼你們要這樣做？！
Otis: 為什麼不！？弟兄們都蠢蠢欲動了。而且
我又怎麼能拒絕掠奪
你的財物呢？
貴族商人: Nekolyn 的婊子，你一定會付出代價的！
你顯然不知道你正在
搶誰的東西！
Otis: 記性不好嗎，你有？
這應該是我的台詞。
貴族商人: 你... 你們到底是什麼人？你的腦袋
是不是舔了這些野蠻人的
腐臭陽具而腐爛了？！
Otis: 哎呀，你這麼說
反而讓我更開心了～

聽我號令！
海盜們齊聲歡呼。
Otis: 三！
貴族商人: 你的船？！你真是瘋了！
Otis: 二！
貴族商人: 你會毀了它的！
Otis: 一！
貴族商人: 你真的想用你的船
撞穿我的船？！
Otis: 像隻豬一樣。
Otis: 現在！
烏鴉 A: 停。
烏鴉 A: 那根本沒發生。
烏鴉 B: 想像一下摧毀自己船隻的
風險回報...
烏鴉 A: 對啊，就為了多一點培根。
烏鴉 C: 我是說... 說不定真的發生了。
烏鴉 B: 別鼓勵他。
Otis: 哈！如果你們知道那傢伙的
供應鏈，你們也會這麼做的。
烏鴉 A: 呃... 我們是專業的。我是說...
真的嗎？就為了培根？

早上來點酥脆培根是不錯，但
一艘船長期來說更有用。
這就像...
烏鴉 C: 就像兩塊培根？
無夜鴉因為這句話被敲了頭。
烏鴉 B: 而且這一切都建立在你說的
是真的前提下。
Otis: 你們這些沒信心的人。

再多給一點，你就能
像皇室一樣享用了。
Satia: *清了清喉嚨*...
Otis: 啊！這不是媽媽鳥
本人嗎。妳在那裡多久了？
Satia: 夠久了，久到看到你那小故事
破綻百出。
烏鴉 B: 等等，我們是不是該在被
捲入戰火前先溜走？
烏鴉 A: 不，不可能！我從沒看過
真正的「貓打架」，更別說是
半個字面意義上的了。
Satia 用一種批判的眼神瞪著 Otis。
Otis: 好可怕。

不怕妳的臉會
定格在那樣嗎？
Otis: 預

passages.name: SP: Pup x Norde C - Begining
passages.content:
Pup: ...
I raised the sword to my eyeline.
Pup: Yeah, that's sharp now.
Getting up, I sauntered over to the weapon rack 
to put the sword back into storage.
Pup: Hm?
I passed by a set of swords that had been 
designated for training purposes.
Pup: When did these get so bad?

I couldn't even buff out the problems with some of 
these...
Pup: ...

(It's been too long since we updated our training 
arms, I think.)
My head turned towards a nearby tent.

Soft voices could be heard from within.
Norde: Then we'd be able to send people back to this 
town for supplies if we get boxed in.
Fellow Crow: Yeah, we can scout out that path for additional 
threats first, though.
Norde: Then we'll need to-
Pup: Hello, fellow Crows.
Fellow Crow: Were you expecting company?
Norde: No.
Pup: We've got a problem.
Norde: We're busy.
Pup: Are you?
I turned to the Nightless Crow he was talking to.
Fellow Crow: Oh, well... We were just finishing up anyways.
Norde: We are busy.
Pup: Perfect.

So we've got an issue with the training gear.

A lot of it is just completely on it's last legs. We 
need replacements.
Norde: There are more important issues to worry about.
Pup: But there's always something "more important".
Pup: That's why it's gotten as bad as it has in the first 
place.
Norde: ...
Norde lowered his head a little a took a deep 
breath.
Norde: Then go fix it.

If it truly is so important, then you can deal with it 
yourself.
Pup: You know I don't have that much control over our 
spending.
Norde: ...
Norde lowered his head again and took another 
deep breath.
Norde: Then earn it.
Pup: What?
Norde raised himself to his feet, towering over 
Pup's current stature.
Norde: A test of strength.
Fellow Crow: Sir, what are you talking about?
Pup: (A test of... strength.)
I could feel my blood boil a little when presented 
with the words.
Norde: A duel. Now.
Pup: Deal.
Fellow Crow: W- What?!

Oh, for fuck's sake... You two are doing this again?
Charlotte: ...

Why am I here?
Pup: You're the piggy bank
Charlotte: Would you mind rephrasing that?
Pup: Ah, woops.
Norde: You are our primary financier at this time.
Norde: It was appropriate to deem you the
judge of this.
Charlotte: *Sigh*... Can we not, then? This is stupid.
Pup: No.
Norde: No.
Charlotte: Yeah, well next time I'm gonna shop around for 
mercenaries to hire instead of just going with the 
first one to save me, then.
Pup and Norde continued staring each other down 
with weapons at the ready.
Charlotte: *Sigh*... Fine, let's just not kill each other, yeah?
Charlotte: Then we'll start in... 

3... 

2...
Charlotte: Go!
Pup: ...!
Norde: ...!
Pup: (Dammit. I'm constantly on the defensive.)

(Maybe if I-)
Pup: ...?!
Pup: (A heavy... strike... I almost missed blocking that.)
Charlotte: Hey! I said no killing each other!
Norde: ...
Pup: (Maybe if I...)
With the blades clashing, I let go of my weight and 
let his attack follow through downwards.
Norde: ...?!
But I slipped out with the screech of the sword's 
steel as it slid along his blade.

Without the counter to stabilize his center of 
gravity, Norde began falling towards the ground.

Before he could catch his balance...
Pup: How'd you like this!
He rolled out of the way!
Norde: You... Grh...
Pup: Heh. How'd you like that?
Charlotte: Is it that hard to try to not kill each other?!
Pup: ...!
I slipped towards Norde again, once again trying to 
use his heavy strikes against him.
Pup: Take this!
Pup: ...
Norde: ...
Pup: ...?!
Shimmering bits of steel rained through the air all 
around, as the sword shattered on impact.
Pup: No...
A blade was pointed at me after I was knocked to 
a vulnerable state on the ground.
Norde: Judge?
Charlotte: ...
An awkward silence fell over the scene, but 
Charlotte begrudgingly went through with her 
role here.
Charlotte: Yeah. It seems pretty definitive to me.

Norde wins.
Pup: Dammit...
Norde: Hmph. A spoiled child, still.

And that ill-fitting weakness for Ivan's child.
Pup: ...
Norde: We're done here.
Norde began to turn away.
Charlotte: To go to the point of fighting and that's all you 
have to say?
Norde stopped.
Norde: ...

It is for the best to end this here.
Pup: You can say whatever you're thinking, you know?

I'm no child anymore.
Norde: ...
Norde bit his lip as a silence settled in.

But then he turned back towards me.
Norde: You killed Ivan.
Charlotte: What?! That's complete unfair to claim-
Charlotte: What?! You can't just say that! We don't even 
know if-
Norde: ...
Norde shot a look at Charlotte that stopped her 
words in their tracks.

He turned back towards Pup.
Norde: Ivan Baranov was a great man.

A protector, a liberator... A hero.

A man whose very presence could raise the 
downtrodden to heights they could've never 
dreamed of.
He was a hero beyond the platitudes of those who 
could only wish for better.

He was someone who had the strength to change 
the world in front of him.
Pup: ...
Norde: But you, his child... are not.
Norde: You are but a pup he kept at his side. One he was 
ever vigilant with regards to.

An anchor that dimmed that splendor of his 
potential.
Norde: I've watched him.
Norde: Before your time. And after he showed up with 
you to the Crows that day.

For every miracle he could've created, you were 
there to pull him back down into the depths.

An anchor that he dragged through the dirt... until 
the end.
Norde: You are no hero.
Norde: I have seen a true hero. And now I have seen one 
fall.

You are no hero.

And you never will be.
Norde dropped his weapon and turned to leave.
Charlotte: What was that?!

How dare you try and lay that sort of blame on 
Pup?!
Norde: ...
He started walking away.
Charlotte: Get back here!

Apologize or... or...

Or I'll give the victory to Pup!
Norde stopped and turned back partially.
Norde: Would you rather I lie?
Charlotte: ...
Pup: (So he said it.)
Pup: Urgh...
I raised myself to my feet.
Charlotte: Are you going to just let him say those vile lines?
Pup: I am... no child anymore.
Pup: Though I guess I always had a feeling it was 
something like that.
Charlotte: You shouldn't put up with that treatment.
Pup: I did ask for it.

(And... I can't even bring myself to disagree, to be 
honest.)

Norde.
Norde: ...
Pup: If that's what you think, then that's what you 
think.

I've known you long enough to know you're being 
sincere, and I can't say I've ever changed your 
mind before.
But...

But someone has changed your mind before... 

My father.
Norde: What...?
Pup: It just means I need to be strong, right?

Strong enough that you'll have no choice to 
acknowledge it.
Pup: Just like you did with my father.
Norde: ...
Norde turned back to walk away again.
Pup: Urk!
Charlotte: Hey!
I fell to a knee, but Charlotte helped catch me 
before I fell entirely.
Charlotte: What is wrong with you? That was completely 
unacceptable.
Pup: He's right... I'm not my father. I'm honestly not 
even close to him.
Pup: But I still want to be strong. To find my strength.

Then, one day...

One day Norde will...
My fist tightened with determination.
Charlotte: And how are you going to do that if all the training 
equipment is broken?
Pup: ...
Pup: Ha... hahaha... ha...
passages.content_zh:
Pup: ...
我將劍舉到與視線齊平。
Pup: 沒錯，現在夠鋒利了。
起身後，我慢步走向武器架，
準備將劍放回儲藏處。
Pup: 嗯？
我經過了一組被指定為
訓練用途的劍。
Pup: 這些什麼時候變得這麼糟了？

我甚至沒辦法把這些問題都修好...
Pup: ...

（我們更新訓練武器的時間太久了，我想。）
我的頭轉向附近的一個帳篷。

可以聽到裡面傳來輕柔的聲音。
諾德：這樣一來，如果我們被困住，就能派人回到這個
城鎮補給物資。
夜鴉同伴：嗯，我們可以先偵察那條路，看看有沒有其他
威脅。
諾德：那我們需要-
Pup: 哈囉，各位夜鴉。
夜鴉同伴：你有預期到訪客嗎？
諾德：沒有。
Pup: 我們遇到麻煩了。
諾德：我們很忙。
Pup: 是嗎？
我轉向和他談話的夜鴉。
夜鴉同伴：喔，好吧...反正我們也快結束了。
諾德：我們很忙。
Pup: 太好了。

所以我們的訓練裝備出了問題。

很多都已經完全走到盡頭了。我們
需要替換。
諾德：有更重要的問題要擔心。
Pup: 但總是有「更重要」的事情。
Pup: 這就是為什麼情況會變得這麼糟的
原因。
諾德：...
諾德稍微低下頭，深吸了一口
氣。
諾德：那就去修好它。

如果它真的這麼重要，那你自己處理
就好。
Pup: 你知道我對我們的
支出沒有那麼大的控制權。
諾德：...
諾德再次低下頭，又深吸了一口
氣。
諾德：那就去賺取它。
Pup: 什麼？
諾德站起身，居高臨下地看著
Pup現在的身材。
諾德：力量的考驗。
夜鴉同伴：長官，你在說什麼？
Pup: (力量的...考驗。)
聽到這些話，我感覺我的血液有點
沸騰。
諾德：決鬥。現在。
Pup: 成交。
夜鴉同伴：什- 什麼？！

喔，該死的...你們兩個又要來了嗎？
夏洛特：...

我為什麼會在這裡？
Pup: 你是豬公

passages.name: SP: Norde x Satia B - Begining
passages.content:
Satia: Norde, there you are.
Satia: Would you have a moment?
The scribbling of a pen suddenly stopped.
Norde: ...

I am... very busy.
Satia: ...
Norde: I suppose a few minutes can be spared.
Satia: Excellent.

Now... Have you come to a decision
about armor repairs?
Norde: *Sigh*... This again?
Norde: As I've said before, we need to review our 
inventory before making any decision on the topic.
Satia: And it would be awfully irresponsible for it to be 
left unfinished after all this time.
Norde: Yes, but not via myself. It was not my assignment.

The pup was thrown that bone.
Satia: But... I never heard anything from Pup?
Norde: Is this truly a question for me anymore?
Norde started to pick up his feather pen again.
Satia: ...

Come to think of it, I haven't seen Pup around 
lately?

Like every time we see each other, there's some 
hurry to end it.
Norde: You say that as if it is new.

The pup avoiding your... encumbering disposition 
is not a new phenomenon.
Satia: So the chats with you are so plentiful then?

With your own overwhelming mirth and friendly 
disposition?
Norde: ...
Satia: It seems WE are being avoided.
Satia: And I can't really blame anyone but us after the 
late night arguments we've had lately.

Remember how much the others have been 
yawning lately?
Norde: A surprising depth of self-awareness... for you.
Satia: Maybe try it for yourself.
Norde: *Sigh*... Then shall we conclude this more civilly 
this time?
Satia: By...?
Norde fidgeted with his pen as he wrote and 
erased thought after thought within his mind.
Norde: We can fix the armor ourselves. Frugally.
Satia: Imagine how long that'd take... and we're not 
exactly professionals.
Norde: Our current funds can't afford professional 
craftsmanship.
Norde: If self repair is not an option, then the only other 
one is to wait until our coffers restore themselves.
Satia: You know as well as I that the Crows have weaker 
members that could die with subpar equipment.
Norde: And such is the nature of combat...
Norde: Perhaps some need to learn how to parry instead 
of relying on armor so heavily?
Satia: You... You're impossible.
With a flip of her hair and a visually evident attempt 
to restrain her anger, Satia walked out of the tent.
Satia: Damn... ugh... Stupid seedy parts of these damn 
towns.
As she attempted to dry her shoe, a noise peeked 
her interest from a nearby tavern of questionable 
repute.
Drunk Noble: Why does... everything keep spinning?
With barely a warning, the man was slumped into 
the dirt of the street below.

A clink and a clank reverberated in Satia's ears as a 
hefty coin pouch fell to the ground beside the 
man.
Satia: ...
Satia poked at the man.
Satia: You... awake? Alive?

...
Her eyes traveled to the coin pouch again.
Satia: Goddess forgive me.
Satia grabbed the bag and tried to walk away.

But a voice quickly came from her starting place.
???: ...a thief?!
Rowan: No, my dear man. I say much the
opposite.
Constable: Let me get this straight...

You’re saying your manservant told your 
bodyguard– this woman -you went to the wrong 
tavern.
And when she saw that man lying face down, she 
thought he was you?
Rowan: With such, mon ami, the final curtain falls on my 
dire tale of mistaken identities and 
grand incompetence.
Constable: ...

So why'd she pick up the coin purse?
Rowan: Why, she was merely doing her due diligence to 
verify if I had been robbed!

You are aware of the town district in question?
Constable: Yeah, I guess ya got a point... uh... What was your 
name again?
Rowan: It is as I said before. I am Duke Malos!
Rowan flashed his heirloom towards the man.
Rowan: Head of the grand Malos estate, poet 
extraordinaire, orchestrator of the…
Constable: Yes, yes. I don’t need to hear all of that again.

Damn nobles and their endless titles…
Rowan: What was that, good sir? I’m afraid you’ll have to 
speak up.
Constable: Er… it was nothing, Duke.
With that, Satia's manacles were unlocked.
Rowan: Wise decision. I’ll be sure to send a token for your 
kindness once I return to court.

Now come along, Jules. And you’d better believe I’ll 
be docking your pay for a mistake like this.
Satia: Yes... sir...
Satia: That was... something else? Impressive, even.
Rowan: "Duke Malos" will always be here to help.
Rowan: But, mayhap your gratitude be better serviced 
torwards the puppetmaster?
Rowan directed a nod towards behind Satia, and 
she turned to see Norde before her.
Satia: You mean Norde had...?
Satia turned back, only to find Rowan already 
having disappeared into the crowd.
Norde: A reckless move. The Nightless Crows thrive on our 
reputation and you just tried to throw that away.
Satia: I know... I know all that, just...
Norde: And... these towns are not behind execution when 
nobles are involved.
Satia: We needed funds. Remember the armor situation?

People may die without it.
Norde: I remember. But this is becoming a trend of 
problematic behavior.
Norde: This has happened before...
Young Norde: Thank you. I shall use this well crafted blade for a 
worthy cause.
Blacksmith: Not if you don't pay, hero boy.
Young Norde: Ah... right... The agreed upon compensation was...
As Norde reached for his funds, a flicker of flame 
danced around the blacksmith's hand.
Blacksmith: Argh! Dammit! ...Just... Just leave the money on 
the counter...
The blacksmith hurried to quell the forge's flame 
and Norde paid.

Norde began to leave with his companion, Satia, in 
step behind him.

But she stopped.

And her eyes darted between the busy blacksmith 
and a sword rack near the door.
Young Norde: Are you out of your mind?!
The hushed whisper matched the timing of Satia's 
hands wrapping around a sword's handle.
Young Satia: No, more like finally screwing it on straight.

I’m sick and tired of slaving away as a helping hand 
for people acting like heroes.
Young Norde: Heroes don’t steal. Common criminals do.
Young Satia: Oh, get off your high horse. As if none of you even 
care to give me a chance.

You've barely been in the Crows and they're 
already giving a lizard like you a weapon.
Young Norde: ...
Young Satia: Didn't you want to save others? Come on, "hero". 
Let's go actually save a few other-
Blacksmith: What's going on here?
The blacksmith appeared before the two youths 
standing in the doorway.

His eyebrows lowered as he put two and two 
together.
Blacksmith: I’m afraid I’m going to have to call the-
Young Norde: We want to buy it.

She... She needs a weapon, too. I forgot to 
mention it before.
Blacksmith: ...Fine.
After another chunk of money was placed in the 
blacksmith's hands, the two exited the shop.
Young Satia: Norde, I can’t believe you actually… I mean, you 
didn’t have to…
Young Norde: Not another word. Just make sure you make use of 
it. Make it worth it.
Young Satia: You know... You're not that bad, are you?
Young Norde: And your half of the cost will come out of your 
food budget.
Young Satia: Ah... There's the lizard boy I know...
Satia: You know, I still have that sword.

It’s been beaten to hell over the years, but I’ve 
never once thought about discarding it.
Norde: Don't change the subject.
Norde: The point is that you have a history of reckless 
decisions when easy choices aren't available.
Satia: But doesn’t that story prove... ‘it only matters if 
your heart is in the right place?’
Norde: Maybe. But we were young and dumb then, Satia. 
Things are rarely so simple.
Norde: Ivan taught us better than this. And
 now that he's gone...
Satia: Then what do you propose to solve the armor 
issue?
Norde: I don't know. But not this...
Satia: ...
Satia: Oh, your story.
Norde: I said "no stealing".
Satia: Not that part. The part how we paid for it before.
Norde: Taking it out of our... food budget?
Satia: Yeah, but we could do it from our two payrolls in 
general.
Norde: That'd only work partially.
Satia: Enough to cover for the important armor repairs? 
To cover what we can't cover in the normal 
budget?
Norde: ...
Norde: You do know, one of these days I may not always 
be around to bail you out anymore.
Satia: ...
Satia: For what it’s worth, Norde, I hope that day never 
comes.
Norde: *Sigh*...
Norde: You're not the only one.
passages.content_zh:
薩蒂亞：諾德，你來了。
薩蒂亞：能抽出一點時間嗎？
鋼筆的書寫聲突然停止了。
諾德：…

我……很忙。
薩蒂亞：…
Norde：我想可以抽出幾分鐘。
薩蒂亞： 太棒了。

現在...你做出決定了嗎
關於裝甲修理？
Norde：*嘆氣*...又是這樣？
Norde：正如我之前所說，我們需要審查我們的
在就該主題做出任何決定之前先清點一下。
薩蒂亞：如果這樣做是非常不負責任的
這麼長時間後仍未完成。
Norde：是的，但不是透過我自己。這不是我的任務。

小狗被丟了那塊骨頭。
薩蒂亞：但是……我從來沒有收到過小狗的任何消息？
Norde：這對我來說真的是一個問題嗎？
諾德又開始拿起他的羽毛筆。
薩蒂亞：…

想想看，我還沒看過Pup呢
最近？

就像我們每次見面都會有一些
趕快結束它。
Norde：你說得好像它是新的一樣。

小狗迴避你...阻礙性的性格
這並不是一個新現象。
Satia：那麼跟你的聊天就這麼頻繁了？

帶著你自己壓倒性的歡樂和友好
性格？
諾德：…
薩蒂亞：看來我們正在被迴避。
薩蒂亞：除了我們之外，我真的不能怪任何人
我們最近發生了深夜爭吵。

記住其他人已經做了多少
最近打哈欠？
Norde：對你來說，自我意識的深度令人驚訝。
薩蒂亞：也許你自己試試看。
Norde：*嘆氣*...那我們可以更文明地結束這件事嗎
這次？
薩蒂亞：通過…？
諾德一邊寫一邊坐立不安地擺弄著筆。 
腦海中一個又一個的念頭被抹去。
Norde：我們可以自己修理裝甲。節儉。
薩蒂亞：想像一下這要花多久時間......而我們不是
完全是專業人士。
Norde：我們現有的資金無法負擔專業的費用
工藝。
Norde：如果自我修復不是一個選擇，那麼唯一的其他選擇
一是等到我們的金庫恢復正常。
薩蒂亞：你和我一樣知道烏鴉隊的實力較弱
可能因裝備不佳而死亡的成員。
Norde：這就是梳子的本質

passages.name: SP: RowanxTatiana A - Begining
passages.content:
Noble: Ah, I don't believe one word of-
Rowan: ...!
Tatiana: ...?
Rowan pulled in Tatiana for a kiss.
*Smooch*...!
Tatiana: ...?!
Tatiana: O- Oh... my...
Rowan: For you kind lady of mysterious allure, I would give 
my soul.
Tatiana: Y- You flatter me... dear stranger.
Rowan: Shall we run atop the wind together? We shall buy 
a palace and live happily ever after!
Tatiana: Sounds... enticing. How about you go rent a 
wagon for our escapades?
Rowan: I will not let you down, my love!
Tatiana turned back to the noble as Rowan bolted 
off.
Noble: I- I... even my wife doesn't...
Rowan spun around the corner to whisk himself out 
of sight.
Rowan: Hmm...
He raised his hands to his lips.
Rowan: That kiss was... it felt weird this time...?
Rowan peeked around the corner to see Tatiana 
being handed a bag of money and smiling.
Tatiana: ...
Rowan: That smile... that wicked smile... why does it 
torture my heart to see?
Rowan: Hmph! Keep it professional! I must!
Rowan: ...or maybe...?
Shaking out his pause, Rowan strode to gain the 
commission of a wagon.
Tatiana: Rowan!
She had turned a corner, entering Rowan's vision, 
while half sprinting.
Rowan: Of course, my lady~
The wagon started moving and Tatiana jumped on.
Noble: You! That’s the witch! The liar! The wench!
He trailed after it, not able to catch it but still 
within speaking distance.
Tatiana: I am sorry, have we met before?
Noble: You..!
Guards surrounded the noble.
Noble: N- No! It was her doing! I... I didn't...!
Tatiana: You see that guy's face when the guard's got him?
Tatiana: "Oh no! I had consequences to my actions! Buah 
buah buah!"
Rowan: What a magnanimous portrayal, despite the "buah" 
brigade at the end.
Rowan: It feels almost... professional.
Tatiana: Oh, shut up you.
Tatiana: Guy was such a sore loser, in the end.
Tatiana: Imagine being so incompetent that you need to 
resort to swindling children just to "win".
Rowan: Indeed...
Tatiana: The hammer of justice hits hard, though. Like that 
guy exploiting widows from before.
Rowan: Mhm... clean windows... right...
Tatiana: "Windows"...? You alright?
Rowan: Ah... yes... I am...
The wagon stopped as it reached it's destination.
Rowan: Or... uh... I was thinking of the smiling faces of the 
orphans when they hear of our deeds.
Tatiana: Right. It's the kids we're doing this for. They make 
it all worth it.
Having arrived in the poor sector of the town, 
Tatiana jumped off from the wagon.
Rowan: Love...? Love has never been this... And alas, 
professionality is key here.
Rowan turned his head to see Tatiana discreetly 
distributing the money to orphans that were 
scammed.
She soon returned to the wagon's side.
Tatiana: Something up?
Rowan: I was just admiring how beloved the professionalism 
of our process has become.
Tatiana: Well, yeah, we did do it all in secret.
Tatiana climbed onto the wagon again.
Tatiana: It is a bit sad to not do any of this out in the open, 
though.
Tatiana: Maybe we can bring back the Armored Bandit for 
another round of heroism?

It's gotta have been long enough.
Rowan: A... thought to consider.
The wagon began moving again...
Rowan: ...

...............
Rowan: ........................!

Ah... I cannot just roam about these thoughts and 
fantasies anymore...!
Rowan: There is something I must attempt.
Rowan turned to a confused Tatiana.
Tatiana: What? What was it you just said?
Rowan: Oh, sweet green tulip. Whose face covered in iron 
hides a beauty no man has seen.
Rowan: My love blossoms for thee, my dearest Tatiana!
Tatiana: ...?
Rowan: ...
Tatiana: Is this... the routine? Practice?
Tatiana: Aren't you supposed to be more aggressive with it?
Rowan: What?
Tatiana: *Clears throat*...
Tatiana: You're supposed to... give it a little "oomph"! You 
gotta sell that love shit.
Rowan: Then... you are asking me to be more aggressive?
Tatiana: Y- Yeah!
*Thump*

Rowan leaned in with his hand on a box on the 
wagon. His other hand placed itself on Tatiana's 
cheek.
His head slowly... slowly approached.
Tatiana: ...!
Tatiana's heart skipped a beat, and...

Their lips touched.

...........
Tatiana: Y- Yeah... like... like that...

That... T- That'd sell it, for sure...
Rowan: That was no act, my budding flower.
Rowan had not moved. The two were inches from 
one another.
Rowan: I can detail your enthralling nature, should you 
want.
Rowan: Another step in the grandeur of the hunt~
Tatiana: Eh...ah...EH?!
Rowan: Of course, I can give you time to think.
Tatiana: But you're like... a prince. A noble. I'm the noble 
boogeyman. The armored bandit...

W- Wouldn't that be... scandalous?!

Our "relationship" was an a- act, so... It was just 
a... a...!
Tatiana, who was already off balance, tried to back 
up ever so slightly until...
Tatiana: ...!?
She began to fall from the wagon...!
Rowan: ...?!
...pulling the entangled associate with her!
Tatiana: M- My...
Tatiana's arm extended to use her magic to 
summon her armor from the wagon.
Tatiana: Make it... in time...!
Her eyes snapped shut as the seconds felt like a 
never ending wait.
Tatiana: ...
Tatiana: ...!
Her eyes snapped open, only to find herself safely 
caught by her armor.

But she quickly felt another source of heat 
contained within.
Rowan: Such spaciousness! I did not expect it so.
Rowan: Now, about the Armored Bandit... I do not much 
care either way. Do you?
Tatiana: Y- You..!
Rowan: Ask yourself...
Rowan leaned in and kissed her again within the 
confined space.
Rowan: Ask yourself what you want. How does the 
thought make you feel?
Tatiana: Aren't... Aren't you one to t- take advantage of 
the situation?
Rowan: Says the lady who doth chosen toleave the 
situation as is, despite wielding control over the 
armor encasing us.
Tatiana: ...W- Well...
Rowan: How does that make your sweet heart beat? What 
feelings arise...?
Tatiana: I guess...

H-... H- Ha...ppy...?
Rowan: ...
Tatiana: Wipe that smirk off your face!
Rowan: I look forward to seeing how our story unfolds from 
here~
Tatiana: D- Dammit... I'll... I'll get you, you stupid noble...
passages.content_zh:
Noble：啊，我一個字都不相信──
羅文：……！
塔蒂亞娜：……？
羅文拉住塔蒂亞娜親吻。
*接吻*...！
塔蒂亞娜：……？ ！
塔蒂亞娜：噢——噢……我的……
羅文：對於你善良、具有神秘魅力的女士，我願意給你
我的靈魂。
塔蒂亞娜：你——你太恭維我了……親愛的陌生人。
羅文：我們一起乘風奔跑好嗎？我們要買
一座宮殿，從此幸福快樂地生活！
塔蒂亞娜：聽起來……很誘人。你去租一個怎麼樣
我們的旅行車？
羅文：我不會讓你失望的，親愛的！
當羅文逃跑時，塔蒂亞娜轉身面向貴族
關閉。
Noble：我、我……連我的妻子也不……
羅文轉過街角想溜出去
的視線。
羅文：嗯…
他把手舉到唇邊。
羅文：那個吻……這次感覺很奇怪……？
羅文在轉角處偷看，看到了塔蒂亞娜
被遞上一袋錢並微笑著。
塔蒂亞娜：…
羅文：那個笑容……那個邪惡的笑容……為什麼呢？ 
折磨我的心看什麼？
羅文：哼！保持專業！我必須！
羅文：……或者也許……？
羅文擺脫了停頓，大步走上前去。 
一輛馬車的委託。
塔蒂亞娜：羅文！
她拐過一個轉角，進入了羅文的視野，
半衝刺時。
羅文：當然啦，女士~
馬車開始行駛，塔蒂亞娜跳了上去。
諾布爾：你！這就是魔女！騙子！那個丫頭！
他尾隨其後，沒能抓住它，但仍然
在通話距離內。
塔蒂亞娜：抱歉，我們以前見過嗎？
諾布爾：你……！
衛兵包圍了貴族。
諾布爾：不——不！都是她幹的！我……我沒有……！
塔蒂亞娜：當警衛抓住那個人時，你看到他的臉了嗎？
塔蒂亞娜：「喔不！我的行為承擔了後果！Buah
呸呸！ 」
羅文：儘管有“buah”，但這是多麼慷慨的描繪啊
旅在最後。
羅文：感覺幾乎…專業。
塔蒂亞娜：噢，閉嘴。
塔蒂亞娜：最終，蓋伊真是個失敗者。
塔蒂亞娜：想像一下，你是如此無能，以至於你需要
為了「贏」而欺騙孩子。
羅文：確實…
塔蒂亞娜：不過，正義之鎚的打擊很重。像這樣
傢伙利用無線網路

Mariel sat near the cliff's edge. Her gaze wandered 
off into the horizon.

The silence carried through her eyes to her mind. 
The tiny speck on the horizon gathered what 
attention she could muster.
Mariel: ........
......

..............
Charlotte: Sis!
Mariel: ...
Charlotte: You're missing the planning meeting. Why are you 
out here?
Mariel: ...
Charlotte: Sis?
Charlotte put her hand on Mariel's shoulder.
Mariel: ...Oh?
Charlotte: You falling asleep with your eyes open now?
Mariel: N- No...
Charlotte: You really should take this stuff more seriously. We 
do want to liberate our home, don't we?
Mariel: ...

Do you remember when we were little?

We used to watch the horizon whenever we sailed 
away from Lockhart.

And just... watch it disappear.
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte paused for a second.

But then she moved to sit next to Mariel.
Charlotte: I do. It's a nice memory.
Charlotte: The first time I saw your reaction to it is one of my 
earliest memories, even.
Charlotte: You were just like "Oh~ Wow!"
Charlotte: It was so cute.
Mariel: Haha... I would have loved to see your first time, 
too.
Charlotte: I'm sure you've seen plenty of my firsts.
Charlotte: Like...
Charlotte looked off into nothing as she thought.
Charlotte: Remember my high society debut?

That birthday party.
Mariel: Oh, was that the one where...?
Charlotte: Yep.
Charlotte: Lucky you, not being known by anyone then. You 
got to watch.
Mariel: *Giggle*
Mariel: That man was quite livid.
Charlotte: I still say that he deserved it.
Mariel: It's hard to entirely disagree. I know father didn't.
Mariel: But maybe it wasn't the best idea to assault the 
man just because you knew he couldn't go against 
our family?
Charlotte: I was just a little girl. And it was a little bruise on his 
shin.
Mariel: You're saying you were thinking of that at the 
time?
Charlotte: No, I was thinking of kicking his shin.
Mariel: Haha... It did look satisfying.
The two lightly laughed together.
Mariel: ...
Mariel: More fun than my debut...
Charlotte: Wish I kicked that guy's shin, too. Making you cry.
Mariel: It wasn't his fault. I was just... overwhelmed by the 
moment.
Charlotte: Tell me it wouldn't have been satisfying to kick the 
guy, though?
Mariel: Uh... Well...
Mariel: P- Perhaps...
Charlotte: You've come a long way since then, too.

Remember when that foreign businessman came 
not too long ago?

He wanted to build that warehouse.
Mariel: Right, the one from the East Auran Alliance.
Charlotte: Yeah, you stood up to him when the proposal was 
barely out of his mouth.
Mariel: He wanted to build in a poor residential district. So 
many people would've been displaced.

Even for others that could find new homes, they 
would have had to travel even further to get to 
their jobs.
The traffic, the time away from families, and...

Everything would've been miserable. Worse so with 
a new warehouse to require even more workers.
Charlotte: Exactly. You've gotten so much better than 
standing up for yourself and your beliefs.
Charlotte: It was an amazing insight. It was the sort of stuff 
that I never dreamed of thinking of right away.

I remember even father being shocked. It hadn't 
even occurred to him, yet.
Mariel: Right... Father...

That would've been the last time that...
Charlotte: ...
An awkward silence fell over the horizon watching 
duo.
Charlotte: You know what?

You should take over Lockhart once we get it 
back.
Mariel: ...What?
For the first time, Mariel had taken her eyes off the 
sight in front of her.
Charlotte: Maybe those whispers among the upper echelon of 
the city were right.

Maybe you are the right choice to take over the 
company and the city.
Mariel: I... Charlotte...
Charlotte: I'm not afraid to admit it. Not anymore. Not with 
everything that has happened.
Charlotte: You know the city so well. The people, the 
places... That wasn't the first time you've surprised 
me with it.
You're a natural born user of the Goddess's 
blessings. There's a reason you still have our family's
heirloom.
Charlotte: Not to mention, you'd be better suited to 
actually...
Charlotte raised her hand and gently rubbed her 
ears below her hat.
Charlotte: You'd be... You'd be better suited to actually 
leading. They'd accept you. They already want to.
Mariel: Sis... I... can't. I wouldn't be a good choice for 
that.
Charlotte: Don't try to save my feelings.

Do I need to repeat what I said? You'd be a great 
choice.

You're not exactly a slouch when it comes to 
economics and-
Mariel: No... Charlotte... I...

Maybe I wouldn't be a bad choice. Maybe I could 
do a good job.

But I couldn't replace you.
Charlotte: It's okay. I'm not afraid to admit it.
Mariel: I mean I couldn't replace how irreplaceable I think 
you are to Lockhart.

The idea of us not succeeding doesn't even seem 
to cross your mind. It's like a part of you.

When I look at you... I see Lockhart.

The city is you, as you are the city.

You'd fight for it. Like you were fighting for your 
own life.

And as much as I love my home... I love it like my 
home. I could never match that.
Charlotte: I- I...
Charlotte: I don't... think...
Mariel: I know.

I don't think I'd be good enough either.
Mariel looked back towards the horizon. 

She leaned over to rest her head on Charlotte, and 
Charlotte ended up doing the same in kind.

They stared silently for a time. A speck in the 
distant horizon their focus once more.

A place they believed to be calling to them. 

Home.
Charlotte: Ah... So much for whatever 'rivalry' we had.
Mariel: I never wanted to see it like that.
Charlotte: I guess.. I was more afraid it would become a rivalry 
than anything.
Mariel: I know. I know... We just...

We just both want what's best for Lockhart. 
What's best for our home.
Charlotte: Yeah... When we liberate it... we... we'll do what 
we can.
Mariel: I hope so. I really do.

passages.content:
Crow: ...and I just wanted to thank you personally, sir.

Or... uh... ma'am...? Or...
Norde: ...
Crow: ...and I just wanted to thank you personally, sir.
Norde: Is this what you requested a meeting for?
Crow: I- I just wanted to thank you for 
enabling the armor repairs.

I heard it came from your and Satia's expenses 
and... well, it saved my life in the last fight.

I am... truly grateful.
Norde: Understood. 

Your gratitude is accepted.
Norde began to turn to pick up equipment to 
leave.
Crow: Oh, uh... is that... it? I was expecting... 

I just felt like I had to say it.
Norde: It is good that you are alive, and no thanks are 
required for such a matter of course.
Norde: But I am not one to reject a sincere sentiment.
Crow: T- Thanks... Norde...
As Norde finished adjusting the armor straps, a 
swivel of the head placed Norde's vision in the
Crow's direction.
Norde: You are welcome. I look forward to
continuing to fight by your-
Satia: Come back here!
Norde: ...!
A figure sprinted through the camp.

Norde began to jolt after the man, but quickly 
started stumbling.
Crow: Careful! Didn't you take a hit to
the knee last battle?
Norde: Damn archer...
Satia sprinted into the area and stopped.
Satia: You saw that man?
Wordlessly, Satia began to turn to continue the 
chase, but Norde reached out to stop her by 
grabbing her wrist.
Norde: What's happening?

I can't work on no information.
Strategizing or otherwise.
Satia: I... don't have time to...
Satia turned her head back towards the direction of 
the fleeing man, only to find no sign of him.
Satia: Fine.
Satia: I was just-
Satia: ...Let go of my wrist.
Norde: How do I know you won’t just
immediately run off afterwards?
Satia: Look. Do you see him anymore?
Norde: Right...
The grip on the wrist was released.
Satia: I'm not that reckless, you know?
Norde: Now. What happened...?
Norde: So, to summarize...
Norde: One of the men has been building up
gambling debts at practically every
stop we’ve made.
And now we have a loan shark collecting on 
payments via extorting strategic info about the
Crows from him.
Norde: Is that all correct?
Satia: Yeah. It was Jothram, too.
Norde: Is he the one...?
Satia: That everyone knows has a terrible
poker face...? Yeah...
Norde: Given the source, this has been
surprisingly thorough.
Satia: Thanks, I-

...
Satia: What was that about "given the source", again?
Norde: Come to think of it, much of it seems oddly familiar.
Norde: What was the name of the man at that time...? 
"Black"... something?
Satia: Ignoring me is only going to make
the punishment worse later.
Norde: It was from a story from another mercenary 
company. That was a couple years ago.

It wasn’t with gambling debts, though. It was with 
unpaid bar tabs, but that’s not important.
Satia: *Sigh*

...Fine, I'll play along.
Satia: I remember this story.

About the "Black Fang" loan shark guy.
Norde: Then do you remember how the guy was 
described?
Satia: A brash man with an ego to match.

Apparently, he has a fondness for exotic female 
prostitutes.

Emphasis on the "exotic".
Satia: A brash man with an ego to match.

He is very brazen about his distaste for outlanders.

The sort to fling words like "savages" at anyone but 
honlyns.
Norde: Not an uncommon sight when you look
below the surface of society.
Satia: Hmm...
Satia: But it does give me an idea.
Norde: Nothing reckless...
Satia: Then it's settled.
Norde: I just said--
Satia: Let me know if you think of a better idea before 
we put this plan into action, then.

Until you can, consider it punishment for your little 
quip before~
After tracking down the indebted and previously 
fleeing Crow, the two were able to get a meeting 
setup with the loan shark.

passages.name: SP: Norde x Satia A - Femenine Path (7-12)
passages.content:
Norde: For the record, I object to this.
Norde: I object to everything about this.
Satia: Aw, but you look amazing.
Norde was dressed in a dark blue and silver dress.
Satia: I even let you have the dress you like.
It looked suspiciously similar, pattern wise, to her
normal mercenary armor.
Norde: I simply am trying to make the best out of a bad 
situation.

We must think strategically about details if this is to 
have a chance at working.
Satia: Yep, yep. You are so right.

Every girl will indeed have her own sense of style.
Norde: *Sigh*... This won't work.
Satia: You say that, but Pup's been handling her changes 
quite well.
Satia: What? Can't keep up?
Norde: That is not what I-
Footsteps interrupted Norde.
Satia: Ah! Is that him? I need to go.
Satia: Don't forget the plan!
Satia whispered loudly as she ducked out of the 
scene and a new face entered it.
Black Fang: Hmm... Curvy bod, nice dress...
lots of sharp angles...
The man looked up and down Norde.
Black Fang: You the broad Jothram set up for me?
Norde: "Black Fang", I take it?
Black Fang: Heh, yep. Scourge of the west.
Norde: ...
Black Fang: It's okay. You can bask in my glory.
Norde: Hmm... That's extra.
Black Fang: Hmph. Lizards like you live longer when you can 
control your tongue, you know?
Norde: ...
Norde: ...
Norde took several steps towards the man.

The clicks of her heels pierced through the silence 
in the alleyway.
Norde: The great "Black Fang" isn't up to the challenge of 
silencing a silly little "lizard" girl?

What? Can't keep up?
Black Fang: ...

Heheh... I'm gonna enjoy this.
Two glasses of a shimmering liquid were still 
as the mood within the hotel room.

The Black Fang eyed the wine suspiciously, 
glancing at Norde and back.
Norde: What better way to add bite to a 'wild' ride of a 
night than with a pristine vintage?

Courtesy of your friend, Jothram.
The Black Fang shrugged, chuckling lowly.
Black Fang: That hopeless sap’s hardly my friend... but I 
suppose you’re right. Let us get good and drunk.

Heh! I'll need to if I want to forget the nature of 
my company.
The Fang raised his glass and downed it almost
immediately.
Black Fang: Ah... that wasn’t half bad. 
That fool knows how to treat his betters. 

You could learn a thing or two from him.
He poured another one and raised his glass for a 
toast.
Norde: Very well.
Norde raised her glass as well, but...
Black Fang: Ha! 
As if I'd celebrate a bitch in heat.
Pulling back, he downed his glass once more.
Norde: ...
As the Fang finished his glass, he turned to Norde 
with a more suspicious look to his face.
Black Fang: N- Not... drinkin'...?
Norde: I like to earn my prizes.
Black Fang: Heheh... Twen dwet's have you earn it!
The Fang reached for Norde’s glass and downed it 
as well.
Black Fang: Now that thatsh out of the way...
The Fang sprung on Norde and pushed her against 
the wall.
Norde: ...
Black Fang: I shee. 

Thish ish why you wanted me drunk, you bitsh. 
You wanted it rough after all. 

I’ll oblige.
The Fang's hands jumped to grab Norde's neck!
Black Fang: Heheh... heheh...
The gripped tightened and tightened!
Black Fang: ...?!
His eyes blinked in the aftermath.

The Fang stared at the mix of broken glass, spilled 
wine, and blood from the glass cuts on his hands.
Black Fang: W- What...?
Norde: About time.
The Fang turned his head to his side.
Black Fang: W- What?! How dwid you...?!
Norde: Why did you end up strangling a
wine bottle to its breaking point?

That would be the hallucinogenic effects of the 
mushroom powder I put in your wine.

Enough to kill ten men, actually.
And you just drank about a quarter of it.
Black Fang: You bitsch... I’ll fucking kill-

Ugh...!
He stopped dead in his movements as though he 
became possessed, and he fell to the floor while 
convulsing.
Norde: You better kill me quickly then.
You have seconds left.
Black Fang: Pleash... anti... antidote...?!
Norde pulled a vial from her cleavage.
Norde: After what you did to the Crows,
the world would be a better place without you.

Let's not forget that you're wanted 
dead or alive, so...
Black Fang: Ngh... ngh.............!
Norde stared on, just one tiny movement away 
from opening the antidote vial if so motivated.
Norde: ...

如果這件事要成功，我們必須從戰略上思考細節。

每個女孩確實都會有自己的風格。

很多銳利的稜角...
那個男人上下打量著Norde。
黑牙：妳就是Jothram為我安排的妞兒？
Norde: 「黑牙」，我猜的對嗎？
黑牙：嘿嘿，沒錯。西方的禍害。
Norde: ...
黑牙：沒關係。妳可以沉浸在我的榮耀中。
Norde: 嗯... 這有點過頭了。

Norde: ...

她的高跟鞋敲擊聲穿透了小巷裡的寂靜。
Norde: 偉大的「黑牙」無法應付讓一個愚蠢的「蜥蜴」女孩閉嘴的挑戰嗎？

怎麼？跟不上嗎？
黑牙：...

呵呵... 我會好好享受的。
兩杯閃爍的液體，如同酒店房間裡的氣氛一樣靜止。

黑牙懷疑地看著酒，又看了看Norde。
Norde: 有什麼比一瓶完美的年份酒更能為一個「狂野」的夜晚增添風味呢？

這是妳的朋友，Jothram的敬意。
黑牙聳了聳肩，低聲笑了起來。
黑牙：那個沒用的笨蛋算不上我的朋友... 但我想妳說得對。我們開始吧。

passages.name: SP: Norde x Satia A - Draconic Path (13-19)
passages.content:
Norde: ...
Norde stood in the shadows of the alleyway.
Soon, a set of footsteps joined him.
Black Fang: Jothram? That your stupid face?
Norde turned his head towards the man, 
creating a shadowed silhouette in his vision.
Black Fang: Hmph. You know a last minute
meeting like this is gonna cost ya?

I don't care if ya lot are gonna be
moving out first thing in the morning...

You're dealing with the illustrious
'Black Fang'. You play by my rules.
Norde started to step out the shadows, if partially.
Norde: Jothram won't make it today.
Black Fang: Ah...! A... a beast?!
Norde: I will give you one chance.

We can end this diplomatically.

Without issue. Without blood being spilt.
Norde: After all, I can provide the info you want on the 
Nightless Crows in place of Jothram.
Black Fang: G- Guards!
A few armed men swarmed in from the alleyway 
entrance.
Guard: ...!
Norde: ...

I need your answer.
Black Fang: As if I’d listen to pleas for diplomacy from a savage 
like you!

What did you do to Jothram?! 
A beast like you... could you have...?!
Norde: Then I'll be magnanimous.

 
One more chance.

I work within parts of the Crows that put me in a 
position to give you more information than Jothram
ever could.
Black Fang: W- What?

You're trying to tell me that THE Nightless Crows 
would bother with a lizard?

Try a believable lie!
Norde: You may believe whatever you wish.
But it is the truth.
Norde: Last chance to make a deal.
Black Fang: I only make deals with people!
Norde: ...
Norde: Then there's your answer.
Norde smiled wickedly.
Black Fang: Now what did you do to Jothram, you beast?!

Tell me, and I’ll consider putting you down quick!
Norde: We Nightless Crows are a rather...

My hunger.

o’fiery dragon and lady of fine repute,

It was your inspired plan and performance

We still had to rely on your heirloom. For that,

towards me!

Rowan: Though...

What do you want? A favor?
Rowan: You have struck at the heart of the matter.

A sympathetic ear should I ever need such a favor

Satia: Then your answer would be?
Norde: ...
Norde: I... think we can do that.
Satia: *Giggle*...

Norde: It has been a while since I've felt this sort of 
satisfaction. 

Not since... 

Not since Ivan...
Satia: ...

I think he'd be proud of how you've grown.

For all the complaints and dour stares, you've 
managed to make your situation into a good thing.

You'd never have done that before.
You'd have pushed forward stubbornly 
no matter what with your normal tactics.
Norde: You've grown yourself.
Norde: Your plan was well developed.
Norde: A... manageable recklessness.
Satia: Oh? Such high praise for this hotblooded lady.
Norde: It was annoyingly well developed, even. 

Almost...
Norde: Almost calculated... haha...
Norde: Conventional tactics would've caused problems that 
your plan didn't.
Norde: It... posed an efficient compromise of ideals, 
I would say.

Satia: So are you going to stop belittling every idea I 
bring up now?

has no merit?

They both opened their mouth at the same time.
Both: "No deal."

Norde: I'm the one that should be kept in line?
The two shared a soft laugh together as the night 
went on.

And into that dark, went the discussions of plans 
for horizons yet traveled.
