Macy: Very chill, very zen.
Eve: Not when you have to manually do all those 
things...

You ever carry a full water bucket before?
Eve: ...and then have to fetch all the items to make 
people happy...
Eve: Will the damn tuna be fished already?!
Macy: Oh, yeah! I remember when I was just waiting for the
duck's feather to drop. Stupid RNG.
Macy: At the very least, I don't have to worry much 
about combat.

And there are no taxes, so I can just take my time 
and chill.
Eve: Hmm... I never thought about that...
Eve: I do spend a lot of time with a succubus friend... 
she is teaching me... "stuff".
Jenny: Succubus? You've met one?
Eve: Yeah, in the second world I was in. Right before 
this one.
Jenny: I also met a succubus. She is a bit... "overly
friendly", if you catch my drift.
Jenny: She also wanted to teach me stuff. Like "the 
wonders of the female body".
Jenny: I am pretty sure my breasts have grown since she
started touching them on a daily basis...
A bit of an awkward silence fell between the three.
Macy: Ok, time to change topics... sheesh... You wouldn't be
caught dead speaking like that in University...
Eve: Oh! Are you a university student? My brother is one
too...
Eve: Well, he spent quite some time looking for one... 
he is a bit eccentric.
Eve: He'll be starting soon. Or was at the time.
Macy: Eve... and Adam...? I wonder...

Say, Eve... is your brother going to a school called
"Orchard University"?
Eve: Sounds... familiar?
Eve: It sounds right, so probably? Whether he goes by 
"Adam" as a nickname isn't something I am aware 
of, though.
Why?
Macy: No... reason...
Macy: You know, if we get the chance to return to our 
worlds, maybe I could stop by your house?
Eve: Oh, a sleepover with friends?!
Jenny: That does sounds fun.
Eve: I've never been to one before!
Macy: Yeah... and you can show me your brother's 
room...

I am sure there are some things I would want to...
Macy: ...repair.
passages.content_zh:
珍妮：嗯嗯…
梅西：嗯……？
伊芙：嗚嗚嗚…
梅西：嗯。
珍妮：嗯嗯嗯…
梅西：快到了…

等一下...

嗯！
伊芙：我……快堅持不住了！
珍妮：啊啊啊！
當另外兩個人試圖清理一個高架子時...
……一個孤獨的紅髮「女祭司」躺在
沙發上，想看書，卻無濟於事。
珍妮：我好無聊！ ！ ！
梅西：噢——哎喲…
伊芙：嘿——嘿…

你……有點……重……！
除了無聊的牧師之外，還有一個女僕和一個農夫。 
嘗試失敗後倒在地板上
清潔注意高架子。
身材中等的女僕壓在農夫的身上
現有的...高原。
梅西：你知道，如果你幫助我們，事情會比較容易…
梅西抬起身子，小心翼翼地說。
從地板上。
伊芙：讓她休息吧。
夏娃緊跟在後，結束後重新站起來。
絆倒。
伊芙：我確信她已經厭倦了…無論她做什麼
一直在做……對嗎？
梅西：你到底在做什麼？
珍妮：我想看看有沒有什麼好故事。
珍妮：龍和騎士的故事在哪裡？的
巫師打敗邪惡的惡魔？
梅西：這就像是……這個時代的吟遊詩人嗎？有嗎
你向羅文要一兩首歌嗎？
珍妮：呃…
珍妮：上次我嘗試的時候，他開始跟我調情。
珍妮：……就好像我是女孩一樣…
梅西：你……不是嗎？

passages.name: Supply Run Ch4 - Scene 2
passages.content:
Later in the night...
Pup: ...
The library stood before me in the quiet stillness.
Pup: This window isn't barred off.
Pup: (I need to find something about the 
Oathbreakers.)
I sneaked through the hallways of 
dusty bookshelves.
Pup: (Magics section... here it is.)

(Oathbreakers... Oathbreakers... come on...)
Pup: (...Nothing? But this is a Covenant Library? I know 
it's not a big library, but...)
Pup: (I wonder if they have a restricted section?)
With that in mind, I was about to head off to look 
for one when a thought jumped to my mind.
Pup: (I don't actually know much about how magic 
works in the first place.)
Pup: (I have all night, so...)
I quickly scoured the books for a introductory text 
on magic.

My fingers flipped through the basics of the 
writings.
Pup: ('Magics are a blessing from the Goddess Aurier.')

('In the beginning, this world was created as a trial 
ground for the souls that once defied Aurier.')

('Within the spiritual realm of Miryo, this land was 
created between the dark and the light.')
I looked out to the darkness of the night sky. The 
thousands of shimmering stars looked back at me.
Pup: I sometimes forget how foreboding the night can 
be. With the army of the damned scattered across 
the sky above...
My eyes turned back to the page.
Pup: ('The souls that turned away from damnation 
pledged an Oath of loyalty to Aurier.')

('So their mortality was tested in this trial ground of 
life, for said holy Oath to the Mother Soul was the
key to eternal salvation.')
...
Pup: What did this have to do with magic, again?
It was all information I knew. I had been taught 
these things since I was young.

I flipped through a few more pages. It went into 
detail about the old war between Aurier and 
Zened, the first son.
Zened was defeated and banished to the dark of 
the night.
Pup: Wait, here's something new...
Book: Magics are blessings granted by dutiful lineages loyal 
to Aurier or her ideals of existence.

Over generations of this loyalty and prayer, a 
Noblesse Heirloom is created.

It acts as a tool of the Goddess granted to 
true nobility.

With it, these nobles are tasked with guiding the 
people forward as exemplars of the faith.

Often simply referred to as an heirloom, Noblesse 
Heirlooms hold blessings of different forms.
Book: These blessings are categorized into 4 different 
types.

Red Magic. Blue Magic. 
Green Magic. Gray Magic.

Red magic is elemental. Fire, electricity, wind... 
They are the energies of the world.

Blue magic is divine and spiritual. Often, this is 
associated with healing.

Green magic is creation. It controls the particulate 
that forms this world itself.

Gray magic is the magic of the soul manifested via 
tapping into red, blue, and green in equal 
measures.
While not strong enough to call on their individual 
strengths, the combination of them can allow for a
unique skill.
Pulling from memories of prayers within the 
heirloom, the user can call on the lingering noble 
soul of their ancestors.
This spirit can temporarily transmogrify the user to 
be a reflection of the soul in question.

It transforms their body to match the heights of 
their skill and strength.

It transforms their body to match their skill and 
strength.

It transforms their body... strength...

It transforms their body.

Transforms their body.
Pup: ...
My eyes focused on a section that stood out to 
me.
Pup: ('Transforms their body')

(Could that be what's happening to me?)

(Wait, it said temporary... Does that mean my 
changes are...?)
I decided to read on.

The discussion started to go over my head, but I 
did stumble upon another passage that seemed to 
clarify an element.
Book: In contrast to Noblesse Heirloom, the Oathbreakers 
act much the opposite.

An Oathbreaker is a show of defiance towards the 
Goddess's laws of nature. It breaks said laws.

It is a cheat on the trial this life provides, and it 
breaks the Oath to the mother soul.

This is in contrast to the heirlooms, which are 
blessings within the Goddess's laws.
Pup: (So they're complete opposites?)
Pup: (Then... are they not compatible at all?)
Pup: (That Covenant auditor said they might be able to 
offset the effects at the academy though?)

(Are they partially compatible then, or...?)

us both before I knocked us out of the way.
Librarian: T- Thank you... for... saving me...
The librarian was struggling to find words after the
surprise.
Librarian: I guess you were right... after all...
Pup: (Is this me being lucky or unlucky?)
Pup: I- I'll go get someone!
I jumped to my feet and scrambled out the now 
unlocked door.
passages.content_zh:
我把自己滑到書架旁，想看看管理員在哪。
Pup: (我看到那邊有燭光在移動。那一定是他。)
管理員: 現身吧！就算你是隻老鼠，我也會手下留情。
Pup: (我該找什麼藉口？或許... 沒人說過這裡正在翻修嗎？)
我轉頭看到一些鷹架，離管理員不遠。
Pup: (完美。)
管理員: 最後一次機會... 5... 4... 3...
Pup: 我聽到有人嗎？
管理員: 蛤？你是誰？
我走到管理員手持的燭光附近。
Pup: 只是一個路人。你是這裡的負責人嗎？
管理員: 你怎麼進來的？大門應該剛剛才鎖上的。
Pup: 呃... 是的。我試著敲門和喊叫，但沒有人回應。
Pup: 我會來這裡只是因為我認為我在翻修工程中看到了一些可疑的東西。
管理員: 年輕小姐，我不知道妳想表達什麼，但是...
Pup: 拜託...

我只是想幫忙而已。
Pup: 你有看到這工藝嗎？簡陋至極。
我舉起手，用力拍了拍我旁邊的結構，以示強調。
Pup: 如果你仔細看，你就會注意到...
Pup: ...注意到...
傳來一陣低沉的隆隆聲。

我轉頭看到黑暗中有東西移動的輪廓。
Pup: (它要倒了？!)
搖搖欲墜的結構正朝著管理員倒去！
Pup: 小心！
我向前一躍！
Pup: *喘氣*... *喘氣*...
我回頭看到一根柱子差點砸到我們兩個，幸好我把我們撞開了。
管理員: 謝... 謝謝妳... 救了我...
管理員在受到驚嚇後，努力地想說出話來。
管理員: 我想妳說的是對的... 畢竟...
Pup: (這算我幸運還是不幸？)
Pup: 我... 我去叫人！
我跳起來，爬出現在已經解鎖的門。

passages.name: Supply Run Ch4 - S3 Charismatic
passages.content:
I slid myself around the bookshelf to get a read on 
where the librarian was.
Pup: (I see a candlelight moving over there. That must 
be him.)
Librarian: Show yourself! Even if you're a rat, I can show 
mercy.
Pup: (Could I convince him it wasn't a person? Maybe a 
rat...? Or a ghost...?)
I looked around and saw some rocks on the floor.
Pup: (From the renovation?)
Pup: (This could work, though.)
Librarian: Last chance... 5... 4... 3...
Librarian: Huh? Come out! I can hear you.

...

Don't make me start counting again.
Pup: *Soft ghostly wailing*...
Librarian: Ha ha... very funny-
Librarian: ...?!
He turned on his heels in the other direction.
Librarian: How are you... You can't be in two places at once.
I tip toed towards the end of an aisle 
of bookshelves.
Pup: (This should hopefully pull his eyesight away 
enough for me to get outside.)
I carefully placed a book at the end of the 
bookshelf in a precarious position.

Starting to move, I dropped another rock to pull 
him further in this direction.
Librarian: Think you're being sneaky? You won't feel sneaky 
when I am done with you.
The librarian slowly scooted towards the sound.

By the time he was there, I was at the other end 
of the bookshelf.
Pup: (Now just a firm shake, and...)
Librarian: Ack! Begone ghost!
Pup: (Time to sprint out of here!)
Pup: (No time to... to...)
There was a low rumbling sound.

I turned my head to see the outline of something 
in the darkness moving.
Pup: (The renovation stuff... it's falling?!)
It wasn't entirely localized, and I had to jump out of 
the way of falling debris myself.
Pup: *Cough* *cough*...
Librarian: Goddess... Goddess help me...

*Cough*... I guess it was just this thing falling 
apart, in the end.

Oh fucking...! This shit fell apart?!
Pup: (Okay, he's definitely distracted now.)
I jumped to my feet and scrambled out the door.
passages.content_zh:
我把自己滑到書架旁，想看看圖書館員在哪裡。
Pup: (我看到那邊有燭光在移動。一定是他。)
圖書館員: 現身吧！就算你是隻老鼠，我也會手下留情。
Pup: (我能說服他那不是人嗎？也許是老鼠...？還是鬼...？)
我環顧四周，看到地上有些石頭。
Pup: (是裝修留下的？)
Pup: (這或許可行。)
圖書館員: 最後一次機會... 5... 4... 3...
圖書館員: 蛤？出來！我聽得到你。

...

別逼我重新開始數。
Pup: *輕柔的鬼魂哀嚎聲*...
圖書館員: 哈哈哈...真好笑-
圖書館員: ...？！
他立刻轉身朝另一個方向走去。
圖書館員: 你怎麼... 你不可能同時出現在兩個地方。
我踮起腳尖走向一排書架的盡頭。
Pup: (這應該能分散他的注意力，讓我逃出去。)
我小心翼翼地把一本書放在書架的末端，一個岌岌可危的位置。

開始移動後，我又丟了一塊石頭，想把他引得更遠。
圖書館員: 以為你很狡猾？等我收拾完你，你就笑不出來了。
圖書館員慢慢地朝聲音的方向挪動。

當他到達那裡時，我已經在書架的另一端了。
Pup: (現在只要用力搖晃一下，然後...)
圖書館員: 呃！鬼魂退散！
Pup: (是時候衝出去了！)
Pup: (沒時間... 沒時間...)
傳來一陣低沉的隆隆聲。

我轉過頭，看到黑暗中有東西移動的輪廓。
Pup: (裝修的東西... 要倒了？!)
它並非完全局部性的，我不得不跳開，躲避掉落的碎片。
Pup: *咳嗽* *咳嗽*...
圖書館員: 女神... 女神救我...

*咳嗽*... 我想最後就只是這東西倒塌了。

喔，該死的...！這東西竟然塌了？！
Pup: (好吧，他現在肯定分心了。)
我跳起來，衝出門外。

passages.name: Supply Run Ch4 - S3 Direct
passages.content:
I slid myself around the bookshelf to get a read on 
where the librarian was.
Pup: (I see a candlelight moving over there. That must 
be him.)
Librarian: Show yourself! Even if you're a rat, I can show 
mercy.
Pup: (What would be the quickest way out?)
I looked around and saw a few paths I could take.
Pup: (There aren't many wide open places because of 
the renovation.)

(I can make this work, though.)
Librarian: Last chance... 5... 4... 3...
Librarian: There you are.
The librarian walked over to a set of bookshelves 
that had make a creaking sound.
Librarian: Gotcha!

Or... wait...?
He turned to the aisle and saw... nothing.
Librarian: Hmm...
Pup: (That was close...)
The silent thought felt like it echoed from where I 
was.

I had climbed the bookshelf to the top of one.
Pup: (Some of the scaffolding up here leads through a 
window.)
Slowly but surely, I crawled my way along the 
bookselves' tops and to the scaffolding.
Librarian: A rat... maybe...?

Hmm...
Through the corner of my eye I saw the candlelight 
raise like he was looking towards to the top of the 
bookshelves.
Pup: (Shit, did he figure it out?)
I started to rush.
Pup: (No!)
Librarian: The rat?!
Pup: No more time for stealth.
My feet propped myself to jump up and sprint from 
where I was, but...
There was a low rumbling sound. I turned my head 
down to see the surface beneath me falling.
Pup: (The renovation stuff... it's falling?!)
Pup: ...?!
The surface fell forward and forced me to tumbled 
along the path I was walking!
Pup: Urgh!
I hit the ground hard as I fell out of a window and 
onto the ground outside.
Pup: O- Ow...
A voice could be heard from within.
Librarian: Goddess... Goddess help me...

*Cough*... I guess it was just this
thing falling apart, in the end.

Oh fucking...! This shit fell apart?!
Pup: (Okay, he's definitely distracted now.)
I jumped to my feet and scrambled around the 
side of the library towards its entranceway.
passages.content_zh:
我在書架上滑動來閱讀
圖書館員在哪裡。
Pup：（我看到那邊有燭光在移動。那一定是
是他。 ）
圖書館員：展示一下你自己吧！即使你是老鼠，我也能證明
憐憫。
小狗：（最快的出路是什麼？）
我環顧四周，看到了幾條可以走的路。
Pup：（沒有太多空曠的地方，因為
裝修。 ）

（不過，我可以做到這一點。）
圖書館員：最後一次機會...5...4...3...
圖書館員：你來了。
圖書館員走到一組書架前
發出嘎吱嘎吱的聲音。
圖書館員：明白了！

或……等等……？
他轉向走道，卻發現……什麼也沒有。
圖書館員：嗯…
Pup：（已經很接近了…）
沉默的思緒彷彿從我所在的地方迴響
是。

我已經爬到書架的最上面了。
小狗：（這裡的一些腳手架穿過一個
視窗。 ）
緩慢但堅定地，我沿著這條路爬行
書架的頂部和腳手架。
圖書館員：一隻老鼠……也許……？

嗯...
我用眼角的餘光看到了燭光
舉起，就像他正在看向頂部一樣
書架。
Pup：（媽的，他懂了嗎？）
我開始著急。
小狗：（不！）
圖書館員：老鼠？ ！
小狗：沒有時間再隱形了。
我的腳支撐著自己跳起來衝刺
我當時在哪裡，但是…
低沉的轟鳴聲響起。我轉過頭
向下看我腳下的地面正在下落。
Pup：（裝修的東西……掉下來了？！）
小狗：……？ ！
地面向前傾倒，迫使我翻滾
沿著我走過的路！
小狗：呃！
當我從窗戶掉下來時，我重重地摔在地上
到外面的地面。
小狗：噢——噢…
裡面傳來了聲音。
圖書館員：女神……女神救救我……

*咳*...我想只是這個
事情最終分崩離析。

哦他媽的……！這玩意兒竟然崩盤了？ ！
Pup：（好吧，他現在肯定心煩意亂了。）
我跳了起來，爬到了周圍
圖書館面向入口的一側。

passages.name: Supply Run Ch4 - Continue 2
passages.content:
Pup: *Pant*... *pant*...
I turned back to see the librarian wander out the 
front door.
Pup: (At least he's okay.)
Librarian: Dammit, the main branch will not be happy about 
this. It'll cost a ton to fix.

The damn contractors will face the wrath of the 
Covenant!
Pup: And... I don't want any part of that.
I ran off to the inn.
With supplies on hand, our Nightless Crows 
company and allies started on our way out 
of town.
Pup: Mr. DeClares, was it?
Cainan: Cainan DeClares at your service.
Pup: You said that people at this... academy, was it...?
Cainan: The Theodal Royal Academy, yes.
Pup: Right.
Pup: You said they'd be able to offset the symptoms of 
this curse, correct?
Cainan: It is a possibility.
Cainan: But if there is any place that can, it would be them. 
They are a bastion of knowledge and research.
Pup: R- Right...
As we were talking, we passed by the library.
Cainan: Did something happen here?
Librarian: Hmph. Looks like the contractors we hired for the 
renovations did a poor job.
Cainan: Unfortunate. Shall I send word to Oadthine for 
assistance?
Librarian: If you could, that would be most appreciated.
The librarian headed off grumbling under 
his breath.
Cainan: I am happy I stopped you from entering.
Cainan: It would do us no good if you had been trapped 
beneath the rubble.
Pup: Y- Yeah... That was... That was a good call...
passages.content_zh:
小狗：*褲子*...*褲子*...
我回頭看到圖書館員走出去
前門。
小狗：（至少他沒事。）
圖書館員：該死，總館不會高興的
這個。修復起來要花很多錢。

該死的承包商將面臨政府的憤怒
盟約！
Pup：還有……我不想參與其中的任何部分。
我跑到客棧去。
手邊有物資，我們的不夜鴉
公司和盟友開始了我們的出路
鎮的。
Pup：DeClares 先生，是嗎？
Cainan：Cainan DeClares 竭誠為您服務。
Pup：你說這個……學院的人，是……嗎？
該南：Theodal 皇家學院，是的。
小狗：對。
Pup：你說他們能夠抵消以下症狀
這個詛咒，對嗎？
蔡南：有這個可能。
蔡南：但如果有地方可以的話，那就是他們了。 
它們是知識和研究的堡壘。
小狗：R——對…
說話間，我們經過圖書館。
彩南：這裡發生了什麼事情嗎？
圖書館員：哼。看起來像我們僱用的承包商
裝修工作做得很差。
蔡南：不幸的是。我可以寫信給 Oadthine 嗎？ 
援助？
圖書館員：如果可以的話，我們將不勝感激。
圖書館員一邊抱怨一邊走開了。 
他的呼吸。
Cainan：我很高興阻止你進入。
該南：如果你被困住了對我們沒有任何好處
在廢墟下面。
小狗：是-是的...那是...這是一個很好的決定...

passages.name: Supply Run Ch5-6 - Begining
passages.content:
Rowan: And take one down, pass it around~ 
23 boxes left to pack~
Charlotte: Oh dear Aurier up in the sky... Please strike down 
this fool.
Rowan: The goddess would not dare starve the world of 
my lovely singing.
Charlotte: You actually think you're good at singing?
Rowan: How about we let the goddess herself decide?
Rowan raised his chin to look towards the sky.

..........
Rowan: It appears your prayer went... unanswered?
Charlotte: That doesn't mean anything.
Rowan: Ah... It is good to be goddess approved~
Rowan: 23 boxes left to pack~
Charlotte: Shut up, shut up, SHUT UP!
Otis: Ai, shut it yourself. I'm trying to take a nap.
Otis was strewn about on top of a tall box nearby.
Otis: If ya want to get it to stop, just finish up the prep 
work.
Charlotte: And why aren't you or your crew helping?!
Otis: Hungover, lass.
Otis: You do wanna leave today, ay?
Charlotte: I wish for you to do the job you were hired for...
Otis: Then we'll leave... *yawn*... tomorrow...
Otis rolled his back towards Charlotte and quickly 
started producing snores.
Charlotte: You little...
Rowan: 23 boxes left to pack~
Charlotte: Urgh! I get it!
Charlotte turned towards the loading ramp.
Charlotte: ...
Pup: ...
Charlotte: Why are you unloading a box?
I stood there with a box still in my hands. It was 
covering my chest.
Pup: Uh... well... It has good shape to get a grip on. It 
works well as a foundation to what I am carrying...
Pup: It's... more efficient.
My grip on the box tightened as I drew it a little 
closer to my chest.
Charlotte: *Sigh*... I don't care... We shouldn't even be 
doing this.
Pup: Well... It is what it is... so...
passages.content_zh:
羅文：然後拿下來一張，傳給大家~
剩23盒待打包~
夏綠蒂：天上親愛的奧裡爾…請擊落吧
這個傻瓜。
羅文：女神不敢讓世界挨餓
我可愛的歌聲。
夏綠蒂：你真的認為你擅長唱歌嗎？
羅文：我們讓女神自己決定怎麼樣？
羅文抬起下巴，看向天空。

…………
羅文：看來你的祈禱……沒有得到回應？
夏洛特：那沒有什麼意義。
羅文：啊…得到女神認可真好~
羅文：還剩23盒要打包~
夏洛特：閉嘴，閉嘴，閉嘴！
奧蒂斯：哎呀，你自己關門吧。我正想小睡一會兒。
奧蒂斯躺在附近一個高箱子的頂部。
奧蒂斯：如果你想讓它停止，就完成準備工作
工作。
夏洛特：那你或你的團隊為什麼不幫忙呢？ ！
奧蒂斯：宿醉了，姑娘。
奧蒂斯：你今天確實想離開，是嗎？
夏綠蒂：我希望你能完成被雇用的工作...
奧蒂斯：那我們就離開…*哈欠*…明天…
奧蒂斯背向夏洛特，迅速
開始打鼾。
夏洛特：你這個小...
羅文：還剩23盒要打包~
夏洛特：呃！我得到它！
夏洛特轉向裝載坡道。
夏洛特：…
小狗：…
夏綠蒂：為什麼要卸下箱子？
我站在那裡，手裡還拿著一個箱子。原來是
摀住我的胸口。
小狗：呃……嗯……它的形狀很好，很容易抓握。它
很好地為我所攜帶的東西奠定了基礎......
Pup：這……更有效率。
當我輕輕地拉動盒子時，我握緊了盒子
更靠近我的胸部。
夏綠蒂：*嘆氣*...我不在乎...我們甚至不應該
做這個。
Pup：嗯……就是這樣……所以……

passages.name: Supply Run Ch5-6 - Choice
passages.content: [Choice]: We should act like a team. / Make light of the situation. / Complain about Otis, as well.
passages.content_zh: [選項]: 我們應該像個團隊一樣行動。/ 輕鬆看待這個情況。/ 也抱怨奧提斯吧。

passages.name: Supply Run Ch5-6 - S3 Diplomatic
passages.content:
I started to move towards and around Charlotte.
Pup: We're all on the same team at this point.

Maybe they're not contributing now, but we'll be 
reliant on them once we set sail.
As I began to make my way around the two, I kept 
facing them and sidestepped as I kept moving.
Pup: It's the least we can do to get from point A to 
point B safely, right?
Charlotte: ...
I had made my way to the other side.
Pup: We should try to all get along, no? I'll get another 
box to pack.
With those words, I quickly pivoted to facing away 
from them and scurried off from the scene.
passages.content_zh:
我開始朝著夏洛特移動並繞著她走。
小狗：我們現在都是同一隊的。

也許他們現在沒有貢獻，但一旦我們啟航，我們就會
依賴他們。
當我開始繞著他們兩個走時，我一直
面對著他們，並側身移動。
小狗：這至少是我們可以安全地從A點到B點的方法，對吧？
夏洛特：...
我已經繞到了另一邊。
小狗：我們應該試著好好相處，不是嗎？我去拿另一個
箱子來打包。
說完這些話，我迅速轉身背對著他們，並匆匆離開了現場。

passages.name: Supply Run Ch5-6 - S3 Charismatic
passages.content:
I started to move towards and around Charlotte.
Pup: What else do you expect of the bandits of the sea? 
I've heard some tales myself.
Pup: You should hear some of the stories the Crows 
have of pirates. Bard boy over there probably has a 
few tales, too.
As I began to make my way around the two, I kept 
facing them and sidestepped as I kept moving.
Pup: Then again, if we don't want it to happen again...?

Maybe we should pour out the rum before setting 
off?
Otis: Urgh...
I had made my way to the other side.
Pup: As for this? Better to just get it over with, right? 
Haha... ha...
With those words, I quickly pivoted to facing away 
from them and scurried off from the scene.
passages.content_zh:
我開始朝夏洛特走去。
小狗：你對海賊還有什麼期待？ 
我自己也聽過一些故事。
小狗：你應該聽聽烏鴉的一些故事
有海盜。那邊的吟遊詩人可能有一個
故事也很少。
當我開始繞過這兩個人時，我一直
面對他們，我一邊走一邊閃開。
Pup：話又說回來，如果我們不想再發生這種事的話…？

也許我們應該在凝固前倒出朗姆酒
關？
奧蒂斯：呃…
我已經走到另一邊了。
小狗：至於這個嗎？最好就這樣結束吧？ 
哈哈……哈……
說完這句話，我迅速轉過身去
離開了他們並匆匆離開了現場。

passages.name: Supply Run Ch5-6 - S3 Direct
passages.content:
I started to move towards and around Charlotte.
Pup: Yeah, it is the typical sort of pain in the butt.
Pup: That dumb nekolyn is going to be the death of us if 
this keeps up.
As I began to make my way around the two, I kept 
facing them and sidestepped as I kept moving.
Pup: Rowan, you should keep singing as a punishment 
for the dead weight snoring up there.
Rowan: ...
I had made my way to the other side.
Pup: I guess... let's not dawdle. We can make up for 
these guys being lazy, at least.
With those words, I pivoted to facing away from 
them and scurried off from the scene.
passages.content_zh:
我開始朝著夏洛特移動並繞著她走。
Pup: 沒錯，就是那種典型的麻煩事。
Pup: 如果這樣下去，那個笨貓靈遲早會害死我們的。
當我開始繞著他們兩個移動時，我一直面向著他們，並側著身子繼續移動。
Pup: Rowan，你應該繼續唱歌，作為對上面那個打呼的廢物的懲罰。
Rowan: ...
我已經繞到了另一邊。
Pup: 我想...別磨蹭了。至少我們可以彌補這些傢伙的懶惰。
說完這些話，我轉身背對他們，並迅速離開了現場。

passages.name: Supply Run Ch5-6 - Continue 2
passages.content:
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte turned back to Rowan.
Charlotte: What? Not going to sing "24 boxes" since one was 
taken off?
Rowan: ...
Rowan's eyes were set on the skies above the sea.
Rowan: It looks as though a storm may be setting in?
Charlotte: A storm...?
Otis: Shit. Kid's right.
Otis jumped down from the box. He rubbed his 
neck that was stiff from sleeping.
Otis: I'll get me mates. We really can't burn our time if 
dark clouds are formin'.
Otis: Ah... The Crimson Sea's bloody enough without 
the cracklin' of lightnin'.
Charlotte: Wait, then shouldn't we stay in port?
Otis: Eh, by the looks of it we can stay to its edges even 
if it gets bad.
Otis: Well, if we hurry to get going at least. 
Chop-chop, princess.
Charlotte: ...
With the full crew getting whipped into action, we 
were able to get out of port soon enough.
Norde: Such unnecessary dramatics...
Satia: At least we were able to get out of port before 
the sun was fully up.
Norde: Small victories do not always feel as such.
Norde: At least we left before the sun was able to fully 
rise. Small victory that it is.
For my part, as the ship began to drift away from 
port, I closely grabbed onto the ship's railings.
Mariel: Watching the town as it goes over the horizon?
When she approached, I scooted myself closer to 
the railing as to not face her.
Pup: Y- Yeah... That sounds about right?
Mariel: Is it your first time?
Pup: ...

(I guess I haven't before but...)
Pup: (How could I care about that when dealing with... 
this...)
I looked down to the small protrusions on my 
chest. The ones that I was attempting to hide.
Mariel: I was little at the time. It has a sort of magical air in 
my memories.

But even now it still is a pretty sight to watch.
Rowan: Watching the town as it goes over the horizon?
When he approached, I scooted myself closer to 
the railing as to not face him.
Pup: Y- Yeah... That sounds about right?
Rowan: Mayhap this be your first chance to do do?
Pup: ...

(I guess I haven't before but...)
Pup: (How could I care about that when dealing with... 
this...)
I looked down to the small protrusions on my 
chest. The ones that I was attempting to hide.
Rowan: It was a long time before I had an opportunity, but 
it was a surreal moment.
Rowan: No matter what hardships have come since, that 
day still stands as a nostalgic milestone.
Pup: ...

I... need to check on something.
Not handling the anxiety well, I dipped away and 
slipped towards the ship's cabins.

My conversation partner was left there looking 
confused.
The two ships we had taken set out smoothly into 
the sea.

While the storm clouds stayed in the distance, I set 
myself up with a blanket for a nap.

Then another nap.

And another.

*Shove*
Pup: ...?!
Pup: What the...?
Norde: Stop moping. Help grab some supplies for meal 
time.
Pup: Ah...?!
I quickly grabbed the blanket again to cover myself 
with.
Pup: S- Sure...
Norde: Don't drag your feet, then.
Norde walked away and the intense feeling of 
vulnerability that had washed over me died down.

I slowly got up to my feet and made my way 
through the ship cabins, blanket still covering me.
Charlotte: There you are. Where've you been hiding?
Pup: Oh... just resting.
I turned away to not face her.
Charlotte: Then can you-
Pup: N- Norde already asked me for some help.
With that, I scurried off around a corner of the 
internal corridors.
Charlotte: Okay...

Hmm... Wasn't that direction the way back 
outside?
Bursting onto deck, I breathed a sigh of relief. The 
light drizzle was enough for me to raise the blanket 
over my head.
But I was quickly met with a gust of wind!
Pup: Ah!
The blanket was ripped from my grip and flew 
overboard.

I took my jacket off to shield me from the rain as I 
ran after it.

My hand reached out and...!

Nothing.
Pup: Dammit... Now I can't sneak back inside.
Pup: ...?!
A jerk of the ship left me grabbing onto a railing 
nearby.
Pup: (What now... Maybe I should get...)

(Wait, Norde never told me what to get.)
Pup: (Whatever, I can just ride it out here. Hopefully no 
one-)
Pup: ...?!
Another jerk of the boat tested my grip.

Yet, at the same time, an alien sensation of weight 
pulling on my chest flashed in my senses.
Pup: (Crap... I really don't want to deal with these 
bouncing around now of all times...)
Pup: I really need to just go and-
*Splash*
Pup: ...
Pup: Was that just...?
Pup: Was that just a wave... of water?
Pup: ...
My mouth was agape, me stuttering much the 
same.
Pup: ...?!
Pup: Could you stop shaking about, you stupid ship?!
Pup: I... I...
Pup: Do these really need to be so... mobile...?!
The feeling of the breasts interacting with gravity 
became a lot more apparent.

At least it was after that strong first bounce and 
subsequent turbulence.
Pup: It isn't even like they're that... big?!
I tried to stabilize at least one of them with a free 
hand.
Pup: (And so noticeable through the wet shirt?!)
Pup: Oh shit...

How can I hide this...?!
Charlotte: Hide what?
Pup: Nothing!
I spun towards Charlotte's voice, but draped my 
front with my jacket.
Charlotte: What are you doing?
Pup: Oh, I was just getting some air...

And there was... like... some rain and... water... 
and... uh...

I wasn't doing nothing.
Charlotte: Huh...?
Charlotte: Oh, I don't care, just get inside. Even at the edge 
of the storm, it's dangerous to be out here.
Pup: (Thank the goddess, she won't notice after all.)
Rowan: Ah, did Pup start a wet shirt competition?
Rowan poked his head from the door Charlotte had 
exited.
Pup: Huh?
Rowan: Charlotte, you must join in!

Surely your breasts will glimmer in the stormy skies 
as well?
Pup: ...
Charlotte: Say another word and die, cretin.
Rowan: ...
Rowan retreated within the ship again.
Pup: How did...

How did... he know?
Charlotte: Come on.
Pup: H- How did... How did...?
Charlotte: Everyone knows! Now get inside!
Charlotte grabbed my non-functioning self and 
dragged me back into the ship cabin.
Pup: W- What?!
Charlotte: We've literally got a walking, talking, and drinking 
example of the sort of thing happening to you.

It's not a difficult guess!
She said as my body autonomously went along with 
her dragging me.
Pup: No.. But... How... I...
Pup: (ARGHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!)
passages.content_zh:
夏洛特：…
夏洛特轉身面向羅文。
夏洛特：什麼？不會再唱《24個盒子》了，因為一首
起飛？
羅文：…
羅文的目光落在了海面上的天空。
羅文：看來暴風雨即將來臨？
夏洛特：暴風雨…？
奧蒂斯：媽的。孩子說得對。
奧蒂斯從包廂裡跳了下來。他揉了揉他的
脖子因睡覺而僵硬。
奧蒂斯：我會去找我的夥伴的。如果我們真的不能浪費時間
烏雲正在形成。
奧蒂斯：啊……紅海已經夠血腥了，沒有
閃電的劈啪聲。
夏洛特：等等，那我們不該留在港口嗎？
奧蒂斯：呃，從表面上看我們甚至可以保持在邊緣
如果情況變糟。
奧蒂斯：好吧，至少我們趕快出發吧。 
劈劈啪啪，公主。
夏洛特：…
隨著全體工作人員開始行動，我們
我們很快就可以離開港口了。
Norde：這種不必要的戲劇性...
薩蒂亞：至少我們之前能夠出港
太陽已經完全升起來了。
Norde：小勝利並不總是給人這樣的感覺。
Norde：至少我們在太陽完全升起前就離開了

這……）
我低頭看著我身上的小突起
胸部。那些我試圖隱藏的。
瑪麗埃爾：當時我還小。它有一種神奇的氣息
我的回憶。

但即使現在，它仍然是一個值得一看的美麗景象。
羅文：看著小鎮越過地平線？
當他走近時，我迅速靠近

小狗

passages.name: Supply Run Ch6-7 - Begining
passages.content:
My mind was dulled.

Static buzzed like white noise among my thoughts.
Recent events felt unreal.

They felt detached from my end goal.

My destination.

My...

*Bump*
Pup: ...?
The bumps of the carriage wheel along the 
roadside had shaken me out of my stupor.

I was greeted with the sight of the port and 
lodgings we were at... being left behind.
Kara: So, you've simply been traveling aimlessly since 
dropping out of the academy?
Rowan: 'Aimless' might be the wrong word, but...
Rowan: It has indeed been a glorious sequence of 
happenstance on many occasion.
Charlotte: ...!
An awkward air filled my senses.

I felt like an outsider to every word being 
discussed.
Pup: (Right, this is why I tried to zone out...)
Turning my head, I looked again at the situation 
playing out in the carriage.

The greater group had been split among carriages 
for a tour of the Cartenan capital.

I had somehow ended up with this group.
Kara: Haha... to think that young boy Alexei would be 
able to travel the world like so.

I still remember that time you collapsed from 
running in the physical education courses.
Rowan: Ah... I do insist. "Rowan" is my name.
Rowan: And believe me. I would still faint.
Pup: ("Kara"... and "Alexei"... This is... Who even are 
these people? These names?)
I turned my head away from that conversation to 
our fourth passenger...
Charlotte: ...!
...who was staring daggers at Rowan.
Pup: (Has she blinked?)
Pup: (Well, maybe this is better than nothing.)
Pup: Isn't this crazy? All this talk about a "prince" and 
stuff?
Charlotte: ...
Pup: Yeah... like... all that stuff.
Charlotte: Allegedly... he just had a growth spurt.

And a complete personality shift.
Pup: So... you actually knew him? Do you buy that?
Charlotte: Allegedly... he dropped out of school to go 
wandering about who knows where.

Allegedly... he hasn't spoken to his royal parentage 
since before all that took place.
Pup: Uh... I wasn't really...
Charlotte: Allegedly... he thought it a good idea to just not 
mention any of this.
Pup: (She's not really listening to me.)
Charlotte: Allegedly... allegedly... allegedly...
Rowan: I've no qualms about pretending this was never 
revealed to the world at large.

It was my intent, after all.
Pup: Yeah... just try putting that genie back in 
the bottle.
Kara: Why is it that you kept this from your old friend?
Charlotte: Alleged friend.
Rowan: It was not my initial intent, but Charlotte didn't 
recognize me.

Afterwards, my mind was aflutter with concepts of 
grand reveals.
Rowan: Imagine me, the foreign prince, stationing myself 
on a border with legions in tow.

Am I friend or foe? What twists and turns does 
such a dramatic endeavor bring impending?
Kara: With an army in tow? But Lockhart has already 
been invaded?
Rowan: I... was still in the planning phases.
Charlotte: Alleged planning phases.
Kara: What a nostalgic feeling this conversation has.
The carriage came to a stop.
Kara: We must be here.
With Kara leading the group out of the carriage, we 
found ourselves in a grand courtyard.
Kara: This is our first stop on the tour.

Theodal's Grand Cathedral to the Goddess.
Pup: ...

(Holy... that's massive.)

(They make buildings this big?!)
Rowan: An elegant visage, as always.
Charlotte: Yeah. Kara, why the tour anyways? We've lived 
here for years back in school.
Rowan: "We" have?
Charlotte: Allegedly.
Kara: It is good to refamiliarize yourself with subjects 
you've not touched in years.

Places and... people... you may not recognize as 
well as you once did.
Charlotte: Well, if it's you that's saying so...
Charlotte: Wait...
Kara: Now, if you'll see here...
We toured the Cathedral, seeing the various works 
of art that made it up.

Afterwards, we continued on to other locations, 
until...
Castel: Hmm...
Pup: U- Uh...
A finger was poking me in the forehead.
Castel: Elasticity of section 1... minimal.

Now section 2...
Pup: Careful where you...
Pup: Are you able to cure me or not? I got excited 
when they said you could do something.
Kara: It will be several days before the Queen can take 
your meeting.

Until then, we have recruited a professor from the 
Royal College to assist in your case.

His name is Castel Balreig. He is a specialist in various 
types of magical research.
Kara: This would be a good time for you to meet him.
I looked around the room as I sat on the 
examination table.

The others were in an observation room off to the 
side, but towards my front...
Castel: *Sigh*... Impatience only leads to folly.
Castel: And cure? I don't know about that. This is the 
work of an Oathbreaker after all.

They work outside the bounds of the laws of the 
Goddess. To use the miracles within those bounds 
has no guaranteed counter.
Pup: So... you can't? Then why...?
Castel: What I can do is introduce you to cosmetic essence 
manipulation.
Pup: Cosmet... what?
Castel: I guess you'd be unaware, wouldn't you? It's most 
commonly used by the gentry, after all.
Castel: It is a very specialized way to use magic.

Red magic is the magic of energy. Of power and 
elements.

Green magic is the magic of creation. Of matter. 
The bits and pieces that make up our world.

And blue magic is the magic of the divine. The soul 
and essence that defines the self.
Castel: Imagine if those were to be used in precise 
coordination.
Castel: You could control the fabric of the self. You could 
mold a being to your design.

Power, stamina, longevity. Nothing is truly outside 
of our grasp.

This combination of the three is called "Gray" 
magic.
Pup: You could... anything?!

How... How is this not a massive thing?!
Castel: It is... an ongoing research initiative that has lots of
financiers to pursue it.
Castel: But to manipulate anything so specifically... the 
amount of calculations and skill required is massive.
Pup: R- Right...?
Castel: *Sigh*...It is a very complicated field of research, to 
say it simply.
Castel: The math...
Pup: ...?!
Castel: The math involved is among the most complicated 
any can do.
Castel: If that allows you to understand properly.
Pup: Then... If it's so complicated, then how are you 
supposed to help me?
Castel: There is one area of the field that is fairly well 
developed. Something that nobles jump at the 
chance to finance the research of.
Pup: That being...?
Castel: As said before... cosmetics.

Remove aging wrinkles. Change or grow hair.
Castel: Enlarge external sexual characteristics...
He looked at me as and could tell I still wasn't 
entirely keeping up.
Castel: Bigger boobs. Bigger butts. Bigger penises.
Pup: O- Oh...!
Castel: Nobles can be very open with their wallets when 
these possibilities are at stake.
Pup: Nobles do...
I turned to the watching audience. The ones who 
were left outside of the lab to wait and listen.
Pup: Nobles do... that...?
Charlotte: How old do you think I am?! I don't need some 
stupid stuff like that.
Kara: I never have, but I've always been intrigued by the 
field.
Charlotte: Ah, come on, Kara. You're plenty young and 
pretty.
Kara: I am simply a fan of humanity's ability to push 
boundaries.
Pup: ...
My eyes turned to the last audience member.
Rowan: Ah. Myself?
Rowan: I shall leave it to your imagination.
Pup: (Then my imagination won't partake, please and 
thank you.)
I turned back to Professor Balreig.
...who was touching my hair now.
Castel: A non-standard texture given the predicament.

Perhaps green magic could help? Textures are 
formed by surface interactions after all.
He moved to check my forearms.
Castel: And no body hair? It is almost unnaturally smooth.

Then red magic to counter this? To metabolize the 
hair growth?
After poking and prodding at my body, he stepped 
back to look over my body.
Castel: I suppose there is no guarantee any of it will work, 
but... theoretically...
Pup: Okay, this is getting weird.
Castel: Think of it as what it is. A medical procedure.
Pup: I guess that helps a bit, yeah.
Castel: Now strip.
Pup: W- What?!
Castel: If I am to analyze the extent of the changes to 
you, then I must see the body proper. From head 
to toe.
You are covered with a bulky, unwieldy jacket and 
other gear.
Pup: I... I... Do I... have to...?
Castel: Of course you do. This is questionable if it even can 
work.

There is no room for error. So, I need to start the 
detailed preparations to-
Kara: *Clears throat*
Castel: M- Ms. Lyons...!
Kara had appeared suddenly next to Professor 
Balreig.
Kara: It was a lovely visit, but we do not have time on 
our schedule for this level of detail.
Pup: Thank you...

(I feel like she saved me...)
Kara: The stripping will simply have to be done at a later 
date.
Pup: Wait, wh- what?!
Kara grabbed my hand and began to lead me and 
the group out to the carriage again.
Rushed into the carriage, the tour continued 
without many more thoughts on that subject for 
the time.
With that, it passed through my thoughts into 
memory as we made a few more stops.

The last one being a restaurant. An incredibly fancy 
and high end restaurant.
"Click" went the porcelain glass that was set in 
front of me.
Pup: ...

(They said this was... tea?)
I thought I knew what I was in for when the 
option of tea was available, but the presentation 
threw me off.
The aroma smelled like nothing I smelled before, 
and the cup itself had so many impractical details 
that it'd be fruitless to try to start counting.
Charlotte: What, never drank tea before?
She said as she took a sip.
Pup: Of course I have.
I grabbed the cup and quickly raised it to my 
mouth.
Kara: Oh... Anton, was it?
Kara: There is an etiquette to tea drinking in such an 
establishment.

You shouldn't raise the saucer with it, and your 
pinky should be-
Pup: *Slurp*!
Kara: Ah! Sips! Sips!
Pup: (That was...)

(That was better than I thought, but...)
Charlotte: Oh?
I didn't like her teasing expression.

I decided to...
[Choice]: Compliment the tea. / Lean into the teasing. / Lambast the tea.
Pup: That is quite good.

Compliments to the... uh... chef?
Charlotte: Ah...
Charlotte: Teamaker. Or brewer perhaps?
Charlotte: Wait, what would it be? We should-
Pup: Oh, so this is what tea tastes like?

Ah, my life is changed! How did I ever live 
without it!
?
Charlotte: Hmm...

Is that the game you want to play?
Pup: I guess it tastes like tea. Like most tea.
Pup: Like... dirty water.
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte: You want to play that game? Then...
*Clap clap*
Kara: Now now. The food will be here soon. No need to 
rile yourselves up before a good meal, yes?
Rowan: You may be surprised at the joy a rowdy round of 
food can bring.
Charlotte: So says the guy who... allegedly... attended the 
same etiquette classes as the rest of us.
Kara: I do recall him doing well in those courses.
Rowan: The elegant hand is but a tool for one to wield.
Kara: Hmm... Is that so...?
The discussion began to meander off into old 
school stories and references.
Pup: ...
Pup: (There they go into that again.)

(I can see why I was with Kara's group because of 
my... situation. But...)
Their conversation continued.
Pup: ...
And continued...
Pup: ...
Pup: (When will that food get here?)
Pup: (Maybe I could try to change the subject? Or make 
it more relevant to something I can talk about?)
I decided to...
[Choice]: Ally with Charlotte against Rowan's suspiciousness. / Gossip about the others' pasts via Kara. / Ally with Rowan to make "sides" to the conversation.
passages.content_zh:
我的思緒變得遲鈍。

靜電般的雜音像白噪音般在我的思緒中嗡嗡作響。
最近發生的事情感覺很不真實。

它們感覺與我的最終目標脫節。

我的目的地。

我的...

*顛簸*
小狗：...？
馬車輪子沿著
路邊的顛簸將我從昏沉中搖醒。

我看到港口和
我們所在的住所...被拋在身後。
卡拉：所以，你從學院輟學後就一直在漫無目的地旅行嗎？
羅文：說「漫無目的」可能不太恰當，但是...
羅文：在許多場合，這確實是一系列光榮的
偶然事件。
夏洛特：...！
一種尷尬的氣氛瀰漫在我的感官中。

我感覺自己像是每個被
討論的詞語的局外人。
小狗：（對了，這就是我試圖神遊的原因...）
我轉過頭，再次看向
馬車裡正在發生的情況。

為了參觀卡特南首都，大部隊被分成了幾輛
馬車。

不知怎麼的，我和這群人待在了一起。
卡拉：哈哈...真沒想到年輕的亞歷克西會
能夠像這樣環遊世界。

我還記得你當時在上體育課時跑步昏倒的事情。
羅文：啊...我堅持。「羅文」是我的名字。
羅文：相信我。我現在還是會昏倒。
小狗：（「卡拉」...和「亞歷克西」...這是...這些人到底是誰？這些名字？）
我把頭轉開，不再聽他們的對話，看向
我們的第四位乘客...
夏洛特：...！
...她正用眼神狠狠地瞪著羅文。
小狗：（她眨過眼嗎？）
小狗：（嗯，也許這總比什麼都沒有好。）
小狗：這不是很瘋狂嗎？一直在說什麼「王子」之類的？
夏洛特：...
小狗：是啊...就像...所有那些事情。
夏洛特：據說...他只是經歷了青春期。

還有徹底的性格轉變。
小狗：所以...你真的認識他？你相信嗎？
夏洛特：據說...他從學校輟學，跑到不知道什麼地方流浪。

據說...自從所有這些事情發生之前，他就沒有和他的皇室父母說過話。
小狗：呃...我其實不是...
夏洛特：據說...他認為跳

passages.name: Supply Run Ch6-7 - Diplomatic
passages.content:
Pup: You know...
I leaned over towards Charlotte.
Pup: You really think Rowan is this "Alexei" guy?
Charlotte: Hmm... Good question.
Pup: Well, we should keep an eye out for any... foul play 
by him, right?
Pup: We could make a great team for doing just that.

With your brains and my brawn, we could cover the 
gambit.
Charlotte: Hmm...
Charlotte: I'd be up for being cautious. Too many alleged 
claims not to be.
Charlotte: But are you sure about that last part?

Me brains and you brawn? Is that how that'd work 
out?
Pup: Uh... I mean, why wouldn't it? I'm a mercenary and 
you're a princess.
Charlotte: Hmm... I wonder.
Rowan: There was a time when Charlotte loved to play the 
big bad guardian.
Charlotte: Hey. You were just a little kid.
Rowan: Was I?
Charlotte: A- Allegedly...
passages.content_zh:
小狗：你知道...
我向夏洛特傾身。
Pup：你真的認為Rowan就是這個「Alexei」傢伙？
夏洛特：嗯……好問題。
小狗：好吧，我們應該留意任何…犯規行為
由他來吧？
Pup：我們可以組建一支出色的團隊來做這件事。

憑藉你的智慧和我的力量，我們可以覆蓋
策略。
夏洛特：嗯…
夏洛特：我會保持謹慎。被指控的人太多了
聲稱不是。
夏洛特：但是你確定最後一部分嗎？

我有腦子，你有肌肉嗎？是這樣的嗎
出來？
Pup：呃...我的意思是，為什麼不呢？我是一名僱傭兵並且
你是公主。
夏洛特：嗯……我想知道。
羅文：曾經有一段時間，夏洛特喜歡玩
大壞守護者。
夏洛特：嘿。你還只是個小孩子。
羅文：我是嗎？
夏洛特：A-據說…

passages.name: Supply Run Ch6-7 - Charisma
passages.content:
Pup: So...
I leaned over towards Kara.
Pup: You're supposed to be a friend of these two, right?

Have they always been at each others' necks like 
this?
Kara: They had their moments.
Kara: But they always made for a cute pairing of 
underclassman and upperclassman.
Pup: Moments, then? Anything particularly scandalous? 
Stuff that surprised you?
Kara: I can't say anything comes to mind. Not much will 
surprise me these days.
Pup: Ah, come on. I'm sure there's something fun like 
that.
Kara: I cannot say I remember the last time I was truly 
surprised by something.
Kara: You'd be better off rephrasing your question.
Pup: Uh... O- Okay...
Pup: Then... maybe...?
As I was about to do just that...
Charlotte: What are you talking about "no surprises"?

There was that time Alexei got dragged by a horse 
in riding class.
Rowan: Ugh... What a cruel memory to introduce.
Kara: *Giggle*... I don't believe that to be a perfectly 
accurate account. After all, there was...
passages.content_zh:
小狗：所以...
我靠向了卡拉。
小狗：妳應該是這兩人的朋友，對吧？

他們一直都像這樣水火不容嗎？
卡拉：他們偶爾會這樣。
卡拉：但他們總是能組成一對可愛的學弟妹組合。
小狗：偶爾？有沒有什麼特別勁爆的？
　　　有沒有什麼讓妳驚訝的事情？
卡拉：我想不太起來有什麼。現在很少有事情能讓我驚訝了。
小狗：拜託啦。我確定一定有什麼有趣的事情。
卡拉：我不太記得上次真正被什麼事情驚訝是什麼時候了。
卡拉：你最好重新措辭你的問題。
小狗：呃... 喔... 好...
小狗：那... 也許...？
正當我準備這麼做的時候...
夏洛特：你說「沒有驚訝」是什麼意思？

　　　　還有一次阿列克謝在騎術課上被馬拖著跑。
羅文：呃... 真是一個殘酷的回憶。
卡拉：*咯咯笑*... 我不認為那是完全準確的描述。畢竟，還有...

passages.name: Supply Run Ch6-7 - Direct
passages.content:
Pup: You know...
I leaned over towards Rowan.
Pup: This 'Alexei' thing...

I don't know if I buy it, but Charlotte definitely 
seems to want your head on a pike.
Rowan: I have grown used to it.
Rowan: You had a similar sentiment as of
just recently, did you not?
Pup: R- Right... Out of the fire and into another, I 
guess?
Pup: You do tend to do everything you can to stop 
people from trusting you, though.
Rowan: At this rate I may need a bodyguard.
Rowan: Might you be willing to take up that mantle?
Pup: B- Bodyguard? You mean...?

(Wait, is he being serious?)
Pup: I mean...
Charlotte: As if a bodyguard would keep you safe if I really 
wanted to.
Rowan: This reminds me of that one boy you sought 
revenge on in the academy.

What did he do? Try to take your hat from you?
Charlotte: Yeah, and if you want to end up like him...
passages.content_zh:
小狗：你知道...
我向羅文傾身。
Pup：這個「阿列克謝」的東西…

我不知道我是否買，但夏洛特絕對買
似乎想要你的頭在長矛上。
羅文：我已經習慣了。
羅文：你有類似的感受
就在最近，你不是嗎？
小狗：R-對…走出火場，進入另一個火場，我
你猜？
小狗：你確實會想盡辦法阻止
不過，人們不再信任你。
羅文：照這樣下去我可能需要一個保鑣了。
羅文：你願意承擔這個職責嗎？
小狗：B、保鑣？你的意思是...？

（等等，他是認真的嗎？）
小狗：我的意思是...
夏綠蒂：如果我真的的話，就好像保鑣會保護你的安全一樣
想要。
羅文：這讓我想起你要找的那個男孩
在學院報仇。

他做了什麼？試圖奪走你的帽子嗎？
夏綠蒂：是的，如果你想成為像他一樣的人...

passages.name: Supply Run Ch6-7 - Continue
passages.content:
And so each of them went back to their nostalgic 
topics.
Pup: ...
So I sat back and just waited.

Less than a minute later a plate was put before me 
with a meal.
Pup: Looks good...
I picked at the food with my fork and took small 
bites.
Pup: Looks good. Is good...

...
Pup: (I wonder if I could take some as leftovers?)

(It'll be my turn for a supply run soon. Maybe that'll 
get me out of it?)
Pup: ...

Maybe.
passages.content_zh:
於是他們各自回到了他們懷舊的話題。
小狗：...
所以我坐回原位，靜靜地等待。

不到一分鐘後，一盤餐點被放在我面前。
小狗：看起來不錯...
我用叉子挑著食物，小口小口地吃。
小狗：看起來不錯。也好吃...

...
小狗：（我在想我能不能打包一些當剩菜？）

（很快就要輪到我補給了。也許那能讓我擺脫困境？）
小狗：...

也許吧。

passages.name: Supply Run Ch7-8 - Begining
passages.content:
*Click*
*Click*
*Click*
*Click*

The carriage moved swiftly, but the click of wheels 
on brick roads were loud.

Very loud.

*Click*
Pup: ...!
I started to feel like I was going to hurl as the next 
bump of the brick road rattled my senses.
Pup: (The Queen... We need to talk to... the Queen...)
I tried to focus my attention into staring at a single 
point.

In this case, it was my arm.
I stared at my...

I expected to see hairs standing on edge, but I 
didn’t have any body hair to do so.
Pup: (Right, I had that-)
Pup: Ugh...

(I need to stop thinking about it...)
I stared at my...

I expected to see hairs standing on edge, but I 
didn’t have any body hair to do so.
Pup: (It really is just hitting me all-)
Pup: Ugh...

(I need to stop thinking about it...)
As my eyes unfocused and my breathing caught up 
with me, I tilted towards the carriage window.
Pup: (Snowy... mountains... how... how pretty?)
My mind struggled to focus on it, so I gave in to 
the distractions.
Norde: Do not lose focus.
Pup: I know. I know, I know...
Norde: Mmm...
Norde had a drop of sweat going down his brow.

His breathing was distinctly controlled and calm, 
as though it required effort.

And he couldn’t get that look of frustration off his 
face anymore.
Pup: You’re also...?
Norde: Do not... say it.
Pup: (Yeah, he is.)

(I can’t be mad at him about it. He’s handling it 
way better than I am...)
Norde: It... will not be long now.
As Norde said as much, the city... and the palace... 
was coming into view.
Pup: Yeah...
Avalina: ...You DARE set foot here as such?!
Pup: ...?!
The outburst shook me from my stupor.
Avalina: ...a sacred place of authority and...
Kara: ...n’t have done it if...
Rowan: ...not know the minds of...
Charlotte: ...save the kingdom and then...
Pup: (And then...?)
Pup: (And then...?!)
I tried to pay attention to the conversation they 
were having with the Queen. I really did.

But I couldn’t.
Pup: What did she...?
Knight: Shh!
Pup: S- Sorry...
We had been placed in a group boxed by royal 
guards.

Only Charlotte, Kara, and Rowan were allowed to 
approach due to their statuses within the world.

But being away from the conversation wasn’t the 
main reason I had trouble hearing.
Pup: Urgh...
A dull, ringing sensation underscored the sounds I 
heard.

It accompanied a sore sensation that left only a 
partial feeling coming from my nerves.

I tried to grip my hand tighter, if only to 
reinvigorate my ability to sense the surrounding 
world.
Avalina: ...foolish enough to...
Charlotte: ...what everyone said about...
Pup: ...
Goosebumps slid across my back and up across my 
head, where the roots of my hair felt like they 
were stinging.
Along with it, feelings of heat pulsated through the 
rest of my body. With emphasis around my chest 
and hips.
I tried very hard to not think about what any of 
that meant, as much as my mind wanted to 
wander to it.
And I... bit my tongue.

The tighter grip didn’t work, so...
Pup: (Keep focus... I can’t mess up now.)
Charlotte: ...Crows just happened to...
Charlotte: ...if you could...

...
Charlotte: ...come over...
Charlotte: ...PUP!
Pup: ...!?
Charlotte: Pup, please come tell the Queen about it.
Pup: R- Right... Yeah...
Knight: Don’t make any sudden moves as you approach.
I nodded my head.
Pup: (Approach... for...?)
We hadn’t had a chance to discuss our strategy for 
this meeting before.

So I simply followed the directions and approached 
the part of the throne room with Charlotte and 
them.
Kara: Thank you very much for your assistance here.
Pup: Yeah...
Charlotte: Anton here was there when it happened.

So, as a first hand testimony...
Pup: (Oh, so she wants...?)
Pup: Yeah, I can do that.
I turned towards the Queen.
Avalina: Then, Anton Baranov of the Nightless Crows... Tell 
me of this ordeal.
Pup: I am... Anton Baranov. I am the current acting 
head of the Nightless Crows Mercenary Corp.

Not too long ago, we... we...
My words were starting to get stuck. I took a 
breath and tried to reset myself.
Pup: Not too long ago, we were hired to... and...

And the telegram lines. They were.. And then... 
then...
Pup: ...there were... bandits and...
Pup: ...and...!
I hit my limit.
Pup: Ugh...
Pup: ...!
With but a second of grogginess, I became aware 
again.

Patting my body around, a morbid curiosity quickly 
took over me.
Pup: ...
Pup: Nothing... No changes...

...yet...
I felt significantly better. I still felt woozy, but the 
bout of weakness that had overtaken me had 
subsided.
With that, my attention swung to the present.

Voices came from beyond my bedside.
Rowan: ...would not be wise to let him go...
Charlotte: ...not like we’re lacking in people. We could leave 
him with...
A discussion was being had.
Pup: (It’s about me.)

(Did they get the Queen’s assistance?)

...
They were just around the corner.
Pup: (I’m not staying behind if the Empire is showing up 
again.)
I needed to pick my words carefully.
[Choice]: Try to reason with them / Try to appeal to their emotions / Just refuse outright
passages.content_zh:
*點擊*
*點擊*
*點擊*
*點擊*

馬車行駛得很快，但車輪的咔噠聲
磚路上聲音很大。

非常響亮。

*點擊*
小狗：……！
我開始感覺我要作為下一個投擲者
磚路的顛簸讓我的感官感到不安。
Pup：（女王……我們需要和……女王談談……）
我試著集中註意力盯著一個
點。

在這種情況下，是我的手臂。
我盯著我的...

我以為會看到毛髮豎立，但我
沒有任何體毛可以做到這一點。
Pup：（對，我有那個-）
小狗：呃…

（我需要停止思考這個問題......）
我盯著我的...

我以為會看到毛髮豎立，但我
沒有任何體毛可以做到這一點。
小狗：（這真的讓我很震驚-）
小狗：呃…

（我需要停止思考這個問題......）
當我的目光渙散、呼吸變得急促時
我和我一起向車廂窗戶傾斜。
小狗：（雪……山……怎麼……怎麼漂亮？）
我的思緒很難集中註意力，所以我屈服了
幹擾。
Norde：不要失去焦點。
小狗：我知道。我知道，我知道…
諾德：嗯…
諾德的額頭上流下了汗珠。

他的呼吸明顯受到控制且平靜，
好像這需要努力。

他無法擺脫那種沮喪的表情
不再有臉了
小狗：你也是…？
Norde：別……說出來。
小狗：（是的，他是。）

（我不能為此生他的氣。他正在處理這件事
比我好多了...）
Norde：這……不會太久了。
正如諾德所說，這座城市……還有宮殿……
正在進入視野。
小狗：是啊...
Avalina：……你竟然敢踏足這裡？ ！
小狗：……？ ！
這突如其來的爆發將我從昏迷中驚醒。
阿瓦琳娜：……一個神聖的權威之地……
卡拉：……如果……的話，我還沒做到。
羅文：……不知道……的想法
夏洛特：…拯救王國，然後…
小狗：（然後…？）
小狗：（然後……？！）
我試著注意他們的談話
正在和女王一起吃飯。我真的做到了。

但我不能。
小狗：她……做了什麼？
騎士：噓！
小狗：S-對不起…
我們被分在b組

passages.name: Supply Run Ch7-8 - Dip
passages.content:
I rose to my feet and pulled the bedside curtain 
out of the way.
Pup: I can help.
Charlotte: You’re awake?
Pup: We all remember what happened in Lockhart. We 
need everyone we can get.
Rowan: Are you alright?
Pup: I’m...
Pup: I’m better.

I’m ready to help.
Kara: You believe yourself to be fit to fight?
Pup: After what happened at Lockhart. I need to help. I 
can.

We don’t even have... We don’t even have my 
father this time.

There isn’t room for debate on this.
passages.content_zh:
我起身站立，拉開床邊的窗簾。
Pup: 我可以幫忙。
Charlotte: 你醒了？
Pup: 我們都記得在洛克哈特發生的事。我們需要所有能幫忙的人。
Rowan: 你還好嗎？
Pup: 我...
Pup: 我好多了。

我準備好幫忙了。
Kara: 你認為自己適合戰鬥？
Pup: 在洛克哈特發生那些事之後。我需要幫忙。我可以的。

我們甚至沒有... 這次我們甚至沒有我父親。

這件事沒有討論的空間。

passages.name: Supply Run Ch7-8 - Cha
passages.content:
I rose to my feet and pulled the bedside curtain 
out of the way.
Pup: So we’re headed out now? Let’s get going.
Charlotte: You’re awake?
Pup: Sorry if I have some bed head, but I think we have 
more important things to deal with.
Rowan: Are you alright?
Pup: I’m...
Pup: I’m doing as well as one can expect.

I wouldn’t dare sit this one out.
Kara: You believe yourself to be fit to fight?
Pup: I know I can handle a sword. Maybe even swing it 
with some righteous fury, too.
Pup: If this is the Empire... I... You all know I cannot just 
sit this out.

This is too important for too many reasons to 
debate.
passages.content_zh:
我站起來拉開床頭簾
讓開。
小狗：那我們現在就出發吧？讓我們開始吧。
夏洛特：你醒了？
小狗：抱歉，如果我有一些床頭，但我想我們有
更重要的事情要處理。
羅文：你還好嗎？
小狗：我是…
Pup：我做得很好，正如人們所期望的那樣。

我不敢坐視這個。
卡拉：你相信自己適合戰鬥嗎？
小狗：我知道我會用劍。也許甚至可以搖擺它
也帶著一些正義的憤怒。
Pup：如果這是帝國……我……你們都知道我不能只是
坐下來。

由於太多原因，這太重要了
辯論。

passages.name: Supply Run Ch7-8 - Dir
passages.content:
I rose to my feet and pulled the bedside curtain 
out of the way.
Pup: Let’s get going, then.
Charlotte: You’re awake?
Pup: And ready to go.
Rowan: Are you alright?
Pup: I’m...
Pup: I’m ready to fight.

I wouldn’t dare sit this one out.
Kara: You believe yourself to be fit to fight?
Pup: I believe I will fight. I KNOW I will.

If this is anything like Lockhart... I’m not going to 
just let it pass me by.
Pup: I will make a difference. I won’t... I won’t be the 
reason for sacrifices being made.
passages.content_zh:
我起身站立，拉開了床邊的簾子。
小犬：那我們走吧。
夏洛特：你醒了？
小犬：而且準備好了。
羅文：你還好嗎？
小犬：我...
小犬：我準備好戰鬥了。

我不敢錯過這次機會。
卡拉：你認為自己適合戰鬥嗎？
小犬：我相信我會戰鬥。我知道我會。

如果這次跟洛克哈特那次一樣...我不會就這樣讓它過去。
小犬：我會有所作為。我不會...我不會成為需要做出犧牲的原因。

passages.name: Supply Run Ch7-8 - New Event
passages.content:
The stares that came my way were wary.
I could press the issue only so much.
Norde: I... agree.
Satia: You... what?
Satia: We shouldn’t...
Pup: You... wait, really?
Norde: If one is compelled to action and can make a true 
difference...
Norde: Do you think you could make a true difference, 
Anton?
Pup: Yes.
Norde: I support it, then.
Pup: ...
Pup: Thank you...
I turned back and stared at the others with a 
determined face.
Pup: ...
But...
Pup: ...!
Satia: Is it the curse again?!
Mariel: U- Uh... I can get a first aid kit!
Otis: Eh, lad. Knowin’ ya limits are important.
Otis: Especially in the early days for ya.
Charlotte: Yeah, this is getting irresponsible.
Pup: I... No...
A barrage of worried faces that couldn’t look 
anymore like antagonists filled my vision.

Voices of worry barraged my hearing.

And I dreaded the approaching hands of mercy.
Pup: I... I can...!
Kara: Then make a promise.
There it was. An opening.

A path through the ocean of goodwill.
Kara: Promise everyone you will not allow yourself to die.

That you will stop yourself when you cross that line 
of becoming a hindrance.
Pup: ...
A medic approached Kara.
Medic: These are the supplies you wanted me to run out 
and get, right?
Kara: They are. Thank you.
As the medic scurried off, she seemed to start 
preparing a small sort of tonic.
Kara: Promise.
Pup: ...
Pup: Okay. I promise.

I promise I will retreat when it goes too far.
Kara: Good.
With her tonic nearly complete, she unbuttoned 
her collar and took out a necklace.

Soon enough, it shone with a brilliant light.
Rowan: Magic? This is an heirloom?
Mariel: Are you enchanting the tonic in some way?
The shimmering lights of the magic settled into 
the tonic.
Kara: This will not cure you. This will not ease your 
symptoms.

It will, however, stop them from getting worse for 
a time.

And that is all it will be. Time. Time that you must 
make the most of.
Pup: I... How did you...?
I looked down at the bottle she had placed in my 
hand.
Pup: Thank you.

I... I will not break your faith.
The others around didn’t have anything more to 
say.
Kara: I look forward to seeing you rise to this challenge.
I looked her in the eyes and nodded.

I gave no attention to the others.
To their gazes of worry.
Pup: *Nod*...
Hope had won.

Over the tides of goodwill.
passages.content_zh:
朝我這邊投來的目光充滿了警戒。
我對這個問題只能強調這麼多。
諾德：我……同意。
薩蒂亞：你……什麼？
薩蒂亞：我們不應該…
Pup：你……等等，真的嗎？
Norde：如果一個人被迫採取行動並且能夠做出真正的
區別...
Norde：你認為你可以做出真正的改變嗎？ 
安東？
小狗：是的。
Norde：那我支持。
小狗：…
小狗：謝謝你…
我轉過身來，用一種眼神看著其他人。 
堅定的臉。
小狗：…
但是...
小狗：……！
薩蒂亞：又是詛咒嗎？ ！
Mariel：呃——呃……我可以獲得急救箱！
奧蒂斯：呃，小伙子。了解限制很重要。
奧蒂斯：尤其是在早期。
夏綠蒂：是的，這越來越不負責任了。
小狗：我……不……
一連串憂心忡忡的臉無法直視
不再像對手一樣充滿了我的視野。

憂慮的聲音充斥著我的耳朵。

我害怕慈悲之手的臨近。
小狗：我……我可以……！
卡拉：那就做出承諾吧。
就在那裡。一個開口。

一條穿越善意海洋的道路。
卡拉：向大家保證你不會讓自己死去。

當你越過那條線時你會停下來
成為障礙。
小狗：…
一名醫生走近卡拉。
軍醫：這些是你想讓我用完的補給品
並得到，對嗎？
卡拉：是的。謝謝。
當醫生匆忙離開時，她似乎開始了
準備一種小補品。
卡拉：保證。
小狗：…
小狗：好的。我保證。

我保證當事情走得太遠時我會撤退。
卡拉：好。
當她的補藥快完成時，她解開了釦子
她從衣領裡拿出一條項鍊。

很快，它就綻放出了絢麗的光芒。
羅文：魔法？這是傳家寶？
Mariel：你是否以某種方式讓補藥變得迷人？
閃爍的魔法光芒落入
滋補品。
卡拉：這治不了你的病。這不會緩解你的
症狀。

然而，這將阻止他們變得更糟
一次。

這就是全部。時間。你必須的時間
充分利用。
小狗：我……你怎麼……？
我低頭看著她放在我的瓶子裡
手。
小狗：謝謝你

passages.name: Supply Run Ch10-11 - Begining
passages.content:
The fluttering rays of light filtered through the
morning haze.
Blinded by it in the awakening daze, I could only 
hear the ruckus of something from afar.
Atticus: ...
Charlotte: ...
I couldn't make out words, but I assumed 
something had happened.
.........
Marya: Apologies, but excuse me.
Pup: ...?
Pup: ...Hello?
A woman was standing over my sleeping bag,
folding some sort of a fabric.
Marya: Oh, did I wake you? I'm so sorry.
Pup: Who are...
Pup: (Oh wait...)

Mrs. Ranasseur.
Mrs. Marya Ranasseur was standing over me. 
Atticus's wife.
Marya: I was just getting an early start on rolling up your
supplies here.
Pup: Why... would you do that?
Pup: (Did someone spot the army in the area already?)
I picked myself up and yawned.
Marya: Well...
As I knelt down to start collecting my own sleeping
bag, she told me about how the Oathbreaker was 
gone.
Pup: W- What?!

(After everything we did?! How did... How did that
happen?!)
Marya: That sweet girl Charlotte agreed to help track it 
down as part of your group's efforts.
Pup: Yeah, of course we can help.
I quickened my rolling of the sleeping bag.
Marya: Thank you. I know it would do my husband's heart 
good to know you have his back wholeheartedly.
With a huff, I pulled the stored sleeping bag up.
Pup: Of course. After all, if we don't, then who will?
Kara: In this case, especially.
Kara approached, with Charlotte not far behind her.
Charlotte: How did they get it in the night? We were all here...
Kara: If there's a trail to follow, we're the only ones with
a shot of finding that lead.

It would be weeks before a Covenant deployment
could be here to start an investigation.
Pup: I'll carry this over to the horses and-
I stepped forward.
As I did...
Pup: Ah...?
...I stumbled a little.
My clothes had gotten tangled with the sleeping 
bag a little, catching on it in a way I didn't expect.
Pup: I- I'll just be on my way.
Marya: Oh my, are you alright?

You're absolutely swimming in that outfit...
Charlotte: Oh, you noticed, too?
Marya: Sweetie, I can offer you something that may fit 
better, if it'd help?
Kara: Despite the problem, that is a bit much to ask of 
you.
Pup: Yeah, these will suit me fine...
Kara: That was not what I said.
Pup: Ah...
Marya: It really is no trouble. If anything getting rid of
some of the clothes stored around here would be a 
help to us.
Pup: I- I don't-
Charlotte grabbed the sleeping bag...
Charlotte: Pup. Take the offer.
Charlotte: It really has gotten unmanageable. One wrong 
move in a fight and you could open yourself up
to a fatal attack.
Pup: I just... need to adjust the tailoring again a little.
Charlotte: A little...?
Charlotte: You know what? Want me to bribe you "a little" 
instead?

What about some sweets at the next village?
Pup: Like... what sort of sweet...?
Charlotte: Kara and I have probably tried things you've never 
even heard of before. Maybe one of those?
Pup: I mean....
I shook my head.
Pup: N- No! Of course I'm not gonna get bought with a 
little chocolate.
Pup: Is that supposed to tempt me?
Pup: I'm not one of your schoolgirl classmates from when 
you were at the academy.
Kara: You may be surprised by how delectable some offerings
are.
Pup: I'm not gonna fall for that either...

No means no.
Charlotte: Well, then that just means you're doing it for free.
Pup: Charlotte... the only clothes she'd have that'd 
fit me are women's clothes...
Charlotte: I mean...
Kara: Actually, did you not say to treat you as a girl?
Kara: Why would your wardrobe be an exception?
Charlotte: Oh yeah, nice catch.
Pup: That's... That's not what I meant by-
All of sudden, I was pulled forward a little.
Charlotte swiftly took the sleeping bag while I was
distracted.
Pup: Hey!
Charlotte: No more excuses. Just go make sure you're not 
gonna get yourself killed over it.
Pup: But I'm not gonna-
And this time, I felt a grip on my gambeson.
Marya: Oh, it won't take long, dear. Trust me.
Now a tug, only for the scene in front of me to 
start getting father away.
Charlotte: We'll get everything ready to go.
Kara: ...
...with their waves to accompany the farewell.
Pup: (Fuuuccckkk...)
Entering the Vault's dormitory halls, I could only
sigh.
Pup: (They got me roped into this again...)
Marya: ...and then Xavier joined Lefen on his quest. I am
proud, though I'd probably be happier if they were 
safe and sound.
Add to that, Euna and Pelus actually have time to 
visit from time to time. I wish they all could.
Marya guided me through the halls, and quickly 
found herself talking about her children.
Pup: (I guess it must have been a while since she had
someone new to talk to out here.)
Pup: (But... to immediately start talking about your
kids...?)
Marya: Ah, if only you could meet. I'm sure Euna could 
help you pick which clothes would best suit you.

Though maybe the mother's touch has gotten to 
her sense of fashion too~

I really must go out there to see my grandson 
again.
Pup: (Are all mother's like this?)
Marya: Ah, sorry. Maybe I'm getting a bit off topic?
Pup: Haha... It's no worry. You seem so excited about it
that it'd be a shame to stop you.
Marya: I suppose so! I am just going off on my own 
tangents.

You'll understand once you're a mother.
Pup: ...
Pup: ...
I stopped.
Pup: (What did she... say...? Did I mishear her...?)
Marya: And here it is.
Not far in front of my stopped location, she opened 
a door.
Pup: (I...)
Pup: I- I must have misheard her...  *Clears throat* ...
So I stepped through the door.
Marya: Tada!
It was a dress! 

I wasn't surprised.
Marya: Euna always looked so cute in it when she wore it. 
And it's warmer than your typical dress.
Pup: Your... daughter's... dress...?
Marya: I'm sure she won't mind. It was among the 
wardrobe she left behind when she moved out...
Pup: I- I'm not sure I could work with a dress. It is a
battlefield after all.
Marya: Are you sure? I saw multiple of your allies wearing
dresses, after all.
Pup: Haha... haha... I'm sure... they're just more used to
it?
Pup: It'd be much safer for me to just get this old thing
tailored again.
I backed away towards the door.
Marya: There are other outfits I can-
Pup: Oh, I think it'd be too much of me to ask for your
daughter's hand-me- downs.
Pup: Y- You really don't have to worry about it.
Marya: If... you insist.
As I was one foot out the door, I tried to not look 
her in the eyes.
Pup: It... really was nice hearing about your family.
I gave a brief but sincere smile, and hurried my 
way back the way we came.
Marya: ...
She crossed her arms and sighed like a 
disappointed mother.
Kara: I assume that means Pup didn't take the outfit?
Kara, watching me as I hurriedly headed back, 
stepped through the door to meet with Marya.
Marya: It's a shame, I think it suited her, too.
Kara: What a cute dress. It would have indeed went with Pup's
hair.
Marya: Is she okay? I never imagined she'd be so against it
once here.
Kara: There is a bit of a story behind that.

...
Kara: Though, I do have an idea...
Our path took us from the vault, leading us out of 
the mountains.
Luckily, signs of our pursuers from the Cartenan
struggle were few and far between.
We had time.
So we moved along a safe path to head south 
within the empire, all while we looked for any signs 
of the Oathbreaker thief.
There were... thoughts beyond the effort, as well.
Charlotte: I can't believe you didn't take the damn outfit.
Pup: Haha... haha...
It wasn't long until we were at the base of the
mountains.
Norde: We'll be stopping at this village here.
Norde pointed towards a map. It was a village at 
the base of the mountains, often used for 
resupplying for expeditions into them.
Pup: A supply town... They'd probably have...
Charlotte: A tailor?

The sun just rose, so they should be open soon.
Pup: Y- Yeah...
Tailor: ...and that'll be maybe an hour or so to finish once 
it gets to the top of my queue.
Pup: Thank you.
I paid the shopkeep, while keeping an eye out over 
my shoulder for the other tagalongs.
Charlotte: ...
Mariel: ...
Satia: ...
...amongst other Crows that needed repairs from 
the long trek in the mountains.
Pup: Hmm...
Tailor: Here, follow me.
The shopkeep led me towards the changing 
room, since I needed my current clothes adjusted.
Pup: (Charlotte and them don't seem... suspicious?)
I watched her and the others happily look through 
the displays.
Pup: (They do seem to be having fun... Makes me 
wonder... what would look good on them?)
I tilted my chin upwards and started to let my mind
drift as we walked.
Pup: Here you go.
I passed along my clothes through the changing 
room tarp.
Tailor: Perfect. I'll be back with a basic spare set. Then 
you can return later when the work is done.
They left and I could hear the footsteps echo off 
into the distance, so I exhaled a bit.
Slipping back into the changing room chair in just 
my under layers, I tried not to look into the mirror 
too much.
Pup: (I wonder what sort of clothes Charlotte and them 
are looking at?)
Instead, I distracted myself with an idle thought.
I tried to imagine some of them in the outfits they 
may be looking at, but...
Nothing.
Pup: (I... don't have the faintest clue of what clothes
those were.)
Pup: ...

(To be honest, I'm not even sure what they might 
be looking at.)
An itch of curiosity washed over me.
And it was in that moment that I heard footsteps
outside.
Pup: (The shopkeep is back with the temporary
clothes? That was fast.)
Standing up, I stepped over to the curtain 
and poked my head out.
Pup: Here, hand me-
Charlotte: Hand you what?
Charlotte: Some clothes?
Pup: C- Charlotte?
Mariel: Pup, we had a thought.
Charlotte: So, a little... sponsor's whim here.
Satia: No need to dance around it.
Satia: My dear Pup...
Satia: We have some outfits for you to try~
Charlotte: To say it simply, you need to try one of these 
outfits.
Pup: ...
Breath taken away, I breathed deeply as I looked 
from outfit to person.
Pup: No.
Charlotte: Oh, come on. You're waiting on the tailor to adjust
your normal outfit, so you need something to try 
on until she's done.
Pup: The shopkeep said they had some spare sets for
situations like this. Basic clothes...
Satia: Don't worry. We already told her we'd take care of it.
Charlotte: I think the shopkeep assumes we took on
that responsibility now.
Pup: W- Why did you push that set of dominoes?!
Charlotte: Come on. It's too late to take it back.
She pushed the outfit she held in my 
general direction.
Mariel: It's... more fun than you give it credit for.

Just try it the one time before you say no.
Charlotte: What sort of self proclaimed girl can't try on an
outfit?
Pup: I...
...
I pulled myself back behind the curtain.
Pup: (Dammit...)

Fine. Just... Just one of them.
Charlotte: Perfect!
Charlotte: There's a few options here.
She listed off what had been grabbed.
Something formal. 
Something flowy. 
Something with armor.
Pup: (Well, if I'm gonna try one, then I might as well...)
[Choice]: Formal Outfit / Flowy Outfit / Battle Outfit
Pup: Just... give me the formal one.

(That's... probably going to be the most normal? I
think...)
Charlotte: Good choice.
Her hand stuck through the curtain, and I 
grabbed the clothes.
Charlotte: If you need any help with a part of it, just say.
Pup: *Sigh* ...
I laid it out to get a better look.
Pup: (Hmm... It's somewhat normal but has all these 
bells and whistles. Like a noble would have.)
Pup: (Or maybe like... a diplomat or something?)
Pup: ...
Pup: Just... give me the flowy one.

(If they're gonna insist, better to go big or not at
all... I think.)
Charlotte: Good choice.
Her hand stuck through the curtain, and I 
grabbed the clothes.
Charlotte: If you need any help with a part of it, just say.
Pup: *Sigh* ...
I laid it out to get a better look.
Pup: (Hmm... It's so fancy. Like something a noble would
wear.)
Pup: (Or maybe like... a dancer or something?)
Pup: ...
Pup: Just... give me the armored one.

(If I'm gonna do this, it's best to do something I'm
more used to.)
Charlotte: Good choice.
Her hand stuck through the curtain, and I 
grabbed the clothes.
Charlotte: If you need any help with a part of it, just say.
Pup: *Sigh* ...
I laid it out to get a better look.
Pup: (Hmm... It does seem like its more meant for
mercenaries.)
Pup: (But it has so many little bells and whistles... Why is
it so... fancy?)
Pup: ...
I stared at the outfit.
On the edge of moving.
.........
On the edge... of acting...
Pup: *Sigh* ... I can't.
I folded the clothes back up again, and 
handed them out.
.........
Mariel: It's okay.
Charlotte: Oh well...
Satia: Thank you for trying, at least.
Charlotte: At least you tried. So thanks.
Charlotte: We'll have the shopkeep bring the normal 
temporary outfit now.
Pup: Thanks...
I dropped to the seat and could only exhale to try 
and relax.
The footsteps got farther away, and I did overhear 
one last thing before it went silent.
Charlotte: It went better than last time. Maybe next time, we
can...
Pup: ...
I closed my eyes.
Pup: (I am... a girl. A woman.)
Pup: (Even if I change back later, I can't get away 
from that now. But...)
It felt like a point of no return.
It wasn't that it didn't make sense that I should.
It wasn't that my own motivations didn't lead to 
the same conclusion that the girls gave.
Pup: (Maybe it was just how... feminine they felt...?)
Pup: (I sort of wished I just took Marya's offer if I was
gonna do this. It was a bit of a simpler outfit
in comparison, after all...)
Pup: ...
.........
Kara: Pup, are you in there?
Pup: (Kara...?)
Pup: Yeah. I'm here.
Kara: I feared a worse disposition.
Kara: ...after overhearing the ending earlier.
Pup: *Sigh*... Of course you did. You've got a future as 
a spy.
Kara: Did you want to try them on?
Pup: ...
Pup: No... Maybe? I don't know.
Pup: Just not... now. Not with the outfits they gave 
me.

(If I'm lucky, maybe I won't have a NEED need to 
until this is all settled and we can think about fixing 
the curse properly.)
Kara: ...
Kara: Here.
A pile of clothes was passed through the curtain.
Pup: ...?
A stepped up and took them in my hand.
Kara: That pile has the temporary outfit the shopkeep has for
customers.
Kara: It also has the outfit that Marya offered before.
Pup: ...

(What...?)
I looked at it, and as she said, the dress 
from before was under the other garment.
Pup: ...
Kara: Under no situation is there an obligation for you to
act on that in any way.
Kara: Consider it an option, though.
Pup: ...

Thank you.
Kara: I am glad to be of assistance.
With a shifting sound as though she curtsied, she 
then walked away, and the footsteps went out of 
hearing range.
Pup: ...
Pup: (How does...?)
I stepped in front of the mirror, fearful of what I
might see.
Pup: It'll be... fine.
My eyes were half closed, and my other senses 
were stronger for it.
The cool air across my smooth and exposed thighs 
was a new feeling.
The cool air across my exposed thighs was a new
feeling.
Pup: ...It's okay Anton... You're a girl now, even if its
for the time being.

You're a... a... girl...
So I opened my eyes further, and full turned 
towards the mirror.
Pup: (That's... a different person.)
I felt like I didn't recognize who I saw.
The silhouette alone took me by surprise.
From how my legs came out of the dress to how 
the corset created a shape around my waist.
Then there was the cleavage showing, and the 
small feminine details like ribbons.
And even my normal features felt new, like how 
each strand of my silky hair fell down to frame my 
face, and how that worked with the dress.
And even my normal features felt new, like my hair
framing my face with the shape the dress created.
I had looked myself over when I had last changed, 
but this... This felt different.
Even in this more modest dress... I was...
Pup: ...

...Cute.

.........
I stared, the thoughts passing through my mind 
much like how I had thought about Charlotte and 
the others trying on new outfits before.
Like it was someone else.
At least until a particular thought settled 
in my mind.
Pup: (That's... me.)
Pup: T- That's... me...?!
The dots had connected.
Pup: ...

.........

..................
I switched to the temporary outfit, though my 
heart still raced, and set the dress aside.
Pup: *Sigh*...
Pup: ...
I looked at the dress again.
I made sure to fold it carefully.
It wasn't too much longer until my normal clothes 
were tailored to fit better.
Kara: Hello, Pup.
Pup: Uh... Yeah, hey. See you back at camp.
She just smiled, and pressed no further.
I started walking away, but some words quietly 
made their way out.
Pup: Thanks... again...
Back at camp, I still had the dress in hand.
After a little hesitation, I stored it in my luggage.
Towards the bottom.
passages.content_zh:
光線的閃爍穿透了
早晨的薄霧。
在甦醒的迷糊中被光芒刺眼，我只能
聽到遠處傳來的喧鬧聲。
阿提克斯：...
夏洛特：...
我聽不清他們在說什麼，但我猜
一定發生了什麼事。
.........
瑪麗亞：抱歉，打擾一下。
小狗：...？
小狗：...哈囉？
一位女士站在我的睡袋旁，
摺疊著某種布料。
瑪麗亞：喔，我吵醒妳了嗎？真抱歉。
小狗：妳是...
小狗：（喔，等等...）

拉納瑟爾夫人。
瑪麗亞·拉納瑟爾夫人站在我面前。
阿提克斯的妻子。
瑪麗亞：我只是想早點開始收拾妳的
補給品。
小狗：為什麼...妳要這麼做？
小狗：（有人已經發現這附近的軍隊了嗎？）
我起身並打了個呵欠。
瑪麗亞：嗯...
當我跪下來開始收拾自己的睡袋時，她告訴我
誓約破壞者已經消失了。
小狗：什- 什麼？！

（在我們做了這麼多之後？！怎麼...怎麼會
發生這種事？！）
瑪麗亞：那個可愛的女孩夏洛特同意幫忙追蹤它，
作為妳們團隊努力的一部分。
小狗：是啊，我們當然可以幫忙。
我加快了捲睡袋的速度。
瑪麗亞：謝謝妳。我知道如果我丈夫知道妳們全心全意
支持他，他會很高興的。
我呼了一口氣，拉起了收好的睡袋。
小狗：當然。畢竟，如果我們不這麼做，那誰會做呢？
卡拉：在這種情況下，尤其如此。
卡拉走了過來，夏洛特緊隨其後。
夏洛特：他們怎麼會在晚上偷走它？我們都在這裡...
卡拉：如果有的話，我們是唯一有機會
找到線索的人。

盟約部署需要數週的時間
才能到達這裡開始調查。
小狗：我會把這個搬到馬那邊，然後-
我向前走了一步。
當我這麼做時...
小狗：啊...？
...我稍微踉蹌了一下。
我的衣服和睡袋有點纏在一起，
以我沒想到的方式卡住了。
小狗：我- 我這就走。
瑪麗亞：喔，我的天啊，妳還好嗎？

妳完全被那身衣服淹沒了...
夏洛特：喔，妳也注意到了？

Charlotte: Oh, you noticed, too?
Marya: Sweetie, I can offer you something that may fit better,

Kara: That was not what I said.
Pup: Ah...
Marya: It really is no trouble. If anything getting rid of

Pup: I- I don't-
Charlotte grabbed the sleeping bag...
Charlotte: Pup. Take the offer.
Charlotte: It really is at a point where one wrong move and you

Pup: I just... need to adjust the tailoring again a little.

Charlotte: You know what? Want me to bribe you "a little" instead?

What about some sweets at the next village?

Charlotte: Kara and I have probably tried things you've never even

Pup: I mean....
I shook my head.
Pup: N- No! Of course I'm not gonna get bought with a little

###### If Not

Pup: I'm not one of your schoolgirl classmates from when you

Kara: You may be surprised by how delectable some offerings

No means no.
STAGE DIRECTION> ###############
Charlotte: Well, then that just means you're doing it for free.

that fit me.

Kara: Why would your wardrobe be an exception?
Charlotte: Oh yeah, nice catch.

All of sudden, I was pulled forward a little.
Charlotte swiftly took the sleeping bag while I was
distracted.
Pup: Hey!
Charlotte: No more excuses. Just go make sure you're not gonna get

Pup: But I'm not gonna-
And this time, I felt a grip on my gambeson.
Marya: Oh, it won't take long, dear. Trust me.
Now a tug, only for the scene in front of my to start
getting father away.
Charlotte: We'll get everything ready to go.
Kara: ...

STAGE DIRECTION> FADE MUSIC VERY SLOWLY
STAGE DIRECTION> FADE TO BLACK BG

Entering the Vault's dormitory halls, I could only

Pup: (They got me roped into this again...)

Marya: ...and then Xavier joined Lefen on his quest. I am

and sound.

Add to that, Euna and Pelus actually have time to visit

Marya guided me through the halls, and quickly found

Pup: (I guess it must have been a while since she had

Pup: (But... to immediately start talking about your

Marya: Ah, if only you could meet. I'm sure Euna could help

Though maybe the mother's touch has gotten to her sense

I really must go out there to see my grandson again.
Pup: (Are all mother's like this?)
Marya: Ah, sorry. Maybe I'm getting a bit off topic?
Pup: Haha... It's no worry. You seem so excited about it

Marya: I suppose so! I am just going off on my own tangents.

You'll understand once you're a mother.
Pup: ...
Pup: ...
I stopped.
Pup: (What did she... say...? Did I mishear her...?)
Marya: And here it is.
Not far in front of my stopped location, she opened a
door.
Pup: (I...)
Pup: I- I must have misheard her... 
Clears throat
...
So I stepped through the door.
STAGE DIRECTION> FADE TO BG HOUSE (DAY)
Marya: Tada!
It was a dress! I wasn't surprised.
Marya: Euna always looked so cute in it when she wore it. And

Pup: Your... daughter's... dress...?
Marya: I'm sure she won't mind. It was among the wardrobe she

Pup: I- I'm not sure I could work with a dress. It is a

Marya: Are you sure? I saw multiple of your allies wearing

Pup: Haha... haha... I'm sure... they're just more used to

Pup: It'd be much safer for me to just get this old thing

I backed away towards the door.
Marya: There are other outfits I can-
Pup: Oh, I think it'd be too much of me to ask for your

Pup: Y- You really don't have to worry about it.
Marya: If... you insist.
As I was one foot out the door, I tried to not look her

Pup: It... really was nice hearing about your family.
I gave a brief but sincere smile, and hurried my way

She crossed her arms and sighed like a disappointed

Kara, watching me as I hurriedly headed back, stepped

...

Luckily, signs of our pursuers from the Cartenan

We had time.

Charlotte: I can't believe you didn't take the damn outfit.

It wasn't long until we were at the base of the

I tried to imagine some of them in the outfits they may

Nothing.

An itch of curiosity washed over me.

STAGE DIRECTION> ...

...

STAGE DIRECTION>

...

Pup: ...
STAGE DIRECTION>

...

On the edge of moving.
STAGE DIRECTION> FADE MUSIC VERY SLOWLY

... I can't.

STAGE DIRECTION> .........

STAGE DIRECTION> ############

... Of course you did. You've got a future as a
spy.

Pup: ...
Pup: No... Maybe? I don't know.
Pup: Just not... now. Not with the outfits they gave me.

(If I'm lucky, maybe I won't have a NEED need to until

Kara: ...
Kara: Here.
A pile of clothes was passed through the curtain.
Pup: ...?
A stepped up and took them in my hand.
Kara: That pile has the temporary outfit the shopkeep has for
customers.
Kara: It also has the outfit that Marya offered before.
Pup: ...

(What...?)
I looked at it, and as she said, the dress from before

Pup: ...
Kara: Under no situation is there an obligation for you to

Kara: Consider it an option, though.
Pup: ...

Thank you.

Pup: ...

My eyes were half closed, and my other senses were

##### If no body hair TF
The cool air across my smooth and exposed thighs was a

##### If not
The cool air across my exposed thighs was a new
feeling.
STAGE DIRECTION> ##############
Pup: ...It's okay Anton... You're a girl now, even if its

You're a... a... girl...
So I opened my eyes further, and full turned towards

Pup: (That's... a different person.)

The silhouette alone took me by surprise.
From how my legs came out of the dress to how the
corset created a shape around my waist.
Then there was the cleavage showing, and the small
feminine details like ribbons.
####### If silky hair TF
And even my normal features felt new, like how each
strand of my silky hair fell down to frame my face, and
how that worked with the dress.
##### If not
And even my normal features felt new, like my hair
framing my face with the shape the dress created.
STAGE DIRECTION> ###############
I had looked myself over when I had last changed, but
this... This felt different.
Even in this more modest dress... I was...
Pup: ...

...Cute.

.........
I stared, the thoughts passing through my mind much
like how I had thought about Charlotte and the others
trying on new outfits before.
Like it was someone else.
At least until a particular thought settled in my mind.
Pup: (That's... me.)
STAGE DIRECTION> REMOVE NARRATION AND DIALOGUE

Pup: T- That's... me...?!
The dots had connected.
Pup: ...

.........

..................

STAGE DIRECTION> WAIT 60 FRAMES
STAGE DIRECTION> CHANGING CLOTHES SE
STAGE DIRECTION> WAIT 150 FRAMES

I switched to the temporary outfit, though my heart
still raced, and set the dress aside.
Pup: Sigh
...
Pup: ...
I looked at the dress again.
I made sure to fold it carefully.
STAGE DIRECTION> FADE MUSIC VERY SLOWLY
STAGE DIRECTION> FADE TO BLACK BG
It wasn't too much longer until my normal clothes were
tailored to fit better.
STAGE DIRECTION> WAIT 90 FRAMES
STAGE DIRECTION> FADE TO BG VILLAGE (DAY)
