Kara: Hello, Pup.
Pup: Uh... Yeah, see you.
She just smiled, and pressed no further.
I started walking away, but some words quietly made
their way out.
Pup: Thanks... again...
STAGE DIRECTION> FADE TO BLACK BG
Back at camp, I still had the dress in hand.
After a little hesitation, I stored it in my luggage.
Towards the bottom.

passages.content:
Our group reached the western border of the 
Kingdom of Cartenan.
Pup: Ugh...
Satia: Here, Pup. Just hold on and try to get your energy
back.
Norde: Anton... It'll be...
Carried from the battlefield, I had only recently
stopped slipping in and out of consciousness.
My exhaustion from the fight and the effects of the
curse had hit me hard.
Rowan: I'll admit, even I'm at a bit of a loss.
Kara: For now... regrouping feels like the apt step to take.
Norde: All of our group was scattered in the retreat. Crows
and otherwise.
Norde: We'll need to find a safe place to regroup soon if 
we hope to reform.
Charlotte: Is it... safe to stop here?
Kara: Hmm...

Sir Norde. How are the effects of that curse for 
you?
Norde: ...Manageable.
Norde adjusted his equipment as though he was 
insecure about what might be beneath.
Norde: At least with your concoction. It assisted at staving
off the worst, if just for a time.
Kara: Be careful with attempting to hold it back too 
much.
Kara eyed over to me.
Kara: It seems resistance can have more... explosive 
changes, if the cards play out that way.
Norde: Hmm...
Rowan: All the more reason to establish this 'regrouping
point' sooner over later.
Charlotte: Any ideas, Kara? You know the Kingdom better 
than anyone.
Kara: A few... potentially viable options come to mind.
Charlotte: Works for me. Let's do one of those.

How about you all in the Crows?
Does it sound agreeable?
Norde: It'll be-
Pup: ...F- fine... We'll be... fine to keep going.

If there's a better place to stop, then... then...

Argh...
I started to fall over as my consciousness slipped 
for a second.
Rowan: Are you okay?
I had fallen in a pile of snow,
and Rowan went to help me up.

Between the newfound winter and our 
group reaching the edge of the mountain
range, it was all over the place.
Norde: ...

Ignore Anton. We can follow your lead. Choose 
what you think is best.
Pup: Ugh...
Kara led us to a nearby cave.
She told us that it was an old mine used as a 
hidden reserve for military operations.
At least, I thought she did. My mind was still foggy 
as I tried to force myself to keep moving forward.
Pup: Ah...
Resting against a wall, my face felt flush and hot.
Pup: Mmm...

O- Okay... What... What next...?
My voice echoed.
As did the drip of water from my clothes. 

The snow was melting quickly.
Kara: I can organize the regrouping.

It'd give me opportunity to organize some of the
stragglers of the kingdom's forces as well.
Pup: Then I can...
Satia: No.
Charlotte: Nope.
I didn't have the wherewithal to argue.
Norde: Then, I can focus on the Crows and...
Rowan: ...let me know all about what I'll need to do to get
our supply situation sorted out, yes?
Rowan: Some of us... more than one... could stand to not 
exert themselves too much at this time.
Norde: ...

Fine.
Rowan: Then let us discuss the plans for my merry little 
jaunt of a 'supply run', shall we?
Rowan and Norde moved away from the group.
Charlotte: I can stay back, then.
Pup: I... I don't... I don't need...
Charlotte: Shush.

Your jacket is soaked. Here, let me help with that.
Satia: Thank you, Charlotte.
Satia: I'll focus on seeing what options we have for bedding.
That cave wall doesn't look the most comfortable.
Kara: It sounds as though we've all put ourselves in 
motion.

I'll try to be swift in my own endeavors, then.
Charlotte: I'm trusting my sister to you. Tell her hello when 
her group catches up.
Kara: That I can do.
With a nod to Charlotte and everyone, Kara headed 
out of the cave.
Charlotte: Now... where were we?

Strip.
Pup: Ah...?!
My feverish mind was getting a bit tipsy and loopy 
as Charlotte reached for me.
Pup: W- What are you...!?
Charlotte: We need to get you out of those wet clothes.
She said as much, but I got distracted by the drip 
of water from my gambeson to the cave floor.
Soon enough, it was off. That piece was, at least.
Charlotte: Oh, uh...
Charlotte: *Clears throat*
Pup: Huh...?
Charlotte: N- Nothing. Not sure what I was expecting, 
just... uh...
Charlotte: Y- Yeah, don't worry about it.
Pup: ...
Pup: ...it's cold...
Charlotte: Yeah, that's sort of how it works when the 
greenest nation in the world gets a sudden onset 
winter.
...
Charlotte: ...Okay, now I made myself sad.
Charlotte: I... should probably get some kindling to start a fire.

Your clothes aren't going to dry anytime soon
otherwise.
Charlotte grabbed the snow soaked gambeson and 
moved it to the place she planned to set up a fire.
Charlotte: Stay here. I need to find some dry wood.
Pup: (...wood...?!)
Charlotte turned the corner of the cave as my mind
tried to process the words she said.
I couldn't quite understand it myself, but I was
distinctly in a daze from the exhaustion and an
oncoming sickness.
Pup: (Wood... WOOD... wood...)

(What did she mean by...?)
Pup: Oh, wait...
Pup: (Didn't she say something about stripping?)

...
Without another thought, my hand reached to the 
buttons on my damp shirt.
Pup: ...

(...boob...?)
I had been distracted and had forgotten the task I 
set out to do.
Pup: (Shit, these are... way too big to try to hide from
anyone anymore.)
The breast that popped out my shirt was notable. 
It encapsulated much my view when I tried to look 
down.
Pup: (I think it broke the binding I was using...)
Pup: (Fuck... fuck fuck fuck...)
Pup: ...
Despite my beleaguered thoughts, my mind 
couldn't stay focused on the topic.
Pup: Ah...?!
As I shuffled around in frustration, the weight on 
my chest shifted and a slight tingling could be felt.
A slight tingling that, when combined with my
sick status, made me hyperfocus on the feeling.
Pup: (That... That felt... sort of...)

...
...

...........

.....................
Pup: "Boop"...
Taking one of my fingers, I had lightly pressed in 
the nipple on my exposed breast like it was a 
button.
Pup: Mmm...

...boop...
I did it a few more times as I found myself mildly
amused and mildly excited by the whole thing.
As I went, I eventually shifted into just massaging
the breast... my mind still hyperfocused on each
sensation.
Pup: Mmm...

(This may require further investigation.)

(I need to... be able to get at them more easily...)
My hands started to move to remove the rest of 
my shirt.
.........
Charlotte: Hmm...?
Charlotte: Ah! Wait, what are you-? Don't...
Charlotte: What are you...  *Sigh* ...

Your jacket was the main thing that got soaked. 
You don't need to remove your shirt...
Charlotte quickly helped me get my shirt 
back in place.
Charlotte: *Sigh* ... I guess worse stuff could've happened.
Pup: Was I in danger...?
Charlotte: I mean... no, but...
Charlotte: W- Who knows what sort of dangerous... stuff... 
you could've drawn this way?
Pup: ...

(I guess that makes sense.)

(With the curse, anything is a threat... I think...)
At least, my fevered mind didn't want to think 
deeply on it enough to find an objection.
Charlotte: *Clears throat* ... Anyways, let's get that fire 
started, shall we?
As Charlotte went over to the designated firepit, 
one other person slowly turned the corner.
Norde: ...
His movement indicated a level of tiredness similar 
to my own.
He quickly found his own comfortable place on the 
wall, and slid down to sit against the cave wall 
much like I had.
Norde: Mmm...
Pup: Mmm...
Norde: I see you've progressed another stage... in all 
manners of ways...
Pup: At least open your eyes when you're gonna say "I 
see" about shit...
Norde: Mmm...
Pup: You know what? Why... Why aren't you changing?
Pup: Not even a bit after all this time...?
Norde: ...
Norde repositioned himself slightly.
Without opening his eyes, he curled up a little more
like a turtle entering its shell.
Norde: Better self control.
Pup: Hah... Okay...

Wanna get into that time with the village girl when
you-
Charlotte: And let's stop that there!
Charlotte whipped her head in our direction.
Charlotte: Let's just calm down and rest, shall we? We have 
more important things to focus on.

Last thing we need is for you two to bicker like
siblings to the point of fighting.

Hmm... I might need to put your weapons further 
away...
As Charlotte jumped back into her tasks, the 
thought dwelled in my mind.
Pup: (Self control my ass. Norde is just...)

...
I glared a bit at Norde, looking over him for any 
signs of changes.
Pup: ...

(You know... With everything that happened...
What all actually changed? I haven't had a chance 
to check what's happened to my body...)
My mind was calming and stabilizing a bit.
As it did, I realized I hadn't really assessed myself.
At least, not beyond the thing that stood front and
center when I tried to look down.
Pup: Hmm...
In my sitting position, I squirmed around a little as I
felt around my feverishly sensitive new existence.
Pup: (Breasts, of course...)

(My hair seems a lot longer, too)

(My voice feels a bit different...)
Pup: (Hard to tell anything about my height from here, 
but I wouldn't be surprised...)
Pup: (And then there's... down there... Did that...
change...?)
After thinking about it, I decided to look more 
into...
[Choice]: Test out my voice more / Play with my hair / Check my crotch area
passages.content_zh:
我們的隊伍抵達了卡特南王國的西部邊境。
Pup: 嗚...
Satia: 來，Pup。撐住，試著恢復體力。
Norde: 安東... 他會...
我從戰場上被抬下來，直到最近才停止斷斷續續地失去意識。
戰鬥的疲憊和詛咒的影響重創了我。
Rowan: 我承認，連我都有些不知所措。
Kara: 目前... 重整旗鼓似乎是恰當的一步。
Norde: 我們所有的隊員都在撤退中走散了。烏鴉們和其他人也是。
Norde: 如果我們希望重組，就需要盡快找到一個安全的地方重整旗鼓。
Charlotte: 在這裡停下來... 安全嗎？
Kara: 嗯...

諾德爵士。那個詛咒對你的影響如何？
Norde: ...還能控制。
Norde調整了他的裝備，彷彿對裝備下的東西感到不安。
Norde: 至少有妳的藥劑。它幫助我暫時擋住了最糟糕的情況。
Kara: 小心別試圖過度壓制它。
Kara看著我。
Kara: 如果情況發展成那樣，抵抗似乎會帶來更... 爆炸性的變化。
Norde: 嗯...
Rowan: 這更有理由盡早建立這個「重整點」。
Charlotte: 有什麼想法嗎，卡拉？妳比任何人都更了解這個王國。
Kara: 我想到了一些... 可能可行的選項。
Charlotte: 我沒問題。我們就選一個吧。

烏鴉們，你們覺得如何？
聽起來可以接受嗎？
Norde: 我會-
Pup: ...沒... 沒事... 我們... 我們可以繼續走。

如果這裡不是個好地方，那... 那...

呃...
我開始倒下，意識瞬間模糊。
Rowan: 你還好嗎？
我倒在雪堆裡，
Rowan上前扶我起來。

由於新出現的寒冬和我們的
隊伍抵達山脈邊緣，一切都亂了套。
Norde: ...

別管安東。我們可以聽妳的。選擇妳認為最好的。
Pup: 嗚...
Kara帶我們到附近的一個洞穴。
她告訴我們，那是一個舊礦坑，曾被用作隱藏的儲備地。

passages.name: Supply Run Ch8-9 - Dip
passages.content:
Pup: Ho... Hi... Whom... Hum...?
Pup: "The great and respected King Minae had two 
subjects placed before him."

"Each claimed paren-"
Pup: "...parenta- parentage of a baby."
The different feel of the voice and my feverish 
state started making me slur and stumble over 
words by the end.
That may be my limit.
Charlotte: Everything... okay?
Pup: N- Nothing... Just... repeating a story...

...just... testing stuff...
I mumbled out those parts, but as of now it 
definitely did feel like my voice had gone up in 
pitch.
I never had a deep voice, but now it'd be hard to
mistake it as a guy's voice when you saw me.
Pup: (Maybe if someone wasn't seeing me, then they 
wouldn't be able to tell?)
Charlotte: I think it sounds nice.
Pup: Huh?
Charlotte: Your new voice, I mean.

It still sounds like you, but... maybe a little more
soothing.
Pup: ...
Pup: Mmm...
I didn't know what to say.
Or maybe I just didn't want to talk any more.
passages.content_zh:
小狗：嗬……嗨……誰……嗯……？
小狗：「偉大而受人尊敬的米那國王有兩個
擺在他面前的科目。 」

“每個聲稱的父母-”
小狗：“...parenta- 嬰兒的親子關係。”
聲音的不同感覺和我的發燒
狀態開始讓我口齒不清並跌倒
到最後的話。
這可能就是我的極限了。
夏洛特：一切……好嗎？
Pup：沒-沒什麼...只要...重複一個故事...

....只是...測試東西...
我含糊地說出了這些部分，但到目前為止
確實感覺我的聲音提高了
音調。
我從來沒有低沉的聲音，但現在很難了
當你看到我時，誤以為這是男人的聲音。
Pup：（也許如果有人沒有看到我，那麼他們
會不會說不出來？ ）
夏洛特：我覺得聽起來不錯。
小狗：啊？
夏洛特：我是說，你的新聲音。

聽起來仍然像你，但是…也許更多一點
舒緩。
小狗：…
小狗：嗯…
我不知道該說什麼。
或許我只是不想再說話了。

passages.name: Supply Run Ch8-9 - Cha
passages.content:
My hand guided itself through the strands of 
hair dangling down along my chest.
Pup: (So much longer...)
The feeling of my hands gliding along the 
silky smooth hair was relaxing, though.
Pup: Mmm...
The feeling of playing with my hair had 
something of a relaxing effect, though.
Pup: Hmm...
Pup: Heh...
As I did, my mind changed gears.
I started to swing it around like a sword.
A toy sword, at least.
Pup: ...Hah! Heheh~
Charlotte: Hm?
Charlotte: You okay?
Pup: Y- Yeah...
Pup: J- Just... Stuff...
Embarrassed, I stuffed my hair back to 
where it was.
Charlotte: *Giggle*...
Charlotte turned back to her task.
As she did, I shook my head some and felt the long 
hair shake and flutter across my neck and such.
Pup: ...
Charlotte: It looks nice, if you're worried.
Pup: Hm?
Charlotte: Your hair. It has a pretty shade with that length.
Pup: I...

(W- What is she saying?!)
I turtled myself up a little.

My already hot head felt like it was burning
for a few seconds after she said that.
passages.content_zh:
我的手不受控制地穿梭在垂落在胸前的髮絲中。
Pup: (變得這麼長了...)
手滑過絲滑柔順頭髮的感覺，卻很放鬆。
Pup: 嗯...
玩弄頭髮的感覺，確實有種放鬆的效果。
Pup: 嗯...
Pup: 呵呵...
當我這麼做時，我的思緒轉變了。
我開始像揮舞劍一樣甩動它。
至少是玩具劍。
Pup: ...哈！ 呵呵呵～
Charlotte: 嗯？
Charlotte: 你還好嗎？
Pup: 呃- 嗯...
Pup: 只- 只是... 一些事...
我感到尷尬，趕緊把頭髮塞回原位。
Charlotte: *咯咯*...
Charlotte轉回頭繼續做她的事。
當她轉身時，我搖了搖頭，感覺長髮在我的脖子上搖晃和飄動。
Pup: ...
Charlotte: 如果你很擔心，它看起來很棒。
Pup: 嗯？
Charlotte: 你的頭髮。那個長度讓它有很美的色澤。
Pup: 我...

(什- 她在說什麼啊?!)
我有點縮起身子。

在她說完那些話後，我已經發燙的頭感覺好像燒了起來，持續了幾秒鐘。

passages.name: Supply Run Ch8-9 - Dir
passages.content:
Pup: Mm...!

(I should... I have to...)
I positioned my hands to take a peek.
Hesitating, my feverish mind started to fill my
thoughts with more ridiculous imaginings.
The image crossed my mind's eye of it turning 
towards me and snapping at me like a snake.
Then one image was of something akin to a 
dried, shriveled up cucumber.
Another felt like it might just fall off if I looked at
it wrong.
Pup: ...!
I peeked!
Pup: ...!
It was smaller.
Pup: ...
Pup: (IT'S SMALLER?!)
Charlotte: Hahah...
Charlotte: ...I think.
Pup: Ah..?!
The peephole to within my bottom side coverings 
snapped shut.
Charlotte: You... Y- You don't need to worry so much 
about... ah...
Charlotte: ....just... try to rest.

You may find others care less about it than you 
may think...
Pup: ...
Pup: Huh?
She turned away from me as we both blushed 
up a storm.
Pup: Mmm...
Thinking on it, I hadn't been able to tell if it was
smaller after the previous change.
But this time the change felt unmistakable.
passages.content_zh:
小狗：嗯……！

（我應該…我必須…）
我伸出雙手來偷看。
猶豫著，我的腦袋開始充滿了狂熱。
想法與更荒謬的想像。
畫面在我腦海中閃過，它正在轉動
向我衝來，像一條蛇一樣向我猛咬。
然後一張圖像類似於
乾枯的黃瓜。
另一個感覺如果我看的話它可能會掉下來
錯了。
小狗：……！
我偷看了！
小狗：……！
它更小。
小狗：…
小狗：（變小了？！）
夏洛特：哈哈…
夏洛特：……我想。
小狗：啊..？ ！
我底部覆蓋物內的窺視孔
啪地一聲關上了。
夏綠蒂：你...你-你不用擔心那麼多
關於……啊……
夏洛特：……只是……試著休息一下。

你可能會發現其他人比你更不關心它
可能會認為...
小狗：…
小狗：啊？
她轉身離開我，我們都臉紅了
掀起一場風暴。
小狗：嗯…
想來想去，我也分不清是不是
上次更改後較小。
但這次的變化是顯而易見的。

passages.name: Supply Run Ch8-9 - New Event
passages.content:
Charlotte: *Clears throat*
Charlotte: There's the fire going now.

I'll grab a blanket for you. I think I saw one around
the corner.
Charlotte turned the corner and circled back to me.
Charlotte: Here we are, one for each of you.
Norde: ...

...zzzz...
The light snore from Norde made it clear that
sleep had taken him.
Charlotte set the blanket on him without 
waking him.
Charlotte: Now, you...
Charlotte: Hmm... You really should get a new set of clothes 
at this rate.

Your gambeson is one thing, but the rest is more
sticking to you because its damp.

It's really starting to get tight and loose in all the
wrong places.
Pup: I guess it can be a bit hard to move around in. I 
could get something...?
Charlotte: I wonder what color would go well with your hair 
like is now?
Pup: Well, I always liked-
Pup: Ah... no...
Pup: N- No... I... I'm sticking with these.
Clutching to the collar of my shirt, I held on
tightly to the thing I still had control over.
Charlotte: Hmm... Then maybe we can get it tailored so it fits...
a little better, at least?
Pup: I... I can't just give up. I need to be able to turn
back to normal.
Charlotte: Right...
Charlotte shifted and sat next to me.
Pup: I need to hold the fort until.... until my father...
until he...
Pup: ...
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte leaned against my blanketed body, 
resting her head on my shoulder.
Pup: *Pant* ...  *pant* ...
With me having snapped back to the present, I 
panted a little in a slight panic.
The silence continued with us together, and I 
started to calm down some.
Pup: ...
I looked over at Norde, another inflicted by this.
Pup: Maybe... Maybe it's all pointless...
I muttered it under my breath.
Charlotte: It's not.
Charlotte: In Lockhart, you saved people. In Cartenan, you 
saved people.

Even in this predicament we find ourselves in... 
we're still helping. You're still helping.
Pup: ...
I breathed in deeply. I didn't have words.
Charlotte: After everything that has happened...

...I get the feeling of losing... 
those close to you... I get that.
Charlotte: But even after all that, you can still keep moving
forward, right?

For yourself, and for everyone else.
Pup: ...

You think?
Charlotte: I've found the thought helps.

It's true, at least. That much I can say from
experience.

Eyes facing forward, and take it one step at a time.
Pup: Yeah...
It was something I intrinsically knew.
She didn't have to tell me.
I had been told it by my father... by Norde... by
Satia... by everyone in the Crows.
Pup: (I make for a pretty poor mercenary sometimes...)
I felt like sleep was starting to take me.
Pup: One... step... at a time...
I slumped over and found the top of Charlotte head,
still resting on my shoulder, to rest on with my own.
And finally let myself... sleep.
passages.content_zh:
夏洛特：*清清喉嚨*
夏洛特：現在著火了。

我去給你拿一條毯子。我想我在周圍看到一個
角落裡。
夏洛特轉過街角，繞回我身邊。
夏洛特：我們來了，給你們每人一份。
諾德：…

...zzzz...
諾德的輕微鼾聲清楚地表明
他睡著了。
夏洛特不費吹灰之力就把毯子蓋在他身上
叫醒他。
夏洛特：現在，你...
夏綠蒂：嗯……你真的應該買一套新衣服
按照這個速度。

你的甘伯森是一回事，但其餘的更重要
因為潮濕而黏在你身上。

一切真的開始變得緊繃和鬆散
錯誤的地方。
小狗：我想在裡面走動可能有點困難。我
能得到一些東西...？
夏綠蒂：我想知道什麼顏色適合你的頭髮
就像現在一樣？
Pup：嗯，我一直都喜歡──
小狗：啊……不……
Pup：不-不...我...我堅持這些。
我緊緊抓住襯衫領子
緊緊抓住我仍然可以控制的事情。
夏綠蒂：嗯...那麼也許我們可以量身定制它，使其合身...
至少好一點？
Pup：我……我不能就這麼放棄。我需要能夠轉身
恢復正常。
夏洛特：對…
夏洛特挪了挪身子，坐在我旁邊。
Pup：我需要堅守陣地，直到…直到我父親…
直到他...
小狗：…
夏洛特：…
夏洛特靠在我蓋著毯子的身上，
她的頭靠在我的肩膀上。
小狗：*喘氣* ... *喘氣* ...
當我回到現在時，我
略顯驚慌地喘息著。
我們一起繼續沉默，而我
開始平靜一些。
小狗：…
我看著諾德，另一個受此影響的人。
Pup：也許……也許這一切都毫無意義……
我低聲嘀咕道。
夏洛特：不是的。
夏洛特：在洛哈特，你拯救了人們。在卡特南，你
救了人。

即使在這種困境中，我們也發現自己處於...
我們仍在提供協助。你還在幫忙。
小狗：…
我深深地吸了一口氣。我無話可說。
夏洛特：在發生了這一切之後…

……我有一種失落的感覺……

passages.name: Supply Run Ch9-10 - Begining
passages.content:
Pup: And...
Pup: ...there!
The hilt of my sheathed sword slammed down, 
and the stake was set into the ground. 

The tent should be stable now.
Pup: Ahh...~
That was the last one needed.
Charlotte: *Exhale*... How do you guys do this all the time?
Pup: It's super easy, barely an...
Pup: ...barely an... inconvenience...

...

*Sigh*...
I tried to stand tall, but I was wavering.
Charlotte: Well, I'm not used to it, but you could really use 
some rest, too.
Pup: I said already that I'm fine.

Most of the way to being a girl or not, whatever. 

I just need to focus on the task at hand 
and I can...
Pup: ...and I can...
Charlotte: Sure.

And I wonder if you're hiding any injuries behind 
that mask?
Pup: Charlotte, you don't need to-
Charlotte: Go get a health check before your rest.
Pup: My time would be better spent-
Charlotte: Consider that a directive of your client.
Pup: Ack...
Charlotte: I am really starting to love those magic words~
Charlotte poked at the tip of her nose with a big of
arrogant bravado.
Charlotte: That said, I am serious.

Go get checked out before too long.

We can't have...
Charlotte: ... *Yaawnnnn* ... can't...
Charlotte: ...can't have you bleeding out internally as you
sleep...
Charlotte's words trailed off as she started to drag
herself away to go and rest.
Pup: Hmmm...

(Well, if she's asleep, I can just tell her I did.)
But the faint voice of Charlotte's words managed to
reach me from where she had walked to.
Charlotte: Kara, you took your rest already, right?
Pup: (Kara, but she isn't here right now?)
And so Charlotte continued away from where I 
was...
.........
And so did the tents...
Pup: (Why are the tents...?)
I turned my head.
Kara: Hello, dear Baranov.
I was being dragged.
Pup: I...
Pup: ...
Pup: *Sigh*...
Pup: (Let's just get this over with...)
We arrived in the medical tent with Kara 
as the lead.
Kara: Hello? Is anyone...
Kara stepped in only to find an empty tent.
No one was there.

Pup: (I... It's not... weird for me to be in here at this
point... yeah?)

(Not technically...?)

...
I stood there, hesitating...
Pup: Sigh
...
Pup: Fuck it.
I took the first step forward, and I took it defiantly.
Pup: (It's fine for me to be here.)

(It'd be weirder if I hesitated too much.)

(All I need to do is be decisive!)
I kept taking the steps forward.
One step into another.
And another
And once more after that.
STAGE DIRECTION> WAIT 130 FRAME
STAGE DIRECTION> HIT LEG ON FURNITURE SOUND EFFECT
STAGE DIRECTION> FADE MUSIC VERY SLOWLY
STAGE DIRECTION> WAIT 180 FRAMES
Pup: ...?!
My shin banged into a storage chest. I hadn't seen it
through my focus on moving forward.
Female Crow: Huh, what was that?
Eyes shifted my way.
Female Crow: You alright?
Pup: Mmm...

...Yeah.
I side stepped in a robotic manner, and the chest was
no longer in my way.
Pup: ...

(N- No... No hesitation...!)
STAGE DIRECTION> RUNNING AWAY SE
STAGE DIRECTION> WAIT 120 FRAMES
STAGE DIRECTION>
##################################################
########### End of Choices
STAGE DIRECTION> FADE TO BLACK BG
STAGE DIRECTION> WAIT 150 FRAMES
STAGE DIRECTION> TENT FLAP SE
STAGE DIRECTION> WAIT 100 FRAMES
I stepped into the storage area.
Immediately, I gasped for air and tried to calm my
beating heart.
Pup: Pant
... 
pant
...

(I did it...?)
Pup: (I- I did it!)
I gave myself a slight internal hurrah.
Pup: (What sort of big deal was I making out of that?)
With a small chuckle at my own silliness, I started to
look around.
It wasn't long until...
Pup: Here it is.
So I started to head back with my head held high.
STAGE DIRECTION> WAIT 60 FRAMES
STAGE DIRECTION> TENT FLAP SE
STAGE DIRECTION> WAIT 200 FRAMES
Charlotte: ...
Pup: ...
Charlotte: Why are you here?
Pup: Why are you naked?
Charlotte: I...
Charlotte: It's the bathing tent...!

Close your eyes and follow me.
Pup: Y- Yes ma'am!
STAGE DIRECTION> WAIT 180 FRAMES
STAGE DIRECTION> PLAY BGM PERITUNE VERDURE_LOOP
STAGE DIRECTION> FADE TO BG DLC CAMP_INSIDE (DAY)
STAGE DIRECTION> TENT FLAP SE
STAGE DIRECTION> WAIT 80 FRAMES
Charlotte: I caught your prey.
Kara: I thought you were heading to bed, Charlotte?
Charlotte: AFTER getting rid of that layer of sweat, yes...
Kara: I had a feeling Anton might've found his way there.
Charlotte: Giving you much trouble, then?
Kara: In fact, he was just helping me get an extra medical
probe.
Charlotte: Was that it?
Pup: I- I told you.
Kara: Not that I asked him, too.

Let alone asked him to enter that tent.
Charlotte: ...So why were you in that tent...?
Pup: She just said...
Pup: Argh...

W- Why were you wearing your hat in the bathing tent?!
Charlotte: ...
STAGE DIRECTION> SMACK SE, WAIT 70 FRAMES
What followed was a distinct and hard slap to the back
of my head.
Pup: H- Hey...!
Charlotte: Hmm...
Kara: Every lady has their secrets, Anton.

You wouldn't ask to look under my skirt, would you?
Pup: I... I mean...?!
Flabbergasted, I stood there speechless.
STAGE DIRECTION> TENT FLAP SE, WAIT 90 FRAMES
######## If mariel alive
Mariel: Hey, Kara, I found my extra probe and-
Mariel: Huh...?
Mariel walked into the awkward situation.
Kara: I should mention that Mariel arrived shortly after
Anton left.
Mariel: ...
My position was in a distinctly... submissive one
relative to Charlotte. I was bending over after her
smack.
Mariel: I... Well, maybe I should wait outside?
Charlotte: No!

All of us. Together in here. Now!
Mariel: ...
Mariel: Sis...? Are you... okay?
######## If not
Lady Kara, I was able to get the extra probe to-
A fellow Nightless Crow, a medical professional,
stepped into the odd sight.
I was bent over from the smack to the head.
Sigh
... Kids these days.

Just make sure you disinfect the place when you're
done, okay?
STAGE DIRECTION> #############################
STAGE DIRECTION> REMOVE ALL DIALOGUE BOXES
STAGE DIRECTION> .........
Kara: Perhaps I should clear something up here?
STAGE DIRECTION> FADE TO BLACK BG
After the misunderstanding was settled, we were able to
have me examined properly.
The result? No internal bleeding.
But I was diagnosed with exhaustion.
##### If mariel alive
Mariel: Try to get some sleep, okay?
Pup: I've been trying...
##### If not
Make sure you get rest.
Pup: That's what I've been saying...
STAGE DIRECTION> ###############
STAGE DIRECTION> FADE OUT MUSIC VERY SLOWLY
STAGE DIRECTION> WAIT 60 FRAMES
STAGE DIRECTION> FADE TO BLACK
STAGE DIRECTION> GIVE ITEMS FOR SUPPLY RUN COMPLETION
STAGE DIRECTION> RETURN TO CAMP MENU END

passages.name: Supply Run Ch11-12 - Begining
passages.content:
The fluttering rays of light filtered through the
morning haze.
Blinded by it in the awakening daze, I could only 
hear the ruckus of something from afar.
Atticus: ...
Charlotte: ...
I couldn't make out words, but I assumed 
something had happened.
.........
Marya: Apologies, but excuse me.
Pup: ...?
Pup: ...Hello?
A woman was standing over my sleeping bag,
folding some sort of a fabric.
Marya: Oh, did I wake you? I'm so sorry.
Pup: Who are...
Pup: (Oh wait...)

Mrs. Ranasseur.
Mrs. Marya Ranasseur was standing over me. 
Atticus's wife.
Marya: I was just getting an early start on rolling up your
supplies here.
Pup: Why... would you do that?
Pup: (Did someone spot the army in the area already?)
I picked myself up and yawned.
Marya: Well...
As I knelt down to start collecting my own sleeping
bag, she told me about how the Oathbreaker was 
gone.
Pup: W- What?!

(After everything we did?! How did... How did that
happen?!)
Marya: That sweet girl Charlotte agreed to help track it 
down as part of your group's efforts.
Pup: Yeah, of course we can help.
I quickened my rolling of the sleeping bag.
Marya: Thank you. I know it would do my husband's heart 
good to know you have his back wholeheartedly.
With a huff, I pulled the stored sleeping bag up.
Pup: Of course. After all, if we don't, then who will?
Kara: In this case, especially.
Kara approached, with Charlotte not far behind her.
Charlotte: How did they get it in the night? We were all here...
Kara: If there's a trail to follow, we're the only ones with
a shot of finding that lead.

It would be weeks before a Covenant deployment
could be here to start an investigation.
Pup: I'll carry this over to the horses and-
I stepped forward.
As I did...
Pup: Ah...?
...I stumbled a little.
My clothes had gotten tangled with the sleeping 
bag a little, catching on it in a way I didn't expect.
Pup: I- I'll just be on my way.
Marya: Oh my, are you alright?

You're absolutely swimming in that outfit...
Charlotte: Oh, you noticed, too?
Marya: Sweetie, I can offer you something that may fit 
better, if it'd help?
Kara: Despite the problem, that is a bit much to ask of 
you.
Pup: Yeah, these will suit me fine...
Kara: That was not what I said.
Pup: Ah...
Marya: It really is no trouble. If anything getting rid of
some of the clothes stored around here would be a 
help to us.
Pup: I- I don't-
Charlotte grabbed the sleeping bag...
Charlotte: Pup. Take the offer.
Charlotte: It really has gotten unmanageable. One wrong 
move in a fight and you could open yourself up
to a fatal attack.
Pup: I just... need to adjust the tailoring again a little.
Charlotte: A little...?
Charlotte: You know what? Want me to bribe you "a little" 
instead?

What about some sweets at the next village?
Pup: Like... what sort of sweet...?
Charlotte: Kara and I have probably tried things you've never 
even heard of before. Maybe one of those?
Pup: I mean....
I shook my head.
Pup: N- No! Of course I'm not gonna get bought with a 
little chocolate.
Pup: Is that supposed to tempt me?
Pup: I'm not one of your schoolgirl classmates from when 
you were at the academy.
Kara: You may be surprised by how delectable some offerings
are.
Pup: I'm not gonna fall for that either...

No means no.
Charlotte: Well, then that just means you're doing it for free.
Pup: Charlotte... the only clothes she'd have that'd 
fit me are women's clothes...
Charlotte: I mean...
Kara: Actually, did you not say to treat you as a girl?
Kara: Why would your wardrobe be an exception?
Charlotte: Oh yeah, nice catch.
Pup: That's... That's not what I meant by-
All of sudden, I was pulled forward a little.
Charlotte swiftly took the sleeping bag while I was
distracted.
Pup: Hey!
Charlotte: No more excuses. Just go make sure you're not 
gonna get yourself killed over it.
Pup: But I'm not gonna-
And this time, I felt a grip on my gambeson.
Marya: Oh, it won't take long, dear. Trust me.
Now a tug, only for the scene in front of me to 
start getting father away.
Charlotte: We'll get everything ready to go.
Kara: ...
...with their waves to accompany the farewell.
Pup: (Fuuuccckkk...)
Entering the Vault's dormitory halls, I could only
sigh.
Pup: (They got me roped into this again...)
Marya: ...and then Xavier joined Lefen on his quest. I am
proud, though I'd probably be happier if they were 
safe and sound.
Add to that, Euna and Pelus actually have time to 
visit from time to time. I wish they all could.
Marya guided me through the halls, and quickly 
found herself talking about her children.
Pup: (I guess it must have been a while since she had
someone new to talk to out here.)
Pup: (But... to immediately start talking about your
kids...?)
Marya: Ah, if only you could meet. I'm sure Euna could 
help you pick which clothes would best suit you.

Though maybe the mother's touch has gotten to 
her sense of fashion too~

I really must go out there to see my grandson 
again.
Pup: (Are all mother's like this?)
Marya: Ah, sorry. Maybe I'm getting a bit off topic?
Pup: Haha... It's no worry. You seem so excited about it
that it'd be a shame to stop you.
Marya: I suppose so! I am just going off on my own 
tangents.

You'll understand once you're a mother.
Pup: ...
Pup: ...
I stopped.
Pup: (What did she... say...? Did I mishear her...?)
Marya: And here it is.
Not far in front of my stopped location, she opened 
a door.
Pup: (I...)
Pup: I- I must have misheard her...  *Clears throat* ...
So I stepped through the door.
Marya: Tada!
It was a dress! 

I wasn't surprised.
Marya: Euna always looked so cute in it when she wore it. 
And it's warmer than your typical dress.
Pup: Your... daughter's... dress...?
Marya: I'm sure she won't mind. It was among the 
wardrobe she left behind when she moved out...
Pup: I- I'm not sure I could work with a dress. It is a
battlefield after all.
Marya: Are you sure? I saw multiple of your allies wearing
dresses, after all.
Pup: Haha... haha... I'm sure... they're just more used to
it?
Pup: It'd be much safer for me to just get this old thing
tailored again.
I backed away towards the door.
Marya: There are other outfits I can-
Pup: Oh, I think it'd be too much of me to ask for your
daughter's hand-me- downs.
Pup: Y- You really don't have to worry about it.
Marya: If... you insist.
As I was one foot out the door, I tried to not look 
her in the eyes.
Pup: It... really was nice hearing about your family.
I gave a brief but sincere smile, and hurried my 
way back the way we came.
Marya: ...
She crossed her arms and sighed like a 
disappointed mother.
Kara: I assume that means Pup didn't take the outfit?
Kara, watching me as I hurriedly headed back, 
stepped through the door to meet with Marya.
Marya: It's a shame, I think it suited her, too.
Kara: What a cute dress. It would have indeed went with Pup's
hair.
Marya: Is she okay? I never imagined she'd be so against it
once here.
Kara: There is a bit of a story behind that.

...
Kara: Though, I do have an idea...
Our path took us from the vault, leading us out of 
the mountains.
Luckily, signs of our pursuers from the Cartenan
struggle were few and far between.
We had time.
So we moved along a safe path to head south 
within the empire, all while we looked for any signs 
of the Oathbreaker thief.
There were... thoughts beyond the effort, as well.
Charlotte: I can't believe you didn't take the damn outfit.
Pup: Haha... haha...
It wasn't long until we were at the base of the
mountains.
Norde: We'll be stopping at this village here.
Norde pointed towards a map. It was a village at 
the base of the mountains, often used for 
resupplying for expeditions into them.
Pup: A supply town... They'd probably have...
Charlotte: A tailor?

The sun just rose, so they should be open soon.
Pup: Y- Yeah...
Tailor: ...and that'll be maybe an hour or so to finish once 
it gets to the top of my queue.
Pup: Thank you.
I paid the shopkeep, while keeping an eye out over 
my shoulder for the other tagalongs.
Charlotte: ...
Mariel: ...
Satia: ...
...amongst other Crows that needed repairs from 
the long trek in the mountains.
Pup: Hmm...
Tailor: Here, follow me.
The shopkeep led me towards the changing 
room, since I needed my current clothes adjusted.
Pup: (Charlotte and them don't seem... suspicious?)
I watched her and the others happily look through 
the displays.
Pup: (They do seem to be having fun... Makes me 
wonder... what would look good on them?)
I tilted my chin upwards and started to let my mind
drift as we walked.
Pup: Here you go.
I passed along my clothes through the changing 
room tarp.
Tailor: Perfect. I'll be back with a basic spare set. Then 
you can return later when the work is done.
They left and I could hear the footsteps echo off 
into the distance, so I exhaled a bit.
Slipping back into the changing room chair in just 
my under layers, I tried not to look into the mirror 
too much.
Pup: (I wonder what sort of clothes Charlotte and them 
are looking at?)
Instead, I distracted myself with an idle thought.
I tried to imagine some of them in the outfits they 
may be looking at, but...
Nothing.
Pup: (I... don't have the faintest clue of what clothes
those were.)
Pup: ...

(To be honest, I'm not even sure what they might 
be looking at.)
An itch of curiosity washed over me.
And it was in that moment that I heard footsteps
outside.
Pup: (The shopkeep is back with the temporary
clothes? That was fast.)
Standing up, I stepped over to the curtain 
and poked my head out.
Pup: Here, hand me-
Charlotte: Hand you what?
Charlotte: Some clothes?
Pup: C- Charlotte?
Mariel: Pup, we had a thought.
Charlotte: So, a little... sponsor's whim here.
Satia: No need to dance around it.
Satia: My dear Pup...
Satia: We have some outfits for you to try~
Charlotte: To say it simply, you need to try one of these 
outfits.
Pup: ...
Breath taken away, I breathed deeply as I looked 
from outfit to person.
Pup: No.
Charlotte: Oh, come on. You're waiting on the tailor to adjust
your normal outfit, so you need something to try 
on until she's done.
Pup: The shopkeep said they had some spare sets for
situations like this. Basic clothes...
Satia: Don't worry. We already told her we'd take care of it.
Charlotte: I think the shopkeep assumes we took on
that responsibility now.
Pup: W- Why did you push that set of dominoes?!
Charlotte: Come on. It's too late to take it back.
She pushed the outfit she held in my 
general direction.
Mariel: It's... more fun than you give it credit for.

Just try it the one time before you say no.
Charlotte: What sort of self proclaimed girl can't try on an
outfit?
Pup: I...
...
I pulled myself back behind the curtain.
Pup: (Dammit...)

Fine. Just... Just one of them.
Charlotte: Perfect!
Charlotte: There's a few options here.
She listed off what had been grabbed.
Something formal. 
Something flowy. 
Something with armor.
Pup: (Well, if I'm gonna try one, then I might as well...)
[Choice]: Formal Outfit / Flowy Outfit / Battle Outfit
Pup: Just... give me the formal one.

(That's... probably going to be the most normal? I
think...)
Charlotte: Good choice.
Her hand stuck through the curtain, and I 
grabbed the clothes.
Charlotte: If you need any help with a part of it, just say.
Pup: *Sigh* ...
I laid it out to get a better look.
Pup: (Hmm... It's somewhat normal but has all these 
bells and whistles. Like a noble would have.)
Pup: (Or maybe like... a diplomat or something?)
Pup: ...
Pup: Just... give me the flowy one.

(If they're gonna insist, better to go big or not at
all... I think.)
Charlotte: Good choice.
Her hand stuck through the curtain, and I 
grabbed the clothes.
Charlotte: If you need any help with a part of it, just say.
Pup: *Sigh* ...
I laid it out to get a better look.
Pup: (Hmm... It's so fancy. Like something a noble would
wear.)
Pup: (Or maybe like... a dancer or something?)
Pup: ...
Pup: Just... give me the armored one.

(If I'm gonna do this, it's best to do something I'm
more used to.)
Charlotte: Good choice.
Her hand stuck through the curtain, and I 
grabbed the clothes.
Charlotte: If you need any help with a part of it, just say.
Pup: *Sigh* ...
I laid it out to get a better look.
Pup: (Hmm... It does seem like its more meant for
mercenaries.)
Pup: (But it has so many little bells and whistles... Why is
it so... fancy?)
Pup: ...
I stared at the outfit.
On the edge of moving.
.........
On the edge... of acting...
Pup: *Sigh* ... I can't.
I folded the clothes back up again, and 
handed them out.
.........
Mariel: It's okay.
Charlotte: Oh well...
Satia: Thank you for trying, at least.
Charlotte: At least you tried. So thanks.
Charlotte: We'll have the shopkeep bring the normal 
temporary outfit now.
Pup: Thanks...
I dropped to the seat and could only exhale to try 
and relax.
The footsteps got farther away, and I did overhear 
one last thing before it went silent.
Charlotte: It went better than last time. Maybe next time, we
can...
Pup: ...
I closed my eyes.
Pup: (I am... a girl. A woman.)
Pup: (Even if I change back later, I can't get away 
from that now. But...)
It felt like a point of no return.
It wasn't that it didn't make sense that I should.
It wasn't that my own motivations didn't lead to 
the same conclusion that the girls gave.
Pup: (Maybe it was just how... feminine they felt...?)
Pup: (I sort of wished I just took Marya's offer if I was
gonna do this. It was a bit of a simpler outfit
in comparison, after all...)
Pup: ...
.........
Kara: Pup, are you in there?
Pup: (Kara...?)
Pup: Yeah. I'm here.
Kara: I feared a worse disposition.
Kara: ...after overhearing the ending earlier.
Pup: *Sigh*... Of course you did. You've got a future as 
a spy.
Kara: Did you want to try them on?
Pup: ...
Pup: No... Maybe? I don't know.
Pup: Just not... now. Not with the outfits they gave 
me.

(If I'm lucky, maybe I won't have a NEED need to 
until this is all settled and we can think about fixing 
the curse properly.)
Kara: ...
Kara: Here.
A pile of clothes was passed through the curtain.
Pup: ...?
A stepped up and took them in my hand.
Kara: That pile has the temporary outfit the shopkeep has for
customers.
Kara: It also has the outfit that Marya offered before.
Pup: ...

(What...?)
I looked at it, and as she said, the dress 
from before was under the other garment.
Pup: ...
Kara: Under no situation is there an obligation for you to
act on that in any way.
Kara: Consider it an option, though.
Pup: ...

Thank you.
Kara: I am glad to be of assistance.
With a shifting sound as though she curtsied, she 
then walked away, and the footsteps went out of 
hearing range.
Pup: ...
Pup: (How does...?)
I stepped in front of the mirror, fearful of what I
might see.
Pup: It'll be... fine.
My eyes were half closed, and my other senses 
were stronger for it.
The cool air across my smooth and exposed thighs 
was a new feeling.
The cool air across my exposed thighs was a new
feeling.
Pup: ...It's okay Anton... You're a girl now, even if its
for the time being.

You're a... a... girl...
So I opened my eyes further, and full turned 
towards the mirror.
Pup: (That's... a different person.)
I felt like I didn't recognize who I saw.
The silhouette alone took me by surprise.
From how my legs came out of the dress to how 
the corset created a shape around my waist.
Then there was the cleavage showing, and the 
small feminine details like ribbons.
And even my normal features felt new, like how 
each strand of my silky hair fell down to frame my 
face, and how that worked with the dress.
And even my normal features felt new, like my hair
framing my face with the shape the dress created.
I had looked myself over when I had last changed, 
but this... This felt different.
Even in this more modest dress... I was...
Pup: ...

...Cute.

.........
I stared, the thoughts passing through my mind 
much like how I had thought about Charlotte and 
the others trying on new outfits before.
Like it was someone else.
At least until a particular thought settled 
in my mind.
Pup: (That's... me.)
Pup: T- That's... me...?!
The dots had connected.
Pup: ...

.........

..................
I switched to the temporary outfit, though my 
heart still raced, and set the dress aside.
Pup: *Sigh*...
Pup: ...
I looked at the dress again.
I made sure to fold it carefully.
It wasn't too much longer until my normal clothes 
were tailored to fit better.
Kara: Hello, Pup.
Pup: Uh... Yeah, hey. See you back at camp.
She just smiled, and pressed no further.
I started walking away, but some words quietly 
made their way out.
Pup: Thanks... again...
Back at camp, I still had the dress in hand.
After a little hesitation, I stored it in my luggage.
Towards the bottom.
passages.content_zh:
光線搖曳，穿透清晨的薄霧。
在剛醒來的朦朧中，我被光芒刺得睜不開眼，只能
聽到遠處傳來一陣喧鬧。
阿提克斯：...
夏洛特：...
我聽不清他們在說什麼，但我猜想
一定發生了什麼事。
.........
瑪麗亞：抱歉打擾了，請原諒。
小狗：...？
小狗：...哈囉？
一個女人站在我的睡袋旁，
正在摺疊某種布料。
瑪麗亞：喔，我吵醒妳了嗎？真抱歉。
小狗：妳是...
小狗：（喔，等等...）

拉納瑟爾夫人。
瑪麗亞·拉納瑟爾夫人站在我面前。
阿提克斯的妻子。
瑪麗亞：我只是想早點開始整理妳的
這些補給品。
小狗：為什麼...妳要做這個？
小狗：（難道有人已經發現這附近的軍隊了嗎？）
我起身並打了個呵欠。
瑪麗亞：嗯...
當我跪下來開始收拾自己的睡袋時，
她告訴我叛誓者已經消失了。
小狗：什- 什麼？！

（我們做了這麼多？！怎麼會... 怎麼會發生這種事？！）
瑪麗亞：那個可愛的女孩夏洛特同意幫忙追蹤它，作為妳們團隊努力的一部分。
小狗：是啊，我們當然可以幫忙。
我加快了捲睡袋的速度。
瑪麗亞：謝謝妳。我知道如果我丈夫知道妳們全心全意地支持他，他一定會很高興。
我呼了一口氣，拉起了收好的睡袋。
小狗：當然。畢竟，如果我們不幫忙，那還有誰會幫忙呢？
卡拉：在這種情況下，尤其如此。
卡拉走了過來，夏洛特緊隨其後。
夏洛特：他們怎麼會在晚上偷走它？我們都在這裡...
卡拉：如果還有線索可循，我們是唯一有
機會找到線索的人。

盟約的部署需要數週時間
才能到達這裡開始調查。
小狗：我會把這個搬到馬那邊，然後-
我向前走了一步。
就在我這麼做的時候...
小狗：啊...？
...我稍微絆了一下。
我的衣服和睡袋有點纏在一起了，
以一種我沒想到的方式卡住了。
小狗：我- 我這就走了。
瑪麗亞：喔，我的天啊，妳還好嗎？

妳穿那件衣服看起來簡直像在游泳...
夏洛特：喔，妳也注意到了嗎？

passages.name: Supply Run Ch11-12 - New Event
passages.content:
We stepped through the bustling morning 
of Crekskia.
Charlotte: So... big changes?
Pup: In a sense.
I hiked up my gambeson to over my shoulders 
once more.
But, after a few more steps, the jostling had 
pushed them to slide off again, with the straps on 
my clothes being what kept it on overall.
Pup: *Sigh*...
Kara: First of all, you slept outside for the night, yes?

It may have not been for long, but do you feel 
alright?
Pup: I'm feeling okay... maybe a little sore?
Charlotte: So why did you head off like that?
Mariel: Yeah, what happened to cause... you to change more?
Satia: Indeed. What brought you out to a graveyard?
Charlotte: Or, better yet, what led you to that chamber in 
the first place?
Kara: You did have some strange behavior as you uncovered it.
Pup: W- Well...
Norde: One question at a time, yes?
Norde: Few of us have had much sleep, Anton included.
I looked over to Norde, who had cut off the topic
before I could be piled underneath the questions.
I smiled softly at the gesture.
Pup: Actually, I had a question, too.

What happened to the Imperials we were fighting? 
I missed the last bits of that.
Rowan: Yours truly rallied the town and Crows to the 
rescue.

Hand in hand, their leader was placed under our 
very own lock and key.
Pup: That fox eared lady merc? We captured her?
Rowan: Amongst others.
Rowan: In fact, she was set to the side to be interrogated 
by our very own Charlotte~
Rowan said in a melodic tone, and tilted his head
towards Charlotte as he did.
Charlotte: I'm... taking a break.
Charlotte: *Sigh*... it's way too early in the morning for that.
Rowan: Yes, a break.

Before even starting.
Charlotte: I don't exactly see you benefiting from beauty 
sleep yourself.
Rowan: Alas, I was too worried for our fair Pup.
Charlotte: So was I...!
The two's familiar bickering seemed to trail off in 
the background, and I could only chuckle.
Soon enough, Kara's face popped forward and 
into my view.
Kara: On that topic, we are tasked with completing parts of
the resupply.
Pup: Isn't that what we did last night?
Satia: Well, the fight with the Imperials chipped away at 
that progress.
Norde: Not after that fight with the imperials.
Kara: I'm sure Pup is exhausted. One of us can help you 
back to the housing, and the rest can focus on said 
supply run.
Pup: No need. I can help.
Mariel: You don't want to overexert yourself. It can be
dangerous.
Kara: Overexerting oneself is not a good idea.
I twinged a bit at the assertion.
Pup: I can help...
Norde: You don't know how much this change has 
impacted you. Best to take it easy until we move 
out.
Pup: I...
I wanted to still help.
Pup: (But how to get through to them...?)
[Choice]:  I wanna thank the townsfolk. / We’ll get better deals. /  I’m a mercenary. I can do this.
Pup: No, I should come along.
Rowan: You really mustn't force yourself.
Pup: Then... I promise I won't.

If I feel like I'm pushing myself, I'll take the initiative 
to step away and rest.
Pup: I can at least help some... even if its not as much 
as others.
Pup: We don't want to take another person away from 
the effort just to help me, either.
Charlotte: Hmm...
Pup: Plus... I wanna talk to the townsfolk.

I wanna thank them. On behalf of the Crows and...
myself.
Pup: I would like to help and come along.
Rowan: You really mustn't force yourself.
Pup: Then you have my word that I won't.

If I feel like anything I'm doing properly strenuous,
I'll speak up and step aside.
Pup: I can at least help some... even if its not as much 
as others.
Pup: We don't want to take another person away from the
effort just to help me, either.
Charlotte: Hmm...
Pup: Plus... I'm not lacking in self awareness enough to 
not realize that my appearance helps.
Pup: People like seeing a cute smile. It'll get us at least
a little better deals.
Pup: I wouldn't be much of a mercenary if I didn't come
along.
Rowan: You really mustn't force yourself.
Pup: Be assured that I won't, then.

I can set a good example and continue to be 
bodyguard to Charlotte, at least, if not more.

I'll work to my limits and step aside if it becomes 
too much for me currently.
Pup: I'd at least help some... even if its not as much as
others.
Pup: We don't want to take another person away from 
the effort just to help me, either.
Charlotte: Hmm...
Pup: Plus... I'm not unaware that without my father, 
people will look to me as one of the Crow's leaders.
Pup: It's important I set that example of what a good 
Crow is. Strong, but wise.
Charlotte: Hmmm...!
Charlotte: Fine.
Charlotte: We're gonna make sure you actually hold to those 
words, though.
Satia: It was very well said, Pup.
Satia: I'll be sure to keep you to that, as well. I'll be
vigilant.
Pup: No objections from me.
Kara: It seems we have an agreement then. Shall we?
We stepped through the markets of Crekskia, 
talking to townsfolk and having some quick 
conversations.
Some were sweet, and others a bit awkward, but I 
could feel the warmth of the village as we moved 
through its mountainous and snowy streets.
Smiles were had, laughs were shared, and in time 
we entered store after store as we worked 
through the tasks.
More than a few of us split off from the group as 
we got enough supplies to send people back to 
the full group with a load.
As we did, we found ourselves at the final 
destination of this supply run...
The tailor's shop.
Pup: I mean, at this amount, it probably warrants a small
discount?
Shopkeep: Eh? But you need a rush job.
We needed to get some of our leather armor 
repaired before we headed out, and we wanted to 
leave sooner over later.
Pup: (Kara said... with that Nora woman captured... we
gained maybe a day or two on the main forces of 
that regiment?)
The shopkeep gave me a knowing look.
Pup: Very well. We appreciate you doing the rush job for us.
I set down the payment, and stepped back to take 
a deep breath.
Shopkeep: Thank ya.
I was starting to get a bit tired. So, I let myself
relax and take in the moment.
...
......
.........
Charlotte: ...cute...
Pup: ...?
A few words tickled the ear from the other side of 
the shop.
Charlotte and the others had stepped aside when I 
was talking to the shopkeep.
Kara: ...indeed...
Pup: (Where did they go...?)
I headed towards the sounds, and continued to 
hear more of their conversation.
Kara: It's made from a nice texture.
Charlotte: Definitely. It probably got imported through 
Lockhart early in the year.
Mariel: Really, I just like the design.
Mariel: I saw a lot of fun designs from all over the 
continent when I was at school, so I stopped 
caring as much about the fabric.
Charlotte: Doesn't mean nice fabric doesn't help though.
Mariel: Haha... You're not wrong.
Kara: I do like how the skirt's color transitions between 
the two.
Kara: It feels quite... fairytale.
Charlotte: Right, right?
Charlotte: The sash works well with it, too.
Pup: Hmm...
I was now in the clothes section, standing to their
side. It would only take a few long steps to join 
them.
Mariel: The gloves are nice. Do you think they go with the 
rest of the dress?
Kara: I believe they intended the gloves to match the 
shoes. Like a sort of framing.
Charlotte: Ah, yeah. I can see that.
They continued on, chattering away about some of 
the dress sets on the rack.
Pup: ...

...they do look... nice.
I whispered.
But it was a mistimed moment. It was a moment 
where one could hear a pin drop.
Charlotte: Hm? Did you say something...?
The group of woman turned to me.
Mariel: ...
Kara: ...
All of them were stuck in that pin drop moment, as
though processing what they had heard.
Pup: Uh...
In fact, I hadn't truly processed what had slipped
through my mouth myself.
Pup: Did I say something weird?
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte: Heh.
Each of them looked back towards one another, 
and smiled.
Pup: (What are they...?)
Kara: Might you want to... try one?
Pup: "Try one"...?
Charlotte: Try on an outfit.
Pup: W- Wait, why? What brought this on?!
Mariel: Wouldn't it look good on you?
Kara: Indeed, I think the colors go well with your hair, 
Pup.
Pup: W- What? How does-? What?!
Charlotte: Heheh~
Charlotte: Come here, lil Pup. We've got something great for you~
Pup: H- Hey! We don't have time for... whatever it is 
you have in mind!
Kara: The tailor's repairs aren't a short endeavor.
Charlotte: Heheh~
Pup: W- Wait...!
Kara: I do like the asymmetrical design of this one.
Charlotte: It's not bad, but it might be a bit hard for Pup to 
get on.
Charlotte: This one could be good. Both pretty and with 
space to add protective gear for a mercenary.
Mariel: It feels like one you'd choose, sis.
Kara: A very Charlotte styled choice.
Rowan: Perhaps this? It flows and sways with a unique charm?
Charlotte: Weren't you supposed to get Satia?
Rowan: She can't arrive soon.
Charlotte: Don't you have a job to do?
Rowan: I am not the only one.
Rowan: But I shall go back to my work and leave you ladies 
to it.
Pup: Not that I get a say in this...
This went on for longer than I imagined it could.
Yet...
Pup: (It's... sort of fun.)
Hectic energy seemed to follow the adventure as I 
was pulled by one girl to another, each eager to 
show me some grand idea they were formulating.
I barely got a second to think, let alone actually
consider what was happening or what my actual 
thoughts were.
It was in that hecticness that a thought bubbled 
up alongside the others.
Pup: You know...

Are any of these gonna fit me?
Charlotte: Sure, we can just ask the tailor to adjust them to 
your measurements.
Pup: ..."Measurement"...?
The word was legitimately foreign to me. I had little
to no reason in all my life to think on it.
Pup: I guess I used to be... a medium?
I looked down at my chest.
Pup: Maybe a large now...
Kara: Charlotte, Pup would've never gotten 
measurements before.
Charlotte: Oh... I mean...
Charlotte: Shoot...
Mariel: Now that I think about it... does the tailor even 
have time? They're working on the Crows' 
equipment.
Kara: I'm unsure if we'd have time to ask for the 
adjustments anyways, given the tailor is working on 
equipment.
Charlotte: Whose side are you on?
Kara: It cannot be helped.
Pup: *Sigh*...
Kara: I have taken measurements for family members 
before though.

Would you like to get that before we leave?
Pup: I...

I... guess... I should?
Her words sounded like a requirement to me.
A gate pass to do... something we were trying to.
In all honesty, my mind had yet to catch up to my
mouth.
Kara: I'll ask the tailor for a room to do so in then.
With Kara's soft and warm smile, I felt like I was in
good hands, at least.
She took my own, and we stepped further into the 
store.
None of the rooms were available, so the tailor
directed us to a small tent behind the store.
It was used as a shared place to store overflow
supplies for the local shops.
Kara: Take off your clothes.
Pup: Huh?
She said the words with a nonchalant aura that 
took me off guard. Combined with the direction 
itself, I was speechless.
Kara: Don't worry, I won't take long.
Pup: Why do I have to...?
Kara: I couldn't possibly get accurate measurements of 
your bust and waist with that gambeson on.
Pup: Is that what we're doing?
Kara: Of course. Now, let's not dawdle.
Pup: Y- Yes ma'am!
Kara: You only need to take off your top, by the way.
Pup: (My top...?)

Oh, just my shirt and gambeson.
Kara: Good. Arms up.
Pup: Mmm...
Air chilled over my body.
We were up in the mountains and it wasn't as 
though it was the middle of summer.
Between my hardening nipples and the soft 
footsteps behind me, I felt my heart race.
Pup: (I should try to... calm down.)

(Maybe I can-)
Pup: Mm...!
Like a secret operative, Kara was behind me before 
I could even notice her.
A tape measure wrapped around my bare breasts, 
and whatever cold I felt burned away as my 
flushed face radiated heat.
Kara: It was kind of the tailor to let us borrow a 
measuring tape. This won't take long.
Pup: Y- Yeah... Not really something you'd... walk 
around with.
Pup: ...?!
I felt the tape tighten a bit around my breasts.
A tingling feel arose in small waves across my body.
Pup: (Kara is...)
The image of what was happening behind me 
popped into my head, and the stimulating waves 
got stronger.
Pup: (I... need to calm down...)
My heart was racing.
Kara: Here, I just need to...
Her arm reached forward, and she brushed my 
hair outwards and made room for the tape 
measure to get behind me.
Each tickle of arm and hair on my back was 
something that I felt like I could feel twice as 
strong as normally.
Kara: ...minus one... or maybe...

Is it tight?
Pup: A little...
Kara: Well, you typically want it a little snug.
Pup: It's probably... a little past snug.
Kara: Then I can...
She backed off some, and it felt like a retreat 
within my mental realm.
Pup: *Inhale*...

...
Pup: *Exhale*...
I was still on edge, but I felt more calm.
Kara: There.
Pup: (Thank the Goddess it's over.)
Pup: ...?!
The tape slid downward, slipping over my 
waist instead.
Kara: Next waist, then hips.
Pup: Hm...?
Pup: Haha...?!
A ticklish feeling came about.
Kara: Oh, are you ticklish?
Pup: (I wasn't...?)
My body disagreed, and Kara appeared to switch to 
a more gentle grip.
Kara: I'll try to be more careful.
I twitched a little, and I tried to stave off the
laughter.
It was over in a few more seconds, even if it felt
significantly longer in my mind.
Pup: *Sigh*...
Kara: Now just the hip....
She moved, and she was getting more efficient 
with it as she took each next step.
Kara: Fully done now.
She stepped back.
Kara: *Mumbling*...
And with that, she was mumbling what sounded
like a few numbers over and over.
Kara: I'll be right back. I should write these down.
Pup: We're done...?
I started to let my arms down, and my heart was 
still racing.
Pup: (Is this what it's like... to actually be a girl?)
My whole day had been as far from what I could've
imagined it being just yesterday, or even this 
morning.
Pup: ...
Pup: A girl... a woman...
I lowered my arms, and almost by instinct my hands
gravitated towards my breasts.
They settled into my grip, and I could feel their 
true weight without distraction.
Pup: (Heavy...)
With a slight squeeze, the sensation of electric
ripples gave me goosebumps.
Pup: (I don't think it feels as... strong, as when Kara
touched me...)
But it still felt nice.
I massaged them some more. The soft waves of 
pleasure washed along my body.
Each one comforting, hypnotizing, and soft.
Pup: (So this is what women feel like... when they...)
Pup: ...
I hit a sensitive spot, and I flinched.
After a quick breath, I tried touching it again, 
but it wasn't as strong.
Pup: (What, did I catch myself by surprise?)

(Honestly, it really did feel a bit better when Kara
was...)
The thought was idling, but it brought me back to 
the moment.
And...
It felt better.
Imagining that moment again... One of - not even 
Kara specifically - but another person touching me.
Flashes of indiscriminate fantasy flared into 
my mind.
Pup: ...

I...

.........
I let my hands fall from me silhouette and to 
my side.
I slouched down, stepping over to one of the 
barrels and sitting against it.
Pup: (This is what its like to actually feel like a
woman...)

(To imagine myself as one...)

(Being... touched... by...)

.........
I didn't know what to think.
Did I like it? Did it feel natural?
Did I hate it? Did it feel alien?
Each of those felt both right and wrong at different
times as I let the thoughts swirl through my head.
This was who I am now.
With no guarantee to ever be anything different 
again.
I buried my head into my knees. My increasingly 
fetal sitting position felt more like a protective 
bubble the more I did.
I was simply... overwhelmed.
Did it feel wrong?
......
I opened my mouth slightly, and a few words 
whispered out.
Pup: ...no... it didn't...
Kara: I'm sorry that took so long. The tailor was busy so I
needed to talk to-
Kara: ...Pup?
Pup: I'm going to head back to the staging site.

I'll keep my word. I've pushed myself too far.
Kara: ...Okay.

Do you need any help?
She stepped to the side and grabbed my shirt 
to hand to me.
Pup: Thank you.
I slowly let myself start rising to my feet.
Pup: And no... I'm... okay.

Probably would be better by myself for a bit.
Kara: Understood.

Do be safe.
It didn't take me long to put back on my familiar
getup.
As I left, I just thought on the point of it all.
Pup: (It's not like... I was considering getting a new
outfit to replace this anyways...)

(I...)

(I don't know.)
Kara followed me to the tailor's exit, and she 
insisted they'd be fine transporting the fixed 
leatherwork back to the staging area.
Charlotte: Was that Pup?
Mariel: Is everything okay?
Kara: I believe it is alright. But my expertise in such
things is... limited.
Charlotte: Was it as bad as the last time we tried to get them 
to buy a new outfit?

We didn't even suggest something specific this 
time.
Kara: Nor did Pup try anything on...
Charlotte: Well... yeah.

Hope Satia doesn't end up too disappointed when 
she gets here.
Charlotte: Well... yeah.
Kara: They seemed... overwhelmed.

In contrast to seeming resistant.
Mariel: You think?
Mariel: That's a good sign, right?
Charlotte: Hmm... it does seem positive.
Kara: Add to that... I did get measurements.
Kara waved around a small slip of paper.
Charlotte: Nice. Then we'll have those for next time.
Kara: Actually, if I may make a request of you, the sponsor
of this group...
Charlotte: Hm...?
Kara: If the chess pieces move in the ways I suspect...

There may be a need sooner over later.
Charlotte: You really think so?
Kara: Sad to say, I know some of the major players 
perhaps too well.
Charlotte: Like the queen?
Kara: Yes, amongst others.
Charlotte: Alright. I can agree to buy a little something.
Charlotte: What did you have in mind? Maybe we get a few?
Kara: Only the one is needed, I would say.
Mariel: Maybe that first one we were looking at?
Mariel: Didn't Pup seem to like it?
Kara: A good point.
Kara: Perhaps we can look at the one Pup themself said 
looked good?
Charlotte: I can get behind that.
Charlotte: Oh tailor~
Tailor: Hm?
Charlotte: We have another job for you.

Is that the insect from before?
Tatiana: ...

Thanks. You gave me another reason for you to 
die.
passages.content_zh:
塔提亞娜：你做得真好。你讓你的血脈感到驕傲。
貴族軍官：這個聲音...

是剛才那隻蟲子嗎？
塔提亞娜：...

謝謝。你又給了我一個讓你去死的理由。

passages.name: Paralogue 1 (Battle) - Start
passages.content:
Pup: Everyone is scattered about...

What can we do...?
Pup: I'll have to trust them. I'll head to the town center 
where we can hopefully meet up.
Pup: (And maybe deal with some of these soldiers on 
the way...)
I placed my hand on my sword and turned to the 
girl I had met in this havoc.
Pup: Stay as safe as possible. I'll handle these guys as 
best I can.
Tatiana: What? Do you want to get yourself killed?
Pup: Believe it or not, I'm a mercenary. One with allies in 
town with me.
Pup: I just need to regroup with them...
Tatiana: You're still gonna...
Tatiana: *Sigh*... What to do?
Win Condition: The officer dies
Lose Condition: Pup, Tatiana, Rowan or Charlotte 
die.
Win Condition: The officer dies
Lose Condition: Pup, Otis, Tatiana, Rowan or 
Charlotte  die.
passages.content_zh:
小狗：大家都四散了...

我們能做什麼...?
小狗：我必須信任他們。我會前往鎮中心，
希望我們能在那裡會合。
小狗：（而且也許能順便解決掉一些士兵...）
我將手放在劍上，轉向我在這場浩劫中遇到的女孩。
小狗：盡可能保持安全。我會盡我所能處理這些傢伙。
塔蒂亞娜：什麼？你想找死嗎？
小狗：信不信由你，我是個傭兵。而且鎮裡有我的盟友。
小狗：我只需要和他們重新集結...
塔蒂亞娜：你還是打算...
塔蒂亞娜：*嘆氣*... 該怎麼辦？
勝利條件：軍官死亡
失敗條件：小狗、塔蒂亞娜、羅文或夏洛特死亡。
勝利條件：軍官死亡
失敗條件：小狗、奧蒂斯、塔蒂亞娜、羅文或夏洛特死亡。

passages.name: Paralogue 1 (Battle) - Pup → Tatiana
passages.content:
Pup: What are you still doing here?! I said get to safety!
Tatiana: To think they'd go this far? Could I even...?
Tatiana: Argh! Fuck it! I'll kill them myself!
She looked around the area.
Tatiana: It looks like everyone else has ran away? It should 
be safe to do it...
Pup: Are you even listening?
Tatiana: I'll clean up my own mess, thank you very much.
Tatiana: Now...
She raised her hand and a bracelet she wore 
around her wrist seemed to glisten in the sun.
After a second silence, there was a whoosh of air 
approaching us and ringing through me ears.
As my head turned to it, the object in question 
flew in and out of my sight only for it to snap to 
the girl's arm.
Pup: What in the Goddess's name is that?!
A gauntlet had attached itself to her hand. It was 
double the size of her actual hand, even.

Another whoosh of air came as a metal boot did 
the same to her foot.
Tatiana: Well if you're too dumb to put two and two 
together, then that makes this simpler.
One after another, pieces of armor attached to her 
body.

What stood before me at the end was a hulking 
set of armor that was at least double her size.
Pup: The... "Armored Bandit"?
Tatiana: Took you long enough.
Tatiana: Let's keep this our little secret, yeah?
Pup: I didn't even catch your name.
Tatiana: Tatiana. Not that'd help those idiots try and catch 
me.
Pup: So many questions...
Pup: I'll save them, though. You up for trying to meet 
up with my allies?
Tatiana: If I get to boot stomp that fuckwad in charge of 
the soldiers? Gladly.
Tatiana was recruited!
passages.content_zh:
小狗：你還在這裡做什麼？ ！我說注意安全！
塔蒂亞娜：沒想到他們會走到這一步？我甚至可以…嗎？
塔蒂亞娜：啊啊！他媽的！我要親手殺掉他們！
她環顧四周。
塔蒂亞娜：看起來其他人都跑掉了？應該
安全地做這件事...
小狗：你到底在聽嗎？
塔蒂亞娜：我會收拾好自己的爛攤子，非常感謝你。
塔蒂亞娜：現在…
她舉起了手，手上戴著手鐲
她的手腕周圍似乎在陽光下閃閃發光。
短暫的沉默後，空氣中傳來一陣嘶嘶聲
靠近我們並在我耳邊響起。
當我的頭轉向它時，有問題的物體
飛進飛出我的視線，只是為了它突然捕捉到
女孩的手臂。
小狗：女神的名字是？ ！
她的手上附著了一副手套。原來是
甚至是她實際手的兩倍大小。

又一陣空氣咻咻地傳來，就像金屬靴子發出的聲音一樣
她的腳也一樣。
塔蒂亞娜：好吧，如果你太笨而不能把兩個和兩個
在一起，那麼事情就變得更簡單了。
一件又一件的盔甲貼在她的身上
身體。

最後站在我面前的是一個巨大的
這套鎧甲的尺寸至少是她的兩倍。
Pup：那個……「裝甲強盜」？
塔蒂亞娜：花了你足夠長的時間。
塔蒂亞娜：我們保守這個小秘密吧？
小狗：我甚至沒聽清楚你的名字。
塔蒂亞娜：塔蒂亞娜。這並不能幫助那些白痴嘗試抓住
我。
小狗：這麼多問題…
Pup：不過我會救他們的。你準備好嘗試見面
和我的盟友在一起嗎？
塔蒂亞娜：如果我能踩死那個負責的混蛋
士兵們？樂意。
塔蒂亞娜被招募了！

passages.name: Paralogue 1 (Battle) - Pup → Tatiana
passages.content:
Pup: Might I ask... How are you... you know? How are 
you doing that?
Tatiana: The armor?

I'm not going to pretend I get the theory, but I've 
got a knack for being able to manipulate it.

One day I found an heirloom, and moving shit 
around was the thing that worked for me when I 
tried to use it.
Pup: So you're... using magic to hold it in place around 
you? And move it around as you need to?
Tatiana: As best as I understand it? Yeah. Some shit like 
that.
Pup: That's... pretty cool...
Pup: (I need to ask the others how that could work... 
Maybe I could...)

(No, for now we need to focus on the task at 
hand.)
passages.content_zh:
小狗：請問... 你... 你是怎麼... 做到那樣的？
塔蒂亞娜：盔甲嗎？

我不會假裝我懂其中的理論，但我就是有辦法操控它。

有一天我找到了一個傳家寶，然後移動東西就成了我嘗試使用它時唯一有效的方法。
小狗：所以妳是... 用魔法將它固定在妳周圍？然後根據需要移動它？
塔蒂亞娜：就我所理解的？對啊。大概就是那樣。
小狗：這... 真酷...
小狗：（我需要問問其他人那是怎麼辦到的... 也許我可以...）

（不行，現在我們需要專注於手邊的任務。）

passages.name: Paralogue 1 (Battle) - Satia → Mariel
passages.content:
Mariel: Wh- Why are the soldiers acting like this?
Satia: Some commander likely got too big for their 
britches.

What to do... They look like they're looking for 
someone or something.
Mariel: Shouldn't we find the others? What if they're in 
danger?
Satia: Very true! Focus on keeping our friends and loved 
ones safe.
Satia: That should be our number 1 priority.
Mariel: Just let me know what I need to do.
passages.content_zh:
瑪麗埃爾：什、為什麼士兵們會這樣？
薩蒂亞：有些指揮官可能對他們來說太大了
馬褲。

該怎麼辦...他們看起來正在尋找
某人或某事。
瑪麗埃爾：我們不應該去找其他人嗎？如果他們在裡面怎麼辦
危險？
薩蒂亞：非常正確！專注於留住我們的朋友和所愛的人
安全的。
Satia：這應該是我們的第一要務。
Mariel：讓我知道我需要做什麼。

passages.name: Paralogue 1 (Battle) - Norde → Jakson
passages.content:
Jakson: *Concerned bark*
Norde: No, you may not carry the meat.
Jakson: *Disagreeable bark*
Norde: Because you will eat it.
Jakson: *Offended bark*
Norde: Because you've done it before.
Norde: More enemies approach. Do not distract me 
further.
Jakson: *Huff*...
passages.content_zh:
Jakson: *擔憂的吠叫*
Norde: 不行，你不可以拿肉。
Jakson: *不贊同的吠叫*
Norde: 因為你會吃掉它。
Jakson: *被冒犯的吠叫*
Norde: 因為你以前就這樣做過了。
Norde: 更多敵人正在靠近。別再分散我的注意力了。
Jakson: *哼*...

passages.name: Paralogue 1 (Battle) - Cainan → Charlotte
passages.content:
Cainan: Hmm... This appears to be troublesome.
Charlotte: We can't go anywhere nice, can we?
Cainan: Shall we, then?
Charlotte: The big bad auditor is going to stand up to the 
local army?
Cainan: It is but a trifle.
Cainan: May I escort you through the flames of battle, 
princess?
Charlotte: Why not? Be sure to watch out for friendly fire, 
dear auditor.
passages.content_zh:
彩南：嗯……這看起來很麻煩。
夏洛特：我們不能去好地方，不是嗎？
蔡南：那我們可以嗎？
夏洛特：大壞審計員將勇敢地面對
當地軍隊？
彩南：不過是小事而已。
該南：我可以護送你穿越戰火，
公主？
夏洛特：為什麼不呢？一定要注意友軍火力，
親愛的審計員。

passages.name: Paralogue 1 (Battle) - Rowan → Otis
passages.content:
Rowan: This... What are the soldiers doing?
Otis: Looks like a raid to me.
Rowan: It was such a pleasant day, too.
Otis: I don't know... This looks pretty fun, too.
Rowan: Wait, don't run off! We were supposed to be 
purchasing sanitary supplies!
passages.content_zh:
羅溫：這... 士兵們在幹什麼？
奧提斯：看起來像是一場突襲。
羅溫：天氣明明這麼好。
奧提斯：我倒覺得... 這看起來也挺有趣的。
羅溫：等等，別跑開！我們本來應該去買衛生用品的！

passages.name: Paralogue Pre-Story - Scene 2
passages.content:
The Nightless Crows had been traveling to a new 
destination among the many in their journey.

Along that path, they came across a medium sized 
village that they could rest and resupply within.
Shopkeep: Fresh lobster! 20% off until noontime!

Get your lobster! So fresh you'd think you're 
swimming seaside yourself!
Pup: (Why give a discount to super fresh lobster? I think 
I smell a little white lie in that.)
I approached the food stand.
Shopkeep: Welcome, welcome! Lobster for your evening 
dinner?
Pup: A little rich for my blood.
Pup: You have any trout in stock?
Shopkeep: Splendid choice! Let me see...
Away from the market town scene, some rumbling 
from horse hooves and steel boots rattled the 
eardrum.
Villager: Are those...?
Another Villager: Maybe we should move.
Pup: Hmm...
Looking at the trout, I wasn't sure how actually 
fresh it was.
Pup: May I?
Shopkeep: Of course. I wouldn't ask you to not trust your 
own senses.
Pup: Thank you.
I picked up one of the fish and stepped back a few 
paces to smell it for how fresh it was away from 
the other fish.
Pup: *Sniff*...

(It doesn't smell like it's going bad... I think?)

(I could probably-)
Pup: Grk!
Pup: What the-...?!
I turned to see an annoyed soldier looking down 
on me.
Soldier: Watch where you're going!
Pup: YOU hit me.
I looked over to the ground around me.

The fish I was holding was covered in the 
surrounding's dirt.
Shopkeep: My- My product?!
Pup: Goddess dammit...
Pup: You going to pay for that?
Soldier: Pay for... a fish? Hahaha! You don't know who 
you're talking to, do you?
Pup: A minimum wage hired hand?
Soldier: Hmph. Maybe we should teach you a lesson?

You scuffed my armor. How about you treat us to 
a nice fish dinner?
The other soldiers had gathered around the 
first. They started chuckling along with him.
Pup: Tsk. I...
Tatiana: Hey ladies~

Gossiping without me?
Pup: Huh?
I turned to see a girl around my age sitting on the 
food stand I was at before.
Tatiana: You know... gossip is often better in hushed 
whispers.

Better than spilling your drama across the 
marketplace, at least.
Shopkeep: Who are you?!
Tatiana: Shh... The grown-ups are talking now.
With the shopkeep stunned into silence, the girl 
jumped down from the food stand and walked 
over.
Soldier: Hmph. Did you invite your friend to help cook for 
us daring heroes?
Pup: Never met her before.
Tatiana: Yeah, I'll cook. I'll cook your balls to a crisp and 
make some Crimson Sea Oysters.
Soldier: Wh- What? What did you just say?!
Tatiana: Maybe you should stop trying to perform your 
little play in the steets?

Unless you really think harassing some young girl is 
really going to make you look good.
Pup: Uh... I'm... just...
Pup: Uh... I'm... not...
Soldier: You little-
The soldier started to take a step forward towards 
the girl.
Noble Officer: What is the hold up here?
Another figure stepped forward in more regal gear 
than the normal soldier. He had a round belly that 
stood out to everyone involved.
Tatiana: Your soldiers were harassing this girl for some fish.

Maybe you should try feeding them at some point 
instead of just yourself?
Noble Officer: ...
The commander seemed to go quiet as he looked 
at the girl... with a focus on her ears.
Noble Officer: Einlyn, aren't you?
Tatiana: What's it to you?
Noble Officer: Soldiers, we don't have time for exterminating 
insects. Bigger and better things are planned today.
Tatiana: You piece of shit...
Soldier: Yes, sir!
Without even acknowledging the girl's existence for 
another second, the soldiers regained their 
formation before heading off down the street.
Tatiana: ...
Pup: Well, that was unexpected.
Tatiana: Here.
Her hand reached down and helped me to my feet.
Pup: You okay?
Tatiana: Shouldn't I be asking you that?
Tatiana: But yeah. You get used to it.
I quickly introduced myself and asked for her
name as well.
Tatiana: Oh, I'm no one important.
Tatiana: Anyways, don't you have more important things to 
worry about?
Pup: What do you mean?
Shopkeep: MY FISH!?
Pup: Oh... crap...
Tatiana: I'll just leave you to it.
As the girl started to walk away, everyone was 
distracted by the shouts from afar.
Wealthy Villager: Soldiers! Soldiers!
Pup: More?
Tatiana: ...?
Wealthy Villager: I've been robbed!
Noble Officer: And what, pray tell, do you expect us to do about 
it?
Wealthy Villager: I- I... You could catch them?!
Noble Officer: Petty crimes are petty.
The scene seemed to have played out as the 
regiment of soldiers started to move on.
Wealthy Villager: It... It might have been the Armored Bandit!
Then the commander stopped.
Noble Officer: ...

The Armored Bandit, you say?
Wealthy Villager: Y- Yes. It was a hulking set of armor that cornered 
me and took my coin purse!
While the group down the street yelled loud 
enough for many to hear, a question mark popped 
into my head.
Pup: The "Armored Bandit"?
Shopkeep: Have you never heard?

The Armored Bandit is a vigilante who steals from 
the rich and noble then gives to the poor.

They say he's massive! Multiple heads taller than 
either of you ladies.
Pup: Huh...
Pup: Seriously, I'm not...
Tatiana: They'll never catch him.
Pup: Why not? It sounds like he just committed a 
robbery. He's probably still here.
Shopkeep: That's the mystery! No one knows who he is.

Despite being as big as a giant, his identity is 
obscured by the armor.

And every tale of him ends with him 
disappearing right after!
Pup: Really?
Shopkeep: Some say he's a vengeful ghost.
The commander had turned to the burgled 
individual.
Noble Officer: How sure of this are you?
Wealthy Villager: Uh... P- Pretty sure! It matches what the rumors 
say.

He turned a corner and... poof! No giant armor to 
be seen.
Tatiana: I imagine this scene has played out a hundred times 
before, so I'll just-
Noble Officer: Heheh... What fantastic timing...

Soldiers! New orders!

Find this Armored Bandit! I don't care what you 
need to do in order to do so!

Every house! Around every corner! Check every 
piece of existence in this town!

Do not let the fugitive escape! At any cost!
Soldier: Yes, sir!
Tatiana: What are they doing?
We saw a soldier approach a nearby house.
Villager: Hey! What are you-?!
Pup: He just broke in! Are they going to tear apart the 
city?!
Tatiana: W- Why would they...?
Shopkeep: I... I'm going to close up shop for the day! You can 
pay for the trout later!
I watched as the shopkeep ran off towards another 
part of the town.
Pup: Goddess dammit...

(What do I do? Everyone else is scattered around 
town!)
passages.content_zh:
不夜鴉們正前往一個新的地方
他們旅程中的眾多目的地之一。

沿著這條路，他們遇到了一個中等大小的
他們可以在裡面休息和補給的村莊。
店家：龍蝦新鮮！中午前20%折扣！

來拿你的龍蝦吧！如此新鮮，你會認為自己是
自己去海邊游泳吧！
Pup：（為什麼要給超級新鮮的龍蝦打折？我想
我聞到了一點善意的謊言。 ）
我走近食品攤。
店家：歡迎光臨，歡迎光臨！晚上的龍蝦
晚餐？
小狗：我的血有點豐富。
小狗：你們有鱒魚庫存嗎？
店主：不錯的選擇！讓我看看...
遠離集鎮的景象，有些轟隆隆
來自馬蹄和鋼靴的嘎嘎聲
耳膜。
村民：那些是…？
另一個村民：也許我們應該搬家。
小狗：嗯…
看著鱒魚，我不確定實際上是如何
很新鮮。
小狗：我可以嗎？
店員：當然可以。我不會要求你不相信你的
自己的感官。
小狗：謝謝。
我拿起一條魚，往後退了幾步
快步去聞它的新鮮程度
其他魚。
小狗：*聞聞*...

（聞起來不像是變質了……我想？）

（我可能可以-）
小狗：咕嚕！
小狗：什麼——？ ！
我轉身看到一名惱怒的士兵低下頭
在我身上。
士兵：看你往哪裡走！
小狗：你打我了。
我看向周圍的地面。

我手裡拿的魚被水覆蓋了
周圍的污垢。
店主：我的－我的產品？ ！
小狗：該死的女神…
小狗：你願意付錢嗎？
士兵：付錢買……一條魚？哈哈哈！你不知道是誰
你正在說話，是嗎？
小狗：最低工資的僱工？
士兵：哼。也許我們應該給你一個教訓？

你磨損了我的盔甲。你對待我們怎麼樣
一頓美味的魚晚餐？
其他士兵都聚集到了周圍
首先。他們開始和他一起咯咯地笑。
小狗：嘖。我...
塔蒂亞娜：嘿女士們~

沒有我就閒聊嗎？
小狗：啊？
我轉身看到一個和我年紀相仿的女孩坐在
我以前去過的食品攤。
塔蒂亞娜：你知道…八卦經常發生

passages.name: Paralogue1 Post Story - Tatiana Recluited
passages.content:
Noble Officer: You... disgusting... insect!
Tatiana: Hmph. Got what he deserved.
Villager: Ahhh! The- The soldier is dead!?
Tatiana: Tell everyone that the Armored Bandit is to be 
feared!
Villager: Eek!
The villagers around the fight all ran off well away 
from our group.
Tatiana: *Sigh*... Maybe that'll keep those assholes down 
for a bit.

I'd hate for this sort of thing to happen again...
Tatiana released the magic she was using on the 
armor and it fell to the ground around her.

With another swipe of her hand, the armor came 
together into a bundle like it was magnetized.
Charlotte: What's this now?
Tatiana: It's easier to carry like this.
Charlotte: No... I mean... everything.
Pup: Well...
Pup: Is it okay to tell?
Tatiana: I guess. You bunch seem alright. You did help keep 
this asshole from harassing the whole town.
I did my best to explain the situation.
Charlotte: The "Armored Bandit"?
Pup: Have you heard of her?
Charlotte: It's a boogeyman story they tell in the halls of 
nobility.

And probably an older story than this girl is.
Tatiana: You're not that much older than me
Rowan: I believe the point our fair lady was trying to make 
was less accusatory than that.
Rowan: If the tale predates your activity, then it is likely 
people made the connection between the two 
rather than you inspiring it.
Rowan: Quite a clever bit of luck. To grasp onto reputation 
beyond your own.
Tatiana: Well, I've never heard of it.
Charlotte: It's sort of beside the point.

Knowing the idiot local nobility here, they're 
probably going to get more aggressive.

They may truly tear this town down to nothing just 
to chase the "evil" boogeyman they grew up 
hearing about.
Tatiana: No way...

I need to get out of here, then. Maybe I can...
Pup: We can't just let that happen, either.
Rowan: Indeed, but what to do?

Perhaps if we intercept any rumors and remove the 
"Armored Bandit"'s involvement?

That would quell the deep seated fears that 
motivate the nobles.
Charlotte: I don't think we could stop that knowledge from 
getting out at this point.
Charlotte: I've got a better idea, anyways.
Tatiana: ...
Tatiana looked onto the group planning up a 
method to help her and the town.
Tatiana: Maybe they really are okay people...?
Pup: Sorry, what was that?
Tatiana: Nah. Nothing to worry about.
Villager: Is that...?
Villager: The- The Armored Bandit?!

He's heading out of town!
The crowd just watched as Tatiana gave them a 
small performance.
Tatiana: This should direct their attention away from the 
town, at least.
Everyone gathered in the plains nearby.
Charlotte: You should try to keep your head down for a while.

Don't give them a trail to follow by calling attention 
to yourself.
Rowan: Mayhap you start a career as an actress? Star in a 
play about the Armored Bandit's legend?
Charlotte: *Sigh*... That might actually work. In a weird 
way...
Tatiana: Actually...
Tatiana: Maybe I could tag along with you guys for a while?

I could stay out of sight while also getting some 
chances to help people.
Pup: You wouldn't be the first criminal in our group, I 
suppose...
Otis: What's one more? We can party harder!
Rowan: ...
Charlotte: I guess it would be foolish to turn down good 
help...
Tatiana: Perfect!
Tatiana grabbed Charlotte's shoulders.
Tatiana: Keep being not assholes and we'll get along great.
Charlotte: I- Uh... Right...
Swinging away from Charlotte, Tatiana swung her 
arm around my shoulder.
Tatiana: I get the feeling us ladies will make a great team!
Pup: ...
Pup: In regards to that... There's something I need to 
let you know...
Tatiana: ...
Tatiana: ...

...What?
passages.content_zh:
貴族軍官：你... 噁心的... 蟲子！
塔蒂亞娜：哼。罪有應得。
村民：啊啊！士、士兵死了！？
塔蒂亞娜：告訴所有人，武裝盜賊是令人畏懼的！
村民：咿！
戰鬥周圍的村民都跑得遠遠的，離開了我們這群人。
塔蒂亞娜：*嘆氣*... 也許這樣能讓那些混蛋安靜一陣子。

我真不想再發生這種事了...
塔蒂亞娜解除了她施加在盔甲上的魔法，盔甲掉落在她周圍的地上。

她又揮了一下手，盔甲像被磁化了一樣聚成一團。

夏洛特：不... 我是說... 所有的一切。
帕普：嗯...
帕普：可以說嗎？
塔蒂亞娜：我想可以。你們這群人看起來還不錯。你們確實幫忙阻止了這個混蛋騷擾整個城鎮。
我盡力解釋了情況。
夏洛特：「武裝盜賊」？
帕普：妳聽說過她？
夏洛特：那是貴族大廳裡流傳的嚇唬人的故事。

而且可能比這個女孩還要古老。
塔蒂亞娜：妳沒比我大多少
羅文：我相信我們這位美麗的女士想表達的重點，並非指責。
羅文：如果這個故事早於妳的活動，那麼很可能是人們將兩者聯繫起來，而不是妳啟發了它。

了解這裡愚蠢的當地貴族，他們可能會變得更具侵略性。

他們可能會真的把這個城鎮夷為平地，只是為了追捕他們從小聽到大的「邪惡」嚇唬人的東西。

我需要離開這裡，然後。也許我可以...
