這樣可以平息貴族們根深蒂固的恐懼。
夏洛特：我不...

passages.name: Paralogue1 Post Story - Tatiana not recluited
passages.content:
Noble Officer: Damn you... bastards!
The girl from before ran up and saw the 
commander as he fell.
Tatiana: Hmph. Got what he deserved.
Villager: Ahhh! The- The soldier is dead!?
Tatiana: I saw the Armored Bandit landed the killing blow! 
Tell everyone to flee!
Pup: What?
The girl began to flee herself, but turned to give 
me a wink and smile in her departure.
Charlotte: The Armored Bandit?
Charlotte: That's a boogeyman tale that is passed around as a 
rumor in noble hallways.

Why would she...?
Pup: I saw her before and was hearing about this myth. 
The soldiers were looking for that Armored Bandit,
even.
Pup: Maybe she wanted to shift the blame away from
us?
Charlotte: On us would be better, though? The nobles might 
attack this place again if they think their 
boogeyman is here.
Pup: Maybe she didn't realize?
Pup: She was pretty confident in them not finding the 
Armored Bandit, though.
Rowan: Intriguing. You don't think...?
Pup: N- No way...
Pup: Could that even be possible? For someone with her 
size and frame?
Charlotte: They do say the Armored Bandit is a giant...
All of us stood there, silent, for what was likely a 
minute but felt like much longer.
Pup: (I wonder if we'll ever meet that girl again?)
passages.content_zh:

之前那個女孩跑了過來，看到指揮官倒下。

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Start
passages.content:

to hunt.

Let's just start.

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - End of turn 1
passages.content:
Castel: Argh...!

B- Back away!
Beast: Rrargh!
Castel: I had enough to deal with already with the imperial
soldiers...!
Soldier: You're not getting away this time!

Castel: Summonings, go!
Shade: ...
Castel: N- Now! Protect me!

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Talk to Castel
passages.content:
Castel: U- Uh...?!
Unknown_4294967295: Alright, we're here.
Unknown_4294967295: Alright, we're here.
Kara: Professor Balreig, we've arrived to help-!
Kara: N- No!
Kara ran over to the body of Castel lying limp on 
the ground.
Castel?: ...?
Rowan: Ah! Were we too late to save the damsel in distress?
Mariel: I'm sorry, but... there's no signs of life. No
breathing... no... anything...
Charlotte: He doesn't look... like he's... breathing.
Pup: Of... Of course...

(Time after time, we just keep...)
Castel: Ah... Lady Lyons?
Kara: ...!
Kara turned towards the figure, with fiery fingertips
ready to strike.
Castel: N- N- N- No! It's me!

I'm here. I'm Professor Balreig!
..........
Charlotte: Huh?
Norde: Why is a shade talking?
Pup: Shades... aren't those... like magical rats?
Norde: Correct.

They can mimic the silhouette of anything and are 
beast enough to have their actions controlled.

Summoners will commonly use them as a base for 
their pawns, as a result.
Kara: ...
Castel: I- I- I tried to summon another shade, and... next
thing I knew...
Kara: You somehow transferred your soul to the new body.
Castel: Yes, indeed! I did-
Castel: I did... that...
Pup: I... I'm not sure I get it.
Charlotte: Yeah, me neither. That's not exactly something I 
can imagine when compared to my engineering 
experience.
Rowan: It is quite simple, my dear friends...
Rowan: It merely means we have a damsel even more 
enchanting than before~
Rowan approached Castel in his new form.
Rowan: We shall assist you however we can.
Castel: S- Stay back!

What are... Who even are you all!? Are you the 
ones who invaded the Kingdom?!
The ethereal like form of Castel dropped into a 
mage's battle stance.
Castel: I wasn't so dumb as to not retrieve my heirloom, 
at least! I can and will fight!
Kara: ...

Professor Balreig...

Castel...

We can fix this.
Castel: ...
Castel's panicked panting subsided as he scanned 
Kara and the group.
Castel: Hah... Then... my apologies. I let myself get ahead 
of myself.

With Lady Lyons with you, I know I can trust you 
enough to stick with you, at least.
Castel: Lady Lyons and others. If I may accompany you? At 
least until I can fix my body.
Pup: What's one more mouth to feed?
Castel joins the party!
passages.content_zh:
Castel: 嗚... 嗚...?!
Unknown_4294967295: 好了，我們到了。
Unknown_4294967295: 好了，我們到了。
Kara: 巴爾雷格教授，我們來幫忙了-!
Kara: 不... 不！
Kara跑向倒在地上，奄奄一息的Castel的屍體旁。
Castel?: ...?
Rowan: 啊！我們是不是太晚來救這位落難少女了？
Mariel: 對不起，但是... 沒有生命跡象。沒有呼吸... 沒有... 任何東西...
Charlotte: 他看起來... 好像... 沒有呼吸。
Pup: 當... 當然...

(一次又一次，我們總是...)
Castel: 啊... 萊昂斯女士？
Kara: ...!
Kara轉向那個身影，指尖燃燒著火焰，準備攻擊。
Castel: 不... 不... 不... 不要！是我！

我在這裡。我是巴爾雷格教授！
..........
Charlotte: 蛤？
Norde: 為什麼陰影在說話？
Pup: 陰影... 不就是... 像魔法老鼠那種東西嗎？
Norde: 沒錯。

它們可以模仿任何東西的輪廓，而且是足以被控制的野獸。

因此，召喚師通常會用它們作為僕從的基礎。
Kara: ...
Castel: 我... 我... 我試著召喚另一個陰影，然後... 下一件事我知道的就是...
Kara: 你不知怎麼地把你的靈魂轉移到新的身體裡了。
Castel: 沒錯，的確！我做了-
Castel: 我做了... 那件事...
Pup: 我... 我不太明白。
Charlotte: 對啊，我也是。這和我工程方面的經驗相比，實在很難想像。
Rowan: 這很簡單，我親愛的朋友們...
Rowan: 這僅僅意味著我們現在有了一個比以前更迷人的少女～
Rowan走向了新形態的Castel。
Rowan: 我們會盡我們所能幫助你。
Castel: 退... 退後！

你們是... 你們到底是什麼人！？你們是入侵王國的人嗎？！
Castel那如精靈般的形態擺出了法師的戰鬥姿勢。
Castel: 我還沒笨到沒有取回我的傳家寶，至少！我可以而且會戰鬥！
Kara: ...

巴爾雷格教授...

Castel...

我們可以解決這個問題。
Castel: ...
Castel恐慌的喘息聲平息下來，他掃視著Kara和團隊。
Castel: 哈... 那麼... 我很抱歉。我太過於衝動了。

passages.content:
Rowan: What lovely hair you have cascading down your 
back~

It is like glass in its beauty.
Castel: Ugh...

回來~

它的美麗就像玻璃一樣。
卡斯特爾：呃…
羅文：啊！親愛的，有事嗎？ ！

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Kara → Otis
passages.content:
Otis: So, pretty little noble lady has hunted before?
Kara: As a necessity, but yes.

And, after all, some nobles do need to hunt. Minor
ones, especially.
Otis: Well?

It get ya off-kiltered to be hurtin' them animals like
the other nobles who never had to?
Kara: Oh, I am quite neutral on the subject.

I've neither the stature of a huntswoman nor the
resolve to fight for the Goddess's creatures.
Otis: Eh. The "Goddess's creatures"? Quite 
complimentary of you to the latter in ya phrasin'.

Ya sure you're okay with killin' the critters yourself?
Kara: People will do what they must.

But if we allow ourselves to forget the ideals, then 
we lose sight of a better tomorrow.

Such is the balance of life.
Otis: We're talkin' about huntin', right?
Kara: *Giggle* ... That we are.
passages.content_zh:
奧提斯：所以，漂亮的小貴族小姐以前打過獵？
卡拉：迫於生計，打過。

而且，畢竟，有些貴族確實需要打獵。尤其是那些小貴族。
奧提斯：嗯？

像那些從來不用打獵的貴族一樣，傷害那些動物會讓你感到不適嗎？
卡拉：喔，我對這個話題相當中立。

我既沒有獵人的身手，也沒有為女神的生物而戰的決心。
奧提斯：呃。「女神的生物」？妳用詞的後半段倒是挺恭維的。

妳確定妳自己殺那些小動物沒問題嗎？
卡拉：人們會做他們必須做的事。

但如果我們放任自己忘記理想，那我們就會失去對美好明天的憧憬。

這就是生命的平衡。
奧提斯：我們是在說打獵，對吧？
卡拉：*輕笑* ... 沒錯。

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Flynn → Tatiana
passages.content:
Tatiana: Eh! Get back here, ya beast!

Tatiana: Huh?

Tatiana: ...
Tatiana: Gotcha. Stealth mode it is.

Thanks.
Tatiana: Now I'll hunt ya down, you annoying little...!
Tatiana clamored off... more quietly.

for once.
passages.content_zh:
塔蒂亞娜：呃！回到這裡吧，野獸！
Flynn：你進場時需要保持安靜。
塔蒂亞娜：啊？

塔蒂亞娜：…
塔蒂亞娜：明白了。這是隱身模式。

謝謝。

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Satia → Atticus
passages.content:
Atticus: On your left.
Satia: You seem quite experienced in tracking prey.
Atticus: Yes... In such a remote location, supply drops often
are delayed.
Atticus: And even before the Vault, life does not always go 
the way you want.

Satia: Though that was small fry in comparison to these
beasts.
Satia: But it did help develop a skill I could use later with
the Crows.
Atticus: Haha... One man's crisis is another's life lesson at
times, it seems.
passages.content_zh:
阿提克斯：在你左邊。
薩蒂亞：你追蹤獵物的經驗似乎很豐富。
阿提克斯：是的... 在這種偏遠的地方，補給常常
會延遲。
阿提克斯：而且就算在寶庫之前，人生也不總是
如你所願。
阿提克斯：妳呢？妳看起來也很熟悉。
薩蒂亞：我有時也遇到過類似的困境。
薩蒂亞：雖然跟這些
野獸比起來，那只是小菜一碟。
薩蒂亞：但它確實幫助我培養了一項技能，之後我可以在
烏鴉幫派中使用。
阿提克斯：哈哈... 有時，一個人的危機是另一個人的
人生課題，看來是這樣。

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Jakson → Reagyn
passages.content:
Jakson: *Sniff sniff* ...?

*Directional bark* !
Reagyn: You found one?!

Hrrraaaaaggghhh!!!

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Story
passages.content:
Our journey had taken us to many lands.
But through those trials and tribulations, a certain
truth became self evident.
Rowan: *Stomach growling*...
Charlotte: I actually heard that.
Pup: *Stomach growling*...
Charlotte: And another?!
Charlotte: I wonder if we could get them in sequence? Like a
chorus?
Norde: I think it just means we've reached lunchtime.
Mariel: That does sound nice right now.
Rowan: A splendid proposition.
Pup: Mmm...
As with our many lengthy treks, we had prepared 
rations to expedite the meal process for such a big 
group.
Flynn: ...
Otis: ...!
Taking shifts to ensure we couldn't be ambushed, 
we started during our break in our march.
Rowan: Ah, that does hit the spot at times like these~
As Rowan chowed down, I looked on from a seat 
off to the side of the wider group.
Pup: ...
It was a basic bread roll.
Pup: Hmm...
I took a bite.
Pup: ...
Pup: *Sigh*...
The blandness of it got to me.
After an extensive last few days, I felt emotionally
exhausted.
This blandness was the lack of frosting on the
metaphorical cake.
Pup: (I feel like we've had only bread for the past several
days, too.)
Apparently, my sigh was enough to attract 
attention.
Satia: Are you okay?
Charlotte: Fan of the food?
Kara: Perhaps it is due to the bread.

We've run out of some of our designated ration 
stock.
Kara seemed to be choosing her words very 
carefully. Each one a little more deliberate than I 
was used to.
Pup: (I think she's trying to be nice...)
Pup: (But regardless of that, if we're out of meat and
stuff...)
Charlotte: I guess it has been sometime since we could resupply in
a town.
Kara: Indeed. It was unfortunate that the last village's
disrupted supply lines left its stocks so depleted.
Charlotte: Where is the closest town?
Pup: Norde might know, but we don't operate a ton in 
this area.
Kara: We should have enough to get by on our current path.
Charlotte: Just trying to live on the pile of bread we have
left...
Pup: Urgh...
I turned away from the two with my instinctual and
tired grunt.
Kara: Hmm...
Kara: There is one option.
Charlotte: I knew a little poking and prodding could get a
solution out of you~
Pup: What do we have to do?
Standing to my feet, I was at full attention.
Kara: In times of revolution, armies would often need to
resupply outside of traditional supply lines.

By hunting. And by foraging.
Pup: I can do that!
Pup: The crows are rarely all that far from a proper 
outpost, but we have had some times of 
scarcity where we needed to hunt.
Charlotte: Uh... Where would we do that? Is there a health 
risk on the food?
Kara: I have enough experience to ensure safety.
Kara: As for where, we'll likely need to find a place for a
small detour...

I imagine there is a half decent spot along our
current path.
passages.content_zh:
我們的旅程帶領我們前往許多土地。
但經歷了那些考驗和磨難，一個
真理變得不證自明。
Rowan: *肚子咕嚕叫*...
Charlotte: 我真的聽到了。
Pup: *肚子咕嚕叫*...
Charlotte: 又一個？！
Charlotte: 我在想我們能不能讓它們按順序來？像個
合唱團？
Norde: 我想這只是意味著我們到午餐時間了。
Mariel: 現在聽起來真不錯。
Rowan: 真是個絕妙的提議。
Pup: 嗯...
如同我們許多漫長的跋涉一樣，我們準備了
口糧，以加快這麼大一群人的用餐過程。
Flynn: ...
Otis: ...！
輪流值班以確保我們不會遭到伏擊，
我們在行軍休息期間開始用餐。
Rowan: 啊，在這種時候真是恰到好處～
當Rowan狼吞虎嚥時，我從
較大群體一側的座位上看著。
Pup: ...
那是一個基本的麵包卷。
Pup: 嗯...
我咬了一口。
Pup: ...
Pup: *嘆氣*...
它的平淡讓我感到厭煩。
經過過去幾天漫長的旅程，我感到情緒
疲憊不堪。
這種平淡就像是隱喻蛋糕上缺少了糖霜。
Pup: (我覺得我們過去幾天都只吃麵包了。)
顯然，我的嘆息足以引起
注意。
Satia: 你還好嗎？
Charlotte: 喜歡這食物嗎？
Kara: 也許是因為麵包的緣故。

我們已經用完了一些指定的口糧
庫存。
Kara似乎在非常
小心地選擇她的措辭。每一個都比我
習慣的更加深思熟慮。
Pup: (我想她想表現得友善...)
Pup: (但無論如何，如果我們沒有肉和
其他東西...)
Charlotte: 我想距離我們上次在
城鎮補給已經有一段時間了。
Kara: 確實。不幸的是，上次村莊的
供應線中斷導致其庫存如此耗盡。
Charlotte: 最近的城鎮在哪裡？
Pup: Norde可能知道，但我們在這個
地區的活動不多。
Kara: 我們應該有足夠的食物來維持我們目前的路線。
Charlotte: 只是試圖靠我們剩下的那堆麵包
活下去...
Pup: 呃...
我轉身背對著她們，內心...

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Castel recruited
passages.content:
Castel: *Pant*... Is that... all of them?
Norde: Clear in this section.
Norde: FLANK.
Uncharacteristically, Norde yelled across the
battlefield to get the all clear.
Crow: Clear over here!
The voice was difficult to hear, but audible.
Castel: Who are... Who are you all?
Kara: Professor Balreig.
Kara inserted herself into Castel's vision.
Castel: Ah, Lady Lyons.
Castel: It is a pleasure to-

...
Castel: ...my glasses.
Charlotte: Glasses? Those would still be with the...
Charlotte: The uh... yeah...
Charlotte: Do you still need them, though?
Castel: I guess... not.
Castel: I feel naked without them, though.
Castel: But... I will simply have to adjust.

For now my focus should be on getting my body 
back.
Charlotte: Uh...
Castel: ...What?
Kara: Professor, this is something we will need to account
for immediately in our efforts.
Kara gave a meaningful look.
Castel: Blasted, did my body last so little time without a
soul?
Kara: From what I heard of such an event before, your 
body loses the instinct to do vital processes when 
the soul is removed.
Castel: "Heard before"?
Kara: Only rumors. But, between that and your 
misfortune here, it does make one thing clear.

It is controllable.
Kara: If you master the technique you used and your 
summoning abilities, then you can reconstruct your 
body.
Castel: Ah, very true. Very true indeed.
Castel: Maybe I can craft an even better body...
Charlotte: I guess you weren't all that attached to it, then.
Rowan: And who would be with such an upgrade as we see before
us?
Castel: Hm? What you do you mean?
Rowan: It is simple, my dear.
Rowan: Beautiful hair with the aura of stained glass...

A wisp of shadow forming a gown like those of an 
opera diva...
Rowan: All framing a form that is a delight to the eyes.
Rowan: For an accident, you chose a body of exquisite taste.
Castel: ...
Charlotte: I think you broke him.
Kara: If... a female form makes you uncomfortable, you 
may be able to take solace in it being reversible.
Kara: You'd still need to make that scientific 
breakthrough, but if anyone was equipped to...
Castel: ...
Castel: I- I... How are you all taking this in stride?!
Kara: Ah, that element.
Eyes shifted to me.
Pup: ...
Charlotte: To say it's become a familiar revelation... wouldn't 
be wrong.
Rowan: Yes, it seems the Goddess smiles upon us.
Pup: (I really don't need this right now.)
Castel: Ah, you! That girl!
Pup: Hey, can-
Castel hustled up to my face.
Castel: The one cursed by the Oathbreaker to become a woman.
Pup: You know it really isn't that simple and-
Castel: Yes.
Castel: Yes, this is serendipitous.

I had my regrets over not fixing you before, and 
now fate has given me all the motivation I need to 
solve these mysteries~
Pup: I really wouldn't call it the same thing.

Aren't... Aren't you like... a rat, technically?
Castel: ...
Castel: Ah...!?
Kara: A shade is a magically imbued rodent type creature,
yes.
Kara: They've developed the ability to imprint a 
silhouette of any creature at a young age.

They can take that form as a defense mechanism 
against predators.
Kara: An... example of this silhouette being...
Castel: ...
Pup: So yeah, you're a rat.
Kara: A 'rodent' would be more technically correct.
Rowan: I'm sure you're a cute rat, too.
Kara: No, a...
Kara: *Sigh*...
Castel: ...
Castel: *Exhale*
Castel took a few steps back from Pup.
Pup: Hmph...
Castel: Very well.
Castel: Then it is but one more challenge to overcome.
Castel: Goddess, I take on your trials with vigor!
Castel: Come now, all! We have work to do!
Castel started marching off in a direction.
Pup: ...
Pup: Is that even the way we need to go?
Norde: What we NEED to do is collect the hunted meat 
and store it.
Kara: Yes, it seems our dining tent will be greeted with 
two new upheavals soon.
Rowan: Both graciously welcomed~
Pup: That... does sound pretty good right about now.
passages.content_zh:
Castel：*喘氣*...那是...全部嗎？
Norde：本節內容清楚。
諾德：側翼。
諾德一反常態地大喊大叫
戰場一切都清楚了。
烏鴉：清除這裡！
聲音很難聽，但還是聽得見。
Castel：誰……你們是誰？
卡拉：巴爾雷格教授。
卡拉將自己融入卡斯特爾的視野中。
卡斯特：啊，萊昂斯女士。
Castel：很高興——

…
Castel：……我的眼鏡。
夏綠蒂：眼鏡？那些仍然會與...
夏洛特：呃……是的……
夏洛特：不過你還需要它們嗎？
Castel：我想……不是。
Castel：不過，沒有它們我就感覺赤身裸體。
Castel：但是……我只需要調整。

現在我的重點應該是讓我的身體
回來。
夏洛特：呃…
卡斯特：……什麼？
卡拉：教授，這是我們需要考慮的事情
立即在我們的努力中。
卡拉露出意味深長的表情。
Castel：該死，我的身體在沒有任何東西的情況下持續了這麼短的時間嗎？
靈魂？
卡拉：據我之前聽過這樣的事件，你的
當身體失去進行重要過程的本能時
靈魂被移除。
卡斯特：「以前聽過」？
卡拉：只是謠言。但是，在那和你之間
不幸在這裡，確實說明了一件事。

它是可控的。
卡拉：如果你掌握了你所使用的技術和你的

Castel：啊，非常正確。確實非常正確。
Castel：也許我可以打造出更好的身體…
夏洛特：那我想你對它沒有那麼執著。
羅文：誰會像我們之前看到的那樣進行這樣的升級
我們？
卡斯特爾：嗯？你什麼意思？
羅文：很簡單，親愛的。
羅文：美麗的頭髮，帶著彩色玻璃的光環…

一縷影子，形成一襲長袍
歌劇女主角...
羅文：所有的一切都構成了令人賞心悅目的形式。
羅文：一次偶然，你選擇了品味精緻的身體。
卡斯特：…
夏洛特：我想你傷透他了。
卡拉：如果…女性形態讓你不舒服，你
也許可以從它的可逆性中得到安慰。
卡拉：你還是會

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Castel NOT recruited
passages.content:
Castel: *Pant*...  *Pant*...
Castel: I- Is that all of them?
A rustling sound could be heard from nearby.
Rowan: Oh damsel~?
Castel: Ah!
Castel scattered off into the distance.
Castel: I- I can... then I can...
He did so while formulating plans on how to deal 
with his new situation.
All without...
Kara: Hmm...?
The group entered the area.
Charlotte: No sign of the professor?

Might've we just been mistaken?
Kara: It isn't impossible.
Norde: We've completed the resupply hunt, at least.

Pup: That... does sound pretty good right now.

卡斯特爾: *喘*... *喘*...
卡斯特爾: 這- 這樣就全部了嗎？
附近傳來一陣窸窣聲。
羅文: 喔，小妞～？
卡斯特爾: 啊！
卡斯特爾慌忙逃向遠方。
卡斯特爾: 我- 我可以... 那我可以...
他一邊逃跑，一邊擬定計畫，思考該如何應對
他現在的處境。
一切都...
卡拉: 嗯...?
一行人進入了該區域。
夏洛特: 沒有教授的蹤影？

或許... 我們只是搞錯了？
卡拉: 並非不可能。
諾德: 至少我們完成了補給狩獵。

passages.name: Norde Paralogue END - END STory
passages.content:
Raider Leader: Who the fuck are you lot?!
Norde: Why are YOU attacking a village of teenagers and
children?
Raider Leader: Tsk. Not gonna take shit from a fucking lizard!
Norde: ...
Raider Leader: Ya just gonna-!
Raider Leader: I- I... ugh...!
Soldier: R- Run...!

The commander is down! The commander is down!

RUN!!!
Pup: *Pant*... Is that enough...?
Pup: (They're not exactly all that coordinated, but...)
What was left of the raiding soldiers started to
scatter.
Norde: Good... Everyone got out safely.
Norde: Run! Your type of trash is no longer welcome here!
Soldier: Damn... playing guardian for the brats?! They made 
a deal with a lizard beast!
A few raiders threw some less than kind words our 
way as they ran, and took some lazy swings our 
way as they passed.
I raised my own sword to deflect a swing and 
scuttled towards a more defensible position.
Pup: ...!

(Good, keep running.)
My eyes drifted towards Norde, who seemed like 
he was starting to relax a little.
Norde: Thank the goddess...
Norde: ...
But as I saw that, another sight came into the 
corner of my vision.
Sonth: Here, get to...
...and to his side.
Pup: Ya stupid...!
Pup: SONTH!!!
Norde: What...?!
Sonth: ...?
It was as though in an instant.
Soldier: Argh...!?
A hand gripped around the raider's neck 
like a noose.
Norde: ...
A scene aligned above a crimson pool.
One that, without mistake, signaled an end.
Soldier: I- I- Ugh...!
He couldn't get a word out.
There was a crackling feeling that I could 
practically feel the edges of myself.
Orphan: M- Mister Norde. What are you...
Seeing the crimson from afar, one of the nearby 
orphans was the first to gather at a distance away.
Pup: Norde, you need to-
I began to run towards them.
Orphan: Wait. Sonth... Is Sonth...?
Soldier: B- B- Bast...ard... kid...!
Norde: ...!
Pup: (No, Norde, not in front of the kids...!)
Norde: Die.
The tightening grip was audible.
Pup: Ugh...!

(This feeling?!)

(It's like... like...)
The curse.
Pup: ...?!
Pup: (This is the same curse as I have?! I can feel it!)
A sensation from within my own chest emanated 
outwards, matching the feelings I had whenever
the curse was at its strongest.
Norde: ...
It was a feeling of reverberation.
As though the curse leaked so strongly from 
Norde's own aura that it created a resonance 
within my own soul.
As though whatever self control and willpower that 
had held it back so far broke like a dam.
Soldier: G- Good... Riddance... ya fuckin'... l- lizard...!
Norde: ...
Norde stepped forward.
And dropped his weight.
Down.
Fragments of the world's crust burst upwards, 
flanked by droplets of crimson carried by the 
same momentum.
Soldier: ......?!
No scream followed. There was no air to do so.
He stayed there, being grinded into the cracks of 
the crater... 

...by the person above who had not 
relinquished his grip.
Norde: ...You worthless... piece... of...
Pup: (Norde is... more beast like...?!)
As I reached Norde's side...
Soldier: ...............
The raider's arms fell. Any resistance gone from 
what was left.
Norde: ...worthless... piece of...!
Norde raised his arm to strike again.
Orphan: *Sniff*... No...!
Pup: Stop! He's already dead!
Norde: RRAAAAAAAAAAAGGGGGHHH!!!
I caught his arm, stopping him.
Pup: Norde... He's already dead.
Norde: ...a... worthless... piece of...
As I held his caught arm, I could feel his fist
tighten.
Pup: And you got him. Please try to-
Norde: I am... a worthless... pieces of garbage...
Pup: ...Norde...?

(The curse... That feeling, again...?)
The resonance made it feel like the curse itself was
leaking out, like steam into air.
A steam rose from him, and the heat was
accompanied by a shift in the change.
Norde: I'm a failure. I always have been.
Norde: Ivan... He'd had been better off leaving me to rot.

I've only proven to be... a disgrace to his legacy...
Pup: (His face... and hair...?!)
Pup: (This change, it is entirely different than before.
It's more like...)
Norde: I'm... no better than his own child. Just a stain... 
on what impact he tried to leave on the world...
Pup: (This is... him thinking we're the same. The same 
as he sees me. He's mirroring my changes.)
I let go of his arm, and he didn't strike the corpse.
Norde: A disgrace...
Norde: ...or a beast.
The changes were basic, but enough to see Norde 
being pulled in two different directions.

Each like reversberating in pure magical energy
and creating a smoke signal of the steam.
Norde: What is... even the point, anymore...?
Pup: (I've never seen him like this.)
Norde: What is even...!
Norde: ...the point!
His fist landed into the ground, cracking it at its
seams.
Orphan: ...Mister Norde...?
The other children had largely gathered now.
Norde: ...Leave me.
Norde: Whether beast or disgrace... I have... nothing left 
to offer.
Norde stood up, wobbly as he did.
And started walking away.
Orphan: That's not true!
He stopped.
Pup: They're right.
Pup: Norde... You are not worthless.

I've spent most of my life watching my father's 
back as he blazed forward like a comet.
Pup: All... I've ever wanted to do was to catch up, and 
do the same.
Pup: But... he's not the only one that I watched. You
trailed starlight too, even if it was in his wake.
I stood and turned to Norde, 
with his back facing me.
Pup: You've been my role model, too! My brother!
Norde: ...

Just... get the kids to-
Norde: ...?!
Norde: ...?!
Norde: ...Grrhhh...!
With his body changing rapidly, he landed on the 
ground with a thud.
Orphan: *Gasp*...?!
Pup: (It's not giving him a break!)
Running up to him, I tried to find the words.
Pup: (Norde... what do I even say?!)
[Choice]: We're not the same!  / You're better than these bandits! 
Pup: Norde, we'll never be the same.
Pup: I know... I know I haven't lived up to my father...

That I played a part... in why he died...
I stopped, and I took a deep breath 
before continuing.
Pup: But you are not me.
Pup: Norde, you're the one that I've looked towards if I
ever wondered what might my father do.
Pup: You're the closest thing I've ever knew to what my
father was to both of us.
Norde: ...I don't...
Norde: Urgh...?!
I could still feel the aura of the curse, and it
weakened.
But it did not disappear.
Norde: How could... just some animal... live up to... a
hero...?
Norde gritted his teeth as the curse's pull from
his worries over legacy became meek in
comparison.
Norde: Grrr...!
His scales grew, crawling up his face and across the
rest of his body.
His hands dug into the dirt. Each tightening of the
grip was accompanied by a more claw like hand.
I could see him grit his teeth, growling, as his
canines became more fang like. 

His eyes transforming more lizard like as 
they visually appeared with a slit type 
structure.
Pup: ...Norde!
Norde: GRRR....!
Orphan: No! You're not a beast! No beast would be sent by 
the goddess!
Norde: ...!?
Orphan: You've always been like... a star...! One sent from 
the sky by the goddess.

When you saved us before... Then again... and 
again... and even now...

How could such a savior be a beast?!
The children gathered around Norde.
Norde: You... You shouldn't rely on...
Orphan: The one who saved us?

The one who always shows up when things are
at their worst?
Norde: No... I...
Orphan: Mister Norde. You are our hero.
Norde: ...

You...
Norde's breathing... calmed...

I don't know how long we waited,
but he slowly normalized.
The effects of the curse had not faded physically, 
but it was clear a cloud over his mind was fading.
Norde: You... all deserve better.

But...
Norde: Thank you. All of you.
Norde's gaze landed on me as well, 
smile not wavering.
Norde: Perhaps... family can be a blessing... siblings,
included.
Pup: I... Yeah...
Pup: Yeah.
Norde: I just... need... a second...
Norde laid his head back. Falling asleep.
Pup: Norde, do you think you're no better than those
bandits?
Norde: You act as if it was just them.
His form continued to fluctuate.
Norde: They've never stopped telling me. Just... a beast.
Pup: And what does that make them?
Norde: What...?
Pup: If you're just a beast, what does that make those
scum?!

How low would they need to fall to make you a 
beast in comparison?
Pup: Norde... You are not a beast.
Pup: I know my father saw you as more than just the average
person, too.
Norde: ...I don't...
Norde: Urgh...?!
I could still feel the aura of the curse, and it
weakened.
But it did not disappear.

Steam continued to rise.
Norde: It doesn't matter. It never mattered if they were
right.

Beast... person... I've... only wasted the time 
that the goddess gave me.
Norde started breathing faster. 

The worries over any animalistic nature within 
him became meek in comparison to another.
Norde: I failed Ivan. I failed him. How can I ever call myself
anything but a disgrace...?
Norde's hair grew, in a sight I felt all too familiar.
Hands digging into the dirt... Each tightening of the
grip was accompanied by a slimmer set of fingers.
The armor started to sag. It no longer fit well, as
though in an instant... And I could guess easily 
what else started to change below.
Norde's breaths became deeper, and each inhale 
and exhale seemed to refine their face into one I 
had seen before.
Pup: Norde... I'm sorry.
Norde: This is... my stain. My disgrace.

I am sorry for ever pushing that shame on you.
Orphan: No! You're not a disgrace! You are an idol! No one
would ever be ashamed of you!
Norde: ...!?
Orphan: You've always been like... a star...! One sent from 
the sky by the goddess.

When you saved us before... Then again... and 
again... and even now...

How could such a savior ever disgrace their idol?!
The children gathered around Norde.
Norde: You... You shouldn't rely on...
Orphan: The one who saved us?

The one who always shows up when things
are at their worst?
Norde: No... I...
Orphan: You are our hero.
Norde: ...

You...
Norde's breathing... calmed...

I don't know how long we sat there waiting,
but it... was normalized.
The the effects of the curse were dramatic and did 
not fade physically. But a sense of mental clarity 
could be felt.
Norde: You... all deserve better.

But...
Norde: Thank you. All of you.
Norde's gaze landed on me as well, 
smile not wavering.
Norde: Perhaps... family can be a blessing... siblings,
included.
Pup: I... Yeah...
Pup: Yeah.
Norde: I just... need... a second...
Norde laid their head back. Falling asleep.
Once upon a time.
A rumor was born of a safe haven. A refuge from 
war and strife.
It was a tale of a promised land that spread 
through the whispering voices of war orphans.
"A society for us, by us." ...so the orphans said.
It was not real.
So the orphans decided to make the 
rumor a reality.
Bandit: Heh.
But with that sliver of truth for refuge came 
attention and violence.
Sonth: ...!?
Tragedy was fated.
Expected.
Unless...
Norde: ...
Unless those with the power to intervene 
chose to act.
Unless those unrelated...
...those uninvolved...
...those with nothing to gain...
...chose to make a better world.
Bandit: ...?!
Norde: ...
Orphan: *Sniff* ...
Pup: We'll have to find a new home for these kids.

So... what about after that?
Norde: ...
We stood among many.
Many of the displaced orphans that were saved.
And those that were not.
Pup: If people reacted poorly to you not being a homlyn
before, this will only make that worse.
Norde: ...
Norde's eyes scanned over the makeshift graves.
Pup: The Crows aren't going to care much, but...
Norde: Those who assumed it before will be the same to 
see me as such now.
Pup: But what if it gets worse? This is the curse, after
all.
Norde: Then I'll cross that bridge when it comes to it.
Pup: We're... sort of in the same boat now.
Pup: I'd offer to teach you a thing or two about it...
Pup: But I suspect you'd be teaching me before I knew 
it, haha...
Norde: ...
Norde's eyes stayed trained on the 
makeshift graves.
Pup: (I... don't think I'm helping.)
Pup: ...

I guess the curse has a one track mind at times.
Norde: ...
Norde: Heh... I guess it does, in a sense.

A palpable irony to it, even...
Looking over at Norde, the glint of laughter was 
only for that moment.
Pup: ...
Pup: *Sigh*... I'm sorry.
Pup: I guess this result is only natural for me at this
point.

My own failures dragging you down. Worrying that 
you'll end up like me...
Pup: Maybe all this misfortune could've been avoided in its
entirety.
Norde: No.
Pup: Huh?
Norde: My failures are my own to carry.

You did nothing wrong.
Pup: Norde, if I'm the source of one of the anchors that
weighed you down here, then...
Norde: Then it is still not your fault.
Norde: I would not blame the tree for a rotten apple that I
chose to eat.

You did nothing wrong. It is my fault for letting it
impact me as such.
The words settled on my mind.
Pup: (My fuck ups just keep spreading, don't they...?)
Norde: Anton... No, I mean...  *Sigh* ...
Norde: Anton...
Norde: I was wrong. You didn't kill Ivan.
Norde: I just...
Norde: *Exhale*...
Pup: Norde...?
Norde was taking deep breaths again.
This topic gave me a similar feeling of uneasiness.
Norde: A hero is someone that saves a soul.

One who holds great power, and wields it for those 
most vulnerable.
Norde: For them not to act... would they even be qualified 
to be called "good" anymore?

Could a man be a "good person" if they refuse to 
act despite having the power to make a difference?
Norde: To be called an admirable person, let alone a hero...
it would be a stain on the goddess's oath...
Pup: A thoroughly stained world, in that case...
Pup: Though we both know that.
Norde: As we also both know what its like to meet the
opposite. A true hero.
Pup: (After all the stories I heard of legends... to grow 
up seeing my father in action...)
Norde: Ivan was my hero. He saved my soul.

I owe him a greater debt than I could ever pay.
Norde: And at the same time, I am amongst his legacy...
Norde: We two are those left behind.

To be a good person. An admirable person. A hero, 
if we dared...
Norde: That... That is what I struggle with.

The question of whether I even can.
Norde: Whether either of us... as Ivan's legacy, can live up
to even the foundation he left behind.
Norde breathed in.
Norde: .........

*Exhale*...
Norde: As to not waste the chance he gave us.
Pup: (My father's legacy...)
I raised my hand and gripped it into a fist.
Pup: (Maybe that's also at the core of what I struggle 
over, too. At least in part.)

(That question... can I? Can Norde? Can anyone?)

...
I felt experience tell me an answer.
Knowing how much it could take for people to just 
get along and do their best for one another...
Pup: I don't know.
Norde: ...?
Pup: Peace is a struggle. A never ending one. After all,
ideals are far from homogenized...
Pup: *Sigh*...
Pup: Who knows? Maybe it's for the best.
I raised my hand to my chin, a thought spurring 
into my mind.
Pup: Whether we actually can live up to the power and 
will of his legacy... let alone if we actually do...

It's a mystery. But one that keeps pushing us.
Pup: Maybe we'll get there without even knowing. And 
maybe its best we don't realize if we do.
My instincts told me an answer.
A glint of my insight on others, and knowledge of 
how human nature can sway society...
Pup: Who knows?
Norde: ...?
Pup: All we can know are the smiles on the faces of 
those we help.
Pup: What other feedback can you get that you're on the
right track, after all?
I chuckled a little, rubbing my neck as 
though a little embarassed to say it aloud.
Pup: Just keep trying to be the sort of person that can 
make another smile...

Through heroics, laughter, or... anything else...
Pup: Who knows if we'll reach it? To have the ability and
will to be worthy of it.

But so long as we never stop trying, then we have 
a chance.
My gut told me an answer.
Through all our battles, I had an instinct for what
it'd take to get the future one may strive for...
Pup: No.
Norde: ...?
Pup: I don't think we'll ever know if we can reach that.

To have power and will enough to be worthy of it.
I lowered my hand to rest on my 
sheathed sword's hilt.
Pup: You just gotta keep trying. Step forward, blade at 
the ready to help when needed.

Even if we never reach it... Then at least we tried.
Norde: ...
Norde: I suppose so.

Perhaps you have gained more wisdom then I give 
you credit for.
Pup: ...Thank you, Norde.
Pup: You're not half-bad yourself.
Norde: Heh...
We stood there for a while, and watched over the
orphans as they each felt it was time to head out.
 
Each thanked us, especially Norde, for everything.
All until it was only us two left.
Pup: ...You know...

I remember a story my father once told me.

About how you got the name "Norde" because you 
misheard him saying to go "north".
Norde: And?
Pup: Just... a thought came to mind.
Pup: That first child we met when we came here.

"Sonth".
Pup: Who gave him his name?
Norde: ...
Norde: Well...
Norde: ...himself.
Pup: He was a good kid.
Norde: Indeed. 

I couldn't be more proud of him. 

Of all of them.

passages.name: Paralogue-Norde - New Event
passages.content:
Soldier: Ugh...!
Pup: *Pant*...  *pant*...
The soldier fell to the ground, having met a fate 
most deserving.
Pup: So...  *pant*... this is the place?
Norde: ...
Pup: Norde!
Norde: ...?
Norde: Yes. Yes, this is the place.
He stepped forward, staring forward as he moved 
towards the nearby village.
Or, more accurately...
What remained of it.
We hadn't stopped traveling for the better part of 
two days. We were working off just a few hours 
of sleep.
Norde had received a letter from, as he said, 'a 
group of children he once saved from a life 
threatening situation'.
Pup: (This doesn't look like a village that's been saved.
Not anymore.)
Norde: ...!
Another enemy down.
Norde: *Inhales slowly*... 

*Exhale*...
We had arrived on the scene, a small and normally
isolated village, only to find a raid in progress.
Pup: Have they been dealing with this all along?
Norde: No. The letter did not mention it.

It only mentioned a singular recent confrontation 
with a bandit group, and nothing in regards to 
imperial soldiers.
Norde: ...
Pup: So it's escalated since then.
Norde: Move. Faster.
Norde and I entered the village proper, 
with the other Crows that had tagged along 
not far behind.
Pup: This...?! This is...?!
Pup: How did... bandits did this?
Pup: How long have they been at this...?!
The village was more rough in certain parts, but at 
its worse, we saw several buildings had been 
stripped for parts.
Norde: ...
Norde scanned the village. Eyes dotting from hiding
place to hiding place.
There.
Norde: Sonth?
Norde dashed over to a partially collapsed wall.
Sonth: Mister... N- Norde...?
Norde: Sonth, it's going to be okay.
Sonth: You're... You're actually here...!
Norde: Just... take a deep breath.
Sonth: M- Mister... *sniff*...Norde...
Norde leaned in and...
...hugged the child.
Gently, like a big brother or father might.
In a way... I had never seen before.
Pup: Norde...?

(This is... a new side to him. Even with kids in
general.)

(Why is he like that with this kid specifically? Being
protective of a kid he saved before?)
Norde: I'm here now. I'll do whatever is necessary to resolve
this.
Sonth: T- Thank you...
The two stood back on their own, and Norde 
looked back to me before turning back to 
the child.
Norde: Please. Catch me up on the situation.
Sonth was able to compose himself, telling of the 
days since they sent Norde that letter.
Initially, they had come into contact with a few 
men from the Imperial Army moving through the 
area.
It was cordial, but a small incident with a local
shopkeep put each side on edge. That was when 
the letter was sent.
Ever since, the soldiers had started instigating 
more and more violent encounters.
And at a point, like the snapping of a twig 
underfoot, they stopped even pretending 
to keep it civil.
They became bandits, raiding the town for fun and
supplies at every opportunity.
Norde: My best guess would be that the unit deserted 
from the imperial military.

Perhaps its leadership was even thrown out and 
replaced by a more unhinged core.
Sonth: You... You really think that's why?
Pup: The soldiers we've come across have acted a lot 
more like bandits, at least. We've fought plenty of 
those before.
Pup: And I can't help but remember a story that this reminds
me of. One that another Crow told me about once.
Sonth: Who are you...?
Pup: Me...? I'm Pup.
Pup: I am part of the Nightless Crows mercenary 
company, just like Norde here.
Sonth: Does that mean... you're a hero, too?
Pup: Hero?
Pup: N- Nothing quite like that. I'm just half decent with 
a sword, really.
Pup: (..."Too"? Does that mean he sees Norde as a hero?)
Sonth: If Mister Norde trusts you, then so do I.
Pup: You can count on me.
Norde: Whether they're rogue imperial soldiers is probably
beside the point. At least currently.
Norde: Sonth, do you know where the others are? We need to get
you all the safety.
Sonth: But we don't have anywhere to go...
Norde: ...
Sonth: If anyone could get to safety...

I at least remember what direction the others
moved in when they attacked this time.

I... think they prefer to terrorize us than kill us, 
so hopefully they're all alright.
Pup: Just means we'll need to hurry before some stupid
soldier takes it too far.
Sonth: Y- Yeah.
Norde: Sonth, start laying out where everyone might be.

And for you and the others, retreat to-
Pup: I've got your back.
Pup: Can't leave a bunch of vulnerable kids out there at 
the mercy of these garbage people, after all.
Norde: It's my obligation to...
Norde: ...
Norde: No, of course.

Thank you. Pup.

士兵：嗚...！
小狗：*喘氣*... *喘氣*...
士兵倒在地上，得到了他應得的下場。
小狗：所以... *喘氣*... 這裡就是那個地方？
諾德：...
小狗：諾德！
諾德：...？
諾德：是的。是的，這裡就是那個地方。
他向前走去，目光直視前方，朝著附近的村莊走去。
或者，更準確地說...
是村莊的殘骸。
我們已經連續趕路將近兩天了。只睡了幾個小時。
諾德收到了一封信，正如他所說，是「一群他曾經從危險境地中救出的孩子」寄來的。
小狗：（這看起來不像一個被拯救過的村莊。
至少現在不像。）
諾德：...！
又一個敵人倒下了。
諾德：*緩慢吸氣*...

*呼氣*...
我們趕到了現場，一個小而通常與世隔絕的村莊，卻發現正在遭受襲擊。
小狗：他們一直都在應付這種事嗎？
諾德：不。信裡沒有提到。

信裡只提到最近與一群土匪發生過一次衝突，沒有提到帝國士兵。
諾德：...
小狗：所以情況從那時起就升級了。
諾德：走。快點。
諾德和我走進了村莊，其他跟隨而來的烏鴉們也緊隨其後。
小狗：這...？！這是...？！
小狗：怎麼會... 土匪做的？
小狗：他們這樣做了多久...？！
村莊的某些部分比較粗糙，但最糟糕的是，我們看到一些建築物被拆解了。
諾德：...
諾德掃視著村莊。目光從一個藏身之處移到另一個藏身之處。
找到了。
諾德：桑斯？
諾德衝向一堵部分倒塌的牆壁。
桑斯：諾... 諾德先生...？
諾德：桑斯，沒事的。
桑斯：你... 你真的來了...！
諾德：只要... 深呼吸。
桑斯：諾... 諾德先生... *抽泣*...
諾德俯身...
...擁抱了那個孩子。
輕輕地，就像一個大哥哥或父親可能會做的那樣。
在某種程度上... 我從未見過他這樣。
小狗：諾德...？

（這... 是他新的一面。即使是對待一般的孩子。）

（為什麼他對這個孩子特別...）

Norde gritted his teeth as the influences by his

Orphan: You've always been like... a star...! One sent from the

The children gathered around Norde.

STAGE DIRECTION> CHANGE TO FEMININE FORM

weakened.
But it didn't not disappear.
Norde: It doesn't matter. It never mattered if they were

Beast... person... I've... only wasted my time that the
goddess has given me.
Norde started breathing faster. The worries over any
animalistic nature within him became meek in comparison
to another.
Norde: I failed Ivan. I failed him. How can I ever call myself
anything but a disgrace...?
Norde's hair grew, in a sight I felt all too familiar.
Hands digging into the dirt... Each tightening of the
grip was accompanied by a slimmer set of fingers.
The armor started to sag. It no longer fit well, as
though in an instant... And I could guess easily what
else started to change below.
Norde's breaths became deeper, and each inhale and
exhale seemed to refine their face into one I had seen
before.
Pup: Norde... I'm sorry.
Norde: This is... my stain. My disgrace.

I am sorry for ever pushing that shame on you.
Orphan: No! You're not a disgrace! You are an idol! No one
would ever be ashamed of you!
Norde: ...!?
Orphan: You've always been like... a star...! One sent from the
sky by the goddess.

When you saved us before... Then again... and again...
and even now...

How could such a savior ever disgrace their idol?!
The children gathered around Norde.
Norde: You... You shouldn't rely on...
Orphan: The one who saved us?

The one who is always there when the night is its
darkest?
Norde: No... I...
Orphan: You are our hero.
Norde: ...

You...
Norde's breathing... calmed...
The the effects of the curse were dramatic and did not
fade physically. But a sense of mental clarity could be
felt.
Norde: You... all deserve better.

But...
Norde: Thank you. All of you.
Norde's gaze landed on me as well, smile not wavering.
Norde: Perhaps... family can be a blessing... siblings,
included.
Pup: I... Yeah...
Pup: Yeah.

Norde laid their head back. Falling asleep.

########### End of Choices

Once upon a time.
A rumor was born of a safe haven. A refuge from war and
strife.
It was a tale of a promised land that spread through
the whispering voices of war orphans.
"A society for us, by us." ...so the orphans said.
It was not real.
So the orphans decided to make the rumor a reality.
Bandit: Heh.
But with that sliver of truth of refuge came attention
and violence.
STAGE DIRECTION> FLASH RED, WAIT FOR IT
Sonth: ...!?
Tragedy was fated.
Expected.
Unless...
STAGE DIRECTION> CLASH SE, WAIT 60 FRAMES

Norde: ...
Unless those with the power to intervene chose to act.
Unless those unrelated...
...those uninvolved...
...those with nothing to gain...

BEAST

Norde: ...
Orphan: Sniff
...
Pup: We'll have to find a new home for these kids.

So... what about after that?
Norde: ...
We stood among many.
Many of the displaced orphans that were saved.
And those that were not.
#### If Norde Beast Flag
Pup: If people reacted poorly to you not being a homlyn
before, this will only make that worse.
Norde: ...
Norde's eyes scanned over the makeshift graves.
Pup: The Crows aren't going to care much, but...
Norde: Those who assumed it before will be the same to see me
as such now.
Pup: But what if it gets worse? This is the curse, after
all.
Norde: Then I'll cross that bridge when it comes to it.
STAGE DIRECTION> ###########
#### If Norde Fem Flag
Pup: We're... sort of in the same boat now.
Pup: I'd offer to teach you a thing or two about it...
Pup: But I suspect you'd be teaching me before I knew it,
haha...
Norde: ...
Norde's eyes stayed trained on the makeshift graves.
Pup: (I... don't think I'm helping.)
Pup: ...

I guess the curse has a one track mind at times.
Norde: ...
Norde: Heh... I guess it does, in a sense.

A palpable irony to it, even...
Looking over at Norde, the glint of laughter was only
for that moment.
STAGE DIRECTION> ###########
Pup: ...
Pup: Sigh
... I'm sorry.

point.

My own failures dragging you down. Worrying that you'll
end up like me...
Pup: Maybe all this misfortune could've been avoided in its

impact me as such.
The words settled on my mind.

...

One who holds great power, and wields it for those most

Norde: To be called an admirable person, let alone a hero...

Pup: Though we both know that.

I owe him a greater debt than I could ever pay.
Norde: And at the same time, I am amongst his legacy...
Norde: We two are those left behind.

To be a good person. An admirable person. A hero, if we
dared...
Norde: That... That is what I struggle with.

The question of whether I even can.
Norde: Whether either of us... as Ivan's legacy, can live up
to even the foundation he left behind.
Norde breathed in.
Norde: Exhale
...
Norde: As to not waste the chance he gave us.
Pup: (My father's legacy...)
I raised my hand and gripped it into a fist.
Pup: (Maybe that's also at the core of what I struggle over,

passages.content:
Raider Leader: Who the fuck are you lot?!
Norde: Why are YOU attacking a village of teenagers and
children?
Raider Leader: Tsk. Not gonna take shit from a fucking lizard!
Norde: ...
Raider Leader: Ya just gonna-!
Raider Leader: I- I... ugh...!
Soldier: R- Run...!

The commander is down! The commander is down!

RUN!!!
Pup: *Pant*... Is that enough...?
Pup: (They're not exactly all that coordinated, but...)
What was left of the raiding soldiers started to
scatter.
Norde: Good... Everyone got out safely.
Norde: Run! Your type of trash is no longer welcome here!
Soldier: Damn... playing guardian for the brats?! They made 
a deal with a lizard beast!
A few raiders threw some less than kind words our 
way as they ran, and took some lazy swings our 
way as they passed.
I raised my own sword to deflect a swing and 
scuttled towards a more defensible position.
Pup: ...!

(Good, keep running.)
My eyes drifted towards Norde, who seemed like 
he was starting to relax a little.
Norde: Thank the goddess...
Norde: ...
But as I saw that, another sight came into the 
corner of my vision.
Sonth: Here, get to...
...and to his side.
Soldier: Ya stupid...!
Pup: SONTH!!!
Norde: What...?!
Sonth: ...?
It was as though in an instant.
Soldier: Argh...!?
A hand gripped around the raider's neck 
like a noose.
Norde: ...
A scene aligned above a crimson pool.
One that, without mistake, signaled an end.
Soldier: I- I- Ugh...!
He couldn't get a word out.
There was a crackling feeling that I could 
practically feel the edges of myself.
Orphan: M- Mister Norde. What are you...
Seeing the crimson from afar, one of the nearby 
orphans was the first to gather at a distance away.
Pup: Norde, you need to-
I began to run towards them.
Orphan: Wait. Sonth... Is Sonth...?
Soldier: B- B- Bast...ard... kid...!
Norde: ...!
Pup: (No, Norde, not in front of the kids...!)
Norde: Die.
The tightening grip was audible.
Pup: Ugh...!

(This feeling?!)

(It's like... like...)
The curse.
Pup: ...?!
Pup: (This is the same curse as I have?! I can feel it!)
A sensation from within my own chest emanated 
outwards, matching the feelings I had whenever
the curse was at its strongest.
Norde: ...
It was a feeling of reverberation.
As though the curse leaked so strongly from 
Norde's own aura that it created a resonance 
within my own soul.
As though whatever self control and willpower that 
had held it back so far broke like a dam.
Soldier: G- Good... Riddance... ya fuckin'... l- lizard...!
Norde: ...
Norde stepped forward.
And dropped his weight.
Down.
Fragments of the world's crust burst upwards, 
flanked by droplets of crimson carried by the 
same momentum.
Soldier: ......?!
No scream followed. There was no air to do so.
He stayed there, being grinded into the cracks of 
the crater... 

...by the person above who had not 
relinquished his grip.
Norde: ...You worthless... piece... of...
Pup: (Norde is... more beast like...?!)
As I reached Norde's side...
Soldier: ...............
The raider's arms fell. Any resistance gone from 
what was left.
Norde: ...worthless... piece of...!
Norde raised his arm to strike again.
Orphan: *Sniff*... No...!
Pup: Stop! He's already dead!
Norde: RRAAAAAAAAAAAGGGGGHHH!!!
I caught his arm, stopping him.
Pup: Norde... He's already dead.
Norde: ...a... worthless... piece of...
As I held his caught arm, I could feel his fist
tighten.
Pup: And you got him. Please try to-
Norde: I am... a worthless... pieces of garbage...
Pup: ...Norde...?

(The curse... That feeling, again...?)
The resonance made it feel like the curse itself was
leaking out, like steam into air.
A steam rose from him, and the heat was
accompanied by a shift in the change.
Norde: I'm a failure. I always have been.
Norde: Ivan... He'd had been better off leaving me to rot.

I've only proven to be... a disgrace to his legacy...
Pup: (His face... and hair...?!)
Pup: (This change, it is entirely different than before.
It's more like...)
Norde: I'm... no better than his own child. Just a stain... 
on what impact he tried to leave on the world...
Pup: (This is... him thinking we're the same. The same 
as he sees me. He's mirroring my changes.)
I let go of his arm, and he didn't strike the corpse.
Norde: A disgrace...
Norde: ...or a beast.
The changes were basic, but enough to see Norde 
being pulled in two different directions.

Each like reverberating in pure magical energy
and creating a smoke signal of the steam.
Norde: What is... even the point, anymore...?
Pup: (I've never seen him like this.)
Norde: What is even...!
Norde: ...the point!
His fist landed into the ground, cracking it at its
seams.
Orphan: ...Mister Norde...?
The other children had largely gathered now.
Norde: ...Leave me.
Norde: Whether beast or disgrace... I have... nothing left 
to offer.
Norde stood up, wobbly as he did.
And started walking away.
Orphan: That's not true!
He stopped.
Pup: They're right.
Pup: Norde... You are not worthless.

I've spent most of my life watching my father's 
back as he blazed forward like a comet.
Pup: All... I've ever wanted to do was to catch up, and 
do the same.
Pup: But... he's not the only one that I watched. You
trailed starlight too, even if it was in his wake.
I stood and turned to Norde, 
with his back facing me.
Pup: You've been my role model, too! My brother!
Norde: ...

Just... get the kids to-
Norde: ...?!
Norde: ...?!
Norde: ...Grrhhh...!
With his body changing rapidly, he landed on the 
ground with a thud.
Orphan: *Gasp*...?!
Pup: (It's not giving him a break!)
Running up to him, I tried to find the words.
Pup: (Norde... what do I even say?!)
[Choice]: We're not the same!  / You're better than these bandits! 
Pup: Norde, we'll never be the same.
Pup: I know... I know I haven't lived up to my father...

That I played a part... in why he died...
I stopped, and I took a deep breath 
before continuing.
Pup: But you are not me.
Pup: Norde, you're the one that I've looked towards if I
ever wondered what might my father do.
Pup: You're the closest thing I've ever knew to what my
father was to both of us.
Norde: ...I don't...
Norde: Urgh...?!
I could still feel the aura of the curse, and it
weakened.
But it did not disappear.
Norde: How could... just some animal... live up to... a
hero...?
Norde gritted his teeth as the curse's pull from
his worries over legacy became meek in
comparison.
Norde: Grrr...!
His scales grew, crawling up his face and across the
rest of his body.
His hands dug into the dirt. Each tightening of the
grip was accompanied by a more claw like hand.
I could see him grit his teeth, growling, as his
canines became more fang like. 

His eyes transforming more lizard like as

structure.
Pup: ...Norde!
Norde: GRRR....!

Norde: ...!?
Orphan: You've always been like... a star...! One sent from 
the sky by the goddess.

When you saved us before... Then again... and 
again... and even now...

How could such a savior be a beast?!
The children gathered around Norde.
Norde: You... You shouldn't rely on...
Orphan: The one who saved us?

The one who always shows up when things are
at their worst?
Norde: No... I...
Orphan: Mister Norde. You are our hero.
Norde: ...

You...
Norde's breathing... calmed...

I don't know how long we waited,

The effects of the curse had not faded physically, 
but it was clear a cloud over his mind was fading.
Norde: You... all deserve better.

But...
Norde: Thank you. All of you.
Norde's gaze landed on me as well, 
smile not wavering.
Norde: Perhaps... family can be a blessing... siblings,

Pup: Yeah.
Norde: I just... need... a second...
Norde laid his head back. Falling asleep.
Pup: Norde, do you think you're no better than those

Norde: You act as if it was just them.
His form continued to fluctuate.
Norde: They've never stopped telling me. Just... a beast.
Pup: And what does that make them?
Norde: What...?
Pup: If you're just a beast, what does that make those

How low would they need to fall to make you a

Pup: Norde... You are not a beast.
Pup: I know my father saw you as more than just the average

Norde: ...I don't...
Norde: Urgh...?!
I could still feel the aura of the curse, and it
weakened.
But it did not disappear.

Steam continued to rise.
Norde: It doesn't matter. It never mattered if they were
right.

Beast... person... I've... only wasted the time 
that the goddess gave me.
Norde started breathing faster. 

The worries over any animalistic nature within 
him became meek in comparison to another.
Norde: I failed Ivan. I failed him. How can I ever call myself

Norde's hair grew, in a sight I felt all too familiar.
Hands digging into the dirt... Each tightening of the

The armor started to sag. It no longer fit well, as

Norde's breaths became deeper, and each inhale

Pup: Norde... I'm sorry.
Norde: This is... my stain. My disgrace.

（這可以配置為有確認

你想學習它們嗎？

A-L_開關
S-R_開關
空間 - 跳過
“game.ini”檔案也有多種設定。

設定可用）
我們希望您喜歡這個遊戲！

passages.name: Intro Map - Story
passages.content:
A bedtime story? Hmm...

Have I ever told you two a tale of the 
Oathbreakers? What about the story of 
Eul'minae?
It's an old legend that goes back a millennia.

The great and respected King Minae had two 
subjects placed before him. Each claimed 
parentage of a baby.
But only one could be the true mother of the child. 
So the good king was asked to give judgement.

His edict was to split the babe in two. One half for 
each that claimed to be its mother.

The liar of the two accepted the offer. To avoid 
such tragedy, the other relented the child to the 
former.
Minae then knew the true mother. For such 
disparity of love revealed the latter to be sincere 
in her devotion.
And so comes the name Eul'minae. Named in honor 
of the wisdom King Minae showed to the world 
that day.
Hm? No, it doesn't work in reverse like that. I am 
blessed to have both of you as my children.

No matter what happens in life... No matter what 
person you may become in the future...

That will never change.

Good night, Nikolai.

Good night, Anton.
The continent of Ilvanis.
Year 813 of the modern era.

The Republic of Rabaneau...
Outskirts along the border of 
the Nolvanus Empire.
Ivan: Dead men tell no tales.
Pup: Neither does any man once they've had their 
tongue cut out.
Gk!!
passages.content_zh:
睡前故事？嗯...

我有沒有給你們兩個講過一個故事
背誓者？故事又是怎樣的
尤爾米奈？
這是一個可以追溯到幾千年前的古老傳說。

偉大而受人尊敬的米那國王有兩個
擺在他面前的科目。各聲稱
嬰兒的親子關係。
但只有一個人才能成為孩子真正的母親。 
於是請善良的國王做出判斷。

他的法令是將嬰兒分成兩半。一半為
每一個都自稱是它的母親。

兩人的騙子接受了這個提議。為了避免
發生這樣的悲劇，對方讓孩子屈服了
以前的。
米奈隨後認識了真正的母親。對於這樣的
愛情的懸殊顯示後者是真誠的
在她的奉獻中。
Eul'minae 這個名字由此而來。以榮譽命名
米那國王向世界展示的智慧
那天。
嗯？不，它不能像那樣反向工作。我是
很幸運有你們兩個作為我的孩子。

無論生活中發生什麼...無論發生什麼
你將來可能成為的人...

這永遠不會改變。

晚安，尼古拉。

晚安，安東。
伊爾瓦尼斯大陸。
現代813年。

拉巴諾共和國...
沿著邊境的郊區
諾瓦努斯帝國。
伊凡：死人不會講故事。
小狗：任何人一旦擁有了自己的
舌頭被切掉。
哎呀！ ！

passages.name: First Battle - Bandit (Pup)
passages.content:
Ivan: Remember, Pup. Victory comes on the shoulders of 
the mind, not brawn.

You may not be able to master all weapon types, 
but some have inherent strengths against others.
Pup: I know.
Bandit: Heh. Your "mind" ain't gonna do much when you 
take a few axe swings to your noggin'.
Melee Weapons come in 3 types: swords, lances 
and axes. 

Swords are strong against Axes. 
Axes are strong against Lances.
Lances are strong against Swords. 
You are more likely to hit and avoid weapons that 
you are strong against.
passages.content_zh:
伊凡：記住，孩子。勝利是靠腦袋，不是靠蠻力。

你可能無法精通所有武器類型，但有些武器天生就對其他武器有優勢。
孩子：我知道。
強盜：哼。你的「腦袋」要是挨了幾斧頭，可就沒啥用了。
近戰武器有 3 種：劍、長槍和斧頭。

劍剋斧頭。
斧頭剋長槍。
長槍剋劍。
你更有可能擊中並閃避你所剋制的武器。

passages.name: First Battle - Intro Text
passages.content:
Satia: Pupils dilated. An increased rate of breathing.
Satia: I think it safe to say that this man is no professional.
Pup: A tongue that lacks experience is one fresh for 
harvest.
I took a step towards the bandit as I did my best 
to project confidence.
Satia: *Giggles*
Pup: Satia... Don't just...
Bandit Leader: ...
Ivan: Now now, Pup. It isn't as though his yapper is 
hiding any silver.
Ivan: What my young comrade means to say is that we 
are not being paid for if you talk or not.

We were hired to "take care" of the local bandits. 
Nothing more. Nothing less.
Ivan took a step forward, and the bandit's face
twitched in dismay.
Bandit Leader: N- Not a step closer...
Ivan: This discussion wouldn't be happening if your 
untimely end had to fall on today of all days.

Please, tell us what you can about your fellows. 
We can all walk away from this alive.
Bandit Leader: ...

Heheh... hehehehe...
Pup: What? He's... laughing?
Ivan: ...
Bandit Leader: Now! Attack!
And...
Nothing.
Bandit Leader: ...!
Bandit Leader: Fools! Attack! Attack now! That was your chance!
Silence persisted.
Pup: W- Was this a trap?!
Satia: Yet his entire company abandoned him? How sad.
Bandit Leader: Fucking useless, the lot of them! What point is 
there in setting an ambush if-
A nearby part of the forest rustled.
Bandit Leader: Finally you lot are here. Get-

...

Where are the rest you useless maggots!?
Bandit: Boss, you wouldn't believe what we... found...

...Did... Did you get captured? ...Again?
Bandit Leader: Cornered! I. Am. Cornered!

Did you idiots just FORGET the damn trap?
Bandit: Uh... but boss, we found the-
Bandit Leader: No excuses! I'll have a finger from all of you if even 
a hair on my head is harmed due to your 
incompetence!
Pup: *Sigh*... They've got a bit of a comedy routine 
going, don't they?
Satia: I imagine it must help restore the levity after a 
long day of raiding and pillaging.
Bandit Leader: Shut it you fuckin' gold munchers!

You there, maggot! Break their formation!
Bandit: Heh. Yeah, yeah. I can take the runt.
Ivan: Pup.
Pup: Tsk... I know.
Win Condition: Defeat the Bandit. 

Lose Condition: Pup gets killed.
passages.content_zh:
薩蒂亞：瞳孔放大。呼吸頻率加快。
薩蒂亞：我認為可以肯定地說這個人不是專業人士。
小狗：缺乏經驗的舌頭是新鮮的
收穫。
我盡全力向強盜邁出了一步
展現信心。
薩蒂亞：*咯咯笑*
小狗：薩蒂亞……別只是……
強盜首領：…
伊凡：現在，現在，小狗。看來他的咆哮並不是
隱藏任何銀子。
伊凡：我年輕的同志的意思是，我們
無論您是否說話，都不會獲得報酬。

我們被雇來「照顧」當地的土匪。 
而已。一點也沒有少。
伊凡向前一步，強盜的臉
驚愕地抽搐。
強盜首領：不、還沒有更近一步…
伊凡：如果你的
不合時宜的結局不得不落在所有日子中的今天。

請告訴我們您對您的同事的了解。 
我們都可以活著離開這一切。
強盜首領：…

呵呵……呵呵呵……
小狗：什麼？他在……笑？
伊凡：…
強盜頭子：現在！攻擊！
還有...
什麼也沒有。
強盜首領：……！
強盜首領：笨蛋！攻擊！現在攻擊！那是你的機會！
沉默持續著。
小狗：這－－這是個陷阱嗎？ ！
薩蒂亞：然而他的整個公司都拋棄了他？多麼悲傷啊。
強盜頭目：一群人真他媽沒用！什麼點是
如果——
附近的森林傳來沙沙作響的聲音。
強盜首領：你們終於來了。得到-

…

你們這些無用的蛆蟲，剩下的去哪了？
強盜：老大，你不會相信我們...發現了什麼...

……你……你被俘虜了嗎？ ……再一次？
強盜首領：走投無路！我是。走投無路！

你們這些白痴忘了那個該死的陷阱嗎？
強盜：呃……但是老大，我們發現了——
強盜首領：沒有藉口！我會得到你們所有人的一根手指，即使
我的一根頭髮因為你而受傷
無能！
小狗：*嘆氣*...他們有一點喜劇套路
去吧，不是嗎？
薩蒂亞：我想這一定有助於恢復一段輕鬆的時光。 
漫長的一天的襲擊和掠奪。
強盜首領：閉嘴，你們這些該死的金嚼子！

你在那兒，蛆蟲！打破他們的格式

passages.name: First Battle - First Turn
passages.content:
Pup: Hmph. You picked the wrong "runt" to die to.
Satia: Go get 'em, killer!
Pup: S- Satia! You're not helping!
Satia: You say that, but aren't you the one who 
volunteered to be the "bad cop" today?
Pup: I... J- Just let me work, please?
Pup: (Now what have we got to contend with...?)
Pup: (He doesn't look all that strong and it's a 1 v. 1
fight... I can do this.)
Battle! Watch out, the man is out for your head!

First you need to know how to move. Use the 
cursor/mouse to select your units (like Pup). From 
there, you can select a space in range to move.
For attacking, choose the attack option. There will 
be a small result preview. Keep the damage done 
to you to a minimum!
When you're out of units to use, left click and 
select "End" to continue on. This can be configured
to be automatic in the config menu.
passages.content_zh:
Pup: 哼。你選錯了「小不點」來送死。
Satia: 上啊，殺手！
Pup: 莎...莎緹亞！妳這不是在幫倒忙嗎！
Satia: 你是這麼說沒錯啦，但今天自願當「黑臉」的
不就是你嗎？
Pup: 我... 我只是想好好工作，可以嗎？
Pup: (現在我們得應付什麼東西...？)
Pup: (他看起來沒有很強，而且是1對1
的戰鬥... 我可以的。)
戰鬥！小心，那傢伙想取你項上人頭！

首先你需要知道如何移動。使用
游標/滑鼠來選擇你的單位（像是Pup）。從
那裡，你可以選擇一個範圍內的空格來移動。
要攻擊的話，選擇攻擊選項。會有
一個小小的結果預覽。盡量減少你受到的
傷害！
當你沒有單位可以用的時候，點擊滑鼠左鍵
並選擇「結束」來繼續。這個可以在設定
選單中設定成自動。

passages.name: First Battle - Second Turn
passages.content:
Rounds are divided in 3 Phases: your turn, the 
enemy's and the ally's in that order. 

Each group will only move in their associated 
phases, so plan your moves accordingly.
passages.content_zh:
回合分為 3 個階段：你的回合、
敵人和盟友的順序是這樣的。 

每個組別只會在其關聯的區域中移動
階段，因此相應地計劃您的行動。

passages.name: First Battle - Win Triggered
passages.content:
Satia: Everything in working order?
Pup: There's some whiplash and stinging, but nothing 
that won't heal.
Ivan: Now. I believe we were discussing the terms of a 
peaceful surrender.
Ivan: At least as peaceful as this situation can be at this 
point.
Bandit Leader: Grr...
Ivan: It may be worth noting that I will not ask again. 
Wasting our time is no longer on the table.
The man looked every which way for a sign of his 
other comrades.

We gave him a minute, but the silence slowly was 
replaced with the low hum of his whine.
Bandit Leader: F- Fine... I yield.
passages.content_zh:
莎提亞：一切都運作正常嗎？
小傢伙：有些揮鞭傷和刺痛感，但沒什麼
不會痊癒的。
伊凡：現在。我想我們正在討論
和平投降的條件。
伊凡：至少就目前情況而言，盡可能
和平的投降。
盜匪首領：唔...
伊凡：或許值得注意的是，我不會再問第二次。
浪費我們的時間已經不在選項之中。
那個人四處張望，尋找他
其他同夥的蹤跡。

我們給了他一分鐘，但沉默漸漸地被
他低聲的哀鳴所取代。
盜匪首領：好... 好吧... 我投降。

passages.name: First Battle - Choice part
passages.content:
Pup: And...
Rope coarsely strained against my palm, and the 
knot around the man's wrists went taut.
Pup: There we go.
The man uttered obscenities under his breath, and 
the three of us surrounded him at a short distance.
Ivan: Let's make this simple. Name and company?
Bandit Leader: My name is the last thing you lot are getting. I can 
see the wanted posters already...
Satia: A shame. Nameless graves are often a sad sight.
Ivan: I suppose a name doesn't matter all that much.
Ivan: But you are a commanding officer of the Hell's 
Raisers mercenary corp, yes?
Bandit Leader: ...What of it?
Ivan: "What of it?"... You've made few friends in the 
past few weeks.
Ivan: Raiding... Pillaging... Though I guess that in itself is 
nothing new to you.
Pup: It's got the local governors in a panic. That much is 
certain.
Ivan: Something most would avoid. It's why the typical 
bandit raiding corp avoids staying in one place 
too long.
Ivan: I imagine you can tell where I am going with this? 
What we were hired to do?
Bandit Leader: Hmph. I thought you wanted me to sell out my 
fellow "bandits"?
Pup: (Is this guy really more willing to sell out 
his comrades than just admit what they 
were up to here?)
Pup: ...
With a few steps, I pulled my father to the side.
Pup: Let me try.
Ivan: You don't have to.
Pup: ...
Ivan: ...Very well.
Pup: Don't worry. I can do this.
Satia: Be wary over your approach. You came into this 
wanting to use it as training, after all.

It's the little things that influence how you develop 
as a warrior. As a person.

How you carry yourself will bleed into your view of 
every aspect of the world in due time.
Pup: (Yeah, but I just need to do what works. If it gets 
me results, then I'll gladly take that route.)
Choices for Pup are choices on how he approaches 
certain types of conflict.

NOTE: They will always be in this order: 
Diplomatic, Charismatic, Aggressive. 

-Diplomatic- 
Attempt to get people to compromise on solutions.

-Charismatic- 
Attempt to charm and persuade people to 
your solution.
-Aggressive- 
Use force to place priority on your solution.

These choices will pop up in the story every so 
often. Eventually, the summation of these choices 
will determine minor story and gameplay deviations.
Pup: (How to approach this...?)
I turned on my heel to place myself in front of the 
bandit.
[Choice]:  Appeal to a common goal of continued life for all /  Persuade him to work with your group / Threaten more than just his own health
Pup: You keep surprising me. Whatever it is you're after 
over your own life? 

What sort of priority is that?
Bandit Leader: You don't actually care about what I'm looking for.
Pup: How would I know? I don't know what
it is.
Pup: Not that I don't want to just take a hot bath at 
this point. Much better than getting another axe 
swung my way.
Bandit Leader: I mean it. You don't care about it. You just think 
you do because you've got gold on the line.
Pup: Then what's so hard about just telling us. If it's 
nothing to us then it's nothing to us.

Better yet. Then we can all go home for that hot 
bath and plenty of our life still to live.
Bandit Leader: You're not very subtle, runt. Even for me.

You think it's clever to have identified that I want 
to live?

Fuck man... How did that idiot lose to you, 
hahaha...
Pup: You keep surprising me. It's a weird thing to throw 
your life away for.
Bandit Leader: You don't actually care about what I'm looking for.
Pup: Of course I don't.

I don't know exactly what it is, but what little I 
heard before doesn't make it sound like it's worth 
your life.
Bandit Leader: Might be worth your life... heh...
Pup: Maybe we could go half and half, then?

That's not actually a horrible idea. Working 
together? It certainly could save a few gray hairs on 
my father's head.
Bandit Leader: You're not very subtle, runt. Even for me.

You think you're clever? "Work together"? Give 
me a break.

Fuck man... How did that idiot lose to you, 
hahaha...
Pup: Talk.
Bandit Leader: Already told you I'd tell you anything you'd want to 
know about those dumbasses.
Pup: Fine. How about this?
Pup: Tell me the person in your corp that
truly means something to you.
Bandit Leader: Heh? What are you going on about now?
Pup: Truly you're not going to say you don't even have 
a friend in that group? One who you'll miss? 
That'll miss you?
Bandit Leader: How dare you... You monster...
Pup: Exactly. Wouldn't it be best if we could just not-
Bandit Leader: Ha! That was what you wanted me to say, wasn't 
it?
Pup: What... Don't just...
Bandit Leader: You're not very subtle, runt. Even for me.

You're trying to threaten a merc with hurting 
his friends? How soft hearted.

Fuck man... How did that idiot lose to you, 
hahaha...
Pup: ...?!
Bandit Leader: Final offer. I give you info on the rest of those 
deadbeats and you let me walk.

Heheh... We both know you can't walk away 
empty handed.
Pup: ...
I briskly took several steps forward before 
grabbing the man's collar.

As I pulled in the man, an arm split us apart.
Ivan: Now now, Pup.
Bandit Leader: Should've sent the lass. She might've put a blade 
to my throat, haha!
Satia: ...I still might.
Bandit Leader: Offer one more time and I might be into then, 
sweetie.
Ivan: What did I say before about wasting our time? We-
Once more, we heard a rumbling from the forest 
around.
Satia: More of these bandits?
Ivan: ...
Pup: (Whatever it is, it's getting closer...)
Ivan: Satia. Pup.
passages.content_zh:
小狗：還有…
繩子粗魯地拉緊我的手掌，
男人手腕上的結繃緊了。
小狗：我們走吧。
男子低聲說出髒話，
我們三個人在不遠處圍住了他。
伊凡：讓我們簡單一點。姓名和公司？
強盜首領：我的名字是你們最後得到的。我可以
已經看到通緝海報了…
薩蒂亞：真遺憾。無名的墳墓常常是令人悲傷的景象。
伊凡：我想名字沒那麼重要。
伊凡：但你是地獄的指揮官
Raisers傭兵團是嗎？
強盜首領：……那又怎樣？
伊凡：「那又怎樣？」…你在這圈子裡交不到幾個朋友。 
過去幾週。
伊凡：襲擊……掠奪……雖然我猜這本身就是
對你來說沒什麼新鮮的。
Pup：這讓當地的州長們陷入了恐慌。這麼多就是
確定。
伊凡：大多數人會避免的事情。這就是為什麼典型的
強盜襲擊公司避免留在一個地方
太長了。
伊凡：我想你能知道我要說什麼嗎？ 
我們被雇來做什麼？
匪首：哼。我以為你想讓我賣掉我的
同胞「土匪」？
Pup：（這傢伙真的比較願意出賣嗎？
他的同志們不只是承認他們的所作所為
到這裡了嗎？ ）
小狗：…
我走了幾步，把父親拉到了一邊。
小狗：讓我試試。
伊凡：你不必這麼做。
小狗：…
伊凡：……很好。
小狗：別擔心。我可以做到這一點。
Satia：對你的做法要小心。你來到了這個
畢竟想用它作為訓練。

這些小事會影響你的發展
作為一名戰士。作為一個人。

你的表現方式將會滲透到你的視野中
世界的各個面向都在適當的時候。
Pup：（是的，但我只需要做有效的事。如果它成功了
我的結果，那麼我很樂意採取那條路。 ）
Pup 的選擇是他如何接近的選擇
某些類型的衝突。

注意：它們始終按以下順序排列：
外交、魅力、進取。 

-外交-
嘗試讓人們在解決方案上妥協。

-魅力-
嘗試炭化

passages.name: Pup - Dead
passages.content:
Pup: Goddess damn you!

I... I... can't fall here.... Not
now... Not yet... Not with so much
left undone...
passages.content_zh:
小狗：女神你他媽的！

我……我……不能倒在這裡……不能
現在...還沒有...沒有那麼多
未完成...

passages.name: Pup - Dead
passages.content:
Pup: This... This is the end?

So many hopes... So many dreams...
Please, see them through,
everyone...
passages.content_zh:
Pup：這……這就是結局了？

太多的希望…太多的夢想…
請看清他們，
大家...

passages.name: Pup - Dead
passages.content:
Pup: This view... This ending...

This is not the dream I grasped for.
Clawed for... No, this is... this
is...
passages.content_zh:
小狗：這景色... 這結局...

這不是我所追求的夢想。
奮力抓取的... 不，這是... 這是...

passages.name: Pup - Injured
passages.content:
Pup: Goddess damn you!

I... I... can't fall here.... Not
now... Not yet... Not with so much
left undone...
passages.content_zh:
小鬼：女神在上！

我... 我... 不能倒在這裡.... 不能
現在... 還不能... 還有這麼多
事情沒做...

passages.name: Pup - Injured
passages.content:
Pup: This... This is the end?

So many hopes... So many dreams...
Please, see them through,
everyone...
passages.content_zh:
Pup：這……這就是結局了？

太多的希望…太多的夢想…
請看清他們，
大家...

passages.name: Pup - Injured
passages.content:
Pup: This view... This ending...

This is not the dream I grasped for.
Clawed for... No, this is... this
is...
passages.content_zh:
Pup：這景色…這個結局…

這不是我所追求的夢想。
抓來的……不，這是……這個
是…

passages.name: Ivan - Dead
passages.content:
Ivan: I will not fall here! I- I cannot...

Anton... still needs a guiding hand... Please... 
Please let me... do one last good thing...
passages.content_zh:
伊凡：我不會倒在這裡！我...我不能...

安東...仍然需要一隻引導的手...拜託...
拜託讓我...做最後一件好事...

passages.name: Jakson - Dead
passages.content:
Jakson: *Whines in pain*...!
Pup: Boy, no... Jakson... No...!
Pup: You bastards! I'll never forgive you!
passages.content_zh:
Jakson: *痛苦地呻吟*...！
Pup: 不行，孩子... Jakson... 不...！
Pup: 你們這些混蛋！我永遠不會原諒你們！

passages.name: Jakson - Injured
passages.content:
Jakson: *Whines in pain*...!
Pup: Boy, get to safety! We can take it from here!
passages.content_zh:
傑克森：*痛苦地哀嚎*…！
小狗：孩子，到安全的地方去！我們可以從這裡拿走它！

passages.name: Norde - Dead
passages.content:
Norde: No... No... Not now... Ngh...
Norde: I must... retreat... to keep our
promise.
passages.content_zh:
Norde：不……不……現在不行……呃……
Norde：我必須…撤退…以保住我們的
承諾。

passages.name: Norde - Dead
passages.content:
Norde: No... No... Not now... Ngh...
Norde: Ivan... I promised you. I will keep Anton safe. But I 
must retire to see that promise through.
passages.content_zh:
諾德：不... 不... 現在不行... 唔...
諾德：伊凡... 我答應過你。我會保護安東的安全。但我必須退隱才能實現那個承諾。

passages.name: Norde - Injured
passages.content:
Norde: No... No... Not now... Ngh...
Norde: I must... retreat... to keep our
promise.
passages.content_zh:
諾德：不... 不... 現在不行... 唔...
諾德：我必須... 撤退... 為了遵守我們的
約定。

passages.name: Norde - Injured
passages.content:
Norde: No... No... Not now... Ngh...
Norde: Ivan... I promised you. I will keep Anton safe. But I 
must retire to see that promise through.
passages.content_zh:
Norde：不……不……現在不行……呃……
Norde：伊凡……我答應過你的。我會保證安東的安全。但我
必須退休才能兌現這項承諾。

passages.name: Satia - Dead
passages.content:
Satia: Blood... That is a lot of blood. Ngh... So much more 
than normal...
Satia: It'll be okay, my little Pup... You're... You're not so 
little anymore...
passages.content_zh:
莎緹雅：血...好多血啊。唔...比平常還要多這麼多...
莎緹雅：會沒事的，我的小崽子...你...你已經不再那麼小了...

passages.name: Satia - Injured
passages.content:
Satia: I need to get to safety. Pup, you'll be fine. You 
will.
passages.content_zh: 莎提亞：我需要去安全的地方。小傢伙，你會沒事的。你會的。

passages.name: Rowan - Dead
passages.content:
Rowan: That was a clever... clever move of yours... I'm 
impressed.
Rowan: At least... At least I could see my end... with just 
that one lingering regret...
passages.content_zh:
羅文：那是你的聰明……聰明的舉動……我是
印象深刻。
羅文：至少……至少我能看到自己的結局……只要
那一樁揮之不去的遺憾…

passages.name: Rowan - Injured
passages.content:
Rowan: That was a clever... clever move of yours... I'm 
impressed.
Rowan: At least... At least I could see my end... with just 
that one lingering regret...
passages.content_zh:
羅文：那是你的聰明……聰明的舉動……我是
印象深刻。
羅文：至少……至少我能看到自己的結局……只要
那一樁揮之不去的遺憾…

passages.name: Kara - Dead
passages.content:
Kara: Wait... Am I... Am I actually...?
Kara: To think. Here of all places... After all this... all 
this...
passages.content_zh:
卡拉：等等... 難道... 難道我真的...?
卡拉：真不敢相信。竟然會是在這種地方... 經歷了這一切... 這一切...

passages.name: Kara - Injured
passages.content:
Kara: That truly stings... If I do not have these treated, 
then... I must retreat.
passages.content_zh:
卡拉：這真的痛徹心扉... 如果我不趕快治療，
那麼... 我必須撤退了。

passages.name: Charlotte - Dead
passages.content:
Charlotte: I... will not go down this easily!
Charlotte: Ngh!
Charlotte: Crap... this is actually it, isn't it?
passages.content_zh:
夏洛特：我……不會輕易倒下的！
夏洛特：呃！
夏洛特：糟糕……實際上就是這樣，不是嗎？

passages.name: Charlotte - Injured
passages.content:
Charlotte: I... will not go down this easily!
Charlotte: Ngh!
Charlotte: Crap... this is actually it, isn't it?
passages.content_zh:
夏洛特：我……不會輕易倒下的！
夏洛特：呃！
夏洛特：糟糕……實際上就是這樣，不是嗎？

passages.name: Mariel - Dead
passages.content:
Mariel: Ah... It- It hurts...

Charlotte, please keep pushing forward... I know 
you...
Mariel: I know you'll be great.
passages.content_zh:
瑪麗耶爾：啊... 好... 好痛...

夏洛特，請繼續前進... 我知道妳...
瑪麗耶爾：我知道妳會很棒的。

passages.name: Mariel - Injured
passages.content:
Mariel: Ah... That really hurts. O- Ow... This means I need 
to retreat, right?
passages.content_zh: 瑪麗耶爾：啊... 真的好痛。喔... 喔... 這代表我需要撤退，對吧？

passages.name: Jenny - Dead
passages.content:
Jenny: Well... I guess it's game over. 

I wonder if I will get back home.
passages.content_zh:
珍妮：嗯……我想遊戲結束了。 

我想知道我是否會回家。

passages.name: Jenny - Injured
passages.content:
Jenny: Anothis always said better safe than dead. Good 
luck everyone else!
passages.content_zh:
珍妮：阿諾西斯總是說安全總比死了好。好
其他人都好運！

passages.name: Eve - Dead
passages.content:
Eve: So I'm dying again? How many worlds does this 
make this now?

At least I did some good in my short time here. I 
wonder... if I'll get to meet that Goddess again?
passages.content_zh:
Eve: 所以我又死了？這已經是第幾個世界了？

至少我在這短暫的時間裡做了一些好事。我在想... 我還能再見到那位女神嗎？

passages.name: Eve - Injured
passages.content:
Eve: Ah, I don't want to die... again! Sorry everyone. I 
need to get to safety for now.
passages.content_zh: Eve: 啊，我不想再死一次了... 抱歉各位。我現在需要先去安全的地方。

passages.name: Macy - Dead
passages.content:
Macy: Time for Cypher to beam me back in... but why... 
does it feel... cold...?
passages.content_zh:
梅西：是時候讓 Cypher 給我回訊息了…但是為什麼…
是不是感覺……冷……？

passages.name: Macy - Injured
passages.content:
Macy: Time for Cypher to beam me back in... oh, right... 
retreating is going to be harder without her.
passages.content_zh:
梅西：該是賽博把我傳送回去的時候了...喔，對了...
沒有她的話，撤退會變得更困難。

passages.name: Bennett - Dead
passages.content:
Bennett: Crap... I guess this makes sense for it to end this 
way...
Bennett: I just... hope I didn't make it worse before... 
before...
passages.content_zh:
Bennett：糟糕……我想結束這一切是有道理的
方式...
Bennett：我只是…希望我之前沒有讓事情變得更糟…
之前...

passages.name: Bennett - Injured
passages.content:
Bennett: Crap, this now? Maybe I can...? No, I don't think 
they'll let me. I have to retreat.
passages.content_zh: 班尼特：可惡，現在來這招？或許我可以...？不行，他們不會讓我這麼做的。我得撤退。

passages.name: Liebra - Dead
passages.content:
Liebra: Hmph... So these are the limits of this constructed 
body...?
Liebra: Ah... I wished to see the end of this story...
passages.content_zh:
Liebra：哼……所以這些就是這個構造的極限
身體……？
Liebra：啊……我想看這個故事的結局……

passages.name: Liebra - Injured
passages.content:
Liebra: Hmph... So these are the limits of this constructed 
body...?
Liebra: Then, to see the end of this story, I must retreat...
passages.content_zh:
Liebra: 哼... 這就是這具人造軀體的極限了嗎...?
Liebra: 那麼，為了見證這個故事的結局，我必須撤退了...

passages.name: Jude - Dead
passages.content:
Jude: *Pant*... S- Shit... This isn’t... worth it...
Jude: I just... wanted...

...one more taste...
passages.content_zh:
裘德：*氣喘吁籲*...操-操...這不...值得...
裘德：我只是…想要…

....再嚐一口...

passages.name: Jude - Injured
passages.content:
Jude: *Pant*... This isn’t worth the
payment at this point.
Jude: Sorry... but gotta retreat.
passages.content_zh:
裘德： *喘氣*... 這點錢根本不值得
我這樣拼命...
裘德： 抱歉... 但我得撤退了。

passages.name: Cainan - Dead
passages.content:
Cainan: Argh! That... stings...
Cainan: It seems I must... pull back for now. Apologies for 
this embarrassment.
passages.content_zh:
凱南：啊啊！那個……刺痛……
彩南：看來我必須……暫時撤退了。抱歉
這種尷尬。

passages.name: Cainan - Injured
passages.content:
Cainan: Argh! That... stings...
Cainan: It seems I must... pull back for now. Apologies for 
this embarrassment.
passages.content_zh:
凱南：啊！這...真刺痛...
凱南：看來我必須...暫時撤退了。為這場狼狽致歉。

passages.name: Tatiana - Dead
passages.content:
Tatiana: You think I'd- I'd...
Tatiana: ...I'd go down... that... that... eas...i...ly...
passages.content_zh:
塔提阿娜：你以為我會...我會...
塔提阿娜：...我會這麼...這麼...輕...易...地...倒下...

passages.name: Tatiana - Dead
passages.content:
Tatiana: I... I'm not gonna die to these assholes. They're 
not... not worth it!
passages.content_zh:
塔蒂亞娜：我……我不會死在這些混蛋麵前。他們是
不……不值得！

passages.name: Otis - Dead
passages.content:
Otis: Y- You think... You think this could take me 
down..?!
Otis: *Gasping cough*! ...Wait... This... No, this isn't... 
this isn't funny...!
passages.content_zh:
奧蒂斯：你-你認為...你認為這會帶走我
下來..？ ！
奧蒂斯：*氣喘吁籲*！ ……等等……這……不，這不是……
這不好笑...！

passages.name: Otis - Injured
passages.content:
Otis: You... Argh! Fine, I'll maim ya later ya asshats!
Otis: *Gasping cough*! ...Wait... This... No, this isn't... 
this isn't funny...!
passages.content_zh:
奧提斯：你... 呃啊！ 好啦，我等等再把你們這些混帳東西給打殘！
奧提斯：*喘息咳嗽*！ ...等等... 這... 不... 這一點都不...
這一點都不好笑...！

passages.name: Reagyn - Dead
passages.content:
Reagyn: This... This is just... a flesh wound...
Reagyn: I can keep... can keep... going...
passages.content_zh:
Reagyn: 這...這只不過是...皮肉傷...
Reagyn: 我可以繼續...可以繼續...撐下去...

passages.name: Reagyn - Injured
passages.content:
Reagyn: Curse you... This is just a flesh wound, but... Fine, I 
will retreat!
passages.content_zh:
Reagyn：詛咒你……這只是皮肉傷，但……好吧，我
會撤退！

passages.name: Flynn - Dead
passages.content:
Flynn: O- Ow... No, this one feels... a bit...
Flynn: Haha... Of course I messed up. Everyone... finish 
it...!
passages.content_zh:
Flynn：噢-噢...不，這個感覺...有點...
Flynn：哈哈……我當然搞砸了。大家…完成
它……！

passages.name: Flynn - Injured
passages.content:
Flynn: Curses... Of course I messed up. I can't die here, 
though! I'll retreat.
passages.content_zh: 弗林：可惡... 果然還是搞砸了。但我不能死在這裡！我撤退。

passages.name: Elliot - Dead
passages.content:
Elliot: *Cough*... Just... one more...

...one... More... shot...!

passages.name: Elliot - Injured
passages.content:
Elliot: *Cough*... Is that... no...
Elliot: I have to retreat? I’m sorry... mother... father...
passages.content_zh:
Elliot：*咳嗽*...那是...不...
艾略特：我必須撤退嗎？對不起……媽媽……爸爸……

passages.name: Castel - Dead
passages.content:
Castel: T- To think... Bested here?
Castel: T- This isn't the end... *cough*... I... I... I won't 
give... up... yet...!
passages.content_zh:
卡斯特爾：怎、怎麼會... 在這裡被打敗了？
卡斯特爾：這、這還不是結束... *咳*... 我... 我... 我還不會... 放棄... 的...！

passages.name: Castel - Injured
passages.content: Castel: Bested here? Oh well, I guess I must retreat.
passages.content_zh: Castel：在這裡表現最好？哦，好吧，我想我必須撤退了。

passages.name: Atticus - Dead
passages.content:
Atticus: This... is it? Hmm... I wasn’t expecting it to... 
end... here...
Atticus: Marya, Lefen, Euna, Pelus, Xavier... Live wonderful 
lives.
passages.content_zh:
阿提克斯：這...就是這裡了嗎？嗯...我沒想到會...
在這裡...結束...
阿提克斯：瑪雅、雷芬、尤娜、佩魯斯、賽維爾...好好地活下去。

passages.name: Atticus - Injured
passages.content:
Atticus: Augh... That’s... about as far as I can go.
Atticus: Apologies. For my left side not being able to... keep 
up. I need to retreat.
passages.content_zh:
阿蒂克斯：啊……我只能說這麼多了。
阿蒂克斯：抱歉。因為我的左側無法...保持
起來。我需要撤退。
